tei:div.tei:p: hā:bye ni gu/ 1 bca 'ab 3777ne bya 8330lung0606ba 'ang 505 5 3 3 17 bci kho migaXng khukhu po khor
khri:
༷ (4 1 bye — — — —1 tho— brdza kyi / phyo //nga /— — —4 gdu sgo 4 4 ḍa

dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi/ rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'jom gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khyab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched bcugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur nyi dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gzhas/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'grel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying /'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / sbyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las dar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib la jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser ga khug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba 6pa'i tshes 7la/3

bsna/sgrig gab55 nga trend/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang bcal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos chan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / g.yin yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa' gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhi kha bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags (kan 6) rtoganakhong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags 6) 'a) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (ja spu (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags6) stergyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags 6)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags (tha)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags smyon)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (phen ste 'dul ba'i

snyelas chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags (ba)ste bstod tsho gos dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (5) (mo) 'a spu ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza)ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)sde bka' brgyad bde po khri shegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (ba)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma rtong)sde le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañdza mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du lañdza 'a yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdas rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang / tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'chams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ rmad la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes 'a na brgyar zhu'o/ /ser ra khri go nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15 la/

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ ratna'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i ste'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi bande zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'khrungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sgrul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'khrungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol ba chin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gzhis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab lha/ga brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs bod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tsho thabasdu phyog sgrig khang nas/0

dkar chagaphyogs bcu'i bde gshegs byang sems slob mi slob kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ (1)rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bstod pa ta'i ra'i rgyud mang / (36)yon tan gyi gzhi rten bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len gyi rim pa zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (43)bla ma'i rnal 'byor bla ma dang spyan ras gzigs dbyer med du sgrub pa dge legs kyi gter mdzod sogs/ (44)bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs/ (51)snying po don gsum gyi 'khrid kyi dmigs rim ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas sogs/ (76)mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (161)slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas sogs 'phags bod kyi bla ma rnams la bstod pa/ (201)kun mkhyen bu ston chos rje'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs sogs/ (256)'khrungs rabs kyi zhing bkod 'dri tshul gyi rtogs brjod kha byang dang bcas pa gsal ba'i me 31nga (414)snyan mgur gsang gsum yid bzhin char 'bebs (429)lam yig rang gzugs gsal ston dri bral me long / (432)1

phan bde'i rtsa lag jo shāka rnams kyi brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga mi 'gyur g.yung drung / (450)smon lam chen mo'i dam bca'i skabs kyi ma ṇi bskul rgyu'i tshigs bcad brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa (460)ja mchod kyi rim pa bcud mchog nam mkha' mdzod kyi dga' ston/ (463)phun tshogs 'dod dgu ma sogs ja mchod kyi skor bzhugs so/ (470)

rgya ra dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshetu dge ba'i dngos po'i nor 'dzin khyon las legs 'khrungs stobs bcu'i yongs 'du sa brtol g.yur za'i bris/ /srid 'di'i lnga bdo'i nags klung stug po'i nyes pa'i tshogs 'joms 'gro ba'i bla ma bu ram shing pa rtag tu rgyal/ 3 /skal bzang dpyid kyi ma ma'i mngal khur las/ /rigs kyis mngon mtho shākya'i dga' tshal cher/ /mtshan bzang dpag bsam gsar pa yongs 'du'i dbang / /srid pa'i nags klung dbus na mngon par mtho/ 4 /gsang tshig rigs nying nge 'dzin gyi gzugs can/ pa smra ba'i 'khrul 'khor lces/ /don ldan brjod pa'i nyams 'gyur sgyu ma'i gar/ /spyod tshul bla na mkhas pa'i mdzad pa yis/ /rgan po kun kyang 'phyang mo'i drwa bar chud/ 5 dga' ba sgeg pa'i nyams ldan/ /nai le'u dang po don gsal gyi rgyan/ rañdza nye she la'i (2ba)stegs bu gang / /brnag nus phyi rol gyur pa rdo rje gdan/ /'jigs bral spo der char dus margad kyi/ /gnyen lhug lo ma'i phon po mchog tu 'jam/ 6 /log par glags blta bdud dpung sngon gyi lha/ /thun gsum g.yo med ting 'dzin nyag phran gyis/ /lhag mar byas tshe gtsug na zla ba yang / /skyengs te gangs ri'i phag tu 'gog par mnal/ 7 /blangs na bde ster chos kyi bdud rtsi'i ros/ /dgra bcom mngon rab rtog gzugs can/ gyur bden mthong 'phags pa'i yul/ khyab tshe gser ldan lus phra rang gi ltor/ /sgo/nga min 'gyur snyam skrag ste cung zad 'dar/ 8 /phun sems med rab rtog /tshogs lta na sdug pa'i grong khyer na/phul byung rab rtog /skye ba'i las sngon ched du gshegs pa'i tshe/ /sprin 'byung lang tsho dar ba'i legs byas kun/ /dus ston gsar pa'i mgron du 'ongs sam snyam/ 9 /cha shas gzugs can dang ting nge 'dzin/ legs ldan gter gyi 'byung gnas dka' thub slar/ /tshad du gzhal dka'i rdzu 'phrul nyin byed gzis/ /ston par khas 'che'i sde drug me khyer tshogs/ /rmeg med gyur pas phan bde'i 'dab stong 'dzum/ 10 /gzhom cha shas gzugs can/ du med pa'i zho 'thung rus pa'i dpyid/ /gsang ba'i rang bzhin rdo rje'i gzugs kyi sku/ /myang 'das grong khyer chen po'i dbyings gzims pa/ /'khrul 'gra'i snang ba'i me long ngos su shar/ 11 /cung zad bstod pa'i nor cha shas gzugs can/ bu dbang gi rgyal/ /bde legs rgyal mtshan rtse mor mngon 'bar ba'i/ /phul byung dngos grub 'dod dgu'i gru char gyis/ /srid gsum dbyig 'dzin khyon 'dir rgyas gyur —2 —

bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ (bdacig12 /ces rnam 'dren thub pa'i dbang po la bstod pa bla na med pa'i bdud rtsi'i (3na)zil mngar zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang nyid kyi dad pa'i sos su za hor gyi rigs las shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjes/ 'gro ba'i bla ma bu ram shing pa zhes pa lcags sprel lor bltams nas lo nyis stong drug brgya dang nyag ma gsum 'das pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu mo lug gi lo sprin bzang gi zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la skyid shod sman ljongs kyi yul gru dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /rgya gar skad du/ lha gi shā ro da zhi sur su:sta tra braha sa su sha pta su ro ma te ni dhi rkakho nā ma/ bod skad du/ ngag gi dbang phyug lha mo dbyangs can ma la bstod pa tshangs sras bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs blo gros kyi gter mdzod ces bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dbyangs ldan ma'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'chal lo//rab brjid arka brtsegs pa gyen 'phyur bcu gnyis bdag po'i 'od rnon lan brgyar gyon pas 'gran pa'i go skabs ring du rab spangs khyim zla'i sku/ /gdangs snyan tambu ra yi rgyud mang skyengs byed sgra 'dzin dam pa'i shing rta cher 'ong tsam gyis gzhal med dga' bder rab spyod tshangs pa'i gsung / /ji snyed shes bya'i tshogs kun 'bras ldan dus kyi kun gsal lam la chu srin grong khyer dga' byed dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs ltar gsal ba'i thugs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur dran pa tsam gyis blo gros snang ba mchog stsol rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la gus pas 'dud/ 1 /rab yangs lta na sdug pa'i pho brang dbus/ /rab dkar sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan bzhad pa'i steng / /rab gang gnyis skyes bdag po'i (3ba)dkyil 'khor rtser/ /rab mdzes 'dren byed bdud rtsi gsar pa yi/ 2 /gang sku dkar 'jam yid 'ongs mdzes pa la/ /mtshan bzang lang tsho'i dpal gyis spud pa 'di/ /mthong bas ke la sha yi sa 'dzin dag /ma bzod gnod sbyin phyogs su mngon par bros/ 3 /'dren byed lta bas mi ngoms khyod zhal la/ /'od dkar can mtshungs smra ba nges par brdzun/ /bden na skabs gsum bdag po'i gnam ru ltar/ /ma 'dres khyab byed ku mud gnyen las ci/ 4 /mgo skyes a sa ṅga 'di byed po yis/ /kun gsal mdzes —3 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshema'i tshogs kun yol go'i nang / /bsdus te 'od bkra'i yan lag gis bzhu ba/ dbu dang snang byed gong du byugs sam snyam/ 5 /dpal khyim rta bdun bdag po'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /phye 'dra'i zhal gyi so gos mngon gsal bas/ kho bo'i 'od mdangs phrogs zhes rgod ma kha/ /skrag ste lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha' ru yib/ 6 /spos glang las byung mu tam mkha' mtsho'i grangs/ /srad bur brgyus lta'i gnyis skyes sprin 'dra'i dbus/ /'jug brgya lta bu'i ro 'dzin 'khyug pa las/ /dbyar rnga dang mtshungs rig byed sgra bsgrags pas/ 7 /de tshe chu skyes mngal dang pad dkar mig /me skyes mchod sbyin brgya pa dbyangs bdag sogs/ /dregs ldan gar mkhan tshogs kyi khengs pa rnams/ /btang ste khyed kyi zhabrus sen mdongs su bsten/ 8 /'jam mnyen 'dzin byed zung gi 'dab brgya'i rtser/ /dbang po'i grangs ldan sor mo'i ge sar sbas/ ta|nga 'byog ra yig gnyis pa'i phul byung dbyangs/ /bcud ldan bdag po'i sgra 'dzin gsal mthong du/ 7 /'ongs pas gan dha: de lho phyogs kyi/ /dga' ba'i tshal (4na)der song snyam yid blong pas/ /ci bya brtol med gyur te bshol med ma'i/ /me tog lam gyi padma'i mig tu zhugs/ 10 /sku stod kha ba'i rdul brtsegs dbang po la/ /'chi med bdag po'i mtshon chas 'khrud 'dra ba'i/ /rin thang gzhal du med pa'i lha rdzas kyis/ /mngon par klubs pa'i phang phung rab tu g.yo/ 11 khyod kyi nyer len byang khog lha lam la/ /log skyes chu 'dzin g.yos pa'i zil mngar gyi/ /gru char 'thung snyam daṇḍi ma chu smyung ma/ /rab dga'i me long snyan pa'i skad 'byin pas/ 12 /gtsug lag rmongs pa'i tshad nad kyis gdungs pa'i/ /mdzangs par rlom pa'i lag ldan phon po rnams/ /sngon chad thos 'dzin khung bur ma 'ongs pa'i/ /sgra 'di ci snyam lag pa'i ngar skad sgrog /13/rgya mtsho dus kyas bcings pa'i sgyu rtsal gyis/ /mthong kha rab rgyas gser ga bdun pa'i yul/ /phra ldem 'gying bag g.yo ba'i mdzes sdug gi /rnam 'gyur 'bab ldan 'thung phod ltar shar pas/ 14 /lang tsho'i nyams kyis ma ro zhe par dregs pa yi/ /legs brisarked med rgyu skar lta bu'i dbus/ /thig le mchog ma ngan spong bur mtshungs pa/ /'dren byed lam nas mngon shes drug ldan gyi/ 15 /mkhyen pas mngon par gsal bas gser mngal can/ /snang byed du:—4

bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ (bdakhas mnar ba'i skyi bun gyi/ 'tshol 'dar gdung bas steng dang phyogs bzhi sa /'byung ba'i grangs kyi ma sta ka sprul pas/ 16 /yid kyi shing rtas drangs snyam mgrin sngon can/ /gnam pos ldem por gyur par rab sems nas/ /myos pas tha snyad ston byed yal ga yin/ /spyi bo'i sra tha (4ba)ma na mngon par bcad/ 17 /'on tang g.yem pa'i gdengs ka gzugs kyi tshul/ /dran pa mngon par gyur nas sbyong slad du/ /do ker gnas nas skal ldan shing rta'i rgyan/ /phab ste khyod kyi zhabs bsil tshul du phul/ 18 /gsus khyim khra ra sa na'i rkang 'thung las/ /byung ba'i mchog can me tshel ngos dag tu/ /ratna 'khyil 'dra'i gzugs brnyan shar ba las/ /bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po'i dngos grub dag 19 /sprin byung dus kyi rlung gi 'bras bu ltar/ /te por phag pas 'od mdas tsha bo dag /'khu bas ya lad rab bgos sha snya thogs/ /gtum drag brngam pa'i dpung gis bskor bar nges/ 20 /bgrod byed ha ri tsandan sdong bu la/ /smad g.yog lo 'dab 'phur lding rab g.yo zhing / /dregs ldan nor 'dzin yan lag mchog gi rtser/ /sdong rkang zhabs 'tsher rnam par g.yo ba yi/ 21 /blo gros rab rmongs sdeg chas meg pa'i mthus/ /rnam dpyod nyer len rmongs brtul nyi shu yi/ /mche phrag 'gro nye'i mkhas rlom legs bris la/ /legs par bshad pa'i gsos sman mchog tu med/ 22 /tshangs sras khyod sku rnam par drang yang thor tshugs cung zad g.yon du yo/ /zhal khyim rgya mtsho skyes ltar dkar yang zur phud stang zil brtsegs ltar nag /mthong kha glang 'jom stod ltar rgyas kyang rked pa utpal skra ltar phra/ /kun la tshad med bzhi dang ldan yang bde 'byung gtsug gi tshe bdag phrogs/ 23 /gang de'i rnam 'gyur smra ba'i 'bab stegs kyis/ /bskal bar brjod kyang bgrang ba'i gnas min pa'i/ /rnam mang yon tan phung po'i phul byung gter/ /(ldan)ma lus gter du bsdus pa'i gzugs sku la/ 24 /brang 'gro so lki'i sha mchog mañdzu ri/ /gha ta puṇḍa mthon ka chen po dang / /ga ka ṇa la pad rā ga spa dza rā/ /rab ljang margad srog ldan dmar po dang / 25 /myos pa'i rdul ldan brang 'gro las 'ongs pa'i/ /grol can dzaskru nā di rdo ba dkar/ /nor bu'i 'khri shing la sogs sbyin dgra dang / /mi zhen nya drug bu dang na raḥsogs/ 26 /kun gyi nor bu'i tshogs rnams byed po yis/ /— 5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegacig tu rab bsdus rin thang tshad mas kyang / /lha lam mtha' ltar gzhal du med 'di la/ /bi shwa ga me'i 'dzin byed sor mo yis/ 27 /sna tshogs thabs mkhas 'phrul gyi zlos gar las/ /cod pan ga rje kā dang sgra 'dzin 'khyil/ /mgur na spa dang dpung gdub ka ṭa ka /sor gdub mañdzi ra dang 'og pag sogs/ 28 /rnam mang spen pa'i tog 'od phon po yis/ /legs par smras pa'i gzi 'od 'bar ba dang / /gang sku'i ye shes 'od kyi phung po dag /phan tshun 'dres 'dra'i 'od kyi dra ba yis/ 27 /dbang gzhu mkhyil 'dra'i 'od zer lta bu yi/ /snang tshul ro 'dzin lam las phyi rol du/ /rab gyur snga na med pa'i snang byed kyis/ /zil mngar g.yo ba'i sgra snyan dbyar gyi rnga/ 30 /legs bris gtsug phud can gyi sgra 'dzin du/ /'ongs pas dga' ba'i gar stabs bsgyur ba yi/ /tshul der la jug pa bcu pa blta ba la/ /rings pas skya rengs nu bo nyon par nges/ 31 khyod kyi ri mo gsum pa'i gso med la/ /tshangs dbyangs rlung gi shing rta'i byed po yis/ /lnga rig char gyis gdul bya'i blo gros kyi/ /ljon shing rgyas (5ba 'di sa gsum dga' ba'i dpal/ 32 /gang thugs ji lta ji snyed chos rnams kun/ sgrib med gsal bar gzigs la ya mtshan ci/ /rjes thob gang du'ang mi 'gyur bde chen la/ /rtag tu snyoms par la jug 'di e ma mtshang/ 33 /rab 'khyams mkhyen pa'i mkha' lam yangs pa las/ /'phags sna'i/sa yan lag drug pas bgrod pa'i tshe/ /pha mthar ma gyur rmugs pas ye shes kyi/ /lus 'degs 'khur gyi ngal ba cis ma btang / 34 /las can kun la byams brtse'i dpung tshogs kyis/ /lus pa med pa'i tshangs bcom sder bcas rnams/ /lus srog bral ba thug 'dra'i dngangs skrag gis/ /lus ched zol gyi mthu la rnam par brten/ 35 /'jigs rung drag shul gar nyams bstan tsam gyis/ /srid gsum gnas pa'i bdud sde'i dpung tshogs rnams/ srid gsum gzhan du 'bros pa'i mthu med pas/ /'jigs byed gtso mo khyod kyi bran du mchis/ 36 /dpal ldan rgyal ba rnams kyi rnam mang yon tan phung po kun/ /kun nas ma lus rab bsdus rab yangs mkha' ltar gsal ba'i blo/ /blo gros snang ba mchog stsol mchog tu 'gyur med bde ba che/ /ches cher rab tu rgyas mdzad rgyas sogs las kun bsgrub pa'i dpal/ 37 /—6

bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ (bdadapal gyi dum bu lta bur dkar mdzes dpag bsam ljon pa'i sku/ /sku gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i yal 'dab 'bras bus brjid/ /brjid pas 'gying ba'i gar gyi nyams ldan tshangs sras ngag gi lha/ /lha mchog lhag pa'i lha der lus ngag yid gsum gus pas 'dud/ 38 /de ltar ngag dbang lha mo'i rnam mang yon tan phon po'i me zhal lam yangs par/ /mngon par ldang (6na)ba'i mtha' bral 'khor lo'i bgrod byed stug po rnam par rab g.yo zhing / /bstod tshig snyan pa'i dbyar rnga rab bsgrags thugs rje'i rlung gi 'bras bu'i tshogs babs pas/ /bdag blo yongs 'du'i dbang por phyogs kyis bcings pa'i rig gnas gdu bus brgyan gyur cig 37/stobs bcu mnga' ba'i blo gros rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du/ /mdo rgyud gzhung lugs me sbyin skyes kyi tshogs la dbang sgyur zhing / /phas rgol bcud bral las rgyal grags pa dri bsung khyab mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i 'chi med bdag po'i bshad sgrub bstan pa dang / 40 khyad par gtsug lag gzhung lugs sa 'dzin dkar por gnas lnga rig pa'i lus stobs rtsal gsum rab rdzogs shing / /snyan dngags gtsug phud 'khyil ltar rab rgyas mngon brjod rnam gnon zla ba 'dzum byed ltar rno mche sder bgrad/ /sdeb sbyor kāñtsa nam gyi legs byed dag gis rab spud zlos gar skad gsang mthon po bsgrag mdzad pa'i/ /thos ldan ri dwags dbus na shong lo gdong lnga'i dbang po'i lugs bzang rdzogs ldan bzhin du rgyas gyur cig 41 /ces ngag gi dbang phyug lha mo dbyangs can ma la mngon rtogs kyi rim pa dang mthun cing / phul byung bstod pa bcas a ma ra ke ga tshig gter rtsa 'grel sogs tha snyad kyi gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i chen po'i pha rol tu son pa'i rgya bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi gzhung lugs las legs par byung ba'i gtam rgyud rnams dang sbyar ba'i bstod pa/ tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i sgra dbyangs blo gros kyi gter mdzod ces bya ba 'di ni/ thub bstan gser ldan gyi dbus su sa 'dzin dbang po ltar mngon par 'phags pa'i slob dpon rin po che (6ba)dkon mchog chos 'phel ba'i zhal snga nas kyis bka' stsal ba spyi bos nos shing / khyad par rang nyid mchog tu dad pa'i rta ljang gi 'od zer dgod pas blo gros kyi utpal kha phye ba la brten nas/ 'bru —7—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemang gi lo'i dus zhabs pa rnams kyi ston tha/ glu dbyangs kyi zla ba dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes la/ shākya'i btsun pa mang thos ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje rigs ldan snyems pa'i sdes/ gangs can sa'i thig le/ ye shes sgyu mas sprul pa'i gtsug lag dang zung du 'brel ba'i chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi gzims khang dga' ldan pho brang me tog mngon par bkra ba'i lding khang gi rig gnas ba gam gnyis par sbyar ba'o/ /rgya gar skad du/ bhanta ra ko bha ga wa tī ku ru ku lwa yi sdi dro beeḍūrla su mā la sta bhu mi rna gas myu dzñā laṅga ro nā ma/ /bod skad du/ /rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma rigs byed ma la bstod pa'i beeḍūrla'i 'phreng ba sa gsum klu dbang gtsug rgyan zhes bya ba/ lhag pa'i lha mo dbang gi rgyal mo la phyag 'tshal 61/ /gang sku lo lha ta ma'i sa 'dzin dbang po lta bur rab dmar rab mdzes lag mkha' gzugs kyis bcings pa'i mtshan dpe'i dbang gzhus nyer 'byud sku ni 'dren byed bdud rtsi'i dpal/ /dpal sdug yum gyur khyod gsung stobs bcu mnga' ba'i dbyangs ltar legs snyan legs gsung yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs bdun la sogs sgra yi legs spud gsung ni thos 'dzin yi ni mchog /mchog tu 'gyur ba med thugs lha lam pha mtha' lta bur dpag dka' dpag yas ji sted yon tan phung po'i chu 'dzin dag kyang rmugs byed thugs ni yid la dga' bde stsol/ /(7na yasnro pa mdzad rgyal kun thugs rje'i zlos gar gcig bsdus rigs byed dbang mo dbang phyug brgyad kyi go 'phang mngon du legs mdzad lha mchog gang des phun tshogs dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ 1 /sra brtan 'jigs med rdo rje'i srung 'khor dang / /dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus/ khu thal dmar po gos chen brtsegs pa'i steng / /rta bdun bdag po'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i phyir/ 2 /rab dmar 'jam mnyen khra ldem 'gying bag can/ /sgyu rtsal drug cu'i nyams ldan zag bral sku/ /mngon par bzhengs pas khyu mchog rgyal mtshan can/ /'gog pa'i ting 'dzin zol gyi brgyal bsten/ 3 /bskal pa'i me dpung pham byed ma sta ka /rab dkar gzi byin 'od kyis mkha' dbyings kyang / /bsreg par dogs pas mtshams sprin gzhon nu yis/ /dmar ser slar —8

bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ khobadaskyes zol gyis g.yog par nges/ 4 /sgram bkra rlung gi rgyal mtshan khyugs 'dra ba'i/ /rtse mo'i grangs ldan snang byed dbang po yis/ /lkog tu gyur pa'i ji lta ji snyed chos/ /kun mkhyen ye shes gzigs pa'i lam las gsal/ 5 /zhal khyim 'dzum ldan mche ba rab gtsigs pa'i/ khro chags zhi ba'i nyams kyi rnam 'gyur gyis/ /zung 'jug bde chen mgron du bsu ma dang / /bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo pham pa mnyam du mdzad/ 6 /byed pos rab tu dkar ba'i rdul brtsegs la/ /padma rā ga'i rgyan kyis legs spud pa/ /byug ris lta bu'i 'od skor rab rgyan la/ /rigs kyi khyab bdag rnam lnga gar gyis rol/ 7 /thabs mkhas 'phrul gyi sgo 'phar las 'ongs pa'i/ /nor bu'i 'khri shing (7ba7skyod lta'i rtsa phyag gis/ /'bab ldan lang tsho dmar po'i gnam ru la/ /dpal khyim myu gu gsar ba'i nyag phran rtser/ 8 /me tog mgrin can 'dzum pa'i mde'u can/ /rgyud las 'phos pa can gyis srid pa gsum/ /g.yo ba'i 'phrul 'khor phul byung dbyar rnga'i sgra/ /phyogs bral rna ba'i rgyan du legs bkod pas/ 9 /'joms dka' lang ga'i bdag po'i yan lag mchog / 'phrog mdzad 'phongs skyen rgyal po rā ma ṇa/ /rgya chen bsam pa'i khur gyis yab rje'i bka'/ /mi 'da' zol gyis dka' thub spyad par nges/ 10 /'jam mnyen lhas ma'i tha snyad ston byed kyi/ /'dab brgya las grub lcags gyo zhags pa yis/ /zhub chen rab bgos rno ngar mtshon thogs pa/ /kun las rnam par rgyal ba e ma mtshar/ 11 /rab rgyas mthong ga ri dwags mig can lus/ /dkar 'dzin legs byad mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /bcu gnyis bdag po yid kyi shing rta'i rgyus/ /lan brgyar 'khyud pa'i khur chen bsten par nges/ 12 /de lta'i log skyes dbyar dus mkha' glang ltar/ /rab g.yo 'chi med chu shing brla can bzhin/ /sta zur rgyas pa'i bar na rgyab chod yul/ /yod dam med snyam yid la nim nur 'dzin/ 13 /gsang ba'i 'khor lo mi zad bde ba che'i/ /lang tsho rnam par rgyas pa'i dpyid kyi mas/ /rigs ldan mchog gi yongs 'du dpag bsam shing / /brjod bral bde chen dbyar gyi dga' ston rgyas/ 14 /skyil krung phyed pa'i nyams ldan gang gi zhabs/ /nam mkha'i nor bu'i gdan la rtag bkod kyang / /rang byung skra can gsod dang legs bris gtso/ /dregs (8na tshe skrun kun gyi spyi bo'i gtsug na —96

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'agyings/ 15 /bcu drug lang tsho'i gzi ldan khyod sku la/ /rin chen phyang phrul rus rgyan mgo rlon 'phreng / /bhe tra'i slog pa lha rdzas 'od kyi tshogs/ /gcig tu 'dres te tha dad gang gis mtshon/ 16 /ye shes zhugs kyis sgrib gnyis tshang tshing kun/ /bsregs kyang bdud dpung tshogs kyi srog dbugs med/ /lhag mar bya phyir bzod dka' me dpung dbus/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyi rnam par bstan min nam/ 17 /nyi gzhon 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i byu ru'i ri/ /dus kyi bā shwa da nas lhag par byed/ /rnam bkra 'ja' lus 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku/ /srid gsum 'di na 'gran pa'i zla dang bral/ 18 /brjid bral grangs med gre 'gyur sna tshogs glu/ /gcig bsdus rab snyan phul byung tshangs pa'i gsung / /ches cher bsgrags pas dri za'i rgyud mang sgra/ /skyengs te sum rtsen gnas su bros sam snyam/ 19 /mi phyed bde stong ngang la rtag rol thugs/ /tshad ma'i srang la gzhal yang rtogs min zhes/ /rab 'khyams dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus kun/ /skyid bsgyur zhi ba'i dbyings su bzhugs kyi dogs/ 20 /nges gsang theg pa'i rnam rgyal khang bzang du/ /bla med dkyil 'khor 'khor lo nye dbang dbus/ /rigs kyi mchog gyur rje btsun 'chi med gtso/ /lhag pa'i lha der sgo gsum gus pas 'dud/ 21 /bdag blo sa da rī da'i tshal rgyas phyir/ /gsol 'debs rlung gi shugs kyis log rtog sprin/ /rab dngas sems kyi ba gam kun gsal dbus/khyod sku rta ljang 'gog med rtag bzhugs gsol/ 22 /de ltar thugs rje'i byed pa'i rgyu rtsal las/ /mngon (8ba)par 'ongs pa'i rab 'byams dbang gi las/ /thogs med grub pa'i nus ldan 'khor lo'i shugs/ /srid gsum kun las rnam par rgyal gyur cig 23/ces rje btsun ku ru ku lle la bstod pa beeḍūrya'i 'phreng ba sa gsum klu dbang gtsug rgyan zhes bya ba 'di la rang gi kha ton gyi phyir/ tha snyad kyi gtsug lag la blo gros kyi snang ba cung zad dkar ba'i tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sa yos 'dod dus kyi zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis ba'i tshes la drang srong mgrin sngon gtsug rgyan gro zhun gyi na chung dang rtsa ba'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin 'dren byed mu nānta 'a pho brang ma la yar skyes kyi dri bsung la dga' bder spyod pa'i sum rtsen yul la 'gran pa dga' ldan khang gsar gyi rig gnas ba gam lnga par sbyar ba'o/ /— 10

bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ (bdargya gar skad du/ /bha ga wa tī ārya tsinta tsakri3 ma ra kho yu ba na sgyu mṛ to nā ma/ /bod skad du/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la bstod pa 'chi med lang tsho'i zil mngar zhes bya ba/ stobs bcu mnga' ba kun gyi yum gyur 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sras mo la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu rnams/ /ma lus gcig tu rab bsdus lhag pa'i lha/ /bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid bzhin zla ba'i ma ma 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /'dab stong sdong bu yal 'dab rab rgyas rtser/ /bde 'byung gtsug rgyan 'khor lo nya gang steng / /dus gsum dpal sdug kun gyi yum mchog ma/ /rnam mang kha ba'i rdul brtsegs lhun po la/ /rnam bkra dbang po'i gzhu yis 'khyud 'dra ba'i/ /rnam dag gar dgu'i (9na tshe nams ldan gzugs sku 'di/ /rnam kun spyi bo'i pad mtshor rol bar mdzod/ /'bras ldan dus kyi mkha' dbyings las 'ongs pa'i/ /dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gsum pa'i bsil zer yang / /pham par nus pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor la/ /anda rnyil ltar rab sngo'i nor bu 'khyil/ /utpal dmar po dang mtshungs mchu sgros dang / /ge sar g.yo 'dra'i gcod byed 'phreng mdzes shing / /dpal khyim 'dab ma lta bu'i bcud kyi ma/ /phra rgyas spangs pa'i drang srong tshogs rnams kyang / /yid kyi shing rta mngon par rgyas byed pa'i/ /'dren byed yon por lta ba'i mdzes sdug gis/ /chos kyi sprin la gnas kyang kun dkris dag /yod dam med snyam bdag yid dpyang thag 'dzin/ khyod sku ma la ya skyes 'gro 'gog la/ /dkar 'jam phra ldem gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhing / /mtshan dpe'i lo 'dab gang bu g.yur za las/ /thugs rje'i dri bsung ci yang g.yo ba'i mthus/ /nyam nga gsum gyi tsha ba'i 'jigs pa yis/ /mnar ba'i lus can mche ba'i stobs ldan la/ /phan dang bde ba'i bsil ngad mi 'jigs pa'i/ /sbyin la dpa' ba'i snying stobs rgya chen gyi/ /tshul 'di mthong bas rgyal po thams cad sgrol/ /mchod sbyin dag la spo ba chen po yis/ /mang du 'god pa'i mchog tu khur khyer bas/ /rgyal bzhi'i skyong byed go 'phang thob par nges/ /'dzin byed g.yas kyi mchod sbyin phyag rgya yis/ /'gro rnams 'jigs pa kun las skyob mdzad cing / /g.yon pa'i dbang — 11 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemachog sprul pa gsum gyes pas/ /dus gsum skyes bu'i seng ge rnam par mtshon/ dgod byad mig (9ba)gi bcad skyas shing 'phel gyi/ /'bar ba'i ro 'dzin la yang 'khu ba 'di/ /chu skyes gdan la rtag tu rab bkod kyang / /snyigs par ma gyur 'di ni e ma mtshar/ /gang sku sna tshogs rin chen 'phreng ba dang / /ātpal lhab lhub dar gyi na bza' yis/ legs par brgyan pas rgyu skar 'phreng ba'i tshogs/ /blta bar kun gsal lam las 'ongs pa bzhin/ khyod kyi yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs kyang / /dbyings ldem khengs pa phrogs la ya mtshan ci/ /'gyur med zhi la bzhugs pa'i 'phags tshogs kyang / /sgra 'dzin mngon par bteg ste nyan 'di mtshar/ /kun mkhyen ye shes kyis kyang dpag dka' ba'i/ /'phags pa khyod thugs mi zad yon tan gyis/ /gcig bsdus tshogs pa'i khur chen 'degs byed pa'i/ /e ma 'od srungs byin ni rab tu sra/ /de ltar 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rnam mang yon tan puṇḍa ri ga'i dga' tshal du/ /bdag blo'i rta bdun dbang po'i 'od kyis bstod tshogs 'dab brgya cung zad ba 'ad pa'i dge ba yis/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod las kyi bdag sogs yid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /chu 'dzin dus kyi lha lam du ma'i skye gnas 'khrugs las rlung gi 'bras ltar 'byung gyur cig /ces bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la bstod pa 'chi med lang tsho'i zil mngar zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang nyid kyi dad pa'i gsos su 'gyur ba'i ched du/ shar phyogs rgyal po'i khab tu lo 'go yongs grags kyi hor zla bcu gcig pa zhes par 'bod cing / dus 'khor zhabs pa rnams kyi dgun ra/ nam mkha' nor bu gzhu khyim du babs pa'i dkar (10na)po'i phyogs kyi ḍā gi dga' ston gyi tshes la/ mang thos ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje rigs ldan snyems pa'i sdes/ dga' ldan pho brang me tog mngon par bkra ba'i lding khang gi brda sprod dga' ba'i tshal du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /dus gsum rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter/ /mdzes sdug lha mo'i chu mtshor rgyas pa las/ /mchog mthun dngos grub bsam 'phel nor bu'i rlabs/ /'phyur mdzad yid bzhin 'khor lo'i — 12

bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ (bdazhabs la 'dud/ /snyigs bral 'o mtsho chil chil 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /pad dkar 'dzum pa'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i steng / khrel dkar lhun po lta bu'i gzugs kyi sku/ /'jo sgeg lus phra'i gar gyis 'gying la 'dud/ /dri mas sbags dang 'phel 'grib skyon rnams kun/ /yongs spangs dkar 'jam 'dzum pa'i zhal khyim la/ /lha mi'i sgeg mo'i bzhin dang zla snang gis/ /mtshungs bral rang nyid dper bstan khyod la 'dud/ /mthon mthing ral pa'i zar bu'i lha lam mtha'/ /'dzam bu'i gser gyi rtse phran mtshams sprin can/ /logs skyes nam mkha'i glang po 'khrigs pa las/ /bde ba'i char gyis brlan par byed la 'dud/ / phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgyas 'chi med tshe'i/ /sgo 'phar brgya phrag 'gro la legs phye zhing / /utpal lcug phran g.yon pa'i phyag sor la/ /mi phyed mdza' bas 'khyud pa khyod la 'dud/ /zhabs zung rdo rje'i skyil mo krung bcas pa'i/ /sen ma'i 'od stong 'bar ba'i dmar po'i gzis/ /'dab stong snyigs par 'gyur snyam chu shel dbang / /(10ba)bsil ba'i zegs ma spro ba khyod la 'dud/ /gang gi yon tan bla na med pa'i tshul/ /rtogs pa'i mi 'gyur dad pas bstod pa'i dges/ /gnas skabs mi mthun bar chad kun zhi zhing / /tshe dpal 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par shog /nam shig dus kyi pho nya'i dbang gyur tshe/ /dag pa'i zhing khams rgyal ba'i 'dun sa sa /mngal gyi skyon bral padma'i sbubs skyes te/ /zab rgyas theg chen chos la spyod par shog /rnam dag dal ba'i rten gyi zhing sa la/ /gsung rab mang du thos pa'i sa bon gyi/ /bsam sgom mthun rkyen ma lus tshang ba la/ /mi gnas myang 'das 'bras bu smin gyur cig /mdor na rgyal ba kun gyi yum mchog ma'i/ /phun tshogs thugs rje chen po'i byed po yis/ /gnas skabs mthar thug 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /gegs med lhun gyi 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo la bstod pa 'dod don grub pa'i smon lam dang bcas pa 'di'ang / rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams chos bzang gis bskul ba'i ngor/ za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ /na mo badzra ḍā zhi rkye/ zag med bde chen rgyas pa'i kun dga'i dpyid/ /thun mtshams lang tsho dar — 13 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheba'i 'jo sgeg can/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol pa'i bcom ldan ma/ /rje btsun mkha' spyod dpa' mor phyag bgyid do/ 1 /chu skyes 'dab brgya dgod pa'i ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ /rta bdun bdag po'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i steng / /dus mtshan 'jigs byed mnan pas ma tshim par/ /'dam ltar brdzis pa'i 'bras zung brkyang bskum can/ 2 /(11na)g.yon ngos cung zad phyogs pa'i bzhin ras la/ /chos kun gzigs pa'i spyan gsum dmar zlum g.yo/ /thar pa'i grong du 'gro kun bsu mkhas pa'i/ /'dzum zhal mche ba'i myu gu zla tshes can/ 3 /phyag g.yas ma rig gcod pa'i gri gug mtshon/ /'khor bar thur du brkyang dang lhan cig par/ /bde chen mdangs ldan khrag gang thod pa'i bcud/ /rol phyir g.yon pas mkha' la bteg pa bzhin/ 4 /thabs shes zung 'jug kha ṭwāṃ phrag g.yon ngos/ /'chang bar ḍā dril 'phan gyis sku gsum mtshon/ /ma bris mthon mthing gsar pa'i mdangs 'dzin pa'i/ 'ching ba kun grol dbu skra'i zang bu g.yo/ 5 /rab dkar rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga yi rgyan/ /sdud dang lhan cig thod skam do shal 'phyang / /rked phra nu 'bur mngon rgyas mdzes chags dang / /gcig car mi sdug khro nyams ston pa 'dra/ 6 /tsha sreg rnam par 'bar ba'i ye shes kyi/ /me dpung klong dkyil dbus na rab 'gying ba/ /ra yig dri bzhon shugs kyis nyer bskyod pa'i/ /gtum mo'i bde drod 'gro la ngom pa bzhin/ 7 /rnam pa kun bral bde stong mkha' dbyings su/ /rnam par bzhedas pa'i bzhin lag mtshan dpe'i 'ja'/ /rnam mang dngos grub ngo mtshar byed po mchog /rnam 'dren kun gyi yum cig khyod la bstod/ 8 /deng nas 'khor bar nges 'byung 'gro ba kun/ /'dren pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa mi dman pas/ /'khrul med gsang chen slob bshad zab mo'i lam/ /ji bzhin nyams su longs par byin gyis rlobs/ 9 /mkha' spyod nyer bzhi'i yul kun rab rgyu ba'i/ /dpa' mo'i nyams kyis (11ba)rol ba'i 'jo sgeg can/ /khyab bdag he ru ka dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /phyi yi rje btsun rnal 'byor 'grub par shog /khyod ni a wa dhū ti'i grong khyer du/ /bde ba'i rang snang e dbyings gzugs can dbus/ /zung 'jug sgrub gzhi rab dmar ba yig tu/ shar ba'i nang gi rje btsun 'grub par shog 10 /ming gzugs brjod du med pa gnyug ma'i sems/ /rab gsal — 14

bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ (bdablo 'das 'dzin med stong pa'i gshis/ /'dod nas 'brul pa bral ba chos dbyings klong / /gsang ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor 'grub par shog 11 /grub chen dril bu pa dang ku swā li/ /nā ro ta pa 'khon ston bsod nams rtse/ /tshar chen rdo rje 'chang dang mkhyen brtse'i dbang / /mngon sum rjes su gzung ba ji bzhin du/12 /bskyed rdzogs zab lam ma lus nyams blangs pas/ /bdag sogs rigs 'dzin dbang mo yid 'ong mas/ /mngon sum byin brlabs sgyu ma'i lus dang bcas/ /mkha' spyod dga' ba'i zhing der 'khrid par shog / 13skal pa dman pas tshul de ma 'grub na/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags tshe dga' ma khyod/ /mngon sum 'ongs te rig pa'i khyi'u chung / /dag pa'i zhing khrid rgyal ba'i sras su bskrun/ 14 /mdor na tshe rabs kun tu rdo rje'i theg /rim gnyis zab mo'i lam dang mi 'bral zhing / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ 15 /zhes jo bo nā ro ta pa'i thugs dam rten/ ra tshag gi rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku brnyan ye shes sems dpa' dngos su bzhugs pa'i drung du/ bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di yang / /sems kyi rdo (12na)rje'i rnal 'byor la gzhol ba'i a wa dhū tī pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /na mo ārya mañdzu shi ye/ /mkha' khyab don dam chos sku lha yi lam/ /bcu drug bde chen mtshan bzang dbang po'i ga/nu/ /gnyis med gnyis su 'char ba'i sgyu dra'i gar/ /ston mdzad 'jam mgon zur phud lnga par 'dud/ /chu skyes 'dab brgya dgod pa'i ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ /rab gsal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya rgyas steng / /gur kum rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po ni/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od kyis 'khyud pa bzhin/ /bcu drug lang tsho dar ba'i 'jo sgeg can/ /rgyas sras gzhon nur ston 'dis ring mo nas/ /rnam 'dren kun gyi yab ces rgan po'i mtshan/ /'chang ba'i gtam 'di thal gyis bsgrib pa bzhin/ /mtshams sprin gangs kyi ri bo pad rā ga bzhin/ /mdangs dbyibs gzugs sku'i bkod pa bye ba'i tshogs/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma skems bar/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i don du bstan las ci/ /mig gi bdud — 15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshertsir spyod pa'i mdzes sdug sku/ /phun tshogs mtshan dpe'i ri mo bkra ba gang / /mthong thos dran dang reg pas rnam grol ba/ /'di ko skal bzang gdul bya'i bsod nams dpyid/ /de don rtogs pa'i blo gros ches phra rnams/ /sna tshogs rin chen phreng ba'i do shal dang / /pañtsa li ga'i dar gyi sham thabs la/ /bsngags brjod dar dir sgrog par ngal ba'i gnas/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa mig sman ltar gnag pa/ /mthar byed nā da'i sgra dbyangs rta ljang can/ /rgol ngan smra ba'i ku mud (12ba)zum pa dang / /dpyod ldan blo gros pad dkar 'dzum gyis bsu/ /dam pa'i chos kyi rgyud mang 'khrol ba'i glu/ / skal bzang rna bar 'jibs pa tshangs pa'i gsung / /ches cher rmongs pa'i 'gro la brag ca'i sgra/ /mi bzad bdud sde'i snying la char pa bzhin/ /chu klung gcig las rnag khrag bdud rtsi sogs/ /sna tshogs du mar snang zhing don byed pa/ /kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i chos kun don dam dbyings/ /ma rnyed dbu ma'i lam bzang ston pa bzhin/ /skad cig tsam la rgya cher shes bya'i mtha'/ /'jal nas zab yangs thugs kyi rgya mtsho cher/ /grangs med chos kyi ri bong 'dzin pa'i gzugs/ /mi 'char lkog tu gyur de de ga re/ /phul byung thugs rje laṅka 'a bdag pa'i gzugs/ /blo ldan snying gi rin chen rtsig ngos la/ shar tshe lnga rig ha nu mas gang / /dga' ba'i zlos gar bsgyur la ci yang brel/ /chos brgyad 'bod grogs 'phrul gyis nyer drangs pa'i/ /dam pa'i chos kyi so tra dor byas nas/ /'dir snang ri dwags bsnyegs la mgon khyod kyis/ /mi phan byang bstan phug par nyi zer bzhin/ /gtan gyi skyabs su gsol na smos ci 'tshal/ /cung zad dran pas phan bde'i legs tshogs rnams/ /stsol mdzad 'dod pa'i re skong dbang gi rgyal/ /sngon med yid bzhin nor bu gzhan na su/ /'gro ba'i dbang por 'tsham pa'i 'phrin las kyi/ /pha mtha' kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram pa la/ /'jal byed 'dzad pa med pa'i zhags pa yis/ /srid dang zhi ba'i dngos kun gcig tu bcings/ /phra zhing rnam par dpyod pa'i mkhyen pa'i spyan/ /dkyus ring zur gyis 'phangs pa'i (13na)nyag phrag gyis/ /mtha' med khengs ldan shes bya lus phra ma/ /kun yid dga' ba'i 'dzum dang bcas te bsu/ /brtse chen dpyid kyi dpal mo'i mngal yangs nas/ /lhag bsam chu 'dzin gsar pa'i lang long — 16

bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ (bdacan/ /rlabs chen spyod pa mchog gi char rgyun gyis/ /phan dang bde ba'i myu gu g.yur du za/ /dbang phyug mig las spar ba'i me dpung gis/ /nyag phran bdag po bcom pa nges par brdzun/ /bden na khyod kyi nus mthu'i thog mda' yis/ /nag po'i phyogs rnams cig car bcoms min nam/ khyod dang ma la yar skyes ljon pa gnyis/ /mi shes tsha gdung 'joms la mtshungs na yang / /mgon khyod nyes pa'i skyon bral ngag gi lha/ /tsan dan shing de gdug pa'i sprul gyis 'gril/ /e ma ngo mtshar mkha' la nyi zla zung / /chos bzang lha yi 'dun sar mig stong can/ /grangs med rkang 'thung khrod na yongs 'du'i ljon/ /rgyal sras 'phags tshogs dbus na 'jam dbyangs khyod/ /mchog dman kun la nye dang ring med par/ /gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis 'dod pa'i don/ /lhun grub re ba ma lus skong byed pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu klu dbang gtsug na mdzes/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab ral gri yis/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i drwa ba bcad pa dang / /lhan cig 'khor ba sdug bsngal kun gyi rgyu/ /ngal te 'gro rnams bde ba chen por khrid/ /gang gi gsang gsum byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /skye dgu'i yid kyi yol gor 'khyil ba na/ shes ldan dad pa'i bstod bsngags zil mngar chu/ /mgon khyod thugs kyi padma'i ze 'brur babs/ /mtha' bral rlabs chen mdzad pa mchog gi nor/ /chu (13ba)bur spungs pa gcig tu shong ba'i snod/ /sprul la 'jig rten mes po ngal gyur na/ /srid gsum 'di yang da gdod chung ngur 'khums/ /chos phung rgya mtshor shar ba'i pu sta ka /phrag gong utpal 'dab steng mngon chags pa/ /lta phyir lhun po nyi zla'i sgron me zung / /bteg nas ngal med blta bar chas pa bzhin/ /thabs shes zung 'jug rgyud las drangs pa'i mdas/ /gti mug snying ga phug pa'i khrag gi rgyun/ /'gro la rjes chags dmar ba'i 'od gzi la/ /thun mtshams mdangs su byed pos btags sam snyam/ /rgod ma kha la 'gran bzod zhabs sen gyis/ /'jam mnyen chu skyes 'dab ma bsreg go zhes/ /ri bong 'dzin de tsha ba'i gdung sel slad/ /mkha' las babs nas stan du 'ongs pa bzhin/ /chos kun mkhyen kyang slob pa 'phags pa'i tshul/ /drang po'i sku yang 'khyog po'i 'gying bag can/ /zhi zhing dul yang bdud sde'i tshogs la khro/ /kun la brtse yang — 17—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheskal ldan rjes su 'dzin/ /mgon khyod thugs rje'i zegs ma ma 'dris pa'i/ /lus can rnams la 'jug pa rdzun gtam ste/ /tsand+ra go mi mkhas pa'i mthar sen yang / /da dung skye dgu phal cher rnam par rmongs/ /'gro kun la dzum gyis bsu ba'i zhal gyi khyim/ /gur kum gsar pa'i mdangs la dmar 'od can/ /'khor ba'i pha rol 'tshol ba'i spyan gyi dkyus/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' las rnam par brgyal/ /yid 'ong gdub sil 'brol ba'i snyan po'i sgra/ /rna ba'i bdud rtsir byed pa'i lus dkar can/ /yid bzhin 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /rtsed 'jor rol pa'i 'dab chags ngang pa su/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi mkhyen pa'i phung po dang / /(14nasgo gyod kyi rnam par yangs pa'i blo gros gnyis/ /'jig rten mes pos srang la bteg pa na/ /lci dang yang ba'i go skabs med 'di mtshar/ /dpal ldan stobs bcu'i rtsal 'chang 'dren pa kun/ /kun dga'i legs bshad spel phyir rgyal ba'i sras/ /sras bcas rnams kyi gtsug na mtho ba'i lha/ /lha mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs zhes grags pa 'bar/ /ngag gi dbang po dbang phyug brgyad ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen de mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpyid/ /sgrib gnyis las bral las can 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mchog gi dngos grub dngos su stsol la mkhas/ /mtshams sprin mdangs 'dzin 'dzin ma yongs kyi rgyan/ /rgyan phreng gis mdzes mdzes ldem gzhon nu'i gzugs/ /gzugs sku ngo mtshar mtshar sdug mnga' ba'i mgon/ /mgon po 'jam dbyangs dbyangs bdun legs bshad 'brol/ /dung dung yid kyis rtag tu lhar bsten na/ /brtan brtan snying gi pad mtshor rtag bzhugs nas/ /'grig 'grig gsung gi gnang ba legs stsol nyid / /yang yang thugs rje'i phyag gis dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /ldem ldem padma 'dab ma rgyas pa'i dbus/ /dkar dkar chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor steng / /mdzes mdzes gcig tu bsdus pa'i mtshan dpe'i sku/ /gsal gsal kun rtog yir gyis ci yang 'bri/ /pha mtha' mi mngon tshang tshing rnam par 'khrigs/ kha dog rab dkar kha ba'i reg byas gdungs/ /tsha grang mi snyom tha ga pa yi yul/ /tha klu ra la thob byar 'dzin pa rnams/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i mun pas nyer bsgribs pas/ /mu med sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i rgyu bsgrub par/ /me (14ba)tog bcud la bung ba — /8—

wa wa wa bde gshegs sras yos kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ (bdeltar ri/jor ba'i/ /ma lus 'gro ba drongs shig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /ka ma la ltar 'jam mnyen gzugs kyi sku'i/ kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i bkod pa dang / /ga bur ngad ltar gdung sel thugs rje'i phyag /nga rgyal can gyi 'gro ba'i gtsug na khyongs/ /ca co legs par bshad pa'i dbyangs snyan po/ /cha shas res kyang yid dang rna ba la/ /ja dkar btung bas rig pa'i mdangs gsal ltar/ /nya rgyas zla bzhin blo gros 'phel bar mdzod/ /ta la'i glegs bam rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung / /tha na chung ngu'i dka' gnad tsam la yang / /da lta thogs med smra ba'i spobs pa mchog /nā gā rdzu na'i rnam dpyod dang mtshungs mdzod/ /pa sangs ltar dkar mkhas pa'i bya ba kun/ /pha rol rgol ba zil gyis gnon nus pa/ /ba lang dbus na khyu mchog ji bzhin du/ /ma lus shes ldan rnams kyi mgon du mdzod/ /tsa na yin kyang dngos su zhal bstan nas/ /tsha zer can dang padma ji bzhin du/ /dza ya'i gsung rab kun la lta ba'i mig /wa ler gsal ba'i shes rab rgyas par mdzod/ /zha yig ltar 'khyil 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i nang / /za byed nyon mongs chu 'dzin gdug pas gtses/ /'a 'ur mi zad sdug bsngal ldan pa rnams/ /ya mtshan dag pa'i zhing du khyod kyis drongs/ /ra ba med pa'i phug pa'i blun sgom dang / /la lung 'khyams pa'i rtog ge kha bshag mkhan/ tan khrag sdig la rol pa'i kla kle'i sde/ /sa yi rdul ltar khyab rnams rjes su bzung / / ha cang dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar thug 'dir/ /a don skye med rtogs pa nyin skar tsam/ /ha la'i dug 'dra'i gnas ngan (15na〉spen gyi rgyu/ /a mra'i 'bras ltar myong rnams rjes brtser mdzod/ /da ltar dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /rgyas sras gzhon nu'i tshul 'jin ngag gi lha/ /dran pas rnam 'dren rin chen gling mchog tu/ /'khrid pa'i ded dpon brtan pa'i 'khor lo dgongs/ /mi 'phrogs dad pa'i shing rtas rab drangs pa'i/ khugs drag smon lam dkyil 'khor rta ljang can/ /snyan 'gyur tshig gi mkha' la nyer 'phags na/ /thugs rje'i pad dkar 'dab ma 'dzum las ci/ /bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ /nyon mongs dug gsum drag po'i nad kyis gces/ /gnas ngan len pa'i rgyu yi khur chen blangs/ /blang dang dor byar blta ba'i blo mig ldongs/ /mngon mtho — 19—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shenges legs lam las rgyab kyis phyogs/ /mi bzad ngan song g.yang sar gom pa 'phyan/ dge ba'i las kyi 'khar ba'i rten dang bral/ /nyam thag snying rje'i gnas su gyur rnams la/ /mgon po khyod kyis rjes su mi 'dzin na/ /gtan gyi skyabs gnas dam pa su la re/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems ldan pa'i/ /snyan po'i gtam yang ming gi lhag mar zad/ /ches cher snyigs ma lnga yis nyer sgrags pa'i/ /ha cang 'dul bar dka' zhes btang snyoms su/ /'jog na bgrod par dka' ba'i chu bo la/ /mi phan gru dang zam pas ci zhig byed/ /'gro ba'i khams dang bsam pa bag la nyal/ /ji bzhin rtogs nas rjes su 'dzin pa la/ /rmad byung mkhyen pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa/ /rgyal sras dam pa khyod la lhag par mnga'/ /'gro ba kun la rang gi bu gcig ltar/ /rnam par brtse bas cung zad tsam du'ang / /yal bar mi (15ba'i dor snying rje chen po ni/ /rje btsun khyod kyi rgyud la rtag tu ldan/ /gzhan la phan na dmyal ba'i me dong du/ /la jug par mtsho dang rdzing bur ngang pa ltar/ /dga' zhing spro ba'i nus ldan lhag pa'i sems/ /'phags chen dam pa'i yul las gzhan du ci/ /skye dgu'i mgon skyabs dpung dang gnyen gyur pa'i/ /yon tan kun tshang dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ /'gro rnams yal bar 'dor na skyabs gnas mchog /gsung rab mang por bshad pa rdzun du bas/ /de phyir thugs rje chen po'i zhags pa yis/ /lus can mtha' dag mi gnas myang 'das mchog /rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub pa'i gtan bde'i gzhir/khrid cig smra ba'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /lugs gnyis utpal 'khrigs pa'i rdzing bu la/ /rmongs pa'i glang chen rgyu ba'i gom stabs kyis/ /phan bde'i yal 'dab 'dam ltar rdzi ba la/ /dran 'dzin lcags kyus thul zhig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /me tog mda' yis dge ba'i sems kyi snying / /mngon par phug pa'i ri dwags sha ra bha/ /phul byung byin rlabs dpyad kyis rab phral nas/ /log spyod zug rngu chom shig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /sgra tshad bzo gso nang don rig pa dang / /snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor zlos gar gzhung / /skar rtsis bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas rnams kun/ /'chad pa'i tsham dpyod stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /mtha' klas gtsug lag mngon par 'khyil ba'i chu/ /—20

bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ (bdalog rtog nyes bshad rnyog ma'i lang long can/ /rig lam nor bu ke ta gas drungs pa'i/ /rtsod pa'i rnam dpyod stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i gzhud lugs (16na〉ba lus pa/ /nyung du spel dang rgya chen snying por bsdu/ /ma chad kha 'geng gab dkrugs bsdeb pa sogs/ /rtsom pa'i rnam dpyod stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /blo gros dri ma med pa'i ā darshar/ /cung zad tsam la gsung rab byed ba'i gzugs/ /thogs med 'char ba'i 'dzin dang mi brjed pa'i/ /gzungs kyi dngos grub stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /phyogs res mi ngoms legs par bshad pa'i tshig /lus phra'i 'gram pa'i chang gi thigs pas kyang / /yon tan ba ku la yi kha 'byed pa'i/ /thos pa'i dngos grub stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /tshig tsam ma yin de don dka' ba'i gnad/ /kun la zhib mor brtags zhing nyer dpyad pas/ /yang dag don kyi nges pa gting rnyed pa'i/ /bsam pa'i dngos grub stsol cig 'jam dbyangs/ /sde snod gsum dang rdo rje rnal 'byor sogs/ /zab mo'i lam rnams rgyud ldan bla ma yi/ /man ngag ji bzhin nyams su rab len pa'i/ /spobs pa'i dngos grub stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog /dbyar gyi ljon pa'i lo 'dab ltar rgyas shing / /sems can mtha' dag skyid pa'i grib bsil la/ /yun ring 'tsho zhing skyong cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gsol 'debs bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / /dus gsum dge ba'i sgra dbyangs snyan po can/ /'gro rnams yid kyi gdung sel bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /rgyal kun mchod pa'i rol mos mnyes gyur cig /ces 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs la bstod pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ta sna ra'i rgyud mang zhes pa 'di ni dga' zhing chos rje rgyal yags rab 'byams (16ba)pa grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / /zung chu rab 'byams pa 'phrin las sogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ slob dpon daṇḍi'i gzhung lugs sbyangs nas cung zad shes pa la brten snyan ngag mkhan por rloms pa za hor gyi rigs las a wa dhu tī ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde/ming gzhan 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam/ tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjer 'bod pa'i —21 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losheldum bu bas/ rnam rgyal zhes pa chu mo sprul gyi lo dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes kyi nyin/ rgya nag gi sa'i cha ri bo rtse lnga dang le dbar bdun brgyas bar chod pa'i pho brang pe cing gi snye 'dabs su ja sbyor gsum gyi yun la 'grub par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni smon 'gro paṇa chen no/ /na maḥ shākya mu ni ye/ /'dzam bu'i gser sbyangs las grub sa 'dzin dbang / /mtshan dpe'i drwa bas 'khyud pa'i gzugs kyi sku/ /mthong bas don ldan nges legs la sbyor ba'i/ /rgyal ba zas gtsang sras por gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi mgur nas gzhes med nā da'i sgra/ /dam pa'i chos kyi dbyangs su sgrog pa'i glu/ /thos pas srid zhi'i gdung sel thos 'dzin rgyan/ /yan lag drug cu'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun gsal thegs pas 'ching bar nus min pa'i/ /rgya chen pha mtha' bral ba shes bya'i khyon/ /mngon sum gzigs pa'i ye shes mchog gi thugs/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /'og min gnas su sku gsum mngon gyur kyang / /'dzam bu'i gling du mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi/ /tshul bstan 'gro ba 'dren pa'i thabs mkhas can/ /kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol ba (17na)btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /tshe rabs kun tu sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /zhugs nas de don tshul bzhin nyams blangs pas/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtshor 0〈cog gyur cig /ces bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa la bstod pa'i rim pa 'di ni/ su nyid u rin wang gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes nyal khar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /na mo ārya me tre ye/ /ngo mtshar yid la kun nas dga' ba'i dpyid/ /rmad byung dam pa'i chos kyi dpal 'dzin pa'i/ /grangs med legs bris tshogs kyi cod pan can/ /rgyal tshab mi pham dbang pos 'gro 'di skyongs/ /mthong bas don ldan mtshan dper ldan pa'i sku/ /thos pas rna ba'i bcud len tshangs pa'i gsung / /dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel kun mkhyen thugs/ /gsang gsum rdo rje'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /gser gyi rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po la/ /nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i gzi 'od can/ /rin chen khri steng bzang po'i bzhugs stangs kyis/ /'gro kun thar pa'i grong du bsu ba —22

bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ khobakabazhin/ /phyag gnyis chos 'chad mdzad pa'i mtheb srin gyis/ /legs bzung mnyen 'jam chu skyes lcug phran rtser/ /phang phung 'dab brgya dgod pa'i ze'u 'bru/ /rna gong utpal phon po'i dpe zlar byas/ /'gro la rjes su chags pa'i spyan gyi dkyus/ /ring po 'khor ba'i pha mthar rdzogs min zhes/ /srid pa'i 'gro rnams khyod kyis 'dren pa yi/ /phul byung dam bca'i khur chen jom pa 'dra/ /u dum wa ra'i dpal 'dzin mchu sgros kyi/ /'dzum dbus chems phreng dkar po'i ke sa ra/ /rmad (17ba〉grang phan bde'i dga' ston ring po nas/ /bsus te bskal bzang 'gro la ster pa bzhin/ /de ltar phun tshogs yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter/ /mi pham mgon de'i sku brnyan bzheng pa dang / /mchod bstod gsol ba 'debs pa'i skye bo kun/ /ma smad thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /gnas skabs dam chos bsgrub pa'i nad gdon bgegs/ /bar chad nyer 'tshe'i g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing / /tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gag par gyur pa'i tshe/ /dga' ldan gnas su skyel bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par dge bcu rdzogs par spyod ldan pa'i/ /brgyad khri'i tshe lor gyur tshe 'dzam gling 'dir/ /mgon khyod chos 'khor bskor ba'i gdul bya yi/ /thog mar skyes nas byang chub bsgrub par shog /ces rje btsun byams pa mgon po la bstod cing smon lam du bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ dngos stobs rigs pa smra ba bde yangs grwa tshang gi slob dpon phun tshogs mchog ldan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ khu kya'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las so/ /'jam mnyen pad ma'i 'dab ma rab rgyas pa'i/ /ze'u 'bru'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /ldem ldem yid 'ong mdzes pa lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yum der gsol ba 'debs/ /mar gad rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po la/ /nyi ma 'bum gyis 'byud pa'i gzi 'od can/ /zhal khyim 'dzum gyis 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /dbugs dbyung phan bde stsol ba'i mchog sbyin mkhan/ /'ja' tshon ltar bkra ma 'dres spyan gyi dkyus/ /'gro la rjes su brtse bas ring (18na)por brkyangs/ /utpal sngon po'i tshal la 'gran bzod pa'i/ /smin ma'i 'khri shing g.yo ba'i zlos gar bsgyur/ /bung ba ltar gnag dbu —23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losheskra'i thor chugs ni/ /gsil bur babs pas phra ldem rked skabs non/ /rab dmar mchu sgros cung zad 'dzum pa yis/ /thags bzang tshems dkar bzhi bcu ngom pa bzhin/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgyas 'gro ba kun/ /'jigs pa brgyad las nye bar skyob mdzad cing / /g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bzung utpa la'i/ /phon po rna ba'i gong du g.yur za ldem/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i nyams dang ldan pa yi/ /zhabs zung sen mo'i dmar 'od nyi gzhen gyi/ /mdangs dang ldan yang 'jam mnyen padma'i gdan/ /rnyigs par ma gyur 'di ko e ma mtshar/ /gser sbyangs btso ma'i mdangs dang ldan pa la/ /sna tshogs rin chen phra yi rgyan spras pa'i/ /rab snyan sil sil gdu bu'i sgra ldan pa/ /'chi med lha mo'i tshogs kyi mdzes pa 'phrog /sku stod 'jam mnyen dar gyi na bza' can/ /pañtsa li ma'i gos bzang rnam par mdzes/ /rked phra 'dod pa'i nu ma mngon rgyas pas/ /zag med bde chen 'gro la ngom pa bzhin/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong 'chi med lha mo'i gzugs/ /mthong bas don ldan rgyal kun 'phags pa'i sku/ /lta bas ngom pa med pa mtshan dpe'i dpal/ /skal bzang mig gi bdud rtsi snga na med/ /rgyud mang glu las dam pa'i chos kyi sgra/ /rab snyan rna ba'i lus gyi dga' ston can/ /med byung brtan bde stsal pa'i mdza' na mo/ /changs pa'i dbyangs snyan drug cur ldan de 'jibs/ /kun gzigs ye shes ma la ya yi dri/ /srid zhi'i tsha gdung 'jom (18ba)pa'i cho ga mkhan/ /phan bde'i reg bya'i 'byung khungs gcig pu/ /ma phyis dri ma med pa'i ā darsha/ /de ltar khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho las/ /cung zad bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun 'phags ma yis/ /dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /nad gdon rims 'khrug dus min 'chi ba dang / /seng ge glang chen smyon pa me dang sbrul/ /lcags sgrog sha za rgya mtsho'i 'jigs chen brgyad/ /mi mthun kun las rnam par bsrung du gsol/ /tshe dang bsod nams mnga' thang dpal 'byor sogs/ /phun tshogs legs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi chu shel dbang po yi/ /cha shas ji bzhin gong du rgyas par mdzod/ /rigs brgyud chu bo'i rgyun ltar rab 'phel zhing / /sbrum ma rnams kyang nad med bde bar btsa'/ /bde skyid dpal la —24

bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ (bdalongs su spyod pa yi/ /dga' ston stsol zhig rje btsun lhag pa'i lha/ /mdor na 'di phyi bar do thams cad du/ /rje btsun sgrol ma khyed kyis rjes bzung ste/ /don gnyis 'dod pa'i re ba ma lus pa/ /lhun grub yid bzhin nor mchog stsal du gsol/ /ces rje btsun sgrol ma la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ dpon mo phun tshogs sgrol mas bskul ba'i ngor/ za hor gyi brnyes ra sa 'phrul snang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /na ma arya lo ke shwa rā ya/ /rnam 'dren kun gyi snying rje chen po'i gzugs/ /phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /rgya bal mtshams gyi tsan dan ljon pa las/ /rang byung gzugs skur bstan (19na〉pa gsol ba 'debs/ /ris med zhe 'gro la brtse ba'i 'dzum zhal sgo/ /phan bde'i dga' ston bsu ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /mthon mthing dbu skra'i thor tshugs g.yo ba'i rgyan/ /rin chen cod pan bcings la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgya las babs pa'i/ /bdud rtsis bkres skoms 'gro ba'i dbugs dbyung zhing / /g.yon pa sta zur la brten 'gying bag sku'i/ /rnam 'gyur gsal bar ngom la gsol ba 'debs/ mnyam par bzhengs pa'i zhabs kyi sen mo'i mdangs/ /thun mtshams mdzes pa 'dzin pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /'dab stong bzhad pa'i ze'u 'brur bsil zer can/ /nya rgyas steng na bzhugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'ja' ltar bkra ba'i pañtsa li ga'i gos/ /rin chen rgyan 'phreng 'khrol ba'i sgra snyan kyang / /mtshan ma'i 'ching ba las grol thugs rje che/ /nam mkha' lta bur khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ /sing gha'i gling gi tsan dan sprul snying dbus/ /rang byon nam mkha' rgyal po'i lung bstan ltar/ /sprul pa'i dge slong pho nyar mngags pa'i tshe/ grag stong skye med mtshon pa'i rang sgra las/ /mi rje srong btsan sgam po'i yi dam du/ /'byon par zhal gyis 'ches pa'i snying po'i don/ /pur rgyal bod 'bangs rjes su 'dzin lags na/ /thugs rje'i mthu dpung skyed pa'i dus la bab/ /g.yul 'khrug 'thab rtsod sad ser btsa' than dang / /mu ge nad rims nag phyogs bdud sde'i 'phrul/ /dkar min las kyi 'bras bu ma lus pa/ /byin rlabs nus pas zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bshad sgrub bstan dang de 'dzin —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shernam par 'phel/ /mi dbang khrims kyis mnga' 'bangs rdzogs ldan bzhin/ /(19ba/stabs 'byor mngon mtho nges legs don gnyer sogs/ /'di phyi'i mdun ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe yang ring por gnas te dal 'byor rten/ /dge sdig blang dor spyad pas don ldan zhing / /yang srid gru 'dzin ri bo'i spor bzung nas/ /mgon khyod sras su 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /byams brtse'i spyan zur rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba la/ /nam yang gzigs pa lhod pa'i skabs bral yang / /'dul skal sba la lus can bde skyid la/ /spyod pa'i dga' ston stsol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /khyad par snying nas gsol 'debs lhur len rnams/ /yid srubs g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga/ /brdung dang lhan cig chab srid ba dan dkar/ srid rtse'i bar du bsgreng bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon po khyod kyis rgya chen thugs bskyed par/ /'od mtshan stong du 'bar ba'i rgyal ba yis/ /legs bsngags dbugs phyung mdzad pa'i bden pa'i mthus/ /bsam don ji bzhin lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ces rang byung 'phags mchog lo ke shwa ra la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa phan bde'i dga' ston zhes pa 'di ni kun ldan gyi lo chu stod zla bar za hor gyi brnyes 'phags pa mched kyi drung du sgo gsum mi 'da' ba'i bcad rgya zhig bgyis skabs mchog dman kun la phan phyir 'bol rtsom go bde bar rgyal bas chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus tshes bzhi'i thun mtshams kyi nges pa zhig la sug bris su byas pa su sti sidhi/ /na ma arya wa ta ya/ /mi zad nam mkha'i mtha' yi tshad bzung bar/ /nus min sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje'i 'phrul/ /rnam rol cir yang brdzu ba'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /'phags mchog wa tir grags la gsol ba 'debs/ /pad (20na)zla'i steng na 'gying ldem thor tshugs gis/ rin chen rgyan dang dang gyi na bzas mdzes/ /phyag gnyis mchog sbyin sta zur dkur brten pa'i/ /'dren byed bdud rtsi'i dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma bcos bzhin lag gzugs su grub pa'i sku/ /ma bris yid ngor 'gegs med rnam bkra ba/ /ma 'dris kun la brtse chen thugs rje can/ /ma bos snying dbus 'jug snyel gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya gar pha rol bal po'i tshur rol gyi/ /nags klung dbus na ha ri tsan dan —26

bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ (bdeshing / /'phags chen rang byon sprul sku'i 'byung gnas che/ /lnga brgya'i 'gro ba 'dren par bstan las ci/ /lha gcig srong btsan smin mtshams 'od zer gyi/ /sprul pa'i dge slong rdzu 'phrul bkod pa yis/ /mang yul skye rgu'i yams nad mun pa'i dpung / /thugs rje'i nyi ma'i 'od kyis bsal zin nas/ /pad 'byung zab gter sbyang rtsi'i ros myos pa'i/ /gling pa gsum gyi mtshan ldan gter ston gcig /rin chen dpal bzang bung ba'i lung bstan sgrar/ /dbus 'gyur ljongs 'dir 'byon par bsgrags min nam/ /rgyal dang de sras dngos dang sprul pa kun/ /gshegs bzhugs mdzad pa mtha' dag lus can la/ /sman 'gyur las gzhan btang snyoms ma mchis pas/ /bde skyid dga' ston cho ga bstar bar rigs/ /nye ring med par mtho dma' thams cad la/ /khyab pa thugs rje chen po'i rta ljang can/ /chos dbyings zad mi shes pa'i mkha' klong du/ /'char dang nub pa spangs pa'i dam bca' dgongs/ /nyam thag 'gro drug 'dren la sangs rgyas lam/ /ston pa'i bstan dang de 'dzin kun rgyas shing / /(20ba thams gnyis gser gyi gnya' shing 'dzin ri'i 'phang / /mnga' 'bangs phan bder spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus min 'chi dang 'brug rtsod nad yams rims/ /sad ser btsa' than mu ge 'byung po'i gdon/ /mi dge'i rnam smin rgyu mthun bdag 'bras kyi/ /rgud pa ming tsam med par byin gyis rlobs/ /ring por 'tsho dang mtha' bzhi'i las sgo 'du/ /srid zhi'i legs tshogs yon tan gong du 'phel/ /'di dang gtan 'dun 'grub pa'i rdzogs ldan gyi/ /gangs can ljongs kun khyab par byin gyis rlobs/ /'phags mchog khyod kyis ngan 'gro'i sems can rnams/ /dbugs dbyung mtho ris lam la rab bkod de/ /lha mi'i rten bzang rnyed kun nges legs su/ /'dren pa'i dam bca'i khur chen mi btang gsol/ /dge ba'i rang bzhin pad rtsa zla 'od dang / /gangs ri'i mdangs ltar dkar ba gang thob pa/ /thub bstan 'phel dang khams gsum lus can rnams/ /rtag tu bde zhing skyid pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces rang byung 'phags pa wa ti la gsol 'debs thugs rje bskul ba'i smon lam dang bcas pa rdzogs ldan dga' ston zhes pa'i tshig sbyor go bde bar byas pa 'di'ang kun snan gyi lo chu sded zla bar za hor gyi bsdos pho brang po ta la'i — 27—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemachod khang rtser bcad rgya zhig bgyis pa'i tshes bzhi'i dus chen gyi thun mtshams la sug bris byas pa shri ye bha wantu/sngon goms byams brtse'i spyan dkyus ches ring ba/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i pha mtha' las brgal te/ /zhi ba'i gnyid las nyer bslang rgyal sras sar/ /'gro kun 'khrid mdzad mi pham mgon por 'dud/ /mtshan dpe'i snang ba 'bar ba'i cha byad kyis/ /srid mun brnag dka'i (21na)zug rngu drungs phyung nas/ /bde skyid rtse dga' dgod pa sbyin pa'i sgo/ /ris med 'gro la 'byed pa de ngo mtshar/ /gsung gcig bgrang du med pa'i skad rigs dang / /dam pa'i chos su go ba tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /mkha' mnyam ma rgan kun gyi 'dod pa'i re/ /yongs skong sngon med yongs 'du'i ljon pa bzhin/ /gang gi ma gzigs ji lta ji snyed chos/ ta des byar 'tshol la dus gsum rgyal kun gyi/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pas nyer gzhal yang / /rnyed pa'i pha mtha' 'chi med lam las brgal/ /'og min nyid du bla med bdud rtsi'i ros/ /myos pa'i nges pa lnga ldan skur bzhengs dang / /dga' ldan gnas su da dung slob pa'i zol/ /blo brid sgyu thabs mdzad pa 'os sam kye/ /de phyir rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa rnams/ /mnyam phyir dzambha'i gling nas gsol 'debs pa/ /ring por bskal yang yid dga' chos 'dzin nas/ /rmad byung thugs rje'i phyag rkyong dbugs dbyung zhig /rin chen dngul dkar rdul brtsegs mgon khyod sku/ /gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /bskrun tshe byams pa 'dus pa dang po la/ /mngon sum chos 'khor bskor bar byon nam snyam/ /dmigs pa'i yul dang 'di'i ched zang zing gtang / /lus dal ngag bkod yid kyi kun rtog 'phro/ /mdor na bzang po'i 'grel pa'i 'jog pa kun/ /rtag tu byams chos yon tan brgyad ldan shog /thub bstan snying po zhwa ser man bas pa'i sde'i/ /yang snying dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos gra che/ /thos bsam dpung pas nyer 'degs bkra shis pa'i/ /phun tshogs sgo mang phyogs bcur 'byed par shog /(21bskor jig rten kun du dus kyi 'khrug pa dang / /nad yams mu ge la sogs sdig to'i 'bras/ /ming tsam ma grags rdzogs ldan gsar pa yi/ /phan bde'i dpal gyi dga' ston dar —28

bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter ma dzod/ (bkabar shog /bdag pas g.yin gces byang sems yu ba can/ /mtha' bral lta ba'i rdo rje'i mtshon rnon pos/ /sgrib gnyis rtsa ba drungs nas nyer phyung te/ /dpal ldan stobs bcu'i go 'phang mngon gyur shog /ces sngags pa no mon khang gi phyi rten du bzhengs pa'i dngul dkar gyi byams pa la bstod cing smon lam du bya ba 'di yang sgo mang slob dpon zur pa ngag dbang dpal 'byor gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /chu yos rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i 'du khang du 'grem rgyu'i sngags thang gra tshar so so'i rgyab tu bstod pa sho lo ka re bris pa byin rlabs 'dod 'jo'i snying po/ /zhi khro rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma lus pa/ /rtse khams dwangs ma'i dbyings su 'ja' mtshon ltar/ /rnam bkra bla ma rigs 'dzin drag po rtsal/ /dngos grub kun 'byung dbang gi rgyal por bstod/ /grangs med bde bar gshegs pa'i rigs kun gyi/ /'dzad med yon tan yid bzhin rin chen gter/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid dpal chen po'i/ /zlos gar che mchog he ru ka la bstod/ /shes bya'i gnas la lkog tu ma gyur pa/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thugs/ /nam yang 'gyur med dngos grub bye ba'i gter/ /sgyu 'phrul yang dag khrag 'thung chen por bstod/ /mtshan dpe rab gsal rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sku/ /sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug gzi 'bar bas/ /nyi ma'i dngos po brgya yi lus 'dzin (22na)pa/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed por bstod/ /rnam 'dren tshangs dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i gsung / /'dzin dang drag shul 'jigs rung nga ro'i sgra/ /rta skad dbyangs su len pa khrag 'thung lha/ /padma'i rigs mchog dbang gi rgyal por bstod/ /mkha' ltar ched bral skye dgu'i dbang po dang /khams dang bsam par 'tshams pa'i 'phrin las rgyun/ /nam yang 'dzad mi shes par 'jug pa'i gar/ /mngon par bsgyur mdzad rdo rje gzhan nur bstod/ /rtsa lam bde stong dbyings grol mkha' 'gro dang / /rbod gtong pho nya las byed mthu rtsal can/ /snang srid ma mo yongs kyi rje dpon du/ /che btsan zla bral mngon rdzogs rgyal por bstod/ /lhun grub phyag rgya tshe dbang rnam smin sogs/ /bgrang yas rdo rje —29
