rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losheslob dpon tshogs kyi dbus/ kun bzang thog ma'i mgon gyi gdung 'tshong mkhan/ /rigs 'dzin gtso mchog thar pa 4rtsal la bstod/ /dpal chen thugs las sprul pa rgyal ba'i sras/ /bstan srung mchod bstod 'jig rten lā yi tshul/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i dkyil 'khor gtso/ /gdul dka' kun 'dul gsang ba'i bdag por bstod/ /drag sngags dmod pa'i mtshon chas dgra bgegs dpung / /phye mar 'thag mjad snang srid sde brgyad tshul/ /'dzin kyang he ru ka dang gnyis med pa'i/ /tshogs kyi dbang phyug stobs ldan nag por bstod/ /srid zhi'i phyag rgya ma lus zil gnan pa/ /chos kyi dbyings nas gdangs pa'i hom khung zhal/ /bdud dpung za bar rab rngams gshin rje gshed/ /dus dgra'i dbang po tshe bdag nag por bstod/ /(22ba)ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i dbyings nyid las/ /rang bzhin lhun grub 'phags mchog spyan ngas gzigs/ /thugs rje rnam 'phrul bde gshegs thub pa drug /rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba 'dren par mdzad der bstod/ /yid srubs kyis brlams ma rungs lha sbyin dpung / /'joms byed rdo rje 'bar ba'i thog mda' yis/ /'dar dngangs sa la brgyal zhing 'gyel byed pa/ /las gyi gshin rje 'char ka nag por bstod/ /rgyal ba kun yum dbyangs can ngag gi lha/ /dgra sde'i gshed du phur srung re ma tī/ /dngos grub char 'bebs 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /srid gsum bdag mo'i rnam par bstan la bstod/ zhal dkar lhun po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzis/ /'khrud pas bsgrun min mdzes sdug lang tsho'i dpal/ /'chi med bu mo bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor / /dpal ldan dung skyong lha mo khyod la bstod/ /lha gcig khri srong lde btsan sku yi lhar/ /byang sems nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa'i gar/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub la thogs med pa/ /lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la bstod/ /sde brgyad stong zlar bcas te srid gsum las/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i 'phrul gyi sgyu thabs mkhan/ /drang srong khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la/ /mthu stobs drag rtsal rdo rje'i thog mdar bstod/ /gsang ba'i bdag ngo/ rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal/ /dge slong legs ldan nag por thub pa'i bstan/ /bsrung bar bka' bsgos dgra lha khyung chen ra chan/ /spu gri 'bar rtsal rgyal po chen por bstod/ /ma logs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rnam bkra ba/ /bde —30—

wa bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ (ban wa wa gshegs sems dpa' khro bo yab yum gyi//gdan gsum (23na)tshang pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/khyab bdag bcom ldan mi bskyod rdo rjer bstod//'ja' ris rnam bkra ind+ra ni la'i ri//stong nyid rdo rje'i btsun mor rnam rol ba//bde chen lang tsho'i rtse dga' dgod pa can/khyab bdag dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom par bstod//shes rab bdag med lha mo'i e yig klong /thabs mchog bcom ldan waṃ yig zung 'jug pa//bde chen sa la gar dgu'i rol gar mkhan//dgyes mdzad rdo rje he ru ka la bstod//si rgyu wa ra'i mdangs 'dzin 'jam pa'i dpal//bzhu blug mig sman lhun po dus mtha'i mes//'khyud pa'i rtse dga' yongs dgod ma he'i zhal//'jigs byed bcom ldan khro bo'i dbang por bstod//gzungs sngags bklags pas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs bral zhes//rmad byung snyan pa'i gtam gyis dbugs dbyung zhing /'chi med bdud rtsis snying gi za ma tog/dgengs mdzad bcom ldan rnam par rgyal mar bstod//gsang sngags mthu las rdo rje'i chos bdun gyi//btsan po'i go ldan las kun nyer 'grub cing //chung ma 'dza' ba'i byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bum//rab 'bar rdo rje rnam par 'joms la bstod//gru 'dzin spo nas 'gro la nyer brtse bas//nam yang g.yel med gzigs pa spyan gyi dkyus//gdul dka' 'dul la dmar zlum rab 'khyil ba//myur mdzad mgon po mahā kwa lar bstod//bla mgon dbyer med thugs rje chen po'i mdangs//gaṅgā'i yab rig te se'i dpal 'dzin pa//phun tshogs dngos grub 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin mkhan//rab dkar mgon po yid bzhin nor bur bstod//rnam snang (23ba)thugs gsang dpal gyi be'u'i gdangs//laṅka'i dbang phyug drag por khros pa'i gzugs//grong khyer sum brtsegs 'dzoms mdzad nag po che//dpal ldan rdo rje gur gyi mgon por bstod//gsal stong rang sems rtsa khams dwangs ma'i dbus//stobs 'phrog dbang po'i gar gyis yongs rtsen kyang //phyi ru bram ze'i gzugs kyis rig pa 'dzin//skyong mdzad legs ldan gdong bzhi drag por bstod//lus ngan rlangs kyis lha min rab mnar zhing //legs bris dga' bde'i ngal gso ster byed pa//srid gsum dbul phongs sel ba'i mchog sbyin mkhan//rgyal chen rnam mang thos —3 —

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shernga 'i sras der bstod/ / rim dun sa 'og thod pa lcags kyi mkhar/ 'chi bdag gshin rje gnas pa'i grong khyer na/ /yi dwags sde dpon srog dbugs bla tshe'i bdag /las kyi gshin rje chos kyi rgyal por bstod/ /gtum chen drag por khros pa'i gad brgyangs kyis/ /dgra snying shubs nas lkog mar nyer 'thon kyang / /rno dbal ral gri mkha' la 'phyar byed pa/ /dbang gi skyes bu gnod sbyin beg tser bstod/ /dus mtha'i me rlung tsha ngar 'khrug pa'i dbus/ /pad nyir klu brgyad bsnol ba'i gdan steng na/ /padma rā ga'i lhun po gar dgu yi/ /rnam rol dbang drag khro bo'i rgyal por bstod/ /chags bzhad rngam zhal bdud sder mche ba gtsigs/ khrag chen bcud myang ljags dmar glog ltar 'khyug /sdang mig spyan gsum nyi zla lta bur 'khyil/ /shangs nas rlung sgras 'byung po brgyal la bstod/ /dbu skra smin ma sma ra me ltar 'bar/ /phyag drug (24na)mtshon chas bgegs dpung phye mar 'thag /brkyang bskum thebs brgyad brdabs pas sa gsum g.yo/ /khrag 'thung yongs kyi rje btsan dbang por bstod/ /sgeg dang mi sdug sna tshogs rgyan gyis sba/ /drag shul rta skad gad brgyangs 'jigs su rung / /snying rjes cher brngams zhi ba'i rang bzhin can/ /gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor bstod/ /ba spu las spros khro bo'i dmag gi dpung / /drag shul yid srubs don snying lkog mar 'byin/ /tshangs pa'i yul sar yongs snyeg bsrung ba yi/ /sra brtan gzhom med rdo rje'i gur la bstod/ /rdos bcas lus 'di snang stong lha skur sgom/ /ngag gis brag stong bzlas brjod rgyun chad med/ /yi gis mig stong zung 'jug lam bzang pos/ /skye bar lha khyod mi 'bral rjes 'dzin shog /gnas skabs mi dang mi min 'byung po'i gdon/ /bar gcod nyes brgya'i g.yul las rab rgyas cing / /tshe dpal bsod nams yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /myur du bla med byang chub thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang dad stobs kyi dbang phyug tshe dbang rdo rjes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /dge legs gter chen phyag na padma gang / /ma rung dgra sde'i gshed du khro bo'i gar/ /rab ston myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub char ltar phob/ /bla —32

wa wa bde gshegs sras bcas kyi bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod/ (bkamagon dbyer med thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /deng nas byang chub snying po ma thob par/ /'bral med thugs rjes bzung ste 'di phyi dang / /bar do'i 'jigs pa kun las nye bar skyobs/ /gnas(24ba)skabs dam chos bsgrub la mthun pa'i rkyen/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las lhun grub cing / /mthar thug zung 'jug dpal ldan mgon po'i sku/ /mngon du byas te 'gro rnams 'dren gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang nam mkha' lha dbang la phan phyir bris/ /su sti siddhi/ thub rnams spangs rtogs yon tan rab mnyam yang / /gdul dka'i 'gro la nyer brtse'i snying stobs la/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun mgrin gcig bsngags pa'i yul/ /bcom ldan shākya seng ger mgos phyag 'tshal/ /bde gshegs kyis bskul cod pan ma pham dbur/ /bcings te gzigs pa lnga yis 'dzam gling 'gro/ /yang dag lam la bkri phyir dga' ldan nas/ /'pho mdzad dam pa tog dkar phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bco lnga'i mtshan/ /sgyu 'phrul lha mo gso sbyong la gnas dus/ /glang chen thal gar mche ba drug ldan gyi/ /rnam pas lhums su zhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbo zla'i tshes bcur slo g.yas nas bltam tshe/ /ngo mtshar ltas bzang lha klus sri zhu mdzad/ /skye mthar zhal 'ches lus can bde skyid mthus/ /don kun grub mtshan gsol la phyag 'tshal lo yi ge rkyal dang glang chen 'dul la sogs/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi las brgal rgyu rtsal gyis/ /gzhen nu'i dus nas stobs can dregs ldan tshogs/ /khengs pa 'phrog par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang lo nyer dgu'i bar du rgyal po'i srid/ /bskyangs tshe 'jig rten mthun dang log rtog rnams/ /sel phyir sa 'tsho grags 'dzin gyis mtshon pa'i/ /btsun mo khab tu bzhes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal gsung sil snyan sgrar (25na)drangs nyer bskul zhing / /rga na 'chi dang dge slong gzigs rkyen gyis/ /mchod rten rnam dag drung du rab byung bar/ /brgya byin ngur smrig phul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rne ra ñdza nar mkha' khyab ting 'dzin la/ /lo drug dka' ba spyad tshe zas gtsang sogs/ /dbugs dbyung legs skyes 'o mas bsnyen bkur mthus/ /gser mdog lang tsho dar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyil krung gcig la byang chub mchog brnyes phyir/ /rdo rje — 33 —

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo she wa wa gdan snyel rtswa tshong bkra shis las/ /nyer bslangs dur pa'i chun po bting ba'i steng / /mi g.yo'i dam bca' brtan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud sde'i mtshon char mdzes ma'i slu brid kyis/ /ma tshugs grangs med mchod sbyin dpang po ru /sa lhas thal mo sbyar tshe 'dod lha yis/ /dang bas ched du bsngags la phyag 'chal lo/ /sum cu rtsa lnga'i dgung lor nyer babs nas/ /sa ga zla ba'i bco lnga'i thun drug gi /tha mar bla med byang chub bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /thugs kyi dpal ber gtams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdun phrag bdun mthar bkra shis chigs bcad gsungs/ /changs dbang gis bskul wa ra nā si sa /chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhir bden pa bzhi'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brgyad cu'i lo la slebs pa'i dpyid tha yi/ /bco lnga'i tshes gyi nang par de bzhin gshegs/ /'jig rten khams su mi snang ltar gyur nas/ /mya ngan 'da' bar mjad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thun slong gdul byar bstan kyang nges pa'i don/ /skye 'chi spangs ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar yongs (25ba)phye ba'i/ /'jad med dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa 'bul/ /thog med bsags pa'i sdig lhung ma lus pa/ /gnyen po stobs ba 'khe sgo nas bshags par bgyi/ /rang g.yin kun gyis bsgrub pa'i dge ba la/ /dad pa'i sems kyis rtag tu yi rang ngo / /rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa 'khor ba'i mtha'/ /stongs min chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /'gro kun thar pa'i lam du ma bzhag par/ /gzugs sku mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs/ /nyer bsags bsod nams phung po skye dgu rnams/ /rnam mkhyen ye shes 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /dge ba'i 'bras bu 'jig rten khams rnams su/ bkra shis bde legs chen pos khyab par shog /'o skol gyi ston pa lha dang bcas pa'i ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po nyi ma'i gnyen gyi mjad pa bcu gnyis las brtsams pa'i bstod pa mchog dman kun gyis go bde phyir snyan ngag gi lam nas ma drangs shing brda dang mngon brjod kyis ma bcings pa zhig dgos zhes grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bskul ba la brten nas klu sgrub kyi gsung du grags pa'i steng rnyed don la gnas tshe dgongs pa 'grel rgyu khyad par can yod pa las 'os ma mchis mod/ gal te 'bri gung skyob —34

pas mdzad pa lta bu ming btags kyis 'dres na don gyi char som nyi 'ga' zhig snang zhing / /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i thugs rtsom de tshig sbyor legs kyang go dka' la mdzad pa gcig la tshigs bcad gnyis tsam yod pa'i cung mi gsal ba nas 'dul ba'i rnam bshad 'khrul pa dang bral ba lung rigs gter mdzod kyi dgongs don sor bzhag pa'i bstod pa legs byas (26na〉sgongs 'du'i snye ma zhes bya ba 'di ni za hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos me sprul hor zla lnga pa'i yar ngo'i dga' ba gnyis par pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa yang bskul ba po nyid kyis bgyis pa dza byu/ /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheno༅༅/ /rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bstod pa taskru ra'i thre/da mang zhes pa bzhugs rbedu/ /༄༅/ /na ma ārya mañdza shri ye/ mkha' khyab don dam chos sku lha yi lam/ /bcu drug bde chen mtshan bzang dbang po'i gzhu/ /gnyis med gnyis su 'char ba'i sgyu dra'i gar/ /ston mdzad 'jam mgon zur phud lnga par 'dud/ /chu skyes 'dab brgya rgod pa'i ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ /rab gsal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya rgyas steng/ /gur kum rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po ni/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od kyis 'khrud pa bzhin/ /bcu drug lang tsho dar ba'i 'jo sgeg can/ /rgyal sras gzhen nur ston 'di ring po nas/ /rnam 'dren kun gyi yab ces rgan po'i mtshan/ /'chang ba'i gtam 'di zol gyis sgrib pa bzhin/ /'tshams sprin gdangs kyi ri bo pad rag gi /mdangs dbyibs gzugs sku'i bkod pa bye ba'i tshogs/ /mtha' ma 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma bskams bar/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i don du bstan las ci/ /mig gi bdud rtsir spyod pa'i mdzes sdug sku/ /phun tshogs mtshan dpe'i ri mo bkra ba gang / /mthong thos dran dang reg pas rnam grol ba/ /'di ko skal bzang gdul bya'i bsod nams dpyid/ /de don (2na)rtogs pa'i blo gros ches phra rnams/ /sna tshogs rin chen phreng ba'i do shal dang / /pañtsa li ga'i dar gyi sham thabs la/ /bsngags brjod dar dir sgrog pa ngal ba'i gnas/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa mig sman ltar gnag pa/ /mthar byed nā da'i sgra dbyangs rta ljang can/ /rgol ngan smra ba'i ku mud zum pa dang / /dpyod ldan blo gros pad dkar 'dzum gyis bsu/ /dam pa'i chos kyi rgyud mang 'brol ba'i glu/ /skal bzang rna bar 'jibs pa tshangs pa'i gsung / /ches cher rmongs pa'i 'gro la brag ca'i sgra/ /mi bzad bdud sde'i snying la tsher ma bzhin/ /chu klung gcig la snag khrag bdud rtsi sogs/ /sna tshogs du mar snang zhing don —36

rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa ta'i ra'i rgyud mang / (bdebyed pa/ /kun rdzob 'brul ba'i chos kun don dam dbyings/ /ma rnyed dbu ma'i lam bzang ston pa bzhin/ /skad cig tsam la rgya chen shes bya'i mtha'/ /'jal nus zab yangs thugs kyi rgya mtsho cher/ /grangs med chos kyi ri bong 'dzin pa'i gzugs/ /mi 'char lkog tu gyur de da ga re/ /phul byung thugs rje'i laṅka'i bdag po'i gzugs/ /blo ldan snying gi rin chen rtsig (2ba)ngos la/ shar tshe lnga rig ha nu dzo gang / /dga' ba'i zlos gar sgyur la ci yang brel/ /chos brgyad 'bod grogs 'phrul gyis nyer drangs pa'i/ /dam pa'i chos kyi si tā dor byas nas/ /'dir snang ri dwags snyeg la mgon khyod kyis/ /mi phan byang bstan phug par nyi zer bzhin/ /gtan gyi skyabs su gsol na smos ci 'tshal/ /cung zad dran pas phan bde'i legs tshogs rnams/ /stsol mdzad 'dod pa'i re skong dbang gi rgyal/ /sngon med yid bzhin nor bu gzhan na su/ /'gro ba'i dbang por 'tsham pa'i 'phrin las kyi/ /pha mtha' kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram pa la/ /'jal byed 'dzad pa med pa'i zhags pa yis/ /srid dang zhi ba'i dngos kun gcig tu bcings/ /phra zhib rnam par dpyod pa'i mkhyen pa'i spyan/ /dkyus ring zur gyis 'phangs pa'i nyag phran gyis/ /mtha' med khengs ldan shes bya lus phra ma/ /kun yid dga' ba'i 'dzum dang bcas te bsu/ /brtse chen dpyid kyi dpal mo'i mngal yangs nas/ /lhag bsam chu mig gsar pa'i lang long can/ /rlabs chen spyod pa mchog gi char rgyun gyis/ /phan dang bde ba'i myu gu g.yur du za/ /dbang phyug mig las spar ba'i me dpung gis/ /nyag phran bdag po bcom pa nges par rdzun/ /bden na khyod kyi nus mthu'i thog mda' yis/ /nag po'i phyogs rnams cig car bcom min nam/ /khyod dang ma la yar skyes ljon pa gnyis/ /mi shes tsha gdung 'joms la mtshungs na yang / /mgon khyod nyes pa'i skyon bral ngag gi lha/ /tsan dan shing de gdug (3na)pa'i sprul gyis 'khril/ /e ma ngo mtshar mkha' la nyi zla zung / /chos bzang lha yi mdun sar mig stong can/ /grangs med rkang 'thung khrod na yongs 'du'i ljon/ /rgyal sras 'phags tshogs dbus na 'jam dbyangs khyod/ /mchog dman kun la nye dang ring med par/ /gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis 'dong pa'i don/ /lhun grub re ba ma lus skong byed —37

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shepa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu klu dbang gtsug na mdzes/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab ral gri yis/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i drwa ba bcad pa dang / /lhan cig 'khor ba sdug bsngal kun gyi rgya/ /dral te 'gro rnams bde ba chen por 'khrid/ /gang gi gsang gsum byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /skye dgu'i yid kyi yol gor 'khyil ba na/ /shes ldan dad pa'i bstod bsngags zil mngar chu/ /mgon khyod thugs kyi padma'i ze'u 'brur 'bab/ /mtha' bral rlabs chen mdzad pa mchog gi nor/ /phyur bur spungs pa gcig tu shong ba'i snod/ /sprul la 'jig rten mes po ngal gyur na/ /srid gsum 'di yang da gdod chung ngur khums/ /chos phung rgya mtshor shar ba'i pu ti ka /phrag gong ātpal 'dab steng mngon chags pa/ /blta phyir lhun pos nyi zla'i sgron me zung / /bteg nas ngal med lta bar chas pa bzhin/ /thabs shes zung la jug rgyud las drangs pa'i mdas/ /gti mug snying ga phug pa'i khrag gi rgyun/ /'gro la rjes chags dmar ba'i 'od gzi la/ /thun mtshams mdangs su byed pos btags sam snyam/ /rgod ma kha la 'gran bzod zhabs sen (3ba)gyis/ /'jam mnyen chu skyes 'dab ma sreg go zhes/ /ri bong 'dzin de tsha ba'i gdung sel slad/ /mkha' las babs nas stan du 'ong pa bzhin/ /chos kun mkhyen yang slob pa 'phags pa'i tshul/ /drang po'i sku yang 'khyog po'i 'gying bag can/ /zhi zhing dul yang bdud sde'i tshogs la khro/ /kun la brtse yang skal ldan rjes su 'dzin/ /mgon khyod thugs rje'i zegs ma ma 'dris pa'i/ /lus can rnams la 'jug pa rdzun gtam ste/ /tsand+ra go mi mkhas pa'i mthar son yang / /da dung skye dgu phal cher rnam par rmongs/ /'gro kun 'dzum gyis bsu ba'i zhal khyim la/ /gur gum gsar pa'i mdangs la dmar 'od can/ /'khor ba'i pha rol 'tshol ba'i spyan gyi dkyus/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' las rnam par brgal/ /yid 'ong gdub sil 'brol ba'i snyan po'i sgra/ /rna ba'i bdud rtsir byed pa'i 'od dkar can/ /yid bzhin 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /rtsed 'jor rol ba'i 'dab chags ngang pa su/ /rgyal ba las kyis mkhyen pa'i phung po dang / khyod kyi rnam par yangs pa'i blo gros gnyis/ /'jig rten mes pos srang la bteg pa na/ /lci dang yang ba'i go skabs med 'di mtshar/ /dpal —38

rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa ta'i ra'i rgyud mang / (bdaldan stobs bcu'i rtsal 'chang 'dren pa kun/ /kun dga'i legs bshad spel phyir rgyal ba'i sras/ /sras bcas rnams kyi gtsug na mtho ba'i lha/ /lha mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs zhes grags pa 'bar /ngag gi dbang po dbang phyug brgyad ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen de mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpyid/ /sgrib (4na)gnyis las bral las can 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mchog gi dngos grub dngos su stsol la mkhas/ /'tshams sprin mdangs 'dzin 'dzin ma yongs kyi rgyan/ /rgyan phreng gis mdzes mdzes sdug gzhen nu'i gzugs/ /gzugs sku ngo mtshar mtshar sdug 'dzin pa'i mgon/ /mgon po 'jam dbyangs dbyangs bdun legs bshad 'brol/ /dung dung yid kyis rtag tu lhar bsten na/ /brtan brtan snying gi pad mtshor legs bsdogs nas/ /'grig 'grig gsung gi snang ba legs ta༄65 chi kha / /yang yang thugs rje'i phyag gis dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /ldem ldem padma 'dab ma rgyas pa'i dbus/ /dkar dkar chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor steng / /mdzes mdzes gcig tu bsdus pa'i mtshan dpe'i sku/ /gsal gsal kun rtog bir gyis ci yang 'bri/ /pha mtha' mi mngon tshang tshing rnam par 'khrigs/ kha dog rab dkar kha ba'i reg byas gdungs/ /tsha grang mi snyom tha ga pa yi yul/ /ṭha ga ra la thob byar 'dzin pa rnams/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i mun pas nyer bsgribs pas/ /mi zad sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i rgyu sgrub par/ /me tog bcud la bung ba ltar 'khor ba'i/ /ma lus 'gro ba drongs shig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /ka ma la ltar 'jam mnyen gzugs kyi sku'i/ kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i bkod pa dang / /ga bur ngad ldang gdung sel thugs rje'i phyag /nga rgyal can gyi 'gro ba'i gtsug na khyongs/ /ca co legs par bshad pa'i dbyangs snyan po/ /cha shas res kyang yid dang rna ba la/ /ja dkar btung bas rig pa'i mdangs gsal ltar/ /nya (4ba)rgyas zla ltar blo gros 'phel bar mdzod/ /ta la'i glegs bam rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung / /tha na chung ngu'i dka' gnad tsam la yang / /da lta thogs med smra ba'i spobs pa mchog /nā gā rdzun 'a rnam dpyod ltar mtshungs mdzod/ /pa sangs ltar dkar mkhas pa'i bya ba kun/ /pha rol rgol ba zil gyis gnon nus pa/ /ba glang dbus na khyu mchog ji bzhin du/ /ma lus shes ldan rnams kyi mgon du —39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemadzod/ /tsa na yin kyang dngos su zhal bstan nas/ /tsha zer sprin dang padma ji bzhin du/ /dza ya'i gsung rab kun la lta ba'i mig /wa ler gsal ba'i shes rab rgyas par mdzod/ /zha yig ltar 'khyil 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i nang / /za byed nyen mongs chu srin gdug pas gtses/ /'a 'ur mi bzad sdug bsngal ldan pa rnams/ /ya mtshan dag pa'i zhing du khyod kyis drongs/ /ra ba med pa'i phug pa'i blun sgom dang / /la lung 'khyam pa'i tog ge kha bshad mkhan/ tan khrag sdig la rol pa'i kla klo'i sde/ /sa yi rdul ltar khyab rnams rjes su zungs/ /ha cang dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar thug 'dir/ /a don skye med rtogs pa nyin skar tsam/ /ha la'i dug 'dra'i gnas ngan len gyi rgyu/ /a mra'i 'bras ltar myong rnams rjes brtser mdzod/ /de ltar dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /rgyas sras ga cho ne nu'i tshul 'dzin ngag gi lha/ /dran pas rnam 'dren rin chen gling mchog tu/ /'khrid pa'i ded dpon brtan pa'i 'khor lo dgongs/ /mi 'phrog dad pa'i shing rtas rab drangs pa'i/ /shugs drag smon lam dkyil 'khor rta ljang can/ /snyan (5na/'gyur tshig gi mkha' la nyer 'phags na/ /thugs rje'i pad dkar 'dab ma 'dzum las ci/ /bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ /nyon mongs dug gsum drag po'i gdon gyis gtses/ /gnas ngan len pa'i rgyu yi khur chen blangs/ /blang dang dor byar lta ba'i blo mig sdongs/ /mngon mtho nges legs lam las rgyab kyis phyogs/ /mi bzad ngan song g.yang sar gom pa 'phyan/ /dge ba'i las kyi 'khar ba'i rten dang bral/ /nyam thag snying rje'i gnas su gyur rnams la/ /mgon po khyod kyis rjes su mi 'dzin na/ /gtan gyi skyabs gnas dam pa su la re/ /bdag g.yin brje ba'i byang chub sems ldan pa'i/ /snyan po'i gtam yang ming gi lhag mar zad/ /ches cher snyigs ma lnga yi nyer sbags pas/ /ha cang gdul ba dka' zhes btang snyoms su/ /'jog na bgrod par dka' ba'i chu bo la/ /mi phan gru dang zam pas ci zhig byed/ /'gro ba'i khams dang bsam pa bag la nyal/ /ji bzhin rtogs nas rjes su 'dzin pa la/ /rmad byung mkhyen pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa/ /rgyal sras dam pa khyod la lhag par mnga'/ /'gro ba kun la rang gi bu gcig ltar/ /rnam par brtse bas cung zad tsam du yang //—40

rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa ta'i ra'i rgyud mang / (bdayal bar mi 'dor snying rje chen po ni/ /rje btsun khyod kyi rgyud la rtag tu ldan/ /gzhan la phan na dmyal ba'i me dong du/ /'jug pa mtsho dang rdzing bur ngang pa ltar/ /dga' zhing spro ba'i nus ldan lhag pa'i sems/ /'phags chen dam pa'i yul las g.yin du ci/ /skye dgu'i mgon skyabs dpung dang gnyen gyur pa'i/ /(5ba〉pon tan kun tshang dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ /'gro rnams yal bar 'dor na skyabasaganas mchog /gsung rab mang por bshad pa rdzun du bas/ /de phyir thugs rje chen po'i zhags pa yis/ /lus can mtha' dag mi gnas myang 'das mchog /rang gzhan don gnyis grub me'i gtan bde'i gzhin/ khrid cig smra ba'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /lugs gnyis sna yis 'khrigs pa'i rdzing bu la/ /rmongs pa'i glang chen rgyu ba'i gom stabs kyis/ /phan bde'i yal 'dab 'dam ltar brdzib la/ /dran 'dzin lcags kyus thul zhig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /me tog mda' yis dge ba'i sems kyi snying / /mngon par phug pa'i ri dwags sha ra bha/ /phul byung byin rlabs dpyad kyis rab phral nas/ /log spyod zug rngu choms shig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /sgra tshad bzo gso nang don rig pa dang / /snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor zlos gar gzhung / /skar rtsis bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas rnams kun/ /'chad pa'i rnam dpyod stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /mtha' klas gtsug lag mngon par 'khyil ba'i chu/ /log rtog nyes bshad rnyog ma'i lang long can/ /rigs lam nor bu ke ta gas drungs pa'i/ /rtsod pa'i rnam dpyod stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i gzhung lugs ma lus pa/ khung du spel dang rgya chen snying por bsdu/ /ma tshang kha 'gengs gab dkrugs sdeb pa sogs/ /(6na/rdom pa'i rnam dpyod stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /blo gros dri ma med pa'i ā darshar/ /cung zad tsam la gsung rab byed pa'i gzugs/ /thogs med 'char ba'i 'dzin dang mi brjed pa'i/ /gzungs kyi dngosagrub stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /phyogs des mi ngoms legs par bshad pa'i tshig /lus phra'i 'gram pa'i chang gi thigs pas kyang/ /yon tan ba ku la yi kha 'byed pa'i/ /thos pa'i dngos grub stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /tshig tsam ma yin de don dka' ba'i gnad/ /kun la zhib mor brtags —4/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheshing nyer dpyad pas/ /yang dag don gyi nges pa gting rnyed pa'i/ /bsam pa'i dngos grub stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /sde snod gsum dang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sogs/ /zab mo'i lam rnams rgyud ldan bla ma yi/ /man ngag ji bzhin nyams su rab len pa'i/ /sgom pa'i dngos grub stsol cig 'jal dbyangs/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog /dbyar gyi ljon pa'i lo 'dab ltar rgyas shing / /sems can mtha' dag skyid pa'i grib gsil la/ /yun ring 'tsho zhing skyong cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gsol 'debs bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / /dus gsum dge ba'i sgra dbyangs snyan po can//'gro ba'i yid kyi gdung sel bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /rgyal kun mchod pa'i rol mos mnyes gyur cig /ces 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs la bstod pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa tambu ra'i rgyud mang zhes pa 'di ni 'ga' zhing chos rje rgya yags rab 'byams pa grags pa rgyal mtshan dang /zung chu rab 'byams pa 'phrin las sogs kyis bskul pa'i ngor/ slob dpon daṇḍi'i gzhung lugs la sbyangs nas cung zad shes pa la bsten snyan ngag mkhan por rlom pa/ za hor gyi rigs las a wa dhū tī pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde/ ming g.yin 'jam nga byangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam/ tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjer 'bod pa'i sdum bu pas/ rnam rgyal zhes pa chu mo sprul gyi lo dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs gyi rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes kyi nyin/ rgya nag gi sa'i cha ri bo rtse lnga dang le dbar bdun rgyas chod pa'i pho brang pe cing gi nye 'dabs su ja sbyor gsum gyi yun la grub par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni smon 'gro paṇa chen no/ /—42

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdar༅༅/ /yon tan gyi gzhi rten bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len gyi rim pa zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren zhes bya ba bsdo kyigs rbersha/ / tsho༄7/ /na mo gu ru we/ thugs rje'i char rgyun dri med 'gro kun gyi/ /ngal gsor stsol mdzad 'jam dpal snying po zhes/ /nyin byed ji ltar rmongs pa'i mun 'joms shing / /blo gros snang ba'i dpal ster de yis skyongs/ /de'ang blo ldan gyi skyes bu ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal gyis ches cher 'jigs pa dag yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims la gnas pa'am/ min kyang rung / kha na ma tho ba med pa'i mchod pa rten rnams kyi drung du bshams te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs dang sangs rgyas chos tshogs rnams sngon du btang nas/ rang gi mdun gyi mkha' la rin chen khri/ /pad zla'i steng du dmar ser dhīḥyig las/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo btsong kha pa/ /sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam rol can/ /rab dkar zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i zhal khyim la/ /phyag zung chos 'chad chu skyes yu ba ni/ /mnyen ldum phra ldem g.yas g.yon 'dab rgyas steng/ ta shes rab ral gri pu sta ka yis mdzes/ /paṇa zhu gser mdog chos gos rnam gsum gyon/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i skyil mo krung bcas pa'i/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshon pa las/ /lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung bkod (2na)pa'i zhing khams nas/ /bde bar gshegs pa seng ge'i nga ro'i dpal/ /rgyal sras bse ru nyan thos 'khor tshogs bcas/ /thogs med spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur/ /dmigs brtse ma dang / me tog bdug spos sgron me dri chab dang / /bza' dang bca' ba snyan pa'i rol mo dbyangs/ /'dod yon lnga dang rgyal srid rin chen bdun/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs rnams 'bul/ /bgrang bar mi nus thog med —43

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'akhor ba sa /ji snyed bsags pa'i sdig pa'i tshogs spyi dang / /tshe 'dir g.yul zhakhrug khrims dang 'tsho ba'i ched/ /srog gcod la sogs lus ngag yid kyi las/ /gnag pa'i 'bras bu 'byin pa'i sdig lhung kun/ /bcos min bsam pa thag pas snying nas bshags/ /mchog dman 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /theg gsum 'phags pa sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /chos 'khor bskor zhing mi 'gyur brtan par gsol/ /legs byas rgyu tshogs kun mkhyen thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bshags pa'i rjes su byang chub ltung bshags/ gtso rgyal ma rnams kyang rten gyi drung du phyag dang bcas te 'grub na bya/ /mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas (2ba)rang la thim par bsam zhing / /nyin re bzhin lan cig gam/de las mang ba blos skabs dang sbyor zhing / dmigs brtse ma brgya stong sogs gang lcogs kyang bzla'o/ /tshegs chung dus sdig sgrib bshags thebs kyi nyams len go bde zhing khyer sla ba 'di yang byang phyogs nor 'dzin skyong ba thu shal thu rdo rje rgyal pos bskul ba la brten nas/ tā la'i bla ma badzra dha ras lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor bla ma dang spyan ras gzigs dbyer med du sgrub pa dge legs kyi gter mdzod ces bya ba rbe rdzogs bzhugs so/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu dra'i gar/ /dngos grub phan bde'i gter gyur bla ma mchog /'jig rten dbang phyug la brten rnal 'byor gyi/ /nyams len nor bu'i 'phreng ba 'di na'o/ /dge legs 'dod dgu stsol mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung la/ /bdag sogs sems can 'khor ba las/ /sgrol bar bya phyir skyabs su mchi/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar ba yi/ /'gro ba ma lus sgrol slad du/ /zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / /brtson pas nyams su blang bar —44

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdabagyi/ /rang lus tha mal gnas pa'i snying ga yi/ /pad nyi'i steng du rig pa'i ngo bo ni/ /hrīḥ yig dmar nag yongs gyur khro bo'i rgyal/ /dbang chen dmar po gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /dur khrod chas rgyan me dpung dbus bzhugs pa'i/ /thugs ma'i hriḥ sa 'od 'phros gdon bgegs bskrad/ /rdo rje'i me dpung zhur khang chen por gyur/ /oṃ badzra kro dha rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ rang lus tha mal spyi gtsug nam mkha'i dbyings/ /hūṃ las rin chen sna lnga'i gzhal yas khang / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rnams rdzogs tsho dbus//padma 'dab bzhi lte bar glang po che/ /seng ge rta dang rma (3na)bya nam mkha' lding / /rnams kyis bteg pa'i rin chen khri steng du/ /ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid/ /rnam pa longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can/ /phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis/ /me tog pad dkar mnyen lag 'khyil ldem 'dzin/ /rin chen dbu rgyan snyan cha gdu bu dang / /dar gyi stod g.yogs pañtsa li ka can/ /mnyam gzhag steng na tshe yi bum pa 'dzin/ /spyi gtsug pad zla'i steng na oṃ dkar las/ /sku yi lha tshogs 'dus pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ /sku mdog dkar po skyabs sbyin 'khor lo 'dzin/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i tshul gyis skyil krung bzhugs/ /mgrin par pad zla'i gdan la āḥ dmar las/ /gsung gi lha tshogs 'dus pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ /sku mdog dmar po skyabs sbyin padma 'dzin/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i tshul gyis skyil krung bzhugs/ /snying gar pad zla'i gdan la hūṃ mthing las/ /thugs kyi lha tshogs 'dus pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ /sku mdog mthing kha skyabs sbyin rdo rje 'dzin/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i tshul gyis skyil krung bzhugs/ /lte bar pad zla'i gdan la dhī ser las/ /yon tan lha tshogs 'dus pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ /sku mdog ser po skyabs sbyin rin chen 'dzin/ /gsang gnas padma'i gdan la hā ljang las/ /'phrin las lha tshogs 'dus pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ /sku mdog ljang gu skyabs sbyin rgya gram 'dzin/ /'dab bzhi'i shar du dkar mo me tog ma/ /lto na bdug spos 'dzin pa ser mo dang / nub tu mar me 'dzin pa dmar mo dang / /bya dang dri chab 'dzin pa ljang mo rnams/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yon pa pi wang 'dzin/ /g.yas pa rang rang mchod pa'i (3ba)rdzas rnams thogs/ /rin chen rgyan dang —45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedar gyi na bza' can/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas dga' ba'i gar stabs bsgyur/ /rang gi snying ga'i rta mgrin snying ga las/ /'od zer 'phros pas rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /sprin ltar gtibs pas bskor te thogs med du/ /byon nas dam tshig pa la thim par gyur/ /gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /ces sogs kyi mjug tu padma ka ma lwa ye : / kun 'dus drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang / /mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo'i tshogs/ /gus pas 'bul la brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /ratna gu ru maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas/ shabha 'a bar gyis mchod/ /kun 'dus drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /yid 'ong gzugs dang sgra snyan rol mo'i tshogs/ /dri ro reg bya'i khyad par ji snyed pa/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /rū pa nas/ /spar sha'i bar/ kun 'dus drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gzhan yang rin chen bdun dang bkra shis kyi/ /rtags brgyad rdzas brgyad la sogs ji snyed pa/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas ba che kha su gsol/ /sngags gsham du sa pta ratna lha gi mo ga la pra ti smi ye swāhā/ de nas bstod pa gang 'os byas pa' mjug tu/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa la/ /snying nas gus pas yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'khor ba'i phun tshogs nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas su/ /shes nas nges 'byung skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nyam thag 'gro rnams pha mar yid ches nas/ theg chen sems bskyed skye bar gsol ba 'debs/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob 'dod blo skyes nas/ /rdo rje'i theg par 'jug par gsol 'debs na/ /nyams su blangs pa'i lam rnams ma lus pa/ /zhi bar gol (4na long log par 'khyams pa sogs/ /nyes pa'i skyon rnams ma lus rab bral te/ /'khrul med bde chen skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ /spyi bo'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ga nas/ /'od dang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pa yis/ /rang gi smin mtshams yan gang bum dbang thob/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag /tha mal snang zhen zhen pa kun sbyangs te/ /sku yi byin rlabs thams cad 'thob par gyur/ /mgrin pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ga nas/ /'od dang —46

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ khobadebadud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pa yis/ /rang gi mgrin pa yan gang gsang dbang thob/ sdig sgrib nyes lhung thams cad byang zhing dag /zag med bde chen ye shes rgyud la skyes/ /snying ga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ /'od dang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi babs pa yis/ /rang gi snying ga yan gang sher dbang thob/ /sdig sgrib nyes lhung thams cad byang zhing dag /bde bas stong pa nges pa'i ye shes skyes/ /lte ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ga nas/ /'od dang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pa yis/ /rang gi lte ba yan gang rgyal ba yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan ma lus pa/ /thogs pa med par grub pa'o nus pa ba 'ag /gsang gnas lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ga nas/ /'od dang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pa yis//rang gi gsang gnas yan gang zhi rgyas dang / /dbang drag 'phrin las sgrub pa'i nus pa thob/ /de nas bla ma rang gi snying dbus su/ /spyan drangs 'od zhu'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag /tshig gi dbang thob rig pa'i ngo bo mthong / /de nas dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /sogs bsngo smon gyis rgyas 'debs bya'o/ /de ltar thun mong min pa'i zhal shes gsum/ /ma gtogs yi ge'i phreng bar bkod pa yi/ /'gro kun dge ba'i bshes dang mi 'bral zhing / /theg mchog chos la spyod pa'i dpal gyur cig /ces bla ma'i rnal 'byor bla ma dang spyan ras gzigs dbyer med du sgrub pa dge legs kyi gter mdzod (4ba/ri di 'ang / gso rig smra ba byang ngos 'tsho byed bsod nams dpal bzang gis bskul ba ltar/ za hor gyi btsun pa ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar/ /na mo gu ru we/ phan bde'i 'dod dgu'i re ba kun/ /stsol mdzad yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor dpag bsam gyi/ /ljon pa'i 'bras bzang 'di na'o/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun kyi nam mkhar seng shes bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ ngo bo rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rnam pa khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu thugs dar bsnol te 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo —47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (/shekrung gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par snya dmar po/ thugs kur hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa/ thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ zhes skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur pa la yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar ba 'bul/gang drin ma sogs kyi gsol ba ci shes btab pa'i mthar/ bla ma rin po che bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma de nyid 'od du zhu ste rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas/ rang gi lus ngag (ldan thad gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs ngo bo dbyer med du gyur par mos nas/ skye ba kun tu dpal ldan bla ma dang / zhes sogs kyi smon lam ci rigs bya'o/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor shin tu nyung ngur bsdus pa 'di yang bā dur hang tha'i jis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus bshes gnyen gzugs/ /bstan nas 'gro rnams 'dren par ngesarnyed phyir/ /phul byung dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa'i/ /zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'bri bar bya/ /de la 'dir zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bya ba la/ sngon du 'gro ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sgom pa dkyus ltar bya/ dngos gzhi'i rim pa la/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badzra su bhā wa ātpa ko3lha/ chos kun mi dmigs stong pa nyid du gyur/ /stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi gtsug tu/ /seng khri padma zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de/ /rnam pa thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs//sku mdog rab dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa me tog padma dkar po 'dzin/ /g.yon pa sems nyid ngal gso'i tshul gyis brten/ /mthon mthing dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs la/ /lhag ma gsil bus sku yi stod phyogs mdzes/ /rtse phran snyan cha mgul rgyan gdu bu sogs/ /rin chan rgyan spras dar gyi na bzas klubs/ /kriṣṭha swa ra'i pags pa phrag par bkal/ /'khas gnyis skyil krung phyed 48

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bkapa'i tshul gyis bzhugs/ /de yi gtsug tu brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs/ /rnam pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zlos gar can/ /mthor brtsegs tshul bzhugs rgyab mdun phyogs mtshams kun/ /slu med skyabs gnas tshogs (5ba)kyis yongs bskor ba'i/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las/ /'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' skad cig gis/ /thogs pa med par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ /slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i/ /rigs lngas dbang bskur snang mthas dbu brgyan gyur/ /mchod pa rnams nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyi rme brlabs la/ oṃ mū la mū lā ni shrī maḥdru ru ārla lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas sha lta'i bar/ /rū pa nasasparsha'i bar/ sa sta ratna pū dze ti ā hūṃ/ aṣṭa maṅga la pā dze ti āḥ lha/ maṅga la bha wa pā dze ti āḥ lhaḥ zhes chu gnyis nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad rnams dang / badzra bhū mi sogs kyi maṇḍal/ ji snyed su dag sogs kyi yan lag bdun pa bya/ de nas gsol ba btab pa ni/ ngo mtshar yid 'ong lta na sdug pa'i yul/ /nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams na/ /chos sku 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol//sa la gnas pa'i dag pa'i nyid gi mchog /lho phyogs ri bo gru 'dzin pho brang na/ /longs sku spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gangs can bod yul dbus 'gyur rdo rje gdan/ /lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang bzang na/ /sprul sku srong btsan sgam por gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mkhas grub du ma'i 'dun sa chos grwa che/ /dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang na/ /yang sprul bsod nams rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /srong btsan sgrub pa'i bsti gnas lha mo mkhar/ /byang chub shing gis brgyan pa'i nags khrod na/ /'jam dbyangs snang mdzad (6na sko rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bde ba'i rdo rje mi 'gyur gsang sngags kyi/ /chos 'khor chad med skor ba'i pho brang na/ /mkhas grub shrī snu tang gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog dang —49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shethun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim par mos/ de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la dmigs te rang nyid kyi ci shes pa'i gsol 'debasakyi rim pa bya zhing / gzhan yang / ngag gi dbang phyug blo gros bye ba'i gter/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i don du ngur smrig gi /rnam rol thub bstan rgya mtsho'i shing rta che/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes ci nus gsol ba btab/ de nas/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'dir snang tshe 'dir zhen pa rang log te/ /snying nas dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i blo/ /bcos min snying nas skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i thos bsam sgom pa sogs/ /rnam dkar dam pa'i chos su spyad pa kun/ /slu med 'bras bu'i chos bzhin legs 'byin pa'i/ /yang dag lam du 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zab lam sgom pa'i log rtog zhabrul pa kun/ /rnam par zhi nas gang shar ma lus pa/ /phul byung dag pa ye shes snang ba'i gter/ /mi 'dzad longs su spyod par byin gyis rlomes/ /gzugs snang thams cad rten dang brten pa'i tshul/ /sgra rnams ma lus grags stong sngags kyi gdangs/ /snang ba mtha' dag bde stong ye shes su/ /'bad pa med par 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bsam pa'i don kun ma lus legs 'grub cing / /tshe gcig nyid la zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang / /thob nas 'gro kun 'dren par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes (6bsko sol ba btab pas bla ma'i gnas gsum nas yi ge gsum dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar dmar mthing gsum rim gyis byung / rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bum pa/gsang ba/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang rnams byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag /lam bskyed rim/ gtum mo/ /pho nya'i lam sgom par dbang bar byas/'bras bu/ sprul sku/ longs sku/ chos sku 'grub pa'i nus pa thob par bsams/ de nas/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ skyabs yul thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de nyid la dmigs te bla ma rin po che/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu —5(/

wa wa bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdagasel/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma de nyid 'od du zhu rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas rang sems dang bla ma'i thugs ngo bo dbyer med du mos nas spros bral gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /dbang bzhi pa byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ yon tan 'phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi mdzod la dbang ba'i nus pa bzhag /lam de kho na nyid sgom pa la dbang bar byas/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i nus pa thob par mos/ 'jug tu dge ba bsngo ba sogs spyi ltar bya/ de ltar 'phags mchog sems nyid ngal gso la/ /brten pa'i nye brgyud bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di/ /chos rje bka' bcu ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis/ /bskul tshe za hor rigs kyi sdom brtson mkhan/ /a wa dhū ༷'i btsun pa ldom bu pas/ /byang phyogs mdo pa zhes par thogs med du/(7na〉〉ra ba'i sor mo'i 'phrul gyis sgyur mdzad mkhan/ /don gyi paṇa chen smon 'gro lo tsā 'o/ /bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba the rgogs bzhugs/ /legs byas rin chen bye ba'i gter gyur ye shes dbu ba'i do shal can/ /sku gsum go 'phang rlabs 'phreng stsol la nam yang yol ba med pa yi/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid gcig pu rdo rje slob dpon zhabs pad zung / /gtsug gi rgyan du 'bral med bsten no dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob/ /blo gros yangs pa'i dga' tshal gsar pa la/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon/ /grags snyan lo 'bras dud pa'i rkang la thung dbang / /slu med 'dren pa khyod ni gtan gyi skyabs/rgyal kun yab gcig zur phud lnga pa gang / /bshes gnyen dam par bstan la nges rnyed phyir/ sangs rgyas rnams kyang gang gi skur tshang bas/ khyod nyid mchod pa dngos grub kun gyi gzhi/ /de phyir rdo rje slob dpon tshul bzhin du/ /mchod pa'i cho ga sngon rabs gsung sgros dang / /'gal ba med cing gzhan dag —5/ —

rgya pa dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 1)se rgyas bsdus cam/ /byas la sbyar byang bkod pa ma yin pa'i/ /rjod byed tshig gi snyan 'gyur rab ldan zhing / /don bzang sngon med legs par bshad pa yi/ /zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta chen po 'di/ kho bos lags bshad do rang 'dren no kye/ /thog mar gnas yo byad byin rlabs skyabs 'gro sems bskyed chad med bzhi sgom pa sngon du btang phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams bla med kyi gzhung las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin byin gyis brlab/ dngos gzhi ni/ su bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sra zhing brtan pa'i rdo rje'i gur khang me dang bcas (7ba)pa'i dbus su zlo las rin po che lnga las grub pa'i gzhal ya sa khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/glang po che/ seng ge /rta mchag /rma bya/ mkha' lding gis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du sna tshogs padma zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ ngo bo rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rnam pa chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa 'jum pa'i zhal las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rgyal ba rnams mnyes shing 'gro ba kun gyi re ba yongs su skong ba/ phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas me tog utpa la'i yu ba nas bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi ral gri dang / sher phyin gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ chos gos rnam pa gsum dang / paṇa zhwa gser gyi mdog can gyis mdzes par brgyan pa/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid can gyi spyi bor oṃ/mgrin par gis thugs mar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcasapa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ sangs rgyas/ chos/ dge 'dun/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ mkha' khyab don dam dag pa chos kyi dbyings/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i dbang po'i gzhu ris can/ /brjod bral sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar mkhan ma/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gnas 'dir gshegs/ /gsang gsum shel dkar dri bral me long ma/ /mchog gsum dam pa'i snang brnyan kun 'char bas/ /dngos grub gzigs (8na 〉 sgor —52

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdamatshar ba'i byed po mchog /kun 'dus rdo rje slob dpon 'dir gshegs shig /mi phyed dad pa'i shing rta chen po yis/ /ye shes 'khor lo'i lha tshogs yid bzhin nor/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams rgyal mtshan rtser 'god phyir/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren thogs med da tshur spyon/ /oṃ mū la: mā la su shrī mdu ru ratna su dhī gī rti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ gnyis 'thung sogs kyis bteg pa'i rin chen khri/ /chu skyes 'dab stong bzhad pa'i ge sar rtser/ /rta ljang chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor steng / /zhabs zung 'khor lo'i ri mo rtag bzhugs gsol/ /padma ka ma lwa ye skyo/ yan lag bdun pa las/ thog mar phyag bya ba ni/ grangs med dkyil 'khor bye ba'i gling bzhi la/ khyab bdag rigs kyi gser sbyangs 'khor lo yis/ /dam pa'i chos kyi srid la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan bzang bcu drug cha shas yongs rdzogs pas/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa'i bshes gnyen bzhugs/ /'gro kun thar par 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan du/ /mes pos sprul zhes 'gro la ngom pa 'dra/ /ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i gnas lugs kyi/ /rtse dga' khong nas rgod pa'i mkhyen pa'i spyan/ /dkyus ring gsung rab rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i rdzas/ /thams cad 'jigs pa'i dbang por lhun gyis grub/ /byams ldan mchu sgros utpal dmar po'i 'dab/ /'gro la rjes su chags pa'i 'dzum rlabs kyis/ /phan bde'i 'gron rnams ring nas 'gugs pa la/ /lung rtogs chos kyi sgo 'phar phye ba bzhin/ /srid pa brgal dka'i chu (8ba)mtshor bying ba'i 'gro/ /skad cig rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa chen por/ /phrangs ring bgrod dkar smra ba'i dngul chu'i thigs/ /rig pa'i sor mos bcad tshe 'jig snyam byed/ /dri med sdom gsum lus stobs rab tu rgyas/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i gser sbyangs dra bas mdzes/ /smin grol mtshon cha'i 'khor los bdud sde'i g.yul/ /pham mdzad bshes gnyen sa srung dbang po che/ /'khor 'das chos kyi legs pa'i lam yangs por/ /'bad med bde bar 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan mchog /dngos su brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /rtse gcig dad pa'i yid kyi phyag 'tshal 'o/ /—53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheganyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba la/ /maṇḍal ni/ phun tshogs khod stoms lta na sdug pa'i zhing / /phun tshogs rin chen las grub dbyig 'dzin steng / /phun tshogs shel dkar dbang sngon pad rā ga dang //phun tshogs gser sbyangs las grub ri rab rtser/ /'chi med bdag po'i khang bzang nyams dga' ba/ /srid pa'i 'byor ba ma lus bsdus pa bzhin/ /bang rim bzhi'i steng legs bris grong khyer ni/ /bkod pa rgya mtsho'i dge mtshan tshar du dngar/ /dge bcu'i yon tan tshang ba yul gyi ljongs/ /phyogs mtshams 'gyur med gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ /gser ri bdun sogs grangs med sa 'dzin rnams/ /byed pos ma bskrun spel legs phreng bar bsgrigs/ /rol mtsho bdun dang chu gter chen po yi/ /'dzum rlabs dga' ston bsu ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /rgyal srid sna bdun bum bzang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /dpag bsam shing dang nyi ma zla ba zung / /lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod phun tshogs rnams/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /bshes gnyen gzugs su rnam rol (9na)dngos brgyud kyi/ /dpal ldan bla ma rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /chu bzhi 'bul ba ni/ gnam sngon zhun mar 'khyil 'dra'i da la 'gro'i rgyun/ /mu tig ltar bkra dbu ba'i 'dzum phreng can/ /dri bzang ngad ldan yol med rlabs phreng g.yo/ /rin chen snod du gtams pa'i mchod yon 'di/ rgyal ba kun dang dpal ldan bla ma la/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul nas legs 'bul gyi/ /brtse chen thugs rje chen pos rab bzhes te/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis bka' drin stsal du gsol/ /oṃ mū la stsam la su shri maṅga ru ratna su dhī kirti sa pa ri wā ra a : pra titsā ye swāhā/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su/ /zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil /bsangs gtor rnams rim pa bzhin bcug la/ sngags kyi gnas su/ /pā rdu añtsa mā rna/ mokṣa ṇi zhes rim pa ltar sbyor/ /nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas 'bul ba ni/ /pad dkar ku mud u dum wa ra ltar/ /'ja' tshon ltar bkra chu skyes sna tshogs pa/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /sngar gyi sngags gsham du pursha྾/ dri zhim ngad kyis phyogs bral 'khor lo kun/ /rab 'gengs bdug spos chu 'dzin ltar 'khrigs pa/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus —54

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdapas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /(pe〉/ rmongs pa'i mun tshogs sel ba snang ba'i gter/ /nyi zla nor bu'i 'od ldan sgron me'i tshogs/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ ā lo ker/ sna tshogs sman gyi bcud ldan bdud rtsi'i chab/ /rba rlabs chal chil g.yo ba'i dri chab 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /ga rje rki/ ro brgya'i zas kyi bcud kun ma lus pa/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i bshos bzang dam pa 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /ni le byer/(9ba)sil snyan rdza rnga pi wang gling bu sogs/ /snyan tshig glu dbyangs rol mor bcas pa'i tshogs/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ shag mo/'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ rked phra lus ldem 'dren byed yon por lta/ /rab mdzes gar bsgyur gzugs kyi mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pā dze te āḥlha/grangs med tshig gi nyams ldan rgyud mang sgra/ /snyan 'gyur glur len sgra yi mchod pa'i tshogs/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ shag mo/ sbrul gyi snying po'i dpal la 'gran bzod pa'i/ /mngar ba'i mdangs ldan dri yi mchod pa'i tshogs/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ dhū per/ skabs gsum dbang po'i longs su nyer spyod pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i spun zla ro yi mchad pa'i tshogs/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul 61 brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ ra sar/legs bris rnams kyi gos zungs dar zab sogs/ /pad 'dab ltar 'jam reg bya'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ sparsha྾/ rgyal srid sna bdun ni/ phun tshogs gling bzhi'i dpal la dbang byed pa'i/ /thogs med rtsibs stong gzur gyi 'khor lo 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ cakra rki/ phul byung 'dod pa'i re ba ma lus pa /skong byed nor bu dbang gi rgyal po 'di/ /—55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losheskyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas ba pheb/su gsol/ /ma ṇisko/zag med bde ba'i mchod sbyin ster mkhas pa'i/ /mdzes sdug yid 'ong btsun mo dam pa 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /sdir/byams brtse'i stobs kyis dbyig 'dzin ma lus pa/ /bde bar skyong ba'i nus ldan blon po 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /pu ru kha྾/ kai la sha yis sa 'dzin dbang po la/ /rin chen rgyan gyis spras 'dra'i glang po 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /hasti྾/ rlung gi shugs 'chang stong gsum skad cig la/ /thogs med myul ba'i cang shes rta mchog 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /a shar/rā ma ṇa ltar dpa' mdzangs brtul phod pa'i/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dmag dpon 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ kha thim/ bkra shis rtags brgyad ni/ dge tshogs (10na sor bu'i yu bas rab bteg pa'i/ /nyon mongs tsha gdung sel ba'i gdugs dkar 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /tshwa tra maṅga la〉/ 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser sbyangs las grub pa'i/ /phan bde'i nyal 'gro'i klung la brten pa'i nya/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /mahā maṅga la sko/ /bkra shis ri mo g.yas su rab 'khyil ba'i/ /snyan pa phyogs bcur sgrog pa'i dung dkar 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /she kha maṅga la〉/nyes pa'i 'dam gyi dri bral byad grol gyi/ /'dab ma rnam par rgyas pa'i padma dkar/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /padma maṅga las/ phun tshogs zad pa med pa'i 'dod dgu'i gter/ /rin chen las grub bum pa bzang po 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun /'dus: brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /—56

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ khobadeka lā sha maṅga lar/ mig gi gzigs mor mtshar ba'i ri mo mchog /yongs su smin pa'i dpal gyi be'u 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /shrī batpa maṅga lar/ thar pa mchog gi khang bzang dam pa'i rtser/ /zung 'jug rgyal mtshan rnam par bsgreng ba 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /khyu dza maṅga lar/ rdzogs ldan mgron du 'gugs byed su wa rje'i/ /ma smad 'khor lo rtsibs stong mu khyud can/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /tsakra maṅga la sa / /bkra shis rdzas brgyad ni/ ji lta ji snyed chos kyi gzugs brnyan kun/ /ma 'dres gsal bar 'char ba'i me long 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ ā dar sha maṅga las/ /dug gsum nyon mongs ma lus sel byed pa'i/ /snying po mchog gyur sman mchog ghi lha 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /go ro tsa na maṅga las/ /zla ba zhun ma snod du 'khyil 'dra ba'i/ /rab dkar bcud kyi snying por gyur pa'i zho/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /da dhi maṅga las/ 'chi ba'i dngos po 'joms pa'i rdo rje'i srog /ring por grub pa'i rtsa mchog dur ba 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /du bo maṅga lam/ gsang sngags nye lam grub pa'i 'bras bu che/ /byang chub snying por 'gyur byed bil ba 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /pha la bil ba maṅga la〉/ snyan pa'i grags pa srid (10ba)pa'i rtse mo'i bar/ /sgrog par byed pa'i chos dung g.yas 'khyil 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /a dzi hwa ma bla mo/ srid zhi'i brtan g.yo yon tan ma lus pa/ /dbang du bsdu bar byed pa'i li khri 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /sindhu ra maṅga lar/ yid grubs ster bcas tha' —57—

wa wa rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smosabar rlog byed pa'i/ /mi bzad rdo rje'i mtshon cha yungs gar 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /sa rṣa pa maṅga las/ mkho ba'i yo byad 'bul ba ni/ mtho ris grong khyer sa la 'phos 'dra ba'i/ /dge bcu'i yon tan kun chang yul gru 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /de shar/ rin chen las grub ba gam mtho ldan pa/ /ngo mtshar bkod mdzes khang bzang dam pa 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /kṛ ha'i/ phan gdugs bla bre dar gyi yol ba can/ /gdong lnga'i dbang pos bteg pa'i 'gyur med gdan/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /ā sa na mo/ cod pan phyag zhabs gdu bu snyan cha dang / /mgul rgyan 'og pag la sogs rgyan gyi tshogs/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /sa laṅka ra mo/ /ngur smig gos dang pañtsa li ka sogs/ /sna tshogs na bza'i khyad par ji snyed pa/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /bstam/ rnam rgyal gser mdog bzang drug candan sogs/ /sna tshogs sman gyi khyad par ji snyed pa/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /o ṣa dha mo/ /phun tshogs ljon pa'i shing las grub pa'i ja/ /ga bur dri ngad 'thul ba'i btung ba 'di/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /e dho da dam/ /sgrub pa'i mchod pa ni/ mtha' bral 'khor ba kun gsal 'gram pa la/ /bde sdug glog gi gar mkhan lha bu'i 'od/ /ma rig sngo bsangs mun pa sdug po'i rum/ /ngan song g.yang du gom pa'i 'phyan rig nas/ /rnam dag nges khrung skya rengs kyis drangs pa'i/ /dri med tshul khrims nyin byed dbang po mchog /tshangs spyod dbang phyogs 'jin ma'i byer 'ongs pas/ /phan bde'i 'dab brgya bskrun pa'i cho ga rdzogs/ /gzhan phan don du 84ra (17)na/na ngan song gnas/ /mtho ris skyed chal lta bur dga' bzhin du/ /'jug nus 1 sa — 58

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing /bams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdepa'i bsam pas /legs drangs pa'i/ /rlabs chen rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod tshul can/ /sgra chad bzo gso thun slong rig pa'i gnas/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sdo bzhi la sogs/ /legs pa'i lam ston gzhung lugs rgya mtsho che/ /dri med kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /klog pa thos bsam snyan 'gyur glu len zhing / /spong ba bsam gtan sbrang rtsis rab rgyas pa'i/ /nyam chung rkang drug bdag gi spyod tshul rnams/ /mchog gsum bla ma dgyes pa'i mchod par 'bul/ /bshags pa ni/ sgo gsum lang tsho dar ba 'tsho glang po che/ /thogs med bsags pa'i nyon mongs chus myos pas/ /mtha' yas dge bcu'i pad dkar rab bcoms nas/ /nag po'i las kyi sna zhags ring du skyong / /bag med mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rnon po yis/ /rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims srog rtsa bcad/ /rang bde 'dod pa'i mi gcang 'dam bcog tu/ /gzhan phan byang chub sems kyi yan lag bying / /theg dman lam du goms pa'i nyi 'od kyis/ /nges gsang zab mo'i lus kun gdung bas mnar/ /mdor na gnas ngan len gyi rgyu bsgrubs pa'i/ /nyis pa'i tshogs kun stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags/ /rjes su yi rang ba ni/ rnam 'dren thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i sgyu ma yis/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa'i sī ta legs phral nas/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i thang yangs por/ /'gro kun 'khrid pa'i shing rta legs 'dren cing / /don du 'gyur na gzhan byed rang nyid kyi/ /phun tshogs bde ba'i dpal kun gtong ba la/ /zhum med snying stobs go cha (11ba)btsan po can/ /dpal ldan rgyal ba'i sras kyi mdzad bzang mchog /srid 'byor e raṇḍa ltar ya ma brla'i/ /ngang chul shes nas gtan bde'i nags klung du/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab rnon po yis/ /'khor ba 'khyog po'i yal ga bcad pa sogs/ /khams gsum skye 'phags rnams kyi rnam dkar las/ /rgya cher spel dang grangs med 'gro rnams kyi/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rgya mtsho la/ /kun nas dga' ba'i sems kyis yi rang ngo / /chos kyi 'khar lo bskor bar bskul ba ni/ /'gro ba'i mchog dman /bams dang dbang po'i gzhir/ /sna mang theg pa'i dbyar skyes gzhon nu'i tshegs/ /thabs mkhas dpyid kyi pho nyas legs bskyangs nga sa / /phan bde'i dus ston phun tshogs 'grub byed sogs/ /mdor na rgya ri ba —3(1

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shernams dang de yi sras/ /nyan thos rang rgyal kun gyis 'gro ba la/ /mtha' klas zab dang rgya che dam pa'i chos/ /'khor lo rgyun chad med par skor bar bskul/ /de nas zhar byung bum pa'i dbang byin rlabs phyi tshul du blang ba ni/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo kun gyi bdag nyid mchog /khyab bdag dpal ldan bla ma'i thug ba'i ka nas/ /chu las chu sbur gnyis pa brdol ba bzhin/ /skad cig mdun gyi bar snang la byon pa'i/ /dbang po'i gzhu ris lta bur rnam bkra ba/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yi dpral ba nas/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang oṃ yig dkar po byung / /rang gi dpral ba'i gnas su thim pa yis/ /lus kyi sdig sgrib bag chags ma lus sbyangs/ /sku yi rdo rje grub pa'i nus pa thob/ /phra rags skyed rim sgom la dbang bar byas/ /'bras bu sprul sku 'i sdi/ba pa'i sa bon ba 'ag /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa ni/(12na)ring nas mgon khyod byams brtse'i dmag dpung gis/ /bdud sde'i dpung tshogs phye mar rab btags te/ /mi 'gyur 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i skus/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i srid la dbang sgyur yang / /ma dag 'gro blo'i rin chen rtsig pa'i ngos/ /tha mal sbyang gzhi'i 'bod sgrogs gzugs brnyan stong / /shar yang blo ldan ha nu — yis/ /mi shes rlung sems lus de gang du mchis/ /de phyir slu ba med pa'i skyabs gnas tshogs / /don la gshegs bzhugs bral yang dman blo'i ngor/ /sgyu ma'i sku de mngon sum mthong dka' bas/ /rags pa'i lus 'di g.yo med brtan par 'os/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zlos gar nyin mo'i mgon/ /chos dbyings thun mtshams phang bar ngal 'tsho na/ /lha lam pha mthas gzhal dka'i lus can gyi/ /mgon skyabs dpung mnyen byed po su zhig mchis/ /tshe rabs du mar gnas ngan len gyi rgyu/ /rang gi 'bad pas bsags pa'i 'bras bu zhes/ /yal bar 'dor na 'gro la bu gcig ltar/ /brtse ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa'ang gtam du zad/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i chu gter chen po'i nang / /nyon mongs chu srin rnon po'i mche ba gtsigs/ /las ngan mi 'da' rlung shugs drag pos g.yeng / /mi bzad sdug bsngal klong du byings ba'i 'gro/ /mgon po khyod kyis rjes su mi 'dzin na/ /gzhan phyir thugs bskyed dka' ba brgya phrag gis/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i dka' thub bsten pa yang / /—6(/—

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bderang nyid ngal ba'i 'bras bu tsam du zad/ /bde ba 'dod kyang sdug bsngal rgyu sgrub pa'i/ /blang dor gnas la rmongs pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /kun mkhyen ye shes sa la ma ga 'ag bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs su gsol/(12ba)/dge ba rdzogs byang du bsnge rdzob ni/ 'khor 'das kun gyi dge legs yid bzhin nor/ /'byung gnas rje btsun bla ma gdengs can dbang / /lung rtogs yon tan rgya mtsho chen po'i bdag /thugs rje dus las yol med rlabs phreng can/ /gang gi sku la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams/ /bzhugs nas bla na med pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /zhing mchog dam pa bskrun zhes rgyud sde las/ /lan cig min par gsungs pa don dang ldan/ /chos long mngon sum snang ba'i skal ba dang //ma rig mun pas bsgribs pa'i 'gro ba la/ /rgyal ba rnams kyang tha mal bshes gnyen tshul/ /bstan nas zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo skor/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad las/ khyod kyi ba spu'i khung bu gcig tsam yang / /tshul bzhin mchod pa'i bsod nams las dkar gyi/ /srang la gzhal tshe mngon par lci min nam/ /lung dang rigs pa'i gtan tshigs rta bdun pas/ /rab drangs mchod pa'i cho ga nyin mor byed/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'chi med lam shar tshe/ /phan bde'i 'dab brgya 'dzum las gzhan du ci/ /de ltar phul byung thugs rje chen po'i rgyud/ /tshul bzhin 'bad pas dge ba'i sor mo yis/ /bskul bas mchog mthun dngos grub snyan 'gyur sgra/ /gtan bde'i thos 'dzin dga' ston 'phel bar shog /'dir snang phun tshogs glog gi gar mkhan ma/ /srid 'byor e raṇḍa yi snying po ltar/ /rtogs nas nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims dag /nan tan snying pos tshul bzhin bsrung bar shog /tshe rabs mang por drin gyis legs bskyangs pa'i/ /ma gyur 'gro la rang gi bde ba gtong / /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dngos su len nus pa'i/ /byang chub sems mchog 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /smin (13na)byed dbang gis sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs/ /grol byed lam gyis zung 'jug sgrub pa sogs/ /byas dang byed bzhin byed 'gyur dge ba kun/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /nang gi mchod yul gsal gdab pa ni/ /ngur smrig gar gyis rol pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /skad cig gnas 'gyur —6/ —

rgya la dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yeshemagon jo/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /sku mdog dmar ser bzhin 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams/ /mthon mthing dbu skra zur phud lnga ldan pa/ /phyag g.yas mi shes gcod pa'i ral gri 'phyar/ /g.yon pa'i thugs dar utpal yu ba nas/ /bzung ba'i 'dab steng sher phyin glegs bam 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje skyil krung can/ /rin chen rgyan dang lha rdzas na bzas mdzes/ /chos sku bde ba chen po'i mkha' dbyings su/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon lta bur rnam bkra ba/ /skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ de nyid la tshogs gsog pa'i snyad du yan lag bdun las/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzugs/ /slu med 'dren par shar ba bla ma rje/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zlos gar 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gnyis med gtan gyi skyabs gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /ma 'dris kun la mdza' ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /rgyu med dug gsum kun la sdang ba'i dgra/ /chags med shes rab ma la rjes su brtse/ /'dod bral bde ba mchog la lhag par sred/ /ro nus ma sdems dug gsum nad sel sman/ /rlung gis ma drangs phan bde'i dri bsung can/ /ku mud mi 'joms legs bshad snang ba'i gter/ /byed pos ma bskrun zung 'jug za ma tog /snyigs dus tshe thung gcig gi yun de la/ /sku (13ba)gsum gling du 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan mchog /rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ /kun 'dus 'khor lo'i mgon la phyag 'chal lo/ /mchod pa 'bul ba la maṇḍal ni/ /'byung ba bzhi 'dus lus gyi sa gzhi'i steng / /rnam par shes pa'i sa 'dzin dbang po la/ /phung khams gser ri rol mtsho bdun gyis bskor/ /skye mched bcu gnyis gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ /ro rkyang nam mkha' nor bu mtshan mo'i mgon/ /dbang po lnga yi gter chen bum pa sogs/ /dkyil 'khor gco bo dpal ldan bla mar 'bul/ /zag med bde ba che la spyod par sheg /bdud rtsi'i mchad pa ni/ rin chen ka pā la yi snod yangs por/ sha lnga bdud rtsi snga las grub pa'i rdzas/ /tha mal snang chen yongs dag zag pa med/ /ro mchog bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sgrub pa'i mchod pa ni/ /phyi nang mtshan nyid ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /theg mchog 'jug sgor dbang gis legs smin zhing / /bsnyen sgrub las gsum 'phran las rnam pa bzhi/ /ril bu —612

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdameg sman la sogs grub chen brgyad/ /thun mong las kun sgrub la thogs med cing / bskyed rim phra rags sgyu lus gtum mo sogs/ /zhakhrul med tshul bzhin nyams su bstar ba las/ /bka' ba'i na sgrub pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'bul/bshags pa ni/ dngos grub 'byung gnas rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /thugs dang 'gal sogs rdo rje theg pa yi/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun/ /gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sgo nas mthol lo bshags/ /rjes su yi rang ba ni/ skal bzang snying gi rin chen bum pa'i nang / /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i chos skye bdud rtsi yis/ /legs bltam tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'grub pa sogs/ /(14na sgom dkar dge ba'i tshogs la yi rang ngo / /chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar bskul ba ni/ /dman pa'i theg par gol ba'i ri dwags srog /dbang rnon mtshon gyis gcod pa'i sha wa ri/ /bzang po'i skal ba can gyi gdul bya la/ /theg chen gsang sngags chos 'khor skor du gsol/ /zhar byung gsang dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du blang ba ni/ 'jam dbyangs mgrin pa'i gnas nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /dmar po a yig dang bcas thogs med byung / /rang gi mgrin pa'i gnas su thim pa yis/ /smin byed gsang dbang byin rlabs tshul du thob/ /ngag gi sdig sgrib bag chags ma lus sbyangs/ /gsung gi rdo rje 'grub pa'i nus pa thob/ /gtum mo'i rnal 'byor sgom la dbang bar byas/ /'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i sa bon bzhag /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dmigs med chos sku'i rang bzhin stong pa'i gzugs/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i mgon bor yongs shar ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma skal bzang gdul bya'i don/ mdzad phyir bskal ba rgya mtshor rtag bzhugs gsol/ /dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ dus gsum dag tu rnyed dka'i zab mo'i lam/ /mngon par bsgrubs pa'i dge tshogs lcags kyi khams/ /rnam dag dri ma med pa'i bsngo ba'i rtsis/ /rnam mkhyen btso ma'i gser du 'gyur bar shog /gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba'i rten skyed pa ni/ /mgon po 'jam dbyangs skad cig gnas 'gyur te/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /sku la gshegs pa gshegs ma sems dpa' brgyad/ /khro bo bcu sogs gdan gsum tshang —63

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebar 'gyur/ /yan lag bdun pa las phyag 'tshal ba ni/(14ba〉pe 'gyur bde chen mtshan dpe'i zlos gar la/ /stong nyid mdzes sdug dga' mas legs 'khyud pa'i/ /gnyis med gnyis su snang ba'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan yid bzhin mtsho nang du/ /gsang gsum lha yi zla snang grangs med par/ /don dam ngang du ro gcig kun rdzob tu/ma 'dres snang ba dbang po'i gzhu ris bzhin/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rdo rje mtshon/ /rnon pos bdud bzhi'i srog rtsa bcad pa'i khrag /bde chen lang tshor smin pa'i 'od ris kyi/ /stong gzugs mthing gsal dmar ba'i mdangs kyis mdzes/ /phung po rnam dag bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs/ /lta bas mi ngom mtshan dpe'i lang tsho can/ khams bzhi yul lnga rnam par dag pa'i yum/ /bde chen ye shes 'dren pa'i mdza' na mo/ /skye mched yongs su dag pa'i sems dpa' rnams/ khro chags zhi ba'i nyams kyi rol gar mkhan/ /yan lag khro bor shar ba'i gtam rngams kyis/ /bdud bzhi'i snying la 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa ster/ /gco dang 'khor zhes sems kyi rol pa yis/ /btags pa tsam las spang rtogs yon tan kun/ /mnyam par rdzogs pas mchog dman so so sa /'dzin par byed rnams byis pa'i blo gros bzhin/ /de phyir mgon khyod dkyil 'khor bye ba yi/ /cig car spro dang bsdu ba'i byed po ste/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi 'byung gnas su/ /nges rnyed dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod pa 'bul ba la maṇḍal ni/ /rdo rje'i lus kyi gser ldan lto ba na/ /mnyam sbyor rdo rje padma'i lhun po mchog /brgya drug dga' ba'i ri mtsho gling bzhis bskor/ /dbu ma bcu gnyis (15na skom gyi rgyu lam du/ /ro rkyang rlung gi nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor 'char/ /sgyu ma'i lus su ldang ba'i rin chen bdun/ /zung 'jug bum bzang yongs 'du sa brtol sogs/ /dkyil 'khor mgon po dpal ldan bla mar 'bul/ /phyag rgya'i mchad pa ni/ mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /'khor lo'i mgon po yab yum mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /brjod bral lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mchog /bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sgrub pa'i mchod pa ni/ rtsa khams rlung la gnad du bsnun pa yi/ /sems kyi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor —64

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdal gzhal nas/ /don gnyis 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor la spyod pa'i/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po khyod la 'bul/ /bshags pa ni/ myang 'das a wa dhwa ti'i grong khyer du/ /sems kyi khye'u chung dri bzhon rtar bskyon nas/ /'khrid byed chos dang gzung mar bcas pa la/ /log rtog som nyi bgyis pa mthol lo bshags/ /rjes su yi rang ba ni/ grangs med bskal bar tshogs kyis mi bskrun par/ /skad cig tsam gyi rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar/ byon zin 'byon 'gyur 'byon par byed bzhin pa'i/ /phul byung mdzad pa kun la rjes yi rangs/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar bskul ba ni/ skad cig bzod dka'i sdug bsngal me 'obs su/ /chud pa'i 'gro rnams myur du bsgral ba'i slad/ /bde chen ye shes 'dren pa'i myur lam gyi/ /nges gsang theg pa'i chos 'khor skor du gsol/ /zhar byung shes rab ye shes kyi dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du blang ba ni/ dkyil 'khar 'khor lo'i thigs las bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /mthing kha hūṃ sngon bcas pa thogs med byung / /rang gi snying ga'i gnas su thim pa (15ba)yis/ /sher dbang byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul du thob/ /yid kyi sdig sgrib bag chags ma lus sbyangs/ /thugs kyi rdo rje grub pa'i nus pa thob/ /sgyu lus zung 'jug sgom la dbang bar byas/ /'bras bu chos sku grub pa'i sa bon bzhag /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ nyon mongs bdud bzhi bsad pa'i dmar 'od khrag /'pho med bde ba chen por shar ba'i mdangs/ rnam kun mchog ldan sku dang zung 'jug khrir/ /sgrib bral sku bzhi'i rdo rje rtag bzhugs gsol/ /dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ dman pa'i thabs kyis 'grol med 'khor lo'i mdud/ /rtsa khams thig le'i rnal 'byor sor mo yis/ /bkrol nas zung 'jug grong du sgyu lus gar/ /bsgyur ba'i dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo/ /de kho na nyid kyi mchod yul gsal gdab pa ni/ /bsam pa'i re ba skong ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma mchog /spyi bo'i pad mtshor thogs med rang gshegs nas/ /dbu ma'i lam bsgyur snying dbus ze'u 'brus rgyan/ /'od zhu rang gi sems dang dbyer med pa/ /so sor mchod du med nga/ ro gcig can/ /snang dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i dngos/ /byar med blo 'di brjod bral ngo —65

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9/shebor byung / yan lag bdun pa las/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ brjod bral lha yi lam ltar rnam dag pa'i//chos dbyings don dam zad mi shes pa'i mdzod/ /'khor 'das kun gyi spyi dpal chen po'i gzhi/ /nges pa don gyi bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod pa la maṇḍal ni/ dri bral rang sems dag pa'i sa gzhi la/ /rang bzhin gdod nas stong pa'i sa 'dzin che/ /med kyang rdzun par snang (16na)ba'i gling bzhi sogs/ /rmi lam yul gyi rol pa ji bzhin 'bul/ /mchod pa ni/ dmigs med don dam chos sku'i zhing mchog tu/ /smra bsam brjod med kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /brtan g.yo kun khyab 'khor 'das dbyer med pa/ /spros kun nyer zhi mnyam nyid ngang du 'bul/ /sgrub pa'i mchod pa ni/ btags tsam kun rdzob chos kyi rdzun pa'i gru/ /don dam rgya mtshor zhig pa'i mtha' bral klong / /dbu mar gnas pa'i nor la longs spyod pa'i/ /nges pa don gyi snying po'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bshags pa ni/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu bsad pa'i dpa' bo ltar/ /med bzhin bde dang sdug pa'i gar mkhan la/ /gzung 'dzin sgrog tu chud pa'i las ngan kun/ /bshags bya bshags byed bral ba'i ngang du bshags/ /rjes su yi rang ba ni/ ma dag gnyis su 'dzin pa 'brul ba'i rgya/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i mtshon cha yis/ /bcad de sdug bsngal lnga pa'i 'jigs pa las/ /thar pa'i mdzad pa mchog la rjes yi rang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba ni/ /gzhan gyis brjod du med pa chos kyi sku/ /rang bzhin ma grub snang stong zung 'brel ba'i/ /tshig dang yi ger bstan du med pa'i chos/ /'khor lo gnyug ma'i ngang du skor du gsol/ /zhar byung tshig dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du blang ba ni/ bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems gnyis po/ /dbyer med zung du 'jug pa'i bde ba che/ /mkha' ltar sgrib bral 'ja' tshon ltar bkra ba'i/ /bzhi pa'i dbang bskur byin rlabs tshul du thob/ /de'ang dbang bzhi'i tshig gi ngo sprod pa tsam las med kyang / /bzhi pa de dbang gsum pa'i ye shes kyi zlas drangs (16ba)ba'i sgo nas ngo sprod dgos pas/gong du dbang bzhi pa byin rlabs kyi tshul cam du blangs pas so/ /gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rgyu dang rkyen gyis bcos su ra/ mchis pa'i/ /gdod nas rnam dag chos sku bde ba che/ /lus can kur la dngos su —66

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ khobadarab snang zhing / /nam yang 'pho 'gyur med par gsal gyur cig /dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ rang bzhin 'od gsal ga tshog ma lhan cig skyes/ /rtag chad mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam bsgoms pas/ /kun rdzob 'brul ngor sna tshogs snang ba kun/ /don dam dbyings su ngo bo gcig par bsngo/ /smon lam ni/ de ltar dngos grub legs tshogs kun gyi gzhi/ /rdo rje slob dpon tshul bzhin mchod pa sogs/ /grangs med dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa'i/ /mtha' klas rnam par dkar ba'i phung po las tshe rabs kun tu dal ba'i rten 'thob cing / /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis legs zin nas/ /thun mong lam gyis rgyud kun rab sbyangs nas/ /rdo rje'i theg la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ /'bad pa chen pos snyigs dus tshe gcig la/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid mchog /kha sbyor bdun ldan go 'phang mngon byas nas/ /'gro kun byang chub mchog la 'god gyur cig khres brjod ni/ dran pa tsam gyis srid bzhi'i 'jigs las skyob/ /mthong thos reg pas legs pa'i lam la sbyor/ /gsol ba btab pas 'dod dgu'i re skong ba'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /zhi ba mya ngan 'das pa'i sa bsnyes kyang / gdul bya'i snang ngor khro chags rnam 'gyur gyis/ /bdud dgra'i snying ga brdzi ba'i stang stabs can/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /mthu (17na tshe lhobs rdo rje'i thog gi rjes 'gro zhing / /'phrin las thogs med sgrub 'di dpag bsam dbang / /chos skyong dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dge legs bkra shis char ltar 'bebs par mdzod/ /gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs pa bya'o/ /de ltar rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i rnga/ /med byung blo gros dbyu gus bskul ba'i tshe/ /skal bzang rna ba'i bcud len rgyas byed pa'i/ //legs bshad sgra dbyangs srid rtse'i bar du sgrog /sngon byon mkhas pa'i dgongs don ma 'phyugs shing / /rnam dpyod mthu yis brjod don phul byung gi /bskrun 'dir sbyar byang spel ba rigs mod kyi/ /ngag sgros rnying pa ldab dang ga la mtshungs/ /bdud rtsis legs gtams 'jim pa'i bum pa dag /dor nas ngan skyugs kyis gang gser bum pa/ /dga' bar byed ltar deng dus la(17

rgya pa dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6 sheskye bo rnams/ /legs nyes 'byed pa'i blo gros skal ba phra/ /sngon rabs mkhas pa'i legs bshad nyin mor byed/ /dus kyi 'grib pa'i chu lha'i phang par nyal/ /tshig don dman pa'i du ba mjug ring zhig /thub bstan nam mkha'i mdzes pa 'phrog phyir rgyu/ /de phyir tshad ldan mkhas pa'i gsung rab kyang / /skal ngan dus gyi nub la nye ba'i tshe/ /blo dman bdag 'dras yi ger 'dri ba dag /rang nyid ngal ba'i 'bras bu tsam du zad/ /'on kyang bod dang hor gyi skad gnyis pa/ /smra ba'i dpyod ldan mer gan bka' bcu zhes/ ta shes rab rgya mtshor 'bod des ring mo nas/ /'bad pa chen pos yang yang bskul ba dang / /nye char gnas lnga rig pa'i chu gter dbus/ /legs bshad phud sgra sgrog pa'i (17ba〉sna jig rten mig /blo chen shes bya kun gzigs gang de yis/ /nan tan bskul ba'i bzhed pa skong phyir byas/ /de 'dra rab 'byams dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ /'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub zhabs pad rdul/ /spyi gtsug rgyan du bsten pa'i rgyal khams pa/ /za hor rigs kyi brnyes yi ger bkod/ /dge des mkha' mnyam lus can ma lus pa/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung ste/ /don gnyis lhun grub stobs bcu'i go 'phang mchog /thob nas 'gro kun 'dren pa'i mgon gyur cig /de ltar mchod pa'i cho ga zung la jug sgrub pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni bod sog gi lo tsā ba dpyod ldan mer gan bka' bcu shes rab rgya mtsho dang bod yul gyi gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍita smon 'gro'i lo tsā ba'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga la gzhi byas/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi sbyor tshul sogs dmigs su phye ste/ za hor gyi rigs las a wa dhū ti pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos byang phyogs kyi chu bo lo hi ta'i 'gram du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang tshe ring ngo / /dpal rigs brgya'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /blo dman ngor ngur smrig zlos gar can/ /rje rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags/ /sprang bdag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ khyed sngon nas tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs pas/ /gnas 'og min dag pa'i zhing khams der/ /longs spyod rdzogs skur sangs rgyas kyang / /ma mkha' mnyam gyi 'gro rnams 'dren —68

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdapa'i phyir/ /zhing 'di na sprul pa'i zlos gar bstan/ /de bsam gyin rje btsun bla ma dran/ /dran gyin du snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /(18na〉sprong bdag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /khyed dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus dang / /don dbyer med ngo bo gcig bzhin du/ /gnas rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul mchog der/ /rje mkhas dang grub pa'i gar mkhan gyis/ /dpal thub bstan nyin byed lta bur mdzad/ /de bsam gyin rje btsun bla ma dran/ /dran gyin du snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /sprang bdag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /chos ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i mtha'/ /don mngon sum rtogs pa'i 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /bod kha bas bskor ba'i yul ljongs 'dir/ /thos bsam dang sgom la nan tan gyi/ /dpal myang 'das kyi gling du 'gro kun 'dren/ /de
