bsam gyin rje btsun bla ma dran/ /dran gyin du snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /sprang bdag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /zhing ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho cher/ /mgon seng ge'i nga ro'i skur bstan nas/ /chos theg pa chen po'i dga' ston gyis/ /bod skal bzang gi gdul bya ma lus pa/ /lam zung 'jug bde ba chen por 'god/ /de bsam gyin rje btsun bla ma dran/ /dran gyin du snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /sprang bdag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /gnas 'khor ba sgyu ma'i blo brid mkhan/ /lar ngan song gi sdug bsngal me 'obs dong //tshe mi rtag glog gi rol gar can/ /grogs mdza' bshes tshong 'dus 'gron po'i dpe/ /rten dal 'byor mi lus nyin skar tsam/ /'di bsam bzhin snying nas nges 'byung skyes/ /de skyes bzhin dam pa'i lha chos dran/ /don gegs med du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang zhi bde don gnyer nyan rang gi /lam dman par gol ba'i tshul shes nas/ /ma 'gro drug rnams 'dren pa'i khur khyer te/ /sems byang chub mchog tu rab bskyed nas/ /tshogs rnam gnyis rdzogs pa'i byed po yis/ /skyon kun zad stobs bcu'i go 'phang de/ /dus ring por mi thogs mngon byed pa'i/ /don bsam pa 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus bskal ba grangs med gsum gyi bar/ /tshegs chen pos sgrub la mi ltos pa'i/ /dpal gsang chen rdo rje theg pa zhes/ /rje sangs rgyas tshe 'dir 'grub pa'i lam/(18ba)/ya ma bral skyed —69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yesherje gas zung 'jug go /rigs kun bdag kha sbyor bdun ldan pa/ /rten 'di la mngon du byed nus par/ /rje bla ma khyed kyi byin gyi rlobs/ /sprang 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rje rgyal ba gnyis pa btsong kha bas/ /dus skad cig tsam yang 'bral med du/ /mgon dpung gnyen mdzad par gsol ba 'debs//bla ma la gsol ba 'debs shing thugs rje bskul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di 'ang / nang du yang dag pa'i tshul la gzhol ba'i blo can dbon po nang sos nged rang la sbyar ba zhig dgos zhes bskul na'ang /rang la yon tan med par sgro btags na mkhas pa rnams khrel gyi dogs pa dang / mi chos bla ma'i rdzun gyis sdom pa 'jig pa'i rgyur gsungs pas/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po la sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa 'di ni za hor gyi brnyes 'dam g.yang ra zhes par sbyar/ /dpa' ldan phun tshogs rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /gdan gsum tshang ba'i rdo rje slob dpon du/ /nges rnyed zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /nyams su blangs pa'i rim pa 'di bshad bya/ /de la 'dir mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'khor 'das kun gyi legs tshogs thams cad kyi byed po/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa nyams su blang bar bya ba la/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa spyi 'gro ltar byas/ de nas oṃ shā n+ya tā dzña na badzra su bhā wa ātpa ko lha/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor seng ges bteg pa'i khri sna tshogs padma dang (19na)zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid/ rnam pa thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis thugs mar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas lhag mas nor bu chu shel gyi 'phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'dren pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin zhing / g.yon lhag mas padma dkar po 'dab ma rgyas pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ gdu bu/ se ral kha/ 'og pags sogs rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shang / lha rdzas las grub pa'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mdzes par gsol ba/ ri dwags —7(/

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdespos swa ra'i pags pas nu ma bkab ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo kru/nga gis bzhugs pa/ dwangs gsal rnyog pa med pa'i 'od kyi rang bzhin can 'ja' zer 'khrug pa'i klong na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam/ dpa' bo/ /mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong srung ma sogs skyabs gnas thams cad badzra sa mā dzaḥs/ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥs/ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra a: nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsams/ mchod pa rnams (19bton ma mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a: nas sha sdi'i bar gyi chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang / rū pa nas spar sha'i bar gyi 'dod yon lnga dang / sa pta ratna sa rin chen bdun dang / aṣṭa maṅga las bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / aṣṭa bha was bkra shis rdzas brgyad rnams phul/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /ces sogs dang / skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ de nas gsol ba 'di ltar gdab par bya ste/ dpal ldan dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo dam pa'i mdzod/ /mchog dman 'gro la ston pa bshes gnyen gzugs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin/ /mgon khyod gzod ma nyid nas ye shes mes/ /sgrib gnyis bud shing mtha' dag rab bsregs kyang / /skal dman 'gro rnams 'dren phyir ma dag pa'i/ /sbyang gzhi'i sha tshugs 'dzin pa ma yin nam/ /'jig med 'ja' lus rdo rje grub pa'i sku/ /gzhom med nā da'i sgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i gsung / /g.yo med bde stong zung du la jug pa'i thugs/ kha sbyor bdun ldan sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can/ khyod las lhag pa'i skyabs gnas mthar thug ge // /srid dang zhi ba'i khams kyi /bor yug kun/ /nyi zla bye ba'i sgron me bteg —7/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebyas nas/ /mig stong ldan pas btsal yang ga la rnyed/ /de phyir khyod la snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /blo brid sred la zhen pa'i sgrog tu tshud/ /mi zad ngan song g.yang du gom pa 'phyan/ /gtan gyi bde las rgyab phyogs bdag la dgongs/ /phul byung thugs rje'i mthu dpung gser 'gyur rtsis/ /'khor ba'i bde la chags pa'i lcags kyi khams/ /blo phugs chos su (20na〉sna gro ba'i gser sbyangs gtsor/ /bsgyur te don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar nyams su blang ba'i dam pa'i chos/ /mdo rgyud don dang mthun pa'i nyams rtogs kyi/ /yon tan gong 'phel snyigs dus tshe gcig la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim can dang cig car gang du byung / lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag /'bras bu sku bzhi thob pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag par mos/ slar yang gsol ba btab pas bla ma de nyid spyi bo nas byon snying gar bzhugs par mos la/ de nyid la gsol ba ci shes su btab/ mthar rang sems dang bla ma dbyer med du bsres te mnyam par bzhag /dge ba spyi ltar bsto'o/ /de ltar dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog /zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len 'di/ /mtha' 'khob yul du skyes kyang dam chos la/ /yang dag bag chags sad pa'i blo ldan zhing / /sa gzhi'i dbang phyug bog do rgyal po yi/ /mnyes gshin byams pa'i sman gyis skyong ba'i mi/ /dge slong ngag dbang blo bzang zhes pa yis/ /bskul ngor g.yer ba'i gzeb tu rab chud kyang / /bcad lhug tshig sbyor spro la thogs med pa/ /za hor rigs kyi bande ldum bu bas/ /sbyar ba'i sdeb legs yi ge'i phreng spel ba/ /rig gnas bye ba'i bang mdzod can gyis so/ /mkha' khyab don dam chos sku bde chen dang / /sna tshogs gzugs sku'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /ston mdzad rgyal dang de sras nyan rang sogs/ /slu med skyabs gnas ma lus bdag la dgongs/ /(20ba)pha mtha' mi mngon 'khor ba'i chu gter nang / /grangs med bsags pa'i las rlung shugs kyis ded/ /nyon mongs chu srin gdug pas rnam par gtses/ /sdug bsngal rba klong drag po'i nang chud pa'i/ /ma dag —72

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdamun pas byings pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /bde ba 'dod kyang de yi rgyu spangs nas/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa'i 'byung gnas kun 'byung la/ /spyod pa'i tshul 'di thugs rje chen pos dgongs/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga yi las/ /so thar byang sems sngags kyi lhung ba sogs/ /sgo gsum bag med bgyis pa'i sdig pa kun/ snying nas 'gyod pa drag pos bshags byed na/ /skyob pa rnams kyi thugs rje'i chu rgyun gyis/ /las nyon bag chags ngan pa'i dri ma kun/ /drungs nas phyung ste mngon mtho nges legs kyi/tsho/mthun rkyen 'bad pa med par grub par shog /ces sdig pa bshags pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di 'ang / lha khang ser po'i bla ma sbyin pa rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes bris/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i re skong zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo e ṇḍi ya na ratna ya/ 'dod pa'i re skong dbang gi rgyal/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa skyon gyi/ /rnal 'byor rgyun du khyer bde ba/ /nyung gsal don 'dus yi ger 'god/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus skyon padma la/ /snying nas gus pa'i yid kyis skyabs gnas re/ /mkha' mnyam ma gyur 'gro ba'i don gyi ched/ zab lam rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bya/ /rang gi spyi bo'i thad gyi nam mkha' la/ /padma'i sdong po thabs shes nyi zla'i steng / /ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid/ /rnam pa rigs 'dzin chen po padma 'byung / /sku mdog dkar dmar mtshan dpe'i lang tsho can/ /phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab mtshon pa'i brdar/(21na)/g.yas pas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga dang / bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa g.yon na 'dzin/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i gsang gos mthing kha dang / /sdom brtson chos gos gser gyi pa ṭa ris/ /rgyal po'i cha byad zab ber lhab lhub can//dbu la padma'i mnyen zhu mdzes par gsol/ /zhabs gnyis skyil krung gnas gsum yi gis mtshan/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams khor yug ma lus pa/ /'ja' 'od zer gsum drwa ba'i klong dkyil du/ /kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang dbang dang / /bde gshegs rigs lnga 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon/ /rgyal po dza dang rgyal sras 'byor pa'i dbang / /shrī sidha dri med bshes gnyen zhabs/ /rgya gar rigs 'dzin chen po rnam nga brgyad/ /bod kyi rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / /zab chos spyan 'dren sprul sku gter ston —73

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shetshogs/ /sgrub sde brgyad sogs yi dam lha tshogs dang / /pho rgyud mo rgyud dam can chos srung lha/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo las byed pho be thing / /kun bzang mchod sprin spro ba'i lha mo sogs/ /ma lus ye shes rab snang rig pa'i rtsal/ /brjod bral snang srid ba nge chen klong du gyur/ /hūṃ/ rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang nas/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams/ /thog med 'dir gshegs gnyis su med par bzhugs/ /gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'chal gsol ba 'debs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ /thogs med nas bsags sdig ltung ma lus bshags/ /gsang gsum mdzad pa kun la rjes yi rang / /theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar bskul/ /bskal par gzugs sku'i bkod pa brtan par gsol/ /ji snyed bsags pa'i dge tshogs ma lus pa/ /rang rig kun bzang go (21ba)'phang thob phyir bsngo/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /de nas thun drug gi rnal 'byor le'u bdun pa 'am/ /bsdus pa la dga' na gsol 'debs skabs sbyar bya/ /badzra gu ru'i 'dzab ci nus su bzla/ dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer ni/ /dkar dmar mthing byung rang gi gnas gsum zhugs/ /zag rwa med pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang / /bum gsang shes rab ye shes dbang bskur thob/ /bla ma'i gsung gi tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs las/ /'khrul ba'i snang ba 'di kun phyir bkag nas/ /ma bcos rig pa'i gshis kyi ngo bor ltos/ /zhes gsung don la mnyam gzhag tshig dbang thob/ /skyabs gnas thams cad ma hā gu rur thim/ /de nyid mtshon byed rnam pa rdo rje'i dbyibs/ /dbang gi rtags rgyas rab mdzes cod pan can/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du 'bral re/da bsten/ /zhes rang sems bla ma dang dbyer med pa snang stong zung du 'jug pa'i 'dzin med kyi ngang du rme nyam par bzhag la/ thun mchams su brgyud pa'i rim pa la bka' drin rjes dran gyi gsol ba btab pa na/ /chos snying thig ston pa padma 'byung / /de dag snang chul mjal rgod ldem zhabs/ /rtags ngo mchar bstan pa'i rnam rgyal mgon/ khyed thugs rjes bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor 'dus pa dang po rnge rje dge ra// /gter zab yig sgyur mjad rdo rje mgon/ /yongs gdams pa'i bka' babs —74

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdabashes gnyen 'khas/ /rtags ngo mtshar bstan pa'i rnam rgyal mgon/ /khyed thugs rjes bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /lam snang bzhi mthar phyin ngag dbang grags/ /rtags grub mtshan brnyes pa sangs rgyas dpal/ /rje bla mas lung bstan mes ston 'khas/ /rtags ngo mtshar bstan pa'i rnam rgyal mgon/ /khyed thugs rjes bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje dang / /rje khri srong bkra shis stobs kyi rgyal/(22na〉bgon dam pas rjes bzung ngag gi dbang / /rtags ngo mtshar bstan pa'i rnam rgyal mgon/ /khyed thugs rjes bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /zur 'khor lo'i mgon po padma dbang / /chos gdams pa'i bang mdzod drag po stsal/ /mgon drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /rtags ngo mtshar bstan pa'i rnam rgyal mgon/ khyed thugs rjes bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di phyi'i phun tshogs 'khor ba la/ /yongs snying nas chen log 'chi ba dran/ /sems bcos min dad pa'i gdung shugs kyis/ /skyabs bla ma bsten par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang gces pa'i 'khri ba rbad kyis bcad/ /ma mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir/ /lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /don 'khrul med nyams su longs par shog /ces snyan pa'i gdangs sam 'dur ma sogs skabs su gang bab kyis byin dbab/mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas btab pa ci rigs par bya'o/ /slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di ni/ skyar po ba mgon po rab brtan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/rigs 'dzin chen po rgod ldem gyi dag snang brda don lam zab kyi dgongs pa dang mthun cing cung zad spros te za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shesnying po don gsum gyi 'khrid kyi dmigs rim ri bo gru 'dzin du ba11da pa'i them skas zhes bya ba se rdzogs bzhugs/'gyur med chos sku lha yi lam yangs por/ /ngo mtshar gzugs sku'i sgyu 'phrul dbang po'i gzhu/ /gsang gsum bdud rtsis srid zhi'i gdung ba kun/ /sel mdzad dngos brgyud bla mar gus btud nas/ /sgrub mchog dza ha nu yi zhal sgo las/ /legs 'ongs man ngag ga bla'i chu klung nas/ /rnam dpyod skyogs kyis bcus pa'i nyung ngu'i gtam/ /don gnyer blo yi yol gor 'di na 'khyil/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor glog ltar myur du 'jig /ngan song gnas kun bzod dka' me 'obs dong / /lha mi'i rten yang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal du/ shes te (22ba)snying nas skyabs 'gro nan tan bya/ /sdug bsngal des mnar 'gro rnams drin can du/ /nges nas bdag g.yin brje ba'i sems bskyed de/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson bsam gtan dang / khres rab phyin drug lam la bslab pa gces/ /spyi bor shel gyi mchod rten bum pa'i nang / /bla ma kun 'dus spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /yan lag bdun dang gsol 'debs smon lam gyis/ /bsod nams tshogs chen gsog la nan tur byed/ /spyi bor shel dkar mchod rten bum pa dang / /snying ga pad 'dab dbus su spyan ras gzigs/ /bang rim sgo stong bskal bzang sangs rgyas kun/ /rigs lnga'i rnam pa 'dab bzhir āḥyis mtshan/ /'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis kun 'grub pa'i/ /dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang bcas yig drug bgrang / /tha mal snang chen ma lus yongs bkag nas/ /lha yi gsang gsum khyer so gsum ldan bya/ /rtog pas btags pa tsam las rang ngos nas/ /cung zad grub pa med pa'i chos rnams kun/ /gdod nas stong pa nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /snang tshe sgyu ma'i rol par shes pa gnad/ /lus dang gnyen bshes longs spyod thams cad la/ /chags chen 'khri ba yongs su bcad byas te/ /rang sems a yig 'od kyi bu gu'i nang / /brgyud nas byams mgon thugs —76

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdagar thogs med 'pho/ /sngon dus bsgoms pa'i mthu yis bar do dang / /'khrul med rang ngo shes nas snod bcud kun/ /gzhal yas khang dang lha yi rnam par gyur/ /de dag kun kyang skye med stong par blta/ /snang ba thams cad stong par rgyas 'debs shing / /med bzhin snang ba'i 'gro la snying rje yis/ /bdag gzhan don du nying mtshams sbyar byas nas/ /dal 'byor (23na lhan thob lhag pa'i lam la slob/ /de ltar lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad rnams kun/ /tshig nyung don rgyas mi tra dzo ki yi/ /man ngag ji bzhin nyams su blangs pa'i mthus/ /gru 'dzin ri bo'i spo der skye bar shog /ces snying po don gsum gyi khrid kyi dmigs rim brjed byang du bkod pa ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dge slong grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ za hor gyi brnyes bsam grub rtser sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i/ /dngos grub rin chen kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog /zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len par/ /skyabs 'gro sems skyed tshig dang don mthun pa/ /sngon du btang nas dngos gzhi 'di ltar ro/ /'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i chos kun stong pa'i ngang / /rang gi spyi bor seng ges legs bteg pa'i/ /nor bu'i khri steng dus gsum rgyal ba kun/ /gcig bsdus drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ /mthong bas don dang ldan pa mtshan dpe'i sku/ /thos pas rna ba'i bcud len tshangs pa'i gsung / /dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel kun mkhyen thugs/ /mi zad gsang gsum rgyan gi 'khor lo mdzod/ /rnam pa bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje thugs gar 'dzin/ g.yon pa dngul gyi dril bu dku la brtan/ /paṇa zhwa gser gyi mdog ldan cod paṇa can/ /chos gos rnam gsum ngur smrig rtags kyis mdzes/ /zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas/ /dpral mgrin thugs dar 'bru gsum yi ges mtshan/ /hūṃ las 'od 'phros rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam chos srung sogs/ /skyabs (23ba)gnas ma lus badzra sa mā dzas/ /spyan drangs dam tshig ye shes gnyis med gyur/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen ngo/sa phyag 'tshal zhing / /med byung kun tu bzang —77

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shepo'i mchod sprin 'bul/ /sdig ltung nyes pa'i tshogs kun snying nas bshags/ /skye 'phags kun gyi dge ci pa rjes yi rang / /rgyal sras nyan rang chos 'khor skor bar bskul/ /'gro ba'i don du rdo rje ltar brtan gsol/ /byas dang byed bzhin byed par 'gyur ba yi/ /dge ba ma lus sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo/ /ring mo nyid nas spangs rtogs yon tan kun/ /yongs su rdzogs kyang ma dag 'gro ba rnams/ /'dren phyir bshes gnyen dam pa'i rnam rol can/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /bcos min chos su 'gro ba'i blo ldan zhing / /nyams su gang blangs 'brul med lam du longs/ /gtan mdun sgrub la gegs med mthun rkyen 'dzom/ /myur du rnam mkhyen 'thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pas gnas gsum las/ /dkar dmar mthing ku'i bdud rtsi 'od zer bcas rang gi spyi mgrin snying gar thim pa yis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus thob/ /bla ma rang gi gcug byon 'od du zhu/ /thugs sems dbyer med 'dres pa'i ngang nyid du/ /mnyam par bzhag cing 'jug tu bsngo ba dang / /smon lam gsol 'debs skabs dang sbyar ba bya/ /zhes rang gang mos kyi bla ma la sbyar chog pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byar khyer bde ba 'di ni/ shag skor slob dpon mdo sde rgya mtsho dang kong po rin chen rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro srung mar bcas/ /skyabs gnas kun la snying nas skyabs su (24na)mchi/ /rgyud lnga'i 'gro rnams srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /bsgral phyir byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /rang nyid tha mal gnas pa'i spyi gtsug tu/ /ma chags padma thabs shes nyi zla'i steng / /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rigs 'dzin padma 'byung / /sku mdog dkar dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /phyag g.yas thugs gar gser gyi rdo rje dang / /g.yon pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin/ /kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum g.yon pa'i gru mor brten/ /paṇa zhu rgod sgro dar sna me long brgyan/ /gsang gos mthing nag snam sbyar pa ṭa ris/ /za 'og ber chen g.yang klubs tshul du gsol/ /zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje'i skyil krung pa rbos/ /mchan dpe'i skur ldan changs dbyangs ldan pa'i gsung / /kun mkhyen thugs mnga' mkhyen —78

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ khobadabartse nus par ldan/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro srung ma yis/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams sprin phung lta bur khyab/ /'ja' tshon gur khyim 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus yid bzhin nor bu la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul/ /sdig lhung nyes pa'i tshogs kun snying nas bshags/ /skye 'phags dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /mgon khyod rtag tu chos 'khor skor bar bskul/ /gzugs sku bskal brgyar mi g.yo brtan par gsol/ /dge ba mtha' dag sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo/ /ye shes gdod nas lhun grub pa/ /skyabs yul gsal btab tshogs gsog dang / sdig sbyong ched du yan lag bdun/ /gong gsal nan tan byas pa'i rjes/ /rab tu le'u bdun pa 'am/ /ma 'grub bla ma sku gsum ma'i/ /mjug tu badzra gu ru yi/ /'dzab dmigs ngag 'don 'di ltar ro/ /bla ma'i dpral (24ba tha'i oṃ yig dkar po las/ /oṃ yig mang 'phros rang gi smin mtshams thim/ /lus gyi sgrib sbyangs bum pa'i dbang bskur thob/ /'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag /bla ma'i mgrin pa'i ā yig dmar po las/ /āḥyig mang 'phros rang gi mgrin par thim/ /ngag gi sgrib sbyangs gsang ba'i dbang bskur thob/ /'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag /bla ma'i thugs ga'i hūṃ yig mthing kha las/ /hūṃ yig mang 'phros rang gi snying gar thim/ /yid kyi sgrib sbyangs gsum pa'i dbang bskur thob/ /'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag /slar yang bla ma'i gnas gsum yig 'bru las/ /'od 'phros rang gi gnas gsum thim pa yis/ /sgrib pa kun sbyangs bzhi pa'i dbang bskur thob/ /'bras bu ye shes lhun rdzogs nus pa bzhag /steng 'og phyogs mtshams bzhugs pa'i skyabs gnas kun/ rigs 'dzin bla ma nyid kyi sku la thim/ /de yang gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga par/ /gyur pa spyi gtsug bzhugs pa nan tan bsgom/ /des kyang rnam rtog 'phro 'du'i tshogs/ /nyung bar mi 'gyur cher 'phel na/ /gser gyi rdo rje hūṃ yig mthing khar gyur/ /je phrar song ste rgya sran tshad tsam pa/ /spyi bo'i gtsug nas thal byung snying ga'i dbus/ /rang gi sems dang bsres nas mnyam par 'khor/ /des kyang 'phro 'du je nyung ma song na/ /gong gi mjug tu dmigs pa —79

rgya ci pa dbang snga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'adi ltar bya/ /rang gi sems dang dbyer med yi ge de/ /me long ha btab mtha' nas bsdu ba bzhin/ /'ja' ltar yal te brjod bral stong pa'i dbyings/ /byar med blo 'das ngang du mnyam par 'jog /'di ltar nyams su blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /tshe rabs kun tu rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyis/ /rjes su bzung nas bdag sems 'gro ba kun/ /bla med (25na)kun mkhyen ye shes thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang bla ma'i rnam 'byor dang 'brel bar sdig bshags dang / sems don med du g.yeng ba la phan pa'i nyam sa len nyung ngu zhig dgos zhes rnam rgyal tshe ring gis bskul ba la brten za hor gyi bsdos sbyar/ /rab dkar dad pa'i zla zer gyis phye ba'i/ /zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor ku mu da/ /'di phyi'i dngos grub 'dab brgya 'dzum pa'i 'phreng / /gzur gnas blo yi thod du rnam par spel/ e nyi yā na'i slob dpon che/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa pad 'byung dang / /rang nyid mos pa'i bla ma dag /gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku'i/ /tshigs bcad gcig gis skyabs 'gro dang / /sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don mas/ /rang rgyud dag rjes 'di ltar ro/ /'khor 'das chos kun gdod nas stong pa'i ngang / /mkha' las 'ja' ltar rang sems snang ba'i rtsal/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /kun 'dus sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung / /sku mdog rab dkar lo brgyad lang tsho can/ /lta bas mi ngoms mtshan dper ldan pa'i sku/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa'i ngo mtshar can/ /sngags pa'i cha lugs mthing nag gsang ba'i gos/ /rab byung rtags kyi chas gos pa ṭa ris/ /rgyal po'i na bza' za 'og ber chen dang / /mnyen shu rgod sgro me long dar dpyangs can/ /phyag g.yas thabs mchog bde chen mtshon pa'i brdar/ /gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga thugs ka dang / /g.yon pa shes rab stong nyid ka pā la'i/ /rnam par shar ba bdud rtsis rab gang mdzes/ /zag med bde chen ye shes skyed mdzad ma/ /rnam pa kha ṭaṃ tshul gyis dku la brten/ /ma (25ba)chags padma thabs shes nyi zla'i steng / /zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /gdod nas rang sems bla ma'i ngo bo nyid/ /bzhin lag rnam par shar ba'i mos pa dang / /dag pa'i —80

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdazhing na bzhugs pa'i bla ma la/ /gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'di ltar 'debs/ /sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la/ /zhes sogs tshig bdun gsol 'debs ni/ /bdun nas nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs/ /gdung shugs drag por bton rjes su/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pas skyon rje/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam srung mar bcas/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo'i gnas mchog nas/ /thogs med byon te spyi bo'i bla mar thim/ /kun 'dus yid bzhin nor bu'i bdag nyid la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin tshogs 'bul/ /sdig lhung mi dge'i tshogs rnams snying nas bshags/ /dge tshogs kun la snying nas rjes yi rang / /theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar bskul/ /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs/ /kun kyang rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma'am/ /mdor bsdus bla ma sku gsum ma/ /dad pa'i gdung shugs drag po yis/ /lan grangs mang du brjod pa'i rjes/ /bla ma'i gnas gsum yi ge 'bru gsum gyis/ /mchan pa dag las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing / /bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang bcas pa thogs med byung / /rang gi spyi bo mgrin pa snying gar zhugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnam pa gsum/ /'grub pa'i sa bon ma lus legs par ba 'a ga /bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi/ /dbang thob rang rgyud yongs su smin par byas/ /bla ma'i zhal nas 'khrul snang na bun bzhin/ /'dzin med skyong la ma bcos rig ngor ltos/(26na)/zhes pa'i tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs bsgrags pa yis/ /bzhi pa'i dbang thob rig pa'i rang ngo 'phrod/ /bla ma'i sku yang 'od kyi phung por zhu/ /de nyid mtshon byed rtags kyi rdo rje ni/ /rtse lnga spyi bor dbang rtags cod can can/ /byung ba ma thob bar du 'bras med gyur/ /de nas thun mtshams gsol 'debs ni/ /'dod na brda don lam zab gyi/ /brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs tshigs bcad ma/ /rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar te len/ /mdor bsdus tshig nyung 'dod pa la/ /bzang po spyod pa la sogs las/ /byung ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad mas/ /byang chub rgyu ru bsngos shig gu /'dzam bu gling na che ba'i rig sngags kyi/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang phyug skyon rje/ /rang rang mos pa'i bla ma dang sbyar —8/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shete/ /dbyer med gsol 'debs gaṅgā 'a chu rgyun 'di/ /rig pa'i 'byung gnas e yi yul gru nas/ /dad brtson blo gros ldan pa'i smin drug gis/ /'bad pas bskul ltar za hor bande yi/ /rnam dpyod ma dros mtsho chen las 'ongs so /na su sta siddhi/ dngos grub yid bzhin nor bu ma lus pa/ /'di phyi'i gtan gyi mdzod du 'dren byed pa'i/ /kun 'dus zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor gzigs/ /nyams len rlung gis dar chen 'di na g.yo/ /'dir 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub legs tshogs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par byed pas/ 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i 'jigs skrag dang / mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad mar shes pa'i snying rje chen pos rgyud 'khul nges shes pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar byas te/ /su bha (26ba)bas 'kher 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar sna tshogs padma dang / thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i brdar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che sum ldan dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i cha byad can/ sku la chos gos gsum dang paṇa zhu gser gyi mdog can gsol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs gar padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rje bcun bla ma blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnam pa rab tu byung ba'i sku'i cha lugs can/ dbu la bka' gdams zhwa chung gur kum gyi mdangs ldan gsol ba/ phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mjad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kur padma'i steng du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i tshul gyis 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa —82

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdaphyag gnyis thugs gar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i phyag sor kyi me tog padma'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan gyis thad kur kha bye ba'i g.yas na shes rab kyi ral gri dang / g.yon na sher phyin gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/ rab tu byung ba la nye bar mkho ba'i rung mthun gyi na bza' dang paṇa zhu mdzes pa mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyi bdag nyid can rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dngos brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla (27na)ma dam pa/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma sogs skyabs gnas thams cad skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du thogs pa med par byon nas dam tshig pa la thim par bsams te/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar ba'i rjes su gang shes kyi gsol 'debs kyi rim pa dang dbang bzhi len pa sogs spyi ltar byas rjes/ smon lam gdab pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bshes gnyen dam pa'i gzugs/ /ston mdzad chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa/ /khyod kyi byin rlabs snying la la jug par shog /blo bzang chos kyi rgyal srid chen po la/ /dbang sgyur bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ /gang gi zhabs sen nyin byed 'od 'bar bas/ /rtag tu snying gi padma skyong bar shog /ngag gi dbang phyug dgyes pa'i blo gros kyi/ /skal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho'i gnyen gyur pas/ rnam 'dren ma thob de srid dge ba'i bshes/ /mdzad nas legs pa'i lam kun ston par shog /mtha' dang tshad du med pa'i 'khor ba 'dir/ /yang srid nying mtshams sbyor kun dal 'byor gyi/ /lus rten brgyud mar blangs te dam pa'i chos/ /thos bsam sgom pas nyin mtshan 'da' bar shog /chos kun gdod nas stong pa'i shes rab kyi/ /mtshon chas srid pa'i sgrog kun nyer bcad cing / /snying rje'i gzings gyis zhi ba'i mtsho bsgral nas/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i gling bgrod shog /mkhyen brtse nus ldan sangs rgyas de'i gsung chos/ /slob mar bcas pa'i skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa/ /bshes gnyen (27bskom pas rjes su legs bzurnga sde/ /'di dang gtan gyi mdun ma lhun grub —83

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losheshog /ces smon lam btab/ slar yang / dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /zhes sogs brjod de spyi bor bsgoms pa'i bla ma rang gi snying gar gdan drangs/ gsol ba ci rigs pa btab pas slar 'od du zhu/ rang sems dang bla ma dang dbyer med du bsres pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /zhes sogs smon lam ci rigs pas mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor sems dpa' sum brtsegs sgom tshul smon lam dang bcas pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las chos dbang grags pa'i sdes nan tan du bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /na mo ratna tra yā ya/ gang la brten na phan bde'i legs tshogs rnams/ /'bad med stsol mdzad khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor ngag 'don du/ /spel byed yid bzhin 'dod 'jo'i 'phreng ba 'di/ /skyabs 'gro ni/ don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /'gog lam yon tan kun tshang dam pa'i chos/ /rig dang grol ba'i dpal ldan dge 'dun la/ /sangs rgyas ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi/ /sems bskyed ni/ mtha' dang tshad du gzung bar nus min pa'i/ /mar gyur 'gro ba thams cad drangs pa'i ched/ /gzhan phan khur chen khyer ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ /kun rdzob byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ shā khyu tā dzñā na badzra su bhā wa ātpa ko3lha/ 'khor 'das lam gyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i stong pa'i ngang / /mdun gyi nam mkhar seng shes bteg pa'i khri/ /padma (28na to| zla brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du/ /skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /sku mdog rtsa ba'i zhal ni mthing nag la/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar khro chags zhi ba'i nyams/ /rtsa phyag rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa yis/ /rang snang shes rab ma dang snyoms par 'jug /g.yas kyi phyag gnyis 'khor lo padma 'dzin/ /g.yon pas rin po che dang ral gri bsnams/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs ldan/ /rang 'dra'i lha mo re ga bya rdo rje ma/ /ral pa phyed bcings sgeg 'dzum mdzes sdug can/ /lang tsho dar —84

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdabab 'dod yon lnga la spyod/ /gnyis ka rin chen rgyan gyis legs spras shing / /lha rdzas dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub g.yo/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /thugs skar mi bskyod spyi gtsug rnam snang mdzad/ /mgrin par snang mtha' lte bar rin chen 'byung / /gsang gnas don grub lte bar spyan ma dang / /snying gar mā ma ki dang mgrin pa'i dbus/ /gos dkar ma ste sgrol ma spyi bo'i gtsug /mig tu sa snying rna bar phyag rdor te/ /sna la nam snying 'jig rten dbang phyug lcer/ /snying gar 'jam dpal sgrib sel gsang ba'i gnas/ /tshigs la kun bzang byams pa spyi bo'i gtsug /mig sna rna ba lce dang rdo rje'i sgor/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi lha mos mdzes/ /lag pa kha gsang dpung pa pus mo dang / /spyi gtsug rkang mthil rnams la khro bo bcu/ /sku yi cha shas gshegs pa gshegs ma dang / /sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo sogs/ /rigs kun 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /gnas gsum oṃ u3 gis mtshan par gyur/ /thugs rka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /bla ma (28ba〉sku dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma sogs/ /skyabs gnas ma lus spyan drangs gnyis med gyur/ /yan lag bdun pa na/ chos sku mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings nyid las/ /gzugs sku dbang po'i gzhu ltar rnam bkra ba/ /mthong bas yid 'phrog mtshan dpe'i zlos gar can/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon por phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngur smrig gos kyis klubs pa'i zlos gar sogs/ /rang rang 'dul bya'i blo dang legs 'tshams pa'i/ /grangs med sku yi bkod pa sna tshogs su/ /ston mdzad bshes gnyen dam par phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bde mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /brje nus lhag bsam snying stobs sa blog rlabs kyis/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i pha mthar bgrod nus pa'i/ /rmad byung thugs rje'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i lha yi sku/ /bde stong nyams kyis rol pa'i 'jo sgeg can/ /kun mkhyen rgya mtshor 'khrid pa'i ded dpon che/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal lo/ /las nyon sgrib pa'i dbang gi sangs rgyas rnams/ /dngos su mthong bar nus min snyigs dus kyi/ /bdag sogs —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegadul bya'i dpal gyur dge ba'i bshes/ /bka' drin mtshungs pa med la phyag 'cha' 'o / /ri rab lhun po gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ /rin chen ri bo dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /mngar ba'i ro ldan 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud/ /'dod 'jo'i ba mo ma rmos lo tog ldem/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i 'khor lo rin po che/ /'dod dgu'i char 'bebs yid bzhin nor bu mchog /zag med bde ba ster ba'i btsun mo dang / /dpa' mdzangs brtul phod blon po rin po che/ /glang chen nyi zla'i bgrod pa'i stobs dang (29na tshe ldan/ /cang shes rta mchog rlung gi shugs ltar 'phyo/ /pha rol dgra dpung 'joms pa'i dmag dpon te/ /rgyal srid bdun dang gter chen bum pa bzang / /sgeg pa'i lus kyi 'gying bag mtha' klas pa/ /khong nas rgyas pa bsnyems pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /lha dang mi las khyad par byas pa yis/ /sna tshogs spel legs rin chen phreng ba 'dzin/ /mgrin pa'i lam nas 'ongs pa'i glu len dang / /lhan cig rgyud mang la sogs sgra dbyangs 'khrol/ /mnyen lhag lus kyi zlos gar ji snyed pa/ /'dren byed yul du gzigs mor tshar du dngar/ /u dum wa ra pad dkar utpa la/ /sna tshogs me tog chun po snyim pas 'dzin/ /gur kum candan a ka ru la sogs/ /dri ldan bdug spos 'dzin pa'i yid 'ong ma/ /me shel mdangs dang rtsi bcud las spar ba'i/ /snang gsal 'od kyis mun 'joms mar me ma/ /phun tshogs ngad ldan sman gyi byug pa yis/ /dri bral sku la sri zhung bgyid mkhas ma/ /rta bdun dbang po ri bong 'dzin pa yi/ /gzi brjid chen po'i snang bas 'jig rten mjes/ /srid zhi'i khongs las brgal par 'khor ba'i gdugs/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mchan sogs/ /mdor na lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs rnams/ /dngos su bshams dang yid kyis legs sprul te/ /'chi med lam rnams dog por rab bkod nas/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin dang lhan cig 'bul/ /thog med dus dang da lta'i bar dag tu/ /bsags nga 'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs/ /sngar byas la 'gyod phyis nas sdom sems bcas/ /gnyen po stobs bzhi'i sgo nas mthol lo bshags/ /'phags mchog rnams dang so so skye bo sogs/ /rang gzhan rnams (29ba)kyis bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge /rlabs chen spyad dang phra —86

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdamor spel kun la/ /bcos min bsam pa thag pas rjes yi rang / /rgyal dang de sras slob mar bcas pa yi/ /chags bral tshul dang rgya che zab mo'i lam/ /mchog dman gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham pa yi/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar bskul/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo'i rmu rgod 'dul dka'i 'gro'i/ /snang tshul la gzigs zhi bder mnal sems rnams/ /bskal brgya'i bar du mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /skye dgu'i mgon du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /'khor ba'i ya mtha' mi mngon de srid nas/ da lta'i bar du bsags pa'i dge ba kun/ /rang don sgrub pa'i ched du ma yin par/ /sems can don du sangs rgyas rgyu ru bsngo/ /gsol 'debs ni/ mthong na mi mthun med pa mtshan dpe'i sku/ /tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i skad du sgrog pa'i gsung / /shes bya ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /bden pa gnyis sogs rtogs pa'i bstan pa rnams/ /brjod byar byed pa'i lung gi legs bshad kun/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas nas chad med rab ston pa'i/ /dam chos kun 'dus ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ khyod kyis legs bstan chos rnams thos bsam dang / /sgom pas gtan la phab pas spang rtogs kyi/ /yon tan ma lus mngon du gyur pa yi/ /dge 'dun kun gyi byed por gsol ba 'debs/ /bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho'i chos/ /nyes ltung rnyog pa bag yod ke ta gas/ /legs bgrungs tshul khrims chu klung chad med pa'i/ /rnam dag 'dul ba 'jin la gsol ba 'debs/ /bying dang rgod pa'i rjes su mtshams kyi rta/ /rgyug tshe shes bzhin kha lo legs bsgyur nas/ /lus sems shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba la/ /rab (30na〉goms mdo sde 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos dang gang zag bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo'i/ /zhen yul drungs phyung mkha' ltar dmigs med cing / /kun rdzob du'ang sgyu ma dang mchungs par/ /gzigs pa'i mngon pa 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /smin byed dbang dang grol byed rim gnyis lam/ /zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sku gsum go 'phang mngon du gyur mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod 'og min dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /dkyil ri/char bye ba phrag brgya'i byed po ru /bzhugs kyang bdag sogs 'gro ba 'dren —87—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shepa'i ched/ /tha mal gzugs su bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ /dal 'byor rnyed par dka' zhing 'jig par sla/ /bzod dka' ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dang / /dkar nag las 'bras blang dor legs ston pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /lha mi'i bde ba 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal can/ /skye rga na 'chi dar rgud la sogs pa/ /'khor ba snying po med pa'i ngang tshul kun/ /ston mdzad bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum po legs goms pas/ /rang nyid gtan gyi bcan sa zin gyur kyang / /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don du phyin drug gi /rlabs chen spyod pa ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas sgrub la grangs med gsum gyi bar/ /tshogs gnyis gsog yun ma rgan 'gro ba rnams/ /nyams thag ma bzod tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya pa'i/ /gsang sngags nye lam ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang la mchod tshe bsod nams zhing mchog tu/ /sangs rgyas kun kyang khyod kyi sku lus la/ /zhugs nas tshogs chen rdzogs par mdzad pa yi/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba btab na mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub ma lus char ltar 'bebs nus pa'i/ /yi dam dkyil (30ba〉sgo ngur 'khor lo ma lus pa/ /kun 'dus bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /dgra gdon bgegs sogs bar gcod nyer 'tshe kun/ /dran pa tsam gyis ma lus sel ba la/ /chos skyong srung ma'i mthu stobs ma lus pa/ /lhun grub bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /mdor na mchog dang thun mong dngos grub sogs/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs mdun ma ma lus pa/ /stsol mdzad bsam 'phel yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /smon lam ni/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje dang / /rten 'brel rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs mar gyur sems can thams cad kyi/ /las nyon sdig sgrib ma lus byang bar shog /dmyal ba'i tsha grang ral gri lo ma'i chogs/ shal ma li yi stong po sol phung dang / /lcags bsreg sa gzhi bsdus 'joms ri bo sogs/ /bde skyid lha yi gnas ltar 'gyur bar shog /btab pa'i ma tshon rnams me tog tu bsgyur cing / /chu bo rab med bying rnams 3 lus thob/ /gshen rje —88

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdakhwa ta bya rgod skrag byed pa'i/ /phyag na rdo rjes dbugs dbyung rjes 'dzin shog /lag na padma'i thugs rje'i char rgyun gyis/ /'jigs rung dmyal ba'i mi rnams gsod gyur cing / /'jam dpal dbyangs mthong dmyal ba'i sems can rnams/ /thar pa'i skal ba bzang po 'thob par shog /gsod spyod gcig la gcig za gti mug pa'i/ /sdug bsngal kun las dud 'gro'i tshogs thar zhid / /bkres skom gdung ba'i ming yang mi grags par/ /yi dwags rnams ni rtag tu bde gyur cig /mi lus thob kyang bkres phongs dbul ba rnams/ /bza' btung gos sogs 'byor pa dang ldan zhing / /dbang po nyams rnams mig rna yan lag kun/ /tshang zhing de yis don byed nus par shog /sman kun mthu ldan nad (31na)rnams myur du gsos/ /mi dang mi min gcan gzan 'byung ba bzhis/ /rnam par 'tshe rnams 'jigs skrag las thar zhing / /yid chad rnams kyi yid ni gsos par shog /tshong pa lam bde khe spogs bsam pa 'grub/ /sprum ma bder btsa' mya ngam thang 'khyam rnams/ /grogs dang phrad nas bde bar bgrod gyur cing / /mgon med rnams kyang lha mis skyob par shog /'gro rnams dal ba'i rten thob mtho ris kyi/ /yon tan bdun ldan nga rgyal dag dang bral/ /byang chub sems ldan bdud kyi las kun spongs/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis rjes 'dzin shog /sdig sems can rnams de las ldog gyur cing /mkha' 'gro srin po snying rje'i sems dang ldan/ /dus su char 'bebs lo tog phun sum tshogs/ /nad rims 'khrug slong 'thab rtsod zhi bar shog /rgyal po rnams kyang rang gi mnga' ris kyis/ /chog shes 'bangs rnams chos bzhin bde bar skyong / /dge 'dun sde rnams tshul khrims rnam dag cing / /chos spyod bcu yi rim pa 'phel bar shog /sangs rgyas thugs rje 'gro kun la 'jug cing / /byang sems rnams kyis 'gro ba 'dren pa yi/ /bzhed pa'i don rnams ma lus lhun gyis grub/ /dge ba'i bshes dang rtag tu mi 'bral shog /bdag ni 'gro ba 'dren pa'i snying stobs khur/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo'i spyod pa ltar spyad nas/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du sems can rnams/ /'dren pa'i mgon dang skyabs su bang ga gyur cig /dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ yig dkar po las/ /'od 'phros rang —8(3

wa wa ——— rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegi dpral bar thim pa yis/ /bum dbang byin rlabs tshul thob lus sgrib sbyangs/ /'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥyig dmar po las/ /'od 'phros rang gi (31ba)mgrin par thim pa yis/ /gsang dbang byin rlabs tshul thob ngag sgrib sbyangs/ /'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i thugs ga'i hūṃ yig sngon po las/ /'od 'phros rang gi snying gar thim pa yis/ /sher dbang byin rlabs tshul thob yid sgrib sbyangs/ /'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i gnas gsum dag las 'od zer 'phros/ /gang gi gnas gsum so sor thim pa yis/ /tshig dbang byin rlabs chul thob sgrib kun sbyangs/ /'bras bu zung 'jug 'grub pa'i sa bon ba 'ag /skyabs gsum kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma mchog /bdag gi snying ga padma 'dab brgyad dbus//thogs med byon la byang chub ma thob par/ /'bral med bzhugs nas brtse bas rjes 'dzin mdzod/ /gsol ba btab pas bla ma snying dbus byon/ /rang sems bla ma'i ngo bor blta ba'i mod/ /dbyer med ting nge 'dzin la mnyam bzhag nas/ /slar yang rjes thob ngang nas smon lam bya/ /de ltar bsags pa'i dge tshogs ji snyed pas/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis tshe rabs kun/ /rjes su bzung nas 'di dang gtan mdun rnams/ /'bral med lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'dod 'jo'i phreng ba 'di ni dad stobs ldan pa er te ni da la'i hung wang tha'i jis tshogs gsog gsol 'debs smon lam go bde ba 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /na mo gu ru we/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar 'dod pas sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma'i skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ sa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad nyi'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid chos kyi rgyal po bcong (32na tha pa chen po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ sku chos gos gsum dang dbu snye pa paṇa zhwa gser gyi mdog can gsol ba/'bas rdo rje'i skyil me krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dbu gtsug tā rgyal ba shākya thub pa/ /dpung pa — )/)

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdagayas su spyan ras gzigs/ dpung pa g.yon du phyag na rdo rje/ thugs gar mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs rnams bzhugs pa'i thugs ma'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs te gnyis su med par bsdim/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /zhes sogs kyi yan lag bdun pa phul/ de nas dmigs brtse ma gang lcogs bton te gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab/ mthar dbu gtsug dang dpung pa gnyis kyi lha rnams 'od du zhu nas bla ma la thim/ bla ma'ang rang gi snying gar byon te 'od du zhu nas rang sems dang dbyer ma mchis par bsam la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs smon lam ci rigs par gdab bo/ zhes pa 'di ni dur bod dpon po'i nyams len khyer bder 'phral du bkod pa'o/ /ngag dbang blo yi 'dab brgya yongs bzhad pas/ /skal bzang bung bar chos kyi sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /legs stsol rnam par rgyal ba'i grags snyan mtshan/ rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab par gsol ba 'debs/ /na mo gu ru we/ mtshan sgra gsum tshang ba'i gsol 'debs la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma sngon du btang / su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor seng gis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma/ zla ba/ nyi ma brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du /bams gsum chos kyi rgyal po (32ba)btsong kha pa chen po dang rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis ngo bo dbyer ma mchis pa rnam pa rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog mthing kha rdo rje dang dril bu thugs gar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa mtshan dpe'i gsal rdzogs kyi bdag nyid can zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs gar ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra mtshon gang pa/ de'i thugs dar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig sngon po/ bla ma rnam gsum sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi chul du bzhugs pa'i dam tshig sems dpa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ/ thugs dar hūṃ/ thugs ma'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gzha ra/ nas skyabs gnas thams cad spyan drangs/ jaḥ& baṃ sgo sa gnyis su med par bstim/ de —9/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshenyid la/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa tshar gcig phul rjes/ /gsol 'debs rtse( ka gcig pus gsol ba ci nus btab pa'i mthar/ dam tshig sems dpa' ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pa can du gyur nas rang la thim par bsam zhing / bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di'ang dur bod dpon mos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes bris/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzugs/ /ngur smrig gar gyis rnam rol btsong kha pa'i/ /snyen bas pad gtsug na rtag tu legs bsten nas/ /mgon khyod sgrub pa'i nyams len 'bri bar bya/ /de'ang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'tsham pa rgyud dang 'dres nges sngon du btang nas/ shā n+ya 'a 'khor 'das kyis bsdus (33na)pa'i chos thams cad stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bo'am mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du yi ge dhīḥ dmar ser/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po bcong kha pa chen po sum ldan dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam rol can zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis thugs dang chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis me tog yi la'i yu ba nas 'dzan pa'i 'dab ma dpung pa'i thad du rgyas pa'i g.yas kyi 'dab steng na shes rab kyi ral gri dang / g.yon gyi 'dab steng na sher phyin gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/ chos gos rnam pa gsum gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ dbu la paṇa zhu gser gyi mdog can sne ring gi tshul du gsol ba/ /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor bde chen gyi 'khor lo la dbus su dhīḥ las 'phags pa 'jam dpal ser po gzhon nu zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon glegs bam bsnams pa/mgrin pa longs spyod gyi 'khor lo'i dbus su hrīḥlas spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag ba'i pa/ dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar zhing 'og ma gnyis shel 'phreng dang padma 'dzin pa/0(32

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdeganyis ga'ang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su hūṃ las phyag na rdo rje mthing nag khro bo'i rnam pa can g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs gar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can rin po che dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs (33ba)g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par yid mar po/ thugs dar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ma'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas ngo mtshar rmad byung bkod pa'i zhing khams sogs rang bzhin gyi gnas nas chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma sogs skyabs gnas yin no cog gis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dza hūṃ rbaḥtshes gnyis su med par bstim/ /de nas/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /zhes sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa rgyas par phul te nyams len dngos/ dmigs brtse ma la chig dril du byas nas gsol ba 'debs/ dmigs brtse ma rgya skad du bsgyur na/ /ka raṇḍa glu hā sa ma na ra dā ya phya ma shā ni dhi rnye spri kha sgri bi ma pyo/ /pa ṭa rjoṭa ā laṅka ri ྅rje mu khyu pa la ṇḍaḥsu dhī kirti adhe ṣa 'o sto/ zhes lag 'gro lhung ba'i sdeb sbyor 'di lta bu'i sgo nas kyang gsol ba btab pa'i mthar dbang bzhi len pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor spyi 'gro lta ra byas rjes bla ma spyi bo nas zhugs snying dbus su byon/ snying padma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su bla ma mtshon gang ba zhig gsal btab/ de la gsol ba drag tu btab pa ni mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang sems dang mnyam par bzhag go /de ltar dmigs brtse ma la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dmigs brtse ma rgya skad du bsgyur ba dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes rgyal khang rtse sprul pa'i sku'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas za hor kyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /na mo gu ru we/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od stong cher 'bar bas/ /ma rig mun pa'i tshogs kyi gsal mdzang pa'i/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma'i zhabs pad la btud nas/ /—93

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegazhug ma lhan ceg skyes pa rang gi sems/ /snang tshul ji bzhin brtags nas rtsad bcad pas/ /(34na)chu la ri mo bris ltar zhig pa'i mthar/ /gnas lugs sems kyi phyi thag gcod tshul bshad/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' don che 'jig sla zhing / shi nas ngan 'gror skye ba'i sdug bsngal soms/ /gal te bde 'gror skyes kyang 'khor ba kun/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar bas zhen log gces/ /bde sdug rtsa ba las 'bras yin pas 'dzems/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs las skyob phyir skyabs 'gro bya/ /'gro kun mar shes byang chub sems mchog skyed/ /yi ge brgya pas sgo gsum sdig ltung sbyongs/ /ku su lu yi mchod pas tshogs gsag cing / /dngos grub rtsa ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor te/ /sngon 'gro'i nyams len gnad du song ba'i rjes/ /bla ma rang sems bsres pa'i brjod med ngang / /snang srid kun gyi rtsa ba sems 'di nyid/ /dang po snod bcud gang las byung ba brtag /bar du lus sogs phyi nang gar 'dug btsal/ /tha mar mi gnas gang du 'gags pa ltos/ /de ltar gnas pas skye med chos kyi sku/ /gnas med stong gsal rjen pa longs spyod rdzogs/ /'gre sa med kyang rang gdangs 'gag med du/ shar ba sprul sku bzhi yi sku gsum ste/ /sems kyi ngo bo gang du ma grub par/ /mnyam par bzhag pas chos kun stong par rtogs/ /de ltar gsal stong 'dzin med ngang ba 'ag nas/ /gzhi lam sku gsum ma bu bsres nas sgoms/ /de bzhin bsgoms pas gnas pa dang po'i tshe/ /ri gzar rbab bzhin rnam rtog shin tu mang / /gnyis pa chu bo dal 'bab bzhin du nyung / /gsum pa rgya mtsho'i gting ltar sems mi g.yo/ /bying na rgya bskyed rgod na rig pa dmar/ /'phro na sgrim zhig rmugs na gsol ba 'debs/ /'byams na hril (34ba)bsdus mig ni sna rtser bab/ /rang ngo de la cer gyi lta ba gnad/ bying rgod phral tshe sems bying dmigs pa la/ /gnas kyang rnam rtog phra mor skyon mi lta/ /bsgom bya sgom byed bral ba'i 'od gsal de/ /sems kyi ngo bo gzhi yi chos sku yin/ /'gyu ba phra rags sgom gsum gnas pa yi/ /tha ma bar dang thog ma'i rnam rtog ste/ /gnas thog 'gyu dang 'gyu thog gnas pa ni/ /'gyu ba rang sar bzhag pas phrol ba'i don / /gnas dang 'am sa pru nga rtog pa go rim ba 'an/ /'char ba rim gyis pa yin nges med pa/ /thong ra pa — 34

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ 'obakab de sems ngo sprod tsam na/ /gsum ga dus gcig 'char ba cig car ba/ /de ltar sems kyi ngo bo legs 'phrod nas/ /nyams su len par sems kyi ngo bo'i steng / /bsgrims te cung zad ma 'gyus par bzhag pas/ /rig pa grung 'don dran shes bsten tshul yin/ /myong ba thon nas 'bad rtsol mi byed par/ /rang sems cham me lhod de shig ge bya/ /ma bcos rang sar lhod de slod pa yi/ /cir snang gsal stong 'dzin med ngang du 'char/ /de nas bsgom bya sgom byed kun bral ba'i/ /sems ni rang babs rang sar bzhag pa yi/ /cir snang chos sku'i rang zhal 'char ba nas/ /gnyug sems mngon sum mthong ba de la zer/ /de nas 'phro dang mi 'phro'i dus kun tu/ /bzang ngan mi bya sems las ma 'das pas/ /mkha' las sprin dang glog sogs 'byung ba ltar/ /sems las 'phro zhing sems kyi dbyings su yal/ /de nas mnyam bzhag las langs rjes thob byas/ /gzugs sogs gang snang thog tu lhod glod nas/ /bzhag tshe snang stong dbyer med rjen lhag tu/ shar ba snang ba chos sku'i rgya yan yin/ /gzhi yi rnam rtog (35na)dbul po'i gter lta bu/ /lam gyi rnam rtog sngar 'dris grogs dang mtshungs/ /'bras bu'i rnam rtog gser gling rdo 'dra bar/ shes na rnam rtog chos sku las gzhan med/ /chos kun ngo bos grub ma myong ba de/ /gzhi yi phyag rgya chen por nges rnyed nas/ /lam dus thabs shes zung 'brel nyams blangs pas/ /'bras bu sku gsum mngon du 'gro ba yin/ /chos kun stong par lta ba'i phyag rgya che/ /gnyug ma'i mnyam gzhag bsgom pa'i phyag rgya che/ /de las byang chub sems kyi rtsis zin nas/ /sdom gsum la gnas spyod pa'i phyag rgya che/ rnam rtog bskyod pa med par sems gnas tshe/ /rtse gcig rnal 'byor rgyud pa skyes pa yin/ /chos kun sems yin sems kyang stong pa'i gshis/ /thams cad dag tshe spros bral rnal 'byor yin/ /sems snang sna tshogs ye shes rol ba sde/ /snang stong dgag sgrub bral tshe ro gcig yin/ /bsgom bya sgom byed bral ba'i blo 'das kyis/ /rtogs pa mngon du gyur tshe sgom med yin/ /de ltar dbu ma phyag chen rdzogs chen zhes/ /chen po gsum gyi lta ba'i dgongs pa rnams/ /thun mong spyi khyab ngo sprod man ngag las/ /btsos te tshig nyung don tshang bkod pa 'dis/ /dge slong rin chen rgya mtsho —4)5

wa wa rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shezhes bya bas/ /'bad pa chen pos nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ /'jam mgon dpal 'byor lhun grub gsung rgyun bzhin/ /za hor brnyes g.yar khral tsam du sbyar/ /dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor 'dus pa'i dpal/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /chos skyong srung ma skyabs gnas ma lus kun/ /'dir gshegs snying dbus padma'i ze'u 'brur bzhugs/ /(35ba)bye ba phrag brgyar sprul pa'i bdag lus kyis/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dzad med kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /dngos bshams yid sprul nam mkha'i khyon bkang 'bul/ /dug gsum dbang gis sngon nas deng gi bar/ bgyis pa'i sdig las stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags/ /skye 'phags kun gyis bsags dang gsog 'gyur nyid / /da ltar spel ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /rgyal dang de sras slob mar bcas pa rnams/ /'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar bskul/ /mkha' mnyam mar gyur 'khor ba las sgrol phyir/ /'og min zhing gi mgon ltar rtag bsdogs gsol/ /pad rtsa ltar dkar dge tshogs gang bsags pa/ /kun mkhyen ye shes 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /bdag sogs 'gro la rtsa brgyud bla ma yis/ /phul byung thugs rje 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ /yi dam lha yi mkhyen brtse nus dpung gis/ /mchog thun dngos grub stsol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' 'gro chos srung nus pas bar chad kun/ /zhi zhing 'phrin las sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sgo gsum 'bad pas tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong na/ /de don lhun gyis 'grub par bdag byin rlobs/ /mchog gsum dam pa'i phun tshogs dge legs kyis/ /dus rnams kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shes shog /ces bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma kun 'dus la yan lag bdun pa'i sgo nas bsags sbyangs byed pa'i rim pa 'di ni bde mchog chos rjes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin/ /tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtshor nges (36na)rnyed nas/ /mgon khyod sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor 'di ltar ro/ /— 36

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdaskyabs 'gro sems bskyed nyams len chul/ /man ngag ltar byas ngag 'don ni/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas 'gro 'dren sangs rgyas dang / /bden pa gnyis dang ldan pa dam pa'i chos/ /de don chul bzhin sgrub pa dge 'dun la/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /mtha' dang tshad du bral ba'i sems can rnams/ /zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid thob pa'i ched/ /bdag gis tshar chen rdo rje 'chang dbang la/ /brten nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom par bgyi/ /dngos gzhi dmigs pa'i gsal 'debs su/ /tshig gi ngag 'don 'di ltar bya/ /kun rdzob chos rnams gdod nas stong pa'i ngang / /hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / /ra ba dra gur bla bre me 'bar ba/ /sra brtan 'jig med srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang / /hūm̐ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs rnam bzhi can/ /rin chen rgyan spras tshad dang mtshan nyid tshang / /dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /seng ge chen po brgyad kyis nyer bteg pa'i/ /mdzes shing brjid chags rin chen khri stan la/ /'khor bas ma gos sna tshogs padma dang / /thabs shes zung 'jug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus tshar chen chos kyi rgyal/ /sku mdog dkar la dmar mdangs zhal rgya can/ /g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga thugs rka'i thad/ /'dzin cing g.yon pa dril bu dku la brten/ /bla gos la sogs rab tu byung ba'i chas/ /padma rā ga'i mdangs kyi rjes 'gror 'tshar/ /dbu la sa zhu dmar zlum sna rings mdzes/ /zhabs gnyis (36ba〉skyel krung spyi gtsug rigs kyi bdag /kun spangs chos rje rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /gdong lnga'i chibs la phyed skyil tshul gyis 'gying / /bdud tshogs skrag phyir cung zad khro nyams can/ /de ltar pha ma mchog gnyis sbyang gzhi'i sku/ /gcig 'dres gnas 'gyur sbyangs 'bras kyai rdo rje/ /sku mdog int+ra ni la ltar 'tsher ba'i/ /rtsa zhal sngon po g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar/ /steng zhal dung mdog lhag ma'i zhal bzhi gnag /dus gsum cig car gzigs pa'i spyan gsum ldan/ /bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /dmar ser dbu skra gyen brjes rtsa zhal gyi/ /spyi bor sna tshogs ldo rjes legs par mtshan/ /rab dkar thod nang g.yas kyi phyag brgyad pos/ /—97

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 1)se glang bo che dkar rta sngon bong bu gwa/ /glang dmar rnga mo thal kha mi dmar po/ sha ra bha sngon byi la gu pa bsnams/ /g.yon rim sa chu me dang rlung gi lha/ /ser dkar dmar dang ljang gu'i kha dog can/ /zla ba dkar po nyi ma dmar po dang / /gshin rje sngon po nor sbyin ser po 'dzin/ /ye shes lnga ldan thod skam dbu rgyan dang / /dbyangs gsal dag pa'i thod rlon do shal 'phyang / /rigs drug bdag nyid rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rang snang rig mar 'khyud/ /g.yas kyi zhabs gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla yi ngos/ /g.yon pa'i zhabs gnyis bskums pa'i sor mo rnams/ /bstan pa'i skyil krung phyed pas bdud bzhi po/ /brtsegs steng gar dgu'i nyams kyis rnam par 'gying / /mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /de yi bar du rdo rje bdag med ma/ /sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /shes rab lang tsho rgyas pa'i mdzes sdug can/ /g.yas pa rdo rje gri gug mkha' la brkyang / /(37na)g.yon pa bdud bzhi'i khrag bkang thod 'dzin 'khrud/ thod skam dbu rgyan do shal phyag rgya lnga/ /zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas pa yab la 'khril/ /thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i bde stong mdangs/ /bzlan lag rnam par shar ba yab yum zung / /ye shes me dpung rab 'bar dbus bzhugs pa'i/ /gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūṃ sngon mtshan/ /gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed rnam par shes/ /rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gcig bsdus rdo rje 'chang / /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' yum lnga dngos/ /dbang lnga lus tshigs rtsa rgyus sems dpa' brgyad/ /g.yas g.yon phyag ngar zhal gsang dpung pa zung / /pus gnyis spyi gtsug zhabs mthil khro bo bcu/ /'dod yon lnga dang chos dbyings lha mo drug /gdan gsum chang ba'i lha yi ngo bor gsal/ /thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros dag zhing nas/ lam 'bras gser chos bcu gsum mgon zung gi /smin grol man ngag lung sogs slob bshad kyi/ /snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i lha sangs rgyas de sras dang / /nyan rang dpa' bo ma/ba 'a 'gro chos srung tshogs/ /thogs pa med par badzra sa mā dzaḥ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku dang gnyis med gyur/ /gang drin la sogs gsol 'debs rigs/ /rgyas bsdus blo dang sbyar byas nas/ /snyan brgyud — 38

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bkakun rig bla ma'i mtshan rags rim/ /brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ltar ro/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang rdo rje bdag med ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir wa pa/ shar phyogs nag pa po dang rgyal rigs ḍa ma ru pa/ /a wa sgru tī pa pa paṇa 'a ghā ya dha ra la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /lo chen 'brog mi shākya ye shes se ston (37ba 〉 ta ston chos 'bar/ /mkha' spyod dbang mo paṇa chen nā ro pa/ /pham mthing sku mched gcen 'jigs med grags pa dang0khung ngag dbang grags pa/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal blo gros grags/ tshe se'i 'khobs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /la ba pa dang rgyal po/ ind+ra lha ti/ lcam legs ka ra/smin/ /bram ze birba pa dang rje gas/ mi tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na rdo rje bha rend+ra ru tse/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /bal po ye shes rdo rje 'phags pa/ lo ke shwa ra dang / /byang sems blo gros rin chen ka mā la badzra/ dza ya se na sum pa lo tsā bar/ dar ma yon to/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rje bas/ rigs byed dbang mo rgyal po/ lhan skyes rol pa'i zhabs/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung ba ri ba rin chen grags/ /bram ze/ sa ra ha dang mgon po/ klu sgrub sha ba dbang phyug /ri/ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /bal po/ ha du dkar po rje btsun rdo rje chos/ bde mkha' 'gro ma/ ba rgyas byed dze ta ri pa dgra las rnam rgyal/ dang / /grub 'a/rol pa'i rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa bsrung / /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rje btsun sgrol ma spyan ras gzigs/ sidha nā da dang / /slob dpon tsanda go mi slob mar bcas/ /a thu la dha sa badzra/man dza gling pa'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /gas/ phul byung ba/gtsug tor rgyal po mnga' ris/gsal ba'i snying / /'khon ston skye chu ba dgra lha 'bar/ mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje gur/(38na)/ grub chen/ bram ze mchog sred nor bu gling pa slob dpon/ bde ba'i rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /paṇa rṣa/ dad byed go cha lor/ rin 'a/ bzang pa/ brag steng pa bon tan tshul khrims/ /ba kla ta pa sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ /mar me mdzad bzang pa/ dang dpal bde ba/ bi mā la gupta/ sol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rin chen rdo rje rin so grags pa/ rnam gnyis ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ /lo chen gnyan dar ma —99

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshegrags/ dang nye gnas gnam/ kha'u pa/ /skyes rgyan padma 'byung gnas/ kha che/ dharma pā la'i 'khas/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /gshin rje gshed po lha chen ma hā de wa/ ā tsarya/ nyi 'od grags/ /paṇḍita/ zla ba nag po shrī/ dha ra kra shu dang / /sa chen kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal ma'/ sku mched sa skya/ paṇḍi tar/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /tshogs sgom pa/nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa / glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ /do bo ston tshul 'gro mgon/ chos rgyal 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug /mkhas pa yon tan khri/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhan wo/ seng ge bzang po shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa/ye shes/ rin chen/ kun dga' byang chub mkhan chen/ rgyal bzang dpal/ bla ma/ grags pa/ dpal sa bzang / ma ti paṇa chen sa rsāng 'phags pa/ gzhon nu/ blo gros/ la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /dam pa kun grags bdag nyid chen po/ bzang po/ dpal dga' ldan pa/ kun dga'/ bsod nams/ dang / /gan pa rin chen/ rgyal mtshan/ 'ad ston dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ /bkra shis/ 'od zer/grub thob/ 'dar char chos rgyal/ bo dong rin chen/ jo sras/ sangs rgyas/ rin chen/ par/ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /slob dpon/ shes/ rab/ mtsho bla ma/ bsod nams/ dbang phyug lcang dpe pa/ seng ge /'bum mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs/ pa/ /bla ma dam pa/ ba tre rgod nams/ rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos rje/ dpal ldan/ tshul khrims shar chen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ /grub chen/ bzhi shrī /ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ mus pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ yar klung seng ge rgyal mtshan/ par/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /sngags 'chang gzungs kyi/ dpal ba/ theg chen kun dga'/ bkra shi/ sa pa/ nam mkha'/ bzang po nyi lde ba/ ngag dbang / grags pa/ bdag po zha lu ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ /rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub/ dge ba/ rgyan mtshan/ gra thang pa/ shes rab zla rab la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'jam dbyangs/ rgyal ba/ mchog yab 'jam dbyangs/ nam mkha'/ rgyan la mtsho/ grub chen/ dpal ldan/ rdor rje kun mkhyen/ bsod nams seng ge/ /bdag chen rdor rje/ 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/— /()/lha

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bderje btsun/ kun spangs rdo ring pa / sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ ye shes/ dpal blo bzang dkar mo/ dkon mchog thugs rje la/ /gsol (38ba)ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /gling smad paṇḍita/shes/ rab/ seng ge /dpal ldan/ rin chen/ chos mchog /mdo khams pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ /'bras spungs pa/ tshe dbang /ba po/sa rnam rgyal bkra shes jo gdan/ nam mkha'/ lhun bzang / pa/ /brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po dang dpal 'dzan bzang po gnyis/ dang chos rje rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /blo gros/ rnam rgyal / chos rje 'phrin las pa kun mkhyen/ dpal ldan/ seng ge /pa/ rin chen/bkra shi/sa rtogs ldan/ yon tan mgon dang bla ma/ gzhon nu dpal ba/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan chos rje/ shes rab rin chen la/ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /snyan brgyud chu bo kun 'dus tshar pa chos/ blo gsal rgya mtsha/ rje/ /'jam dbyangs/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bod mkhar ba/ shrī tri'i don grub rgyal mtshan/zhabs/ /mkhan chen gzhon nu/ :sna gros/ mkhan chen/ bslab ga sdo/ma rgyal mtshan la/ /garbe rgol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /bo dong rta rwa ba sngags 'chang/ bsod nams lhun grub/ chos 'phel bya gzhang mkhan chen/ 'a/ ji/ba rgya mtsho spyan snga/ mi pham zhabs chos kyi rgya mtsho/ /drung yig pa/ byams pa don sdo/ba rdo rje 'chang /dbang phyug rab brtan dpal/ /yangs can mkhan chen/ ngag dbang chos grags lo pa spyan snga/ kun dga' don grub la/ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'a zhu'i/ rdo rje 'chang dngos mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rje/ /zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa padma dbang gi grong khyer/ /glang phu chos rje chos skyong dbang phyug zha lu/ mkhan chen byang gling par rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /tshar chen nyid kyi dri med gsung / /'di bton rjes 'dzin zhal gyis bzhes/ /blo gsal mang thos ngur smrig 'chang ba'i gtso/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /'phrin las lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan can/ /dpal ldan yongs 'dzin bzang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bdag ni deng nas skye ba thams cad du/ /rje btsun bla ma khyod dang mi 'bral (39na tshe zhing/ /ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas mnyes byas te/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su 'dzin par shog /don gnyer gyis — /()/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebaskul blo brid du/ /me khyer nyi zla'i gral snyeg tshul/ /gsung ngag chad med dbang /khrid gdams pa'i mdzod/ /blo gros bum bzang legs gtams 'phrin las kyis/ /rgya mtsho'i mthar khyab 'jigs med go cha can/ /thub bstan lang tsho'i sdol gsol ba bdebs/ /lan grangs mang por gsol 'debs 'di/ /nan hur mdzad pa gong ma'i srol/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /chos la blo 'gro de don lam du longs/ /'khrul snang bar gcod zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos min blo spangs byams dang snying rje 'byongs/ /snang ba sems rtogs de don sgyu mar shes/ brjod bral blo 'das gnas lugs mngon du gyur/ /'gro kun don du rdo rje 'dzin gyur cig /mchod 'bul dmigs rim zhib cha rnams/ /zhal shes khungs btsun yi ge blta/ /'jig rten khams na bdag pos bzung ba dang / /ma bzung 'dod pa'i longs spyod ci mchis pa/ /med byung mchod pa'i tshogs su gyur to cog /dkon mchog kun 'dus rtsa rgyud bla mar 'bul/ /dgra bgegs nye du bar ma'i sems can sogs/ /'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i/ /sems can thams cad skyabs mgon bla ma yi/ /bka' yi bran dang 'bangs kyi ched du 'bul/ /mtshan ldan thod par bdag lus nyer spungs pa/ /sngags kyis byin brlabs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i dngos por bsgyur byas nas/ /mchod (39ba〉yul dgyes bskyed rigs drug tshim zhing grol/ /tshig 'dis gsol gdab dbang bzhi rnams/ /byin rlabs tshul len gsung rgyun ltar/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma dam pa yis/ /bdag la dbang bskur zab mo stsal du gsol/ /gsol ba btab pas gnas gsum yig 'bru las/ /sngags dang 'od zer rim brgyud cig car byung / /rang gi gnas gsum rim bzhin thim pa yis/ /sgo gsum dri ma bag chags bcas pa dag /dbang bzhi byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul du thob/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dngos grub brnyes par bsams/ /de nas bla ma rang sems gnyis/ /dbyer med gdod ma'i rang zhal blta/ /dgyes mdzad yab yum snyoms zhugs byang chub sems/ /bde ba chen ngo/'i rnal 'byor spyi gtsug nas/ /thim pas gsang gsum rang gi sgo gsum dang / /dbyer med — /(/skye

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ khobadachu la chu bzhag bzhin du 'dres/ /mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa'i ngo bo kun/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba'i gnas lugs kyi/ /rang ngo shes nas gsal stong zung 'jug tu/ /nyams su len pa'i skal bzang e ma'o/ /rjes su bya ba bsngo smon dang / tshes pa brjod pa'i rim pa ni/ /dngos grub kun 'byung lam zab rnal 'byor gyi/ /legs byas zla ba 'bum ltar ches dkar bas/ /bdag sogs rdo rje 'chang dbang ma thob bar/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i mgon gyis rjes 'dzin shog /zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa ma lus dang / /khyad par nye lam zab mo rdo rje'i theg /yang snying gsang chen slob bshad ring lugs mchog /srid mtha'i bar du dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /thog med dus nas drin gyis nyer bskyangs pa'i/ /nyam thag 'gro ba mar gyur (40na〉mi tha' klas kun/ /srid dang zhi ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral te/ /tshe gcig nyid la kun mkhyen 'thob gyur cig /snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan bla ma dang / /yi dam dgyes mdzad rdo rje he ru ka /chos skyong gur mgon stobs 'phrog dbang po yi/ /bkra shis rgya mtshos dus kun khyab gyur cig /ces tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la brten pa'i zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor ma dros chu klung zhes bya ba 'di ni se dkar rigs kyi thig le 'dzin pa 'dar pa ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub ces legs sbyar gyi bstan bcos pā ṇi ka tsan dbyangs can ma sogs brda sprod kyi gtsug lag la snang ba mchog tu dkar ba'i skad gnyis smra ba gang gis nye bar bskul ba la brten nas rgyas bsdus ma gtogs lam zab las gzhan du rang bzos ma sbags shing gsung ngag gser chos/ chos skyong gi bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan rnams nyis bldab tu mi 'chor ba'i khyad nas go rim sna tshogs su gyur kyang don gyi brgyud pa'i tshul rnam grangs mang po'i khrod nas gtso che ba re tshang ba'i lugs su byas te tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi snyan brgyud zab mo rnams thos bsam sgom gsum gyis gtan la phab pas rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa thob pa'i za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /— ///sdu

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshespyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng / /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /khyab bdag rdo rje sem/sa dang/'a yi /rnam rol sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can/ /'bral ba med par rtag bzhugs la/ /mi phyed dad pas gsol btab tshe/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs char/ /chad med snying gi ze'u 'brur phob/ /tshe 'dir mngon (40ba)sum mig gis mthong / /khyod gsung rna ba'i bdud rtsir bsten/ /de don bsam dang sgom pa yis/ /nyams su len par bdag byin rlobs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung ma sogs/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus khyod nyid las/ /gzhan pa'i skyabs gnas bdag la med/ /gso pa ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /'gal rkyen bar gcod thams cad sol/ /ci bsams 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /snying dbus ze'u 'brur skyabs mgon khyod/ /rtag tu 'bral med bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /rang lus rtsa khams zhi khre'i lhar/ /mngon sum 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na deng nas rang sems dang / /bla ma yi dam srung ma rnams/ /dbyer med dag pa'i rang zhal de/ /rgyun chad med par mjal bar shog /ces thag ring po nas rgyang 'bod kyi tshul du gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes dga' ldan gsang sngags yang rtse'i slob dpon zur pa nyag re rab 'byams pa blo bzang rnam rgyal gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /mgon khyod lus kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ru /shar nas skye dgu'i bsod nams rgya mtsho che/ /rab spel rdo rje'i slob dpon gtsug tu bsten/ /'di na rgyun khyer rnal 'byor nyung ngu yis/ /tshegs chung nyams len gru gzings la brten nas/ /sa snyel ma chu gter pha mthar bgrod byas te/ /sku gsum nor bur longs su spyod 'di mtshar/ /de phyir phan bde'i 'bras bzang don gnyer ba/ /blo gsal ska la bzang mdongs mtha'i dga' ston du/ /rnam (41na)dpyod chu 'dzin lang long 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /legs bshad dbyar gyi rnga gsang ches cher ldir/ /de'ang rgya la dbang bsdung rnga pa chen pos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge legs kyi/ /yon — ///mu

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdatan kun gyi rtsa ba drin can rje/ /zhes dang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ shin tu khyad par gyur pa nyid/ /rtag par bla ma la ni dbul/ /de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar tshogs gsag gi zhing phul du byung ba dang / legs tsho gis kyi gter mdzod rdo rje slob dpon tshul bzhin du mchod pa la rag las pa'i phyir rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bya ba 'di ltar ro/ /thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par bya/ mchod pa dang nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ 'jigs byed kyi cho ga nas bshad pa ltar byed/ rten bskyed pa ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su zlo las 'khor lo dkar po zlo gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa rin po che lnga ldan gyi rtsig pa/ rtsig pa'i steng nas pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed/ mda' yab pu shus rnam par mdzes shing / 'dod snam nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul ba/ nang rin po che'i ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i gdung bzhi mig mang ris su bres nas phub pa'i thog rin po che'i tog can dang /rta babs bang rim bzhi pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo ri dwags sogs gzhal yas khang gi tshad dang mtshan nyid sogs rdzogs pa'i dbus su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri (41btangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs padma/ raṃ las nyi ma/ a las zla ba rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la dhīḥlas ral gri'i yu ba la sgyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ngo bo rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i rnam pa chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ 'dzum ldan zhal gyis 'gro kun thar pa'i khang bzang du bsu ba/ phyag gnyis chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis me tog utpa la'i yu ba nas bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan g.yas g.yon gyi thad du kha bye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi ral gri dang stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam bsnams pa/ sku la chos gos rnam pa gsum dang / dbu — /05

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yeshel paṇa zhu gser gyi mdog can gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de nyid 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku mdog gser bco ma lta bu/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal ser po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar po/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis utpa la dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ sku mdog phyag mtshan yab dang 'dra bas 'khrud pa/ gnyis ga'ang gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba la gnas shing / sprul pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ de'i dpral par oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥ dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa/ bskyed chog 'di ni rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po 'jam dpal (42na)dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin pas de dang 'brel chags pa'i dbang du byas kyi g.yin du na gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ bde mchog lu nag /gshin rje gshed sogs yi dam gyi lha gzhan la'ang sbyor rung bas skabs sbyar gyi mngon rtogs spos pas chog go /thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rgya chen spyod brgyud zab mo lta brgyud/ nyams len byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa sogs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang / gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang / myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa dang / dam can gshin rje'i rgyal po phyi nang gsang gsum/rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ dpal ldan 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug ma sogs mdor na skyabs gnas kyi yul du gyur to cog thams cad badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ tshigs bcad kyis spyan 'dren par spro na/ bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma sogs//dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor bzhugs pa kun/ /thogs pa med par gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ratna gu ru sarba shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥ& baṃ ho: mchod yon 'bul zhing gdan la bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa'i gzhal yas dbus/ /rin chen padma nyi zla — ///slo

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bkabartsegs pa'i khrir/ /bla ma yi dam chos skyong ma lus pa/ /kun 'dus skyabs kyi dam par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ratna gu ru sarba shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra pra wa ra sad ka raṃ a lha pra tismo ye swāhā/ oṃ padma ka ma lwa ye sdo/ phyag bya ba ni/ bye ba phrag brgya'i rten dang brten pa rnams/ /spro zhing sdud mdzad rigs kun khyab bdag mchog /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams (42ba〉pa gus phyag 'tshal/ /mchod pa'i nang tshan phyi mchod kyi rim pa las maṇḍal ni/ spos chus chag chag legs btab nor 'dzin gzhir/ 'khor yug lcags ri gcig gis yongs bskor dbus/ /rin chen sna bzhi las grub ri rab rtser/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha yi khang bzang mdzes/ /phyogs mtshams gling bzhi gling phran brgyad dang ldan/ /rin wo ri bo dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang ma spos lo tog rgyas/ /rgyal srid sna bdun mi mdzad gter bum che/ /sgeg 'phreng glu gar me tog bdug spos dang //snang gsal dri chab
