kyis mchod mdzes sdug ma/ /nyi zla rin chen gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sogs/ /phun tshogs lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma lus pa/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung ltar spel nas/ /mchog gsum kun 'dus bla ma mchog la 'bul/ /brtse bas bzhes te longs su nyer spyad nas/ sku gsung thugs kyis bdag byin brlab tu gsol/ /g.yin yang sa bzhi spos kyis ma dang/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum sogs yongs grags kyi tshigs bcad byed par spro na bya'o/ chu bzhi nyer spyod dang bcas pa'i mchod pa ni/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags na/ /bzhes te bdag la bka' drin stsol/ /oṃ ratna gu ru sarba shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra a lha prati tstsha ye swāhā/ gong gi yon chab kyi tshab tu zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bcug la/ a lha gyi gnas su pā hūm̐/ añtsa mā ṇi/ bro/ ṇi/ phre dhū pe/ lha pe/ byu/ ni we bye/ sha lta'i bar sbyor/ 'dod yon lnga 'bul ba ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs (43na thad 'ong rgyan 'phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /chos rgos mchog gsum ngo bor bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal — /(17—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedu gsol/ /o ratna bu ru sarba shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra rū pa pra titsā swāhā/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan yid 'ong sgra snyan ci mchis pa/ /mos blos mchog gsum ngo bor bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ oṃ ratna gu ru sarba shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra shasta pra titsā swāhā/ phyogs dus kun na tsandan sprul snying dang / /a gar la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos mchog gsum ngo bor bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ ratna gu ru sarba shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ga rje pra ti tstsha swāhā/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos mchog gsum ngo bor bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ ratna gu ru sarba shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ra sa pra tī tstsha swāhā/phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos mchog gsum ngo bor bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ ratna gu ru sarba shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra sparsha pra ti tstsha swāhā/ rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba ni/(43ba(kha 'di 'khor lo rin chen gyis/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste/ /dngos grub 'dod pa sbyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin re shes rab can gyis dbul/ oṃ ratna gu ru sarba shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra tsakra ratna pra tī tstsha ye swāhā/ zhing 'di nor bu rin chen gyis/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste/ /dngos grub 'dod pa sbyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin re shes rab can gyis 'bul/ /oṃ ratna gu ru sarba shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ma ni ratna pra two tstsha ye swāhā/ /zhing 'di btsun mo rin chen gyis/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste/ /dngos grub 'dod pa sbyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin re shes rab can gyis 'bul/ /oṃ ratna gu ru sarba shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra wastaratna pra twe tstsha ye swāhā/ zhing 'di blon po rin chen gyis/ /mkhas pa zo/ dngos ri/ /nyin ྾/ /oṃ ratna gu ru na/ pu ru ṣa ratna dze/ /zhing 'di glang po rin chen gyis/ /mkhas pa'i/ dngos mo/nyan ri/ /oṃ ra tā gu ru mo/ga ja ratna〉zhing 'di rta mchog rin chen gyis/ /mkhas par/ /dngos mo/nyin ྾/ /oṃ ge tā sdu ru ga a shwa ratna〉/ zhing 'di dmag dpon rin chen gyis/ /mkhas spo/nyin྾/ /— ///8—

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (ba)oṃ ratna gu ru ྾/ kṛ ha ratna ྾/ nyer mkho'i mchod pa ni/ yid 'ongs khang bzang sra brtan rdo rje'i khri/ /bla bre 'phan 'dugs rgyal mtshan lda ldi dang / /ja dkar btung ba rdul chags sman sna tshogs/ /lha mi'i rdzas kun skyabs gsum ngo bor 'bul/ oṃ ratna gu ru sa spru shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra bi shwa pā dza pra tī tstsha ye swā hā/ sgrub pa'i mchad pa ni/ dal 'byor zhing sar dge bcu'i sa bon las/ /mngon mtho'i rten gyi 'bras bzang rab spel zhing / /thos don bsam dang sgom pa'i nges legs lam/ /tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'bul/ /oṃ ratna gu ru sa spru shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra shī la sirnya pā dza pra tismo ྾/ nang gi mchod pa ni/ rab dkar mtshan ldan ka pā la yi nang / /rdzas kun sbyangs rtogs sbar byas zag med kyi/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di/ /mchog gsum kun dngos rje btsun bla mar 'bul/ /oṃ ratna gu ru sa spru shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ u3/ gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ bcu drug lang tsho rab rgyas mdzes sdug ma/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /mnyam sbyor dga' bzhi'i ye shes rab rgyas pa'i/ /bde stong zung du la jug pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ ratna gu ru sa spru shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā su kha hūṃ dza pra twe tsa ye swāhā/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ /mchod pa mchod byed mchod pa'i dngos po kun/ /rang bzhin gdod nas stong pa'i nam mkha' la/ /kun rdzob tsam du 'ja' tshon ltar bkra ba'i/ /snang stong dbyer med blo 'das mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ ratna gu ru sa spru shā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra sa spru dharma su bha wa shu dha pu dza pra tī tstsha ye swā hā/ bstod pa ni/(44na)dus gsum rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ zhing 'dir ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zlos gar gyis/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde ma lus spel mdzad pa/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos khyod la rtag tu 'dud/ /gang gi phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yi rnam rol can/ /rigs kun khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po khyod la 'dud/ /mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /gnyis med gnyis su snang ba'i zlos gar can/ /bde chen nyams ldan 'jo sgeg sgyu dra'i gar/ /ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i ri mo rnam bkrar 'dud/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa'i glang po ltar/ /med bzhin snang — /()5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum / 6sheba'i ngo mtshar mtha' klas kyang / /gang gis mtshon du med pa'i gnas lugs mchog /brjod bral don dam byang chub sems la 'dud/ /gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa bag la nyal/ /ji bzhin gzigs nas mchog dman bar ma dang / 'tsham par gsang gsum 'khor lo ston mdzad pa'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pa mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang rgyud dang mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyis bstod pa mdzad pa spro na bya/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i bla ma spyi bstod 'di gdon par 'dod na/ mngon mtho nges legs legs tshogs ma lus pa/ /gang gi zhabs pad kho nar rag las zhes/ /rgyal bas mdo rgyud kun las cher bsngags pa/ /bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/thog med dus nas mi khom gnas brgyad 'khyams/ /da lan gcig pu dal ba rnyed dus 'dir/ /don ldan snying po len pa'i thabs ston pa/ /bla ma rin po che la ྾/ /las ngan mi dge sdig pa'i rlung shugs kyis/ /bzod dka' ngan 'gro'i g.yang du mngon phyogs tshe/ /thugs (45ba)rje'i phyag gis nye bar 'dzin mdzad pa/ /bla ma ྾/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi rlabs 'phreng g.yo ba can/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas las/ /'gro kun thabs mkhas gru yis sgrol mdzad pa/ /bla ma ྾/ /rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i gdon gyis bzung / /rnam mang zug rngus nyam thag gyur pa'i tshe/ /byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gso mdzad pa/ /bla ma ྾/ /myang 'das dman pa'i mya ngam thang la 'khyams/ /nyes brgya srid pa'i chom rkun gyis bcom rnams/ /phyin drug lam bzang mchog tu khrid mdzad pa/ /bla mas/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba ma lus pa/ /skal dman snyigs dus skye bo 'dul ba'i phyir/ /thabs la mkhas pas bshes gnyen tshul 'dzin pa/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bye ba phrag brgya yang / /khyod thugs lhan skyes ngang du ro gcig cing / /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'dod dgu'i chang 'bebs pa/ /yi dam kun 'dus khyod la gsol ྾/ /dran pa tsam gyis bar chad ma lus sel/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub mdzad pa/ /mthu ldan ye shes srung ma kun gyi dngos/ /chos skyong kun 'dus khyod la ྾/ /sku gnyis mngon gyur yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /— //(/

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdabaden gnyis zung 'jug dam chos kun gyi mdzod/ /rig grol gnyis ldan 'phags mchog kun gyi rje/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus khyod la ྾/ /de ltar zhing gi dam pa bla ma la/ /zhing rdul mnyam pa'i lus kyis phyag 'tshal zhing / /dngos bshams yid kyi sprul pa'i mchod sprin dang / /bla med sgrub pa'i mchod pa rtag tu mchod/ /thog med dus nas dug gsum nyon mongs kyis/ /sgo gsum bsags pa'i nyes lhung thams cad bshags/ /'khor 'das kun gyi dge la yi rang zhing / /zab yangs chos 'khor rtag tu skor du gsol/ /(45na)lus can kun gyi phan bde ma lus pa/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la rag las de yang ni/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams la rag las phyir/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs su gsol/ /skye 'chi spangs pa rdo rje'i sku brnyes kyang / /gdul bya'i don du skye 'chi sna tshogs pa/ /ston mdzad phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs bla ma rnams/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /rnam dag mi phyed dad pa rdo rje'i gdan/ /lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba zla ba'i gdan/ khugs drag smon lam pa blo'i ze'u 'bru la/ /srid mtha'i bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /khyod sku mig gi bdud rtsir mi 'bral zhing / /theg mchog gsung gis rtag tu 'tsho ba dang / /sku gsum thugs kyis nges par byin brlabs nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /skyabs mgon bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin las/ /'gal rkyen bdud sde'i bar chad kun las rgyal/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bsams pa'i don kun 'grub/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /yan lag bdun gyi dang po gnyis song zin nas phyi ma lnga ni/ /bdag sogs rnams kyis 'khor ba thog med nas/ /da lta'i bar du bsags pa'i sdig lhung kun/ /sngar byas la 'gyod phyis nas sdom sems kyis/ /rten mchog dam pa'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /skom pas nyen la chu thigs byin pa nas/ /tshe 'dir zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi lam/ /bsgrub pa'i dge tshogs phra rags ci mchis par/ /bcos min bsam pa thag pas rjes yi rang / /rnam mang theg pa'i 'jug sgo grangs mang por/ gang 'tsham gdul bya khrid nas thar lam la/ /'god phyir sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu — —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheskor du gsol/ /'gro ba mtha' dag bla med byang chub tu/ /bkod (45ba〉skun de srid zhi bar mi gnas par/ /sna tshogs gzugs sku mi 'gyur rdo rje bzhin/ /nam yang g.yo ba med par bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /lus ngag yid kyi sgo nas nyer bsags pa'i/ /dge tshogs mtha' dag drin can mar gyur 'gro/ /'dren phyir rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /go 'phang mchog de 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /smon lam ni/ rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa sogs/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus mchod pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /bdag sogs deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon dang mi 'bral shog /dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'jig sla ngan song gi /sdug bsngal mi bzad las 'bras slu med du/ zhas nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro zhing / /sdig spong dge ba sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /lha mi'i rten thob mngon mtho'i dpal 'byor kyang / /sdug bsngal bde bar rlom pa'i mtshang ris ste/ /snying nas 'khor ba'i tshul la yid phyung nas/ /thar pa'i go 'phang sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /thog med dus nas drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma/ /nyam thag sdug bsngal myong ba ma bzod par/ /smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /rgyal sras spyod la bslab par byin gyis rlobs/ /grangs med bskal par tshogs gnyis gsog pa la/ /bltos min snyigs dus tshe thung 'di nyid la/ /zung 'jug mngon du byed nus smin grol lam/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan la 'jug par shog /dam tshig sdom pa mig gi 'bras ltar bsrung / /skye shi bar do sku gsum ngo bor sbyang / /zab lam rim pa lnga yi rnal 'byor gyis/ mi slob zung 'jug go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma'i skyon kun rang sems ma dag par/ shar ba'i mtshang du rtogs nas mdzad pa rnams/ /yon tan kho nar nges pa'i dad pa yis/ /sangs rgyas dngos su mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/(46na)/dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du blang ba ni/ /bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim can dang cig car byung / rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo sogs gnas gsum so so dang / /thams cad du thim pas sgo gsum gyi dri ma gsum so so dang / de rnams kyi bag chags thams cad dag /rdo rje — //2

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdagasum so so dang / thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad zhugs/bum dbang gsang dbang shes rab ye shes dbang bzhi pa rnams thob/ slar yang 'dod don la gsol ba btab pas bla ma rang gi spyi bor byon 'od du zhu ba rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur bar bsam/ yang na 'di skad brjod de/ de ltar skyabs gnas re sa gzhan spangs nas/ /gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pa las/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi/ /yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer kha dog gsum/ /rang gzhan 'gro ba kun gyi gnas gsum thim/ /sgrib pa gsum dag dngos grub rnam gsum thob/ bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes dang / /bzhi ba'i dbang thob bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ rang dang ro gcig gyur/ /slar yang snying ga'i pa dme'i ze'u 'bru la/ /rtag par khyod bzhugs byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /shis brjod ni/ rgya chen spyod pa zab mo lta ba dang / /nyams len byin rlabs brgyud sogs bla ma'i tshogs/ /kun 'dus rigs brgya'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi bkra shis shog /gsang ba 'dus pa bde mchog he ru gaḥ/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed la sogs pa/ /grangs med rgyud sde bzhi yi 'khor lo'i gtso/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /myur mdzad mgon po las (46ba)gshin phyi nang gsang / /rnam mang thos sras dmag zor lha mo sogs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen bsrung mdzad pa'i/ /chos skyong dam can rnams kyi bkra shis shog /gzhan yang bkra shes pa'i rim pa ci rigs bya'o/ /de ltar bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bgyi ba 'di ni yar klungs pho brang ge ra ba gsol dpon blo bzang mkhyen brtses don 'dus shing / 'khyer bde go sla ba 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes don gnyer chen pos bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /oṃ sa sti siddhi/ bye ba phrag brgya'i rdul snyed zhing khams su/ sna tshogs sprul pa'i rol gar mtha' klas kyang / /zhing 'dir ngur smrig tshul 'chang kho na yis/ /thub bstan nyi ltar gsal mdzad btsong kha pa/ rigs gsum mgon po'i mkhyen brtse nus — //3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shepa kun/ /bshes gnyen gzugs su shar la nges rnyed de/ /tshul bzhin gsol ba gdab pa'i rnal 'byor gang / /'jam mgon bla ma'i gsung sgros ji bzhin 'god/ /de la 'dir dmigs brtse ma dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor mkhas pa'i dbang po stag lung grags pa'i gsung rgyun 'jam mgon bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi zhal lung las byung ba ltar 'god pa la thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas pa spyi ltar ram/ bsdus pa la dga' na sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma bya/ tshad med bzhi sgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor seng shes bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri padma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan sum brtsegs kyi steng du dhiḥlas ral gri'i yu ba dhīḥs mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las (47na)ngo bo skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing / phyag gnyis thugs kur chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mtheb srin gyis me tog utpa la'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa'i g.yas kyi 'dab steng du shes rab kyi ral gri dang / g.yon gyi 'dab steng du stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam bsnams pa/ dbu la paṇa zhwa gser gyi mdog can dang / sku la chos gos gsum gyis mdzes pa/ sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i cha lugs can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i dbus su pad zla'i gdan la mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser gur kum gyi mdog lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar zhid / g.yon me tog utpa la'i yu ba nas bzung ba'i 'dab ma'i steng du sher phyin gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing rin po ches brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su padma dang zla ba'i gdan la thugs rje chen po spyan ngas gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rtsa phyag gnyis thugs shar thal — //4

bla ma'i rnal 3byor zheng khams rgya mche'e byir rubs myur 'dren/ (bdamo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas shel dkar gyi 'phreng ba dang / g.yon 'og mas padma dkar po'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ri dwags khri brnyan sa la'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ thugs ka chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la dpal phyag (47bsko rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa gser gyi rdo rje 'phyar zhing /g.yon thugs gar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang sprul rigs lngas brgyan pa/ dar sngon mo'i stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de ltar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas zab mo lta brgyud/ rgya chen spyod brgyud/ nyams len byin rlabs brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong srung ma sogs skyabs gnas kyi yul thams cad rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dza2PROB baṃ sngo sa gnyis su med par bstim/ de ltar skyabs gsum kun 'dus su gsal btab pa la/ sa gzhi spos kyis sog ba'i dang / bdag g.yin lusang ga yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ /rin chen maṇḍal bzang po kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /blo yis blangs te bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum la 'bul/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes maṇḍal 'bul/ ji snyed su dag ces sogs bzang po spyod pa las 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rgyas par spro na sa gsum ma sogs byar rung zhing / bsdu bar 'dod na dmigs brtse mas chig dril du byas/ slar yang thal mo sbyar te/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ lung rtogs dam chos kun gyi 'byung gnas gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun gyi (48na)gtsug rgyan dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gi lus ngag — //sa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheyid gsum la byin gyis rlobs shig /sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du gzhen nu nor bzang ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin du bsten pas ci mdzad legs par mthong shing ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub par byin gyis rlobs shig /dal 'byor rnyed par dka' zhing 'jig par sla ba/ las 'bras zab cing ngan song gi sdug bsngal bzod dka' bar rtogs nas snying thag pa nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing sdig spong dge ba tshul bzhin sgrub par byin gyis rlobs shig /mngon mtho lha mi'i bde ba thob kyang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses shing slar yang ngan song du skye ba sogs zo chun gyi 'khrud mo ltar 'khor ba'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi tshul shes nas thar pa don gnyer gyi blo bcos ma ma yin pas lam bslab pa gsum la slob par byin gyis rlobs shig /mkha' mnyam gyi ma rgan sems can rnams nyam thag pa'i tshul la bsams na rang nyid gcig pu ci thar byed pa dman pa'i bde ba don du mi gnyer bar bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che la slob par byin gyis rlobs shig /bskal chen grangs med gsum gyi yun tsam gyi bar 'gro ba nyam thag par ma bzod par nges gsang rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la zhugs nas smin grol gyi lam zab mo nyams su blangs nas tshe 'dir zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang 'thob par byin gyis rlobs shig /mdor na skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du mgon po khyod kyi bstan pa la zhugs nas so so thar pa nas bzung ste lam rim pa lnga'i nyams len mtha' dag 'khrul pa'i dri ma tsam yang med par nyams su len cing / de ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa (48bting skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral bar byin gyis rlobs shig /deng nas sangs rgyas ma thob gyi bar du 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i dpal khyed bdag gi snying gi padma'i ze'u 'brur bzhugs nas 'di dang gtan gyi mdun ma thams cad lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ nyi ma'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim bzhin du byung / rang gi gnas gsum du rim pa bzhin du thim pas/ bum dbang gsang dbang sher dbang rnams — //6

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdarim pa bzhin byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ 'bras bu sprul sku longs sku chos sku gsum thob pa'i nus pa bzhag /slar yang gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum cig car du 'phros/ gnas gsum du thim pas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag 'bras bu zung 'jug thob pa'i nus pa bzhag /de nas bla ma sku je chung du song spyi bo nas rtsa dbu ma'i lam brgyud snying padma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su byon/ snying ga'i padma kha zum/ mtha' skor du oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥsu ma ti kirti shrī bha dra a dhiṣṭha na a dhi sti te kur yas zhes pa'i sngags kyi 'phreng pas dam du bcings te byang chub ma thob kyi bar du mi 'bral bar bsam mo/ /rjes su bsngo ba smon lam ci rigs pa bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni lugs gnyis kyi dpyod ldan mkha' 'gro blo bzang bstan skyong gis dmigs brtse ma la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar rje lha ri ba chen po'i thugs dam gyi nying khu yin zhes gcigs can du mdzad pa'i gsung rgyun bzhin za hor gyi brnyes go bde bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /na mo gu ru we/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma'i sku las skyabs sems sdon du btang nas/ rang gi spyi bor seng khri dang / /padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul/ /(49na tshe skyabs gnas kun 'dus bdag nyid can/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba rnams/ /don dang ldan par nges mdzad la/ /mi phyed shugs drag dad pa yis/ /lus stong sprul nas phyag 'tshal zhing / /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul/ /sdig ltung nyes tshogs thams cad bshags/ /dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /rtag tu chos 'khor skor bar bskul/ /bskal brgyar brtan par bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /bsod nams byas pa mtha' yas pa/ /bla med byang chub 'thob phyir bsngo/ /bla ma'i gnas gsum yi ge las/ /'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum ni/ /rim gyis pa dang cig car byung / /rang gi gnas gsum la thim pas / /sgrib pa sbyang zhing dbang bzhi thob/ /sku ba'i phyi sa bon legs par bzhag /bla ma 'od zhu rang nyid dang / /dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu gyur/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma sogs smon lam tshigs bcad ci rigs pa bya'o/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyung ngu lus la — //7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losebacangs chog pa'i lag bris ma zhig dgos zhes dang stobs ldan pa cho khur o pa shis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar/ /bde bar gshegs pa zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs/ /mgon khyod lus kyi dkyil 'khor la rdzogs pa/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus padma thod 'phreng la/ /deng nas byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /'gro rnams srid pa'i rgya mtsho las bsgral phyir/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje rigs 'dzin tshe dbang rtsal/ /rtag tu bsnyen cing mchod bstod gsol 'debs pa'i/ /zab lam rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bya/ /'khor 'das chos kun mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang / /rdo rje'i sa gzhir ra ba drwa gur dang / /bla bre me dpung 'bar ba'i srung 'khor nang / /rin chen zur brgyad gzhal yas khang gi dbus/ /(49ba)padma nyi ma zla ba brtsegs pa'i steng / /bdag nyid dbang chen rta mgrin sku mdog dmar/ /phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'phyar/ /g.yon pa thod khrag 'dzin pas yum la 'khrud/ /dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang khus rta skad 'tsher/ /dur khrod chas brgyad rus rgyan sprul gyis spras/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs dor stabs bzhugs/ /pang du phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin/ /yab kyi mgul 'gyud dur khrod rus pas mtshan/ /spyi bo'i gtsug nas phag skad ngur sgra sgrog /zhabs g.yon yab 'khyud g.yas pa gdan la brkyangs/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /spyi gtsug pad sdong nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng / /rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / gnyis med ma hā gu ru padma 'byung / /sku mdog dkar dmar gzi 'od rab 'bar ba/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir cung zad khro nyams can/ /phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje thugs dang 'dzin/ /g.yon pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i ka pā la/ /kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum sku yi g.yon phyogs brten/ /sngags pa'i cha lugs mthing nag gsang gos can/ /rab byung na bza' chos gos pa tra ris/ /rgyal po'i cha byad zab chen ber smug gsol/ sha ba'i mnyen zhu padma'i 'dab ldan la/ /rgod sgro dar sna rdo rje nyi zlas spras/ /zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje'i skyil mo krung / /g.yas na manda ra ba mkha' 'gro'i tshul/ /dkar mdzes bcu drug lon pa sgeg mo'i gzugs/ /dbu skra thor tshugs rin chen — //8—

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdabrog zhu gyon/ /rna cha mgul rgyan gdu bu do shal phreng / /'jam mnyen dar gyi stod g.yogs smad sham mdzes/ /g.yon pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i ka pā la/ /g.yas pa mtheb sin phud gtang phyag rgya can/ /g.yon na jo mo mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal/ /mthon mthing dbu skra'i thor cog lhag par bcings mu tig (50na)g.yu tshom phra yis spras pa'i thod/ /rin chen gser gyi thur mas rnam par spras/ /nor bu'i rna rgyan dkar dmar rin chen shal/ /'ja' tshon lta bur bkra ba'i na bzas mdzes/ /bdud rtsis gang ba'i dngul dkar snod bzang 'dzin/ /steng na kun bzang rigs lnga rdo rje sems/ /dga' rab rdo rje rigs gsum sprul pa'i sku/ rgyal po dza dang ring chas rgyal 'byor pa'i dbang/ khyu sidha bi mā la mi tra/ /dgongasabargyud brda brgyud rigs 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs dang phyogs bzhin burnya badzra dang / ratna padma dmi thod phreng rtsal/ /rin chen rus pa dpa' bo'i rgyan gyis spras/ /rang snang rigs kyi yum dang mnyam par sbyor/ /de yi phyi rim padma 'dab brgyad la/ /padma 'byung gnas padma saṃ bha wa/ /blo ldan mchog sred padma rgyal po dang / /nyi ma 'od zer shākya seng ge'i zhabs/ /seng ge sgra sgrog rdo rje gro bo lod/ /de'i phyi 'dab brgyad steng la hūṃ ka ra/ /dha na saṃ spro 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dpal/ /rdo rje chos dang nā gā rdzu na'i zhabs/ /rdo bu gu spo tsa dru pra ha sti/ /shinti ga rba rgya gar rigs 'dzin brgyad/ /de'i phyi 'dab mar gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying / /'brog mi dpal ye gnubs chen sangs rgyas dang / /khri srong lde'u btsan ngan lam rgyal ba mchog /rlangs chen dpal seng jo mo mkhar chen bza'/ /lo chen bee ro bod kyi grub chen brgyad/ /de yi phyi rim pad 'dab bco brgyad la/ /g.yu sgra snying po dzñā na ku mā ra/ /rdo rje bdud 'joms sngags pa ye shes dbyangs/ /lha dpal rnam snang ye shes dpal dbang phyug /ldan ma rtse mang ska ba dpal brtsegs zhabs/ khri1da bu dpal seng rgyal ba'i blo gros dang / khye'u chung lo dran pa nam mkha'i mtshan/ /'o bran dbang phyug rma thog rin po che/ /lha lung dpal rdor lang 'gro dkon mchog 'byung / /rgyal ba byang chub rje (50ba tsher bangs nyi shu lnga/ de'i phyir 'dab mar nyang ral chos kyi dbang / /rgod kyi ldem phru yar rje skyon gling / /tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gling pa bcu gcig dang / /— //9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshedri med rnam gsum padma dbang rgyal mtshan/ /gnam lcags me 'bar bkra shis stobs rgyal sogs/ /sprul pa'i gter ston brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyis/ /nyer mtshon gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma'i tshogs/ /'og tu sgrub sde chen po brgyad kyi lha/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha gter srung tshogs/ /phyogs bcur ging chen pho nyas bdud dpung skrod/ /de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ yig las/ /'od 'phros padma 'od kyi gzhal las nas/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ/ /dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la/ /zhes sogs tshig bdun gsol 'debs bdun nam gsum gang rung brjod/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i spyan snga mā /rin chen snod du gtams pa'i mchod yon dang / /chu dang thang skyes me tog sna tshogs pa/ /tsandan sman spos sbyar ba'i dud sprin 'khrigs/ /nyi zla nor bu rtsi mar sgron me sbar/ /thugs mar byug pa dri yi chu rgyun sbreng / /phun tshogs ro brgya 'da' ba'i bza' bca' btung / /rgyud mangs gling bu sil snyan rol mo ldir/ rtsa brgyad yan lag stong las sbyar ba'i sman/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ldan ba dzi ta/ /bsgral dang rang byung rakta'i rba klong zhabrug /'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs mchod dam pa yis/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i thugs dam bskang / mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags sor chud mthun pa'i dngosagrub stsol/ /mtsho skyes mjes sku mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /drug cu'i gsung gis gdul bya'i re ba skong / /chags thogs med thugs shes bya kun mkhyen pa/ /phyon sangs rgyas gnyis par gsol (51na)ba 'debs/ /zab pa gter dang rnam dag bka' ma'i rgyun/ /chad med stsol ba'i brgyud pa drug ldan gyi/ /rgya bod mkhas dang grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin/ /rin chen 'phreng ltar byon la gsol 'debs/ /khyad par khyod sku mig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ /theg mchog chos sgra rna ba'i dbang por btag /rmad byung thugs rjes thang lhod med 'dzin pa'i/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan kun bzang khrag 'thung he ru ma'i/ /rnam par rol nas bdud sde'i snying ga la/ /rngam pa'i gar bsgyur sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha/ mkha' 'gro srung mar bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /le'u bdun ma sogs gsol 'debs — /2(/

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (banadang phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bzlas pa'i rim pa byed par spro na skabs 'dir bya/ /de ltar bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /dam can srung ma kun 'dus bdag nyid can/ /padma thod phreng rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis/ /dbyer med ro gcig rang gi rig pa'i rtsal/ /rang sems don gyi padma 'byung gnas la/ /mngon sum rang ngo 'phrod pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /mchod bstod bzlas pa gsol 'debs lhur blangs sogs/ /zab lam nyams su bstar ba'i dge tsho gos mthus/ /ka dag dbyings las lhun grub rang shar te/ /tshe 'dir snang bzhi'i lam bzang zad sar 'byol/ /phung po 'ja' lus zag med rdo rje'i sku/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon por mngon 'gyur shog /skal dman brtson 'grus zhan pas ma 'grub na/ /sgyu lus khang stong lta bur bor ba'i dus/ /rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' gsang lam du/ /skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du 'pho bar shog /gal te ma 'phos bar do shar gyur na/ /sgra 'od zer sogs 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang rnams/ /zhi dang khro bo'i rnam par yongs shes nas/ /ma pang bu rgyug bzhin du ngo 'phrod shog /yur (51ba)ba rked chad wa yis chu 'dren ltar/ /lam bzang mngon du gyur min srid 'khyams kyis/ /skye bar theg mchog bsgrub pa'i dal 'byor gyi/ /lus rten rgyun chad med par 'thob par shog /der yang mkha' la rigs 'dzan gral ma zhig /'og tu dkyil 'khor thig tshon bkrag ma yal/ /bar du mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma 'ams pa'i/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon dam pas rjes 'dzin shog /yang srid kun tu tshe ring nad med cing / /dpal 'byor longs spyod mkho dgu'i 'byor ba sogs/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen ma lus pa/ 'bad pa med par lhun rgyas grub par shog /yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun tu rtsod ldan gyi/ /dus kyi chad pa nam yang mi 'byung zhing / /'gro ba thams cad phan dang bde ba la/ /spyod pa'i rdzogs ldan rtse dga' dgod par shog /khyad par kha bas bskor ba'i bod yul 'dir/ /mi phyugs nad rims 'khrug rtsod skya mug sogs/ dkar min 'bras bu'i ming yang mi grags cing / /bde skyid lha yi dpal la 'gran nus shog /dri med rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen dar/ de 'dzin dam pa'i tshogs rnams zhabs pad brtan/ /mdo sngags 'dus pa'i sde rnams 'phel zhing rgyas/ /chos spyod /2/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang ble bzang rgya mcho re gsung 'bum/ 6shernam bcu'i bya ba mthar phyin shog /sa spyod rgyal po'i sku tshe chab srid rgyas/ /rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing phrag par lci/ /mtha' bzhi'i las sgo mtha' dag ngang gis 'du/ /smon pa'i re ba myur du 'grub par shog /sgo gsum 'bad pa'i legs byas gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /lhag bsam ral pa'i lam gsum las babs pa/ /mar gyur lus can byang chen chu gter klong / /ches cher rgyas pa'i rgyu ru ro gcig bsngo/ /de ltar bla ma'i spyi mgrin snying lte ba'i/ /oṃ dkar a dmar hūṃ mthing hrīḥm las/ /'od zer dkar dmar mthing dang 'ja' tshon byung / /rang gi gnas bzhi so sor (52na)thim pa yis/ /bum gsang shes rab rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob/ /sdig sgrib nyes lhung ma lus byang zhing dag /bskyed rim gtum mo pho nya rdzogs pa che/ /sgom par legs dbang sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /slob dpon chen po padma'i thugs kur bsdus/ /de yang 'od zhu spyi gtsug nas thim pas sems dang dbyer med bde stong zung 'jug gyur/ /dran pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i gdung ba kun/ /sel mdzad rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bkra shas shag /dngos grub ma lus char ltar 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bkra shis shog /yid srubs sder bcas thal bar rlog mdzad pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs kyis/ /phyogs dus kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dpal skyon sangs rgyas gnyis pa dang rang gang mos kyi bla ma dbyer med du byed pa'i rnal 'byor la brten nas mchod bstod gsol 'debs smon lam bkra shis dang bcas tshang ba 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes 'phan yul snga ba rta dpon rnam 'joms kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /srid dang zhi ba'i legs tshogs ma lus pa'i/ /'byung gnas zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor la/ /brten nas gsag sbyang ji ltar bya ba'i chul/ /rgyun du skyong bde'i nyams len 'di ltar ro/ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma sogs skyabs sems rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du btang ba'i nyams len dngos la/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badzra su bhā wa ātpako ྅hi/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs — /dpe

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing /rngams rgya ra zo 'i byen rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdapa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge (52ba〉nya po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du dkon mchog ma lus pa 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang sku mdog ind+ra nī la ltar sngo ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kur bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs lhag ma dpung pa'i thad du gsil bur 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/mgul rgyan/ se mo do/ 'og pag /phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub sogs rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras shing /lha rdzas kyi stod g.yogs dang pañtsa li ga'i sham thabs can/ phung po lnga rigs lnga/ 'byung ba lnga yum lnga/ spyan sogs sems dpa' brgyad/ phyag ngar sogs khro bo bcu ste/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i bdag nyid du bzhugs pa'am/ yang na bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can chos gos gsum dang ldan zhing g.yas rdo rje thugs ka dang / g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa sogs gang mos su gsal btab pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par a'i thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ rgyud sdebazhi'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro /chos skyong srung ma sogs skyabs gnas kyi yul du gyur to cog thams cad badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par mos/ gsag sbyang gi gtso bo yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni/ bye ba phrag brgyar yongs sprul bdag lus kyis/ /mgon po sras dang bcas pa ma lus par/ /mi phyed dad pa'i shugs kyis rab drangs nas/ /yan lag lnga yis btud de phyag bgyi'o/ /lus rer mgo bo mgrin lce grangs med du/ /sprul nas mchog gsum dam pa'i yon tan la/ /ches cher rab bsngags (53na)snyan pa'i glu dbyangs su/ /blangs te brjod pa rnam dag tshig gis bstod/ /mgon po nyes skyon kun zad yon tan rnams/ /yongs rdzogs mdzad par thos bsam goms 'dris kyis/ /nges rnyed dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brangs ba'i/ dkar phyogs zla 'drar 'phel ba'i dad pas btud/ zhal dkar beeḍūr pad rā ga gser sbyangs kyi/ /lhun po gling bzhi gling phran rin chen ri/ /yongs 'du sa — /23

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebartol 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba/ /ma rmos lo tog rgyal srid rin chen bdun/ /bum bzang sgeg sogs brgyad kyis rab spel ba'i/ /me tog 'phreng brgyus chun pos lo ma dang / /sman spos phye ma phur ma bdug mchog dri/ /man shel rtsi bcud 'bru mar snang ba'i gter/ /khrus dang byug pa'i sman chab rdzing bur 'khyil/ /lha mi'i bza' btung ro mchog brgya phrag ldan/ /mgrin pa'i dril 'brol dbyangs dang sil snyan sgra/ /mdzes sdug gar gyi 'gyur ba pha mtha' yas/ /nyi zla gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor mchod pa'i sprin phung rnams/ /rang rang blo yi nus pa de nyid kyis/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du sprul nas 'bul/ /mtha' med skye bar bsags sdig rjes dpag dang / /tshe 'dir mngon sum nyams su myong ba yi/ /nag po'i las rnams khong par song ba'i dug /ji bzhin bcos min snying nas 'gyod sems dang / /sred med changs pa lha dbang 'khor los sgyur/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor thob pa'i khe spogs mthong / /gnyis pa'i srog la bab pa'i nyen gyur kyang / /dkar min las la snying nas sdom sems kyis/ /rten gyi mchog gyur dkon mchog rnam gsum drung / /bcos min snying nas sdig ltung ma lus bshags/ /'dag byed rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba'i las/ /rang gi ji tsam nus pa bsgrub par bya/ /rnam 'dren (53ba〉spring dang rtogs pa'i yon tan dang / /rlabs chen rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa nas/ /zan changs gcig gtong mtha' rten dkar po'i las/ /mchog dman kun gyi dge la bdag yi rang / /sangs rgyas che 'bring byang sems nyan thos kyi/ /gdul bya'i khams dang dbang po dang 'tsham pa/ /sna tshogs theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /nam yang chad pa med par skor bar bskul/ /nam mkha' bzhin du pha mtha' rnyed dka' ba'i/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba'i ma rgan 'gro/ /'dren phyir bya ba yul gyi 'phrin las rgyun/ /chad min mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /mdor na lus ngag yid kyis gang bsags pa'i/ /bsod nams byas pa'i phung po ci mchos pa/ /yid can mtha' dag mi gnas myang 'das kyi/ /lam bzang mngon du byed pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /bdag sogs deng nas mi khom gnas brgyad sogs/ /log pa'i srid pa nam yang mi 'dzin cing / /ma/tho — /24

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ khobaderis yon tan bdun gyi rgyan ldan pa'i/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang 'thob par shog /ltar snang bshes min yang dag yongs 'dzin gyis/ /rjes bzung tshul khrims gtsang ma'i zhing sa la/ /theg chen rigs kyi sa bon yongs btab nas/ /smin grol gdams pa'i myu gu smin par shog /gnas skabs su yang sum rtsen bdag po dang / /mtshungs pa'i tshe ring stobs 'byor longs spyod rgyas/ /'bangs 'bor gnyen 'dun rtsa lag bcas pa rnams/ /phan tshun mnyes gshin byams ldan bde bar lha rdzog /zas gtsang sras kyi ring lugs mtha' dag dang / /khyad par chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa'i/ /bstan pa bstan 'dzin 'dus sde bcas pa yis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can ma lus khyab par shog /dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / /rten cing 'brel 'byung slu med bden pa'i mthus/ /bdag (54na)gis smon lam ji ltar btab pa kun/ /bsam pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub par shog /de nas bla ma'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim can dang cig car du byung / bdag gi gnas gsum du thim pas bum gsang shes rab ye shes tshig dbang dang bcas pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ chos sku longs sku ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du gyur par mos/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur par bsams nas cung zad mnyam par bzhag /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /zhes sogs kyi smon lam dang bkra shis kyi tshags bcad ci rigs pa bya'o/ /de ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten pa'i yan lag bdun pa smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni rang stobs kyi dbang phyug a pa las kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes gzugs/ /zur phud lnga ldan rgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /bla ma mchog dang dngos po gcig lta ba'i/ /rnal 'byor gsol 'debs rim pa 'di ltar ro/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar byas nas dngos gzhi'i rim pa la/ shu n+ya 'a stong par sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las — /25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sherang gi spyi bor seng shes bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri padma dang nyi ma zla ba'i gdan la drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rnam pa can sku mdog gser bco ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mtheb srin gyis utpa la'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan g.yas g.yon gyi thad kur bye ba shes rab kyi ral gri dang stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs (54ba)bam gyis mtshan pa rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can zhi zhing 'dzum pa ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ma'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ sa gnyis su med par bstim/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /zhes sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa rgyas par 'bul/ gang drin ma/ gzhon nu'i cha lugs ma rang gang mos kyi bla ma'i gsol 'debs sogs rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar te gsol ba gdab/ bla ma'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim can dang cig car du byung ste rang gi gnas so sor thim pas dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob par mos nas rang sems dang bla ma ngo bo dbyer med du byas pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag /mthar dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di'ang zhing skyong nang sos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lta bu'i skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla'i steng / /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / /dam can srung ma la sogs skyabs gnas kun/ /ma lus gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma chos gos gsum ldan pa'i/ /rab byung cha byad paṇa zhwa gser mdog gsol/ /chos 'chad glegs bam 'dzin zhing skyil krung bzhugs/ /ji snyed su dag sogs kyi yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so bdag byin rlobs/ /— /26

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bad(55na)dbang bzhi bskur la sku bzhi'i sa bon thob/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim can dang cig car du byung / rang gi gnas gsum du rim can dang cig car thim/ sgrib bzhi dag dbang bzhi thob/ sku bzhi'i sa bon thob pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag /de nas dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ bla mar rang gi spyi bor byon 'od du zhu nas thim pas/rang sems dang bla ma ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa na cung zad mnyam par bzhag /bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /zhes rang gang mos kyi bla ma la sbyar chog pa'i rnal 'byor 'khyer bde ba 'di ni sa skyong rgya ri ba ngag dbang dga' ldan rab brtan gyi gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal 'chang dpal ldan shākya'i gtso/ /lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan jo bo yab sras dang //thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal ba btsong kha pa/ /yan lag mchog gi pad mtshong rtag bzhunas shig /las ngan dbang gi sngon chad 'khor ba 'dir/ /mtha' med rigs drug skye ba'i srid gzung yang / /phun tshogs dge bas 'phangs pa'i dal ba'i rten/ /mi lus rin chen rnyed pa srid pa tsam/ /lus can spyi dang khyad par 'dzam gling mi/ /nges med dus kyi chad pa'i pho nya yis/ /lus dang longs spyod stobs wor kun bor te/ /zhi ba lhas/ rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing gi /bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar/ zhes pa dang mthun par mdo rgyud du ma las gsungs shing / /spyan snga pas dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba 'di bsam tsa na gnyid log long rang mi 'dug gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dbang med 'jig rten pha rol 'gro 'dis 'jigs/ zhi ba lhas/(55bskan mtshan sdod pa yod med pa ra/ /tshe 'di rtag tu god 'gyur cing / /snon pa gud na bod med na/ /bdag lta 'chi bar cis ma 'gyur/ /zhes dang glang thang pa sku gshegs khar dmyal bar skye ba'i smon lam btab pa dang / zhang ston chos bla gshegs khar mgur mthen pa ltar/ rab 'chi ba la brod 'bring mi 'jigs tha ma mi 'gyad pa thams cad mi rtag pa la thug go /dge dang sdig pa'i rgyu la longs spyod pa'o/ /dkar nag las kyi grib ma srid pa 'dir/ /phyi bzhin 'brangs pa'i bde dang gnas ngan len/ /ma 'dres so sor grub pa'i 'bras — /27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (/se 'di mchar/ /rdos drag bzod dka' yun rings sdug bsngal pa'i/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro'i skye gnas las/ mdo las/ dus kyi bsnyen te rgyal po 'gro 'gyur na/ /longs spyod 'dzad dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang / /skyes bu de ni gang dang gar 'gro bar/ /las rnams grab ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang / /zhes dang / rna ba bye ba nyi shu pa dang / dge 'dun bsrung gi rtogs brjod dang / 'ban gung rgyal gyi rten mchod la thal pa gtor ba dang / slob dpon jo btsun gyi bla ma'i dus mchod gcad pa dang snar thang pa'i gas chung grags rin gyi lo rgyus lta bu/ /ldog phyir rgyu 'bras tshul la nges rnyed nas/ /dge sdig blang dor ma 'dres spyod pa gces/ /mngon mtho'i bde ba 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal can/ /srid 'byor glog dang me 'obs dug sprul tshang / /nyes brgya'i gnas su shes nas gtan gyi bde/ /bshes spring las/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal 'id du gyur nas kyang / /las gyi dbang gi yang bran nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes dang 'phags pa ska khya yas/ /pha sha za bzhin ma la 'tshog /las sha ཾ dgra bo pang du bzung / /chung mas khyo yi rus pa 'cha'/ /'khor ba'i chos la skyo bskyes te zhes dang / /glang thang pa'i g.yu byi bas brkus pa'i lo rgyus ltar ro/ /zhi bde'i lam la gzhol te 'bad par rigs/ /rang nyid sngon chad ngan song gnas gsum du/ /mngon gyur mi bzad duḥkhas mnar ba dang / /bde 'gror dngos dang de'i rgyu bag la nyal/ /nyams su myong ba'i ngang tshul yang yang bsam/ /da ltar rang gi nyams su myong ba la/ /rjes su dpag te mar gyur 'gro (56na)ba kun/ /sdug bsngal bzod dkas mnar ba'i ngang tshul la/ /dmigs te bcos min snying rje chen po bskyed/ /des drangs smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /klu sgrub kyis/ bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'dir/ bla med byang chub thob 'dod na/ /de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ zhes pa ltar ro/ /pha rol phyin drug bsdu dngos rnam pa bzhi/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rlabs chen la/ /mi zhus brtson pa chen pos 'jug par bya/ /rlung phar 'gro ba dang mnyam du/ rang bde gtong zhing gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rnams/ /rlung chur rdub pa dang mnyam du/ len pa rlung la bskyon nas bslab bya zhing / /dgra gnyen bar mar chags snang rmongs skyes pa'i/ /'gro ba'i dug gsum 'joms pa'i smon lam bya/ /snod yul nyam nga zhing phongs pa/ bcud sems can ma rungs pa / ngan dang de 'bras rang thog tu babs pa 'a/ sdug bsngal kun/ rang nyid gces par bzung bdag 'jen/ las byung shes shing / /'khrul ba'i snang ba 'di kun btags tsam las/ /bden par rang — /28

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdabazhin gyi/ grub pa cung zad med par lta/ /sdug bsngal spong phyir mthun rkyen maṇḍal 'bul ba sogs/ tshogs bsags sgrib 'gal rkyen/ pa sbyangs stobs bzhi'i bshags pa/ /sdug bsngal lhag ma kun kyang smin pa'i grogs/ /'byung po de tsam mi nus na gtor ma sbyin bar chad mi byed par grogs 'chol/ la bcos dkar phyogs skyong rnams la/ /byang sems sgom pa'i mthun rkyen gsol ba gdab/ /byang chub de ring nas ma shi bar/ sgrub bo snyam pa'i 'phen pa dang / /yang yang / byang chub la goms sa bon bsod nams kyi/ tshogs gsag pa/ /nyes pa kun gyi gzhi yin pas /bden 'dzin sun dbyung byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral ba 'a/ smon lam btab (56ba)pa ste/ /stobs lnga'i chos dang yang yang sbyar bar bya/ /'chi tshe chags zhan thamatsho cad spangs smon lam btab/stong pa nyid kyi rtsis zin sgo nas bar dor byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyang ba'i 'phen pa btang / pa'i/ /spyod lam gzhogs g.yas phab la nyal te bde sdug gtong len spel mar sbyangs pa'i ngos/ /byang chub sems gnyis sgom pa'i mod nyid la/ /lus sems bral ba 'pho ba'i gdams pa mchog /sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i/chos kun bdag 'dzin gnyen por song ba dang go ba/ /rang la rang gis ma khrel rkyen ngan kun grogs su song nas/ /lam du 'khyer nus snya rtsal can yengs kyang rta las mi lhung bltar/ yeng bas kyang zhe sdang sogs/ grogs su song na sems rgyud 'byongs ba'i tshad/ /blang dor khyad gsod tho co'i spyod pa/ mngon mtshan chos dang 'jig rten kyi skyon brjod nas/gzhan smod spang / /kun la dag snang sbyong zhing rang rgyud la/ /gzhan 'brel ba dgos kyang gtso bor/ brtags te nyon mongs gang che thog mar sbyong / /'bras bu mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /dgra la khon 'dzin pha rol gyi lan du/ tshig rtsub gnod pa'i lan 'jal nus pa 'i dus byung tshe bya ba dang / /drag sngags sogs kyis/ lha 'dre gnad dbab g.yo sgyus/ rang nyes ga 'an la 'gel/ /gzhan phung ba'i dngos po rang la yong snyam pa lta bro'i/ rang skyid thabs su 'tshol mi bya/ /glo bur sdug bsngal byung na sems can thams cad la/ des mtshon nas/ /byang sems nan tar bsgom pa log gnon gnad/ /snga dro sems mchog sgom pa'i 'phen pa dang / /nyal khar nyin gyi spyod lam bzang ngan brtag /bshes gnyen mjal dang rang blo las su rung / /mthun rkyen 'dzom pa rgyu yi gtso bo ste/ /yon tan rtsa ba bla mar mos gus dang / /sems can rnams la phyogs med blo sbyang zhing / /— /2(1

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang ble bzang rgya ru/che spru gsung pa bum/ 6shekhyad par rang la 'gran par gyur pa dang / /dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas gnod byed dang / /sngon las dbang gis yid du mi 'ongs la/ /lhag par snying rje chen po (57na〉skom pa gnad/ /mas sgrub pa sogs kyi/mthun rkyen 'dzom dang ma 'dzom gang byung kyang / /thams cad sems gnyis sgo nas lam du 'khyer/ /gtan gyi bde ba gtso bor sgrub pa yis/ /'di phyi'i bde 'bras thams cad zhan gyi 'byung / /chos byed pa'i dka' ba'i sdug bsngal/ dang dgra 'dul gnyen skyong sdug bsngal dang / /chos la 'dun/ dang tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor la 'dun pa'o/ /chos kyi ro myang ba dang 'jig rten bde ba'i ro myangs dang / /sdig pa byed par chos phyir dka' spyad byed/ /chos la sbyangs dang tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor che thabs dang / /'bar 'das kyi dge dang dgra bo nyams la dga' ba rnams dper na chos kyi phyogs rnams ma 'dod la de'i cig shos rnams 'dod pa lta bu ga la'o/ /rim bzhin bzod 'dun ro myang snying rje dang / nya sems dga' ba'i go log drug yin no/ /nyams len nges shes bskyed nas rgyun du bsgom/ /yul la brten nas dug gsum skye mi skye/ /brtags te skye na de yi gnyen por bsgom/ /gzhan la/ phan btags rang gi /mkhas btsun thos bsam sgom pa dang / /dka' spyad la brten pa'i bya ba byas pa la/g.yin la yus mi bya/ /cung zad tsam la khro dga'i rnam 'gyur dang / /phan btags pa la snyan pa'i grags pa dang / /lan dang rnam par smin la mi re ba/ /thams cad byang chub lam la bsgyur bar bya/ /mdor na snyigs ma lnga bdo mthun rkyen nyung / /mi mthun 'gal rkyen du mas gtses dus 'dir/ /bde sdug thams cad lam du rab blangs nas/ /dug la sman du gyur pa lam gyi mchog /de ltar gser gling pa dang a ti shas/ /man ngag snying po rang sems 'dul ba'i tshul/ /ha cang tshig gi spros pa ma yin la/ /snyan ngag tshig rgyan med pa'i go bde zhig /dgos zhes mdo khams tre ho'i yul gru nas/ /dpon tshang dka' bcu ngag dbang (57ba)phun tshogs kyis/ /bskul tshe za hor bande snyoms las pas/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos sde chen por sbyar/ /spyi bor seng khri padma nyi ma'i steng / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa/ /ngur smrig gar gyis rnam par rol pa la/ /bye ba phrag brgyar lus sprul gus phyag 'tshal/ /dngos — /3/ —

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdabashams yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin phung spro/ /stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sdig lhung ma lus bshags/ /rang gzhan kun gyi dge la snying nas rang / /zab dang rgya che'i chos 'khor skor bar bskul/ /'og min zhing gi mgon ltar rtag bzhugs gsol/ /dge ba ma lus byang chub chen por bsngo/ /mgon khyod thugs rjes rtag tu bdag byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di ni pho brang chen po pe cing gi nye 'dabs su lha khang ser po'i bla ma bsam blo er te ni chos rjes dmigs brtse ma dang 'brel ba'i rgyun gyi kha ton byed rgyu zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /blo ldan skal bzang don gnyis grub pa'i gzings/ /rab bskyod mngon mtho nges legs nor gling du/ /'khrid mdzad dam pa'i chos kyi ded dpon che/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'gro ba'i mgon por 'dud/ /gang gi zhal lung ma dros mtsho chen las/ /nyer 'das snyan brgyud dza hu yi bu mo/ /mas ldan lam gsum dag tu legs 'bab pa/ /chos phung chu gter dbus su ro gcig mnyam/ /de phyir sngon chad yi ger ma 'khod pa'i/ /zab zab grags pa'i dbyar gyi rnga gsang sgra/ /snying las chung ngur bgyid 'dod rma bya rnams/ /dga' ba'i sgro gshog zlum por bsgyur la long / de'ang sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i man ngag mtha' dag ma tshang ba med pa nyams su len pa'i dben sa snyan brgyud gsung sgros 'khrul med ltar bkod pas/ /yid du 'ong ba'i (58na)gnas su dkon mchog gi rten bkram/ ci 'byor ba'i mchod gtor bshams/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas sems kyi kun slong nyon mongs pa dang 'di phyi'i bde 'bras tsam don gnyer gyi blo yod med brtag pa bka' brgyud rin po che 'di khyad chos yin gsung / /gal te 'dug na rtog pa de dag bsal la sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon gyi sgros snying du/ bde chen ngang nas rang nyid bla ma lha/ /gang der gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer tshogs/ /phyogs bcur 'phros pas snod bcud byin brlabs pas/ /dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig yon tan gyi/ /bkod pa'i khyad par phun sum tshogs par gyur/ /rab dkar dge sems chen po'i rang nyid nas/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam ma rgan sems can rnams/ /deng — /3/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mche'i gsung 'bum/ 6shenas ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /na mo gu ru we/na mo buddhā ya/ /na mo dharmā ya/ na mo sa ṅgā ya/ ma sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni bla ma ltar gyur nas/ /sems can thams cad bla ma lha'i/ /go 'phang mchog la 'god par bya/ /ma sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis tshe 'di nyid la myur bar myur bar gdod ma'i sangs rgyas bla ma lha'i go 'phang mngon du byas nas ma sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral/ bde chen sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de'i phyir du lam zab mo bla ma lha'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan grangs mang po'i bar du brjod nas rgyud 'dres par bya'o/ /mchod gtor rnams gsang bde 'jigs gsum lta bu'i rgyud sde dang 'brel bar byin gyis brlabs/ dngos gzhi la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dpag bsam gyi shing gi sdong po'i steng du padma bdun brtsegs kyi rnam pa rgya khyon dang 'dab ma'i grangs mas rim nas je chung je nyung du song ba'i steng ma (58ba)pad 'dab bzhi pa'i lte bar seng khri padma nyi zla'i gdan la rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po sku'i dbyibs yongs grags ltar la/ de'i thugs gar bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ de'i thugs gar rdo rje 'chang bsgom/ yang na rje btsun bcong kha pa'i tshab la rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma gang yin kyang sgom srol yod gsung / shar gyi 'dab ma la gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang / der ma zad 'jam rdor sogs gsang 'dus su gtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gang 'dod bsgom/ des mtshon pa'i bde mchog bsgom pa'i 'dab mar ma rgyud kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gang dgos bsgoms bzhin rnams la'ang rigs pa'i 'phrul shes pa byed gsung / lha'i 'dab mar 'khor lo sdom pa/ nub kyi 'dab mar rdo rje 'jigs byed/ byang gi 'dab mar dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams gsal 'debs/ de'i phyi rim 'dab ma gnyis pa la mdun nas brtsams te kun rig sogs rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gang 'dod bskyed pa'i 'dab ma'i kha grangs dkyil 'khor tsam yod dang bstun chog pas nges pa med/ de'i phyi rim gyi 'dab ma gsum par rnam snang mngon byang sogs spyod rgyud/ de'i phyi rim 'dab ma bzhi par dam tshig gsum bkod sogs — /32

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdabya rgyud/ de'i phyi'i 'dab ma lnga par byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun/ de'i phyi rim 'dab ma drug par nyan rang gi dge 'dun/ de'i phyi'i 'dab ma bdun pa'i shar gyi pad 'dab la myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa 'khor bcas/ de'i g.yas su mgon po gdong bzhi pa/ lho'i 'dab ma la mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ nub kyi 'dab ma la gur gyi mgon po/ /byang gi 'dab ma la rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ shar lho'i 'dab ma la las gshin phyi sgrub bam nang sgrub gang rung / lho nub kyi 'dab ma la lha mo dud pa'i sol can/ nub byang gi 'dab ma la dpal ldan dmag zor ma/(59na)byang shar gyi 'dab ma la ma gcig dpal gyi lha mo/ der ma zad rang gang 'dod pa'i chos skyong ci yod pad 'dab grangs mang du btang nas bsgom mchog gsung / rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dbu gtsug na rgya chen spyod brgyud/ zab mo lta brgyud/ nyams len byin rlabs brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang yi dam chos skyong so so'i thad du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams bsgom gsung / de ltar gsal ba'i bla ma lha'i tshogs kyis gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis rang gi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs spyan drangs par bsams la/ ma lus sems can ma sogs tshigs bcad ci rigs brjod cing dzaḥ/ baṃ ho sa gnyis med du bstim/ khrus gsol spro na spyi ltar bya/ sangs rgyas 'dus sku sogs bla ma spyi'i bstod pa ci rigs pa brjod rjes/ sgos kyi brgyud 'debs/ bde chen mgon po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /grags pa rgyal mtshan dar ma rin chen dang / /'jam dpal rgya mtsho dge legs dpal bzang sogs/ /rgyal ba yab sras rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ ta shes rab seng ge dge 'dun grub pa dang / /chos kyi rgyal mtshan blo gros sbas pa dang / /chos kyi rdo rje skyabs mchog dpal la sogs/ /dga' ldan mkhas grub rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal ba dben sa pa/ /rgyal tshab dam pa sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /bstan pa'i sgron me gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de'ang blo ka dang po gnyis rje sangs rgyas ye shes dang phyi ma paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung yin na'ang / /dge lugs kyi bla ma rags rim bsdus pa'i ngo mtshar brgyud par snang / /— /33—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'adi ga'i brgyud pa/ rdo rje 'chang / thub dkar/ 'jam dbyangs/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ rje btsun btsong kha pa/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal (59ba)rgya mtsho/ ba so chos rgyal ba/ grub chen chos rdo rje/ rje blo bzang don grub/ bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes/ de la paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal pos gsan zhing / nye brgyud dben sa pa blo bzang don grub kyis rgyal ba btsong kha par dag snang gi tshul du gsan par bzhed/ mchod pa rgyas par spro na gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i mchod phreng rnams len/bsdus par 'dod na maṇḍal phul rjes bzang po spyod pa'i yan lag bdun pa bya/ gnyen po stobs bzhi'i bshags pa dang sdom pa gsum gyi phyir bcos kyang byed gsung de nas gus pa chen pos/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan bzhugs la/ /bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs legs zhugs nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /da lta nyid du legs par stsal nas ni/ /bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin brlabs nas/ /'gro kun bde chen gnas la 'god par shog /dngos grub kun 'byung thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / /dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ /dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /bdud dpung ma lus 'joms pa'i gsang ba'i bdag /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan blo bzang grags/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma sangs rgyas la/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs//rang gzhan smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes dben sa lugs kyi dmigs brtse ma thun mong ma yin pa dang thun mong ba yongs grags kyi dmigs brtse ma'i gsol 'debs mang du brjod pas bla ma lha'i sku las byung ba'i 'od zer rang la phog pas sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dag /bdud rtsi dang 'od zer gyis lus gang / tshe bsod nams dpal 'byor nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems stong nyid rtogs (60na)pa'i shes rab rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa rnams rgyud la skyes par bsams bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje sangs rgyas rin chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma — /34

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mche'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdasprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma dgos 'dod kun 'byung la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid bla ma rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes mang du brjod/ deng nas brtsams te tshe rabs kun tu bdag zhes pa nas bzung ste/ 'gro ba'i 'dren pa 'gyid par byin gyis rlobs kyi bar sa gsum ma ltar brjod/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i khrid dmigs nyams su len na/ skabs 'dir bya gsung / dga' ldan phyag chen du grags pa 'di'i le lag yin par mdzad/ dbang bzhi len pa ni/ maṇḍal phul/ gang drin ma dang kun mkhyen ye shes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs mas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa bzung / rigs lnga'i sdom gzung dkyus ltar bya/ bla ma lha'i tshogs rnams kyis bdag la da lta nyid du dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las sprul pa'i rang 'dra'i ye shes pa phyag na bum pa sogs thogs pa 'od zer dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa byung nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shrī snri zhes dbang bskur ba'i thog ma med pa nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sa bon dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs/ de thams cad rang gi lus la thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang / lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i snang zhen gyi dri ma spangs/ bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can (60ba〉bzhag par bsam/ yang bla ma lha'i tshogs thams cad yum dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams dang sku'i cha shas las byang sems dkar dmar 'od zer dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa byung nas rang gis kha dang lus gyi cha thams cad la thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sa bon dang bcas pa sbyangs/bde ba chen po rgyud la skyes/ ngag tha mal du 'dzin pa'i snang zhen gyi dri ma sbyangs/ sgyu lus sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi longs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag par bsam/ yang bla ma lha'i tshogs rnams kyi sku las sprul ba'i ye shes lha mo'i tshogs dpag tu med par — /35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebyung nas/ rang dang rang gi lha mo la thim/ rang rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs nas lhan skyes kyi bde ba khyad par can dang bde ba des stong pa nges pa'i bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thog med nas yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sa bon dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs/ yid tha mal du zhen pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ 'od gsal sgom pa la dbang bar byas/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag par bsam mo/ /yang bla ma lha'i tshogs thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang sku'i cha shas las oṃ ā: bdud rtsi 'od zer dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa byung nas rang gi lus kyi cha thams cad la thim pas dbang bzhi thob/ thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sa bon dang bcas pa dang khyad par shes sgrib sa bon dang bcas pa sbyangs/ bden gnyis dbyer med kyi rdzogs rim sgom pa la dbang bar byas/ lus ngag yid gsum tha mal du 'dzin pa'i snang chen gyi dri ma thams cad sbyangs nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zung 'jug (61na)rdo rje'i sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag par bsam/ dbang rgyas par spro na/ gang gi padma 'dab bdun gyi lha tshogs kyi phyi rol tu gzhal yas khang rdo rje me ri sogs gang rung bsgom zhing rdul tshon ras bris tshem bu'i dkyil 'khor gang rung la brten gsang 'dus lta bu'i dkyil chog kha spos nas dbang yongs rdzogs bskur ba dang len pa sogs byas chog gsung yang 'brug lugs kyi shan shor ba 'dra/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyi sdom gsum dang mkhas grub rin po che'i sdom gsum rnam gzhag ltar na 'phags bod kyi paṇa grub rtsod med yongs grags kyi bzhed lugs dang mi 'brel ba'i the tshom gyi gzhir snang ngo / /dbang blangs rjes/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi khrid kyi nyams len yang blo'i babs dang bstun nas bya/ rang lus la brten nas tshogos gsog pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi 'og tu gdon bgegs sogs rigs drug gi sems can rnams gsal btab/ bla ma lha'i tshogs rnams kyis bdag gi lus 'di la brten nas tshogs rgya chen po gsog par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de — /36

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhi ge cher sa rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdarnams kyis oṃ ā hūṃ brjod pa la brten mi mgo'i skyed bu ri rab tsam pa gsum byung par mos/rang sems bla ma'am yi dam gyi rnam par spyi bo nas thon/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i mkha' 'gro ma gri gug thogs pas thod pa phyog nas skyed bu'i khar btsugs/ lus thams cad gtubs nas blug par mdun bskyed byin gyis brlabs/ mkha' 'gro ma thod pa thogs pas bcus te mchod yul rnams la 'bul/ rigs drug la byin pas tshogs gnyis rdzogaba'i par bsam/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ phyi sgrub la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥgu ru su ma ti kirti hūṃ/ yang na rtsa ba'i bla ma su yin gyi mtshan sngags brjod/ nang sgrub mu ni/ gsang sgrub badzra dhika /gsang 'dus sogs yi (61ba)dam chos skyong rnams kyi bzlas pa so so'i skabs nas byung ba bzhin bya/ bkang gso dang gtor 'bul ni/ thog mar bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor dang sgrib sel gyi man ngag bzhin yig brgya nyer gcig tsam bzlas/chos skyong so so'i bshags pa'am bsdu na phyag drug pa'i bshags pa 'don/ bkang rdzas byin gyis brlabs/ phyag drug pa'i bkang ba la chos skyong g.yin rnams bkang gral tu bcug pa'am spro na so so'i bkang ba gtong / long yod cing spro ba 'dod na chos skyong rnams kyi bzlas pa 'dir bya dgos pas de'i sngon du mgon po gnad 'beb kyi rnal 'byor bsgom/ gtor ma gzhus bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas so so'i sngags kyis dbul zhing nang mchod kyang 'bul/ bstod pa ci rigs pa bya/rgyun 'khyer bsdus par 'dod na gtor bsngo tsam gyis mthus/ bar chad zhi ba'i don du drug cu pa bsdus pa'ang skabs 'dir bsngo rung gsung / lcags mkhar zur bcu drug pa'ang 'di'i cha lag tu bzhed rung rtsa tshig zha lu pa legs rgyan gyis mdzad cing bod snga rabs pa la'ang grags pas dpyad gzhir snang / 'dod don la gsol ba gdab cing smon lam bya/ nyer bsdu ni/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang theg pa gsum gyi dge 'dun/ rgyud sde phyi ma gsum gyi lha rnams 'od du zhu nas gtso bo la thim/ 'dus pa sogs bla med kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi dang chos skyong srung ma rnams bdag lus la brtan par bzhugs su gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas rang lus rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan du gsal bar byon — /37

rgya pa dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shete/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis la 'dus pa lha so gnyis/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug la bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis/ snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad la 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa gnyis la dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha drug brgya so bzhi/ gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'dab so gnyis la chos skyong srung ma rnams (62na)'god/ lha dang rtsa grangs nang mthun kyang khrom tshogs lta bu yin nam snyam zhal shes zur pa mi snang/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /ches sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas rang nyid rdo rje 'chang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur pa'i sku las bdud rtsi dang 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ de thams cad rdo rje 'chang du gyur pa rang nyid la thim par bsam/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi rim gnyis kyi smon lam dang shis brjod rgyas par bya'o/ /de ltar sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ /stan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa'i tshul/ /snyan brgyud ri bong 'dzin pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /gdul bya'i snying gi kunda ba 'ad par shog /ces bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dbyer med du sgrub pa'i yi ge 'di ni/ shing rta lo g.yas ru gtsang gi rgyal khams su bgrod pa'i tshe paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal lung las ji ltar thos pa bzhin brjed byang du bkod de spyan sngar phab nas zhus dag pa'i reg zig gcig yod par nye char skyid shod chos rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis nan chen pos bskul ba la brten nas rang bzo spangs te za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge'i byed po dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom par 'dod pas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum gyis rgyud dag par byas/ swā bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng shes btegs pa'i khri/ /padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du/ /ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid/ /rnam pa khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /sku mdog mthing kha iṇḍa ni la'i mdangs/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar longs sku'i cha lugs can/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /rang snang shes rab — /38

bla ma'i rnal 'byar zhing /bams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdam (62ba)dang mnyam par sbyor/ /sku la de bzhin gshegs pa yab dang yum/ /sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo rdzogs/ /'od 'phros nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid can/ /de yi dpral bar oṃ dkar mgrin pa'i dbus/ /oṃ dmar thugs shar hūṃ mthing gis mtshan pa'i/ /thugs ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros bla ma dang / /rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rang rgyal nyan thos tshogs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams/ thogs pa med pa badzra sa mā dza/ /dam chos ye shes gnyis su med pa yi/ /skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ /brgya phrag lus sprul grangs med phyag 'tshal zhing / /lha mi'i 'byor ba phung por spungs nas mchod/ /sngon bsags phra rags sdig pa snying nas bshags/ /dge tshogs bsags pa kun la rjes su rang / /mgon po bskal bar mya ngan mi 'dar bskul/ /theg gsum chos kyi 'gro kun smin grol gsol/ /rang gzhan rnams kyis chos dkar ci bsags pa/ /mtha' yas sems can yongs kyi don du bsngo/ /rang gang mos pa'i bla ma su yin gyi gsol 'debs kyi tshig dang bstun gsol ba phur tshugs su btab rjes/ /bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar 'phros/ /rang gi dpral bar thim pas lus sgrib dag /bum dbang gis smin sku yi dngos grub thob/ /mgrin pa'i ā las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ /rang gi mgrin par thim pas ngag sgrib dag /gsang dbang gis smin gsung gi dngos grub thob/ /thugs ma'i hūṃ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ /snying khar thim pas yid kyi sgrib pa dag zhar dbang gis smin thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ /slar yang 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ /cig car thim pas sgo gsum sgrib pa dag /tshig dbang gis smin dngos grub ma lus thob/ /skyabs gnas thams cad (63na)'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa la/ /snying khung rus pa'i dkyil nas gsol ba 'debs/ /lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pas 'od du zhu/ /'od sngon beeḍūr zhun ma ltar 'tsher pa/ /spyi bor thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs/ /rang gi sgo gsum ngo bo dbyer med gyur/ /zhes cung zad mnyam par bzhag nas/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma sogs bsngo — /3()

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shesmon bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang dpon mo tshe dbang rgyal mos rgyang ring po nas bskul ba ltar sdom brtson sde snod gsum pa za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /spyi bor seng khri padma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma zhwa ser cod paṇa 'dzin/ /ngur smig gos klubs chos 'chad glegs bam bsnams/ /skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /rang byung sgru tī lus kyi dkyil 'khor cher/ /bde chen longs spyod chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus/ /'jam dbyangs 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma yi dam rnam pa so so sa shar yang ngo bo gcig par rab shes pa'i/ /nges rnyed gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs bdag nyid la la jug mdzod/ /nad gdon bgegs rigs mi mthun phyogs su bzhi/ /tshe dpal bsod nams lung rtogs yon tan sogs/ /chos dang srid gyi legs tshogs ma lus pa/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun thugs rje dang / /mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i nus mthu'i stobs/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung bslu ba med pa yis/ /smon pa'i re ba ma lus skong bar shog /ces gar mi yon tan g.yung drung gi gdan sa chen po rdzing phyi (63ba)mkhan chen co ba chos rje tshul khrims dar rgyas bstan gzhung gi ched du byang phyogs hor gyi rgyal khams su 'deg par nye ba'i tshe rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs gsum mgon po dang dbyer med du gsol ba btab chog pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gsung gis bskul ba bzhin za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /snying dbus padma 'dab brgyad kha bye ba'i/ /snying tshil ze'u 'bru rab tu rgyas pa'i steng / /mi phyed dad pa'i nyi gzhen dkyil 'khor la/ /rang sems bla ma 'jam dbyangs dbyer med pa/ dhī khyiḥdamar ser ring cha tsheg drag can/ /yongs gyur zhal gcig phyag gnyis gur gum mdog /zhi nyid legs 'dzum nyams dang ldan pa'i zha kha/ /dbu skra bung ba lta bur gnag snum mdzes/ phyag gnyis ༷yis bzung bas glegs ral bteg /rin chen rus rgyan dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /rang 'dra'i dbyangs can lha mo sku la — /4//—

bla ma'i rnal 'byar zhing /bam/sa rgya ra tsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bda'akhril/ /yab yum rdo rje padma'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /thug bas kar pad steng rigs lnga yab yum gyi/ /snying dkyil zla nyir thugs srog sngags 'khor gyi/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'i nus pa las /'gro rnams mi shes rmongs pa'i gnyid las sad/ /bdag po blo gros snang ba ches cher gsal/ /'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa ma lus drung nas phyungs/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad thob/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun sgrol ba'i nus ldan gyur/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhī khyu: zhes ci nus su bzlas mthar/ bla ma yi dam ngo bo dbyer med la/ khugs drag gdung bas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /'di phyi bar do kun tu rjes bzung nas/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa 'di'ang u pa shing ngag dbang rin chen gyi bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi ban des sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong du 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /(64na)skyabs 'gro rgyas pa'am sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lta bu sngon du btang nas/ /swa bhā was sbyangs/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mtha' gnyis dang bral ba dbu ma'i lam rang bzhin gyi grub pas stong pa'i stong pa nyid kyi ngang nas/ snang stong sgyu ma tsam gyi rang tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri/ padma nyi zla'i steng du bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i rnam pa can zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar gsal zla ba lta bu la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ phyag gnyis chos 'khor gyi phyag rgyas utpa la'i yu ba nas bzung pa'i 'dab ma snyan g.yas g.yon gyi thad kur kha bye ba'i g.yas su mi shes rmongs pa'i drwa ba gcod pa'i shes rab kyi ral gri dang / g.yon na chos kun la de nyid gsal bar ston pa stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam can/gser sbyangs zhun ma byugs 'dra'i paṇa zhwa dang chos gos rnam gsum sogs rab tu byung ba la nye bar 'os pa'i rung mthun gyi gos kyis legs par mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i dbus su 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu glegs ral 'dzin pa/ mgrin pa — /4/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang snye bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yeshelongs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su 'jig rten dbang phyug sems nyid ngal gso g.yas padma dkar po dang g.yon gdan la brten pa/ thugs gar phyag na rdo rje g.yas utpal bzung ba'i steng na rdo rje dang g.yon pus steng na sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ gsum ga'ang zhi ba'i sku can zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang ldan pa ral pa thor tshugs su bcings shing dar dang rin po ches spras pa zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis pad zla'i stan la bzhugs pa'i dpral bar skyed/ mgrin par aX thugs gar hūṃ/(64ba)thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma sogs skyabs gnas kyi yul du gyur to cog thams cad oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ ma lus sams can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /zhes sogs blo ka gcig dang / oṃ gu ru de ba : buṅgā bu ddha sa twa she 6 pi ra ḍā ka dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra e hya he dzaḥ& baṃ ho: sa dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bsam de nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /ces sogs shlau ka gcig gis phyag bya/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /zhes sogs dang gong gi sngags sbyar ba'i mthar arnya pra twe tstsha swa hā/ de bzhin du/ pā rdu/ añtsa ma n-i/ badzra puspro nas shasta'i bar dang / rgyas par spro na 'dod yon lnga rgyal srid bdun sogs rgyud sde so so nas byung ba'i mchod pa'i rim pa sbyar/ maṇḍal tshom bu bdun ma'am bsdu na sa gzhi spos kyis ma dang rgya mtsho ma dang / bla ma spyi bye brag gi sgos bstod rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa dang gzhan yang / /tshogs gnyis mthu las rgyal rnams spangs rtogs kun/ /mnyam yang snying stobs mchog gi pad dkar bzhin/ /bsngags yul zas gtsang sras bstan 'dzin pa la/ /zla bral btsong kha pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i ring lugs tshogs/ /spel la blo ldan mkhas btsun bzang po'i gar/ /rgya chen rnam dpyod mtsho byung lha mo yis/ /legs rnyed bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /deng nas brtsams te yang srid thams cad du/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su nyer bzung mthus/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub stobs bcu'i rtsal/ /ring por mi thogs rdzogs pa'i skal can shog /ces dang / bla ma rin po che bdag gi blo chos su 'gro (65na)bar — /42

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byen rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdabyin gyis brlab tu gsol sogs bla ma'i rnal 'byor spyi 'gro ltar gyi gsol ba phur tshugs su btab nas/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ yig las 'od zer dkar po sogs dbang bzhi spyi ltar len/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas bla ma rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/snying padma 'dab brgyad kyi rnam pa can gyi dbus ze'u 'brur bzhugs la slar yang gsol ba btab pas bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang sems dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i brjod bral de kho na nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag mthar bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs bya'o/ zhes pa 'di chen po hor gyi rgyal khams su mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs spel ba'i bstan pa'i sgron me gcig bu pa 'jam dbyangs blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan kyi gsung dang du blangs te za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /spyi gtsug pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan steng / /rigs kun khyab bdag gdod ma'i ngo bo nyid/ /'khor lo sdom pa iṇḍa nī la'i mdog /zhal bzhi bcu gnyis sna tshogs phyag mtshan can/ /phyag rgya drug sogs rgyan dang na bzas spras/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum me dpung dbus bzhugs par/ /mnyam sbyor rdo rje phag mo byu ru'i mdog /bcu drug lang tsho zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /thabs mchog rin chen gar gyi nyams ldan waṃ/ shes rab stong nyid snying rje a yi dbyibs/ /zung 'jug phung khams ye dag nyer bzhi'i yul/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba'i grong khyer mchog /rdo rje'i lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga'i/ /bde chen 'khor lo ma nyams khrag 'thung dpal/ /lte 'og a bshad gtum mo rnal 'byor mas/ /yongs bzhu (65ba)'bar 'dzag bde stong phyag rgya che/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i mthus/ /lam mchog tshe 'dir nyams su rab blangs las/ /rang sems skye med he ru ka dpal dngos/ /bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa la gar byed shog /ces bla ma dang bde mchog dbyer med du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes u chu mu chu che chin ching wang gi u pa shis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /— /43

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shesnang ba mtha' yas de sras pad dkar 'chang / /dbyer med drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /byang chen bar du skyabs 'gro gsol 'debs na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs myur du stsol/ rang nyid legs ldan nag po phyag drug par/ /rab gsal spyi bor skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma gser sbyangs zhun ma'i mdog /'bum phrag rta ljang gos kyis klubs pa'i gzi/ /rin chen rgyan spras longs sku'i cha lugs can/ /yid bzhin nor bu gser gyi dril bu 'dzin/ /pad nyi'i gdan la rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /bla mgon phan tshun 'od zer 'phro 'du yis/ /bde stong ngang la gar mdzad 'od du mer/ /bla mgon dbye ba med pa'i ngo bor gyur/ /na mo burnya ya/ na mo gu ru saḥ badzra bī ra bī re na shrī ye/ ḍā ka ḍā ki ni/ dzo ka dzo zhi ni/ sarba burnya bo dhi satwa/ shā ra ṇi ga tstsha mi kye/ lan gsum thugs dam bskul phyir gsol btab pas/ /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /yi dam dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor pa/ dpal ldan ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i/ /byin brlabs nus mthu thogs pa med pa yis/ /bdag yid da lta nyid dang myur ba nyid/ /'dug sa 'di ru byin gyis rab rlabs te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rtse gcig (66na)gdung shugs drag pos gsol btab pas/ /bla ma 'od zhu rang gi spyi gtsug nas/ /chu la chu bzhag lta bur gyur pa yis/ /bde stong phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du glod/ /gsol 'debs dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di 'dra zhig dgos zhes bi lig thu rab 'byams pas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /spyi gtsug 'dab stong ri bong 'dzin pa'i steng / /drin can bla ma 'phags ma chag spyan ras gzigs//zla zhun ltar dkar zhi 'dzum longs sku'i chas/ /rtsa phyag thal sbyar lhag ma man shel phreng / /padma 'dzin zhing rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /thugs ma'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros dngos brgyud kyi/ /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs/ /thogs pa med par badzra sa mā dza: /skyabs gnas thams cad
