'dus pa'i bdag nyid la/ /grangs med lus kyis phyag 'tshal mchod — /44

bla ma'i rnal 'byar zhing /bams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bkapa 'bul/ /sdig lhung kun bshags rang gzhan dge la rang / chos 'khor rtag bskor mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /gsol 'debs dge tshogs byang chub phyir bsngos mthus/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'jig rten dbang phyug gis/ /rjes bzung rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di'ang kha 'om dgon bla ma blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag rig smra ba bsam mthong ba phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /rang gi spyi bor seng ges bteg pa'i khri/ /mi 'gyur rdo rjes legs mtshan re khā 'a steng / /gdan gsum tshang ba'i rdo rje slob dpon mchog /chos gos sum ldan rab byung cha lugs can/ /ser mdog zhus mdzes phyag g.yas chos 'chad kyi/ /sor mos pad dkar yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ /(66ba〉dpung pa'i thad gar 'dab ma rab tu rgyas/ /g.yon pa mnyam gzhag steng na rgyal ba rnams/ /bgrod pa gcig pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam/ /legs par ston pa'i pu sta gaḥ yis mtshan/ /rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs mthong zhing thos/ /dran reg mtha' dag don dang ldan mdzad pa'i/ /thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros dus gsum gyi/ /rnam 'dren byang sems rang rgyal thos sgrog pa/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma sogs/ /lus pa med par tshad med thugs rje'i mthus/ /skad cig nyid la badzra sa mā dzaḥ dbyer med skyabs gnas 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ /ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa tshar gcig brjod/ ngag gi dbang phyug mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /ngur smrig gar bsgyur blo bzang grags pa'i bstan/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu khyab mdzad pa/ /tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /thog ma med nas da ltar thug gi bar/ rigs drug gnas su zo chun khyud mo bzhin/ /'khor yang dal 'byor mi lus rnyed pa 'dir/ /nyin mo'i skar ma las kyang ches cher dkon/ /btsas ma thag nas 'chi bdag zhags pa yis/ zin pas nges par 'chi zhing nam 'chi'i cha/ /ma nges rlung nang mar me ji bzhin du/ /gson rkyen nyung zhing 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang / /pha rol skyas chen 'degs pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /rjes su 'brang ba dkar nag las 'bras tsam/ /de phyir phan — /45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang snye bzang rgya mche'i gsung 'bum/ 6shepa dam pa'i chos la ni/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs phal cher gnod byed rgyu/ zha ba'i 'og tu rtsa sbur me bsregs ltar/ /gtan med ma yin rnam par shes pa de/ /bya spu rlung khyer bzhin du srid pa yi/ /bar dor 'khyams rjes nges par lus shig len/ /sngon chad mi dge mang du bsags pa'i 'bras/ /tsha grang dmyal ba bkres sgom yi dwags dang / /rgyan lkugs byol song gar skyes sdug bsngal gyi/ /(67na/sdug bsngal las ngan ma zad bar du myong / /bde 'gro'i gnas gsum dag tu zag bcas kyi/ 'gyur ba'i bde ba sdug bsngal kho na'i rgyu/ /lha mi'i dbang phyug rnams kyang lus dman par/ /skye na 'khor ba chu shing snying po dngos/ /skyes bu 'brum nad byung ba ji bzhin du/ /srid pa'i gnas su mi ldog gtan gyi bde/ /thar pa'i lam las gzhan na ma ma:stag pas/ /ga ṇi ga tu brtson pas bsgrub la 'bad pa gzhes/ /de phyir 'khor ba mtha' dag me 'obs dong / /du: kha'i 'byung gnas yin par nges rig ste/ /tshig tsam ma yin bsam pa thag pa yis/ /rnam dag nges 'byung skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang nyams kyis gzhal mkha' mnyam sems can kun/ /srid pa'i btson rar 'khyams par yongs shes nas/ /'dren phyir byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ /rgyal sras spyod la slob par byin gyis rlobs/ /kun rdzob tsam du 'khrul snang ma lus pa/ /sgyu ma'i rta glang ltar mthong don dam par/ /nam mkha' lta bur mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam/ /klu sgrub dgongs don rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /thun mong theg par bltos min tshe gcig la/ /sangs rgyas sgrub pa nye lam rdo rje'i theg /bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sku gsum go 'phang tshe 'dir brnyes par shog /deng nas bzung ste rnam mkhyen ma thob bar/ /mgon po khyed kyis 'bral med rjes bzung nas/ /srid dang zhi ba'i bde skyid thams cad la/ /sbyor ba'i mdza' bshes mdzad par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi phyed snying nas dad pas gsol btab na/ khyi so ring bsrel phung por song ba ltar/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'brel mi bslu bas/ /re ba don dang ldan par gdon mi za/ khyad par rang bde lhur len 'khri ba dang / /mi ldan rnam par dag pa'i lhag bsam gyi/ phyi nang 'dzin skyong spel gsum mtha' dag la/ khrel ba'i sems (67ba)kyi cha shas cung — /46)

bla ma'i rnal ra byar zhing khams rgya mche'i byen rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdazad med/ /rang la spang rtogs yon tan med bzhin du/ /gzhan rjes 'dzin zhes skad gsangs mthon po mā /sgrog pa'i kha brod 'ding ba pha rol sems/ /'dren pa mo gsham bu yi ngang tshul bzhin/ 'on te srid zhi'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs tog bsgrubs pa las 'byung bar/ /gsung rab dgongs 'grel sngon byon dam pa yi/ /rnam thar mang po 'byung la klan ka su/ de phyir deng nas sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /rjes bzung bla med byang chub mngon gyur tshe/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi thog mar longs spyod par/ /mchog gsum dpang por byas nas smon lam 'debs/ /bdag la gdengs tshod med kyang dkon cog gi /thugs rje mthu dpung nam yang mi 'dzad cing / /rten 'brel rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pas na/ /nges par don gnyis 'jug par the mi tshom/ /de ltar bsam pa thag pas khas blangs par/ /yid ches brtan pos gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /yongs 'du'i ljon pa ji bzhin 'dod pa'i don/ /'bad med lhun gyi grub pa'i bkra shis shog /de nas dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che zhes sogs blo ka gcig gi rjes su/ /bla ma 'theb sor tsam gyur dbu ma'i lam/ /brgyud de snying dbus padma 'dab brgyad dbus/bzhugs pa bde zhu rang sems bla ma dang / /dbyer med ro gcig ngang du e ma'o/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs nges 'byung khul pa zhig dgos zhes sde pa blo bzang sbyin pas bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma'i skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ rang gi spyi bor seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang zla ba nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du hūṃ dngul chu'i mdog can yongs su gyur pa las drin can rtsa ba'i bla (68na)ma de nyid rnam pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog ston rka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa re re bzung nas yum la 'khyud pa yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar po lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i nyams can/ nu ma dang bha ga rgyas pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa re re bzung nas yab la 'khril ba/ yab rdo rje'i skyil krung dang / yum padma'i skyil krung can/ gnyis — /47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losheda'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing dar gyi stod g.yogs can/ /yab stag gi pags pa'i sham thab grol ba 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs gar hūṃ/ thugs kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas skyabs gnas kyi yul du gyur to cog thams cad badzra sa mā dzas spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ sa gnyis su med par bstim/ oṃ tsakra sa wa ra sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas shabha'i bar/ ru pa nas spar sha'i bar/ rgyas par spro na rig ma bcu drug gis kyang mchod/ /skyabs gnas ma lus kun 'dus pa/ /'chi med tshe 'di'i rnam pa sa /yongs shar bde mchog yab yum la/ /phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs bdag byin rlobs/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sgrib bzhi sbyongs//phung lnga ye shes lnga ru sgyur/ /rten 'dir he ru ka dpal gyi/ /go 'phang mngon du 'gyur bar shog /las 'phro zhan pas ma 'grub na/ /tshe 'dir dngos grub legs stsal nas/ /bskal bar mi shigs gzham med kyi/ /srog gi ka ba tshugs par shog /'di snang 'gags dus bla ma dang / /dbyer med he ru ka dpal gyis/ /rjes bzung mkha' spyod dag zhing du/ /khrid nas bde chen la sbyor shog /mdor na deng nas zung 'jug gi /lam bzang mngon gyur de srid du/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yis/ /'bral med rjes su 'dzin par re|ga /ces gsol ba rtse (68ba)gcig btab pas bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs smin mtshams yan chad gang bum ba'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang gsang ba'i dbang thob/ /snying ga yan chad gang shes rab ye shes gyi dbang thob/ /lus thams cad gang dbang bzhi pa thob/ /slar yang gsol ba btab pas bla ma yab yum 'od du zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas thim/ bla ma dang rang sems ngo bo dbyer med du 'dres pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog /'jug tu bsngo smon shis brjod ci rigs su bya'o/ /chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i snyan brgyud bde mchog dkar po dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di ni/ sa'i tshangs pa 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i lung las kyis mngon par mtho ba u chu mu chu dza sag che chen ching wang gis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i — /48—

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing lams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdayi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /snying dbus pad dkar zla ba nya gang steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /sku mdog dmar po zhi rgyan longs sku'i chas/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis shel 'phreng bum 'dzin pas/ /gsang ye pad bum 'dzin dang mnyam sbyor bar/ /phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig lhung ma lus bshags/ /dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /bskal bar bzhugs gsol dge tsho gos byang chub bsngo/ /thog med dus nas da bar 'khor bar 'khyams/ /slar yang las ngan khur gyis lci ba dag /phyag na pad dkar 'dzin pas rjes bzung ste/ /srid pa'i 'ching las grol bar gsol ba 'debs/ /snang stong 'phags mchog zhi khro'i rol gar mkhan/ /grag stong yi ge bcu dang drug pa'i gdangs/ /rig stong ye dag chos sku'i klong yangs nas/ /'gro kun phan bde'i sa la 'god nus shog /tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags tshe 'od dkar sbubs/ /brgyud de gru 'dzin zhing du padma'i nang / /rdzus skyes rgyal ba'i sras gyur rang grol (69na skos/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba 'dren pa'i khur 'khyer shog /'khrul ngor nyam thag chu nang zla gzugs ltar/ /med bzhin snang ba'i lus can mtha' klas pa/ /snying rje'i dbang gis byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /srid mtsho las sgrol ded dpon byed par shog /bdag pas gzhan gces blo yis lha sngags dang / /ye shes ting 'dzin nyams su bstar ba las/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par legs smon pa/ /re ba don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes 'phyong rgyas pa ngag dbang kun dgas thugs rje chen po la brten pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /srid zla 'phel 'grib med par skyil mo krung / /gcig gis mnan pa e waṃ zung 'jug gdan/ /ma chags pad steng mkha' khyab mkha'i rdo rje/ /rigs gsum tshang ba'i mgon khyod rtag tu rgyal/ /rang byung lus kyi bye ba phrag brgya'i shel/ /rtsig ngos rgyal ba'i snang brnyan 'bod sgrogs gzugs/ /dbye bar chung ngu'i blo mig skal phra dang / /dpyod ldan ha nu byu ci zhig mtshungs/ /de phyir chos kyi rgyal po — /49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yeshebatsong kha pa/ /'jam dpal rdo rje dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sa /dngos po gcig tu blta ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dngos grub char can 'bebs pa 'di na'o/ /de la 'dir zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su bstar ba la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ skyabs yul rnams gsal btab par/ bdag gis gtso byas mkha' mnyam gyi 'gro ba thams cad skyabs su 'gro bar mos te/ skyabs 'gro bzhi skor ram drug skor gang yang rung ba kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin pa rgyud dang 'dres nges pa byas/ rang nyams la dpags nas sems can mtha' dag 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral te thar pa'i lam la bkri ba'i phyir/ thog mar rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob (69ba)par bya snyam pa'i smon 'jug sems bskyed pa sngon du btang / gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba drwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ seng ge chen po brgyad kyi bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri/ 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar padma/ thabs shes zung du 'jug pa nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dhīḥ dmar ser las ral gri'i yu ba la dhī: sa mtshan pa/de las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha ba chen po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis gyis chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mtheb srin gyis utpa la'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad mar kha bye ba'i steng du shes rab kyi ral gri dang stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam can/ dbu la paṇa zhwa gser gyi mdangs ldan dang / na bza' chos gos rnam gsum mnabs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rnam dag dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngang tshul can/ mthong thos dran dang reg pas rnam par grol ba/ gcig pu nyid las dus mtha'i gar gyi skad cig dran rdzogs su 'jam dpal rdo rje sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal ser po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar po/ phyag dang po gnyis gyis yum — /50

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing kham sa rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdal 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri dang / g.yon 'og mas 0 la dang gdug tha/'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ sku mdog phyag mtshan yab dang 'dra bas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ga'ang gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba la gnas pa sprul (70na)pa'i 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i thugs gar mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og mas 'khor lo padma/g.yon 'og mas rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ de'i pang du yum reg bya rdo rje ma ljang gu lja nga nag dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud cing / g.yas 'og mas na bza' dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og mas 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ de'i pang du yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can phyag dang po gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud cing /g.yas 'og mas 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ mgrin pa 'od dpag med dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing / g.yas 'og mas padma dang ral gri /g.yon 'og mas 'khor lo dang rin po che 'dzin pa/de'i pang du yum gos dkar mo dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi yab la 'khyud cing / g.yas 'og mas padma dang ral gri /g.yon 'og mas 'khor lo dang rin po che 'dzin pa/lte ba rin 'byung ser nag dkar ba'i zhal can phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi rang 'dra'i yum la 'byud cing / g.yas 'og mas rin po che dang ral gri /g.yon :'og mas padma dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ de'i pang du yum mā ma ki sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud cing / g.yas 'og mas utpa la dang ral gri /g.yon 'og mas padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ gsang — /51 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she gnas su don grub ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri dang sna tshogs rdo rje/ (70ba)g.yon 'og mas padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ de'i pang na yum sgrol ma ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud cing / g.yas 'og mas tsho la dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ thams cad rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ mig tu sa'i snying po dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ padma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rna bar phyag rdor sngon po sngo dkar dmar pa'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje/ rin chen/ 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu padma ral gri 'dzin pa/ snar nam mkha'i snying po ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum/ rin po che/ 'khor lo/ /rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu padma ral gri 'dzin pa/ /lcer 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum/ padma/ rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lus la sgrib pa rnam sel ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu padma nor bu 'dzin pa/ yid la 'phags pa 'jam dpal dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum padma rdo rje 'khor lo/ /g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ tshigs la kun tu bzang po sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje padma 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rtsa rgyus la byams pa dkar nag dmar ba'i 'kha can/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum klu shing gi sdong po 'khor los mtshan pa rdo rje padma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ snying gar thugs rdo rje sngo ljang sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje ral gri mda'/ g.yon dril bu utpal gzhu 'dzin pa/ mgrin nga ra gsung rdo (71na)rje dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal can/phyag dang po gnyis 'khrud pa'i tshul can/ g.yas 'og mas padma dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas 'khor /52

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bkalo dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ dpral bar sku rdo rje dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'byud pa'i tshul can/ g.yas 'og mas 'khor lo dang ral gri /g.yon 'og mas rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ mig tu gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yab la 'khrud cing / g.yas 'og mas me long dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ rna bar sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yab la 'byud cing g.yas 'og mas yi wang dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ snar dri rdo rje ma ser mo ser nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yab la 'khyud cing / (71na tshe g.yas 'og mas yis zas dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas 'khor lo dang rin po che 'dzin te/ gsang gnas su chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yab la 'khyud cing / g.yas 'og mas chos 'byung dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ rang snang gi thabs dang shes rab snyom par 'jug cing / rin po che dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes shing / skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lag pa g.yas la gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'khyud pa'i tshul can/ g.yas 'og ma tho ba dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ lag pa g.yon pa shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar (71ba)nag dmar ba'i zhal can/phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'khyud ba'i tshul can/ g.yas 'og mas dbyug to dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ lcer padma mthar byed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal can/phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'khyud ba'i tshul can/ g.yas 'og ma padma dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas 'khor lo dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su bgegs mthar byed ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'khyud ba'i tshul can/ g.yas 'og mas sna tshogs rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ dpung pa g.yas la mi g.yo ba sngon po sngo dkar — /53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag ngab pa ble bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedamar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'khyud ba'i tshul can/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon 'og mas 'khor lo dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dpung pa g.yon la 'dod rgyal nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'khyud pa'i tshul can/ g.yas 'og mas lcags kyu dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ pus mo g.yas la dbyug sngon can sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'khrud pa'i tshul can/ g.yas 'og mas dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ pus mo g.yon la stobs po che nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'khyud pa'i tshul can/ g.yas 'og mas rtse gsum dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ mdzad nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'khyud pa'i tshul can/ g.yas 'og mas rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'khrud pa'i tshul can/ g.yas 'og mas rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che dang rgyan gyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ khro 'dzum gyi rnam pa can/ g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs (72na)pa/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lī dmar po oṃ gyi snga mtshan pa/mgrin par snya las padma dmar mo āḥ sa mtshan pa/ thugs kur hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa nam mkha'i khams gang ba badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jam dpal rdo rje gdan gsum tshang ba'i skur gsal ba la dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ sa gnyis su med par bstim/ yan lag bdun gyi sngon 'gro phyag bya ba ni/ gang gi drin — /sko4

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdalas zung 'jug sku bzhi'i lam/ rin chen dbang gi rgyal po tshe gcig la/ /stsol ba'i dbang po khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma phyag 'tshal/ shes bya thams cad mkhyen pas mkhas rtser son/ /nyes ltung phra mos ma gos btsun pa'i mchog /bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub sems kyis bzang / /blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /mgon khyed thun mong gdul bya 'dul ba'i tshe/ /ngur smrig gos kyis klubs pa'i dgra bcom tshul/ /bsten kyang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro bsdu yi/ /byed po kha sbyor bdun ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /'jam dpal rdo rje'i ngo bor bzhengs pa'i sku//gshegs pa gshegs ma sems dpa' sems ma dang / khro bo khro mo ma lus yongs rdzogs pa/ /rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdor na srid pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /skyabs mgon dpung gnyen gling du gyur pa la/ /dkon mchog ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can/ /rje btsun bla ma dam par phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa mchod pa'i yan lag ni/ lha rdzas las grub yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /'thungs pas gdungs la mchod yon yid 'ong 'di/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ /bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru ārya mañdzu shrī maṇḍa/72ba〉la sa pa ri wā ra a: pra tī tstsha hūṃ dza me gha sa mu dra khru ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du chu bzhi la/ tshig rkang dang po dang phyi ma gnyis 'dra ba la/ dus dang mthun pa'i zhabs bkru yid 'ong 'dir/ /reg na bsil ba'i 'thor 'thung yid 'ong 'di/ /zhal gyi dri 'joms zhal bsil yid 'ong 'di/ /yang rkang pa phyi ma gnyis 'dra ba la/ /mdzes shing lta bas mi ngoms yid 'phrog pa'i/ /rin chen gser dngul me tog dri bzang ldan/ zag bcas zag med dag las byung ba yi/ /dri zhim yid 'ong bdug pa'i sprin tshogs kyis/ /mi shes mun sel ye shes sgron me dngos/ /nyi zla ri rab sgron me'i snang ba yis /reg cing tshor bas gdung ba kun sel zhing / /zag med bde bskyed dri bzang yid 'phrog pas/ /stong nyid dpag bsam ljon shing las byung ba'i/ /bde ba'i ro ldan sna mang zhal zas kyis/ /rten 'brel las byung skye med rang bzhin can/ /chos rnams skye med ston pa rol mo'i sgras/ /zhes brjod cing so — /35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheso'i sngags phyag rgyas 'bul/ /rol mo'i skabs su oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/sarba budha kṣe tra pra tsa li ni pra dzñā pā ra mi ta ni hā su bhā we/ badzra sa twa lha da ya sa sto ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho a kho swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas gos zungs byin gyis brlabs te/ srab 'jam yang la shin tu dri zhim pa'i/ /lha rdzas na bza' kha dog sna lnga pas/ /badzra wa sta zhes pas dbul/ 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo blon po dang/ /glang po rta mchog dmag dpon rin po che/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'bul/ /'gro kun phan bde'i dpal la spyod par shog /tsa grwa rda ma bha ratna/ zhes pa dang / g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i ral gri dang / /tsha grang gnod pa skyob pa'i pags pa dang / /yang 'jam nyon mongs spangs pa'i mal cha dang / /dga' mgu rtse bar byed pa'i yid 'ong tshal/ /gang 'dod lta nus bde bar nyal ba'i khyim/ /thags bzang bsregs bcad mi nus 'jam pa'i gos/ /chu la mi 'bying ngal dub med pa'i lham/ /nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun 'di dag 'bul/ /u pa sa sta ratna zhes dang / lha yi dbang po lha min (73na)g.yul rgyal tshe/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems rnams la/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ /maṅga lwanyu dra bya/zhes dang / yid 'ong gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs dang / /dri dang ro dang reg bya dam pa rnams//mos blos dkyil 'khor lha dang bdag 'bul gyis/ /bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /ru pā di pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa zhes dang / gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam pa ni/ /bla bre gdugs dang rgya mtshan dang / /ba dan sil snyan rol mo yis/ /gus pas dkyil 'khor lha rnams mchod/ /rdul yab sbrang yab gsil yab dang / khyams dang skyed mos tshal nyid dang / /gzims mal dang ni gdan khri dang / /myur 'gro rta dang glang po che/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing / /rta babs dang ni bla bre sogs/ /bza' btung ro mchog sna tshogs pa/ /glu gar la sogs mtha' dag mchod/ /bum pa bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rin chen lag dang nam mkha'i mdzod/ /blo yis blangs nas 'bul bar bgyi/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /gsum pa bshags pa'i yan lag ni/ bdag sogs rnams kyis 'khor ba — /56

bla ma'i rnal 'byar zhing khams rgya ra/tsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ (bdathog med nas/ /da lta'i bar bsags slad nas gsog 'gyur gyi/ /mi dge sdig pa'i las ngan ci bsags pa/ /gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang bas snying nas bshags/ /bzhi pa rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag ni/ /skye 'phags yongs kyis dus gsum bsags pa yi/ /rnam dkar dge tshogs kun la rang nyid kyis/ /bsags pa ji bzhin dang ba'i sems kyi mthus/ /spro dga' chen po'i sgo nas rjes yi rang /lnga pa chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba'i yan lag ni/ /lus can so so'i khams dang bsam pa yis /khyad par ji bzhin rtogs nas dbang po dang / /'tsham pa'i nyan thos byang sems gsang sngags kyi/ /chos 'khor rgyun chad med par bskor bar bskul/ /drug pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba'i yan lag ni/ /brnag par nus dka' char dong (73bsko bu yi/ 'grod dka'i 'gro la skyo sun mi mnga' bar/ /'gro rnams sangs rgyas sa la ma bzhag bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /bdun pa bsngo ba'i yan lag ni/ /bsod nams byas pa'i phung po rang gi don/ /nyer byed dman pa'i bsam pa ring dor nas/ /drin can mar gyur skye dgu'i tshogs rnams kun/ /bla med byang chub thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /bslu ba med pa'i skyabs gnas yin no cog /gdan gsum tshang ba'i 'khor lor yongs gsal ba/ /dbang rnon chos rjes 'brangs pa'i dad pa yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho chen po sa /mi zad las ngan rlung shugs drag pos g.yeng / /nyon mongs chu srin gdug pas gtses pas nye/ /myang 'das grong khyer skam sar rgyab kyis phyogs/ /bdag sogs rgyud lnga'i skye dgu ma lus rnams/ /mgon po thugs rje'i gzings kyis nyer bsgral te/ /nges par legs pa'i rin chen gling yangs por/ /khrid nas phan bde'i nor bur spyod byin rlobs/ /las 'phro skal ba dman pas grol ba'i lam/ /re zhig thob nus min na skye ba'i 'phreng / /rim par dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i rten rnyed nas/ /dge ba'i bshes gyis rjes su 'dzin par shog /dal 'byor rnyed dka' nges med myur du 'chi/ /dkar nag las 'bras nam yang bslu mi srid/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bzod glags med/ /de las skyob cing bde 'gro thob ba'i ched/ /dkon — /27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mcha'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemachog gsum la snying nas skyabs 'gro dang / /sgo gsum nag po'i las spangs dge ba bcu/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub pas skyes bu chung ngu yi/ /lam gyi rim pa nyams su len par 3|ga /lha mi'i bde ba yun du spyad spyad kyang / /ngan 'gror slar yang mi ldog gdengs med cing / /lha mi'i dbang phyug rnams kyang dmyal ba'i me'i/ /bud shing 'gyur na srid pa'i bde ba yang / /bzod dka' me dpung 'bar ba'i klubs lta bur/ /rig nas tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab kyis/ /lhag pa'i (74na)bslab pa gsum po nyams bstar ba'i/ /skyes bu 'bring gi lam la bslab par shog /rang nyid gcig pu rigs drug gnas ngan las/ /ci thar byed pa dman pa'i lam mthong ste/ /bdag gzhan mnyam par brje ba'i sems bzang pos/ /sbyin gtong tshul khrims bsrung zhing bzod pa bsgom/ /brtson 'grus mthu las zhi gnas ting 'dzin la/ /gzhol bas lus sems las rung bde chen 'dren/ ti shes pa rnon pos bdag 'dzin rab bcad nas/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang thob par shog /'gro rnams bskal mang 'khor 'khyams myur 'dren ched/ /rdo rje slob dpon spyan sngar mtshan nyid kun/ /yongs rdzogs dkyil 'bor chen por smin byed kyi/ /dbang bzhis rang rgyud yongs su smin par shog /dpal ldan chos skyong gsung ngag gzhi lam 'bras/ /sbyor drug rim lnga rim bzhi dpyid thig dang / /gshed dmar spro med mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud sogs/ /rdzogs rim zab mos tshe 'dir grol bar shog /mdor na deng nas skye ba thams cad du/ /mi dge'i bshes gnyen sdig pa spel ba'i grogs/ /chos min chos ltar bcos pa'i blo brid sogs/ /bdud kyi las dang nam yang mi 'phrad re/ga /thub gsung dgongs 'grel bcas pa dpang po sa /bzung ste lung rigs gtan tshigs rnam dag gi /sgo nas thos bsam sgom pa la sbyor bar/ /skye ba kun tu yongs su 'dzin par shog /ngo mtshar med byung bkod pa'i 'jig rten na/ /bzhugs kyang rgya hor bod sogs mgon khyod kyi/ /gdul bya rnams la thugs rje'i spyan gyi dkyus/ /ring por khyongs zhes gsol ba don ldan shog /nye dang ring bar bltos min skad cig la/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi snying gi za ma tog /rab gang mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kyi/ /'dod dgu'i char chen — /nyis

bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing khams rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs myur 'dren/ khobada'abebs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung nas dbang bzhi len tshul (74ba)bla ma'i rnal 'byor spyi 'gro ltar bya/ /gsum pa rjes ni/ de nas dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /zhes sogs blo ka gcig gis gsol ba btab pas srung 'khor gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu bla ma la thim/ bla ma 'jam dpal rdo rjer gsal ba rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying padma 'dab brgyad kyi ze'u 'bru'i khar byon pa dang / padma kha zum nas byang chub gyi bar du 'bral ba med par bsam zhing bla ma dang rang sems dbyer ma mchis pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /mthar bsngo ba smon lam shis brjod ci rigs pa bya'o/ / blos byas sgro gshog 'grig 'grig mdongs mtha' bkra/ g.yo sgyus gdugs ltar ma phub rgyud sde'i don/ dbyar rnga bsgrags tshe byin rlabs mngal khur las/ /zung 'jug sgo brgya grol ba'i cho ga rdzogs/ /sbyangs 'bras sku yis bdag byin brlab pa'i gnas/ /ma rtogs phur btsugs khab kyis gor ma rdo/ /'bigs 'dod brtson pa'i khur gyis ngal ba'i mthar/ /don med mal du gti mug gnyid la yur/ /de phyir dkon mchog bgrang byar 'dren 'os rnams/ /ma tshang med pa 'jam dpal rdo rje'i skur/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pad dkar chun po'i rgyan/ /skal bzang legs bris thod du chings shig bu/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub char 'bebs zhes pa 'di ni 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje'i sprul pa'i sku ching gis gnam gyi rgyal po'i rigs su byon pa blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis bkras btag mchog gsum ma/gser gyi maṇḍal/ dngul gyi ka pā la bcud ldan/ gos yug gnyis/ bkras btags sna ldan rnams kyi rten dang bcas te rgyang ring po nas gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi rigs las sdom brtson sde snod gsum pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes mngon rtogs dang mchod 'phreng rnams yig rnying de khungs ma rnams las bsdus te blo ngan du 'khor ba lcags mo bya'i lo chu stod zla (75na)ba'i dkar cha'i rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes la rang byung 'phags pa'i gzhal med — /59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losekhang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rtsis dkar nag dang rgya bod kyi yig rigs la blo gros kyi 'jug pa yangs pa mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ / spyi gtsug seng khri padma nyi zla'i steng / /gdan gsum tshang pa'i bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin/ /kun 'dus yid bzhin nor bu'i bdag nyid la/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i lus sprul gus phyag 'tshal/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye mchod sprin 'bul/ /thog med nas bsags sdig lhung ma lus bshags/ /bdag g.yin rnam dkar tshogs la rjes yi rang / /rgyal sras slob bcas chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /bskal bar mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /bsod nams byas kun byang chen rgyu ru bsngo/ /mi phyed snying nas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum las 'od 'phros pas/ /dbang bzhi bskur zhing nyon mongs rnam lnga sbyangs/ /phung lnga gnas gyur ye shes rnam pa lnga/ /mngon gyur bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /tshe 'dir thob pa'i sa bon legs par btab/ /gsung ngag dbang bzhi mtho ris chu bo'i rgyun/ /blo ldan skal bzang gdul bya'i dga' ston du/ /'bebs mdzad dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i byed po mchog /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i ngo bor mgon po khyod/ /'od mtshan stong 'bar de bzhin gshegs pa ltar/ /mi 'gyur rtag brtan rang gi sems nyid dang / /dbyer med skye ba kun tu rjes 'dzin shog /ces bla ma'i rnal 'byor yan lag bdun pa dang 'brel ba'i smon lam tshig nyung don tshang zhig dgos zhes dhī tsha sprul pa'i sku blo bzang gar dbang chos grags dbang po'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa sam mthong lo tsā ba phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /— /6(/—

bla mkha bstad tshogs kyi rim pa/(bdar༅༅//mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa bzhugs so//༄༅//akṣa rgyu tsadzñā na war 〉 ṣṭha lwa tsā nutta ru hri da ya3su khyam hā tsa//spyosbyor me bya myos pa//mi 'gyur mchog tu yangs pa'i bde ba che//bla med ye shes bdud rtsi'i snying po can//a:shrīXshu ba lā laṅkar gu shā ko tsagrwa〈〈je kā yatri na mas/sku gsung gsang ba rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod//stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' rgyal ba gnyis par 'dud//dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa rgya mtsho'i rdul//ye shes rang snang las grub 'og min gyi//ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rol rtsed them skas las//rgyal sras dam pa'i rnam par bde bar byon//rnam 'dren kun gyi mkhyen pa'i phung po gang //gcig gyur 'jam mgon mi yi srid pa'i gar//bsam bzhin rnam par rol pa'i mdzad pa la//bskal bzang rgyal ba stong gis bskrun du med//blo gros lang tsho dar ba'i mig stong can//mkhas btsun bzang po'i sa bsrung la bzhon te//'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rdo rje rtse brgya pas//rgol ngan sa 'dzin bcoms pa'i grags pa 'bar//mngal rgya'i brang 'gro'i mdud grol dri bral sku'i//ma la yar skyes lcug phran gzhon nu dag/na tshod phra yang phan bde'i dri bsung ni//nam yang zad mi shes pa'i gter chen po//srid 'byor glog gi bu mo'i gar mkhan ma//sdug bsngal mun par mal 'cha'i 'tshang rig ste//'khor ba mtshan mo'i mtha' las nges 'byung ba'i//tshangs spyod dpal gyi skya rengs dang po shar//gzhon nu'i lus can rgan po'i blo 'chang ba'i//rgyal bstan gyen du 'degs pa'i snying stobs kyis//thos bsam bsgom pa'i sa chen dbus gtsang gi/ljongs su bde bar gshegs pa 'di rmad byung //mang thos dgyes dgu/ spyod la ches sred pas//shes bya'i lus phrar spyad

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshede gzhal zin pa/ /slar yang thos brtson mi phyed mdza' gcugs kyis/ /'byud pa'i skal bzang 'di kos dam du bcings/ /nang don rig pa'i 'o mtsho rab 'khyil bar/ /rnam 'byed shes rab lag ldan nyer zhugs pas/ /tha snyad rig pa'i me tog tshogs kyi rtser/ /blo gros sor mos reg min gang du mchis/ 'jam mgon mkhyen par chags pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho rtogs la mtshar du ci/ khams gsum las rgyal lus med mda' lnga yis/ /ches srab bla gos 'bubs par nus min mtshar/ /sde snod kun sbyangs yang dag grub pa'i 'bras/ /bka' chen du mar 'byams klas bshad pas ci/ /ring mo nyid nas ji lta ji snyed kyi/ /chos kun thugs su chud zin ma yin nam/ /bde stong rang bzhin rgyas pa'i dbang po'i gzhu/ /zung 'jug gur khyim rnam par bkra ba nas/ /gsang chen chos kyi rgyud mang bsgrags pa'i tshe/ /sa ra ha de mkha' spyod gnas su bros/ /khengs ldan gnas lnga rig pa'i lus phra ma/ /rnam dpyod zur mig lcags kyus nyer btab tshe/ /'khyud min mdza' bas mgul par (3ba nem bcings te/ /gos pa med par mkhyen pa'i klong du sim/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i thugs kyi shel dkar du/ /chos kun sgyu mar snang ba'i rnam rol gzugs/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur nges pa'i gzigs mo la/ /dus gsum rgyal ba phal cher yengs sam snyam/ /sgyu lus sa rgyu wā ra'i 'dab ma'i sgo/ mkhas rlom nyi zla'i 'od kyis phyed min pa/ /legs gsung sked med kha yi zegs ma'i chang / 'thor che 'dab brgya pa der rang dbang ci/ /'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen rol par nges rnyed nas/ khyod blo'i ri dwags dka' gnad sgrog gi rgyar/ /bcings rnams zur phud lnga pa'i gsung mtshon gyis/ /bcad la mtshar du 'dzin pa byis pa'i blo/ /rnam 'dren sras bcas grangs med tshogs rnams dang / /lhan cig gsang gsum bkod pas dus 'da' na/ /'phags mchog paṇa grub 'ga' zhig gzigs zhes pa'i/ /bstod bsngags mgon 'di'i che ba'i 'os su min/ /rigs kun khyab bdag dbang por mngon grub pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spro bsdur mnga' 'byor na/ /lhag pa'i lha 'gas byin gyis brlabs so zhes/ /bsngags brjod dang dir sgrog la re ba skyungs/ /mkhas grub che rlom phal gyis khugs min pa'i/ /— /()skye

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdamatha' bral lta dang rim gnyis dka' gnad gzhu/ /legs bshad rgyud kyis bkug 'di thun mongs kyi/ /gdul bya'i (4na skong ngor bstan pa'i mdzad pa'i dpyid/ /nges pa'i don du spangs rtogs phun tshogs kyi/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i dpal stug gdong lnga'i dbang / /'khrul pa'i gcan gzan dregs pa'i nga ro la/ /dgra slar mi sems rang gi ngang tshul yin/ /rgya chen mkhyen pa'i srang la shes bya yi/ /gnas lugs mtha' dag gzhal tshe rdul phran ltar/ /gyur pas skyengs te chos kun 'chi med gtso/ /stong nyid shol med mngal du yud kyis bros/ /brtse chen lhag pa'i bsam pa'i lcid kyi khur/ /nor 'jin bu mos ma bzod rngul ba'i chu/ /ches cher babs la khyab 'jug zhabs bsil du/ /skal ldan shing rtas phab ces sgros su gleng / /dus dgra'i nus mthur grub pa'i thog mda' yis/ /nag phyogs brag ri bcom dang lhan cig tu/ /'dod lha'i lus kyang tshig par mgrin sngon gyis/ /mig mes bsreg zhes rig byed gtam du mchis/ /gang gis thar par drangs min skyes bu ni/ /med phyir rgyal rnams rang gi gdul bya dag /ma rnyed zhi ba'i dbyings su rnal ba la/ /gdul dka'i snyigs ma lnga bdor sgro yis btags/ /srid zhi'i khams na 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yi/ /dpe slar 'os pa 'tshol phyir nyi zla zung / /dal med mkha' la rgyu yang ma rnyed pas/ /ngal ste thun mtshams sgeg mo'i phang par nyal/ /(4ba〉tsul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab bslab pa'i gzhir/ /mtha' yas lus can ma lus nges sbyor ba'i/ /mdzad pa mchog 'dis khyod dang zas gtsang sras/ /tha dad dbye ba'i go skabs rtogs nus min/ /bskal brgyar bsgrub bya snyigs dus tshe gcig la/ /zung 'jug sku bzhi'i lam du 'gro ba kun/ /'khrid la khyod dang khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /sprul longs rtags kyis ma 'dres nges pa brnyed/ /thabs shes rin chen sna bdun la brten nas/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i gling bzhir dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba can/ /kun mkhyen tsong kha pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /deng nas tshe rabs lha yi lam yangs por/ /mi khom skyon gyi chu 'dzin dang bral ba'i/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i bsil zer rab spros pas/ /gtan bde'i ga bur thigs par longs spyod shog /'khrul pa'i khung bur log — 163

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shesmra'i lce rkyong ba'i/ /ltar snang bshes gnyen sbrul gyis mi gtses shing / /yang dag lam ston yongs 'dzin klu dbang gi /gtsug rgyan yid bzhin nor bu thob par shog /rmad byung rnam thar gtsang ma'i khrims dang ldan/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i snying stobs che/ /bde stong mchog gi rim gnyis rnal 'byor spyod/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal bar shog /gang gi legs bshad 'chi med bdud rtsi'i tshogs/ /'thung la nam yang ngom pa ma mchis shing / de don 'chad dang spel ba'i rgyud mang sgra /(5na)srid rtse'i bar du sgrog pa'i dpal thob shog /skye mang nyer brgyud mun pa stug po'i nang //'dir snang bde ba glog 'od skad cig mar/ /rtogs nas mngon mtho'i sgron me nyer 'degs pa'i//dge ba'i rtsi bcud grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /srid pa'i bde ba dbyar gyi chu gter che/ /sdug bsngal mya ngan thang du 'gyur shes nas/ /ldog med theg gsum 'phags pa'i go 'phang gi /mi zad rgya mtsho che la 'jug par shog /zhi bde'i mun ngan mar gyur 'gro ba'i gzugs/ /ma mthong rnam par grol ba'i tshul shes te/ /phyin drug skyong pa'i 'od stong rab spros nas/ /kun mkhyen ye shes snang ba rgyas par shog /grangs med bskal gsum kun gsal rdzogs dka'i tshogs/ /rta ljang rlung shugs rim gnyis 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /snyigs dus tshe thung chu tshod drug cu las/ /lhun grub dbang med bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ khyad par mgon khyod bstan pa yid bzhin nor/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod nas/ /ring lugs dpal 'byor skal bzang 'gro kun gyis/ /mi zad dga' ston spyod la nus ldan shog /'khor ba'i skye srid 'dab chags bgrod pa'i 'gros/ /sna tshogs mtho dman bar mar rgyu ba'i tshe/ /'jam dpal snying pos rjes su nyer bzung ba'i/ /grib ma gnyis pas phyi bzhin 'brang bar 3|ga /chos phung sprin gyi lus phra'i phang pa nas/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa (5ba tshe byug gi sgra/ /bzang po'i bskal pa dbyar dus ji srid du/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dpal du 'grub gyur cig /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po la bstod pa dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di/ /gang gi rnam par thar pa la mi byed pa'i dad pas nye bar bskul te/ dam pa /64

bla ma'i bstod chogs kyi rim pa/ khobadagang de'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos/ /lha hā zhes pa sa pho byi ba'i lo chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang po'i tshes la/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /mtha' yas rgyal ba'i snying stobs btsan po'i go /gcig char yongs rdzogs mtshan dpe'i ngo mtshar mchog /skal bzang 'gro ba'i snang byed dga' ston can/ /rnam 'dren bu ram shing pa rgyal gyur cig /rmongs pa'i mun chen bstibs pa'i bsil ba'i ljongs/ /so thar khrims kyi nam mkha'i nor bu yis/ /rgyal bstan 'od stong spro ba'i thams cad mkhyen/ /mkhan chen bstan pa'i rtsa lag zhi 'tshor 'dud/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i dngos por lci ba'i khur/ /'dren la 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i shing rta pa/ /zung gi kha lo bsgyur ba'i paṇḍi ta/ /lnga brgya'i dpung gnyen mar me mdzad la 'dud/ /thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa yi/ /zag med bde chen snying po'i kunda las/ /mtshan (6na)dpe'i lang tsho rgyas pa'i zlos gar can/ /rgyal ba kun dngos btsong kha ba la 'dud/ /dhī yig rang bzhin blo yi chu gter las/ /grub pa rdo rje 'chang gi bzang po'i bcud/ /phyogs bral grags pa'i ka la shar bstams nas/ /dpyod ldan 'chi med dga' ston spel la 'dud/ /srid 'dir 'jam mgon zur phud lnga pa gang / /mtshams sprin mdangs kyi dpal 'phrog bla gos can/ /thub bstan snying por bgyid pa'i dka' gnad mdud/ /'grol mkhas rgyal ba gnyis par gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar bslu med mchog gsum dam pa'i mthus/ /gangs can phan bde'i dpyid gyur zhi 'tsho'i dbon/ /ngag dbang bstan pa'i 'khor lo bla ma rje/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgya mtsho'i rten/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i nor 'dzin dbang po gang / /shes rab khur gyis 'degs pa'i pad dkar ming / /g.yung drung rtag pa'i rdo rje'i gzhi chen por/ /nam yang g.yo med rab tu brtan gyur cig /grangs med 'gro la nges par legs pa'i nor/ /ji bzhin ster ba'i mi zad bang mdzod mchog /kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras po'i lung rtogs kyi/ /phul byung bstan pa yun du rgyas pa dang / /mu mtha' dang bral mkhyen pa'i chu klung gis/ /tshul min log pa'i — /65

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedri ma kun bkrus pa/ /snyigs dus rgyal ba'i dbang po btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs bzang srid mtha'i bar du 'phel gyur cig /brgal brtags rig pa'i rgyud las nyer drangs pa'i/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i (6ba)gzhung lugs 'dab ldan gyis/ /log smra'i sngon gyi lha kun rab bcom nas/ /legs bshad skabs gsum dga' ston rgyas par shog /zhes pa 'di yang legs bshad chos 'khor gling pa rnams kyis nan gyis bskul ba la brten nas/ /sho lo ka dang po drug gis thub dbang mkhan po rin po che jo bo rje rgyal ba btsong kha pa rnams la bstod cing / lhag ma lngas smon lam byas te/ yul lho phyogs sman ljongs su byung ba'i snyan ngag mkhan/ tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes bris pa'o/ /phul byung blo gros rin chen khang bzang su/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gnyis 'thung dbang po'i snying //grags pa'i mig stong g.yo mkhas rgyal ba'i tog /kun mkhyen 'jam dpal snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /dge legs gter chen rnam 'dren shākya'i gtso'i/ /dri bral ring lugs skyes bu gsum gyi lam/ /'khrul med rgyal mtshan srid rtser sgreng mdzad pa'i/ /mkhas btsun dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i chu gter las/ /yod med mtha' bral rten 'byung yid bzhin nor/ /mgrin par sbud pas dpal ldan zla grags kyi/ /ngo mtshar gnyis pa 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal dbang btsong kha pa yi ring lugs la/ /log rtog dri ma 'khyud pa'i shing rta pa/ /rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ /lung dang rig pa'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' yas (7na)rnam dkar dge tshogs chu gter las/ /mang thos bdud rtsi'i bum bzang la 'dun pas/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog /sgreng mkhas bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /blo gros 'jigs pa med pa'i seng ge'i rgyud/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can pha mthar sgrags pa yis/ /rgol ngan ri dwags klad pa cher 'gems pa'i/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /dkon mchog rgyal ba kun dngos ngo mtshar gyis/ /chos tshul ma lus 'phel ba'i ngag gi dpal/ /'jam dbyangs mi yi srid bzung bla ma rje/ /mtshungs med yongs 'dzin mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /— /66

bla ma'i bstod tshegs kyi rim pa/ khobadazhes gsung rab kun gyi yang snying byang chub lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rgyal ba gnyis pa nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du bgyis pa 'di/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi 'dus pa'i tshogs la chos 'di g.yar khral du phul tshe/ za hor gyi ban dhes 'phral du bris/rgyal kun ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /tshangs spyod lang tsho dar ba'i do ra du/ /bsgyur mkhas sdom brtson dbang po ghanta ra bha/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen par gsol ba 'debs/ /sa lā pa ltar mngon mtho'i rgyal rigs su/ /mtshan dpe'i snang ba rgyas pa'i ngo mtshar sku/ /zhal khyim 'dzum ldan zla bzhin ches dkar bas/ /bstan 'gro'i legs byas (7ba)mgron kun 'gugs pa bzhin/ /zab yangs 'khor ba'i dpal 'byor chu gter che/ /nges 'byung lhun pos bskul bas ring dor te/sdom brtson mkha' la 'phags tshe gtan bde'i cha/ /yongs gang sngon med zla ba khyod min su/ mkhyen dpyod rab yangs goms pa'i gzhen nu yis/ /brtse ldan ka shi mdzes dga'i gzhung lugs la/ /skad cig tsam gyis 'khrud tshe pad dkar mig /mkha' lding zhon te sum rtsen gnas su song / /brtson chen rta ljang shugs kyis nyer drangs pa'i/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i 'od stong gis/ /kun mkhyen ye shes 'dab brgya 'dzum pa las/ /phan bde'i sbrang rtsi'i zil mngar byur bur spungs/ phra zhib rig pa'i brgal brtags 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /mkhas rlom glang gdong dregs pa'i mche ba dag /phyung ste 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mdongs mtha' la/ /zhon nas mkhas mang 'chi med dbus su 'gying / /khri srong dpyid kyi pho nyas nyer bskul bar/ smad byung thugs rje'i dbyar skyes gzhen nu'i tshogs/ /gangs can dga' ba'i tshal du dar ba las/ /thub bstan myu gu'i 'bras bzang ci yang smin/ /dag pa rab 'byams zhing gi bkod pa kun/ /lugs zung mi 'gyur gtsug lag khang bzang du/ /mngon par bsgyur bas ye shes sgyu ma'i gar/ /bstan tshe ngo mtshar bkod pas 'jig rten khyab/ /srid par zhen pa'i la ba dkar po'i thugs/ /myang 'das bsam pa'i gur kum gyis btsos pas/ /(8na)rab byung khrims kyi ngur smrig bla gos can/ /thun mtshams gzhen nus kha ba'i ljongs kun khengs/ /rtsa brtan tshul khrims shes rab stong — /67

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebu can/ /ting 'dzin lo 'dab gsang sngags 'bras bu yis/ nye bar dud pa'i thub bstan yongs 'du'i ljon/ /bod yul bza' shing ra ba kun khyab mdzad/ /rim gnyis rnal 'byor bde chen bdud rtsi'i ro/ /thabs shes zung 'jug mchog gis legs bltams kyang / /chags bral rin chen bum bzang brtul zhugs kyis/ /rgyal bstan yongs kyi rtsa lag dam par 'dud/ /cung zad bstod pa'i dge tshogs yid bzhin nor/ /legs byas rgyal mtshan rtse mor mngon mchod pas/ /don gnyis 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor rgya mtsho la/ /'bad med longs su spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe rabs kun tu mgon khyod thugs rje yi/ /phul byung dbyar rnga dal gyis rgod pa las/ /ma smad tshul khrims sgrum pa'i mngal khur can/ /thub bstan sa la dga' ba'i gar byed shog /zhes gangs ri'i khrod pa rnams la bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho la bstod pa dbyangs can phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs zhes pa 'di yang / /dam pa gang der mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes/ /dus tshigs drug tu phye ba'i dbyar gyi zla ba snga ma gro bzhin gyis nya ba'i rgyal (8ba)ba gsum pa'i tshes la dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /na ma st+ri kā la bu ddha padmā ka rā la/ gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs kyi bstan dang 'gro la lhag par bka' drin mtha' klas pa'i ma hā gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje la bstod pa thugs rje myur 'jug gi shing rta zhes bya ba/ gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang 'gro la rjes chags kyi zlos gar can padma thod 'phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'gyur lhun grub bde ba chen po'i dbyings/ /snang ba mtha' yas sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /grangs med sprul sku'i gzugs su yongs shar ba'i/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos padma 'byung / /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /klu rgyal khang brtsegs steng gyur si rgyu'i mtshor/ /sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan rnam par ba 'ad — /68

bla ma'i bstod chegs kyi rim pa/ (bdapa'i rtser/ /rdzus te skye ba'i cho 'phrul ston mdzad pa'i/ /mngal gyi dri bral mtsho skyes rdo rje'i dpal/ /sde bzhi yongs rdzogs au ṭi yā na yi/ /stobs ldan rgyal por gyur tshe srid 'byor kun/ /rten 'brel sgyu ma'i rol par yongs shar ba'i/ /sa skyong dam pa'i dbang phyug thor cog can/ /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshu rol phyogs kyi gsang ba'i tshal chen por/ /sbyor sgrol ma lus grub pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /ḍā gi ma tshogs bran du rab 'khol ba'i/ /dbang gi mthu (9na〉dzin shānta rakṣi ta/ /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'jigs rung dur khrod kun tu gsang sngags kyi/ /nye lam brtul zhugs spyod pa mthar phyin gzis/ /mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs pad tshal yongs ba 'ad pas/ /dregs pa las 'khol rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos kun rjen par 'char ba'i mkhyen pa'i mkhar/ /bslab sbyang rig par bya ba'i yul bral yang / /pra bha ha ster yo ga'i zab don chos/ /nyan pa'i tshul 'dzin shākya seng ge la/ /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phyogs bral 'phags yul mkhas grub thugs mchog las/ /theg pa rim dgu'i bdud rtsi'i za ma tog /phyi rab 'gro la nyer dgongs thos bsam gyis/ /gnas lnga mkhyen pa blo ldan mchog sred la/ /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhom zhig dang bral ma ra ti ga'i phug /mi 'gyur gnas su tshe dpag med mgon gyi/ /byin — 169

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sherlabs thugs mtshor 'phos pas rdo rje'i sku/ /yongs 'grub tshe dbang rigs 'dzin padma 'byung / /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bde ba'i nyams ster rang rig phyag rgya'i gar/ /dbyer med so sor shar ba'i snang brnyan gyis/ /za hor rje blon ma lus theg pa che'i/ /chos la 'god mdzad padma sambha wa/ /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul pa'i tsha gdung sel phyir me dpung yang / /dal 'gro'i klung du bsgyur bas 'byung po'i dbang / /'khor bcas thar pa'i khang bzang nyams dga' bar/ /'god mdzad sras mchog padma rgyal po la/ /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' 'gro'i lung thob mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthus/ /mi bsrun glags blta'i sems 'chang mu stegs sde/ /mngon par bcom pas mi zad nga ro'i rgyun/ /dbyangs su len mkhas seng ge sgra sgrog la/ /(9ba)rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdib sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ring nas mchog 'grub dman ngor yang le shod/ /yang dag sgrub 'tshe'i bdud dpung phur pa yi/ /glegs bus lhag mar bcom tshe rgya bal bod/ phan bdes khyab mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal/ /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ngan pa'i yid 'chang lha srin lcags kyi khams/ /rgyal bstan chos bzhin skyong ba'i gser 'gyur rtsis/ /bod 'bangs bsod nams zhing mchog gtsug lag khang / /legs par bskrun mdzad padma ka ra la/ /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol — /7(/

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bda'adebs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mchim phu gsang sngags gzhal yas khang chen por/ /bde gshegs zhi khro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /tshangs pa lha yi me tog rje 'bangs dgu/ /smin mdzad rigs rnams kun gyi khyab bdag che/ /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /stag tshang seng ger nag po'i tshogs kun bcom/ /mchog thun sgrub pa'i chos dang sa bcud nor/ /mi 'jig sgrom bur rgyas btab su la'i ljongs/ /zab gter khyab mdzad rdo rje gro lod rtsal/ /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rlabs chen sprul pa'i byed pos gangs can ljongs/ /ri phug u rgyan yul mtshungs sgrub gnas su/ /byin brlabs sku dang phyag zhabs ngo mtshar rjes/ /brag mtshor gsal bar ston pa'i rgyal ba'i tog /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang snang dag pa'i dkyil 'khor rnga yab kyi/ /gling phran dpal gyi ri bor 'phos 'dra bar/ /srin po'i rgyal por sprul pa'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /dam chos snang ba rgyas mdzad mtsho skyes rje/ /rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la sdig sgrib ma lus sbyongs/ /a ti'i don rtogs grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nam yang 'gog med gang gi thugs rje'i gzugs/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i yid mtshor shar ba las/ /sdig sgrib nad gdon tsha gdung kun bcil nas/ /'dod don bsil zer rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /mtha' yas tshe rabs 'dzin (10na sgo'i lto ba sa /theg dgu'i yang snying gsang sngags dpag bsam ljon/ /rang sems chos skur 'char ba'i 'bras bu'i ros/ /mi 'dzad —17/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shelongs su spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /gangs can lha gcig khri srong yab sras 'bangs/ /kun la drug cu'i dbyangs snyan gsung gyi sgras/ /zhal gyis 'ches ltar bod 'bangs ma lus pa/ /phan bde'i 'dod 'jo rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar dge ba'i bsod nams lhun po'i rtser/ /don kun ma lus 'grub pa'i sgo 'phar brgya/ /rnam par phye las bkra shis dbyangs kyi glu/ /nam yang zad mi shes pa'i dpal du shog /ma hā gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje la bstod pa thugs rje myur 'jug gi shing rta zhes pa 'di yang / chos rje u rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis yun ring po nas bskul ba dang bcas/ shing sprel sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i nyin za hor gyi brnye wa gī shwa ra su dhī swā ga ras 'ol dga' stag rtser sbyar/mgrin sngon gser mngal can dang pad dkar mig /lha dang blo ldan la sogs legs bris kyi/ /bgrang yas dregs ldan kun gyi cod pan du/ /dri bral zhabs zung 'god la gus pas 'dud/ /'phags yul kun gsal mdzes ma'i 'gram pa la/ /za hor rgyal rigs zla shel zhun ma'i ngos/ /'od dpag med mgon sprul pa'i ri dwags gzugs/ /'gog med gsal bar shar la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal sdug nyi ma'i gnyen dang dbyer med pa'i/ /bla med chos kun gzigs pa'i mar me yis 'gro rnams blang dor la rmongs mun pa'i dpung / /(10ba)sel mdzad grangs med yon tan phul 'byung gter/ /sgrib gnyis rdul gyi rgyal mtshan ma lus pa/ /ye shes tshang tshing zhugs kyi mthun rkyen du/ /legs grub rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la rol pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs kyi khyad par che/ /lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bskul dri za'i rgyud/ /dang por bsdungs tshe tshogs lam brtul zhugs gzings/ /rab zhig tshangs spyod rnyog bral chu klung cher/ /bslab gsum bsil ba'i dga' bde ci yang rgyas/ /paṇa grub bye ba'i legs bshad gang ga'i chu/ /mkhyen dpyod yangs pa'i hub kyis legs drangs pas/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i nyal 'gro skyug mkhas pa'i/ /sngon med dza hu ma zhes lha rnams gleng / /gangs can bstan pa'i rin chen rtsig ngos la/ /log spyod laṅka'i bdag po'i gzugs shar tshe/ /lung rig nyag phran gcig gis nyer bcom pas/ /rakta'i bu yi khengs pa btang gis dogs/ /mdo rgyud nyi zla'i rang — 172

bla ma'i bsnyed tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdabazhin tsha bsil khams/ /ma brtags ltar snang 'gal ba'i chos can dang / /sgrib gnyis mun pa sel phyir mchog dman gyi/ /theg pa'i blang dor blo de da ga re/ /gdul bya'i khams kyi rang mdangs tshon pir gyi/ /sna tshogs theg pa'i 'ja' ris gsar pa'i gur/ /kun mkhyen ye shes gzigs mo'i dga' ston mchog /ster ba'i bya rtsol dag la gcig tu mtshungs/ /don dam rang bzhin gyis stong 'dren byed du/ /kun rdzob gzugs brnyan rnam 'gyur legs 'char ba'i/ /mtha' bral rten 'brel rnam 'dren dgongs pa'i bcud/ /'gro kun bde blag (11na)rnyed pa'i mchog sbyin mkhan/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam bzang gser sbyangs kyi/ /them skas bde bar 'gro kun 'dren mdzad na/ /nyes spyod mi zad 'khor ba'i btson ra de/ /mngon sum med phyir ming gi lhag mar zad/ /thun mong ma yin gsang chos glegs bam gyi/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po'i phreng ba mchog /sgrol mas lung bstan rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sogs/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i mgrin pa ci yang mdzes/ /bag med 'dam gyis nam yang gos min pa'i/ /rnam thar gtsang ma'i 'dab stong dkar 'jam can/ /lha chos bdun gyi ge sar ldem pa yi/ /bka' gdams padma'i phreng ba rnam par bzhad/ /phan bde'i grib bsil bstar ba'i dri bral gyi/ /ring lugs gdugs dkar nor bu'i yu ba can/ /'brom ston chos kyi rgyal pos legs gtang nas/ /mi pham dbang po'i dga' ba'i tshal der gshegs/ /snyigs dus nyon mongs snang ba mi bzod pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor thabs mkhas mtshon gyis legs brdar te/ /blo ldan he ru ka yi dga' ston mchog /stsol mkhas sna tshogs las bzang a ti sha/ /mi bsrun nyes spyod phud sgra cher sgrog pa'i/ /lnga brgya'i klu dbang gtsug gi nor bu mchog /phul byung mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid can/ /dpal ldan mar me mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba'i rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i rnga/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs can/ /tshe rabs kun tu rna ba'i dga' ston du/ /mi 'bral longs su spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /(11ba〉byes lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dpal ldan mar me mdzad ye shes la bstod pa drug skyes glu dbyangs zhes pa 'di ni/ kun 'dzin gyi lo/ rgyal bas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i zla — /73

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheb/ nyin byed dbang po seng ge'i khyim du slebs pa'i nyin/ bka' gdams rin po che'i bstan pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos dpal ldan 'bras spungs su sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /mtha' dag gzugs can dang grangs kyi gab tshig /skal ba mchog gi dri bzhen 'khor lo'i shugs/ /longs su spyod las thub bstan dus gzugs chas/ /rnam par gang ba'i bshes gnyen bsil sbyin mkhan/ /phan bde'i sa smos bzhad khyod rgyal gyur cig /ring nas yan lag gnyis pa'i gzugs can/ mdza' bcings mkhyen pa'i bhra ma ras/ /gsung rab 'dab brgya'i bcud kyis myos pa'i glu/ /mkhas mang bla na mtho ba'i mgrin pa nas/ /dbyangs su sgrog pa thos 'dzin rgyan du dngar/ /'khrul med bcu ldan mngon gyur mkha' dbyings nas/ /gzugs can dang le'u dang po'i shar phyogs go ṭa pa la grags pa'i rab dngas kyi rgyan 'dres pa/tshangs spyod dpal gyi pi tsu la ta mchog /blang dor tshul bzhin bstar ba'i snang mdzod kyis/ /tshul khrims sprin gyi me tog ci yang 'dzag /mchog gi dngos po sbyang / nges don rgya mtsho'i 'jing gnas shing rta che'i/ /gzhung lugs ji bzhin ston pa'i ngag ldan na/ /gang gi rigs pa'i (12ba)rgyud las drang ba'i don/ /dpyad gsum dag pa'i 'dab ldan min pa gang / /ldog pa'i dpe rgyan/ rgyal yum bka' dang dgongs 'grel drang nges rnams/ /ma 'dres ston pa'i khyod kyi legs bshad ltar/ mi pham mgon dang thogs med yab sras kyi/ /gsung rab tshogs 'di gcig tu ngo mtshar rmad/ le'u dang po nas bstan pa'i mdzesapa'i yon tan la gnyis su yod pa'i lho phyogs bee skyi la grags pa'i gtam dang sbyar ba'i tshig rgyan gzugs can dang sdebs pa/ da sbyong da ldan gzigs mor mtshar ba'i don gyi 'od/ /ma rtogs ri bos tshad ma'i gung 'bigs par/ /legs bris 'khor gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs kyis/ /rigs gzhung gser ldan lto 'dir rnam par skyel/ /shes mngon gyur mchog la/bya bzhi lnga gtsor brjod chos mngon gzhud / /smra la ljongs 'dir zla bral khengs pas ci/ /rgyal gsung yan lag bcu gnyis mdza' na mos/ /rtag tu mgrin pa'i gzhon nur 'khyud min nam/ /ma ga gzugs can/ gsang ba sngags kyi bdud rtsi'i za ma tog /mtha' drug tshul bzhis — /74

bla ma'i bstod chegs kye rim pa/ (bdemi phyed rgyas bcings par/ /chos kun 'byed pa'i shes rab rgyan bdun gyis/ /skal bzang snying gi yol gor 'dod pa 'jo/ rlabs ldan pa'i gzugs can/ chen snying stobs mkhyen pa'i gru rdzings kyis/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i chu gter las brgal te/ /mkhas btsun bzang por grub pa'i yid bzhin nor/ /sku gsum rin chen char du snyil der 'dud/ de ldan pa'i gzugs can/ ltar dge tshogs (12ba)bsod nams phung po'i mtha'/ /kun tu rnam par klas pa'i byed po yis/ /rnam 'dren bstan pa'i dbyig gi blo gros 'dir/ /rje btsun sa 'dzin dbang po brtan gyur cig /ces rje btsun chos kyi spyan ldan mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa dkon mchog chos 'phel ba la gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'byung du bya ba 'di yang / yul lho phyogs sman ljongs sa'i thig ler byung ba'i rig byed pa tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar/thabs dang shes rab mchog gi chu gter las/ /zung 'jug bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi za ma tog /skal bzang 'chi ba med pa'i dga' ston can/ /rgyal ba'i tog gyur rje btsun bla mar bdud/ /dpal sdug gsang ba gsum gyi yid bzhin nor/ /gang gis bdag gir mdzad pa'i 'byor mdzod las/ /stobs bcu'i lam bzang dpag yas 'dod dgu'i char/ /rtsol med lhun grub zad mi shes pa'i gter/ /nyi ma'i gnyen sras tsunda nges don sgra/ /'jigs med sgrog la shākya bshes gnyen 'khas/ /gangs khrod thub bstan puṇḍa ri ga'i tshal/ /rgyas byed skad gnyis smra ba rta ljang can/ /snga 'gyur lam bzang gzings kyis skal ldan rnams/ /sku gsum rin chen gling khrid sgro phug rje/ /dbang phyogs chos rgyal mgrin sngon ral pa'i rtser/ /'khas sen zla tshes 'god mkhas 'phags pa'i mtshan/ /brgal brtags rgya (13na)cher 'grel ba'i lha lam ngos/ /rgyal dbang blo bzang ring lugs snang mdzod khyim/ /thogs med 'dren pa'i rnam dpyod rta bdun pa/ /log smra'i kunda zum la 'gran zlas dben/ /mngon pad 'dul dka' lnga brgya'i nags klung khrod/ /phun tshogs skyes rabs dgu pa'i yongs 'du'i 'phreng / /mtshar du dngar ba phan bde'i dri bsung gis/ /'dzam gling bstan dang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho'i dpyid/ /rab 'byams shes — /75

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mche'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebya'i 'od dkar can gyi gzugs/ /blo gros chu mtshor shar ba'i ji snyed chos/ /ma 'dres 'byed la bstan pa'i 'khor lo gang / /thun mtshams bla gos gsar pa'i 'od kyis mdzes/ /ring nas goms pa'i snying rje'i mdza' na mos/ /ma 'dris 'gro la 'khyud pa'i rtse dga' yis/ /pad dkar 'dzin pa'i snying stobs khengs pa'i gzhu/ /'gugs byed lhag bsam rgyud 'di gzhan du ci/ /dpag dka' nus stobs rdo rje'i zegs ma yis/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan sder bcas brag gi ri/ /thal bar brlag 'dis mthu chen gsang ba'i bdag /khyod la zhum pa'i tshul gyis 'dud min nam/ /dus gsum gcig car mkhyen pa'i 'od dkar gyis/ /'gro kun ma rig mun las rgyal byed na/ /'phags yul mkhas pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i blos/ /gang gi rnam dpyod la 'gran ngal ba'i dpe/ /gzod ma nyid nas rigs brgya'i bdag po'i skur/ /yongs su rdzogs kyang thos bsam sgom pa yi/ /rlabs chen mdzad (13ba)pas rgya bod grub dbang rnams/ /zhi ba'i dbyings su bzhugs pa'i zol la bsten/ /bskal ba du mar bsgom pa'i thun gsum mthar/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i nyin mor byed pa yis/ /yon tan phyogs rer dregs pa'i me khyer dag /smra bcad bzang rdzu'i tshang tshing stug por yibs/ /ka dag lhun grub dbyig gi blo gros stor/ /mkhregs gcod thod rgal lam zab sā la'i ljon/ /sku dang ye shes gang bu g.yur za ba'i/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun bla ma yi/ /mtha' yas yon tan nor bu'i 'byung gnas las/ /sor rtse'i gar du bgyis lta'i phra mo'i cha/ /cung zad bstod tshig 'phreng bar spel ba 'dis/ /kun gsal bu mo'i pha mtha'i zhags pas kyang //tshad du 'jal dka'i 'khor ba'i rba klong khrod/ /lan gcig min par g.yengs ba'i tshe rabs su/ /bshes gnyen mchog gis brtse bas rjes 'dzin shog /yongs su dag pa zangs mdog dpal gyi rir/mgon khyod 'chi med grub pa'i 'khor gyi gtsor/ /bzhugs tshe dad ldan slob tshogs zhing mchog der/ /theg mchog chos la spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi tsher ma'i khung bu sa /grangs med mnar ba'i mar gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /gang gi thugs rjes gnas skabs mthar thug kun/ /phan — /76

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bkadang bde ba'i 'dod 'jo rgyas gyur cig /ces rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug gsum ldan rdo rje'i 'dzin pa'i gzugs su shar ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal (14na〉cur lhun grub la gsol ba 'debs pa smon lam du bgyis pa 'di yang / dam pa gang de'i gsung gi bdud rtsis nye bar 'tsho ba'i za hor gyi rigs las son pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'o/ /dge legs srid zhi'i yon tan ma lus kun/ /rab stsol sdug bsngal gsum las thar mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun bcas pa la/ /skyabs 'gro thugs rje'i spyan gyis bskyang du gsol/ /'og min zhing du drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /'phags yul mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam rol gyis/ /mchog dman 'gro la phan bde stsol mdzad pa/ /ston pa shākya'i rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa'i bye brag gis/ /grangs med sprul pas 'gro rnams 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /spyan ras gzigs dang rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gsang bdag lag na rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /rim pa gsum du rgyal ba'i bka' rnams kun/ /bsdud mdzad 'od srung la sogs dgra bcom dang / /theg chen srol 'byed klu sgrub thogs med sogs/ /dbus 'gyur paṇa grub tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gangs can rje bo'i tshul gyis dge bcu'i khrims/ /sngon med 'dom mdzad chos rgyal mes dbon gsum/ /gang gis legs bzhengs sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang / /rten dang brten par bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /(14ba/byad par ra sa 'phrul snang gzhal yas su/ /zas gtsang sras dang gnyis med sku brnyan mchog /mthong ba tsam gyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub gyi/ /sa bon bskrun par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /bod yul dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me yis/ /khyab mdzad gnas lnga mkhyen pa a ti sha /sgrol mas lung bstan 'brom ston rje la sogs/ /bka ri gdams rin chen 'phreng la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla na med pa'i snying stobs smon lam gyis/ /lnga brgya'i thub bstan spel la zla med pa'i/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas la gsol ba — 177

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang ble bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'adebs/ /phan bde'i lam bzang yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /mngon mtho'i rten dang thar pa thams cad mkhyen/ /ci 'dod stsol mdzad rtsa ba brgyud pa yi/ /yongs 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul pa yi/ /mtha' yas mchod pa'i tshogs kyi legs mchod cing / /tshe rabs thog med nas bzung da lta'i bar/ /bsags pa'i sdig lhung thams cad snying nas bshags/ /ji snyed rang gzhan rnams kyis bskrun pa yi/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs la rjes yi rang / /'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo rtag bskor zhing / /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs/ /rnam dag bsam pas kun blangs dge rtsa'i tshogs/ /'gro rnams kun mkhyen ye shes thob phyir bsngo/ /dri med yid (15na)kyi snying nas smon pa yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu dal ba'i rten thob cing / /bshes gnyen dam pa'i drin gyis zab pa dang / /rgya che'i chos la spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na mchog gsum dam pa'i thugs rje yis/ /bdag sogs nam mkha'i mtha' klas sems can kun/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg par rab zhugs nas/ /sku gsum go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /zhes thub dbang sogs rgya bod kyi bla ma gnas rten la gsol 'debs smon lam yan lag bdun pa dang bcas pa brda' rnying snyan ngag sogs kyis ma bcings shing nyung ngur 'dus pa 'di lta bu gyis shig ces/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi khyon la stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i bskul ba la brten nas/ /za hor gyi btsun pa bhū su ku ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ /oṃ su sti pra dza saḥ rab yangs shes bya'i lha lam lus phra'i bzhin/ /legs sbyar dbang po'i gzhu yi zur mig can/ tags bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i legs bris gtso/ /thugs brtse'i snang ba rtag tu rgyas par mdzod/ /'chi med gtso bo grags pa'i mu khyud dang / /smra mkhas blo ldan drang srong lha'i bla ma/ /gang des rjes gzung dbang phyug go cha la/ /gus pas 'dud do rnam dpyod dpal kun stsol/ /legs (15ba)pa'i cha bsags 'bab stegs bde spyod dang / /gzhung don gsal byed ku rta bhu ti'i — 178

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi zer pa / (bdazhabs/ /'phags yul rgyan gcig tsand+ra go mi la/ /gus pas 'dud do rnam dpyod dpal kun stsol/ /brda' sprod dgongs don gsal byed chos kyi 'bangs/ /mkhyen dpyod rab yangs ratna ma ti dang / /legs sbyar dpal 'dzin puṇḍa tsand+ra la/ /gus pas 'dud do rnam dpyod dpal kun stsol/ /legs bshad mdzod gyur 'chi med seng ge'i zhabs/ /gnas lnga rig pa phun tshogs 'byung gnas dang / /gangs can mig gcig shong lo rnam gnyis la/ gus pas 'dud do rnam dpyod dpal kun stsol/ /mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros dpal bzang po/ /dpang ston thams cad mkhyen pa blo gros brtan/mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa byang chub rtser/ /gus pas 'dud do rnam dpyod dpal kun stsol/ /mtha' klas rig gnas mdzod 'dzin nam mkha' bzang / /ka tsan dgongs pa 'grel mkhas thugs rje dpal/ /gang de'i thugs sras legs pa rgyal mtshan la/ /gus pas 'dud do rnam dpyod dpal kun stsol/ /tshul 'dir bka' drin mtshungs med chos skyong bzang / /legs bshad bdud rtsi 'thung mkhas skyogs ston rje/ /dbyangs can mgrin par 'khrud pa'i dpal sgang par/ /gus pas 'dud do rnam dpyod dpal kun stsol/ /gang gi gsung 'dzin 'od zer rgyal mtshan dang / /mang thos tshe dbang don kun grub pa'i dpal/ /'jam dbyangs dbang gi rgyal ba'i rdo rje la/ /gus pas 'dud do rnam dpyod dpal kun stsol/ /rig gnas rgya mtsho'i phreng 'dzin thugs kyi sras/ /gzhung lugs nor bu'i rna rgyan rab 'phyang pa'i/ /legs sbyar smra mkhas chos rje lo tsā ba/ /tshe brtan brda' sprod rgyal mtshan 'dzin mkhas la/ /gus pas 'dod do rnam dpyod dpal kun stsol/ /dka' gnas rgyal ba'i gsung rab gsang ba'i mdud/ /(16na)ji bzhin 'grol ba'i byed po brda' sprod gzhung / /mkhas dbang gsung ngag 'brul bral legs rtogs nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i blo gros rgyas par shog /mchog tu yangs pa'i shes rab rdzing bu la/ /legs bshad 'dab stong gzhen nu g.yur za bas/ /mang thos snyan pa'i bla na med pa'i glu/ /phyogs bral rkang drug mgrin par len gyur cig /phyogs res tshims min legs par bshad pa'i nor/ /brgya phrag 'tshol ba'i blo dang brtson pa dag /dkar phyogs kun phan lta bur cher — /79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang ble bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'aphel zhing / /phan bde'i bsil zer rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /brda' sprod sngar thos tsam gyis tshim min par/ /slar yang smon 'gro lo stor legs sbyangs tshe/ /slob dpon mkhas pa'i bskul tshig lte sngon gyis/ /sgra 'dzin 'dab brgya rnam par phye ba las/ /ri mor bris pa'i yid 'ong gzugs brnyan dang / /mtshungs pa'i bla ma'i gral du ma tshud kyang / /dbyangs can mgrin par 'khyud pa'i skad gnyis pa/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos 'phral du byas/legs byas rgya mtsho'i snang ba ma lus pa/ /'tsho ba'i nyer 'tshor 'gog med mtshan dpe'i mdangs/ /mchams sprin lus phrar 'khyud pa'i dpal 'dzin pa/ /'jam mgon zur phud lnga pas dge bar mdzod/ /thugs rje'i mdzod 'dzin phyag na padma'i zhabs/ ta shes byar mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug sarba dzñā/ /legs sbyar rgya mtsho'i dpal 'dzin pā ṇi dang / /rig byed blo gros (16ba po pa la mnga' grags 'byor la/ /dri bral sa 'dzin rjes 'gro dang ba'i yid/ /rab brtan g.yo ba med par gsol 'debs na/ /legs bshad rdzings kyis shes bya'i mtshor zhugs nas/ /mang thos mkhas pa'i gling du bgrod par shog /gnas lnga mthar son tsand+ra go mi dang / /gang de'i gsung gi mdzod 'dzin chos 'bangs 'khas/ /legs sbyar smra ba rin chen blo gros rje/ /'phags yul mdzes byed bu bla bhant+ra la/ /dri bral sa 'dzin rjes 'gro dang ba'i yid/ /rab brtan g.yo ba med par gsol 'debs na/ /legs bshad rdzings kyis shes bya'i mtshor zhugs nas/ /mang thos mkhas pa'i gling du bgrod par shog /rmad byung rnam dpyod 'chi med seng ge'i dpal/ /gzhung brgya smra mkhas rab 'byor zla ba dang / /paṇa chen gtsug rgyan la〉 ka ra dang / /'jig rten mig gcig rdo rje rgyal mtshan la/ /dri bral sa 'dzin rjes 'gro dang ba'i yid/ /rab brtan g.yo ba med par gsol 'debs na/ /legs bshad rdzings kyis shes bya'i mtshor zhugs nas/ /mang thos mkhas pa'i gling du bgrod par shog /dbus 'gyur blo brtan gnyis pa shong ston rje/ /de'i gsung gsang ba kun 'dzin mchog ldan pa/ /gangs khrod bstan pa'i nyi ma lo chen dpang / /gang gi chos rigs bdag po byang rtse la/ /dri bral sa 'dzin rjes 'gro dang ba'i yid/ /rab — /8(/

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ khobadabartan g.yo ba med par gsol 'debs na/ /legs bshad rdzings kyis shes bya'i mtshor zhugs nas/ /mang thos mkhas pa'i gling du bgrod par shog /mang thos sgra bsgyur dbang po nam mkha' bzang / /tshul 'di'i bstan pa'i gsal byed thugs rje dpal/ /dpal sdings skad gnyis smra ba grags pa'i mtshan/ /gnas lnga'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad chos skyong bzang / /dri bral sa 'dzin rjes 'gro dang ba'i yid/ /rab brtan g.yo ba med par gsol 'debs na/ /legs bshad rdzings kyis shes bya'i mtshor zhugs nas//mang thos mkhas pa'i gling du bgrod par shog /thugs sras lo chen pad dkar chos skyong dang / /spyang mo skad gnyis smra ba ngag dbang grags/ /brda' sprod gtsug lag gsal byed sī shwa ra/ ta nong ston sprul pa'i zlos gar sangs rgyas dpal/ /dri bral sa 'dzin rjes 'gro dang ba'i yid/ /rab brtan g.yo ba med par gsol 'debs na/ /legs bshad rdzings kyis shes bya'i mtshor zhugs nas/ /mang thos mkhas pa'i gling du bgrod par shog /rig gnas rgya mtsho'i phreng ba 'dzin mkhas pa'i/ /tshe dbang don kun (17na〉(ngas grub paṇḍi ta/ /'jam dbyangs mgrin par 'khyud pa'i legs bshad kyis/ /dbang gi rgyal po 'jo ba'i rdo rje la/ /dri bral sa 'dzin rjes 'gro dang ba'i yid/ /rab brtan g.yo ba med par gsol 'debs na/ /legs bshad rdzings kyis shes bya'i mtshor zhugs nas/ /mang thos mkhas pa'i gling du bgrod par shog /tsand+ra go mi'i brda' sprod ga thi'i rgyun/ /'thung mkhas dpyod ldan drang srong dza hu yi/ /rgyud ldan blo gros gsal ba'i drang srong dang / /bstan bsrung gnod sbyin chen po zhang blon la/dri bral sa 'dzin rjes 'gro dang ba'i yid/ /rab brtan g.yo ba med par gsol 'debs na/ /legs bshad rdzings kyis shes bya'i mtshor zhugs nas/ /mang thos mkhas pa'i gling du bgrod par shog /de ltar snyan pa'i gsol 'debs lha lam ngos/ /brda' sprod nam mkha'i glang po 'khrigs pa las/ /legs bshad gru char rgyun gyis mi shes pa'i/ /rmongs pa'i dri ma drung nas phyung bar shog /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i legs bris skyed tshal du/ /dpyad gsum dri ma dag pa'i yongs 'du'i ljon/ /legs bshad 'bras bu'i khur gyis g.yur za ba/ /blo ldan skabs gsum dpal du dar gyur cig /rig pa'i mtshon — /8/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegyis bcad cing legs bsdar pa'i/ /mtha' klas lung gi bcu gnyis bdag po las/ /med byung rtogs pa'i 'od stong rab 'bar te/ /bde legs rab sbyong rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces brda' sprod pa'i bstan bcos tsand+ra pa'i brgyud 'debs 'di yang / /smon 'gro lo tsā ba'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar mkhas pa gang de'i drin las tsand+ra la phyogs tsam shes pa'i rig byed smra ba'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar/na ma sgar su ste/ mtshan dpe'i mdzes sdug lang tsho'i cha shas kun/ /rab dkar smin legs gzugs (17ba)su yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /dbyangs can 'od dkar can gyis ngag gi bcud/ /bdag blo'i za ma tog tu 'geng bar mdzod/ /snyan tshig gzhung brgya smra ba grags 'byor dang / /legs bshad snying por sgril mkhas daṇḍi'i zhabs/ /phyogs 'dir 'khrul bral phu : tsand+ra la/ /gus pas gsol 'debs ngag gi dbang phyug stsol/ /dpal ldan 'chi med 'jigs bral seng ge'i sde/ /rab 'byams chos nor 'byor ldan zla ba'i dpal/ /'phags yul mig gcig litsā ka ra la/ /gus pas gsol 'debs ngag gi dbang phyug stsol/ /gangs khrod mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan shong lo mched/ /mchog ldan legs blo dpung rgyan mdzes pa'i tog /grags snyan don ldan mkhas mchog dpang lo la/ gus pas gsol 'debs ngag gi dbang phyug stsol/ /dpang rigs shes bya kun mkhyen byang chub rtse/ /tha snyad rig pa'i bstan 'dzin nam mkha' bzang / /mi 'jigs shes rab rgyas pa'i dpal gyur la/ gus pas gsol 'debs ngag gi dbang phyug stsol/ /rmad byung thugs rjes rig gnas yongs rgyas dpal/ /gtsug lag tshul la zla bral burnya 'a mtshan/ /mang thos gnas brtan legs pa rgyal mtshan la/ /gus pas gsol 'debs ngag gi dbang phyug stsol/ /don gyi paṇa chen rin chen chos skyong bzang / /rigs chos 'dzin mkhas pad dkar chos skyong dang / /grang chen lo tsā 'jam pa'i rdo rje la/ /gus pas gsol 'debs ngag gi dbang phyug stsol/ /dge ba'i dbang po'i snyems 'phrog paṇḍi ta/ /tshe yi dbang phyug don grub smon 'gro pa/ /'jam dbyangs dbang gi rgyal po'i rdo rje la/ /gus pas gsol 'debs ngag gi /82

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdadabang phyug stsol/ shar lho'i lugs bzang snyan ngag gzhung brgya'i bcud/ /da lha'i thugs kyi bum bzang las 'ongs pa/ /(18na〉so paṇa mkhas pa'i gsung ngag ji bzhin du/ /'khrul med tshul bzhin rtogs pa'i snang ba stsol/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi ngang tshul la/ /nyams dang 'gyur ba stong gi snyan tshig glus/ /bstod pa'i dbyangs kyi rgyal mo cher bsgrags pas/ /dus mkhyen rgyal po'i bsod nams dar gyur cig /rmongs chen mun pa'i go skabs ring phyogs shing / /blo gros pad dkar 'dab stong cher rgyas pa'i/ /byed po ngag dbang dbyangs can nyin byed kyi/ /thugs rje'i 'od kyis rtag tu skyong gyur cig /ces snyan ngag me long gi brgyud 'debs 'di yang tha snyad rig pa lnga la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i lo tsā ba smon 'grol 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje'i drung du daṇḍi'i gzhung lugs la blos byas ma yin pa'i tshul bzhin bslab sbyangs bgyis tshe slob dpon gyi gsung gis bskul ba ltar/ za hor gyi rigs las byung ba'i rig byed pa tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar/thugs rje'i chu gter slong las dngos grub nor/ /'dod 'jo'i dpal gyur rgyal dbang thub pa che/ /'jig rten byed po legs ldan mgrin sngon la/ /'dud do srid gsum kun las rgyal bar mdzod//dbang phyug chen pos rjes gzung rta mgrin mgon/ de'i sras dpal ldan tshangs lha nā tha dang / /zla ba kun nas mngon dga'i mgon po la/ 'dud do srid gsum kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /mi mthun dri (18ba)bral 0 la bzang po/ /gsang ba'i gdams pa ma lus 'dzin mkhas can/ /mes pos rjes bzung yi dam bzang po la/ /'dud do srid gsum kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /phyi rol gtsug lag mkhas mchog sbas pa'i mtshan/ /blo ldan mang pos dpal ldan shaṅka ra/ /legs pa'i phun tshogs kun 'dzin bzang po la/ /'dud do srid gsum kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /'jigs pa med pa seng ge'i go cha dang / /'jam dbyangs dga'
