bar byed pa'i blo gros can/ /mi shes mun pa sel ba'i 'od mdzad la/ /'dud do srid gsum kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /gnas lnga rig pa rgyal ba kun dga' dang / /sgra bsgyur glo bo lo tsā shes rig zhabs/ /gsung ngag 'dzin mkhas bla ma chos rje la/ /'dud do srid — /83

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzar rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegasum kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /phul byung gdams pa'i rin chen rgyal po dang / /slob dpon chen po ratna shwa ra'i zhabs/ /blo gros gzhon nu las rgyal rin po cher/ /'dud do srid gsum kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /rtsis rig smra ba'i sngags 'chang lhun grub dpal/ /mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i chos kyi rje/ /mkhyen rab mtha' bral ārla de wa la/ /'dud do srid gsum kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin blo gros mi zad dang / /shing rta chen po dpal mgon 'phrin las rje/ phyogs 'di'i gsal byed 'chi med bde ba la/ /'dud do srid gsum kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /legs bshad mdzod 'dzin rdo rje'i mtshan can dang / /smra ba'i dbang phyug dus 'khor rab 'byams pa/ /tshe dbang don rnams grub pa'i paṇa chen la/ /'dud do srid gsum kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /'jam zhing ches dus dbyangs kyi dpal thob cing / /legs bshad dbang gi rgyal po'i gan mdzod can/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje la/ /'dud do srid gsum kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /phra zhib (19na)bde 'byung gsang ba'i gtsug lag kun/ /'khrul med ji bzhin rtogs pa'i rnam dpyod kyi/ /mi mthun tshar bcad gnyen srid sder bcas kyi/ /'dod don lhun gyis grub pa'i dge legs stsol/ /zhes g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i gtsug lag gi brgyud 'debs 'di yang / slob dpon mkhas pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje'i drung du rtsis rig sbyangs tshe slob dpon nyid kyi gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ rtsis rig smra ba'i za hor gyi lo tsā ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar/rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i srang la rab gzhal kyang / /tshad bzung rtogs dka' mtha' bral yon tan gyi/ /phung po zad pa med pa'i mchod sbyin sgo/ /'byed mdzad rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /khyoḥ yig zhu ba'i 'od dkar gur khyim ngos/ /dhīḥ yig ri mo gsar pa'i 'ja' ris can/ /cig car yongs smin mi yi srid pa'i gar/ /mkhyen brtse'i kun dga' dar ba'i dbyid bsgyur mkhan/ /dge tshogs nyin mor byed pa'i 'od zer la/ /rab dkar yid kyi 'dun pa'i 'dab ma'i kha/ /'dzum dbus so phreng ke sa ra bzhad pa'i/ /dga' ba rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar yo la med can/ /dbyangs can lha mos — 184

bla ma'i bstod chegs kyi rim pa/ khobadabardungs pa'i yi waṃ sgra/ /mgrin pa'i ri mo gsum par 'khyil ba'i glu/ gtsug lag bye ba'i nyams dang lhan cig tu/ /(19ba)blangs tshe ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjer kun gyis gleng / /nges 'byung ga bur 'thul ba'i dri ngad kyis/ /'khor ba tshad rims nyer gzhom gtan bde'i gos/ /gur kum tshos kyis bran pas nye bar 'khor/ /gnyis pa swā la'i ljongs 'dir rgyu ba bzhin/ /mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor mi phyed rgya yi mdud//ring nas grol ba'i 'khor lo rnon po'i rtses/ /mi shes 'brul pa'i drwa ba kun bcad tshe/ /byed pos sprul pa'i shes bya'i khyon 'di chung / /blo gros gser ldan yangs pa'i yol go'i nang / /mdo rgyud chu gter chen pos ma khengs par/ /skyengs pas dbyar gyi lus phra rngul ba'i chu/ /gos dkar chu 'dzin phag nas g.yo ba bzhin/ /thugs kyi thig ler 'jam dbyangs zhu ba'i khams/ /'chang ba'i lang tsho dar ba'i rnam dpyod zhal/ /legs bshad yan lag brgyad ldan 'chi med chab/ /nyer skyugs dam bca' 'gro ba'i snying la rdzogs/ /rtsod pa'i me dpung srid rtser mched pa'i lces/ /phas rgol dam bca'i dngos po ma lus pa/ /snying po med par bstan tshe chos kyi grags/ /rigs pa'i snyems pa btang ste ngal gsor mnal/ /skal bar tshangs sras lha mos nyer byin pa'i/ /dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i snyan tshig rgyud/ /chos kun 'gugs par rtsom pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /dge ba'i dbang po ngur smrig gos kyis mdzes/ /mkhyen dpyod 'jam mgon mi yi zlos gar can/ /brtse chen 'jig rten dbang phyug ngang tshul 'dzin/ /mthu stobs gsang (20na)bdag brtul zhugs nyer bzung bas/ /rigs gsum mgon yang gcig tu lhun gyis grub/ /ma rig 'khyog po'i rtsa khams rdo rje yi/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi srong por grub pa'i lus/ kha sbyor bdun ldan rnam par rab bzhengs pa'i/ /zung 'jug sgyu ma'i gar mkhan chen por nges/ /phul byung mdzad pa'i gzhan gsos dbyangs snyan pos/ /nyer drangs rgyal dbang blo bzang grags pa'i bstan/ /sos kyi lang tsho'i dga' ston rab rgyas pas/ /lung rtogs dbyar gyi dpal mo'i bzhin ras 'dzum/ /rnam dpyod gzings kyis rgyal bstan rgya mtsho che/ /pha mthar bgrod pa'i 'phrin las yid bzhin nor/ /phan bde'i 'dod dgus nor 'dzin kun khyab pa'i/ /thams cad — 185

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mche'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemakhyen par nges la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge tshogs gser gyi rtsibs ma stong ldan pa'i/ /'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs gdugs dkar po/ /srid rtse'i bar du bteg pa'i grib bsil la/ /skal bzang skye bo kun gyis spyod par shog /ces pad dkar 'dzin pa rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang po dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rdo rje la bstod pa yon tan bye ba'i zla shel zhes bya ba 'di yang / /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i blo gros kyi chu gter las 'ongs pa'i snyan tshig zla ba dkar po'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ /ngo mtshar dag pa ye shes snang ba'i gar/ /(20ba tshe ni khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i/ khyab bdag dang po'i mgon po rdo rje 'dzin/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo gsal rin chen lta bu'i gdul bya'i tshogs/ /gsang chen rgya mtsho'i gdams pas tshim mdzad pa'i/ /snyan pa'i grags pa yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan rtser 'god dpal bzang po/ /zung la jug mngon gyur khrung po rnal 'byor sogs/ /mkhas grub bye ba'i skyes rabs yongs 'du'i phreng / /snyigs dus nags klung sdug por g.yur za ba'i/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gyur phan bde'i dri bsung can/ /na tshod ches phra zla tshes gsar pa dag /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i cha shas yongs rdzogs pas/ /yi dam chos srung rgya mtshos rjes bzung ba'i/ /rmad byung brtags kyi ri dwags mtshan mas mdzes/ /dge tshogs la 'dun thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis/ /tshangs spyod sprang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan rab ba 'ad pas/ /gzhung lugs bye ba'i 'dab brgya ci yang 'dzum/ /bgrang yas yongs 'dzin legs bshad sbyin skyes gzugs/ /blo gros lto bar zhu ba'i sgregs pa yis/ /mtha' klas gtsug lag nyal 'gro kun 'thung pas/ /drang srong a ga sta la mtshar du ci/ khyad par mchog sred sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po rdo rings pa'i/ /snyan rgyud gsang chen slob bshad bdud rtsi yis/ /thugs (21na)kyi bum bzang bltams pa khyod min su/ /legs bshad 'chad rtsom dbyar gyi rnga gsang gis/ /skal ldan rma bya'i dga' ston rgyas mdzad cing / /rtsod ngag thog mdas — /86

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdalog smra tshar gcod pa'i/ /mkhyen pa'i dpal de 'jam dbyangs gzhen nur 'gran/ /thugs rje'i zad pa med pa'i char rgyun gyis/ /ris med 'gro ba'i phan bde'i myu gu rnams/ /legs par spel ba'i phul byung snying rje yis/ /phyag na padma'i rnam par thar pa bzung / /ye shes mgon po dam can dregs pa'i tshogs/ /bran du 'khol ba'i mthu stobs nus pa yis/ /log 'dren dgra sde'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad tshe/ /gsang bdag mi yi srid pa'i gar du nges/ /lam 'bras gser chos bcu gsum mgon zung gi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i man ngag nyi zer gyis/ ta shes ldan pas tshal kun rgyas pa dang / /skal med ku mud zum pa mnyam du byas/ /tshig 'jams don bzang slob bshad pi waṃ sgra/ /sa rdzus rdo rje'i rna ldan phal cher gyis/ /snying la dga' ba'i ngo mtshar mi bskyed kyang / /skal bzang mi yi thos 'dzin rgyan du snyan/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba gsum/ /gcig bsdus gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /snyan rgyud bye ba'i mdzod 'dzin tshar pa rje/ /mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe rabs kun tu (21ba)rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /mi 'bral dgyes pa chen pos nyer gzung ste/ /snyan rgyud slob bshad gdams pa'i gter chen por/ /mi 'bral longs su spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /phyi rol snang srid ma 'dres so sor rig /nang du rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun/ /gsang ba rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug tu/ /legs rtogs bde ba chen por spyod par shog /gnas skabs phan bde'i grib bsil bla na med/ /mthar thug sku bzhi'i 'bras bu rab tu smin/ /ci bsam lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bde legs kyis/ /dus kun rnam par khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dpal ldan sa skya pa'i snyan rgyud 'dzin pa mtshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa rdo rje'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dam pa gang de'i rnam par thar pa la rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa thob pa'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /oṃ su sti pra dza saḥ dpal ldan rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i nor/ /gang thugs do ker nang tu rab 'byor ba/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar lhun gyis grub/ /'jam mgon bla ma mchog der — 187

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegasol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir blo gsal rig pa brtson 'grus sogs/ /ngal ba du mas mkhas rlom glang po'i mgor/ /bgrang yas mkhas grub skyes rabs gdong lnga pa'i/ /zhabs sen mngon par bsgyur der (22na)gsol ba 'debs/ /skye bar brgyud pa'i gtam tsam lhur len pa'i/ /rgod brten pha wang lta bus 'dzin ma'i gzhi/ /gang dbus gnas lnga rig pa'i bzhag rlabs kyis/ tags bya'i mkha' la bgrod der gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas dregs zer gyis sdom gsum padmo'i tshal/ /zum kyang tshig bshad kunda bzhad byed pa'i/ khengs pa 'phrog byed btsun pa nye bar 'khor/ /sa 'dir slar yang 'ongs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rmongs pas shes rab bcom kyang btsun pa'i rdzur/ /bsten rnams btsun par byed la blang dor gnas/ shes par gyis zhes 'doms phyir ji snyed chos/ /ma 'dres gsal bar mkhyen la gsol ba 'debs/ khyod sku gzhen nu 'dzin ma'i lto ba mā /byang chub sems kyi chu gter chen po las/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i rba rlabs cher g.yos tshe/ /sems dpa' gzhan rnams zhum pa'i ca co sgrog /phul byung mkhyen pa'i gru rdzings la brten nas/ /bcu phrag na kra'i grong khyer rab brgal te/ /phun tshogs rtogs pa'i nor bu dbang gi rgyal/ /legs thob dge ba'i bshes gnyen ded dpon che/ /sgra tshad bzo dang gso ba snyan dngags sogs/ /thun mong rig gnas bshad tshe lha'i bla ma/ /bdag gis 'gran par nus min mkhas pa zhig /gling 'dir gnas zhes phrag dog skyes sam snyam/ /bslab gsum rdzong par byed pa'i sde snod kun/ /sngon med legs bshad gsar pas rab brgyan tshe/ /blo bzang (22ba)rgyal ba slar yang rang nyid kyi/ /ring lugs 'dzin par byon sam 'phyang mo yug /gsang snying rgyud sde'i brjod don ma lus pa/ /me lcags spra ba'i snang tshul ji bzhin du/ /dgongs pa gcig tu 'chad dang nyams bzhes tshe/ /rdo rje 'chang yang 'di las gzhan du ci/ /rnam g.yeng rlung gis 'di snang mkhar bgrod pa'i/ /'phrin las nyin byed chu bur ltar gzigs nas/ /rgya bod grub dbang kun gyi gtsug rgyan du/ /mda' bsnun zhabs de byon snyam yid la grang / /lkog gyur ma lus me long gzugs brnyan ltar/ /thogs med mkhyen pa'i dpag dka'i rnam thar 'dis/ /srid min mngal skyes — /88

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdarigs 'dzin padma 'byung / /gnyis pa gzhan zhig yod par gor ma chag /thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor zhing 'di yi/ /mdzad pa rdzogs nas zangs mdog dpal gyi rir/ /mtsho skyes sras mchog rnam rol bkod pa'i dpal/ /skal ldan 'gro la ston der gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhal dka'i yon tan dbyig 'dzin khyon yangs par/ /rdul gyi cha tshad rnam thar yid bzhin nor/ /tshig gi srad bur brgyus pa'i dge ba des/ /grangs med skye bar rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /bshes gnyen dam pa gser gyi 'khor lo yi/ /tshad med thugs rje chen po'i byed po las/ /theg mchog yangs pa'i sa la dbang bsgyur te/ /mi 'gyur kun bzang dbang phyug thob par shog /ces rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba gsum gyi rnam rol mtha' dag rdo rje 'dzin pa (23na༄na po'i gzugs can 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub de nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa dran pa'i gdung shugs kyis rkyen byas nas/ dam pa gang de'i bka' drin gyis nye bar 'tsho ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos/ snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs tshe chos la brten pa'i sdig gsog par bsams te/ 'bol rtsom shugs 'byung du sug bris byas/phul byung tshogs gnyis chu gter gnyu na/ /smon lam lhun po'i las bzang sgyu rtsal gyis/ /thub bstan kun gsal mdzes ma'i gtsug phud du/ /'gying mdzad bshes gnyen snang gter cod paṇa rgyal/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i blo gros lha lam ngos/ /gang gi mkhyen bzang lte sngon gyis drangs pas/ /legs bshad chos kyi nam mkha'i nor bu yis/ /lung rtogs sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan rnam par bzhad/ /theg gsum 'dul bya'i bcu gnyis khyim rnams su/ /las ldan sna tshogs bsam pa'i rgyu lam gyis/ /mkhas grub dbang po lho byang bgrod pa'i mtha'/ /legs par ston mdzad bshes gnyen padma'i gnyen/ /na tshod gsar pa'i blo gros 'od dkar gyis/ /mkhas mang mi lhung phreng ba'i tshogs rnams kun/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'od zer spro ba'i khur/ /ring du dor byed bshes gnyen mtshan mo'i mgon/ /ches phra dngos stobs (23ba)rigs pa'i srad bu la/ /rnam gsum sde snod nor bu'i 'phyang 'phrul gyis/ /legs brgyus gang thug sgeg mo'i lus spud pas/ /skal ldan na tshod gnas kyi dga' ston dpal/ /— /89

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shernam dpyod sor rtse'i gar las legs bshad kyis/ /rab bkra ri mo'i gzugs brnyan mkha' dbyings la/ /dbang gzhus 'byud lta'i ljongs 'di'i mkhas rlom tshig /gya gyu'i ri mo chur rlom las gzhan ci/ /rnam 'dren gsung gi yang snying bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /skal bzang yol gor gtams pa'i phung po gang / /ji snyed shes bya'i gzugs dang srang gzhal tshe/ /lci yang kun mkhyen gzigs pa'i phyi rol gyur/ /phra rags gnad kun ston pa'i ā dwarshar/ /sdom gsum ka shi mdzes pa'i bzhin gsal 'dis/ /phul byung tshul khrims lang tsho'i khur 'khyer ba'i/ /nye bar 'khor de snyems pa'i ngal ba btang / /rlabs chen spyod pa'i dri bsung cha shas kyis/ /lus can kun gyi duḥ kha'i tshad nad rnams/ /cig car bcom tshe rgyal sras rkang 'thung tshogs/ /zhi bde'i grang reg dus de skyabs bsten snyam/ /mkhas grub 'jug pa bcu pa'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /blo gros lto bar shong min nges pa'i don/ /lta 'phreng ha la brtsegs pa'i ke la sha /yongs 'dzin bde 'byung khyod kyi mgrin pa'i rgyan/ /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i rab brtan lhun po'i rtser/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i shel gyi ba gam dbus/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad gser khri (24na tshe pa/ 'gying mdzad sa gsum 'gro ba 'chi med gtso/ /snying stobs rdul gyi g.yo byed mchod sbyin dgra/ /gang gi mun rtsa'i phyugs bdag nyag phran gyis/ /mngon par bcom tshe mda' bsnun dga' ma'i bdag /bde chen chos dbyings lus med rgyalas ci/ /thob dka' zung 'jug lam gyis ma na ta/ /ma nor nges gsang brtson pa'i 'khrul 'khor las/ /gang thugs bee ḍūr do ker yangs pa'i nang / /'chang mdzad rje btsun bla ma pad dkar mig /'gag med thugs rje'i zhags pas kun gsal mtha'/ /skad cig 'ching zhes legs bris ma lus tshogs/ /rnam par 'jigs te ca co'i sgra chen pos/ /sum rtsen rdza rnga brdung ba'i tshul la brten/ /phun tshogs mkhyen pa'i rta ljang dbang po yis/ /ma rtogs lkog tu gyur pa'i sngo bsangs ma/ /lhag mar byas tshe zur phud lnga pa gang / /cung zad skyengs te khyod kyi mgrin par yibs/ /'dren byed mkha' mkha' phyogs kyi grags ldan pa/ /mchod sbyin brgya pas 'phrin las pha mtha'i tshad/ /ston phyir sprul la drang srong mthus grub ces/ /sngon byung gtam du grags pa don 'dir — /9(/

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdakhums/ /rje btsun mchog gi yon tan na kra'i grong / /gting mtha' 'jal ba'i gzings la legs zhugs tshe/ /kun mkhyen ded dpon la yang skyid skyur nor/ /ster byed tshul 'di'i phra mo'i cha shas tsam/tshig phreng spel ba'i bsil zer mdangs 'dzin dges/ /grangs (24ba)med 'gro rnams yongs 'dzin bla ma'i zhabs/ /rab bstan mi dman rjes 'dzin skal bzang dpal/ /'bral med spyi gtsug rgyan du rtag mdzes shing / /dad dang mos par ldan pa'i skye dgu rnams/ /dam chos ga bur 'dzag ba'i zla shel las/ /sgrib gnyis tsha gdung legs bcom phan bde'i 'od/ /mi 'gyur bde chen gsal ba nyid gyur cig /khyad par 'gro 'di'i phan bde'i ku mu ta/ /rgyas phyir gzugs sku'i ri dwags mtshan ma can/ /nag phyogs sna tshogs gtsug phud las rgyal te/ /thub bstan lha lam dbus su brtan par shog /deng 'dir rnam dkar smon pa'i sa bon mchog /mtha' yas tshig gi zhing sar legs btab pa/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i gru char las/ /don bzang myu gu'i 'dod 'jo rgyas gyur cig /ces mkhan po rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la bstod pa pad dkar chun po zhes bya ba 'di yang / /gzhung lugs la blta ba'i rnam dpyod can gling chos rje mgon po rnam rgyal gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ /mgrin pa'i rdzir bur dbyangs can 'khor lo'i yan lag gi zlos gar rnam par bsgyur ba'i rig byed 'dzin pa tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjes bris pa'o/ /ka phreng dbyangs gsal 'dus pa'i yi ge'i tshogs/ kha ba'i ljongs 'dir bsgyur ba'i rnam dpyod dri/ /ga bur gsar pa'i ngad ltar ldang ba yis/ /nga rgyal rmongs pa'i tsha gdung ring (25na)du bcom/ /ca sogs 'phags pa'i yul gyi yig khrod du/ /cha shas tsam yang med pa'i yi ge drug /ja chang tshig gi sbyor ba byed pa'i slad/ /nya rgyas sngon med gsar pa'i zla ltar shar/ /ta la'i lo mar bris pa'i rgya dpe kun/ /tha dad tshig don khong du chud byas pas/ /da lta'i bar du snyan grags dbyar skyes rnga/ /na tshod gzhen nu'i lang tsho ji bzhin 'bar/ /pa sangs mdog ltar mtha' 'khob bsil ldan ljongs/ /pha mthar dam pa'i chos kyis ches dkar bas/ /ba glang tshul can blang dor la rmongs pa/ /ma lus dpyod — /9/ —

rgyal dbang snga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya ma tsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheldan sa la bkod de mtshar/ /tsa na yin yang chos ldan rgyal po'i drung / /tsha zer nyi 'od snyems 'phros mdun na 'don/ /dza bo'i shing ltar legs pa'i yon tan spel/ /wa skyes ngang tshul ston la lhag par brtse/ /zha yig 'khyil 'dra'i chen por 'os pa'i rgyan/ /za byed gdong lnga'i gzi brjid la 'gong ba/ /'a cag ya rabs skye bo'i cha lugs su/ /ya mtshan ngo mtshar grangs med sgo 'phar phye/ /rwa gdengs rdo rje dang mtshungs rig pa'i mdas/ /la lar mi shes rmongs pa'i brag ri bcom/ kha sha dha ra'i 'od 'dra'i mkhyen yangs kyis/ /sa steng skye bo'i blo yi ku mud phye/ /ha ha dbyangs su len pa'i dga' ston dbus/ /a sogs bod yig sum cu las brtsams nas/ /ha zhes dga' ba'i 65byem bcas legs sad gtam/ /a mra ta bzhin dngar ba thon mi'i drin/ /(25ba)gangs ri'i khrod pa rnams la bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa thon mi sa sto ṭa la ka phreng las brtsams pa'i ched du brjod pa 'di ni/ /za hor gyi bande snyan ngag mkhan tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjes dran grub tu byas pa'o/ /me byi zla 3tshes 20la gnang /su sti/ phul byung blo gros rnam dpyod dbyar skyes rnga/ /skal bzang gtsug phud can gyi thos 'dzin du/ /dga' ba'i 'dod pa 'jo ba'i grags snyan can/ /rgyal mchog tsong kha pa la spyi bos 'dud/ /me khyi zla tshes la bstan 'dzin la gnang /phul byung ngag gi dpal grub dbang phyug brgyad/ /lhun grub blo bzang rgyal ba'i 'phrin las sgo//rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu khyab mdzad pa'i/ /bla med rdo rje rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi mthun zil gnon zhi rgyas dbang drag las/ /thogs med grub pa'i nus mthu'i rtsol ldan pa/ /'khor lo'i gtso gyur rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor ba'i ngang tshul bzod dka' mar gyur 'gro/ /ma rig 'khrul pas 'khyam pa'i tshul bsams nas/ /'khrul med rig pa'i ngo bo kun tu bzang / /mthong phyir theg mchog lam la 'jug par shog /tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub la bar gcod cing / /bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /(26na tshe zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod gang 'tsham gyis/ /'dul ba'i 'phrin las thogs med grub par shog /dge legs rtsa — /92

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa (bkab bla mar yid ches te/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i rigs 'dzin kun 'dus pa'i/ /padma'i phyi nang gsang gsum zab mo'i lam/ /bla sgrub nyams su longs par byin gyis rlobs/ zhi khro kun 'dus sgrub pa bka' brgyad tshogs/ /spyi dang bye brag sngon nas las 'brel lha/ /bsnyen cing bsgrubs pas mchog mthun dngos grub rnams/ /'bad med (26ba〉skrun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'bad med sems kyis lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor gyis sems kyis chos kun cho 'phrul du/ /rjen par mthong ba'i gsal stong rig pa'i gshis/ /mnyam rjes gnyis med dug lnga rang grol ba'i/ /ka dag lta ba rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgya zhags chu sgron nyams blang pas/ /thig le phyag mtshan sku sogs 'phel ba las/ /lhun grub lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin te/ /gdod ma'i mgon po thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /ji snyed bsags pa'i dge tshogs mthu dpung las/ /bstan dang skye dgu'i phan bde legs 'phel zhing / /dngos grub 'byung gnas rigs 'dzin bla ma mchog /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khri la brtan gyur cig /ces gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di lta bu zhig bgyis zhes/ sngon rgyal blon gyi dus kyi lo tsā pa lang 'gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyi gdung las byung ba'i rig sngags 'chang ba rta nag sgrol ma phug nas kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar/ shas bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'khor lo la/ /med byung snying stobs ri mo bkra ba can/ /legs byas 'bum phrag bdud tsi 'dzag pa yi/ /(27na)zas gtsang sras po chu shel dbang po rgyal/rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i zil mngar tshogs/ /blo gros za ma tog 'chang ba'i/ /mdzad bzang rab snyan grags pa'i dbyangs/ /kun gyi sgra 'dzin rgyan de mdzes/ /mtha' dag gzugs can/ grangs med rig gnas rgya mtsho che/ /mang thos rnam dpyod kyis 'thung pa'i/ /mkhas mchog drang srong gsung bcud kyi/ /phreng ba 'dzin de 'jig rten mig /ngo mtshar cha shas gzugs can/ mdzes sdug shel dkar zhun ma'i khams/ /g.yon mig gzugs kyi 'khor lor 'khyil ba las/ /'jo sgeg mtshan dpe'i ri dwags zlos gar can/ /dbyangs can ma kye bdag blo'i kunda skyongs/ /nam yang 'dzad pa med pa'i tshogs gnyis yan lag bzhi — /93

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdagazhaX dka'i gnad/ /gnad 'gag ma lus ji bzhin ston mkhas ston pa gnyis pa blo bzang grags/ /grags snyan phyogs bral kun la rab 'jebs rab yangs dri med rnam dpyod mchog /mchog dman 'gro la bshes gnyen tshul gyis tshul khrims ldan pa'i sdom brtson can/ /(28na)snyan snyan bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan rkang pa bzhi ma'i thog mar gnyis yod pa la gzugs can phul byung gsum 'dres pa'i rab spel/ ga smi ra pa'i kun 'khor rgyud/ /'grig 'grig tshig gi sbyor bas legs brdungs pas/ /lhang lhang bstod cing bsngags pa'i sgra dbyangs 'dis/ /sgeg sgeg smin legs glu yi khengs pa phrogs/ thog ma'i zung ldan/ yang yang skye bar brgyud pa'i che tshugs dang / /btsun btsun gdung rus rigs kyis ma mtho dang / /mkhas mkhas ming tsam lhur len ma yin pa'i/ /'grig 'grig shes bya 'chad mkhas shong dpang brgyud/ /brgyud mtha' thog sbyar pa gang de'i ring lugs bzung ba'i tshe/ /tshe 'dir rmongs pa'i gral ring spong ba dang / /dang po'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs tshul yang / /yang yang goms pa/ grogs ltar ngang gis 'khor/ /'khor 'das 'jug ldog klu sgrub thogs med gzhung / /gzhung lugs chen pos ngoms tshe snyan rgyud du/ /du mar grags pa'i phyag rgya'i sgom pa khyu/ khyu brdal rgyu ba rmongs pa'i gar las ci/ cha shas gzugs can/shin tu sra ba rgyal ba'i gsung gi gzhu/ /mkhyen pa'i rgyud kyis 'gugs la zla bral ba'i/ /grags pa don ldan rnam thar 'di mthong bas/ kha che'i kun 'khor sgo nas bsngags par spro/ /spyi tsam gyi bsdus brjod/'chi med lam gyi phyogs kun chu 'dzin rnams/ /lang long g.yo zhing 'brug sgra sgrog pa la/ /mjug sgro can (28ba)tshogs dga' ba'i zlos gar dang / /skad snyan 'byin la rgol ba'i klan ka su/ /rab dkar dge ba'i nyin byed dbang po yis/ /mi shes mun pa'i smag rum drungs phyung nas/ /chos kun lta ba'i 'od stong cher 'bar bas/ /don gnyis padma'i tshal de rgyas gyur cig /ces dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po la /smi ra'i kun 'bor gyi sgo nas bstod pa tambu ra'i rgyud mang zhes bya ba 'di yang / gnam skos gyi rgyal po phag mo gru pa'i blon po/ rgya gar gyi rgyal rigs su la pa chen po za hor gyi rigs las byung ba'i btsun pa/ bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas cung — 195

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang ble bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shezad bslabs pas phyogs tsam shes pa'i snyan ngag mkhan/ tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes dam pa de nyid la rgyu mtshan gyi nges pa rnyed nas mi 'phrog pa'i dang ba'i dad pas sbyar ba sab dwa dza — /su sdi pra dza saḥbade chen 'gyur ba med pa'i slong yangs las/ /'gro la rjes chags snying rje chen po'i gzugs/ /ston mdzad 'jig rten dbang phyug pad dkar 'dzin/ /bsil ldan lha gcig dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /mtsho skyes rdo rjes rjes bzung gtsug lag 'dzin/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug dkon mchog 'bangs/ /skye ba'i zlos gar srong (29na)btsan sgam po'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so dus kun thugs rjes gzigs/ /'jam dpal rnam 'phrul tshangs pa lha'i me tog /bdud sde'i gshed du mnga' bdag khri ral rje/ /lha chos bdun ldan mes po 'brom ston la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dus kun thugs rjes gzigs/ /phyag rdor dngos 'grub kha che dgon pa ba/ /gsang chen mnga' bdag sa chen kun snying zhabs/ /grub rigs gtsug rgyan 'gro mgon g.yu brag pa/ gsol ba 'debs so dus kun thugs rjes gzigs/ /zab don gter gyi sgo 'byed mnga' bdag nyid/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid lha rje dge ba 'bum/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mthar son dge 'dun grub/ /gsol ba 'debs so dus kun thugs rjes gzigs/ ta shes bya kun mkhyen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ /mthu stobs dbang po gu na sa ga ra/ /gsol ba 'debs so dus kun thugs rjes gzigs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal zil gnon gyis/ /rjes bzung blo gros bzang po'i skul ba can/ /gsang chen dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid mchog /gsol ba 'debs so dus kun thugs rjes gzigs/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin dang mi 'bral zhing / /thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs sngon song nas/ /theg mchog zab mo'i chos la 'jug par shog /dbang bzhis legs smin rang lus lhar bsgom pa'i/ /zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zlos gar can/ /gsal stong 'dzin med 'od gsal dag pa'i sems/ /rang grol ka dag rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lhun (29ba)grub snang ba bzhi yi zab mo'i lam/ /legs ston — 196

bla ma'i bstod chegs kyi rim pa/ (bdatheg pa'i yang rtse rdzogs pa che/ /nyams su bstar bas tshe 'dir kun tu bzang / /mngon du 'gyur ba'i dga' ston rgyas par shog /gnas skabs su yang dam can dran 'khol ba'i/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med rab grub cing / /mthar thug go 'phang gdod ma'i mgon thob nas/ /don gnyis dpal 'byor 'grub pa'i bkra shis sna(ga /ces pa 'di yang sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ za hor gyi rigs las a wa dhū ti pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar/ngag gi dpal mnga' dbang phyug brgyad ldan pa'i/ /blo bzang ring lugs rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhir/ /rab spel 'jigs pa med pa'i go cha can/ /thub bstan lang tsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du/ /lhun grub 'chi ba med pa'i mgon po ltar/ /skal bzang skye dgu'i bsod nams nor 'dzin gzhir/ /zhabs pad yongs 'du'i dbang po brtan gyur cig /dge tshogs mthu yis gnas skabs mi mthun pa'i/ /nyer 'tshe'i 'jigs pa ma lus rab zhi zhing / /tshe dpal stobs 'byor rgyas pa'i yon tan kun/ /dkar phyogs zla ga 'ozhe lta bur rgyas par shog /bshul ring skye ba'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe/ /ngan song (30na)sdug bsngal kun gyis rab dben pa'i/ /mngon mtho lha mi'i lus rten bzang po la/ /'bad med longs su spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe rabs kun tu bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ /'bral med brtse bas rjes su nyer bzung zhing / /mchog thun dngos grub dga' ston legs 'grub pa'i/ /don gnyis dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa yang er ti ni da las bā dur gyis bskul ba ltar ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar/na ma padma ka ra ya/ phul byung ngo mtshar rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i khams/ /sku gsum gsang ba mi zad 'khor lo'i dpyid/ /dngos grub bye ba'i 'byung gnas dbang gi rgyal/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde chen 'chi med ngo bo 'od dpag med/ /med byung snying rje'i gter gyur pad dkar 'chang / /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs padma 'byung / /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyi gzigs/ /mgon des rjes bzung las can dag pa'i 'khor/ nam mkha'i snying po tshangs pa — 197

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shelha'i me tog /mtsho rgyal rdo rje bdud 'joms mu khri btsan/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyi gzigs/ /zab don gter gyi sgo 'byed bzang po grags/ /lung bstan ji bzhin bka' babs rgod ldem can/ /las can chos bdag sngags 'chang rdo rje dpal/ /(30ba)gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /rigs 'dzin gdung tshob byams pa bshes gnyen zhabs/ /lha brag gter gyi srol 'dzin sangs rgyas dpal/ /grub mchog dbang po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /sde brgyad bran 'khol yol mo shākya bzang / /snyigs dus padma 'byung gnas rgyal tshab mchog /mnga' ris rigs 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje la/ gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /rgod ldem thugs sras sangs rgyas byams bzang 'khas/ /drag sngags mthu grub se ston nyi ma bzang / /'chi med rigs 'dzin brnyes pa'i mgon bzang la/gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mgon po zla ba'i zhabs/ /bla chen stag tsha'i gdung 'dzin nub dgon pa/gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /mnga' ris rigs 'dzin nub dgon chos rje gnyis/ /gtsug bsten snga 'gyur bka' gter bstan pa'i bdag /bkra shis stobs rgyal che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /rigs chos thugs sras ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs/ /gnyags kyi ban : dzña na ku ma ra'i/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar 'jam mgon ananta/gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs phyag rgya zil gnon gyis/ /rjes bzung blo gsal skal bzang kun gyi mgon/ /gsang snying dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /gter gyi sgo 'byed kha byang lde mig dang / /srong btsan gyis bskrun grom pa'i gtsug lag khang / ngo mtshar gter gnas rgyang gi yon po lung / gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /mdo rgyud gnad don kun tshang le'u bdun/ /gsol 'debs (31na)gter bsrung dge bsnyen nor bu bzang / /dpal ldan lha mo dre'u — 198

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (ba)zhen rdzu 'phrul can/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /thun drug g.yel med tshul bzhin nyams blangs pas/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs mdun ma 'grub byed pa'i/ /rdo rje'i spun grogs las can snying gi bu/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /brtson pas gsol btab mthu yis las ldan rnams/ /tshe 'dir mngon sum padmas zhal bstan nas/ /tha mal lus 'di ma spangs dag pa'i zhing / /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor 'khrid par shog /tshul de 'grub par 'gyur ba'i mthu dman na/ /'chi ba 'od gsal shar tshe padma 'byung / /sngar 'dris grogs dang phrad pa ji bzhin du/ /dbugs phyung bde chen dbyings su 'khrid par shog /zhi rgyas dbang drag rab 'byams 'phrin las rnams/ /zab don gnad kyi 'khrul med nyams len gyis/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dregs pa'i tshogs/ /las su bkol te don kun grub par shog /brjod du bral ba gnyug ma sems kyi rtsal/ /gdod nas dag pa dbyings rig kun tu bzang / /gsal stong 'dzin pa med pa chos kyi skur/ /ngo 'phrod ka dag lta ba rtogs par shog /mngon sum gong 'phel tshangs phebs zad pa yi/ /'od gsal snang bzhi'i lam kun nyams bstar bas/ /sku gsum yon tan ma lus lhun grub pa'i/ /kun bzang ye grol sa la mngon 'gyur shog /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin (31ba)padma ka ra yi/ /gsang gsum mi zad mthu stobs gzi byin dang / /bdag sogs snying nas gdung ba'i gsol 'debs kyi/ /med byung rten 'brel mthun pa'i rgyu tshogs las/ /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs blo gros bzang pos nyer btag gzhi/ /legs byas rgya mtsho chen po 'byung gnas gang / /'gyur med rdo rje'i khri la zhabs brtan shog /slob dpon chen po chos rgyal rnam gnyis sku'i/ /sprul pa nyang ban nyi ma 'od zer gyi/ /zlos gar legs bsgyur bla med rdo rje rtsal/ /bskal brgyar mi 'gyur zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /rtsa gsum thugs rje chen po'i yid bzhin nor/ /gangs can phan bde'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod pa'i/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i 'dod dgu'i char/ /phyogs dus kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma'i brgyud 'debs smon lam/ de dang 'brel bar brtan — 199

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebazhugs kyi tshigs bcad dang gnas pa zhig dgos zhes/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi bya 'dabs su 'a91da pa'i tshes bcu ba khag bzhis spyi tshogs nas bskul bar brten/ sa glang hor zla drug pa'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu'i nyin za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos pho brang chen po po ta la'i gzims chung khams gsum zil gnon du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /rgyal ba kun dngos blo bzang grags pa yi/ gdung tshab lung (32na)rtogs lang tsho dar bab pa'i/ /ma smad legs bshad 'byung ba'i rin chen gter/ tags bya thams cad mkhyen par gsol ba 'debs/ /dbyangs can mgrin par chags pa'i zhal sgo las/ /gsung rab ga ṅga skyug mkhas rnam dpyod kyis/ /bgrang yas gdul bya'i skal ldan shing rta yi/ /re skong drang srong chen por gsol ba 'debs/phra zhing zhib pa rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad/ /'jigs med gdong lnga'i dbyangs su blangs ba'i sgras/ /rgol ngan ri dwags srog rtsa 'dar byed pa'i/ /sngon med sha ra bha la gsol ba 'debs/ /lung don rigs par sgril ba'i srad bu la/ /'khrul pa'i dri bral mdo rgyud musti ka /legs brgyus rgyal bstan lus phra'i mgul brgyan tshe/ /sgyu ma'i khengs pa bskyungs der gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro rnams thos bsam sgom pa'i gru gzings la/ /brten nas 'khor ba'i chu gter las bsgral te/ /sku gsum nor bur spyod pa'i ded dpon che/ /mkhas grub yongs kyi dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /de lta'i dge tshogs nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /bsod nams gangs kyi ri bo bzhu ba'i chu/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgya mtsho cher/ /'bab pa'i skal pa bzang por bdag gyur cig /ces rgyal ba gnyis pa'i thugs kyi sras mchog rgyal tshab rin po che dar ma rin chen la bstod pa 'di ni/ /za hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i blo'i me long du shar ba'o/ /(32ba)—200

bla ma' bstad chags kya ram pa/khobadeslob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas sogs 'phags bod kyi bla ma rnams la bstod pa bzhugs so//su waṃ sdeb sbyor mgo sha dbyangs//swā mya lha khya〈gu shā bishwa na nirmā sku tsā ko hā/bgrang med rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod//sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar mdzad mtsho skyes rje/dzñā dwa yu sha stu nu bhā7stoṭa spo kla sharasebardzi khri ya://mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthu yis gangs can ljongs//phan bde'i 'od kyis dbang mdzad spyi bor bsten//(33na)pañtsa lha kañtsa ku lā sa hore mā rje ba ṅgā smaya hā mo li ratnaḥ//med byung za hor rigs kyi chu gter dbus//gnas lnga rig pa'i nor bu'i cod paṇa can/shrīX2kā su pa rdu:go mi ko hā mi lha:sprenag stog shum nā/mkhas btsun bzang po'i gdengs ka g.yo ba yi//mar me mdzad dpal klu yi dbang por bsngags//budha du:na go:ba gu mo hā mā ti a mo rmukhā〈mrita mā lha//rtogs dka' rnam 'dren gsung gi ba ku la/ /blo gros bzhin bzang kha chang zil dngar gyis/ru ci riṣa bha3tsaka rā/kirti ka mePROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBsaṃ//rnam par bzhad pa grags pa'i dbyar skyes rnga//srid 'di mdzes par byed khyod rgyal gyur cig/33ba thamā nyukra ātpa ka lha//bar lwa ro:ti nd+ra su//dpal ldan 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can//theg mchog 'byor par legs dbang ba'i//ni rā stog byudi nā paḥn mo sregs ṇi kra//lhun gyis grub pa'i gdod ma'i mgon//lag rtser rtsol bar mdzad la 'dud/ces sho lo ka dang pos gu ru mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje/gnyis pas dpal mar me mdzad/gsum pas rje bdag nyid chen po blo bzang grags pa/bzhi pas 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'byor lhun grub la bstod pa 'di yang /lang ga'i grong khyer sa la 'phos 'dra/shar phyogs 'ol kha stag rtse'i gzims khang khams gsum gyi sgo 'gram mdzes byed du blo gros zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du shar ba'i rgyan tshig ri dwags kyi gzugs can no//(34na)a mas ra ṇi ṅgārma shun mo pa ti nā ri bha ke mi:/2 0 ཿste nu ru pa stanā kyi:u pa pā li te32khya hāswā da/spro:

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzas rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (she.ā ne7〉bi pā kā stu pa rte dza sri//bgrang med sku gsum mngon par dga' ba'i tshig gi mda' can rdzing ring dbyings su zlos gar sgyur gyi me tog can//mkhas grub rkang 'thung nor bu'i 'phreng bzang sdud pa'i lang tshos rgya mtsho'i mar gsar snyems pa 'phrog byed rgyal gyur cig /34ba)sbaPROBPROBmi yi dza te brtas〉do ṅgā mo〉ṅgā towe pa gyi blo gros bdag rigs 'dzam bu'i gser du bsgyur las bsgrubs pa yi/dzñā na par tsa yuPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBta:badzre hi thos la bha bā a nu/lo dzha mi rbu tsakre ṇa brte stu pa rlud ni tre//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa mchog gi ye shes sa rṣa gling bzhir 'dren par byed la thogs bcas dang //bral ba'i stobs ldan rdo rje'i rnal 'byor kun la 'khor los sgyur khyod srid pa gsum gyi mdza' ba'i bshes//35na khri spyond+rathista/dza ya pa lo shrī/ra so bha ri to dhar shudha tsa bha war gron kasmi sbyo pa hā//'ja' rsā ltar bkra dag pa'i rang bzhi gzung du med pa'i lding khang nas//gya nom ro ldan 'bras bu'i khur 'chang ljon pa'i gling 'dir rgyal ba kun/nya ge ṇa nu dzā ga pra tseng na res bsgo bre hā bha bsdu9yab sde zhi toḥpus ra〉nus stoduste re//'gro la rjes su chags pas /aṅgā lta de shan dzibha btsa3rgya3baḥ〈phyag ddha ru cir kāntaXdzā yakā ye/ /mtha' yas legs byas tshogs kyi 'dod pa'i myos bum las//gcig tu dkar por 'dzag pa'i 'bras bzang bde gshegs kyi//mdzes sdug gnyis gzugs graXs kyi yon to gang gi skur//yongs su rdzogs

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdepas skye rgur rnam 'dren dngos su bstan/ /pra ma lhar tri bha bi ta ni stoṣa dharmā mā la tsa yan kṣa sa:/ /me suragure su mi ka stoṭi 'oḥ su bha ba b.raṇḍa hāḥ/ /rab snyan rgyud pas theg pa gsum gyi chos/ /sgra dbyangs mi zad 'byung ba'i smra ba'i stegs/ /drug cu'i gsung bcud kyis bltams za ma tog /bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'di skal ba bzang / /(36na)sgo tsā ra3bla tsitta koṣa me ā sa rbu pā na spo bishānta su bhaṇḍa dza ne taṅgā tā gro pra biṣṭatu/ /thugs kyi mdzod du shes bya kun/ /gang bar mdzad pa'i mkhyen dpyod gzugs/ ti shong ba'i yol go skrun pa la/ /gser mngal can de ngal snyam byed/ /bde bar bta shegs pa'i ye shes rang snang snang mdzod ji bzhin mi shes mun pa bcom pa'i rgyud/ /rgyud mang glu las chos kyi dbyangs snyan snyan par sgrog pa'i thos 'dzin yul du 'khrul ster ma/ /ma 'dris mtha' klas 'gro ba'i mdza' bshes bshes gnyen dam pa'i g.yo med zhabs zung 'khor lo mchog /mchog gi yan lag rtser bkod tshul 'dzin 'dzin dang bklag sogs chos spyod bcu la sbyangs pa'i tshul/ /tshul min mi shes dri ma phyung yang yang dag mdzad pa 'di ko bstan pa na/ /na tshod smin pa'i khur gyis rab mtho mtho ris 'dren pa tshangs dbang pad dkar mig /mig gsum pa dang 'gro ba'i shing rta rta bdun dkar po glang po'i gdong can ma/ /ma drug la sogs snyems pa can kun kun chos dga' bas gtsug tu khyod bsten na/ /na rga skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal tshogs zhi zhi bar mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /'das dang ma (36ba tshe sdongs dus gsum kun mkhyen mkhyen pa'i bla med ye shes gang / /gang 'dir lag rtser stsol bar mdzad nges nges pa'i blo rnyed skyabs dang mgon/ /mgon khyod mtshungs zla gzhan du med de de phyir zas gtsang sras nyid dpe/ /mang thos mkhas pa'i gru gzings la brten nas/ /grub mchog yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal/ /skal bzang skye bor ston pa'i ded dpon che/ /lung rtogs 'dod dgus rgya mtsho'i gos can bkang / /rmad byung mu mtha' bral ba'i blo gros kyis/ /gnas lnga'i rig pa mkhyen la mtshar du ci/ /gzod ma nyid nas rdzogs pa'i stobs bcu'i rtsal/ /'di yis shes bya kun mkhyen bstan min nam/ /gsung rab mtha' dag sgrib gnyis spong thabs su/ /gdams par dgongs khyod 'dod la mi dgyes —2()3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shekyang / /chags sogs lam spyod theg pa lhur mdzad pas/ /'dod yon 'dor ba gzhan ngo tsam du khums/ /mgon khyod byon no mkhyen pas mkhas pa'i rtser/ /bag yod myur blangs btsun pa'i go 'phangs la/ /bdag gachan brjes pas rgyal sras rnams kyi gtsug /phyi nang gakṣ-i na ga sdo/ma sbyar bas sangs rgyas sar/ /da phyo da ldan gdul bya'i rna bar chos kyi rnga/ /sgrog la shing rta che dang rje btsun gang /rab mtshungs klu sgrub rgya gar paṇa chen gtsug /rje btsun gangs khrod mkhas pa'i bla na mdzes/ ma smad sbyangs pa'i bgrod byed brgyad rdzogs shing / /mi bzad rigs pa'i ster mo'i rno dbal gyis/ /phas rgol gdong lnga pa la 'chi ba'i sbyin/ /ster khyod snga na med pa'i sha ra bha/ /phra rags drang dang nges pa'i bā ku la'i/ /ji bzhin 'byed rka'i tshig don 'dab ma'i kha/ /rnam dpyod lus phra'i 'gram chang gis phye ba/ /sngon med legs bshad glegs bu'i ze'u 'bru ldem/ phyi nang gtsug lag rigs gzhud 'byams klas par/ /dpyod la tsand+ra go mi dus zhabs pa/ /la kṣi ka ra dpal ldan dpa' bo'i sde/ /(37na)sangs rgyas bskyangs rnams ji bzhin rnam par mkhas/ /nye reg rnyog bral tshangs spyod 'dab ma brgya/ /'dzum las tshul khrims ge sar rgyas pa can/ /gsal stong phyag rgya'i bung bas drangs pa'i khams/ /sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston mi srid srid pa'i dpe/ /'pho med bde ba'i dbyar gyi dpal mo'i sgo/ /mkha' stong phyogs mig sa hā kā ra'i shing / /dri bzang kha sbyor yan lag bdun grub pa'i/ /brgya pa'i tshe yun grangs med bskal gsum rdzogs/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang thog ma'i mgon po yi/ /lung rtogs gsar ldan lci pa'i nyes bshad kyis/ /bying tshe mkhyen pa'i mchu ring gis 'degs pa'i/ khur 'dis bde bar gshegs rnams zhi bar mnal/ /snying rje'i gzhan dbang dpyid kyi ma ma las/ /lus srog gtong phod mchod sbyin nam mkha'i gos/ /grags snyan dbyar rnga bsgrags pas thos sgrog rnams/ /theg chen rigs kyi mdongs mtha'i mngal 'jin snyam/ /g.yo med goms pa'i shugs ldan ting 'dzin las/ /nus pa'i 'dab ldan mtshon cha'i 'khyog 'bar gyis/ /nag po'i yid brlams ster bcas sngon gyi lha/ /mthar byed khyod la rgol ba'i klan ka su/ /bu ram shing pa'i rjes zhugs bshes gnyen nang / /mkhas dang —204

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdagrub pa'i dpal khyod nges mchis te/ /gzhan gyis btang snyoms kyis bod dka' gnad mdud/ /bkrol ba'i bstan bcos 'di rnams gang las byung / /phul byung blo gros dbyig 'dzin rtser son pa'i/ /ring lugs rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang nas/ /zab don dgongs 'grel 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /grags pa skal ldan lus phra'i rna bar 'jebs/ /stong gzugs gser sbyangs reg bya gar dgu'i mdangs/ /ngur smrig tshon ris bkra ba'i me long ngos/ /(37bskor tshe su la'i ljongs su padma dkar/ /gnas zhes sham bha la ru gtam du gleng / /kun gsal mtha' ltar blo gros yangs kyang yon tan tshogs kyis dog por bkod/ /legs gsung chos kyis nyon mongs bcil yang tshig don glu la mkhas rnams sred/ /mi slob zung 'jug mngon du gyur kyang sangs rgyas 'thob phyir sgrub la gzhol/ /gsang gsum mdzad pa gting mtha' bral yang nyam chung bdag 'dra brjod snyam byed/ /bshes gnyen mchog gi si rgyu'i bdag po dman pa'i blo gros dag gi gshog rtses bskyod pa las/ /bla na med pa'i rtogs pa'i gdengs can rjen par legs mthong lung gi phud sgra sgrog 'dod pa'i/ /ngal ba 'dzin 'di mkha' la ri mo bri dang mtshungs mod 'on kyang dus mkhyen rgyal po ltar/ /do slar bral ba'i dge ba'i dngos po rnam dkar dri med ga bur chu rgyun 'babs pa yis/ /lan gcig min par sdug bsngal gsum gyi tsha bas mnar ba'i srid pa'i me 'obs chen po na/ /ma rig 'khrul ba'i snang bar zhen pa'i bud shing tshogs kyis bskyed pa las byung nyam thag pa'i/ /lus can kun gyi tsha ba'i nad rnams ma lus bcoms nas thar pa'i bsil khang nyams dga' bar/ /gnas ste rnyog bral rdzing bur 'jug pa'i dka' thub la brten bde chen rgyal ba'i sa 'grub shog /nor 'dzin lus phra'i lto bar dung ba'i sde bzhi'i 'dod rgu rab 'khyil bar/ /nam mkha'i sgo glegs brgya phrag las 'ongs mtho ris dpal la dbang ba'i lha/ /rtsod pa'i dus su stobs kyi 'khor lo thogs med bsgyur ba'i bka' khrims kyi/ /gser gyi gnya' shing nyi zla ji srid gnas bar de srid lci gyur cig /bde legs chu klung 'bum phrag tshogs rnams dus kun dge ba'i lhung lhung sgrar bcas dal gyis 'bab ba'i khur/ /mun pa'i go skabs —203

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshering spangs sgron me'i bskal (38na)pa'i sa 'dzin dkar por lnga bdo'i tshul la 'jigs bral ba'i/ /snying stobs rtsal gsum yongs rdzogs nyi ma'i gnyen gyur 'phrog byed lus ngag yid gyi bstan pa'i yang snying mchog /blo bzang rgyal ba'i mi zad nga ro'i rgyud kyi dbyangs 'di'i grags pa srid mtha'i bar du 'bar gyur cig /ces gangs can ljongs kyi mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi shing rta'i srol 'byed dus zhabs pa chen po mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho dpal bzang po la bstod pa/ tas ra'i dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di yang / dam pa gang gi sku brnyan ye shes sems dpa' dngos su bzhugs pa'i sgo rgyan mdzes byed du/ yul lho phyogs sman ljongs su byung ba'i za hor gyi rgyud las rig byed pa tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjes/ 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ge sku bltams pa'i dus chen sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogasakyi tshes bdun la/ sa la spyod pa'i mtho ris kyi grong khyer pho brang 'ol dga' stag rtse'i gzims chung khams gsum du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /su snyi pra dza sa/ /rmad byung rab dmar chu skyes rigs 'dzin pa'i/ /rgyal kun thugs rje'i rnam rol ma lus pa/ /rgyal sras gzhen nu'i skur bstan pad dkar 'chang / /'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro 'di shis pa stsol/ /bskal pa du mar lha yi rgyal bo dang / khye'u gsal ba dkon mchog 'bangs la sogs/ /bram ze rgyal rigs du ma'i rnam rol gyis/ /dpag med gzhan phan mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i byed po yis/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir rnam 'dren bstan pa'i dbu/ /thog mar brnyes pa'i tho ri snyan shal zhes/ /sbas pa'i brtul lugs 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /(38ba〉pas can bsod nams zhing mchog rgyal ba'i sku/ /rab bzhengs 'dren dang bzhugs gnas gtsug lag khang / /bgrang yas spel te rgyal bstan thog ma'i srol/ /legs btod srong btsan sgam por gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis bskul te/ /mkhan slob gnyis sogs lo paṇa spyan drangs nas/ /mdo sngags 'chad sgom bstan pa rgyas mdzad pa'i/ khri srong lde'u btsan 'bas la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs 'dir skyes bu gsum gyi lam srol rnams/ /ches —206

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdacher nyams pa gso phyir a ti sha'i/ /sras kyi thu bo 'brom ston pad dkar 'dzin/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /lung bstan ji bzhin skye med rgyud pa'i mthar/ /gdod ma'i ye shes mngon gyur rig sngags 'chang / /zab gter bstan pa'i bdag po myang ral rje/ /nyi ma 'od zer zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /theg mchog snying po'i rnam 'byor sbas pa'i tshul/ /'phrul snang gtsug lag rgyas phyir srong btsan gyi/ /sprul pa'i gar du bzhengs pa dge ba 'bum/ /rig 'dzin 'gro ba'i srog 'tshor gsol ba 'debs/ /bgrang med rnam dkar dge tshogs rgya mtsho la/ /mngon par 'dun pa'i 'bras mchog yongs smin pa'i/ /mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan chos kyi rje/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gnas mchog sbas pa'i yul/ /mtsho skyes gsang gter lam yig ji bzhin du/ /gnas sgo rab phye blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan/ /rgyas mdzad ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams zhing gi yul mchog rgyal ba'i gtso/ /glegs bam lung bzhin rgya mtsho'i gos can mtha'/ /kun khyab gdul dka'i lus can ma lus par/ /phul (39na jung phan bde stsol la gsol ba 'debs/ /mthon po'i rigs las skyes thob yon tan gyi/ /rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' tshad kyis gzhal ba bzhin/ /skye rgu'i nyer 'tsho 'dod 'jo dbang gi rgyal/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro ba'i don du 'khrul med skye ba sa /legs brgyud tshogs la bstod pa'i dge ba yis/ /theg mchog snying po'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /skye ba kun tu rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /ces glegs bam rin po che'i gzungs rabs rnams gcig tu bsdus shing bod 'di'i skyes rabs rnams 'thar chags kun bsgrigs pa 'di yang dka' bcu pa ngag dbang bsod nams kyis nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ rdo rje 'chang chen po dpal 'byor lhun grub gyi gsung gi rgyun rnams zhabrul med khungs thub tu gor ma chag pas gzhi byas/ cung zad phri bsnan bgyis te/ za hor gyi rigs kyi bande sdom bu pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ /na mo wa gi shwa ra pra hā ṇa ye/ /chos dbyings lha lam yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sna tshogs —207

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegazugs sku'i tsha zer rab 'phro bas/ /las ldan gdul bya'i puṇḍa ri ga'i tshal/ /rgyas mdzad yongs 'dzin nam mkha'i nor bur 'dud/ /rab brjid bee dzā ra yi sa 'dzin la/ /nor bu'i 'bri shing dag gis 'byud 'dra ba'i/ shes rab rgyud sde'i 'khor lo kun gyi gtso/ /bde chen rgyal po yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i gsung rab lhun po'i spor/ /mtha' yas rgyud sde'i rnam rgyal khang bzang du/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir/ /'gying mdzad klu sgrub grags pa'i mu khyud rgyal/ /rim gnyis nyag phran dag la goms pa'i mthus/ /lung rtog bag chags (39ba〉nar smin gcung po las/ /rab rgyal kun tu dge ba rā ma ṇa/ /tshul 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed gang der 'dud/ /'phags pa'i yul nas dka' ba du ma yis/ /phyogs 'dir nges gsang rdo rje theg tshogs kyi//lam bzang ches cher rab tu rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /skad gnyis smra ba blo gros grags la 'dud/ /he ru ka dpal dus kyi tha mar yang / /mi yi srid pa'i zol la nyer brten nas/ /dri med 'khon gyi rigs su legs bltams pa'i/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i tshogs la gus pas 'dud/ /mdo rgyud gsung rab skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun/ /blo gros rnam dpyod gtam gyi 'byung gnas kyis/ /legs drangs thugs kyi bsus khyim 'gengs mdzad pa'i/ /grags pa'i dbang phyug drang srong yab sras rgyal/ /dpal 'byor chos kyi rgya mtsho chen po dag /mkhyen rab sa 'dzin dbang pos bsrubs pa las/ /legs bshad bcu gnyis bdag po'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /gdul bya'i pad tshal rgyas mdzad de la 'dud/ /ces pa 'di yang chos kyi rje rin po che 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i dbang phyug dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis 'di lta bu zhig gyis zhes bka' stsal ba dang du blangs te/ /tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjes 'phral du smras pa'o/ /med byung tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs las/ /mi 'jigs bzhi ldan lhun gyis grub ba'i dpal/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i gsang gsum kun gyi bdag /rnam 'dren 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang de'i thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /rgyal sras gzhen nur shar ba'i snying rje'i gzugs/ /skal ldan 'gro la ngom phyir gru 'dzin spor/ phyag na padma ra bstan la gsol ba —208

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bda'adebs/ /mtha' klas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i chu gter las/ /tho (40na)ri srong btsan tshangs pa lha'i me tog /chos rgyal sprul pa'i zlos gar yongs 'du'i shing / /phan bde'i dri gsung stsol la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' bral zad mi shes pa'i yon tan nor/ /rgya mtsho ltar zab thugs kyi za ma tog /legs bltams bka' gdams rin chen bstan pa'i bdag /'brom ston chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ khri srong dag pa'i skye ba rnam lnga las/ /bcu bdun skye mthar bka' babs lung bstan bzhin//theg mchog gter gyi mnga' bdag smra bo pa/ /rig 'dzin chen po myang la gsol ba 'debs/ gang gis cig car skye sprul grangs med las/ /phan bde'i yid bzhin gan mdzod lha ldan gyi/ /zhabs stegs mdzad pa'i dbang po dge ba 'bum/ /lhar bcas kun gyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /phul byung bstan pa'i rtsa lag dge 'dun gyi/ /'khor lo'i bya ba rnam gsum lhun grub pa'i/ khres bya thams cad gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa'i spyan/ /mchog tu rnam par yangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba'i dngos po dar la babs pa'i dpyid/ /mngon par yongs su rdzogs la 'dun pa'i dpal/ /srid 'dir blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan/ /rgya mtsho lta bur rgyas la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams na bkra'i grong las legs 'ongs pa'i/ /ye shes nyin mor byed pa'i 'od stong gis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyon kun khyab mdzad pa/ /rje btsun bzhad pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' bral yon tan bye ba'i rang bzhin dag /mthu stobs 'jigs pa med pa'i rdo rje'i go /btsan po'i gzugs su grub pa'i rnam rol can/ rgya mtsho'i mtshan ldan dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas grub rim par byon pa'i (40ba)tshogs kun dang / /rnam dkar las kyi 'brel bas ngag gi dbang / /mi zad blo gros bzang po'i rgya chen mdzod/ /mtsho byung drin gyis thob la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan rtsa ba ltar/ /ches dkar dge bas grangs med tshe rabs su/ /bshes gnyen mchog gis brtse bas nyer bzung ste/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang kong po phan bde sprul sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyis nan cher bskul ba la brten nas/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo 'khon ston —209

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya ma/tsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedapal 'byor lhun grub kyi gsung rgyun las btus te/ za hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ /su sti siddhi/ /lhun grub bde legs rgya mtsho chen po las/ /'phrin las 'od zer stong gi dra ba yis/ /phan dang bde ba'i padma dkar po'i tshal/ /rgyas mdzad rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /phyag na padmo'i thugs rje'i rang gzugs gar/ /bod yul rgyal por shar ba srong btsan rje/ /lha chos bdun ldan bka' gdams bstan pa'i bdag /'brom ston chos gyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /khri srong lde'u bcan dag pa'i skye ba lnga'i/ /sku sprul myang gi cig car skye ba'i gzugs/ /bgrang med bstan las ltar bcas skye rgu'i srog /'tsho mdzad dge ba 'bum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lugs 'dzin dge 'dun gyi/ /thos bsam lhun grub bsod nams 'byung gnas mchog /yon tan bgrang med rgya mtsho chen po'i klong / /gcig gyur bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la ngag gi dbang phyug dpal/ /blo bzang grags snyan bstan pa mu thi la'i/ /(41na/drod pan phyag rgyas yongs spras 'phrin las kun/ /dbyar mtsho ji bzhin 'phyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal kun bgrang med gzugs sku'i rnam rol tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lor gcig tu gyur pa'i gtso/ /khyab bdag dang po'i mgon gyi bdag nyid can/ bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku gsum go 'phang yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /nges gsang theg pa'i gru gzings la brten nas/ /'bad med lag rtser stsol ba'i ded dpon mchog /khyab bdag bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams zhing gyur rdo rje slob dpon la/ /cung zad bstod pa'i dge bas tshe rabs su/ /rdo rje theg pa'i snod du legs gyur nas/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di snang phun tshogs nyes brgya skyed pa'i gzhir/ /rtogs nas mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gnas rnams su/ /bla med mahā yo ga'i rnal 'byor la/ /nyin mtshan brtson pas sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bde sdug bzang ngan zhabrul pa'i snang ba kun/ /rang rig sems kyi rol par nges rnyed ste/ /gdod nas zhabrul med gsal stong rig —210

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdapa'i gshis/ /ma bcos rjen par 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /snang grags chos kun lha yi rnam rol du/ /bcos min shar bas tha mal zhen ldog cing / /rtsa 'khor rlung la dmigs gtad grol byed lam//bsgoms pas zung 'jug thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /bde legs 'dod dgu'i dpal la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /bla ma yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho'i mthus/ /'dren pa mchog 'di bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tsho mā /'gyur med rdo rje lta bur gnas gyur cig /ces gsol 'debs smon lam dang (41ba)bcas pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes pho brang gong ri dkar po'i dkon gnyer dpon 'phrin las phur pa'i rig 'dzin pa dge steng bla ma byams pa kun dga' 'byung gnas kyis bskul ba la brten nas/ za hor gyi bcun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ /swasti pra dza sa/ /dge legs snang ba 'bum sde'i 'khor lo'i dpal/ /legs byas mdog lnga'i bzhon pas rab drangs nas/ /thub bstan 'chi ba med pa'i lam yangs por/ /spyod mkhas yongs 'dzin nam mkha'i nor bur 'dud/ /mi zad tshig gi 'dod 'jo ngag gi dpyid/ dbang phyug yon tan brgyad kyi mngal khur can/ /gangs can phan bde'i rtsa lag zhi 'tsho'i dbon/ /tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /phul byung ngag gi za ma tog dbang po/ /mi dman blo gros khyogs la 'degs pa'i khur/ /srid 'dir skal ba bzang pos sgyur ba'i rgyan/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos 'jam dpal snying po'i zhabs/ /blo bzang snyan pa'i grags dkar mu thi la/ /gangs khrod rgyal ba'i bstan rnams yongs khyab pa'i/ /dri med ring lugs 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar cung zad bstod pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /tshe rabs kun du bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ /mi 'bral brtse bas bskyangs las zab mo'i lam/ /nyams su bstar bas ye shes mchog thob shog /ces pa 'di yang 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi rjes su zhugs shing mi dman pa'i blo gros brda sprod kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho chen por 'jug pa'i rnam dpyod can mang yul lo chen tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ snyoms las pa za hor gyi brnyes —21/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yeshebris pa'o/ /(42na)blo gros gom pa gcig gis thub bstan nas/ /ma lus 'jal nus bzang po'i rnam dpyod kyi//dpal gyi be'u'i ri mo snying kha na/ /'bar ba'i grags pa phyogs bcur khyab de rgyal/ /gang gi lugs 'dzin ngag gi dpal thob cing / /dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan lhun grub pas/ /blo ldan skal bzang dga' skyed 'phrin las kyis/ /rgya mtsho'i pha mthar khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdo rgyud tha snyad rig pa'i gang ga'i rgyun/ /mkhas grub lam gsum las 'ongs chad med pa/ /blo gros hub kyis cig car 'thung nus pa'i/ /mang thos drang srong che la gsol ba 'debs/ /bgrang med tshig gi srin bu'i kha chu kun/ /phra zhib dpyad pa'i thags su nyer btags pas/ /don bzang bsam pa'i ri mo rnam bkra ba/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /e waṃ zung 'jug 'khor lo bzhi ldan lus/ /zag med bde chen sgyu ma'i gar mkhan du/ /sgyur ba'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la goms pa'i/ /lam mchog grub pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /'chad pa'i char gyis gdul bya'i myu gu skrun/ /rtsod ngag thog mdas rgol ba'i brag ri 'joms/ /rtsom pa'i man khyu ra yi 'phreng mdzes can/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i lo stor gsol ba 'debs/ /brtse ldan lhag bsam 'chi med lam yangs par/ /mkhyen rab rnam dpyod rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i/ /nus mthu'i 'od kyis bdud dgra'i mun pa'i dpung / /mthar mdzad rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol btab dge ba'i gangs ri las/ /bsod nams stong gi chu bo 'bab pa'i rgyun/ /'khyil ba'i rdzing bur don gnyis 'khor lo'i lag /dga' ston mgrin pa'i rdza rnga sgrog gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang sa skyong dga' ldan pa (42bsgo tsho skyes rdo rje'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/namaḥ sa manta bha dra ta ru ga ya/ /legs tshogs dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog /dpal ldan rtsa gsum 'khor lo'i bdag nyid kyis/ /mi mthun bdud sde'i dpung tshogs 'joms mdzad pa'i/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal dbang padma'i thugs sras sna nam —212

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (sepa/ /zab gter mnga' bdag dngos grub rgyal mtshan sogs/ /bgrang yas rig pa 'dzin pa'i zlos gar gyis/ /theg mchog bstan pa spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngo mtshar mnga' ris cha shas yul ljongs su/ /dri med srong btsan gdung 'dzin rig sngags 'chang / /'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan sras su bsam bzhin du/ /sprul pa'i rnam par rol la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas grub legs bris dbang po'i tshogs rnams la/ /brten nas bka' gter gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /ngoms med longs su spyad pas mchog thun gyi/ /dngos grub 'chi med brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ /snga 'gyur rgyud sde'i zab don nam mkha'i mtha'/ /mkhyen pa'i zhags pa gcig gis nyer bcings tshe/ kha ba'i ljongs 'di 'jam dpal rdo rje nyid/ /gos dkar lcang lo'i zol gyis byon nam snyam/ /ma smad snying rje'i chab kyis nyer bran pa'i/ /lhag bsam 'dab brgya ba 'ad pa'i 'dzum 'phreng gis/ /pad dkar 'dzin de ri bo gru 'dzin nas/ /swā la'i yul 'dir mgron du bsus pa bzhin/ /zil gnon dus dgra grub pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /snang srid sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kyang / /'bar bar mdzad tshe khyod dang gsang bdag la/ /dus gsum rgyal bas gzigs kyang dbye ba med/ /rnam snang gsang sgrom gdeng ba'ican gtsug tor mas/ /yongs 'dus zab gter yid bzhin nor (43na)bu mchog /padma dbang dang lhan cig gnyis tshogs su/ /bzhes nas phan bde'i 'dod dgu char du bsnyil/ /skal bar ldan pa'i 'dren byed las 'ongs pa'i/ /stag tshang brag dmar zab gter me dpung gis/ /nag phyogs lus sreg mgrin sngon can gnyis pa/ thugs gter sgo 'byed rdo rje gro lod rtsal/ /sbas yul 'bras gshongs mes po'i thod yangs las/ /legs drangs chos gter yan lag brgyad ldan chus/ /lnga brgya'i nyes tshogs 'brud pa'i cho ga mkhan/ /rig 'dzin skal ldan shing rta khyod min su/ /gsang sngags chos kyi gru char phyogs bcur phab/ /chos bdag tshogs rnams nang gter lo 'dab brgyad/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i 'bras bu dbang po'i ster/ /gtang nas rnga yab dpal ri'i gling du byon/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos mtsho skyes rje'i/ /thugs rje'i sgyu dra'i gar las legs grub pa/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i —213

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshebadag nyid rig sngags 'chang / /legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /bstod pa'i dge tshogs nyin mor byed pa yis/ /mi mthun mun pa'i smag rum mthar byas te/ /mi zad 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i snang ba yis/ /ngo mtshar gzigs mo'i dga' ston la spyod shog /ka dag lhun grub nges don rdzogs pa che/ /nyams su bstar ba'i lho phyogs dri bsung gis/ /las nyon tsha gdung mtha' dag rab bcom nas/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po mngon 'gyur shog /ces mchog gi sprul sku rig 'dzin mnga' ris pa legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje la bstod pa 'di ni lcags stag hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyi shar dus thol byung du blo la shar ba ltar/ de 'phral za hor gyi bsdos sug bris su byas pa'o/ /(43ba)na mo gu ru badzra dha rā ya/ /dge tshogs la 'dun mchod sbyin brgyas bskrun pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor khyab bdag dbang po'i seng ge'i khrir/ /kun dga'i dpal gter gsang chen bkra shis glu/ /ri mo gsum par 'khyil la gsol ba 'debs/ legs byas bye ba'i rang bzhin dga' tshal du/ /zuXgral med cho ga'i sa bon btab pa las/ /rnam dag tshul khrims lhag phran g.yur za bas/ /brtan mkhas gnyis ldan ljon pa'i dbang por grub/ /phyag na padma dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / /mar ston sems dpa' che sogs mkhas grub kyi/ /thugs bcud gaṅgā'i klung chen 'thung mkhas pa'i/ /sngon med dzaḥ las gzhan du ci/ /skyes bu gsum gyi rim pa'i them skas la/ /brten nas 'khrul med go rim ji bzhin du//byang sems rin chen brtsegs pa'i khang bzang nang / /'jug mkhas khyod ni rgyal ba'i sras kyi mchog /smin grol lam gyi gru gzings la brten nas/ /grangs med gsum gyi rgya mtsho skad cig la/ /bgrod de zung la jug rin chen gling song nas/ /sku bzhi'i 'dod dgur spyod pa'i ded dpon che/ /tshig 'jibs rna bar tshar du legs dngar zhing / /don gyi dka' ba'i gnad kun so sor gsal/ /'chad mkhas gdul bya'i re ba yongs bskang bas/ /drang song phur bu de la co 'drir 'os/ /rnam par sra ba'i gsung rab bye ba'i rgyud/ /mkhyen dpyod nyag phran gcig gis rab bkug nas/ /log smra'i snying kha 'bigs —2/4

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdepa'i rtsod ngag sgras/ /dbus 'gyur chos kyi grags de 'dar gyi dogs/ /mchog dman gdul byar 'tsham pa'i legs bshad kyi/ /rtsom pa'i glegs bam ngo mtshar brjod don kun/ /rdo rje'i tshig tu grub phyir byed pa po/ /(44na 〉 khor lo'i mgon dang dbye ba'i go skabs bral/ /rjes gnang dbang 'khrid 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi/ /gar thig dbyangs sogs gsang sngags phyag bzhes kun/ /sla chos rtsing sbyor spangs nas ston mkhas pa'i/ /tshad ldan rdo rje slob dpon khyod las su/ khyad par 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa yis/ /gsang sngags ring lugs dri med gdugs dkar po'i/ /yu ba khyod la gtad nas chos kyi khrir/ /legs bkod mkhas grub dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /dge 'dis dal 'byor rten gyi zhing sa la/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i sa bon legs btab pas/ /zung 'jug sku bzhi'i myu gu rab smin nas/ /don gnyis 'bras bu'i dpal la spyod par shog /dbang khrid rigs gtad sogs la deng gi dus/ /rtsing spyod dar ba'i rjes su mi 'brang bar/ dam pa khyod kyi rnam thar dang mtshungs pa'i//'brul med phyag len dag la 'jug par shog /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi sde snod rnam pa gsum/ /yang dag ston mdzad kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /dri bral bstan pa'i nor bu bgrang med 'gro'i/ /klu dbang gtsug gi dpal du mdzes gyur cig /ces yang dag pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po sngags rams pa dge 'dun kun dga' bkra shis la bstod pa 'di yang / za hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rdo rje dpal bzang ngo /na mo mū la su gu ra we/ /skal bzang stobs bcu mnga' ba stong gi dbus/ /phul byung snying stobs mtshan ldan shākya'i gtso'i/ /rgya chen chos kyi gdul bya nyan thos kyi/ /mchog gyur dgra bcom tsu nar gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa'i lam gyi bcud/ /zab yangs thugs kyi bum par legs bltams pa'i/ /mkhas grub (44ba)dbang po shākya nga5nis gnyen zhes/ /klu sgrub sras kyi mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam dpyod nyin mo'i byed pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /mun gling snang bas khyab pa'i mdzad bzang can/ /'jig rten mig gcig ka ba dpal brtsegs zha khas/ /skad gnyis smra —213

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheba'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /mdo sgyu sems sogs snga 'gyur rgyud sde'i gzugs/ /mkhyen dpyod 'dren byed stong gis legs gzigs pa'i/ /don gyi brgya byin gsang bdag sgro phug pa/ /zur rigs thams cad mkhyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyag na padma'i bkod pa rgya mtsho'i rdul/ /'gro ba'i khams dang 'tsham par ston nus pa'i/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor si si ri ba zhes/ /thugs rje chen po'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen pas shes bya mtha' dag thugs su chud/ /brtse bas 'gro kun thabs kyis rjes su 'dzin/ /nus pas rgya hor bod rnams dbang bsdus pa'i/ /'gro mgon chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /mdo sngags tha snyad lung gi chos rnams dang / /rim gnyis rtogs pa mchog gi mthar son pa'i/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i ded dpon thams cad gzigs/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo bzang snyan grags rgyas pa'i dri med bstan/ tan ra phyogs rgya mtsho'i pha mthar khyab mdzad pa'i/ /mi dbang gtsug gi rgyan gyur shākya'i mtshan/ /byams chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas rlom glang po'i rtsod ngag mtshon cha yis/ /thub bstan log rtog zug rngu 'byin pa'i tshe/ 'jigs med seng ge'i nga ros pham mdzad pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas kyi rig pa'i rol mtsho legs 'khyil zhing / /ris bral bstan pa'i bang rim rnam bzhi'i steng / /blo bzang ring lugs rin chen khang bzang dbus/ /'gying mkhas 'jam mgon bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /(45na〉thang dag dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyed nyid kyis/ /rjes su bzung ste mngon mtho'i rten rnyed cing / /dal 'byor don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngan song sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba dang / /srid pa'i bde ba 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin du/ zhas nas mngon par mtho dang thar pa'i lam 'thob pa'i thabs la brtson pas 'jug par 3|ga /mtha' yas bskal bar drin gyis legs bskyangs ba'i/ /'gro rnamasang sdug bsngal gsum las bsgral ba'i phyir/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rlabs chen la/ /'jug pa'i snying stobs go cha gyon par shog /khyad par tshe gcig sangs rgyas sar 'god pa'i/ /snga phyir —216

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bda'agyur ba'i gsang chen rdo rje'i theg /smin grol zab mo'i lam kun nyams blangs pas/ /zung 'jug sku bzhi'i dpal la spyod par shog /mdor na mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kyi/ /phun tshogs legs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /'dod pa'i re ba ji bzhin skong ba la/ /bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po dang mtshungs shog /ces dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ 'khon ston rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi skyes rabs 'phreng ba la bstod pa smon lam dang bcas pa 'di yang /rje nyid kyi gsung 'bum rnams phyogs gcig tu dpon yig u rgyan/ chos nor bu/ lo rgyal gsum gyis yi ge pa byas te/ glegs bam la bkod pa'i tshe bla ma'i bka' 'bangs za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang nor bu'o/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /'ja' lus mngon gyur lwa ba dmar po dang //lce yi sngags 'chang 'byung gnas bzang po dpal/ /sku (45ba)bzhi'i dbang phyug gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /mthu chen gnubs ban rgyal ba ye shes dang / /zhang ston grub pa brnyes pa bra dzñā'i mtshan/ /rig pa 'dzin pa padma bha dra ste/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma jo sras 'od po che/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor grub pa rtse mo'i zhabs/ /zhang ston rig sngags 'chang ba nyi ma 'od/ /zla bral rig 'dzin gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha mchog dngos grub rin chen rnam rgyal dang / /zab mo'i don ston rje btsun bsam gling pa/ /'khon rigs grub pa'i dpa' bo 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdams pa'i bka' babs 'jam dbyangs rin chen mgon/ /mkhas grub bla ma nyi ma bshes gnyen dang / /rig sngags 'chang ba nam mkha' rdo rje'i zhabs/ /grub pa'i dbang po gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos dpal ldan rdo rje dang / /mkhas btsun dbang po rin chen chos bzang pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /pad dkar 'dzin pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / /rje btsun bla ma bsod —217

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshenams grags pa'i sde/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang 'khon ston chos kyi rje/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma rje btsun ā nanda/ /'khor lo'i mgon po gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha mchog 'dod khams dbang mos dus kun du/ /mi 'bral rjes su bzung ba'i rig sngags 'chang / /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ /dpal ldan rtsa gsum ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /deng nas brgyud ldan dam pa'i zhal lung las/ /'ongs pa'i rjes gnang srog gtad zab mo'i gnad/ /rgyab brten lung dang phra zhib man ngag gi /snyan brgyud (46na)gdams pa mchog gis tshim par shog /dben gnas dur khrod sgrub khang nyams dga' bar/ /phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang rten tshogs zhing / /mthun pa'i mchod gtor dam rdzas spyan gzigs kyis/ /dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug mnyes byed shog /ma yengs rnam par gsal ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /grag stong sngags kyi bzlas brjod mthar phyin nas/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog ma dang sring mo bzhin/ /'bral med 'grub pa'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin shog /rdzas sngags 'khor lo'i bca' gzhi kun tshang zhing / /gdug can dgra la rbad pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /dam can srung ma las la rab bskul te/ /mngon spyod drag po'i sgrub pa mthar phyin shog /mi bzad btson khang 'bar ba'i 'brub khung du/ /dgra bgegs bla tshe bkug cing bskul ba dang / /sreg zor mnan sogs las kyi mtha' bsdus te/ /gsang ba'i sbyor ba ma lus 'grub par shog /dgra bo'i rnam shes rang gi sems dang bsre/ /nang sems yi dam lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /gang shar dag pa rab 'byams rnam rol gyis/ /gsang sngags zab lam sbyor sgrol mthar phyin shog /mdor na deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rgyal ba kun yum 'dod khams dbang phyug mas/ /rjes su bzung ste gnas skabs mthar thug gi /don gnyis dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dpal ldan 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo'i brgyud 'debs kyi rim pa 'di yang / spre bo hor tshang dka' bcu ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/—218

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kye rim pa/ (bdabagrang yas dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yi/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang dang / /rgyal sras blo gros rin chen la/ gsol ba 'debs so (46ba)byin gyis rlobs/ /zung 'jug sku brnyes klu sgrub zhabs/ /mkhas grub ma tadhi pa dang / /tai lo shes rab bzang po la/ gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas lnga mkhyen pa nā ro pa/ /'jig rten mig gcig mar pa rje/ /mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje la//gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /'khon ston gad pa kirti dang/ /bla sgang bsod nams rin po che/ /thub pa tshul khrims skyabs mchog la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /grub pa mchog brnyes 'phags pa skyabs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gzhon nu 'od/ /kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /'dus pa'i gsal byed 'phags pa 'od/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston zhabs/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /sgra sgyur dbang po nam mkha' bzang / /rje btsun gzhen nu blo gros dang / /rgyal ba gnyis pa btsong kha bar/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba'i sras po bzang po skyong / /shar pa rin chen rgyal mtshan dang / /grub mchog sher 'byung blo gros la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhas grub dpal ldan seng ge'i 'khas/ /mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho'i sde/ /chos rje dge legs dpal bzang por/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ 'jam dbyangs 'od zer bzang po dpal/ /rje btsun chos grags 'od zer dang / /grub brnyes nam mkha' bzang po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang sprul pa'i sku/ /'khon rigs grub pa'i dpa' bo mchog /'jam dbyangs dpal 'byor lhun grub la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /zung 'jug yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /skal bzang gdul byar legs stsol ba'i/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /chos dbyings kun gsal dag pa'i ngos/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon ltar bkra ba'i/ /rtsa gnyis lha yi 'khor lo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs//deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i rten thob cing / /yang dag dge ba'i —2/9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebashes gnyen gyis/ /mi 'bral rjes su 'dzin par shog /'khor ba'i ngang tshul me 'obs dang / /(47na)'gro kun pha mar legs rtogs te/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /bcos min rgyud la skye bar shog /rnam dag dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /snod kyi dri ma kun bkrus te/ /smin byed bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i lam/ /bsgoms pas zung 'jug thob par shog /gnas skabs las bzhi grub chen brgyad//thun mong dngos grub rab thob cing / /mthar thug rdo rje 'chang dbang sku/ /tshe 'di nyid la mngon 'gyur shog /ces pa 'dus pa'i dmar khrid dge lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud 'debs 'di yang / yi ge drug pa'i 'phrin las kyis 'gro mang smin grol la 'god pa/ sprul sku phyag rdor nor bu'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar/ za hor gyi bsdos ra sa 'phrul snang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang nor bu'o/ /zung 'jug bde chen ye shes dbang gi rgyal/ /ma rung gdug pa'i gshed du khros pa'i gar/ /dpal ldan dus dgra'i dbang po ma he'i zhal/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /dga' bzhi'i dpal ster ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /tshul 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed lwa li ta/ /grub pa'i dbang po rje btsun a mo gha/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /mkhas grub dbang po ye shes 'byung gnas zhabs/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug padma badzra dang / /brtul zhugs mthar phyin rje btsun ye rang pa/ gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /mthu stobs mnga' bdag rwa lo rdo rje grags/ /dbon sras gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin chos rab dang / /tshul 'dir mkhas shing grub brnyes ye shes seng/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /rwa chen snyan rgyud 'dzin pa'i 'bum seng dang / /sngags 'chang dbang po rje btsun rga lo'i zhabs/ /rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag rong pa sher seng la/ /(47ba)gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /rje btsun ye shes dpal ba gdams pa'i gter/ /mkhas grub dam pa don grub rin chen dang / /rgyal ba'i dbang po 'jam mgon btsong kha pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /sras kyi thu bo mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ /gsang chen mnga' bdag shes rab seng ge'i 'khas/ /rgyud 'dzin —220

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdadam pa sbyin pa dpal ba la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag shes rab bzang / /rdo rje 'dzin dngos chos skyong mtshan can dang / /'dus pa'i lam gyi gnad ston nam mkha' grags/ gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /zab mo'i don rtogs nyi ma bkra shis dang / /mdo rgyud mnga' bdag bde legs nyi ma'i zhabs/ /gnas lnga rig pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal 'byor lhun grub zhabs/ /'khor lo'i mgon po 'jam dbyangs ā nanda/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /yang na sras kyi thu bo mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ /'phags mchog dam pa don grub rin chen dang / /paṇa chen ngo mtshar rgya mtsho dpal bzang por/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /rdo rje'i 'chang dbang dge 'dun dge 'dun bkra shis zhabs/ /pad dkar 'dzin dngos bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ /rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po nam mkha' bzang / /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /dpal ldan 'byor pa'i bang mdzod lhun grub rje/ /'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po kun dga'i zhabs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu yis/ /rjes bzung blo gsal dga' skyed skal bzang 'gro'i/ /phan bde'i dpyid gyur rje btsun bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /smin byed 'jug sgo dbang bzhi'i grong khyer du/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis legs khrid de/ /sku gsum yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po che/ /'bad med 'grub pa'i sa bon thebs par shog /phra rags gsal snang g.yo med nga rgyal sogs/ /rim pa dang po'i tshul la (48na)rab goms te/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag grub chen brgyad la sogs/ /thun mong las kun 'bad med 'grub par shog /mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud rwa khrid zab mo'i lam/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa mchog la rab gzhol bas/ /tshe 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon gyur te/ /don gnyis ma lus lhun gyis grub gyur cig /ces dpal rdo rje 'jigs —221—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshebyed rwa lugs lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gi brgyud 'debs 'di yang / gsung rab rab 'byams lta ba'i rnam dpyod can kong po phan bde chos rje shākya lha dbang gis bskul ba ltar/ za hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho'o/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal gyi mi bzad nga ro'i dbyangs/ /'jigs med gdong lnga'i rgyud las nyer drangs pas/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa'i ri dwags skrag mdzad pa/ /rgyal dbang zas gtsang sras por gus phyag 'tshal/ /gang gis nges gsang theg pa'i dam chos kyis/ /phun tshogs 'khor los sgyur ba'i sgyu dra'i gar/ /skal bzang 'gro la ston pa'i rigs brgya'i bdag /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ /chos phung rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i kun dga'i bla/ /mkhyen brtse'i cha shas yongs rdzogs 'od dkar can/ /thub bstan kunda'i gnyen gyur a ti sha /lnga brgya'i dpung gnyen mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo ldan skal pa bzang por sgyur mkhas pa'i/ /phul byung grags pa'i sgra dbyangs srid pa 'dir/ /ches 'bar thos 'dzin rgyan gyur ganti/ /kun mkhyen btsong kha pa la gsol ba 'debs//rgyal ba mchog de'i dri med bstan pa'i khur/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas 'dzin pa'i dam pa rnams/ /nam yang 'gyur ba med pa g.yung drung khrir/ /bskal pa (48ba)rgya mtshor brtan par bzhugs su gsol/khyad par blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa la/ /dam chos dpyid kyi ma mas legs bskyangs pa'i/ /ma smad g.yur za ldem pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog /mi mthun grang reg las rgyal brtan gyur cig /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang bye ba'i gter/ /rgya mtsho lta bur zab pa'i nyin mor byed/ /dbang phyogs thun 'tshams stegs las nyer 'phags te/ /gangs can phan bde'i 'od brgya rab 'gyed shog /srid 'byor snying med dbu ba'i do shal can/ /nyan rang dman pa'i lam du gol shes te/ /rlabs chen rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa la/ /snying stobs chen pos slob par byin gyis rlobs/ /thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs sngon song nas/ /dbang bzhis legs smin phra rags bskyed rim dang / /rtsa rlung thig ler rab bsnun rdzogs rim gyi/ grol byed lam gyis zung la jug thob par shog /yongs 'dzin thugs kyi rin chen rtsig ngos —222

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdalas/ /spang rtogs la ṅgā'i bdag po'i gzugs brnyan 'bum/ /snang ltar bdag blor dri med legs 'char ba'i/ /ha nu mant+ra gnyis pa grub gyur cig /tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun bla ma yis/ /rjes su legs bzung rmad byung dam chos kyi/ /dga' ston spel bas bstan dang 'gro ba yi/ /phan dang bde ba'i nyer 'tshor bdag 'gyur shog /khyad par dge tshogs legs lam kun 'phel ba'i/ /lugs bzang 'dzin pa'i khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde/ /'dzam gling gser ldan dga' ma'i lto ba na/ /dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur 'phel gyur cig /sa chen skyong ba bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal/ /bsod nams rab tu bstan pa'i mi yi dbang / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa stobs kyis legs 'dzin rnams/ /sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid rgyas gyur cig /dpa' 'dzangs brtul phod dad dang gtong ba sogs/ /grangs med yon tan rin chen phung po yi/ /(49na)rtse mor son pa'i phun tshogs sbyin pa'i bdag /tshe dpal stobs 'byor lhun gyis grub par shog /mthu chen dbang phyug stobs ldan phyag drug pa/ /dpal ldan dus dgra'i dbang po ma he'i zhal/ /srid gsum bdag mo 'dod khams dbang phyug mas/ /dus kun g.yel med 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /zas gtsang sras dang jo bo yab sras zung / /mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa/ /yi dam chos skyong srung mar bcas rnams kyi/ /bkra shis rgya mtshos sa steng khyab gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang dad pa'i nor gyis mngon par mdzes pa sde srid rin chen rtse pas 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor za tor gyi bzhes sbyar/ind+ra ni la'i lhun po dus mtha'i mes/ /mngon par 'khyud pa'i gar dgu'i nyams ldan pa/dkyil 'khor spro dang bsdu ba'i byed po mchog /dpal ldan dus dgra'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs//zag med bde stong rdo rje ro langs ma/ /shing rta'i srol 'byed rje btsun lā li ta/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po a mo gha/ /zung 'jug mngon gyur gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab mo'i rtogs pa mthar phyin ye shes 'byung / /brtul zhugs grub pa padma badzra dang / /'phrin las rgya mtshor mnga' brnyes bal po'i zhabs/ /dus dgra'i rnal 'byor gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jig rten mig gcig sgra sgyur —223

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang sgro bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sherdo rje grags/ /gang gi dbon sras rwa chen chos rab zhabs/ /gdams pa'i bka' babs ye shes seng ge ste/ /mkhas grub rnam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rwa chen rigs chos 'dzin pa 'bum seng dang / /sngags 'chang dbang po rje btsun rga lo'i dpal/ /dus 'khor zhabs pa rong pa shes rab seng / /mkhas pa'i dbang po gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /man ngag rgya mtshor mnga' sgyur ye shes dpal/ /(49ba 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes bzung don rin pa/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags/ /bstan pa'i bdag po gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs kyi sras mchog dge legs dpal bzang po/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag shes rab seng / /'dus pa'i lam gyi gnad ston sbyin pa dpal/ /'khor lo'i mgon po gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi gdams pa'i mdzod
