'dzin shes rab bzang / /rdo rje 'chang dngos chos skyong mtshan can zhabs/ /lung dang rigs pa smra ba nam mkha' grags/ /bstan pa'i sgron me gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug nyi ma bkra shis dang / /mkhas grub chen po bde legs nyi ma'i zhabs/ /shes bya kun rig nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /mkhas grub chen po gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos dpal 'byor lhun grub zhabs/ /'jam mgon ngag gi dbang po kun dga'i dpyid/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma rje/ /skyabs mchog dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /yang na mkhas grub pa'i rjes su/ /'phags mchog chen po don grub rin chen pa/ /gnas lnga rig pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho ste/ /phan bde'i rtsa lag gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos dge 'dun bkra shis zhabs/ /pad dkar 'dzin pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ /mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha' bzang / /bstan pa'i bdag po gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khon rigs 'jam mgon dpal 'byor lhun gyis grub/ /'phrin las srid mthar rang rgyal rdo rje 'dzin/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can/ /rje btsun bla ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /lugs gcig la thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rjes su/ mkhas grub lha btsun bsod nams dpal bzang po/ /dpal ldan bla ma gsum la —224

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ rtobadagasol ba 'debs/ /bya btang rnal 'byor grub chen khyung po dang / /'jam pa'i (50na)dbyangs dngos dkon mchog chos 'phel zhabs/ kha sbyor bdun ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /bka' drin 'khor med gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir dpal ldan ma he'i zhal/ /bcu gsum 'khor lo'i bdag nyid dus dgra'i dbang / /phul byung skyabs kyi dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /deng nas mi khom chu 'dzin stug po yis/ /ma gtses dal ba'i rten bzang gru gzings la/ /brten nas bshes gnyen yid bzhin nor bu der/ /mi 'dzad longs su spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /'jigs rung ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa dug sprul tshang / /srid 'byor snying med dbu ba'i do shal can/ /nyan rang gzhan don las nyams dman pa'i tshul/ tags nas nges gsang chos la gzhol bar shog /grangs med bskal gsum nor 'dzin pha mtha' la/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor khyab 'jug gom gcig gis/ /snyigs dus tshe thung 'di la bgrod nus pa'i/ /theg mchog 'jug sgo dbang gis smin par re|ga /mkha' la 'ja' ltar rten dang brten pa gsal/ /yungs 'bru tsam gyi thig ler dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /gsal dang stong cha nga rgyal brtan po sogs/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa ma lus mthar phyin shog /rnal 'byor bzhi dang rwa rtser sems 'dzin pa/ /mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma nyams rwa khrid sogs/ /snyan nas snyan brgyud rdzogs rim lam mchog kun/ /tshe 'dir lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas skabs zhi rgyas dbang drag grub chen brgyad/ /thun mong 'phrin las sgrub la thogs med cing / /mthar thug go 'phang zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag /mngon du byas nas don gnyis grub par shog /ces dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang brgyud la gsol ba 'debs pa rin chen ke ta ga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni (50ba)gra byams gling ma ṇi ba/ mgron gnyer dkon mchog blo gros gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ a wa sgru ti ba'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos chu 'go bkra shis 'khyil ba'i nye 'dabs su sbyar/lhun grub mtshan dpe'i rang gzugs zlos gar ni/ /dī rgya mtshor padma'i stong po'i rtser/ sprul —225

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshesku'i rnam rol mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gtso bor gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod ka dag chos sku'i klong yangs nas/ /zhi dang khro bo'i sgyu 'phrul rol gar mkhan/ /thugs rjes 'gro la brtse ldan sprul pa'i skur/ /ston mdzad thod 'phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /rang snang rig mar shar ba 'tsho rgyal dang / /bde stong dbyings su rtse ba'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /pad 'byung rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /ind+ra ni la'i mdangs la 'khu ba'i zhal/ /rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs shing sdigs 'dzub mjad/ /dga' ba bcu drug rab rgyas yum dang sbyor/ /padma 'byung gnas sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /yid 'phrog rab dkar zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams/ /thod pa'i rnga chung 'brol zhing pad phor 'dzin/ /lha rdzas na bza' rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /blo ldan mchog sred sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /phun tshogs snang ba 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ kha ṭaṃ rta ljang 'od rnon zhags pa 'dzin/ /rus pa'i rgyan dang stag gi sham thabs can/ /nyi ma 'od zer sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jigs rung bzod par dka' ba srin po'i gzugs/ /gnam lcags rdo rje sdigs 'dzub gdengs tsam gyis/ /bdud sde cher 'thag seng lpags stod g.yogs can/ /seng ge sgra sgrog sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /sdom brtson lus stobs rgyas pa'i gnyis 'thung dbang / /pad phor skyabs sbyin sna zhags ring skyong zhing / /ngur smrig gser sbyangs dra bas rgyan spud pa/ /padma saṃ bha'i (51na〉skyi la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzi brjid phun tshogs snyan pa'i cang te'u dang / /chos sku mngon par gsal ba'i me long 'dzin/ /lha rdzas dmar po'i gos kyi lhab lhub can/ /padma rgyal po'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshan dpe rab gsal stobs bcu'i rtsal kun rdzogs/ /sa gnon lhung bzed 'dzin zhing chos gos ser/ /bdud bzhi kun bcom mchog gi sprul pa'i sku/ thu kya seng ge'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku mdog smug nag gnam lcags rdo rje 'phyar/ /phur bu 'bar ba log 'dren snying la gzer/ /stag brdzus dmu yi steng na 'gying mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje gro lod sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdul bya'i don du bstan pa'i rnam rol gyi/ /mtshan brgyad sprul pa'i sku yis rjes bzung pa'i/ /bla med theg pa mchog gi 226

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdarig pa 'dzin/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor grub la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu yi/ /thugs rje'i zer gyis blo gros pad mo'i tshal/ /rab rgyas phan bde'i lam bzang rgya mtsho las/ /gtan bde'i chos su skor la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje'i khams las rab grub seng ge'i khrir/ /mgon khyod bskal ba rgya mtshor rtag bzhugs shing / /sde bzhi'i lang tsho dar la bab pa yi/ /chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /ngag gi dpal mnga' dbang phyug yon tan brgyad/ /bsod nams stobs kyis mngon par lhun grub pa/ /mi mthun rgud pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal te/ /bsams pa'i don kun grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang rgyas sman zhang mkhar ba'i tsha bo/'phrin las rab brtan gyis bskul ba ltar/ /za hor gyi brnyes chu 'go bkra shis 'khyil ba'i nye 'dabs su bris/ngag dbang dbyangs can lha yis rjes bzung ba'i/ /blo gros mchog gis skal bzang gdul bya rnams/ /phan bde'i mchog byin (51ba)rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin ltar/ /nam yang 'dzad med rtsol la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba'i sa bon dus su legs smin pa'i/ /don gnyis ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin a mra'i 'bras/ /dal ba'i rten bzang lce ye legs myang bas/ /gtan bde'i sa la dga' ba'i gar byed shog /rgud pa'i chu 'dzin zhi ba'i nam mkha' la/ /bsod nams nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin gyis/ /'dir snang tshe dpal 'dab brgya bzhad pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi ze 'bru g.yur za shog /ces pa 'di yang 'phyong rgyas spen nag pa nang so dngos grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ngo mtshar rmad byung padma'i sdong po la/ /rang byung sprul pa'i gar gyis rnam rol ba/ /rgyal ba kun dngos padma 'byung gnas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin rlabs stsol/ /grangs med 'gro ba thams cad rjes 'dzin kyang / khyad par bod 'bangs yongs kyi gnyen gcig pu/ /tshe dbang rig 'dzin padma thod 'phreng la/ /gsol ba 'debs so grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang du/ /srin po'i rgyal po'i tshul gyis log 'dren kun/ /'dul mdzad dmi gu rur —227—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegasol ba 'debs/ /'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos padma sambha bas/ /rjes bzung gsang chen rdo rje theg pa ni/ /grub pa mchog brnyes rje 'bangs nyer lnga la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /mdo sgyu sems sogs bka' nas bkar brgyud pa'i/ /'brul med bshad dang sgrub pa'i snga 'gyur bstan/ /'dzin 'dzad so zur gnubs sogs rig 'dzin la/ gsol ba 'debs so grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ khri srong rnam sprul myang ban chos kyi dbang / /rgod kyi ldem 'phru rgya ston zhab khrom sogs/ /zab don gter gyi sgo 'byed tshogs rnams la/ /khyad par mkhas grub padma dbang gi rgyal/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug legs (52na〉〈na rdo rje'i zhabs//padma'i rgyal tshab byang bdag rig 'dzin la/ gsol ba 'debs so grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal ldan rgyal ba kun gyi 'byor ba'i mdzod/ /'bad med lhun grub dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ /'khon rigs 'jam dbyangs grub pa'i dpa' bo la/ gsol ba 'debs so grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dang po'i mgon po kun bzang he ru ka /bsod nams zhing du ngur smrig zlos gar can/ /rnam kun mchog ldan rje btsun bla ma la/ gsol ba 'debs so grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug bkra shis chos kyi dung / /mgrin par g.yas 'khyil kun dga'i sgra dbyangs can/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos padma badzra la/ gsol ba 'debs so grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bla med rdo rje'i theg pa mchog gi rtsal/ /lhun grub gang shar rang grol rnal 'byor pa/ /zil gnon dus dgra grub pa'i rig 'dzin la/gsol ba 'debs so grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na dngos grub yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /'bad med stsol phyir dus gsum rgyal ba kun/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla mar legs bstan la/gsol ba 'debs so grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i dge tshogs las/ /tshe rabs kun du rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /rjes su bzung ste smin grol zab mo'i lam/ /tshul bzhin nyams su len par byin gyis rlobs/ /ka nas ye dag rang rig kun tu bzang / /lhun grub zhi khro rab 'byams 'od lnga'i klong / /thugs rjes sprul pa sna tshogs ston nus pa'i/ /tshe 'dir rdzogs chen lam —228

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdabazang mngon gyur shog /nad gdon bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun zhi/ /tshe dpal longs spyod phun tshogs ma lus grub/ /mthar thug gdod ma'i kun bzang mngon byas nas/ /bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang dbu mdzad dang mchod dpon gyi las 'dzin blo bzang yon tan dang / blo bzang lung rig gnyis kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes mchims phu gsang phug tu sbyar/med byung rnam dpyod yangs pa'i mkhyen pa'i (52ba)spyan/ /shes bya'i gnas lugs kun la 'jug pa'i rdzas/ /blo gros mchog gis legs bshad bye ba'i sgo/ /'byed mdzad bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /drang nges gsung rab dgongs don chu gter che/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i gzings kyis rab bgrod nas/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /'dod dgur longs su spyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /ring nas bsags pa'i tshogs gnyis sa bon las/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i yongs 'du'i ljon/ /rgya chen thos bsam sgom pa'i 'bras bu'i bcud/ /dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i rang bzhin rdo rje'i khams/ /grub pa'i rang gzugs 'gyur ba chen po'i khrid/ /mdo sngags rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /skal bzang gdul bya'i dpyid du brtan gyur cig /mi dman rnam pas lhag bsam shing rta yis/ /mngon par drangs pa'i dge tshogs nor bu'i dpya/ /srid zhi'i dbul ba sel ba'i cho ga las/ /gtan bde'i 'dod dgur longs su spyod gyur cig /ces mdo smad gser gzhong yul gyi mdo sngags rab 'byams smra ba'i chos rje don grub rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs brtan bzhugs smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes chos rje nyid kyi slob ma rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ za hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar/dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi ji lta ji snyed kyi mkhyen pa'i rang gi ngo bo bzhin lag gi gzugs su shar ba ngag gi lhas 'jam dbyangs kyi/ /rjes su bzung ba'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan pa'i rigs thams cad gyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa gang / /blo gsal mkhas btsun rje yon bzang po'i ldan pa'i tshogs kyi mgon —229

rgyal dbang snga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshegacig pur gyur ba'i/ /(53na)thub bstan rgya mtsho'i ltar zab cing rgya che ba dag 'dren pa shing rtar gsol ba 'debs so/ nag phyogs bdud sde'i ga sdo/la las bla ma yi dam chos srung gi nus mthus 'jigs pa med pa'i seng ge lta bu'i sgras/ /phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje gsum gyi go cha can/ /thub bstan 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi rnam dpyod lang tsho rgyas pa yi/ /rang gzhan gyi don gnyis grub pa'i sde la gsol ba 'debs so/ /dbyangs can lha mo mgrin par chags pa'i legs bshad kyi rgyud mang las rig gnas che ba lnga dang chung ba lnga ste bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi dbyangs rjod byed kyi dzig mdzes shing brjod bya'i don bzang ba'i snyan pa'i sgra yi ge /rnam dpyod dang ldan pa lus phra ma lta bu 'gugs pa'i dkyus ring po'i spyan gyis/ /kun rdzob don dam gyi shes bya kun la 'jug der gsol ba 'debs so/ /rim pa gnyis kyi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog gi nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis//gnas pa rtsa kham btabakod pa byang chub kyi sems rlung gi padma'i 'dab brgyad yongs su ba 'ad pas/ /'gyur ga med pa bde bas stong pa nges pa'i ye shes khyad par can zung 'jug gi bcud kyi rab tu myos pa'i/ /rdo rje 'chang gi rigs kyi rgyud 'dzin pa a wa dhū tir gsol ba 'debs so/ /dge ba des yi rje btsun bla ma bskal brgya'i bar du/ /bsil ldan bod yul gyi 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i khri la rtag tu zhabs pad brtan cing / /bdag sogs 'gro ba kun kyang tshe rabs thams cad du rje su brtsang sne/ /phan pyodang bde ba'i dpal la longs spyod par shog cig gu /cesapa 'di yang dge slong don 'grub rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes ta dgar sbyar/ngag dbang 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyis/ /rjes (53ba)bzung blo gsal skal bzang 'gro ba'i gnyen/ /rgya chen 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i mtsho chen po/ /rab brtan srid mthar rgyas la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes rdo rje brag pa khams pa sngags rams pa'i ngor bris/ngag dbang mtshungs med blo gros bzang po'i dpyid/ /gsung rab rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur pa'i/ /rje btsun bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di dga' ldan dar rgyas kyi bskul ba'i ngor/ /za hor gyi bzhes zi ling mkhar gyi nye 'dabs su sbyar/—23(/

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdengag gi dbang phyug 'jam mgon btsong kha ba'i/ /ring lugs blo gros yangs pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /'dzin mkhas skal bzang rgya mtsho'i dga' ston can/ /thub bstan yongs 'du'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /byin rlabs dngos grub char 'bebs bdud sde'i gshed/ /bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /kun 'dus mkhyen brtse nus ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /drin can bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /cung zad bstod pa'i yan lag brgyad ldan chus/ /srid bzhi'i rgud pa'i dri ma kun bkrus te/ /tshogs gnyis lang tsho dar ba'i zhabs bsil gyis/ /don gnyis pad dkar mig can grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni 'or bsdus bu yan thu gu shrī no yon gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdong bri tha/ngo mtshar rmad byung thugs rje'i chu rgyun gyis/ /phan bde'i 'khri shing tshar du legs dngar bas/ /don gnyis 'bras bzang dud ba'i dpag bsam ljon/ /'phags mchog phyag na padma ra gsol ba 'debs/ /mchod sbyin rgya mtsho'i sgo 'byed 'jig rten dbang / /o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling bgrod dkon mchog 'bangs/ /(54na)bod yul rgyal por rnam sprul srong btsan zhabs/ /phul byung rgyal ba'i sras la gsol ba 'debs/ /bod yul bstan pa spel mdzad khri srong rje/ /dam chos sgron me spar ba'i ral pa can/ /'phags yul chos kyi rgyal po dge ba dpal/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' gdams bstan pa'i bdag po 'brom ston rje/ kha che'i mkhas grub dam pa dgon pa ba/ /he ru ka dpal bla chen sa skya pa/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug 'gro mgon g.yu brag pa/ /zab don gter gyi sgo 'byed mnga' bdag myang / /bod yul phan bde'i rtsa lag dge ba 'bum/ /lus can kun gyi nyer 'tshor gsol ba 'debs/ /bal po'i paṇa chen padma badzra zhabs/ ta shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i dge 'dun grub/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /mkhas btsun bzang por ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /'bre chen chos kyi rgyal po dpal bzang po/ /ngag gi dbang —231 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa nga go dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshephyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /cung zad bstod pa'i dge tshogs yid bzhin nor/ /mi phyed dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod pas/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'dod dgu'i char bzhin du/ /bsam pa'i re ba ma lus skongs gyur cig /ces 'khrungs rabs brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi rim pa 'di/ dga' ldan khri rin po che ljang ram pa'i dbon po blo bzang rab brtan gyis thang ga'i bris thor bskul ba ltar/ za hor gyi bsdos rgya nag gi yul gru'i cha shas drung lir sbyar/rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs gnyis sa bon las/ /(54ba/spegs bskrun phan bde'i nyer 'tshor rab 'dun pa'i/ /mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i ded dpon pad dkar 'chang / /rje btsun bzhad pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /grangs med bsod nams shing rtas legs drangs pa'i/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i yid bzhin nor bu mchog /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor 'god mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /rlabs chen bsod nams nyi ma stong gi gzi/ /don gnyis snang ba rgyas pa'i dga' ston can/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhi 'dir zla bral ba'i/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /dman pa'i rigs bral srong btsan gdung gis btsun/ /mkhas grub gtsor gyur thos bsam sgom pas mdzes/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin rdo rje'i rnal 'byor grub/ /bsod nams dpal ldan bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal/ gzhon nu'i mtshan mnga' rgan po'i blo ldan pa/ /bzang po'i lam ston yang dag dge ba'i bshes/ /spyan snga chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /zung 'jug sku bzhi'i 'byor par lhun chags ba/ /'khon rigs 'jam dbyangs grub pa'i dpa' bo mchog /rje btsun snang mdzad rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan chos kyi 'byor ba'i 'phrin las rnams/ /rab rgyas ngag gi dbang phyug bkra shis dbyangs/ kun dga'i dpyid gyur dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ /zur chen padma rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo gros bzang po las/ /gsung rab rgya mtshor la jug pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i re ba legs skong la/ /—232

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdagang shar rang sar grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes grub pa'i dbang phyug pa mi tra dzo gi nas nye bar brgyud pa'i snying po/ (55na)don gsum gyi bla ma'i brgyud 'debs 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros yan thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos gnang 'dug pa'i 'phro mus rnams dgos zhes nges don snying po'i tshul la blo gzhol ba'i/ 'tsho byed 'brang rgyas pas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/rgyal ba kun gyi chos phung gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /gangs can bstan pa'i zhabs bsil chu sbyin mkhan/ /blo gsal skal bzang gnyen gyur grags pa'i dpal/ /kun mkhyen tsong kha pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /rmad byung thugs rje chen po'i 'od stong gis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i pad dkar tshal/ /rgyas mdzad lnga brgya'i dpung gnyen a ti sha /dpal ldan mar me mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i rang gzugs lha/ /tshangs spyod dge bsnyen gar gyis rnam rol ba/ /bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes po 'brom ston rje/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'khas la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam mgon btsong kha ba'i/ /dri med lung rtogs yon tan nor bu'i dpya/ /blo gros shing rta bzang pos 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ /tshe 'dir nad gdon bar chad rgud pa yi/ /mi mthun mun pa'i smag rum rab zhi nas/ /bde skyid nyin mo'i snang ba rgyas par shog /grangs med legs byas sa bon smin pa las/ /tshe dpal stobs 'byor ma la yi shing / /phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dri bsung rab mthul bar/ /longs su spyod pa'i dga' ston rgyas par shog /tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gag tshe bar do dang / /gnas ngan len gyi 'jigs pa kun zhi nas/ /bde ba can du rdzus te padma las/ /skyes nas theg mchog chos la spyod par shog /tshe rabs kun du dal ba'i rten bzang thob/ /(55ba〉rgongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes kyi rjes su bzung / /mdo rgyud zab mo'i lam kun nyams blangs nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi byin rlabs dang / /slu med rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mthus/ /mi phyed yid kyis btab pa'i sgron lam kun/ /thogs pa med par myur du 'grub gyur cig /—233

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losheces pa 'di ni gnam sa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i rigs las lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen dpyod can khe shing ge chin dbang gis bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos shar phyogs rgyal po'i pho brang chen po pe cing gi nye 'dabs gzims khang ser por sbyar/sna tshogs shes bya'i spu sdug rab bkra ba'i/ /rnam dpyod tshig don rgyas pa'i sgro gshog can/tshangs pa'i bu mo 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin ma/ /mgrin pa'i dbus su dga' ba'i gar sgyur cig /de la 'dir gsol 'debs ga thi'i chu rgyun gyi don bshad pa la/ gsol ba 'debs par bya ba'i yul/ ji ltar gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshul/ gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rim lnga las/ rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas/ zhes pa ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni rdo rje slob dpon la tshang bar mdo rgyud du ma nas lan cig ma yin par gsungs pas dngos brgyud gyi bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa ni yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten yin pa'i phyir na rgyal ba tsong kha pas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge legs kyi/ /yon tan kun gyi rtsa ba drin can rje//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la dngos dang / zhan byung smon lam gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid la dngos po'i gnas lugs la bstod pa dang / btags pa ba sgro btags kyis bstod pa gnyis/ dang po la gsum las dang po rgyal ba btsong kha pa la (56na)bstod pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi zhes sogs te bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs pa'i theg pa che chung gi chos kyi phung po rnams ni gaṅgā'i chu rgyun dang / bod gangs can gyi ljongs kyi lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa ni gzugs su ma bkod la/ gsung rab la lta ba'i blo gros kyi mig gsal zhing / dam pa'i chos kyi snod du gyur pa'i skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi gnyen du gyur pa mkhas btsun bzang po'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab pa'i dpal mnga' ba'i kun mkhyen bla ma btsong kha pa ni 6khas bsil 'bul bar byed pa'i chu sbyin mkhan po skal ldan shing rta'i gzugs su bkod pas bsdus shing —234

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdam bsdus pa'i gzugs can gyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa'o/ /'di ni rgyal po skal ldan shing rtas chu bo gaṅgā lha yul nas phab ste khyab 'jug gi 'bus bsil du phul ba'i gtam rgyud dang sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ med du byung ba sogs te/ ngo mtshar med byung bslu ba med pa'i thugs rje chen pos bstan pa dang 'gro ba sems can gyi phan bde rgyas par mdzad pa po lnga brgya pa rnams kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dam pa a ti sha dpal ldan mar me mdzad la gsol ba 'debs so/ /sbyar gzhi nyi ma'i 'od zer stong gis padma dkar po'i tshal rgyas pa'o/ /lnga brgya ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'bras dus kyi lnga brgya phrag gsum/ sgrub dus kyi lnga brgya phrag gsum/ lung dus kyi lnga brgya phrag gsum/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i lnga brgya phrag gcig ste lnga brgya phrag bcur yod pas na lnga brgya zhes bshad do/ /a ti sha zhes pa saṃ spro ta'i skad de bod skad du phul du byung ba zhes paṇḍi ta gzhan las lhag pa'i don no/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi sogs te/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje chen po bzhin lag gi rang gzugs su shar ba lha mchog spyan ras gzigs gdul bya'i mos (56ba)ngor snang tshul dge bsnyen la rigs mang du yod pa las tshangs par spyod pa'i gar gyis rnam par rol ba/ sgrol mas lung bstan pa'i 'brom ston rje ni jo bo chen pos bka' gdams kyi bstan pa gtad nas de'i bdag por bskos pas na bka' gdams kyi bstan pa'i mes po ste/ mtshan dngos rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /gnyis pa btags pa ba sgro btags kyis bstod pa ni ngag gi dbang phyug sogs te/ nor bu la sogs pa'i dngos po mang po'i dpya khral shing rta'i 'phrul gyis tshegs chung ngus 'dren nus pa ltar/ smra ba ngag gi dbang phyug mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs btsong kha pa'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa 'khrul pa'i dri ma med pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs/ gsung rab la lta ba'i blo gros bzang pos 'dren par mdzad pa'i byed pa po/ mdo dang rgyud sde rgya mtsho chen por dbang sgyur ba'i sde la gsol ba 'debs so//gnyis pa zhar byung smon lam la/ gnas skabs kyi smon lam/ mthar thug gi smon lam/ bden pa'i —235

rgyal nga bang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shetshig brjod pa dang gsum las/ dang po la 'di phyi bar do gsum las/ dang po ni dge ba 'di yis sogs te/ bshad ma thag pa gsol 'debs kyi dge ba'i tshogs 'di'i mthu la brten nas/ bdag sogs 'gro ba sems can kun kyang tshe 'dir sngon las 'phral rkyen du gyur pa'i 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i nad dang / gnod pa byed pa'i dgra dang gdon bgegs sogs bar du gcod pa la brten nas yid du mi 'ong ba'i rgud pa mi mthun pa'i tshogs rnams zhi zhing / lus sems bde ba sogs bsams pa tsam gyis grub pa'i dga' ba dang skyid par shog ces pa ste/ sbyar gzhi nyin mo'i snang ba rgyas pa na mun pa'i smag rum stug po rab tu zhi ba'o/ /gnyis pa phyi mar dge ba ni grangs med legs byas sogs te/ grangs med pa dus ring po nas nye bar bsags pa'i dkar po dge ba'i (57na〉spegs byas bsod nams kyi mthu la brten nas skye ba thams cad du tshe ring ba dang / dpal 'byor longs spyod 'phel zhing stobs che ba dang / phun sum tshogs pa chos nor 'dod pa thar pa'i sde bzhi rgyas pa'i dga' ston la longs su spyod par shog /sa bon smin pa las byung ba'i ma la ya'i shing dri bsung rab tu 'thul ba'i gzugs su bkod pa'o/ /gsum pa bar do'i smon lam ni/ tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags shing phyi ma'i lus ma thob pa'i tshe srid pa bar do zhes pa 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang sna tshogs 'char ba de rang ngo shes nas bla ma yi dam gdams ngag rnams dran pa'i rkyen gyis dmyal ba sogs gnas ngan len gyi 'jigs pa kun rnam par zhi nas mgon po 'od dpag med bzhugs pa'i rin po che las grub pa'i zhing khams ljon shing me tog mtsho rdzing lteng ka sogs dang ldan pa'i dag pa'i zhing bde ba can der padma las rdzus te skyes nas mgon po 'od mtha' yas pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi theg pa mchog gi chos la longs spyod par shog ces pa'o//gnyis pa mthar thug gi smon lam ni/ tshe rabs kun du sogs te/ tshe rabs kun du dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i rten dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i lus bzang po thob/ gdul bya yongs su 'dzin pa la mkhas pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su bzung nas/ mdo dang rgyud —236

bla ma'i bstong tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdesde zab mo'i lam gyi gnad kun legs par bstan pa la thos pa byas/ de don ma 'khrul bar rang gis nyams su blangs pas myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas rang bzhin gyi don rgya chen po grub par byin gyis rlobs zhig ces pa'o/ /gsum pa bden pa'i tshig brjod pa ni/ rgyas ba sras bcas sogs te/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa kun gyi byin rlabs dang / chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub (57ba)kyang tha snyad du bya byed 'thad pas rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la slu ba med pa'i mthu la brten nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa po rnams kyis mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag po'i yid kyis btab pa'i smon lam kun thogs pa med par myur du grub par gyur cig ces pa'o/ /gsum pa btab pa'i phan yon ni/ bstod pa'i yul de rnams la dad pa rnam dag gi sgo nas gsol ba btab pa ni yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten te/ ji skad du dkon mchog sgron me las/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad srung zhing 'phel bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /tshig gi lo 'dab pha nga phung cher g.yos na/ /don gyi 'bras bu lta bar sgrib snyam byed/ /de phyir 'dir ni don gyi snying po dag /gsal bar bkod pas mtsho la byad ltar mthong / /'di 'dra rgyal ba'i bstan la ches gus shing / /blang dang dor bya'i tshul la dpyod ldan gang / khe shing dbang gis bskul tshe za hor gyi/ /bande ā wa dhu ti'i sdom bus bris/ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs bla ma tsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs blo gros bzang pos legs bzung nas/ /rgya chen snang/kun thugs kyi mtshor 'khyil ba'i/ /slu med 'dren pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe rabs kun du dal ba'i rten thob cing / /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis legs bzung nas/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mchog /sgrub pa'i nyams len snying por byed par shog /ces dpon mo ma'i da ris bskul ba'i ngor bris/su sdi pra dza saḥ rgya chen gtsug lag kun la smra ba'i ngag /mi 'jigs spobs pa mchog gi yid —237

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshebazhin dbang / /blo gros rgyal mtshan rtser bkod legs bshad char/ /skal bzang rgya mtshor 'bab la gsol ba 'debs/ /dug gsum dgra yis 'jigs pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /gnyis (58na)med thabs shes go cha dang ldan pas/ /thub bstan don gnyis lang tsho'i mdun sa sa /'khrid mdzad mchog gi sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs dbyangs can lha yis rjes bzung ba'i/ /kun dga'i dga' ston spel ba'i rdo rje 'chang / /phun tshogs tshogs gnyis lhun grub bshes gnyen mchog /khyab bdag bdag nyid chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /'di phyi bar do kun tu mgon khyod kyis/ /'bral med brtse bas rjes su legs bzung nas/ /bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun rab zhi zhing / /bsams don lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'phel/ /gnas skabs tshe dpal stobs 'byor mnga' thang rgyas/ /mthar thug stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang mchog /mngon du byas nas 'gro kun 'dren par shog /ces pa 'di yang o cher dor ge am bhas bskul zhing mgon po skyabs kyis kyang bskul ba'i ngor bris/thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i chu gter las/ /mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rgyas pa'i dpag bsam ljon/ /'gro la phan bde'i 'bras bzang stsol mdzad pa'i/ /rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi gsung rab ma dres klung chen las/ /grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i gzhud lugs nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang blo gros can/ /rgya bod lo paṇa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /phun tshogs srid zhi'i dge legs kun gyi mdzod/ rgyal ba gnyis pa lha gcig mar me mdzad/ /thugs sras 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po sogs/ /bka' gdams rin chen phreng bar gsol ba 'debs/ /blo gros rab yangs 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu gang / /skal bzang 'gro la ngur smrig zlos gar can/ /grags pa (58ba)bod 'dir mngon mtho thams cad mkhyen/ /rgyal dbang btsong kha pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /bstan la rjes zhugs gtsug lag rgya mtsho la/ /ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa'i blo gros kyis//'chad rtsod rtsom la bzang po'i rnam dpyod can/ /legs bshad rgya mtsho'i dpyid la gsol ba 'debs/ /—238—

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ khobadathos bsam sgom la 'jigs med seng ge'i dbyangs/ /spobs pa'i mgrin pa mtho ba'i go cha can/ /thub bstan lung dang rtogs pa'i lang tsho'i sde/ /rgyas mdzad rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dal ba'i rten la snying po rab blangs nas/ /rang gzhan kun gyi don gnyis ma lus pa/ /lhun grub stobs bcu mnga' ba thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni lha khang ser po'i bla ma bsam blo rab 'byams pa sbyin pa rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes bris/ngag gi rang bzhin mtha' yas shes bya'i tshig /smra ba'i dbang phyug grub pa'i blo gros kyis/ /skal bzang 'gro la rgya chen legs bshad mtsho/ /rnam dpyod yol gor spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /snang srid zil gnon 'jigs med rtsal gsum rdzogs/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i gangs ri'i spo na 'gying / /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i go cha can/ /thub bstan lang tsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ /dal ba'i rten la snying po rab blangs nas/ /'di phyi kun du dge ba'i phan bde'i nor/ /mi 'bral gtsug gi rgyan du bsten par shog /ces pa 'di ni no bon da ri tha'i jis bskul ba'i ngor bris/rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum rdo rje'i gar/ /o ṇḍi yā nar rdo rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /thugs rje'i 'dab brgya ba chad pa'i ge sar rtser/ /sgyur mdzad padmā ka rar gsol ba (59na〉ra de bas/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur kun gyi/ /gtsug na zhabs sen u dum ba ra 'dzum/ /mtshan brgyad sprul pa'i gar gyi grangs med 'gro/ /'dren mdzad thod phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /'chi med tshe dang mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /brtul zhugs mthar phyin lha srin bran du 'khol/ /'phags pa'i yul du sangs rgyas gnyis par grags/ /slob dpon padma sambha ra gsol ba 'debs/ /gangs can bod yul chos kyis dkar por mdzad/ /rnga yab gling du ma rung srin po 'dul/ /dad can mdun du rgyun chad med par 'byon/ /padma 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rig 'dzin slob dpon chen pos rjes bzungs nas/ /gnas skabs bar chad dgra las rnam —239

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shergyal shing / /mthar thug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /ces pa 'di ni blang dor la lta ba'i mig can kha ra phyin bi lig thu nang sos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes bris/mthong na mi mthun med pa mtshan bzang sku/ /thos pas rtsa ba'i gdung sel rdo rje'i gsung /kun la phan bde'i dpal stsol brtse ldan thugs/ /rgyal sras phyag na padma ra gsol ba 'debs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i ngag gi dbang phyug gis/ /blo gsal skal bzang 'gro la dam pa'i chos/ /ston mdzad dpyod ldan rgya mtsho'i gnyen gcig pu/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i 'jigs med kyi/ /rmad byung go cha btsan po cher gyon pa'i/ /thub bstan lang tsho rgyas pa'i yongs 'du'i sde/ /gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba 'dis kyang mkha' mnyam lus can kun/ /nyon mongs dug gsum g.yul las rnam rgyal nas/ /'khru/ra med (59ba〉sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bde ba che/ /tshe 'dir mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa srid mthar rab 'phel zhing / /de 'dzin tshogs rnams bzhed pa'i don kun grub/ /grangs med 'gro ba ma lus bde skyid kyi/ /dpal 'byor bzang pos yun du 'tsho gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang bal po'i bande sogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes bris/zung 'jug sku bzhi'i snang brnyan mtshan dpe'i gar/ /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs grub pa'i blo gros can/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i re skong yongs 'du'i ljon/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i 'jigs med gyi/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i go cha btsan po yis/ /thub bstan rnam par rgyas pa'i lang tsho'i dpyid/ /don gnyis grub pa'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /srong btsan thugs rje'i rlung gis nyer drangs pa'i/ /lhag bsam snying stobs rgyas pa'i tsandan dris/ /gangs can rgud pa'i tsha gdung sel mdzad pa'i/ /phan dang bde ba'i nyer 'tshor gsol ba 'debs/ /gang shar rang sar grol ba theg dgu'i rtse/ /lha chos bdun ldan glegs bam gsang ba'i chos/ /gsung rab bdud rtsi'i snying po slob bshad sogs/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i mdzod la gsol —240

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bkab 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos 'jam dpal snying po yi/ /bstan pa'i gdugs dkar rin chen yu ba can/ /legs 'dzin srid rtse'i bar du 'khor mdzad pa'i/ /tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs dbyangs can lha yis rjes bzung bas/ /rnam dpyod dpyod ldan yid gyi zil dngar can/ /kun dga'i dga' ston brjod bral ye shes che/ /stsol mkhas mkhas btsun bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /dge tshogs yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po che/ /(60na)gsol 'debs rgyal mtshan rtse mor rab bkod pas/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bsam pa'i re ba kun/ /legs skong 'dod dgu'i char gyis tshim gyur cig /ces gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni gtsang rong glang phu ba ngag dbang legs ldan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes rma chu'i 'gram nying shā rgyal bu'i mkhar chen dang nye bar sbyar/gar dbang li khri'i thig le mtshan dpe'i mdangs/ /rab gsal 'chi med dpal ster tshe yi lha//bcom ldan lhag pa'i lha dang dbyer med pa'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan la bla ma mchog /bcom ldan tshe dpag med kyi skur gsal ba'i/ /bum pa las 'ongs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /'chi med dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /gsung ngag legs snyan dri za lha dbang dang / /blo chen tshangs pa lha min stobs bzang sogs/ /rgya chen 'gro la lhag bsam 'o mtsho ltar/ /rab dkar bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di yang gu ru na kho sho'i chin dbang dang gu ru na kong jo gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/spyi gtsug pad dkar zla ba'i gdan steng na/ /rnam 'dren kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpyid/ /rgyal sras gzhen nur shar ba'i 'jo sgeg can/ /'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod 'gyur med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/ /ma dag gdul bya'i snang ngor mngon sum du/ /ji bzhin ston pa'i skal ba ches phra bas/ /bshes gnyen dam par shar la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bla ma'i rnam rol du/ /bstan nas 'gro ba 'dren par mdzad do zhes/ /mdo rgyud du mar —241

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegasungs la nges rnyed nas/ /snying nas bla ma mchog la gsol ba (60ba tsher de bas/ /mtha' med 'khor ba bgrod dka'i bshul lam du/ /las nyon gyis bskrun skye ba'i 'grul ring por/ /'phyug med legs pa'i lam gyi sa mkhan can/ /yongs 'dzin dam pas rjes su 'dzin par shog /dad brtson shes rab shing rtas nyer drangs nas/ /mi gnas myang 'das rin chen gling mchog tu/ /legs par bgrod nas rang gzhan ma lus pa'i/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes rang gang mos kyi bla ma dang spyan ras gzigs dbyer med du gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa 'di ni cha gar thi yan chi sogs mkhar sngon po'i ri khrod pa rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /rgyal kun ngo bo phyag na padma'i gar/ /ngag gi dbang phyug lhun grub blo gros kyis/ /lam bzang rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas skal ldan 'gror/ /ston mdzad bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba 'di yi bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ /tshe 'dir 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub gyur cig /phyi ma lho phyogs ri bo gru 'dzin du/ /skyes ste theg mchog chos la spyod la 'jug par shog /ces pa 'di ni bande thi yan chis bskul ba'i ngor bris/ngag gi dpal mnga' dbang phyug brgyad/ /lhun grub blo ldan skal bzang kun/ /dga' skyed thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sde/ /dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /bdud sde'i tshogs la 'jigs med pa'i/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i go cha can/ /kun mkhyen thub bstan lung rtogs kyi/ /lang tsho rgyas mdzad sde la 'dud/ /dge 'dis tshe rabs thams cad du/ /yongs 'dzin dam pas rjes bzung ste/ /gtan gyi bde ba legs bsgrubs nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di bo ro tshe ring gi ngor za tar gyi bzhes bris/smra mkhas ngag gi rdzing (61na)bur lus dkar dbang / /blo ldan chu bya'i tshogs dang lhan gcig par/ /skal bzang rgya cher bsgrags ba'i mgrin pa'i rngas/ /mtsho byung 'gugs pa'i byed por gsol —242

bla ma'i bstod tshegs kyi rim pa/ (bdab 'debs/ /zhi bdes 'jigs med byang sems go cha can/ /thub bstan snying po stong nyid mtshon rnon pos/ /bdud dgra kun bcom myang 'das lang tsho'i sde/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge des nam mkha'i mthas khyab 'gro ba kun/ /'dren pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag khur cher pos/ /bdag sogs kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtsho cher/ /'jug pa'i skal ba bzang por spyod gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang kha ran thu thal jis bskul ba'i ngor bris/med byung mkhyen pa'i gting mtha' zab cing brling / /'gro la rjes brtse'i rlabs 'phreng yol ba med/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /gtsug lag mang por thos pa'i dga' tshal du/ /sdom gsum khrims kyi rtsa ba brtan pa'i shing / /lhag bsam lo 'bras khur gyis nyer dud pa'i/ /mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs bla ma tsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho la/ /ston mdzad dbyangs can dga' ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /thub bstan yongs 'du'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /dge 'dis bstan 'gro phan bde rab rgyas shing / /de 'dzin tshogs kyi zhabs pad srid mthar brtan/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su 'dzin par shog /gnas skabs tshe 'dir nad gdon bar chad sogs/ /mi mthun rgud pa'i mun tshogs kun zhi zhing / /mthar thug gtan bde'i 'od stong rab rgyas pa'i/ /don gnyis nyin mo'i snang ba 'bar gyur cig /(61ba༄sa pa 'di yang zung chu rab 'byams pa dngos grub yon tan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes chab char sbyar ba'o/ /su sti siddhi/ chos dbyings dam pa zad mi shes pa'i mdzod/ /sna tshogs gzugs sku'i bkod pa rgya mtsho'i sgo/ /legs par phye nas gtan bde'i yid bzhin nor/ /stsol mdzad 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal por 'dud/ /thub dbang spyan sngar dgra bcom tsunda'i zhabs/ /klu sgrub sras mchog shākya bshes gnyen dang / /gangs can mig gcig ka ba dpal brtsegs sogs/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar sgyur la —243

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegasol ba 'debs/ /theg mchog bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sgro phug rje/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor spyod pa'i si si ri/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /bsams bzhin mngon par sprul la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khon rigs 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i thugs sras byams chen rje/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs/ /ngo mtshar skyes rabs 'phreng bar gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan rgyal kun gsang gsum yongs 'du'i ljon/ /spangs rtogs 'byor pa'i 'bras bus yongs dud pas/ /don gnyis re ba skong la lhun grub pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /ji snyed gnas lnga rigs pa mthar son mkhas/ /sdom gsum nyes lhung dri mas ma gos btsun/ /ris med 'gro la lhag bsam dkar bas bzang / /dam pa'i spyod tshul ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /'chad la phur bu'i khengs 'phrog dpyod ldan can/ /rtsom tshe mgrin par dbyangs can 'jo sgeg 'gying / /rtsod na 'jam dbyangs mthon mthing lcang lo dor/ /mkhas pa kun gyi dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i mkhyen pa rgyas/ /'gro ba kun la bu ltar brtse ba ldan/ /(62na)lus can 'dren pa'i snying stobs nus pa che/ /rigs gsum mgon po dngos la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya chen shes pa'i tshig don ma lus thos/ /de don rnam par dpyad nas legs par bsams/ /'khrul med tshul ba 'a na nyams su bstan nas bsgoms/ /mthar thug mngon gyur khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /rje btsun bla mar gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /tshe rabs kun du dal 'byor rten thob ste/ /mi dge'i bshes dang nam yang mi 'phrad cing / /tshad ldan dam pa'i mgon gyis zin par shog /sgra tshad bzo gso tha snyad rig pa dang / /mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa'i chos tshul sogs/ /gtsug lag rgya mtshor thos dang bsams pa yis/ /yang dag bag chags bzang po 'jog par shog /smin byed dbang dang grol byed zab mo'i khrid/ /rgyab rten lung dang bka' gter man ngag sogs/ /snga phyir 'gyur ba'i rdo rje theg pa yi/ /zab mo'i chos rnams nyams su len par shog /bshul ring bgrod dka' srid dang zhi ba'i 'phrang / /nye lam mkha' lding dbang po'i gshog —244

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bderlabs kyis/ /snyigs dus tshe thung gcig la thogs med du/ /sku gsum go 'phang gnas su bgrod par shog /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'byor lhun grub la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni dpa' mdzangs brtul phod dang ldan pa'i tha'i ji tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ba'i ngor bla ma'i bka' 'bangs za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /shes bya'i tshig don 'chad la snyan pa'i ngag /smra ba'i dbang phyug grub pa'i blo gros kyis/ skal bzang gdul bya'i re ba legs skong ba'i/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dbang por gsol ba (62ba)'debs/ /slu med mchog gsum dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar 'khas brtan cing / /bdag sogs rnams kyi bsams don ma lus pa/ /gegs med lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang bstan 'dzin dpon po'i ngor bris/phul byung mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gan mdzod nas/ /dngos grub yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po che//'bad med 'gro la stsol ba'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ /gnas skabs bsams pa'i don kun lhun grub cing / /mthar thug kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtsho cher/ /'jug pa'i skal ba bzang por spyod gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni dge rgyas dpon ngag dbang rdo rjes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes bris/su sti pra dza khyoḥ ngo mtshar chos sku ka dag klong yangs su/ /lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs sku 'od lnga'i gar/ /thugs rjes 'gro la snang ba sprul pa'i sku/ /khyab bdag kun bzang padma sambha wa/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rdo rgya mtshor padma'i sdong po yi/ /'jam mnyen 'dab stong rgyas pa'i ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ /mngal gyi dri bral rdzus skyes mtshan dpe'i gar/ rang byung sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs —245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheso u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ekhri yā na'i nor 'dzin ma lus par/ /dbang sgyur sa spyod ind+ra bhū ti yis/ /sras su bzung tshe 'bangs rnams bde la bkod/ /u rgyan chos kyi rgyal po thor cog can/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'jigs med brtul zhugs seng ge'i nga ro'i rgyud/ /zad mi shes pa'i sgra dbyangs cher bsgrags (63na)pas/ /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin sbyor sgrol mtha' ru phyin/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug shānta rakṣi ta/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /med byung theg mchog chos kyi bdud rtsi yis/ /thugs su legs bltams yi dam lha tshogs gzigs/ /bag yod khrims ldan ngur smrig gos kyis klubs/ /bstan pa'i bdag po shākya seng ge'i zhabs/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'phags yul mkhas grub bla ma mang bsten nas/ /gsang sngags phyi nang rig pa'i gnas rnams kun/ /ma lus gsan zhing sgro 'dogs legs bcad pa'i/ /thams cad mkhyen pa blo ldan mchog sred dpal/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ma ra ti gar 'chi med lha bsgrubs pas/ /tshe dpag med kyis mngon sum byin gyis brlabs/ gzhom gzhig bral ba rdo rje'i sku mchog brnyes/ /tshe dbang rig 'dzin 'chi med pad 'byung rje/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams —246

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdapa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug me tog manta ra/ /bde chen ye shes skyes pa'i gzungs ma mdzad/ /gtsug lag 'dzin sogs za hor yul khams kun/ /chos la 'god mdzad padma sam bha wa/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi bsrun gshed mas spar ba'i bzod dka'i me/ /skad cig chu mtshor sgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /'byor ba'i dbang sogs u rgyan 'gro ba kun/ /byang chub la 'god sras mchog padma rgyal/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ma dag grub mtha' ngan pa'i dug chu yis/ /cher smyos mu stegs log spyod glang chen sogs/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal gsum yongs rdzogs pas/ /phye mar 'thag mdzad seng ge sgra sgrog zhabs/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so༄kyi rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung phur pa'i mthu stobs gzis/ /nag phyogs bdud sde'i mun pa pha mthar bskrad/ /yang dag bde chen lam bzang la brten nas/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ khri srong bsod nams mthu yis spyan drangs tshe/ /lha srin dam gtags sa gzhi (63ba)byin gyis rlabs/ kha ba'i ljongs su dam chos sgron me spar/ /bka' drin 'khor med padma ka ra'i zhabs/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so3ni rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor du/ /chos rgyal tshangs pa lha yi me tog —247

rgyal dbang lnga pa ge ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shesogs/ /las can rje 'bangs smin grol lam la bkod/ /bod yul theg mchog chos kyis dkar por mdzad/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub dang zhi rgyas dbang / /log 'dren cham la 'bebs pa'i drag sngags sogs/ /chos nor gter gyis bsil ldan yul kun bkang / /bdud dpung 'dul mdzad rdo rje gro lod rtsal/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bod yul ljongs kyi sgrub gnas grangs med pa/ /u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dang mtshungs par mdzad/ /brag dang mtsho la sku gzugs phyag zhabs rjes/ /ston mdzad ngo mtshar bkod pa'i pahrūl can/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so3kyi rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /mthong thos dran pa tsam gyis rnam grol ba'i/ /sku rten 'gyur med rdo rje gsang ba'i gsung / /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi snying po yis/ /snyigs dus bod 'bangs phan bde'i ngal gsor mdzad/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /srin yul zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo'i rtser/ /'phrin las khrag 'thung ga rma gu ru yis/ /sgyu 'phrul gar gyis sha za srin po'i tshogs/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje chen pos 'dul mdzad pa/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bsam yas mchims phu dpal gyi yang dben du/ /ngo mtshar grub rtags rdzu phral dpag med mdzad/ /rgyal ba'i sras mchog rje 'bangs nyer lnga yang / /mgon khyod ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /snying 248

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdanas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /myang ral chos kyi dbang phyug rgod ldem can/ u rgyan gling pa tshe brtan rgyal mtshan sogs/ /zab don gter gyi sgo 'byed grangs med rnams/ khyod kyis snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon du sprul/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan rje/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs shig padma 'byung / /'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zab gter bstan pa mi nub spel ba la/ /bka' babs las 'phro sad (64na)ba'i snying stobs can/ /'khrul med rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i tshogs rnams kyang / khyod kyis rjes bzung las can snying gi bu/ gang shar chos kun rig pa'i rang rtsal tu/ /rnam grol swā la'i ljongs kyi phan bde'i gzhi/ /tshe rabs du mar rgyal dbang padma yis/ /rjes bzung med byung thugs rje'i zlos gar can/ /ris med 'gro kun thugs rje chen po yis/ /rjes su 'dzin yang khyad par bod 'bangs rnams/ /dus ngan snyigs ma mthar thug bzod dka' ba'i/ /'jigs rung sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba na/ /mgon khyod thugs rje'i mthu dpung cher bskyed de/ /sprul pa yang sprul nang nub kun du spro/ /dus kyi rgyal po yar ngo'i tshes bcu la/ /ma ro zhe sum 'byon par zhal bzhes rdo rje'i gsung / /slu med tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /byin rlabs dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa'i 'bras/ /'dod pa'i re ba bskong ba'i char chen po/ /stsol ba'i dus la bab po padma 'byung / /dus ngan mthar thug lha srin sde brgyad 'byug /ma rung stod smad gdug pa'i dmag dpung g.yo/ /phung byed bdud kyi cho 'phrul rlung ltar 'tshub/ /mi bsrun skye bo'i ngan spyod chu ltar 'khrug /snying nas chos bzhin spyod la log sgrub mang/ /tshul bzhin thos bsam sgom pa'i bstan pa 'gribs/ /dbang khrid 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i phyag len sogs/ /nges gsang theg pa'i ring lugs 'chol par spyod/ khyad par khyod kyi zab gter gdams pa la/ /chos log yin zhes skur 'debs ya ga sgrog /mi bsrun gzhan 'phrul gnas kyi dbang po 'gas/ /'jam mnyen 'dab mas —249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'agro mang snying kha 'bigs/ /tshul 'di dgongs shig rje btsun thod 'phreng rtsal/ /mthu dpung skyed cig padma sam bha lha/ /(64ba)byin gyis rlobs shig mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs/ /dngos grub stsol cig u rgyan rin po che/ /nad gdon dgra bgegs mi mthun phyogs kun zhi/ /tshe dpal stobs 'byor yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas/ /srid dang zhi ba'i legs tshogs ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos kun gdod nas dag pa stong pa'i dbyings/ /lhun grub snang bzhi'i lam bzang 'ja' ltar bkra/ /rig pa rang ngo shes pa'i kun tu bzang / /tshe 'dir mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam par g.yeng bas tshe 'dir ma grol na/ /'da' kha'i nyams len 'pho ba'i 'tshams sbyor gyis/ /bde ba can sogs dag pa'i zhing mchog tu/ /thogs med bgrod nas rdzus te skye bar shog /tshul de lam na ma longs bar do zhes/ /'jigs rung ya nga'i gnas der skyes gyur na/ /mgon khyod mngon sum byon nas dbugs phyung ste/ /'khrul pa rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dal ba'i rten thob dam pa'i mgon gyis zin/ /zab mo'i chos thos de don nyams su blangs/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs mdun ma lhun grub pa'i/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po thob gyur cig /ces slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas la bstod pa byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i snying po 'di ni/ sa skyong ba sde pa thon pa mgon po bkra shis kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho ming gzhan gang shar rang grol du 'bod pa'i ldom bu pas/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /dpal ldan phun tshogs srid pa'i dge legs kun/ /stsol mdzad dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa yid (65na)bzhin nor/ /dngos grub yongs 'du'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal dbang padmas rjes bzung gnyag gi rigs/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug dzñā na ku mā ra/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /u rgyan thugs kyi sras la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po'i tshul bzung ba'i/ /srong btsan thugs kyi gdams pa'i —250

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdegater gyi sgo/ /legs par phye nas gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i/ /sprul sku dam pa dmar por gsol ba 'debs/ /'gyur ba med pa sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor yongs shar ba'i/ /mal yer zhabs kyis kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /mngon par spro bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo'i mgon po he ru ka /bshes gnyen gzugs su rol ba g.yu brag pas/ /rjes bzung phyag chen lam gyi dngos grub mchog /rab brnyes sangs rgyas 'bum la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdo sgyu sems sogs nges gsang bstan pa'i bdag /zur gyi rigs 'khrungs dge la rab 'dun pa'i/ /yon tan 'dus sde'i 'byung gnas bde ba cher/ /skyed mdzad mkha' 'gro'i dbang mor gsol ba 'debs//khri srong lde'u bcan gsung gi sprul pa'i gar/ /chos dbang zab mo'i gter gyi bka' babs pa/ /sman lung mi bskyod rdo rje'i rigs rgyud du/ bsams bzhin skye ba bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /lung rig legs par bshad pa'i gter chen pos/ /mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas gsang phu'i chos kyi grwar/ /gsung rab 'byor pa'i dpal la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /lang 'gro'i rnam sprul rin chen dpal bzang gis/ /zab chos bdag (65ba)por bka' babs lung bstan pa'i/ /spangs rtogs yon tan rgya mtsho'i mthar phyin pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos 'byung brag gi zab mo'i gter gyi sgo/ /'byed mdzad sprul pa'i skyes mchog las 'phro gling / /kun dga'i zhabs kyi rigs chos 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /dkon mchog rin chen zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan chos kyi 'byor ba'i dge tshogs kun/ /rab rgyas ngag dbang lha yis rjes bzung bas/ /bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i mgrin pa nas/ /legs bshad kun dga'i 'dod 'jor gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kun ka nas dag pa'i dbyings chen por/ /rang grol lhun grub 'od gsal lam bzang brnyes/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa rgyas mdzad padma dbang / /theg mchog chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rdo rje slob dpon mchog gis rjes bzung ste/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par byin —251 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegyis rlobs/ /mi 'gyur padma rā ga'i gnas khang du/ /g.yung drung sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i khrir/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma mchog /bskal ba rgya mtshor zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang bum pa bzang po ltar/ /bsams pa'i re ba ma lus legs skong ba'i/ /phan bde'i dpal gyis dus kun khyab gyur cig /ces dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid zur chen chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang bkra shis kun dga' dpal bzang po'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs kyi rim pa 'di ni/ /sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes (66na tha skul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /phun tshogs ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i za ma tog /bla med ye shes bdud rtsi rab 'khyil bas/ /dge legs 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin dbang gi rgyal/ /rnam 'dren kun dngos bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /snyigs dus nags klung stug po'i tshul yangs par/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes rabs yongs 'du'i 'phreng / /phul byung mdzad pa'i lo 'bras g.yur za ba/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i nyer mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /med byung mkhyen pa'i lha yi lam yangs par/ /'gro la rjes brtse'i ri dwags mtshan ma can/ /lhag bsam nus pa'i 'od dkar stong 'phro bas/ /phan bde'i ātpal bzhad la gsol ba 'debs/ /bgrang yas shes bya kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i gtso/ /dri med tshul khrims ngad ldan btsun pa'i mchog /ris med 'gro la byams ldan bzang po'i dpal/ /kun mkhyen gnyis par nges la gsol ba 'debs/ /'chad pa'i rnam dpyod mtshungs dper dbyig gi gnyen/ /rtsod tshe chos grags rigs pa'i rjes 'gro ba/ /rtsom la dpal ldan dpa' bo'i ngang tshul can/ /thub bstan yongs kyi shing rtar gsol ba 'debs/ /mang du thos pa'i chu gter chen po'i 'jing / /tshul bzhin rnam par bsam pa'i gdengs ka can/ /legs sgom zung 'jug nor bu'i cod pan mdzes/ /bshes gnyen klu yi dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /dmar ser dhīḥyig khams las grub pa'i lha/ /'jam mgon lang tsho rgyas pa'i 252

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdasgyu dra'i gar/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs phyogs bcur spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo ldan skal bzang gdul (66ba)bya'i tshogs rnams la/ /dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston legs stsal nas/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mkhas pa/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' med bgrod dka' 'khor ba'i bshul ring du/ /grib ma ltar 'brang dkar nag las dbang gis/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar ba'i tshe rabs su/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes 'dzin shog /dal ba'i rten bzang rnyed dka' 'jig par sla/ /srid 'byor snying po med pa'i tshul shes nas/ /bcos min nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pa yis/ /skyes bu chung 'bring lam la slob par shog /drin can ma rnams 'dren phyir rgyal sras su/ /rlabs chen spyod pa mchog la legs 'jug cing / /smin grol gsang sngags nye lam la brten nas/ /tshe 'dir rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par shog /dam chos sgrub la mthun pa'i rkyen kun tshang / /'gro ba ma lus phan bde'i dpal la spyod/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa yis/ /'dod pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par shog /khyad par gdong lngas bteg pa'i nor bu'i khrir/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po bla ma mchog /bskal pa rgya mtshor zhabs pad rab brtan cing / /chos 'khor rgyun chad med par skor du gsol/ /zhes dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni gtan gyi 'dun ma lhur len pa la gcig tu gzhol ba'i nor tshang ri khrod pa rnams dang sog ban legs pa'i shes rab kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha (67na)thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes sum rtsen yul la 'gran pa nyang smad kyi sa'i cha pho brang chen po bsam grub rtser sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya ma sna 7 1 / /dpal ldan khyab bdag snang mtha' yas pa'i 'od/ /phun tshogs ngo mtshar cod pan la 'chang —253

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheba'i/ /med byung rjes chags snying rje'i ri dwags gzugs/ /ris med zla ba'i ma mar shar der 'dud/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rnon po'i ngag gi mtshon/ /rmongs pa'i drwa ba gcod pa'i 'khor lo yis/ /shes bya'i nor 'dzin kun la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /blo gsal skal bzang nyer 'tshor gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya chen mtsho ltar gting zab nges gsang bdag /phyag na mthu stobs rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzis/ /bdud dpung 'joms la 'jigs med go cha yis/ /brtul zhugs lhun gyis grub la gsol ba 'debs/ /lhag bsam dpung pas yongs bteg utpal steng / /rlabs chen spyod pa'i bum bzang las 'ongs chus//phan bde'i 'dab stob 'dzum pa'i mchod sbyin mkhan/ /phul byung byams brtse'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdud bzhi'i dgra tshogs kun thub nyi ma'i gnyen/ /dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan pa'i dri med bstan/ /lung rtogs zla ba'i lang tsho dar ba'i cha/ /bshad dang sgrub pas spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshangs dbang sras mo'i phyag sor gyis brdungs pa'i/ /dam pa'i chos kyi dbyangs ldan rgyud mang glu/ /snang ba bdud rtsir spyod la dbang ba'i sde/ /mtha' klas gnas lnga rigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /theg kun rtse mor bgrod pa snang bzhi'i lam/ /bka' gdams dri med lugs srol lha chos bdun/ /dwags shangs snying po chos drug phyag rgya'i las/ /sna tshogs (67ba)gdams pa'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan 'khrul med slob bshad chos/ /mdo sngags zung du 'jug pa'i lam rim sogs/ /'jam dpal snying po'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i mdzod/ /'dzin mkhas rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /dge tshogs chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor las/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'od dkar stong spros pas/ srid zhi'i sdug bsngal mun pa drungs phyung ste/ /don gnyis snang ba'i dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa 'di yang gra ldum bu ba ngag dbang legs pas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /blo bzang dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid la/ /dbang sgyur bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ /ngag dbang blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /blo —254

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ khobadaldan bzang po'i gdul byar dam chos kyi/ /rgyal mtshan bsgreng phyir ngag dbang yi dam lha/ /blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i srung ma yis/ /bskal brgyar g.yo med brtan pa'i dge legs mdzod/ /mtha' med 'khor ba mi gtsang 'dam rdzab tu/ /grangs med skye ba'i srid bzung padma dkar/ /yongs 'dzin nyin mor byed pas legs bskyangs nas/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'dab stong 'dzum gyur cig /gsol ba 'debs brtan bzhugs smon lam 'di lta bu zhis dgos zhes dka' chen pa'i mdun tshul khrims kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes pho brang bsam grub rtser sbyar/mi 'gyur chos sku'i ngo bo snang mtha' yas/ /grangs med longs sku'i rnam rol pad dkar 'dzin/ /med byung sprul sku'i zlos gar srong btsan zhabs/ /gsol ba (68na)'debs so bsam pa lhun grub shog /yang sprul dus gsum mkhyen pa padma 'byung / /zab don gter gyi sgo 'byed dngos grub zhabs/ /mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po myang ral la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bsam pa lhun 'grub shog /sprul pa'i sku mchog shākya bzang po dang / /srong btsan thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul dge ba 'bum/ /'gro la rjes brtse sangs rgyas lcam mo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bsam pa lhun 'grub shog /grub pa'i dbang phyug chu sgom zhig po dang / /chos brgyad spangs pa'i mtha' bzhi bya bral ba/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bsod nams seng ge la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bsam pa lhun 'grub shog /grub pa mchog brnyes bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang / /'gro ba'i bla ma blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /'phags chen lam bzang mngon gyur nor bu bzang / /gsol ba 'debs so bsam pa lhun 'grub shog /mkhas shing grub pa rgyal mtshan bzang po'i zhabs/ /mdo sngags don gzigs chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rin chen rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bsam pa lhun 'grub shog /sku gsum mngon gyur bkra shis rgya mtsho dang / /snang bzhi mthar phyin kun dga' che mchog zhabs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug ye shes grub pa'i dpal/ /gsol ba 'debs so bsam pa lhun 'grub shog /mthu stobs mnga' bdag gzhon nu don grub dang / /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po padma dbang / /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa —255

rgyal dbang lnga pa ge ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losheba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bsams pa lhun grub shog /smin grol zab mo'i lam bzang la brten nas/ /tshe 'dir 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug gi /go 'phang mngon du byas nas don gnyis kun/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i brgyud 'debs bsams don lhun grub ces pa 'di yang rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang phyug zur chen chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brnyes sug bris su bgyis pa'o/ /(68ba)kun mkhyen bu ston chos rje'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs sogs bzhugs so/ /ne mitta bha dru par mārba shudhaṅgā tu rna kṣa yusgro1khuṅgā bi tsi45/ /myu ddha tri:snye ha ma hormenda dra tse pa dhyā yamā ya drum pādzadzin ri/ /dag pa don dam zad pa med pa'i dbyings/ /mtshan bzang dbang po'i gzhu ris rnam bkra ba/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i sgyu 'phrul mkhan/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i mchod sdong gtsug na rgyal/ 'gro la bu ltar rjes chags snying rje'i zla/ /lhag bsam ga bur zegs ma 'thul ba'i zer/ /phan bde'i sa mos 'dzum pa'i dga' ston gyi/ /byed por rgyal ba kun gyis mgrin gcig bsngags/ /grangs med chos phung rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i rdzas/ /mkhyen yangs rnam par dpyod pa'i gru gzings kyis/ /legs bshad rin chen 'dren la dbang 'byor pas/ khres bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpe slar grub/ /sgra tshad bzo gso'i sa srung steng 'gying ba'i/ /gnas lnga'i 'dren byed stong ldan 'chi med dbang / /nang rig rdo rje rtse brgyad gdengs tsam gyis/ /sgrib gnyis ri bo'i bgrod pa lhag mar (69na)byas/ /ind+ra ni la ltar mthing gtsug tor rtser/ /'pho med kun da'i mdud pa yongs grol ba'i/ /stong chen dag pa rab 'byams dbyings kyi gzugs/ /rnam kun mchog ldan bde ba'i 'ja' ris bkra/ /gzod ma nyid nas —256

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kye rim pa/ khobade.e waṃ zung 'jug pa'i/ /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtsor grub kyang / /gzhan ngor thun 'tshams gsar ba'i blo gros kyis/ /thub pa'i bstan la kun mkhyen gnyis par nges/ /kun la thugs rje'i rlabs 'phrong yol med pa'i/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las chad med babs pa'i chab/ /srid pa'i khongs las brgal tshe gser mngal can/ /snod kyi 'jig rten gsar du skrun la brel/ /mdzes so kun gsal 'gram par ri bong can/ /grangs med rkang 'thung khrod na yongs 'du'i ljon/ /theg gsum 'khor gyi dbus na nyi ma'i gnyen/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la kun mkhyen bu ston rje/ /'phags yul paṇa grub dbang po stha bi ra/ /sgyu lus mngon gyur khyung po lo tswa'i zhabs/ kha che'i paṇa chen shākya shri sogs//skyes rabs nor bu'i 'phreng ba tshar du dngar/ /mgon khyod phul byung mdzad pa'i me na ka /dge ba'i zhing khams bkod pa rgya mtsho'i rdul/ /bye ba phrag brgyar yongs su gar sgyur yang / /ma dag zhing 'di'i 'gro la gcig tu brtse/ /de phyir grub dbang seng ge rgyal mtshan dang / /rnal 'byor mchog brnyes pha rgod bsod nams bzang / /'khor lo'i mgon po rje btsun tshar pa rje/ /bar srid skye ba'i zlos gar 'di rmad byung / /rab dkar 'jam mnyen 'dzum pa'i 'dab ma'i sgo/ /yid srubs cho ga rdzogs pa'i rna ba'i rgyan/ /li shi'i zol gyis g.yo ba'i phon po dag /mngar ba'i dri bsung 'thul ba'i skal ba phra/ /shes bya kun (69ba)mkhyen rnam dpyod mkha' ltar yangs/ /'gro la rjes chags chags bral ngur smrig 'chang / /gnas lnga yongs rig rig gnas rgya mtshor mkhas/ /lhag bsam rab dkar dkar ba'i zla ba bzhin/ /yang yang skye bar goms pa'i shes pa dang / /ngal ngal tshe 'dir sbyangs pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /mkhas mkhas kun gyi yang rtser legs son pa'i/ /snyan snyan grags pa dri za'i rgyud mang 'jibs/ /rgya chen mang thos 'chad pa'i rnam dpyod mchog /mchog tu yangs pas rtsod tshe rgol ngan 'jigs/ /'jigs pa med par rtsol ba'i legs bshad rgyud/ /rgyud mang glu las chos kyi sgra bzhin snyan/ snyan ngag nyams 'gyur stong dang ldan pa'i dbyangs/ /dbyangs can lha mor drug cu'i gsung ltar legs/ /legs sbyar brda sprod gzhung brgya chad pa'i blo/ /blo gros sa spru dzñā yi brgyud pa 'dzin/ /'dzin —257

rgyal dbang snga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemed mtha' bral ston pa dbu ma'i lam/ /lam bzang shin tu rgyas pa phar phyin gzhung/ /gzhud kun gtan la 'bebs pa tshad ma rig /rig pa lung 'brel ston mdzad bu ston rje/ /rje btsun rgyal tshab dam pa mi pham mgon/ /mgon de su la'i ljongs 'dir mkhas pa'i dbang / /dbang phyug yon tan brgyad du grub pa'i dpal/ /dpal ldan shākya'i bstan pa ngo mtshar med/ /snyan tshig ngag gis bstod pa'i bsod nams gzugs/ /phung po gcig tu dkar ba'i 'bras bu'i ro/ /longs su spyad pa'i phun tshogs skal bzang gis/ /dus mkhyen rgyal po'i rnam thar 'grub gyur cig /ces gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs kyi yon tan rgya mtsho chen po las chu thigs tsam zhig blangs pa'i snyan tshig padma dkar po'i chun po 'di ni za hor gyi bsdo'i blo mtsho las g.yur du za ba'o/ /(70na)dga' ba brgya pa'i tshems kyi mngal khur las/ /ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ri dwags mig /dbang phyug yon tan brgyad kyi mchog sbyin ma/ /mgrin pa'i pad mtshor rol la gsol ba 'debs/ /rmongs rtul sbyin skyes bcom pa'i blo gros kyi/ /snying gar rnam dpyod dpal gyi be'u'i gzugs/ /skal bzang mig gi gzigs mor ngo mtshar ba'i/ /bshes gnyen 'chi med gtso la gsol ba 'debs/ /mang thos gser mngal can gyi thod yangs las/ /legs bshad chad pa med pa gaṅgā'i rgyun/ gsung rab rgya mtshor la jug pa'i byed po mchog /yongs 'dzin skal ldan shing rtar gsol ba 'debs/ /rgol ngan chu srin rgyal mtshan sder bcas la/ /'jigs med 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i go cha can/ /gtsug na mngon par dkar ba'i ri bong 'dzin/ /lhag bsam bdud rtsi spro la gsol ba 'debs/ /thub bstan lang tsho rgyas pa'i dpal gyi mgur/ /dam pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs snyan pa'i dung / /'jam dpal snying po'i bstan la g.yas 'khyil ba'i/ /dbyangs can dga' ba'i bde la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos kun mkhyen tsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs 'chi med dga' tshal las 'ongs 'bras/ /ma 'dris 'gro la brtse ba'i 'dza' bshes kyis/ /ster mdzad skye rgu'i gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsung ngag dbang gi rgyal po gdul bya'i blor/ /legs bltams mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'jug —258

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kye rim pa/ (bdengogs can/ /phul byung 'dod pa'i re skong yid bzhin nor/ /legs byas rgya mtsho'i zhing mchog zhabs brtan shog /'phrog byed dbang pos bteg pa rdo rje'i khri/ /nam yang gzhom du med pa g.yung drung gdan/ /phun tshogs (70ba)bkra shis rtags kyis legs mtshan par/ /bskal pa'i bar du mi 'gyur brtan par shog /sgo gsum 'bad pa'i dge tshogs chu 'dzin las/ /bsod nams zad pa med pa'i char rgyun gyis/ /gser ldan lto ba yongs su dub pa'i 'bras/ /don gnyis myu gu smin pa'i dga' ston stsol/ /slu med dkon mchog mchog gi thugs rje'i dpal/ /dpal mgrin tshangs dbang dbang po mkhar ba'i dgra /dgra bcom 'phags tshogs tshogs bsags drang srong tshig /tshig don ma lus lus med 'grub par 3|ga /ces gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa 'di ni sku 'bum byams pa gling gi sngags grwa'i slob dpon bsod nams rin chen gyis rgyang ring po nas pho nya mngags te bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos g.yas ru gtsang gi sa'i cha nyang smad bsam 'grub rtser sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho'o/ /ngag gi 'dod 'jo dbyangs can dga' ba'i dpal/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la dbang ba'i blo gros can/ /mkhas btsun bzang por grub pa'i 'khor lo yis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyon la sgyur de rgyal/ /mi 'jigs bzhi ldan rgyal gsung snying po'i bcud/ /yod med mtha' bral dbu ma'i go cha yis/ /thub bstan theg chen lang tsho'i srog 'tsho ba'i/ /rnam dpyod sde bzhi'i dpal mngar gsol ba 'debs/ /shes bya'i pha mtha' rnam par sra ba'i gzhu/ /mang thos rgyud kyis bkug pa'i gnas lnga'i mdas/ /dri bcas 'brul pa'i bde 'byung dka' thub kyi/ /dam bca'i dngos kun 'jig pa'i chos nyid can/ /mtha' klas tshig gi ka shi mdzes dga' ma'i/ /don bzang rna gong la phon po'i kha/ /(71na)phra zhib bsam pa'i zla zer gyis phye bas/ /phul byung legs bshad 'dab ma 'dzum gyis su/ /brjod bral stong chen dag pa'i mkha' dbyings ngos/ /bde chen rnam par bkra ba'i 'ja' tshon mdangs/ /rlung sems goms pa'i bir gyis bris pa'i gar/ /zung 'jug 'dzin ma'i ngos su sgyur la brel/ /'jam dbyangs —259

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedabyangs can mgrin par chags pa'i gtam/ /snyan tshig tshig don 'khrol ba'i rgyud mang sgra/ /rnam dpyod dpyod ldan dga' ba'i 'gyur khug gi /zil dngar dngar ba'i glu dbyangs mgrin par len/ /phun tshogs don gnyis nor bu'i bang mdzod nas/ /'dod pa'i re ba skong ba'i dbang gi rgyal/ /'bad med stsol mkhas ma 'dris mdza' ba'i bshes/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje'i khams las grub pa'i seng ge'i khrir/ khyod zhabs bkra shes 'khor lo'i ri mo can/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor 'gro la dam chos kyi/ /'khor lo bskor phyir g.yo med brtan par bzhugs/ /lung dang rigs pa'i nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ khrims ldan 'dus pa'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i thang / /skal bzang rkang drug tshogs kyis longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis glu dbyangs dar dir sgrog gyur cig /ces pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gsang phu nyi thang bla ma shes rab dpal 'byor gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/mang thos blo gros rab yangs mkhas pa'i dpyid/ /dri med tshul khrims legs gtsang btsun pa'i mchog /'gro la byams pa'i thugs mnga' bzang po'i dpal/ /skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams bye ba'i shing rtas nyer drangs pa'i/ /dal 'byor (71bskyon gyi yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod pas/ /don gnyis 'dod 'jo'i dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ /ro nus stobs ldan bdud rtsi'i bum bzang gis/ /'chi med tshe yi dga' ston stsol mdzad pa'i/ /rnam 'dren sman gyi bla yi ring lugs pa/ /drang srong grub pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /theg pa gong 'og phyi nang grub mtha' gzugs/ /gsung rab rin chen rtsig ngos la shar ba/ /rnam dpyod ha nu pa ma 'dres par/ /rab 'byed mkhas pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /sku gsung thugs rten khrims ldan 'dus tshogs mchod/ /de'i rten gso zhengs las kyi 'khor lo yis/ /rgyal sras sku mched gsum gyi rnam par thar/ /'dzin mdzad rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /'jig rten mig gcig blo ldan shes rab kyi/ /dam pa'i chos kyi khri la rab bzhugs —260

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ khobadanas/ /zab rgyas legs bshad dbyangs snyan legs sgrog pa/ /mtshungs med dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun gsal sgeg mos nyi zla'i rna ba'i rgyan/ /'dzin pa de srid mgon khyod rdo rje'i khrir/ /gshom gzhig bral ba g.yung drung ltar brtan cing / /grangs med gdul bya'i re ba skong gyur cig /rab dkar dge tshogs dri bzhon gyis drangs pa'i/ /legs byas cha shas gang ba'i zla snang gis/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i kunda legs 'dzum pa/ /'bral med gtsug gi cod paṇa mdzes gyur cig /ces gangs khrod kyi rigs lam smra ba kun gyi 'byung khungs gcig bu pa chos grwa chen po gsang gu ne'u thog gi gling stod chos rje blo bzang rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs brtan bzhugs 'di lta bu nyen dgos zhes nyi thang slob dpon shes rab dpal 'byor gyis yang yang bskul ba bzhin za (72na)hor gyi brnyes ra sa 'phrul snang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /dpal ldan phun tshogs tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho las/ /legs 'khrungs rgyal dbang dbang phyug brgyad ldan pa/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos dngos grub kun gyi gter/ /blo bzang snyan grags grags pa'i ba dan rgyal/ /rgyal ba kun yum kun dga'i dpal ster ma/ /yid 'phrog lha mo lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gnyen/ /'jigs pa las stob las bzhi kun 'grub pa'i/ skyabs gnas mchog gyur mchog gi lha mor 'dud/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo gros bye ba'i gter/ /gter mdzod 'dzad mi shes pa'i legs bshad rgyun/ /rgyun chad med par skal bzang dga' ston du/ /du mar spel ba'i byed por gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya chen dge legs legs tshogs rnams kyis gang / /gang zhig rgyal gsung gsung rab dbyar gyi mtsho/ /mtsho ltar rab 'phel 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i don/ /don ldan skyabs mchog mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /lhang lhang ngag gi sgra las nyer drangs nas/ /legs legs tshig gi 'phreng bar rab spel ba'i/ /gus gus bstod cing gsol ba legs 'debs par/ /yang yang 'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /mi bzad 'khor bar 'khyam byed las nyon dang / /mu mtha' bral ba'i nad rigs gdon dang bgegs/ /me tog mda' can dpung bcas rab bcom ste/ /ma lus —26/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'agro ba'i nyer 'tshor bdag gyur cig /pha mtha' mi mngon pha rol ma phyin pa'i/ 'khor ba tshang tshing tshal du gnas pa rnams/ kha dog kha ba ltar dkar mtho ris dang / /thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar 'khrid shog /'khor ba'i rang bzhin mtho dman bar ma'i gzhir/ /skye ba'i srid pa 'dab chags bgrod pa'i rjes/ /bshes (72ba)gnyen dam pa'i grib ma gnyis pa'i grogs/ /mi 'bral rten 'brel slu ba med par shog /skye bar legs byas goms pa'i dpyid kyi mngal/ /bla med mchog gi sa bon smin pa las/ /sku gsum phang phung lo 'dab g.yo ba'i rtser/ /mtshan dpe'i 'bras bzang dud pa'i dpal gyur cig /ces gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes a yu zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ blo ka drug pa yan zung ldan/ bdun pa dang brgyad pa gnyis rjes khrid/ lhag ma gnyis don rgyan du byas te za hor gyi bzhes ra sa 'phrul snang du sbyar/phun tshogs chos kyi dga' ston rgyas pa'i sgo/ /grangs med 'gro la 'byed mdzad ngag gi dpal/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po'i 'dod 'jo mkhan/ /blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgon der 'dud//gang zhig bsten na srid zhi'i yon tan kun/ /stsol mdzad slu ba med pa gtan gyi skyabs/ /bshes gnyen ngur smig 'dzin pa'i zlos gar can/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag gi 'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi zhing / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang rgyas/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang bu tshe dbang gi don du ma dpon mo rda'i khan jus bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/rgya chen gsung rab rab 'byams gzhud lugs la/ /mang du legs thos thos bsam sgom pas phyug /ngag dbang blo bzang bzang po'i lhag bsam can/ /rgya mtsho ltar zab zab yangs mkhyen brtse'i dpal/ /dpal ldan zas gtsang sras kyi ring lugs mchog /mchog tu 'dzin pa'i spobs pa rab tu dge /dge tshogs chad pa med par yongs spel 'phreng / /'phreng ba mgul par spud la (73na)gsol ba 'debs/ /lhang lhang snyan pa'i ngag gis gsol 'debs shing / /dung dung snying nas mi phyed dad pa'i —262

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdamathus/ /yang yang bsams pas 'di phyi'i mdun ma kun/ /lhod lhod 'bad pa med par grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang ja'i sang kho sho'i chis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/skye ba kun la yang dag legs pa'i lam/ /tshul bzhin ston mdzad stobs bcu mnga' ba'i dpal/ /zas gtsang sras kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa la/ /ngag gi 'dod 'jor dbang la gsol ba 'debs//blo gros rab yangs mkhas btsun bzang po yi/ /grags pa'i dpal ldan rgyal dbang btsong kha pa'i/ /dri med bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhir/ /spel mdzad bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar mchog gsum dam pa'i thugs rje yis/ /tshe 'dir 'dod pa'i legs tshogs kun 'grub cing / /grangs med skye bar dam pa'i mgon gyis bzung / /gtan gyi mdun ma lhun gyis grub par shog /ces pa 'di tha'i ji mgon po tshe dbang gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/'gro la rjes brtse'i thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /phyag na 'jam mnyen pad dkar 'chang ba'i lha/ /rgyal sras ga the ne nu med byung snying rje'i gter/ /lha bcas 'gro ba'i mgon der gsol ba 'debs//nor 'dzin skyong ba 'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs/ /mgon med 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur lha'i rgyal po/ /bod khams rgyal por sprul pa gnya' khri btsan/ /nor 'dzin dbang por bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ /gangs can dam chos dbu brnyes tho tho ri/ /rbha ga la yi mi bdag dad pa brtan/ /u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug dkon mchog 'bangs/ sprul pas rnam par rol la gsol ba 'debs/ /(73ba〉bod 'bangs skye rgu'i lha gcig srong btsan rje/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas mdzad khri srong zhabs/ /gsar bcad skad du 'bebs pa'i khri ral pa/ /chos ldan rgyal por gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /'phags yul chos kyi rgyal po dge ba dpal/ kha che'i rnal 'byor chen po dkon pa ba/ /bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes po 'brom ston rje/ /'phags chen dam par bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngags 'chang chen po rtse chen sa skya pa/ /bka' phyag gnyis 'dres g.yu brag 'gro —ba'i mgon/ zab gter bstan pa rgyas mdzad mnga' bdag nyid/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe yi rig byed —263
