rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'adzin pa dge ba 'bum/ /bal yul paṇa chen padma badzra dang / /thams cad mkhyen dngos dge 'dun grub pa'i zhabs/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor gsol ba 'debs/ /dbyangs can ba 'ad pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /phyag na padma bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ /bde chen chos kyi rgyal po dpal bzang po/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren par gsol ba 'debs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dpal ldan ngag gi dbang / /blo gsal skal bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sde/ /chos kun gang shar rig pa'i rang rtsal du//yongs grol rdo rje 'dzin par gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe rabs kun du dam pa'i mgon gyis bzung zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsir longs spyod de/ /gnas skabs bsams pa'i don kun thams cad grub/ /mthar thug rdo rje 'chang dbang thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang blo bzang sbyin pas de lta bu zhig dgos zhes nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyis bzhes bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las so/ /phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba'i sgyu 'phrul (74na)gar/ /dkon mchog 'bangs dang srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs/ /tshangs pa lha yi me tog khri ral pa/ /sa skyong rgyal por gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rgyal dge ba dpal dang 'brom ston rje/ /rtse chen sa skya pa dang g.yu brag mgon/ /nyang ral dge 'bum padma badzra sogs/ /mkhas grub dam par sprul la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge tshogs la 'dun mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /bsod nams mtshan ldan ba 'ad pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs/ /bde chen chos kyi rgyal po dpal bzang po/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang 'jam dpal dbyangs can lha mo yis/ /rjes bzung blo gros rgyas pa'i skal bzang can/ /gtsug lag rgya mtsho 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jigs med spobs pa dge ba'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i go cha rab bgos te/ /thub bstan lang tsho dar ba'i legs bshad sde/ /mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /dge 'dis gnas skabs 'gal rkyen bar gcod zhi/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod rgyas/ /mthar thug bla med —264

bla ma'i bstod tshegs kyi rim pa/ (bdabyang chub legs thob nas/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces smad grong tshe dbang dar rgyas kyi ngor za hor gyi brnyes se ra theg chen gling du sbyar/nam ā: ta ra pā kho padmā ya/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo pad dkar 'dzin/ /gang des rjes bzung mi tra dzo zhi'i zhabs/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po byams pa dpal/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /gdams pa'i gter mdzod bsod nams dbang phyug dang / /mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid bsod nams seng (74ba)ge'i zhabs/ /mkhas grub dam pa rin chen seng ge la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen bu ston rje/ /rgya chen chos kyi spyan ldan khyung lhas pa/ /rgyal ba kun dngos blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /lung dang rigs pa'i dbang phyug dge legs dpal/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i bka' babs ba so ba/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu legs pa chos 'byor la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ rgya chen gzhud lugs 'chad mkhas bsod nams grags/ /phyag na padma bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /lha btsun mkhas grub chen po bsod nams dpal/ /mdo sngags chos kyi 'byung gnas brag dgon pa/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo 'khon ston rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po ā nas/ /ngag dbang blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho la 'jigs shing / /mar gyur 'gro la brtse ba'i snying rje yis/ /legs drangs snying nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang / /smon 'jug sems skyed 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /kun 'dus yid bzhin nor 'dra'i bla ma mchog /spyi bor bsgoms pa yan lag bdun pa dang / /gsol ba btab pas lam mchog sgrub pa yi/ /'gal rkyen zhi zhing tshogs gnyis 'phel bar shog /snying gar yi dam 'phags mchog thugs rje'i lha/ /yi ge drug —265

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shepa'i sgra (75na tshe yis rgyud bskul bas/ /'gro drug sdug bsngal sdig sgrib kun sbyangs nas/ /'jig rten dbang phyug sku ru ldang bar re/ga /nga de tshogs pa'i steng du phar btags las/ /rang bzhin grub pa med par legs rtogs nas/ /kun rdzob spros pa'i chos kyi snang ba kun/ /bden med sgyu ma lta bur 'char bar shog /tshe 'di'i lus dang longs spyod gnyen bshes la/ /chags shing zhen pa'i 'khri ba kun bcad de/ /'od kyi sbu gu'i lam nas rje btsun gyi/ /thugs gar thogs pa med par 'pho bar shog /srid pa bar do 'khrul med ngo shes nas/ /snod bcud rten dang brten par legs sgyur zhing / /kun kyang brjod bral stong pa'i ngang nyid nas/ chos ldan rten gyi srid pa 'dzin par shog /kun rdzob snang ba thams cad stong pa'i gshis/ /bying rgod gegs dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor gang / /byar med phyin drug lam slob bya rtsol can/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad rnams mthar phyin shog /mdor na tshe rabs kun tu bla ma dang / /yi dam phyag na padmas rjes bzung ste/ /'di phyi bar do'i legs tshogs lhun grub cing / /bstan dang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor bdag gyur cig /snying po don gsum gyi khrid kyi brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa bee ḍūrya 'a chu rgyun zhes pa 'di ni gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i chos tshul la rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa'i mkhas pa chen po/ zha lu ri sbug slob dpon rin chen bsod nams mchog grub la zab chos 'di nyid nyams khrid du byas skabs dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /gang shar 'khor 'das chos kun ka dag par/ /rang grol dbyings su bla med rdo rje'i theg /zhi khro bka' brgyad rig pa'i rtsal chen por/ /lhun grub 'ja' ltar bkra la gsol (75ba)ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang blo gter dus kyi dgra chen por/ /'dab bzang lto 'gror rngam 'dra'i zil gnon lha'i/ /drag rtsal 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng ltar/ /nam yang yol ba med la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gyur med g.yung drung rtags kyis legs mtshan pa'i/ /rdo rje'i khams las grub pa'i khri chen po'i/ /mgon khyod bskal brgyar zhabs zungs legs bkod de/ /chos 'khor rgyun chad med par skor gyur —266

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (ba)cig /ces pa 'di yang dus gsum mkhyen pa padma 'byung gnas kyi rgyal tshab byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i mchog sprul blo bzang padma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sde'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/sa rnyarma koṣa tsa:teḥ 5ṭu tsā ni rā sgo lha go mi tsa bas nta tsa bha dral:/ na rmi du su ra tsa bar:o ldasgyutsā ku la pra bya tsa bee ri kas sprum phya/ sdeb sbyor dpyid kyi thig le dpal ldan dam pa'i chos kyi 'byor pa'i mdzod/ /don gnyis lhun grub mkhas btsun bzang po'i dpyid/ /rigs rnams kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bor gsol ba 'debs/ /ādzñā de ji nā ma yu kirti su lha tsa/ skur khyur lha tri thre yaḥku ru dwan/lo keshwa rya mā yu rna rti rjoṭa rā yu ni rma/ /ṛ shā su khyu hi tyā ho bla rgya su rtse tta karā ya smo mas bya thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags/ /sa gsum 'gro ba rnams kyi skyabs/ /legs pa'i tshogs rnams sbyin par mdzod/ /'jig rten dbang phyug sgyu phral drwa ba'i gar/ /gangs can bod kyi rgyal por legs sprul nas/ /'gro ba kun la phan bde'i dpal stsol ba'i/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa'i mdzad bzang de med byung / /zhes pa 'di gsum shing lug zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyer lnga la skyid shod nyang bran pha bong khar phebs skabs gzims chung gi sgo 'gram mdzes byed du gnang ba'o/ /srid zhi'i chos kyi sna chogs sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /gang shar rig pa'i dbyings su 'ja' tshon ltar/ /rang bzhin ka dag ngang du rab grol ba'i/ /theg mchog grub pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /bla med snying po bka' brgyad 'dus pa'i dpal/ /rig 'dzin bla ma rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /zhi khro rab 'byams lha yis rjes bzung (76ba)ba'i/ /dngos grub bye ba'i mdzod la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus kyi dgra bor 'jam dpal khros pa'i gar/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon tshe yi bdag /mthu stobs drag rtsal rdo rje'i mtshon gdengs pas/ /nag phyogs dpung bcas 'joms la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang lha yis rjes bzung blo gros gter/ /skal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mgon gyur pa/ /'jigs —267—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang ble bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemed smra mkhas go cha btsan po can/ /thub bstan lang tsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhom gzhig bral ba rdo rjes mtshan pa'i khrir/ /'khor lo'i mgon po mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /bdag cag 'di phyi'i legs tshogs mdun ma kun/ /bsams pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub par shog /ces pa 'di ni sngags 'chang kun bzang dbang pos nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/blo chen 'jam dpal dpa' bo btsong kha pa'i/ /rjes su legs zhugs skal bzang gdul bya'i gnyen/ /ma smad bstan pa'i rin chen yu ba can/ /grags snyan rgyal mtshan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /'od gsal lha rigs bee ḍūr zhun ma'i mtshor/ /sprul sku'i zla gzhon gsar pa'i zlos gar gzugs/ /byang phyogs skye rgu'i 'dren byed bdud rtsi'i dpyid/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /snyigs mas cher sbags lnga brgya'i nags klung khrod/ skyes rabs tsan dan 'phreng ba g.yur za ba'i/ /dri bsung phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs pa'i dpal/ /mtshungs bral sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /stobs ldan mgrin sngon ral pa'i cod pan du/ /zhabs sen rab dkar zla tshes nyer 'god pa'i/ /dbang phyug brgyad kyi dpal la mnga' 'byor ba/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /nor 'dzin ma 'di'i rgyan du lhun po dang / /gling bzhir bcas (77na)pa 'chang ba de srid du/ /mgon khyod 'jigs pa med pa seng ga'i khrir/ /g.yo med rdo rje lta bur brtan gyur cig /khal kha thu she ye thu rgyal po'i sras blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes tsinta ma ṇi nang sos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/blo gsal skal bzang 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen du/ /'phags chen dam pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /bsod nams bye ba'i 'dzin mar legs sgyur ba'i/ /mtshungs med mchog gi sprul skur gsol ba 'debs/ /dam pa'i ngang tshul lhun gyis rab grub pa'i/ /dge tshogs rgya mtsho'i sgo 'phar legs phye nas/ /thub bstan 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor bzang po yis/ khyab mdzad rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /rmad byung skyes rabs ljon pa'i 'phreng ba las/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'bras bzang yongs —268

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kye rim pa/ (bdasmin pas/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa'i dbul ba sel mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal sras yongs 'du'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i zlos gar rdo rje'i khams/ /grub pa'i rang gzugs gzhom med chos kyi khrir/ /nyi zla'i snang bas mun sel de srid du/ /mgon khyod g.yung drung lta bur brtan gyur cig /rab dkar dge tshogs bsil zer 'bum phrag gis/ /legs byas yil dkar po'i 'dab ma'i kha/ /rnam par phye ba'i gtan bde'i 'dzum rlabs kyis/ /skal pa bzang po'i dga' (77ba〉ston dar gyur cig /ces rgyal ba 'phags pa lha'i mchog gi sprul sku'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs kyi rim pa 'di ni sprul sku ngag gi dbang pos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang tshe ring ngo /su sti pra dza bhyaḥ thabs shes zung 'jug bla med bdud rtsi'i gter/ /'chi med rdo rje'i khams su grub pa'i gzugs/ /mtshan dpe'i lang tsho dar ba'i rnam 'dren gtso/ /tshe dpag med pas dus kun dge legs stsol/ /smra mkhas ngag gi dbang po'i rjes 'gro ba'i/ /rnam par rab bkra mkhyen pa'i 'od dkar can/ /bstan 'gro'i ku mud nyer 'tshor shis pa'i dpal/ /grub rigs rgya mtsho'i mgon der gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal gsung snying po nges don sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /bgrang yas chos kyi nyi ma'i gzis smin pa'i/ /skal bzang bung ba'i dga' ston rnam grol lam/ /stsol mdzad mchog gi sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /snyan 'gyur 'bum du 'dzag pa'i lung gi dbyangs/ /zab yangs rtogs pa'i rgyud du bkug pa'i sgra/ /'gro mgon phag gru'i bka' brgyud srid rtse'i bar/ /sgrog mkhas bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug rgyal ba ma lus pas/ /mi 'gyur bden pa'i tshig gi bkra shis glu/ /mgrin pa'i 'khor lo grol te rab blangs pas/ /dpal ldan grub pa'i khyu mchog zhabs brtan shog /drang nges don mang chos kyi gnas lugs kun/ /sgrib bral phyag rgya chen por rgyas btab ste/ /gzhug ma'i rang zhal nyi ma ltar gsal ba'i/ /rnam grol mchog gi sde gang zhabs brtan shog /rmad byung snying rje smon lam bser bu yis/ /nyer drangs gzugs sku'i ma la ya skyes dri/ /snyigs —269

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shema'i tsha gdung bsil ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /skal bzang dga' ston dpal du gnas gyur cig /'gro 'dren snying stobs go gyon rgyal sras rnams/ /bsams bzhin 'khor bar skye ba'i srid 'dzin na/ /ma dag lnga brgya'i lus can dpung gnyen khyod/ /zhi bder mnal ba sems dpa'i mdzad pa min/ /(78na)rnam dag bslab gsum rtsa ba rab tu brtan/ /spang rtogs yon tan lo 'dab khur gyis brjid/ /mkhas grub dpag bsam yongs 'du sa brtol dbang / /thub bstan nor 'dzin dpyid du brtan gyur cig /sngon bsags rnam dkar smon lam shing rta yis/ /rje btsun dwags po'i bka' brgyud skyed tshal du/ /nye bar drangs rnams phyag chen chos drug gi /mi 'dzad 'bras bu'i ro la spyod gyur cig /mchog gsum thugs rje'i chu gter chen po las/ /don gnyis yol ba med pa'i rlabs 'phreng can/ /dngos grub yid bzhin nor bu'i mchod sbyin gyis/ /phyogs dus kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces bka' brgyud bstan pa'i srog shing chen po stag lung zhabs drung ma chen ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub la gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs smon lam shis pa brjod pa'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes stag lung grwa tshang gi gnyer pa ngag dbang rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor/ mgrin pa'i rdzing bur dbyangs can 'khor lo'i yan lag gi rtse dga' rnam par rgod pa'i za hor gyi rigs las snyan ngag mkhan tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rje/ ming gzhan rgyal ba'i dbang po btsong kha pa'i ring lugs pa a wā sgru ti pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos pho brang chen po ta lar sbyar ba'o/ /su sti pra dzā saḥ phun tshogs ngag gi 'dod 'jo tshangs dbang sras/ /mgrin par rab 'gying blo gros mchog byin pas/ /skal bzang gdengs can gtsug na thos bsam nor/ /spud mdzad legs bshad rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /rgol ngan gnyis 'thung tshogs la (78ba tsher jigs med pa'i/ /rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i go cha btsan po can/ /thub bstan lang tsho rgyas pa'i rnam dpyod sde/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' med tshang tshing srid pa'i ma la yar/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i dri bsung yongs dngar zhing / /bskal brgyar rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gdan khri la/ /rab —27()

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdabazhugs chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar gsol/ /zhes pa 'di ni nges don sgrub brgyud kyi shing rta chen po dpal 'brug pa'i bstan 'dzin lung rtogs 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud pa'i mkhyen dpyod yongs 'du'i dbang po lha rtse sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub thub bstan dge legs dpal bzang pos ngos kyis bskul ma mdzad par brten/ rang la mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i yon tan med bzhin du sgro btags te za hor gyi bande sdom bu pas bris/phul byung gsang ba gsum gyi 'khor lo'i cha/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i phan bde'i zil mngar rgyun/ /skal bzang sa mos 'byed pa'i dga' ston can/ /thub dbang mtshan mo'i mgon gyis 'gro 'di skyongs/ /rnam par byams dang brtse ba'i gru char gyis/ /ris med skye rgur gsher ba'i mi pham mgon/ /rgya chen gsung rab me zhal lam yangs par/ /blo gros thogs med rgyu ba'i nam mkha'i rta/ /rab mas shes bya'i dbyig gi bang mdzod la/ /legs par spyod pa'i bshes gnyen klu dbang gtso/ /'phagasamachog byams pa'i gzhung gi dka' gnas mdud/ /rnam par grol ba'i 'jigs med dpa' bo'i sde/ /tshul khrims ngad ldan btsun pa'i 'dab stong can/ /bag med 'dam gyi dri las (79na)grol ba yi/ /mchog gi blo gros nam mkha' ltar yangs la/ /gsung rab nyi ma'i 'od chen 'bar ba'i sde/ /sgo gsum bag dang ldan pas rang gi sems/ /mngon par dul pas zhi ba'i dbang phyug ste/ /so thar khrims kyi dpag bsam ljon pa yi/ /rtsa ba rab tu brtan mdzad rnam snang mdzad/ /'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud las pha rol phyin/ /dbyangs su bsgrags pas skal bzang dga' ba bskyed/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mngon par rtogs pa yi/ /ye shes mchog la 'gro kun nges par sbyor/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mtha' klas pas/ /gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /gangs can skye rgu kun gyi mig gcig pu/ /skad gnyis smra ba rin cen bzang po'i zhabs/ /tshul 'di'i bstan pa'i sa mos ba 'ad mdzad pa/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba zla ba bzang / /thub bstan 'chad rtsod rtsom pas nyer skyong ba/ /mkhas pa'i dbang phyug 'bum phrag gsum pa'i zhabs/ /rig lam smra ba'i shing rta chen po —27/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheb/ /rngog lo chen po blo ldan shes rab zhabs/ /gang gsung rgya mtsho las thon legs bshad kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i bum bzang 'bre chen shes rab 'bar/ /bla med byang chub sa la nyer 'khrid pa'i/ /yang dag lam gyi mig bu ye shes mtshan/ /sems kyi glang chen nye bar 'dul mdzad pa/ /bstan 'dzin dbus na zla ltar ches dkar po/ /rab dkar dge ba'i bag chags chung ngu nas/ /nyer sad ring mor dal ba don dang ldan/ /sbas don mngon par rtogs pa'i (79ba)gzhung lugs la/ /sbyangs pa'i rnam dpyod mthu brtas 'ad ye ba/ /gnyal ston bdag 'dzin rtsa ba nyer zhig pa/ /'jam dpal rdo rjes rjes su nges par bzung / /dngos brgyad don gyi mdud pa yongs grol ba'i/ /gzad ring dar ma tshul khrims grags snyan 'bar/ /blo dang brtson pas rgyal ba'i gsung rab la/ /rtag 'grub rdo rje'i mtshan can bo dong pa/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug na mngon mtho ba/ /rtag sde seng ge rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i gnas lugs kun/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dpang lo blo gros brtan/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtshor kun gzigs 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan srid gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan mnyam med re mda' ba/ /gzhen nu blo gros thub bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam dbyangs dus kyi mthar/ /ngur smrig gar bsgyur blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas thub pa'i ring lugs mchog /'dzin la zla bral dar ma rin cen dpal/ /khyod gsung ro brgya bda' ba'i zil dngar gyis/ /thugs kyi za ma tog gtams gnya' rgod pa/ /mkhyen pa'i gzings kyis gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mtha'/ /yongs brgal 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal ldan pa/ /blo gros yangs pa'i gling du legs bshad kyi/ /rin cen phyur bur bltams pa'i mud sras pa/ /dpal ldan chos kyi 'byor pa'i bang mdzod la/ /'bad med lhun grub dbang sgyur gnyal ston rje/ /don kun grub pa'i gsung gi snying po mchog /yod med mtha' bral ston (80na)pa'i dpal dang ldan/ /rig pa'i ral gris rgol ngan dam bca' yi/ /dra ba ma lus gcod pa'i blo gros 'phel/ /dge tshogs rgya mtshor 'dun pa'i gdul bya la/ /legs pa'i lam bzang ston pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /dge —272

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ khobade'adun 'dus pa'i rgyan gyur thos dang bsam/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i yongs 'dzin rje/ /blo gsal skal bzang yongs la dam pa'i chos/ /legs par byin pas lung rtogs yon tan 'phel/ /'jam mgon ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zlos gar can/ /dkon cog chos 'phel smra ba'i zla ba che/ /yang na/ dge legs bshes gnyen nas/ lhag pa'i bsam pa mchog gis 'gro ba kun/ /'dren mdzad skal bzang rgya mtsho sems dpa' che/ bskal bzang sangs rgyas lnga pa byams mgon gyis/ /bzhed don 'khrul med 'dzin pa'i blo gros rgyas/ /nam mkha' ltar yangs mkhyen pas shes bya'i don/ /rgya chen 'chad la mtsho byung lha mo bzhin/ /rje dkon cog chos 'phel man 'dra/ /yang na bo dong brtson 'grus rdo rje nas/bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis yongs bsags pas/ /thub bstan ri dwags dbus na seng ge bzhin/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor los yongs sgyur bas/ /smra pa'i seng ge mtshungs pa med pa'i mgon/ /kun gyi tshad mar 'dzin pa'i skyes bu mchog /bsod nams bye ba'i nyid du gyur pa'i mgon/ /shes byar srid pa'i chos rnams ma lus pa/ /nges par mkhyen pa'i bu ston rin cen grub/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i pha mthar yongs son (80ba)pa'i/ /rin cen rnam rgyal bu ston thugs kyi sras/ zhar phyin dgongs pa 'grel mkhas sangs rgyas dpal/ /g.yag phrug mi pham chos rje bla ma'i zhabs/ /rong ston shes bya'i gnad rnams kun rigs pa/ ta1kya'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal mtshan che/ /zas gtsang sras kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /chos kun thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ /mud sras pa blo gros rin cen seng ge man 'dra/ /sbas don mngon rtogs gzhung gi rgyud mang glu/ /blo gsal sgra 'dzin yul du thos pa'i zong / /ma 'dres 'gro la rtul phod gtong ba'i phyag /yangs par skyong ba'i yongs 'dzin tshogs la 'dud/ /dge tshogs mthu yis dam pa'i dri bzhen gyis/ /mi shes tsha gdung sel las mi 'gong zhing / /phyin drug kun la spyod pa'i lus 'degs kyis/ /stobs bcu'i lam gyis mkha' la spyod par shog /bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsa 'grel gyi khyi ka 'grel mtha' dpyod kyi brgyud 'debs kyi rim pa 'di yang rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi drang ba dang nges pa'i gnad mtha' dag la —273—

rgyal dbang snga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshegazhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po 'jam dpal dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel gyis sa bon zhig dang bcas bris shig ces bka' stsal ba spyi bos nos te sngon du yi ger bkod na'ang brgyud pa hor khongs su lus pa sogs byung 'dug pa slar zhus dag par byas te za hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o/ /na mo gu ṇa nā thañtsa dharma swā ma ye/ dpal ldan stobs bcu mnga' ba ma lus pa'i/ /gsang gsum 'gro ba'i (81na)sdug bsngal sel ba'i ched/ /mchog gi sprul sku'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /bde gshegs sman gyi bla der gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi rnam 'phrul rig pa'i ye shes dpal/ /rgyud bzhi'i gsol 'debs byed po yid las skyes/ /'phags yul mkhas dbang 'tsho byed gzhen nu'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /thub bstan shing rta chen po klu sgrub mgon/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mthar son ma khol dang / /gnas lnga rig pa zla ba mngon dga' la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /gangs can mig gcig bee ro tsa na'i zhabs/ /chos rgyal tshangs pa lha yi me tog dpal/ /zab gter sgo 'byed grwa pa mngon shes la/ gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /gang de'i thugs sras dar ma grags pa dang / /tshe yi rig byed 'dzin pa dkon cog skyabs/ /'ja' lus mngon gyur rje btsun g.yu thog par/ gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /skye bar snying thig mnga' bdag ye shes gzungs/ /dri med lugs 'dzin gzhon nu ye shes dang / /gzhan phan gter gyur g.yu thog 'bum seng la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /tshul 'dir mkhas grub bu ji ratna'i mtshan/ /rig byed mang thos don grub rin cen dang / /don kun grub pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang la/ /gsol ba 'debs so g.yin phan snang ba stsol/ /tshig don gsal byed dkon cog rgyal mtshan dpal/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan snga dpal ldan 'tsho byed dang / /tshangs spyod brtul zhugs 'dzin pa dbang phyug grags/ /nges don mngon gyur rigs 'dzin phun tshogs bzang / /mkhas grub zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje'i zhabs/ /lag len mthar phyin mkhas pa tshe 'bum la/—274

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bkagasol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /gso rig bstan 'dzin byed (81ba)po paṇḍi ta/ /mang thos mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan zla ba'i dbang / /byang sems mthar phyin blo bzang rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /g.yu thog rnam sprul drang srong bstan 'dzin rgyal/ /gso rig bstan pa'i nyi ma gling stod rje/ /sman sgom snying thig 'dzin pa ngag dbang la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /zab don rgya mtsho'i bka' babs blo gros mchog /rnam par yangs pa'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so g.yin phan snang ba stsol/ /yang na/ brang tis rjes bzung zul phu sman mo che/ /sman gyi ston pa dbang phyug dpal bzang po/ /mkhas grub chen po mnyam nyid rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /yang na/ zur mkhar chos rje'i thugs sras kong ston pa/ /mtsho smad mkhan chen shākya dbang phyug dpal/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin bsod nams rgyal po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /rin cen sdings pas rjes bzung bstan 'dzin rgyal/ /gling stod chos rje man sngar ltar 'dra/ skabs gsum pa dang phyi nang drang srong gi /'chi med tshe yi rig pa 'dzin pa kun/ /snang rig rjes sbyangs 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /dngos grub 'dod rgu'i dpal stsol yi dam lha/ /mthun rkyen kun bsgrub chos srungs rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ khyad par chos 'di'i bka' srung zhad blon la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /mi mthun 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i las dbang gis/ /nyam thag nad kyis gtses pa'i skyes bu kun/ lus sems bde bar bskyed pa'i bdud rtsi la/ /mi zad longs su spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /ro nus zhu rjes mkhas pa'i phyag len ltar/ /mthun par bsdebs pas tsha grang 'dus pa yi/ /nad kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i ba dan mchog /srid (82na)pa'i rtse mor bsgreng bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sna tshogs sman gyis rlung mkhris bad gan dang / /'dusapa'i nad kun 'joms pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /rang gzhan 'khor bar ltung ba'i drag po'i nad/ /dug gsum rtsad nas gcod par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro mgon gu ṇa'i snying thig gdams pa'i mdzod/ /—275

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shenyams su bstar bas ma bcos rang gi sems/ /bde chen chos kyi sku ru ngo 'phrod nas/ /tshe 'di nyid la grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lhag bsam kha ba'i rdul brtsegs las 'ongs pa'i/ /rlabs chen smon lam ma dros rlung chen gyis/ /gso rig bstan pa'i nor 'dzin kun khyab nas/ /gzhan phan nor bu'i dga' ston rgyas par shog /bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad la gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud bzhir grags pa'i brgyud 'debs 'di'ang don gnyer can du mas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/phun tshogs srid zhi'i legs tshogs ma lus pa'i/ /'jug ngogs bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu'i dpyid/ /rigs kun khyab bdag dbang po'i bdag nyid can/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di ni e khe tha'i ji'i kha ton du za hor gyi bzhes bris/dpal ldan gar dbang snang mtha' yas pa'i 'od/ /lnga rig sdom brtson ldan pa'i rnam rol gyis/ /rgya bod thub bstan nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa'i/ /mnyam med di pam ka rar gsol ba 'debs/ /yi dam 'phags ma'i dbyar skyes mgrin rnga'i glus/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i rma bya dga' ba'i gar/ /(82ba)gangs can phan bde'i nags su sgyur mdzad pa'i/ /'brom ston chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i me shel dngas ba'i khams/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'od stong 'bar ba'i gzis/ /'dzam gling srid zhi'i mun sel btsong kha pa/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /zab rgyas nyams len brgyud pa'i srad bu la/ /chad med mkhas grub mu thi la yi 'phreng / /skal ldan skye rgu'i mgrin mdzes dga' ldan pa'i/ /bgrang yas bstan 'dzin tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang lhag pa'i lha mos rjes bzung mthus/ khes bya'i sa chen blo gros gom gcig gis/ /gzhal nus bzang po'i bag chags yongs sad pa'i/ /legs bshad rgya mtsho'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la 'jigs med spobs pa yis/ /btsan po'i go cha cher bgos thub pa'i bstan/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i lang tsho rgyas pa'i sde/ /tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba'i dpyid kyi mngal las legs 'khrungs pa'i/ 'di phyi'i legs tshogs myu gu'i —276

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdaphon po mchog /smon lam char gyis bskrun pa'i 'bras bu la/ longs su spyod pa'i dga' ston rgyas par shog /nad gdon dgra bgegs chu 'dzin rgya las grol/ /tshe dang bsod nams stobs 'byor snang ba dkar/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs ri dwags gzugs kyis mdzes/ /'di snang zla ba'i cha shas 'phel gyur cig /ngan song gnas gyi sgo 'phar rab tu bcad/ /lha mi'i rten bzang brgyud pa'i them skas btsugs/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i rin cen (83na khing par 'jug /gtan bde'i 'dun ma lhun gyis grub par shog /'di phyi kun tu rnam par dge ba yi/ /bslu med skyabs gnas dkon cog rnam gsum kyang / /gsang ba rab 'byams 'khor lo bkra shis pa'i/ /dbyangs snyan srid rtse'i bar du sgrog gyur cig /ces o rod g.yon ru'i dpon po gcod pa bā dur gyis nged rang gi bstod pa zhig bskul ba la brten nas phan yon che bar bsams te jo bo yab sras mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa dpal ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bstan 'dzin spyi la gsol 'debs dang nged rang yon tan med bzhin du sgro btags kyi bstod pa smon lam shis brjod dang bcas te tshig gi sbyor ba byed pa la mgrin pa'i 'khor lo rnam par grol ba za hor gyi bande skad gnyis smra ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar/dge legs zla ba'i ma ma 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /phun tshogs 'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas yid bzhin nor/ /'di phyir dge ba'i phan bde'i 'jo sgeg mkhan/ /bslu med gtan gyi skyabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i yid kyi me long ngos/ /mi phyed dad pa'i snang brnyan yongs shar ba'i/ /dge tshogs rten cing 'brel 'byung sgyu ma'i gar/ /gtan bde'i gzigs mor tshar du dngar bar shog /dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum thugs rje'i sprin/ /byin rlabs chad pa med pa'i char gyi rgyun/ /de phyir dge ba'i bde skyid myu gu'i 'bras/ /smin cing longs su spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni dpon mo ma ga dhas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/gar dbang thugs (83ba)gsang dpal be'i ze'u 'brur/ /brtse ldan sbrang rtsi'i phung po dkar ba las/ /bla med ye shes ro bcud ches dngar ba'i/ /mchod sbyin sgo 'phar 'byed la gsol ba —277

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'adebs/ /dge legs snang bas 'khor ba'i dgra tshogs mun/ /bcom ste rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzugs/ /mngon sum lta ba'i dri bral ye shes spyan/ /'gro la dus drug gzigs der gsol ba 'debs/ /phye ba'i rlabs 'phreng yol med rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol byed bshes gnyen dam pa'i gru gzings mchog /rtag tu bsten las sku gsum yid bzhin nor/ /'grub pa'i skal ba bzang por spyod gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni khar kha thu shel e thu rdo rje rgyal po'i rigs las 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar/rgya cher shes byar 'byams klas spobs pa dge /don kun rnam par bsam pa'i lang tsho bod/tshul bzhin bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu yongs smin pa'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi bzad ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal las/ /legs thar mngon mtho lha mi'i rten bzang mchog /thob nas gnas skabs zag bcas bde ba la/ /spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por bdag gyur cig /thub pa'i bstan dang mjal zhing de'i rjes zhugs/ /byang chub sems bskyed rlabs chen spyod pa spyad/ /zab mo'i lam kun nyams su blang ba'i mthus/ /sku gsum go 'phang myur du thob par shog /ces pa 'di ni o rod g.yon ru'i dpon mo dge (84na lo la blo bzang sgrol mas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes bris/dge tshogs 'bras bzang yongs smin stobs bcu yi/ /dpal mnga' shākya'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ /mi dman 'dun pa'i rnal 'byor lhun grub pa/ /thams cad mkhyen par nges la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbyangs can mgul par chags pa'i rgyud mangs glu/ /dge ba'i legs bshad sgra dbyangs 'gyur khugs can/ /blo gsal 'dun ldan rna bar bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /stsol ba'i sngon med rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /rab dkar bsod nams spungs pa'i gangs ldan las/ /sde bzhi'i 'phrin las chad med chu bo'i rgyun/ /rgya chen thub pa'i ring lugs 'khyil ba'i mtshor/ /'bab mdzad ba shā da pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /srid zhi'i yon tan cha shas gang ba'i zla/ /thugs rje'i bsil ba'i zer gyis —278

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bda'agro ba rnams/ /'khor ba'i mun tshogs rgya las grol mdzad pa'i/ /'phrin las mtsho ltar 'phel la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros 3)/ /skal bzang gdul byar rgya che rig pa'i gnas/ ston la smra ba'i spobs pa gzengs mtho ba/ /mtsho byung lha mor sbyin der gsol ba 'debs/ /mos pa'i lhag bsam dag pa'i snyad sa la/ /smon lam sa bon yongs su legs smin pas/ /mgon khyod g.yo med brtan pa'i myu gu'i 'bras/ /smin pa'i skal ba bzang por spyod par shog /ces pa 'di ni rje btsun 'brug pa rin po che sprul pa'i sku blo bzang mi pham dbang po nges don grub pa'i shing rta'i gsung gis bskul ba dang (84ba)du blangs te za hor gyi bzhes bris/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus bslu med rin chen gter/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs dgos 'dod stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bsam don lhun grub shog /gsol 'debs rgyun khyer du bde ba 'di'ang dpon sa a ṇi drung gi zhal 'don du bris/phul byung myang 'das zhi ba chos kyi lam/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i dpyid du mngon gyur nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mched/ /paṇa grub dam par bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ /jo bo yab sras gsang chos gdams pa'i bcud/ /bcu drug thig ler bsdus nas nyams len pa'i/ /bka' babs bshes gnyen chen po phul byung ba/ /gzhen nu rgyal mtshan 'khas la gsol ba 'debs/ /gcig las du mar rol pa'i zlos gar gyis/ /ye shes mchog gi dngos grub ches 'bar ba'i/ sne zur pa zhes mi g.yo dngos grub pa/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /thugs sras 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi snang ba can/ /zab don chos kyi rgya mtshor mnga' sgyur ba/ nyams dang rtogs pa'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs/ /pad dkar 'chang ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho yi/ /thugs rje'i 'od kyis nyer bskyangs rgyal ba'i sras/ /thabs shes zung 'jug rab yangs blo gros can/ /lhag bsam gong du 'phel la gsol ba 'debs/ /lung rtogs chos kyi cha shas yongs 'phel ba'i/ /yang dag bshes gnyen zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho —279

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shechen po rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /(85na)dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag las gzhan gces don ldan byang chub sems/ /yod med mtha' dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid/ /zung 'brel chos kyi gru gzings la brten nas/ /sku gsum rgya mtshor 'jug la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo gros rab yangs thos dang bsam pa can/ /'gro la rjes brtse bzang po'i ngang tshul gyis/ /kun mkhyen shākya'i bstan pa legs 'dzin pa/ /mtshungs med rgyal ba'i sras por gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /tshe rabs kun tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /rjes su bzung nas thos bsam sgom pa'i tshogs/ /mthar phyin rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog /ces rgyal sras shes rab 'phel ba'i skyes rabs 'di nyid dge slong grags pa 'od zer gyi rgyal sras don yod chos kyi rgya mtshos skye brgyud 'di ltar yin zhes gsungs pa grwa rgan 'ga' zhig gi ngag sgros las thos tshul gyi sa bon dang bcas nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes bris/blo gsal skal bzang gdul bya'i tshogs rnams kun/ /dri med thub pa'i bstan la rab bkod nas/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las skyong la rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ /ji bzhin yol ba med der gsol ba 'debs/ /grangs med legs byas dpal gyis brjid pa'i sku/ /rang rang mos pa'i rjes 'jug snyan pa'i gsung / /mkha' ltar zab cing yangs pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /chen po'i las 'dzin dpa' mdzangs rtul phod cing / /bstan la nyer gus byang phyogs sa skyong gi /rigs las bltams kyang snyems pa mi (85ba〉thang 'a ba'i/ /dam pa'i rnam par 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsung rab mang por thos dang bsam pas mkhas/ /ngur smrig gos mdzes bag yod khrims kyis btsun/ /bdag g.yin mnyam brje byang chub sems kyis bzang / /mtshungs med rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /sbyin sogs pha rol phyin pa rnam drug gis/ /bdag gzhan rlabs chen spyod par legs sbyar zhing / /nges gsang theg pa'i rnal 'byor la gzhol ba'i/ /rje btsun grub pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos blo bzang grags pa yi/ /dri med bstan pa —280

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdalegs par skyong mdzad pa'i/ /'dren pa mchog khyod bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i bar/ /rdo rje'i gdan la rtag tu bzhugs su gsol/ /bstod cing gsol btab dge ba'i sa bon rnams/ /rab tu smin pa'i bsod nams 'bras bu yi/ khur gyis dud pa'i dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'bras/ /longs su spyod la legs bris spun zlar shog /ces skyid shod sde pa chos rje blo bzang bstan skyong rgya mtsho la gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes bsam blo dka' bcu shes rab rin cen gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'o/ /ngag dbang blo yi 'dab brgya yongs bzhad pas/ /skal bzang bung bar chos kyi sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /legs byin rnam par rgyal ba'i grags snyan mtshan/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po mkhan chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi mtshan dang po'i ming rnams spel ba blo ka gcig tu (86na)tshang ba zhig dgos zhes dur bod dpon pos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/nub phyogs bde ba can na 'od dpag med/ /gru 'dzin spo na 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang / /sirtu rgya mtshor mtsho skyes rdo rje'i dpal/ /skyon yul du rgyal po thor cog can/ /gsol ba 'debs so sprul sku padma 'byung / /byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med rigs 'dzin rje/ thugs rjes gzigs shig gangs can lha gcig pu/ /'di phyi'i bsam don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sbyor sgrol spyod pas shanta rakṣi ta/ /lha srin bran 'khol rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /zhi khro kun gzigs shākya seng ge'i zhabs/ ta shes bya kun mkhyen blo ldan mchog sred dpal/ /gsol ba 'debs so sprul sku padma 'byung / /byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med rigs 'dzin rje/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig gangs can lha gcig pu/ /'di phyi'i bsam don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'chi med sku brnyes tshe dbang rigs 'dzin rtsal/ /za hor yul du padma sam bhā wa/ /me phung mtsho ru bsgyur ba'i padma rgyal/ /mu stegs 'dul mdzad seng ge sgra sgrog pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so sprul sku padma 'byung / /byin gyis rlobs shig —281 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshe'achi med rigs 'dzin rje/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig gangs can lha gcig pu/ /'di phyi'i bsam don 'grub par byin gyis brlobs/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal/ khri srong bzhed pa yongs skong padma 'byung / /bdud dang dam sri 'dul mdzad gro bo lod/ /zangs mdog dpal rir ga rma drag po rtsal/ /gsol ba 'debs so sprul sku padma 'byung / /byin gyis rlobs shig mchi med rigs 'dzin rje/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig gangs can lha gcig pu/ /'di phyi'i bsam don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon khyod 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gyur kyang / /bod yul bstan pa nyi 'od lta bur gsal/ /ri brag mtsho sogs gnas kun byin gyis rlobs/ /zab gter grangs med rgyas btab bka' drin can/ /gsol ba 'debs so sprul sku padma 'byung / /byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med rigs 'dzin rje/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig gangs can lha gcig pu/ /'di phyi'i bsam don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'phrin (86ba〉pas gzhung bsrangs mchod bstod gsol 'debs pa/ /mi phyed gus pas thugs dam rgyud bskul na/ /dus kyi rgyal po tshes bcu nam shar la/ /'byon par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i rdo rje'i gsung / /bslu med bden pa'i 'bras bu yol med du/ /legs par stsol cig skyon sprul pa'i sku/ /re ba skong zhig bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ /gsol btab 'bras bu stsol zhig padma 'byung / /snying nas gdung shugs drag po'i dad pa dang / /ngag nas lhang lhang dbyangs kyis gsol 'debs na/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri nas padma 'byung / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas 'dir gshegs la/ /gsal gsal sku yi snang ba mig la ston/ /snyan snyan gsung gi chos sgra rna bar sgrogs/ /lhod lhod thugs kyi byin rlabs snying la stims/ /byin chen phob la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol/ /sngon las lha srin 'khrugs pa'i 'phral rkyen gyis/ /mi phyugs nad rims sad ser dbul zhing 'phongs/ /phyogs bzhi'i dmag 'khrug mtshon cha'i bskal pa sogs/ /ma lus zhi zhing bzlog par byin gyis brlobs/ /char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /tshe ring nad med lus ngag yid gsum bde/ /mtha' bzhi'i 'byor pa'i las sgo rnam par phye/ /rdzogs ldan dga' ston rgyas par byin —282

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdagyis rlobs/ /bod 'bangs nam yang yal bar mi 'dor zhes/ /mnga' bdag yab sras 'bangs la zhal 'ches pa'i/ /'gyur med rdo rje'i gsung gi don gyi 'bras/ /mngon sum stsol ba'i dga' ston dus la babs/ /mdor na deng nas lhun grub kun tu (87na)bzang / /ma thob de srid mgon po khyod nyid kyis/ /rjes su bzung nas mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis tshims par mdzod/ /ces slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs sprin phung zhes bya ba 'di ni 'phrul snang tshes bcu pa rnams kyi nyams len la phan pa'i ched du byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan zas gtsang sras/ /smra mkhas ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa mgon po klu sgrub zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis brlobs/ /nges don lta ba'i gsal byed zla ba grags/ /mtha' bral don che rig pa'i khu byug che/ /zab don brnyes pa'i khu byug gnyis pa'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis brlobs/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i gtsug rgyan a ti sha /bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes po 'brom ston rje/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mthar son rin cen gsal/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis brlobs/ /de sras thu bo bshes gnyen rin cen grags/ /bdag pas gzhan gces 'byongs pa'i 'chad ka ba/ /mkhas btsun grub pa'i sar zhugs spyil bu ba/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis brlobs/ /lha btsun mkhas grub lung gi dbang phyug dang / /gnas brtan chen po 'gro ba'i mgon po rje/ /bslab gsum bdud rtsis myos pa'i zangs chen pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis brlobs/ /chos 'dul sde bzhi'i 'thar son mtsho sna ba/ /mngon pa'i sde snod kun rig mon gra pa/ /mkhan chen bstan (87ba)pa'i nyi ma chos skyabs bzang / /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag tsong kha pa/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dar ma rin cen dpal/ /rgya chen gzhung brgya smra ba'i nyan shāka par/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis brlobs/ /rje —283

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebatsun chos kyi spyan ldan don yod dpal/ /log smra tshar gcod chos kyi rgyal mtshan rje/ /mkhas btsun chen po dge 'dun rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis brlobs/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / /'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos dkon cog chos 'phel zhabs/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis brlobs/ /tshe 'di'i phun tshogs rmi lam bde sdug dang / /'khor ba'i bde ba 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal du/ tags nas bden bzhi 'byung ldog nyams len gyis/ /gtan gyi bde ba sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyad pa'i rtsa ba bdag nyid gces 'dzin du/ shigs nas bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub sems/ /legs bskyed sbyin sogs rlabs chen spyod pa la/ /nyin mtshan brtson pas sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /tha snyad chos kun grub pa snang ba'i lam/ /don dam dpyad pas ma rnyed ston pa'i gshis/ /mtha' bral lta dang byang sems rin po che/ /zung 'brel nyams su len par byin gyis rlobs/ /don dam ye shes tshogs chen nam mkha' la/ /kun rdzob bsod nams tshogs kyi sprin 'khrigs las/ /chos gzugs sku brnyes sa bon legs smin pa'i/ /stobs bcu'i myu gu g.yur du za bar shog /ces zab mo lta ba'i rgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni dad ldan a yu zhes bskul ba'i ngor (88na)za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang 'phrin las so/ /ngag dbang 'jam dpal blo gros rnam par yangs/ /phyag na padma'i bzang po'i brtse ba can/gsang bdag mthu stobs rgya mtsho rlabs 'phreng g.yo/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsung mchog yang snying yi ge drug ma'i gdangs/ /mgrin pa'i 'khor lo las 'ongs dge ba yis/ /rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing / /bod 'bangs phan bde'i dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa yang bla ma gang ras dbang phyug gis yig drug dung phyur btsugs skabs dgos tshul byung ba ltar bris pa'o/ /brtse chen lha yis rjes gzung gsung ngag mchog /smin byed dbang gi chu rgyun snying dbus su/ /—284

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdalegs gtams blo gsal skal bzang dga' byed dpal/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di ni rigs kun khyab bdag dbang po'i rigs dang chos kyi dbon 'a zha mkhyen rab rnam rgyal gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/phun tshogs phan dang bde skyid ma lus pa'i/ /'byung gnas sangs rgyas de'i gsung dam pa'i chos/ /'brul med tshul bzhin ston mdzad dge 'dun ste/ /dkon cog rin cen gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi pad dkar lta bu zhes/ /rab bsngags thams cad mkhyen pa zas gtsang sras/ /mi pham 'jam dbyangs mchog zung la sogs pa'i/ /skye 'phags 'khor dang bcas la gso la ba 'debs/ /gnas (88ba〉brtan bcu drug grub thob brgyad cu'i zhabs/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis gzugs can snying po dang / /mya ngan med sogs 'phags yul bstan 'gro'i gnyen/ /paṇa grub chos rgyal rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhan slob rnam gnyis chos rgyal mes dbon sogs/ /gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir bshad sgrub kyi/ /bstan pa rin cen spel bar mdzad pa yi/ /lo paṇa rgyal blon rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan lha gcig mar me mdzad/ /'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po bshes gnyen rngog /sku mched rnam gsum grang shar la sogs pa'i/ /bka' gdams bstan 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu ngur smrig zlos gar can/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa/ /'jam mgon bdun sogs mnyam med dga' ldan pa'i/ /ring lugs spel bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyad par mtha' 'khob mun pa'i smag rum du/ /dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me sbar mdzad pa'i/ /pad dkar 'dzin pa bsod nams rgya mtsho sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dngos grub kun stsol yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs/ 'dod rgu'i longs spyod ster ba'i nor gyi lha/ /skyabs gnas kun la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa dam pa 'bul/ /thogs med bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus bshags/ /bdag g.yin dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /rgyal dang de —285

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshesras chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rdo rje ltar brtan gsol/ /(89na)dge ba ma lus sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /bslu med mchog gsum dam pa'i thugs rje yis/ /'dod pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang nor 'dzin skyong ba bstan 'dzin rdo rje rgyal pos bskul ba ltar tshig sbyor rnams go bde bar 'bol rtsom gyi tshul du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo /su sti si ddhi/ gang la brten na 'di dang gtan 'dun gyi/ /legs tshogs yon tan ma lus lhun grub pa'i/ /bsam 'phel yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po che/ /rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ khyad par 'jam dbyangs gzhen nu dus mtha' 'dir/ /ngur smig 'dzin pa'i zlos gar lhur mdzad nas/ /thub bstan rgyas mdzad blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' 'khob mun pa'i rum du thar pa'i lam/ /dam chos nyi ma'i 'od kyis gsal mdzad pa'i/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'khas la gsol ba 'debs/ /rmad byung mkhyen brtse nus mnga' sangs rgyas dang / /'gog lam bden pa gnyis ldan dam pa'i chos/ /rig dang grol ba'i gter gyur dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gnas dkon cog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /dngos grub 'dod rgu'i mchog sbyin yi dam lha/ /'gal rkyen bar chad kun sel mkha' 'gro tshogs/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi ma lus sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdor na rgyal ba rnams dang de yi sras/ /byang chub sems dpa' (89btan rang slob mar bcas/ /dngos dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten la sogs/ /bsod nams zhing gyur kun la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi phyed dang ba'i dad pas rgyud bskul zhing / /nugs drag brtson pa chen pos lcag grabs te/ /bdag dang 'gro drug bye ba phrag brgya yi/ /grangs med lus su sprul nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag pos yongs su bzung dang ma bzung ba'i/ /'dod yon lnga ldan kun tu bzang po yi/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul nas —286

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdadabul bar bgyi/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga la sogs/ /thog med dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu/ /bsags pa'i sdig lhung nyes pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /gnong 'gyod sdom sems bcas te mthol lo bshags/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i rlabs chen spyod pa dang / /rang don zhi ba sgrub pa nyan rang lam/ /lha mi'i bde ba don du gnyer ba sogs/ /mchog dman dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /log smra tshar gcod ldan skal ldan rjes su 'dzin/ /kun shes byed po sde snod rgyud sde sogs/ /mchog dman bar ma'i blo dang legs 'tsham par/ /dam chos chad pa med par skor du gsol/ /skal ba dman zhing rmu rgod gdul dka' la/ /skyid lug btang snyoms zhi bder bzhugs med par/ /gzugs sku'i bkod pa bskal ba rgya mtsho'i bar/ /mi g.yo rdo rje lta bur brtan par bzhugs/ /lus dang srog la ma bltas chos phyir du/ /dka' spyad nas bzung zan changs gcig sbyin pas/ /mtha' brten dge ba ma lus 'gro kun don/ /bla med byang chub thob pa'i (90na)rgyu ru bsngo/ /dge ba'i 'di yis tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dal ba'i rten thob dam pa'i mgon gyis zin/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul nyams blangs pas/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa 'thob shog /gnas skabs su yang nad gdon bar chad zhi/ tshe ring bsod nams stobs dang mnga' thang rgyas/ /mkho rgu'i 'byor pa thams cad ngang gis 'du/ /bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub par shog /bstan pa dar zhing de 'dzin zhabs pad brtan/ /dge 'dun chos spyod 'phel zhing 'jig rten bde/ /phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis bde legs kyis/ khyab pa'i skal ba bzang por bdag gyur cig /ces mchog gsum dam par gsol 'debs yan lag bdun pa smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni yangs pa'i sa chen po bde bar skyong ba'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin dwa yan rgyal pos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /su ste siddhi/ spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /rnam pa bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /longs spyod rdzogs skur gsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang la brten na 'di phyi'i 'dun ma kun/ /yid bzhin nor ltar lag rtser stsol mdzad —287

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang ble bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shepa'i/ /slu med gtan gyi rnam 'dren thugs rje'i gter/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu dus mthar ngur smig gar/ /legs sgyur blo bzang snyan pa'i grags pa can/ khams gsum chos gyi rgyal po btsong kha pa/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /(90ba)ma 'dris kun la 'dza' ba'i bshes gyur kyang / /byang phyogs hor gyi gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi/ /zhing du 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas par/ /spel mdzad thams cad mkhyen par gsol ba 'debs/ /mdo rgyud chos phung gsung ngag gter mdzod la/ /dbang sgyur blo gros bzang pos thub pa'i bstan/ /rgya chen 'chad rtsod rtsom pas dbyar mtsho ltar/ /'phel mdzad rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /snying nas dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i 'bras/ /dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa kun zhi nas/ /rdo rje'i srog gi ka ba rab tshugs te/ /tshe mtha' yas kyi go 'phang thob gyur cig /ring por 'tsho ba'i dal ba'i rten bzang la/ /stobs 'byor dbang thang snyan grags phun tshogs shing/ /mi dang mi min glags lta'i nyer 'tshe dpung / /bcom ste bde skyid dpal la spyod par shog /rigs drug du 'phyan skye srid 'phrang ring por/ /bstan dang legs mjal dam pa'i mgon gyis zin/ /lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum po nyams blangs pas/ /'khor ba'i chu gter che las sgrol bar shog /bdag pas gzhan gces byang chub sems bskyed de/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul nyams blangs pas/ /mkha' mnyam skye rgu ma lus sgrol ba'i ched/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang 'thob par shog /thog med dus nas bsags dang gsog 'gyur pa'i/ /sgo gsum 'bad pas bsgrub pa'i dge ba rnams/ /rgyud lnga'i 'gro rnams srid zhi'i sdug bsngal las/ /(91na skom grol kun mkhyen ye shes rgyu ru bsngo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu ldan tshogs bcas kyis/ /deng nas byang chub snying po ma thob bar/ /bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces bla ma dang tshe dpag med dbyer med du gsol ba 'debs tshul 'khyer bde ba zhig dgos zhes dur bod dpon po rdo rjes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /—288

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdabartse ldan dkon cog 'bangs dang gnya' khri btsan/ /tho ri snyan shal srong btsan lha'i me tog /khri ral dge ba dpal sogs rgya bod kyi/ /sa skyong rgyal por sprul la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sa chen snying po'i zhabs/ /brtson 'grus grags pa mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal/ /dge 'bum paṇa chen padma badzra 'khas/ /mkhas grub dam par bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ /thub bstan snying po dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtsug /rigs kyi bdag por lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal/ /bsod nams ye shes zung 'jug yon tan gter/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo gsal skal bzang la/ /rgya chen legs byas dbyar mtsho lta bur spel/ /chos kun gang shar ka nas dag pa'i dbyings/ /rang grol ba 'ad pa rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdong lngas bteg pa'i 'od stong 'bar ba'i khrir/ /mgon khyod bskal brgyar 'tsho zhing rab zhes nas/ /'gro la zab dang rgya che dam pa'i chos/ /'khor lo rgyun chad med par skor du gsol/ /pad rtsa'i rjes 'gro dge tshogs gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /lhag bsam skal ldan shing rtas drangs pa'i mthus/ /bod yul nyes brgya'i dri ma drung (91ba)phyung ste/ /phan bde'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser sgreng bar shog /srid zhi'i chos kun sems nyid rig pa'i rtsal/ /de yang gdod nas dag pa'i lha lam ngos/ /bslu med rten 'brel nyin mor byed pa yi/ /don gnyis snang ba'i dga' ston lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di yang mnga' bdag gsung sprul chos kyi dbang phyug gi lung zin nyang ston mkhas grub dam pa'i rigs chos kyi rgyun 'dzin rig pa 'dzin pa blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rjes thugs rje chen po'i sku li ma las grub pa'i rten dang bcas bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od kyis 'gro blo'i mun/ /sel mdzad 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo ngur smrig gar/ /legs sgyur skal bzang re skong grags pa'i dpal/ tags bya thams cad mkhyen par gsol ba 'debs/ /gangs can blo gsal bstan 'dzin thams cad kyi/ /gtsug na mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam rol gyi/ /grags pa phyogs bral lus phra'i rna lung can/ /kun mkhyen btsong kha pa la gsol ba —289

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'adebs/ /zab cing ches brling blo gros gru gzings kyis/ /bskal bzang sgron me bzhi ba'i lung rtogs mtsho'i/ /mthar son 'brul med zab don nor bu'i dpya/ /snyan grags don dang ldan par gsol ba 'debs/ /ring nas goms pa'i dge tshogs sum rtsen nas/ /rnam dpyod legs ldan dbang po'i nyag phran gyis/ /rgol ngan lha min bcom pa'i dpal 'bar ba/ /skal bzang skye rgu'i 'dren par gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor los thub bstan la/ /dbang sgyur rnam dkar dge ba'i legs byas (92na)kyi/ /phung po zad pa med pa'i dpal mnga' ba/ /blo bzang rgyal bstan nyi mar gsol ba 'debs/ /dge mtshan snang bas thub bstan legs pa'i lam/ /gsal mdzad dpal ldan di paṃ ka ra dang / /rgyal dbang blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs mchog /'dzin pa'i mkhas grub chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro la rjes brtse phyag na padma'i gar/ /skye rgu'i bsod nams zhing du rnam rol bas/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gos can la khyab pa'i/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /ring mo nyid nas bsod nams ye shes kyi/ /sa bon smin pa'i sku gnyis dpag bsam ljon/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dbus na g.yur za ba/ /rje btsun ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /gnam bskos bsod nams stobs kyi dbang phyug sogs/ shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha' gtugs 'gro kun gyi/ /gtsug na 'khas sen ngal gso thams cad mkhyen/ /rje btsun bla ma'i 'khas la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo bzang snyan pa'i grags 'bar btsong kha pa'i/ /med byung dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid che/ /'dzin mdzad mkhas grub dbus na rgyal mtshan gyi/ /nor bu'i tog ltar mtho la gsol ba 'debs/ /shes bya'i mkha' la blo gros nyin mor byed/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i snang bas chos kyi gzugs/ /rab gsal me tog mda' can las rgyal ba'i/ /mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo chen tshangs dbang drag po khyab 'jug sogs/ /las bzang lhar bcas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ched/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar/ /(92bskyong mdzad yongs 'dzin mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /dri med blo gros yangs pa'i bum bzang du/ /dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis legs —2()//

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (banagatams pa/ /rgyal mtshan tog gi yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /'dod dgu'i char chen 'bebs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag la dbyangs can lha yis byin brlabs pas/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug grub pa'i blo gros kyis/ /skal bzang rgya mtsho'i re ba yongs skong ba'i/ /mtshungs med dam pa'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ gsung ngag chad med smin byed dbang gi rgyun/ /grol la blo bzang grags pa'i thugs kyi bcud/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i chos 'khor gdul bya la/ /skor mdzad bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang lha mos blo gros 'dab brgya'i dbus/ /'jo sgeg dgyes pa'i zhal bzang legs bstan pas/ /rgya chen gtsug lag mtsho ltar gting zab pa/ /dpog pa'i rnam dpyod mnga' la gsol ba 'debs/ /lus ngag yid gsum 'bad pa don ldan gyis/ dbang phyug brgyad mnga' blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan/ /'khor lo gsum gyis rgya mtsho'i gos can khyon/ /legs bkang dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan thub pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba la/ /bde chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs srin mo'i gzugs/ /'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug re ma tī/ /dpag dka' rdzu 'phrul mnga' la gsol ba 'debs/ /mthu stobs rdo rje'i me char drag po yi/ /tsha tsha rnam par 'phro ba'i dmag dang zor/ /rnon pos yid srubs 'joms pa lhag pa'i lha/ /ma mo kun gyi gtso mor gsol ba 'debs/ /khro chags brjid 'jam rnam 'gyur sna tshogs kyi/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las (93na/skrun grub pa'i/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig ma/ /lha mo re ma tī la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal dang de sras nyan rang slob mar bcas/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams/ /bla ma bstan srung dbang mo'i ngo bo dang / /dbyer med ro gcig gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog gsum thugs rje rten 'brel bslu med dang / /mi phyed gdung shugs drag pos gsol btab mthus/ /gtan gyi skyabs mgon dkon cog ma lus pa'i/ /byin rlabs snying gi pa blor 'jug par shog /lus la zag pa med pa'i bde chen rgyas/ /ngag la grags stong tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan ldir/ /yid la bla med ye shes 'char ba yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i ngan song rten khrod —2()/ —

rgyal dbang ྅ pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshen/ /lan cig rnyed pa'i dal 'byor tshang ba'i dus/ /chu sbur bzhin du myur du 'jig pa yi/ /mi rtag long med skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dge tshogs khong khros bcom zhing sdig pa'i dpung / /dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel las 'bras phra zhing zab/ /ngan song sdug bsngal bzod dka' me 'obs dong / /bsams te zhen log skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /skyabs yul spyan sngar 'gyod sdom bsam pa yis/ /gnyen po kun tu spyod pas sdig bshags shing / /sgo gsum dge ba bcu la rab bkol ba/ /nyin mtshan brtson pas bsgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshangs dbang khyab 'jug 'khor los sgyur ba sogs/ /lha mi'i gtso bo rnams kyang dmyal bar ltung / /'khor ba'i bde ba 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal du/ /bsams te nges 'byung skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam dag tshul khrims gru gzings legs bcas par/ /g.yo med ting 'dzin (93ba)brtan po'i ded dpon gyis/ /chos rnams 'byed pa'i shes rab dar 'phyar nas/ /srid mtsho bsgral te thar pa'i gling bgrod shog /bdag 'dzin dbang gis dgra gnyen so so mā /bzung yang tshe rabs mang por phan btags ma/ /'gro kun duḥ khas mnar la snying rje yis/ /drangs pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag skye bar 3rteg /rang bde gzhan la gtong zhing gzhan dag gi /sdug bsngal snying nas dang du len nus pa'i/ /bdag gzhan mnyam par brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /bcos min rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson bsam gtan dang / khes rab pha rol phyin pa rnam pa drug /bskal brgyar nyams su len la mi zhum pa'i/ /snying stobs go cha btsan po bgo bar shog /rang blo dman pa'i lcags khams theg chen blo'i/ /gtso sbyangs gser du bsgyur ba'i nyams len rtsi/ /don ldan 'bad pa'i snying po tshul bzhin du/ /bsgrub la mi mthun bgegs dang bral bar shog /rnam dag bsam pas brtsams pa'i dam chos kun/ /log pa'i lam du nam yang mi 'gro bar/ /'bad pa don dang ldan pa'i 'bras bzang gi /rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i skal bzang rtsol/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba yis/ /'gro ba kun dang bye brag 'dir snang gi /mdza' bshes 'jig rten pha rol song ba rnams/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las thar bar shog /'jig —292

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdarten kun tu nad mug 'thab rtsod sogs/ /zhi zhing tshe ring longs spyod dpal 'byor 'phel/ /khyad par rgyal ba gnyis pa btsong kha pa'i/ /bstan pa srid mtha'i bar du rgyas gyur cig /ces rgyun khyer nyams len du byed rgyur bla ma sngon ma gsum la glo ka gsum/ /phyi ma gnyis la sho lo ka (94na)bzhi/ 'dod khams bdag mor 〈sna ka gsum rnams la 〈( ka re re bzhin nas mtshan sgra thebs pa/ de rnams la gsol ba btab pas skyabs gnas kun la gsol ba btab pa dang mtshungs par byin rlabs 'jug pa'i blo ka gsum blo sbyong dang smon lam gnyis go chod pa'i blo ka bcu/ dge ba bsngo ba'i blo ka gnyis dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes shangs bkra shis rtse pa bkra shis rab brtan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bzhi la dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang mkhyen rab tshad med pa mnga' ba yin pas brjod pa don ldan du snang yang rang nyid la lung rtogs kyi yon tan gang yang med par gzhi med kyi sgro 'dogs de bzhin shes ldan rnams khrel ba'i gnas su 'dug rung bla chen spyi pa'i phyag mdzod nas bton pa'i ham pa stong shob kyi sgo nas za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang rigs kun bdag po'i dpal/ /rdo rje btsun mo rje btsun bdag med ma/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa brnyes birlu par/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol/ sa drug rtogs pa mngon gyur nag po pa/ /sa lam brtul zhugs mthar phyin ḍā ma mā /sa skyong rgyal rigs a wa sgru ti par/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol/ /'jig rten gsum mgon ga ya dha ra'i zhabs/ /'jig rten mig gcig lo chen 'brog mi rje/ /'jigs bral rtog pa mthar phyin mkhar chung par/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol/ /thugs rgyud gsung ngag gis gtams 'ad ston rje/ /thugs rje chen po bla chen sa skya pa/ thugs sras 'ja' lus brnyes pa'i bsod nams rtser/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol/ /mkhas grub dbang po grags (94ba)pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ /mkhas pa'i mthar son paṇa chen chos kyi rje/ /mkhas btsun kun gyi gtsug rgyan 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol/ /mkhyen yangs snyan brgyud —293—

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'adzin pa'i dkon cog dpal/ /mkhyen ldan bla ma'i dbon sras brag phug pa/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol/ /zab don bka' babs dpal ldan tshul khrims 'khas/ /zab gsal ting 'dzin mthar phyin bzhi shrī/ /zab lam bstan pa'i srog shing kun dga' bzang / /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol/ /'khor lo sdom pa dkon cog rgyal mtshan dpal/ /'khor lo'i mgon po blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /'khor 'das dbyer med gzigs pa'i rdo ring par/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol/ /gsung ngag slob bshad mnga' bdag mtshar pa rje/ /gsung ba tshul bzhin 'dzin mkhas mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mthar son bslab gsum par/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan dpal/ /rigs kun mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan rje/ /rigs ldan ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol/ /ma dag 'khor bar 'khyam pa'i 'khrul snang kun/ /ting 'dzin nyams kyi snang bar rab khyer nas/ /gsang gsum dag pa'i rang zhal legs mthong nas/ /bzhi lam 'bras bu'i snang gsum rtogs par shog /sna tshogs bdag med 'khor ba'i 'char sgo'i gdangs/ /myang 'das stong pa'i dbyings su dngas pa'i gshis/ /med bzhin snang ba'i rol rtsed bsam brjod bral/ /zung 'jug blo 'das gnas lugs rtogs par shog /lus kyi (95na〉rdo rje'i rtsa la bum pa'i dbang / /legs thob snang stong lha yi 'khor lo mchog /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes che/ /bskyed rim zab mo'i lam bzang 'byongs par shog /ngag gi dag pa yi ger gsang ba'i dbang / /legs thob gsal stong bdag byin rlabs pa'i mthus/ /rang rig lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes che/ /rtsa rlung zab mo'i lam bzang 'byongs par shog /khams kyi dwangs ma'i bdud rtsir gsum pa'i dbang / /legs thob bde stong dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yis/ /zhu ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes che/ /pho nya'i zab mo'i lam bzang 'byong bar shog /rlung gi snying po ye shes dkyil 'khor la/ /tshig dbang legs thob rba rlabs —294

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdarnam gsum gyis/ /rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa'i zung 'jug sku/ /phyag chen zab mo'i lam bzang mthar phyin shog /dbang bzhis smin pa'i grol byed lam goms par/ /khams 'dus gsum gyi 'phrang gegs chen po la/ /snyan brgyud las 'ongs spyad pa rnam gsum gyi/ /gdams pas rkyen ngan lam du lhongs par shog /dbang rtul brtson 'grus zhan pas tshe 'di la/ /'ja' lus rdo rje 'chang dbang ma thob na/ /dran pa rnam gsum gdams pas bar do'i 'phrang / /yongs sgrol rang byung ye shes rtogs par shog /srid pa bar do'i lam gyi tshod 'dzin du/ /'dir snang a 'thas zhen pa yongs bkag nas/ /nyin dang mtshan gyi snang ba gcig tu bsres/ /thabs mkhas sgyu ma rmi lam 'byongs par shog /gal te bar do nyams 'og ma chud na/ /smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar 'da' ka ma'i/ /'pho ba'i rnal 'byor zab mo nyams blangs te/ (95ba)/dag pa'i zhing du thogs med bgrod par shog /'phags yul grub dbang dpal ldan chos skyong dang / /lam 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed sa skya pa'i/ /gsung ngag rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyis/ kha sbyor bdun ldan go 'phang mngon gyur shog /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dang / /dgyes mdzad rdo rje zhal brgyad he ru ga: /rang sems dbyer med dag pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gsol btab smon pa'i re ba lhun grub shog /rtsa khams lus kun lha yi ngo bor shar/ /ngag gi brjod pa sngags kyi gdangs su sgrog /rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug bde ba che'i/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal gyis khyab gyur cig /ces rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po bir wa pa'i lam srol kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi smin grol brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs lugs srol 'di ga'i rang skad thun mong ma yin pa'i bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i lam la sbyar ba'i smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni chos sde chen po ri bo bde chen gyi kye rdor sgrub mchod pa'i chog dpon dge slong rin cen dpal bzang gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /ngag la smra ba'i spobs pa dge ba'i dbang / /blo chen tshangs pa'i yul sa las brgal bas/ /'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i skal bzang bshes gnyen mchog /rgya chen rnam dpyod mtsho ltar 'phel la 'dud/ /deng —295

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (shenas yang srid zo chun lkod mo ltar//lor ba'i pha mtha' rdzogs min de srid du//mgon po khyod kyi legs pa'i lam bzang po//ston pa'i skal ba can du bdag tsor shog/ces pa 'di ni sku skye blo bzang wen las kyi bskul ba'i ngor za sto gyi brnyes sbyar/(96na)ā0lngaXkar2bā bha nu mus9shā rī ra ku ka bha dra ni mi kā ya/shrī e ma kaṣṭha ti sur ka rta)rteX4 /1/// ( / ///rte 4 sde tsā senas ka lā bha ba e hi5she/ praṅge na kha a nu bha ba ba lus ṅgā re kā dwa yabasgo lwagra:li/ /rgyal kun blo gros dhīḥyig zhu ba'i 'od//mi yi lus su sul ba'i mas bzang sku//ngo mtshar dpal gyi mgur nas sgos dbyangs sgra//grags pas sde bzhi'i dngos kun 'di na shis//mkhyen rab ral gri mthu stobs 'chang bzung can//brtse ldan 'dab brgya ba mo rtser g.yur za ba//am yug a potshi::sprul:pra kar brta pa la tsho khya////rā sa kṣa ra su3ca te0pu9yi zhe khri sngal raX.a nus lhasgokwa la rādza:kho sur lho/re swā mun sto ga bā a mu ke dra//lhag bsam dpung pas nyer bteg rigs gsum gar//gangs can ra bar sgyur mdzad btsong kha pa//nyams khrur tshig gis khyod yon brjod pa'i lce//bskal bar legs byas bye bas bsgrubs zong gis//dus mkhyen rgyal po'i bsod nams zil dngar la//lhan cig (96bsnyad pa'i skal pa 'di na bzang //rgyal bas gang gzigs ji lta ji snyed kyi/gnas lugs mngon sum mkhyen pa'i spyan gyi dkyus//pha mthar 'jal la tshangs pa rgan po 'di//ngal bas bskal brgyar zag bcas gnyid la yur/kha ba ri pa'i sha waṃ ka tshal du//brlang por spyod pa'i sdom brtson gnyis sting snar//bag yod lcags kyus nyer dul tshul khrims kyis//'gram chang dngar pos tsol ba'i dri bsung 'phro//chags sdang sgang rsāng srid pa'i go la mā/mtho dma' lus can nyi zla'i 'gros min par//bdag gas mnyam brje'i dbu mar rtag rgyu ba'i//sems dpa' che de srid gsum rnam par rgyal//nyes pas nam yang ma gos yon to gyi//dngos kun tshangs pa sangs rgyas rang bzhin te//dman tsho yul las 'gong yag rgya mtsho che//tshi gus 'jal stso /༷sa pa deng 'dir mtho//'phags yul mkhas

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shematshor/ /bsod nams rtsa ba sbom por skyed bsrings pa'i/ /bde skyid 'bras khur lci ba'i dpag bsam ljon/ /ro brgya'i bcud myang rtse dga' dgod gyur cig /spyi dang khyad par bstan pa'i tsanda dri/ /ngad 'thul 'gro ba'i snying zhugs gdung ba kun/ /rab gzhil gtan bde'i ngal gso ma la ya'i/ /byang chub snying po'i tshal du byed gyur cig /sdig lta'i dri bral gangs can gaṅgā'i yab/ /rnam smin gcig tu dkar ba nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /'dzad med 'bab byed dge tshogs kha ba'i gos/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen par gyon gyur cig /mang bkur gnam bskos khrims kyi sa zla'i shing / /mchog dman gnya' bar lci ba drang po'i thig /dzā ti'i me tog 'char nas za 'og thags/ /'thag pa'i nor 'dzin khyod la 'degs gyur cig /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'khor ba'i mtshor lhung ma rgan sems can la/ /rang gi bde dngos gzhan la (97ba)gtong ba'i snying stobs cha shas nya/ /yongs gang sngon med zla ba rlabs chen spyod mchog mkhar bgrod pa'i/ /rgyal sras dam pa'i bshul rjes snyeg 'dod smon pa 'grub gyur cig /sgrib gnyis rgya grol ye shes mchog gi 'od stong 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis/ /srid zhir rjes chags ma rig mun bcom smin grol snang mdzad nges gsang lam/ /'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me gcig pu 'gro rnams rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /thob min de srid 'phel 'grib spangs pa'i nyin mor byed lus 'dzin gyur cig /de ltar mkhas dbang daṇḍi'i dgongs don rgya gar kha spu can gyi lugs ka smi ra pa'i kun 'khor kho bo'i slob dpon chen po smon 'gro paṇḍi ta rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa yab sras kyi gsung las thos pa ltar gcig gnyis shig bkod pa la rig gnas rang byon du shes rlom can 'ga' zhig gis ma rtogs pas mtshar du mi 'dzin pa tsū ta'i yul gyi rkang gnyis pa ltar la da lam bkod pa'i kun 'khor 'di 'dra sngon chad 'god pa mang du byung zhing / tshul de snyan ngag gi gtsug lag shes pa rnams ha cang mgu ba'i gnas min kyang sngon dus 'di rigs rtsom shes pa'i nga rgyal bar mchog 'dzin can rnams kyi 'brul blo sel ba dang / rtog ge dang mdo rgyud rig byed la sbyangs pa'i khur ldan blo gros gzhen nu'i ngang tshul can rnams ngo mtshar ba'i ched du za hor gyi brnyes dge byed ces pa chu —238

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdapho stag gi hor gyi zla ba bdun pa'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la bod dang bstun pa'i kun bzang 'khor lo'i sgo nas chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa la bstod pa shri ye dza yas/su blugs dha ṇi ruX.a laṅka re khris sba bhā bā dmagu65mad/ phra be du pā yo bha ya biṣṭha zhi sha rwa rlobadzra sa twa prabhabā shig /skal bzang snang ba dam pa'i mdzes rgyan du/ /phun tshogs srid zhi'i yon tan kun gyi dpyid/ /thabs shes zung 'jug dbang gi rgyal po'i mdzod/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dngos kun shis/ /tyā pā ra mu dru bi sha utta ma dzña rnan garsha me tsi:tsa he ruka pra sgru/ /dma ju no pa tu na ṭakli ta su brti sme trasaḥmo bha su ni chu〈pha le/ /sgrib gsum rgya bral ye shes mchog gi grong / /rang sems dag pa'i khyab bdag he ru ka /snying dbus 'og min zhing du bzhengs pa'i gar/ /bsgyur de smin grol theg pa'i rtser son 'bras/ /(99na ji gu pa kṣi āḥ/ yu smursha no shu zhi āṅgā dha tu mādhe ya tāḥ ispro〉pa suḥpā:tā badzra kā yu bha rbasujukalbe bi dze kā yu re/ /nges gsang brgya byin gtsug tor reg tsam gyis/ /ma dag sbyang gzhi'i phung khams skye mched rnams/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i 'chi med skur gyur tshe/ /bskal par bsgrub bya'i sa bon tshe gcig smin/ /sngon gom gzung 'dzin dwangs shel rtsig pa'i ngos/ /'khrul snang dgra 'drer shar ba lang ga'i mgo /gcod dang lhan cig brtan g.yo'i sī ta ma/ /'gugs pa'i dbang drag las 'di sgyu thabs che/ /mi 'dzad bdud rtsis nyes brgya'i zug ngu rnams/ /rab bcil bsod nams rang blo'i drod chen pos/ /tshe dpal stobs 'byor gser sgong nyer sbrum pas/ /zhi rgyas phan bde'i rtse dga' khong nas dgod/ /'di dang yang srid kun tu nyer bde zhing / /grags chen sangs rgyas tshegs (99ba)chung gis thob pa'i/ /gsang chen nā da'i dbyar rnga sgra bo ches/ /dbang rnon mdongs mtha' rab dga'i mngal khur 'dzin/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed rgyal ba kun/ /dkyil 'khor gcig gi gtso bor yongs shar yang / nyid las gzhan min bye ba phrag brgya'i 'khor/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i mgon de rtag tu rgyal/ kha sbyor bdun dang ldan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i zhing khams su/ /—2()()

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdagis mched zla'i 'jig rten mig /mig stong can gyis rnyed min chos skyong bzang / nges par gnas lnga rig pa'i zhal gyi lung / /chad med 'dzin mkhas smon 'gro lo tsā ba'i/ /drin las dbyangs can snying gi thig le sa /rjes chags dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu 'di len/ /don ldan snyan dngags spungs pa'i gangs ri las/ /legs byas rab 'phel yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i rnam dkar nyal 'gro dang / /lhan cig byang chub snying po'i mtshor 'bab shog /ma rig gnyid slong dge ba'i skya rengs mas/ /nyer drangs bsod nams nyi ma'i gzi byin gyis/ /'jig rten kun tu sdig lta'i 'bras bu'i mun/ /mthar byed bde skyid snang ba 'bar gyur cig /brgya phrag bya dka'i phyin drug spyod pa yis/ /bskal par tshegs kyi sangs rgyas bsgrub min par/ /tshe gcig kun mkhyen 'thob byed nye ba'i lam/ /nges gsang bstan rgyas skye bar der 'jug shog /blo gsal gdul byar bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i gsung / /'khrul med grags snyan ji bzhin ston mdzad btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs rdo rje rnon (100ba)po'i mtshon gyis yid srubs sde/ /bcom nas bstan pa'i rgyal rnga srid pa'i rtser sgrog shog /tshe rings gnam gyi she mong dpung pas dus kyi bdag po sa dbang skur cod pan nyer bcings rtsod dus 'khor los bsgyur ba'i lha/ /dga' ba'i dpal ldan mchod yon nyi zla zung gi chos srid khrims/ /gling bzhi'i dpal la 'dod rgur spyod pa'i dbang phyug che gyur cig /padma'i rtsa ba ltar dkar rab dkar lhag bsam byed po yis/ /zab gsang rdo rje'i theg pa las brtsams yon tan brjod pa'i gtam snyan pos/ /lus can kun kyang dkon cog gsum la ched du brjod pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /ches dkar phung po dus mkhyen rgyal po'i skal ba mchog dang mtshungs par shog /de ltar rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇa chen kha spu can rnams kyi lugs srol bod 'dir 'jam kha sogs mkhas pa rnams kyis legs par bkral ba'i ka smi ra pa'i kun 'khor slob dpon mkhas pa'i dbang po smon 'gro paṇḍi ta yab sras kyi gsung bgros ltar sngon chad bkod pa rnams phyogs re'i mig can gyi mkhas rloms rnams kyis byis pas lha khang mthong ba ltar gyur pa nas bod rnams dga' ba'i kun 'khor dang —3()/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang ble bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebastun te gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud don smin grol 'phrin las kyi rim pa las brtsams te za hor gyi brnyes dge byed kyi lo tha skar gyi nya ba'i phyogs snga ma'i rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la sbyar ba la:sirnying sdu/ngag la smra dbang blo gros mtshon rnon po/ /skal bzang sor mos rab gabs rmongs pa'i (101na)rgya/ /grol bas mtsho byung ngang mo'i mgrin pa'i glu/ /mdo rgyud dbyangs su len la gsol ba 'debs/ /rlabs chen spyod la 'jigs med lhag bsam zla/ /byams dang snying rje'i cha yis nyer gang ba'i/ /'phrin las 'od stong zer gyis mtha' klas 'gro'i/ /phan bde'i kunda bzhad la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal kun mthu stobs phyag na 'bar ba'i mtshon/ /sa 'khrigs rdo rje'i bzhu blug go cha can/ /yid grubs g.yul las rgyal te thub pa'i bstan/ /lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor ba'i tsher rnon ngar gzhom 'jam pa'i dpya/ /myang 'das dbyangs snyan gtan bde'i mgrin pa na/ /g.yas ngos dga' ba legs 'khyil mdza' ba'i bshes/ /ris med skye rgu'i gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi phyed dad pa'i 'chi med skyed tshal du/ /phun chogs dge ba'i sa bon smin pa las/ /skye bar rdo rje slob dpon yongs 'du'i ljon/ /legs bsten zung 'jug 'bras bur spyod gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros kyi chos kyi gdan khri la mngon par 'dzegs pa'i mkhan chen gting skyes pa kun dga' bsod nams legs pa'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /spyi gtsug 'dab stong ze'u 'brur nyi zla'i steng / /dus gsum sangs rgyas padma 'byung gnas dang / /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dbyer med du/ /nges rnyed mi phyed dad pas (101ba)gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan bla ma rnam pa thod 'phreng rtsal/ /gsang gos rnam sbyar za ber pad zhu can/ /rdo rje thod pa kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum 'chang / /srid gsum zil gnon sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog dman bar pa'i gdul bya ma lus pa'i/ khams dang dbang por 'tsham pa dam pa'i chos/ /sna tshogs theg pa kun ston tshangs pa'i —3()2

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kye rim pa/ khobadagasung / /yan lag drug cu'i rjes 'gror gsol ba 'debs/ /kun rdzob snang ba'i mkha' la zhi khro yi/ /rten dang brten pa lhun grub rab bkra yang / /ka dag chos dbyings rig pa'i rang rtsal du/ /legs shar dri med thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag la smra mkhas dbang por grub pa'i blo'i/ /mtshon rnon lhag bsam dpung pas rab bteg nas/ /skal bzang the tshom dra ba yongs gcod pa'i/ /chos kun 'khrul med ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya mtsho ltar zab smin grol gsang sngags lam/ /'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ro yis/ /yid srubs dpung las rgyal ba'i go cha can/ /thub bstan lang tsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /bzang ngan rtog tshogs gang shar chos kyi sku/ /rang grol snang srid zil gnon dus dgra'i dbang / /'gro la rjes chags 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /dge des mgon khyod bskal brgyar zhabs brtan zhing / /bstan 'gro'i phan bde yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /bdag sogs 'di phyi'i gtan 'dun ma lus pa/ /lhun grub bsam pa'i re ba skor gyur cig /ces (102na)dpal skyon gyi slob dpon chen po dang rtsa ba'i bla ma tha mi dad par gsol ba gdab pa'i rim pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes thon nor 'dzin skyong ba legs ldan dbang por bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /gsung ngag dbang gis blo ldan skal bzang rnams/ /stong gzugs phyag rgya chen por yongs smin pa/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag dus 'khor lo'i/ /bdag nyid dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /ro rkyang las rlung zhe ting dngas pa'i mdangs/ /nyi zla sgra gcan brtsegs pa'i mi 'gyur khrir//rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa rdo rje'i sku/ /grub pa'i rang gzugs rtag tu 'char gyur cig /phyi rol 'jig rten khams kyi le'u'i don/ /thos dang bsam pas gtan la nyer phab pas/ /tshe 'dir zung 'jug dus kyi 'khor lo yi/ /go 'phang mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang grwa nang rtsis kyi gtsug lag 'dzin pa lhun grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni —303

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheganas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /nam mkha' ltar yangs shes rab gru gzings kyis/ /mdo rgyud gsung rab rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' las/ /rab brgyal gtan bde'i nor bu legs rnyed pa/ /bshes gnyen ded dpon dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /che ba bzhi ldan bstan par 'jug pa'i sgo/ /'khrul med thos bsam rgya chen lde mig gis/ /phyi nas dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid la/ /dbang bskur (102bsgo khas btsun bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /rab yangs shes bya'i gnas la 'byams klas pa/ /rnam dpyod dbyig gnyen zhabs kyi rjes 'gro ba'i/ /mang thos nyin byed khyod drung mkhas pa gzhan/ /me khyer lta bur mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang bde lhur len dman lam ngal gso'i stegs/ /rab spangs mtha' 'khob yangs pa'i rgyal khams su/ /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid me ro nyer gso ba'i/ /rlabs chen spyod pa mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhung lugs mang po thos shing bsams pas mkhas/ /rang rgyud bag yod khrims kyis dul bas btsun/ /ris med 'gro la mnyam par brtse bas bzang / /dam pa'i rnam thar 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /sbyin tshul bzod brtson bsam gtan shes rab kyis/ /rang rgyud legs smin 'bras bu'i khur dud nas/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis gdul bya'i tshogs/ /rnam par grol bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi'i rdul brtsegs mes po'i ral klung las/ /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i zab lam gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /zung la jug rgya mtsho 'bab byed sgyu thabs mkhan/ /bshes gnyen skal ldan shing rtar gsol ba 'debs/ /nam mkha'i mtha' ltar tshad du gzung dka' zhing / /rgya mtsho ltar zab mar gyur sems can don/ /mgon po khyod kyi ngo mtshar skyes rabs 'phreng / /bdag sogs gdul bya'i don du gyur ston shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs/ /dkon cog rnam gsum thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ /legs (103na tha tab smon pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /dkar phyogs dga' ba'i lha dang drang srong sogs/ tshig dang dmod pa la dbang bden tshig dang / /bdag sogs bcos min bsam pa thag pa —304
