bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa (bdayis/ /gsol ba btab pas 'bras bu lhun grub 3|ga /deng nas bzung ste mi gnas myang 'das kyi/ /sa chen mngon du ma gyur de srid du/ /yongs 'dzin bla mas rjes su nyer bzung ste/ /phan bde'i dpal la spyod par bdag byin rlobs/ /zhes che chen chos rje nam mkha' rgya mtsho la gsol 'debs sku skye myur 'byon gyi smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po sgo mang slob dpon zur pa ngag dbang dpal 'byor dang / gung thang dka' bcu pa blo bzang gis gtsos pa'i chos rje nyid kyi grwa rigs rnams kyis bskul bar brten za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs so/ /bsod nams zhing mchog so thar bstan pa'i dpal/ kha che'i paṇa chen shākya shrī yi/ /gdan khrir chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin pa/ /mkhan chen dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /jo gdan chag mig mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gsol 'debs 'di ni ser byes pa dka' bcu pa mkhas btsun rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/mtho ris bdun ldan rten bzang legs thob sku/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la spobs pa dge ba'i gsung / /rim gnyis ting 'dzin rnal 'byor la goms thugs/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /lus ngag yid kyi spyod tshul ma lus pa/ /gdul bya'i re (103ba)ba skong ba'i yon tan gter/ /mchog dman dbang por 'tsham pa'i 'phrin las kyi/ /sgo brgya phyogs bcur 'byed la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo ldan bzang po'i las can tshogs rnams la/ rgya chen spyod dang zab mo lta ba'i lam/ /mar me mdzad dpal bzhed srol ltar bstan pas/ /dbyar mtsho ji bzhin 'phel la gsol ba 'debs/ /srid par 'jigs med bzod pa'i go cha yis/ /thub pa'i dri med bstan la 'gro ba rnams/ /mngon par bkris nas nges legs lang tsho'i dpyid/ /rab spel yongs 'du'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /deng nas kun mkhyen ye shes grong khyer du/ /zhugs min de srid dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /rjes bzung mtho ris thar pa'i bde ba la/ /spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por —305

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshebadag byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang bshes gnyen chen po gra pa mngon shes kyi gdan sa spyan g.yas mkhan po rtsis dkar nag dang gso ba rig pa'i gtsug lag sogs gzhung lugs mang po thos pa'i sdom brtson dam chos rin cen gyis sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las la sbyar ba 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngo ma chogs par za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /lus ngag yid gsum dbang gis legs smin nas/ /grol byed rtogs pa'i blo gros skal bzang la/ /zab cing rgya chen dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel ba'i/ /dpal (104na)ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i ded dpon la brten nas/ /srid zhi'i rgya mtsho che las rab brgal te/ /bla med byang chub rin cen gling chen por/ /myur 'grod rang gzhan don kun 'grub par shog /ces smon lam gsol 'debs dang bcas pa 'di ni bee ro tsa na'i kha ton du za hor gyi bzhes bris/ngag dbang tshangs sras lha mos mgrin 'khyud pas/ /smra ba'i spobs pa gzengs mtho'i legs bshad kyi/ /blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i 'dod 'jo mkhan/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i seng ge'i khrir/ /mgon khyod bskal brgyar bzhugs gsol nyer 'debs pa/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'ji/ba par mchog gsum gyis/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs myur la jug shog /bdag sogs 'dir snang srid pa'i bde ldan zhing / /ring por mi thogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun/ /rnam 'dren ye shes 'thob pa'i lam ston mkhan/ /dam pa'i mgon gyis rtag tu rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa 'di yang lcogs sbug pa tshe brtan rdo rjes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban no/ /chos rnams ka dag kun bzang dbyings kyi klong / /rang grol lhun grub 'od lnga mtshan dpe'i gar/ /tshad med thugs rjes 'gro la nyer 'jug pa/ khyab bdag padma dbang la gsol ba 'debs/ /—3(/6

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdedrin can bla ma zur chen chos kyi rgyal por gsol 'debs tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban no/ /bag yod khrims (104ba)kyis dul bas rnam par 'jam/ /legs bshad smra mkhas dbyangs can mgrin par chags/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i grags snyan kun khyab pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /skyid shod nyang bran pha phong kha'i gdan sa pa chos rje 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban no/ /dakṣi tu kuṇḍali tsakaṇḍa su tā ni mi stu nu byañdzanā ka ru ta shiñtsa sa dharmā nā da/ lharatna〉pa kar suñtsa yi ka pra shu kliḥshe khā pa ṭaski a/ bodhi tsam sbyadi rgyu/g.yas 'khyil mtshan dper ldan pa'i mgrin pa nas/ /tshangs dbyangs chos sgras byang sems slob mar bcas/ /mchog gsum ngo bor sdud mdzad rab dkar dung / /bkra shis dar dpyang byang chub bar du ring / /srid zhi'i yon (105na)tan gzugs su shar ba'i gtam/ /dra mig sna tshogs klog tshul sgyu thabs kyis/ /ngo mtshar yid la bkod pa gaṅgā'i rdul/ /de snyed grangs kyi khyad par gyis mtshon min/ /tshig gi chu klung gar btung legs bshad gser/ /'gyur ba'i rnam dpyod 'jam bu'i snye ma rnams/ /skyes thob shes rab yal ga'i rtser dud par/ /brtson pa'i lo 'dab g.yo ba 'di na mtshar/ /sna tshogs brjod pa'i tshig gis mi yi lus/ /ngo mtshar sgra don brgya byin gtsug tor gyis/ dag pas snyan 'gyur gsum ldan 'chi med gzugs/ /mngon sum 'gyur ba'i dga' ston 'di ko mtshar/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i nyi ma snying dbus nas/ /shar pa'i blo gros snang ba 'od po che/ /'jigs med spobs pa dge ba'i skya rengs ster/ /grangs med shes bya'i yul la gzigs mor che/ /de 'dra rtags tsam ma yin lnga rig kun/ /kun mkhyen smon 'gro lo sto'i legs bshad rgyun/ /rgyun du 'thungs las nyams 'gyur gzegs ma'i gter/ /gter mdzod gaṅgā'i chu bo zad mi shes/ /rgyal kun thugs rje dar —307—

bla ma'i bstod chogs kyi rim pa/ (bdalas 'phro can/ /rgya mtsho ltar zab zab rgyas chos tshul la/ /smra ba'i rnam dpyod dpyod ldan dga' skyed par/ /mi phyed snying nas dad pas gsol 'debs na/ /nye dang ring par ltos min thugs rje yis/ /bdag sogs gdul byar mchog thun dngos grub rnams/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /thub bstan dar zhing de 'dzin skyes bu kun/ /zhabs brtan 'gro rnams bde skyid (106na8pal la spyod/ /brgyad khri'i tshe ldan 'dzam gling skye rgu ltar/ /dge bcu'i 'bras bzang longs su spyod gyur cig /ces gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni dga' ldan gsang sngags yang rtse'i slob dpon zur pa nyag re rab 'byams pa blo bzang rnam rgyal gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /lnga rig smra la spobs pa dge ba'i ngag /dbang phyug grub pa mes po'i blo gros can/ /skal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /bskal brgyar brtan bzhugs bdag byin brlab tu gsol/ /zhes pa 'di yang phu lung skya rgyal nor bu'i ngag 'don du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban no/ /ngag dbang 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i bstan/ /rgya hor bod chen kun la dbyar mtsho ltar/ /spel mdzad rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /bskal brgyar rtag bzhugs thugs rjes bdag byin rlobs/ /zhes gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs tshang ba'i nyung ngu 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes re sgo shag lho pa'i blo bzang mkhas btsun dang blo bzang chos sgron thun mong gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes bris/su sti pradzā saḥ med byung lhag bsam dpung pas legs bteg rtser/ /g.yin phan sbrang rtsi'i bcud 'khyil 'dab brgya'i 'dzum/ /'gro kun thar par 'khrid pa'i cho ga mkhan/ /'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod bye ba (106ba)phrag brgya'i zhing khams su/ /dngos brgyud sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul rol gar las/ /bsams bzhin srid bzung rgyal bu 'jig —309—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sherten dbang / /sa spyod rigs su bltams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dri med bla ma'i thugs sras dkon cog 'bangs/ /gangs can mgon du legs byon srong btsan rje/ /mi g.yo ting 'dzin mchog brnyes lha'i me tog /'phags bod chos rgyal gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /thub bstan bla nas blar 'degs khri ral pa/ /'phags yul nor 'dzin skyong ba dge ba dpal/ /mar me mdzad dpal thugs sras bshes gnyen 'brom/ /snying stobs gter chen gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab gter rgya mtsho'i bka' babs mnga' bdag nyang / /bal yul bstan 'dzin padma badzra 'khas/ /bka' gdams bstan pa'i shing rta dge 'dun grub/ /mkhas grub dbang po gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ ti shes bya kun mkhyen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing gyur bzhad pa'i mtshan/ /yon tan gter gyur bde chen chos kyi rgyal/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /longs spyod 'khor lo'i dbus na ngag dbang lha/ /blo gros rgyud mangs 'brol pa'i skal bzang can/ /rgya hor bod yul kun khyab 'phrin las rgyun/ /dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel la gsol ba 'debs/ /bslu med rten cing 'brel 'byung seng ge'i khri/ /mi 'gyur bden tshig rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gzhir/ /mgon khyod 'gro la rjes brtse'i lhag bsam gyis/ /zhing 'dir chos 'khor bskor (107na)phyir rtag bzhugs gsol/ khugs drag gsol 'debs rlung gis nyer drangs pa'i/ /mchog gsum thugs rje brgya phrag nyi ma'i gzis/ /bdud bzhi'i mun pa mthar byas bskal ba'i bar/ khyod sku'i snang ba g.yo med 'bar gyur cig /'dis mtshon yang srid mang por nyer bsags pa/ /bsod nams gzugs can bzhin gyur 'bras bzang kun/ /'gro rnams srid zhi las sgrol ded dpon che/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur smin shog /mngon par mtho ba'i rin cen them skas la/ /deng nas grangs med skye bar rab 'dzegs nas/ /bla med ye shes mchog gi khang bzang du/ /'khrid pa'i bshes gnyen mgon dang mi 'bral shog /rtsod ldan snod du tshe lo brgyad khri ba'i/ /bsod nams phung por spungs kun legs shong zhing / /de don longs su spyod la bdag sogs 'gro/ /bzang po'i skal ba can du 'gyur bar shog /thar lam ma rnyed de srid —31()

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdamatho ris rten/ /grib ma'i grogs ltar nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /ring min don gnyis dpag bsam ljon pa las/ /phan bde'i 'dod rgu phyogs brgyar 'bebs gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang lugs gnyis kyi tshul la 'jug pa'i blo ldan 'phan yul drug brgya ba dkon cog tshe dbang sogs kyi don gnyer chen pos bskul ba la brten nas/ /snga sor bgyis pa rnams sprul pa dang thugs brgyud gcig pa'i dbang du btang pa'i dus mtshungs su byung ba 'ga' re yod la/ 'di ni sde brgyad rim par byung ba kho na'i dbang du (107ba)byas shing nged rang yang dam pa de dag dang las kyi 'brel ba thogs pa rgyu mtshan du bsams nas mjug 'thud de za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /phyag na pad dkar sgyu 'phrul dkon cog 'bangs/ /srong btsan lha yi me tog ral pa can/ /dge ba dpal sogs 'phags yul gangs can gyi/ /sa spyod dbang por bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas brtse chen sa skya pa/ /g.yu brag zhang ston nyi ma 'od zer dang / /bod yul phan bde'i srog shing dge ba 'bum/ /bshes gnyen dam par bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ /khrims ldan dge 'dun gtsug na mkhas grub mthus/ /bsod nams zhing gyur mdzad pas gdul bya'i tshogs/ /lung rtogs yon tan rgya mtshor 'god mdzad phyir/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis rjes bzung ba'i/ /bzang po'i bag chags sad la sgro btags kyis/ /me khyer nyi zla'i gral gyi rjes snyeg pa/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /dge 'dis bstan 'gro'i bde legs rnam par rgyal/ /bdag sogs bsod nams gser gyi lag pa las/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs dngul dkar 'bum phrag srang / /sangs rgyas thob min de srid chad med shog /ces gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni dwags po : nas mi dbang gis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /(108na)oṃ su sti pra dzā saḥ mthong bas don ldan mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs sku/ /thos pas gdung sel yan lag drug cu'i gsung / /dran pas 'jigs skyob kun mkhyen ye shes thugs/ /rgyal dbang zas —3// —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshegatsang sras por gsol ba 'debs/ /brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i mtshan gyi gzungs sngags bzlas/ /mchod bstod tsam gyis dus min 'chi ba'i mun/ /mthar byas phan bde'i 'od snang stsol mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan tshe dpag med la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen yangs ral gris rmongs pa'i dra ba gcod/ /brtse chen 'jam mnyen phyag na pad dkar 'chang / /nus mthu rdo rjes yid srubs dpung 'joms pa/ /rgyal sras rigs gsum mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ /snang ba mtha' yas ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /'phagasayul lnga rig paṇa chen tshul bzung nas/ /gangs can bstan pa'i mar me spar mdzad pa/ /mgon po a ti sha la gsol ba 'debs/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i/ /gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar mkhan can/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa/ /bla med gtan gyi skyabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' 'khob yangs pa hor gyi rgyal khams su/ /dam pa'i chos kyi mi 'jigasasbyin pa yis/ /mtho ris thar pa'i sa bon 'debs mdzad pa/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang lha yi blo gros ldan pas mkhas/ /bag yod khrims kyis nye bar dul bas btsun/ /gzhan don lhur len lhag pa'i (108ba)bsam pas bzang / /rje btsun bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya mtsho ltar zab gsung rab 'chad la dbang / /'jigs med spobs pa'i rig pa rtsod tshe rno/ /skyon bral ring lugs go cha rtsom la sra/ /thub bstan lang tsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /thos bsam sgom la rnam par rab 'byed pa'i/ /shes rab lang tsho brtas pas 'jam dbyangs kyang / /dga' bas mgrin pa'i pad mtsho legs bzhugs pa/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gtan gyi skyabs mgon khyed rnams sangs rgyas dngos/ /thugs rgyud spang rtogs yon tan dam pa'i chos/ /de don bsgrub pa'i 'khor rnams dge 'dun te/ /bslu med dkon cog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos su 'byor pa 'dod pa'i yon tan dang / /bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung 'dod rgu'i gter/ /yid kyis sprul pa'i kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar phye nas mchod/ /mtha' dang tshad gzung med pa'i 'khor ba 'dir/ /sngon chad bsags pa'i sdig la snying —3/the

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ khobakanas 'gyod/ /slad mar mi bgyid sdom sems drag po yis/ stobs bzhi'i sgo nas nyes tshogs ma lus bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang sems gzhan phan bsgrub/ /nyan rang bder gzhol skye phal rnam dkar las/ /bsgrubs zin gsog 'gyur da lta byed bzhin pa'i/ /dge tshogs rgya mtshor snying nas rjes yi rang / /mchog bar dman blo'i gdul bya dang 'tsham par/ /zab lam gsang sngags rgya chen (109na)pha rol phyin/ /chags bral spyod pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rnams/ /rgyal sras slob mar bcas pas bskor bar bskul/ /gdul dka' snyigs mar spyod la thugs dbyung nas/ /chos sku'i klongs su zhi bar gshegs bzhed rnams/ /lnga brgya'i 'gro ba nyam thag ngang tshul la/ /dgongs te bskal pa rgya mtshor bzhugs par gsol/ /ya mtha' mi mngon skye ba'i 'phreng brgyud nas/ /da lta'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /'bad pas bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge tshogs kun/ /bla med byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i dus khrims bsrungs pa sogs/ rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /bdag sogs deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /lha mi'i rten bzang rgyud mar 'thob par shog /de ltar yang srid rim par rnyed 'gyur ba'i/ /bde 'gro'i lus la phun tshogs mtho ris kyi/ /ma smad yon tan bdun gyi rin cen rgyan/ /nam yang mi 'bral brgyan pas mdzes par shog /tshe rabs kun tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /legs btab chos kyi sa bon rang rgyud la/ /smin pa'i sa bcu lam lngar yongs 'du'i rtser/ /chos gzugs 'bras bu g.yur du za bar shog /tshe 'dir nad gdon zug rngu'i ming bral ba/ /bde ldan zhing gnas skye rgu'i dga' ston dang / /rdzogs ldan dus su 'tsho ba brgyad khri'i lo/ /rnam thos bu yi stobs 'byor 'thob par shog /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan pa'i khur/ /blo (109ba)dang brtson 'grus phrag pa'i rtser blangs nas/ /tshangs pa'i yul sar 'degs pa'i stobs nus rtsal/ /mchog gsum mthu yis bdag snying la 'jug shog /bod dang bod chen hor gyi rgyal khams kun/ /phan bde'i grib mar rtag tu ngal gso ba/ /dga' ldan chos srid bstan pa'i gdugs dkar po/ /'degs pa'i yu ba bdag gis 'dzin nus shog /dpal —313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losheldan dus dgra'i dbang po ma he'i zhal/ /legs ldan phyag drug las kyi gshen rje dang / /'dod khams ma sogs bstan srung rgya mtsho yis/ /smon pa'i re ba 'grub pa'i grogs mdzad shog /'bad rtsol 'phrul la ltos min dus babs tshe/ /stong gsum mi 'jig bdag po tshangs pa yis/ /gtsug na rin cen bum pas dbang bskur te/ /tshe ring gnam gyi she mong 'thob par shog /rnam 'dren byang sems nyan thos rang sangs rgyas/ lha dang drang srong bden tshig grub rnams kyis/ /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa'i me tog char/ /phab nas dus kun dge ba'i bkra shis shog /ces gsol 'debs smon lam shis brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i ngag 'don rgyas bsdus 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes sa'i tshangs pa bstan 'dzin dwa yan rgyal po'i rigs kyi thu bo ratna sa bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos ja yun gcig la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /mtha' gnyis dgra tshogs bcom pa'i rgyal rnga che/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i khang bzang rtser/ /rab brdungs sgra dbyangs srid gsum khyab mjad pa/ /thub dbang nyin mo khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes phung (110na)por spungs pa'i gtsug tor du/ /gser zhun cod pan 'od kyis rmongs pa'i mun/ /mthar mdzad chos kun yongs mkhyen btsong kha pa/ rje btsun 'jam dpal snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam par 'byed par shes rab lha lam ngos/ /bzang po'i lhag bsam shing rtas nyer drangs pa'i/ /byang chub sems kyi nyi ma 'od po che/ /skal bzang pad tshal rgyas la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang dbyangs can rgyud mangs legs 'khrol ba'i/ /blo gros bum bzang gsung rab rgya mtsho che/ /thos brtson ri bo sgril las nyer 'thon pa/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal kun 'gro la rjes su rab brtse ba/ /'phags chen dam pa'i skyes rabs 'phreng ba can/ /lha bcas 'gro ba'i gnyen du sprul pa'i gar/ /sgyur mdzad rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin las grub seng ge'i khrir/ /ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sde/ /nges pa lnga ldan bzhin du rtag bzhugs nas/ /chos 'khor rgyun mi chad par skor gyur cig /byams pa'i bstan —314

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdapa dbus 'gyur 'chang ba'i yul/ shar min de srid khrims ldan 'dus pa'i gling / /zhwa ser 'dzin pa'i snang ba rab gsal ched/ /'dod khams mun sel sgron mer 'bar gyur cig /ces rgyal ba 'phags pa lha sprul pa'i sku blo bzang 'phags pa bsod nams lhun grub dge legs dpal bzang pos ring por 'tsho ba'i smon lam gyi tshigs bcad cig dgos tshul gsung bar 'brel chags kyi dbang du byas pa'i gsol 'debs bden tshig brjod pa dang / (110ba)bcas te za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /phun tshogs bkra shis sgo 'phar brgya phye nas/ /rnam mang 'phrin las yan lag brgyad ldan rgyun//gzhan phan rgya mtsho chen por legs 'bab pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam bkra rig pas lung don 'byed pa la/ /sras bcas rgyal bas shis pa brjod pa'i sgo/ /gzhung lugs mang por dpyad bzod 'dus pa'i sde/ /de 'dzin bshes gnyen tshogs rnams zhabs brtan shog /ces sgo mang slob dpon 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs 'di ni bkra shis sgo mang spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /rin chen lta bu'i blo gsal gdul bya la/ /lam bzang rdo rje'i theg pa legs bstan nas/dal 'byor don yod sgrub mdzad dge ba'i bshes/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs//zhes smad rgyud blo bzang don yod kyi gsol 'debs 'di ni bla ma brgyud pa'i kha skong du dgos zhes dbu chos gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang dngos grub bo//legs byas phun tshogs mngon mtho'i mngal khur nang / /ring goms chos kyi dbyar skyes gzhon nu'i 'bras/ /snod ldan gdul bya'i tshogs la legs ston pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin thos brtson dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /dngos grub legs tshogs 'byung gnas dge ba'i bshes/ /ring por (111na)bsten nas gsung rab rgya mtsho che/ /rnam dpyod gzings kyis pha mthar legs brgal ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdo rgyud lung don ma lus rig pa yis/ /brgal zhing nyer —3/da

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebartags rgya chen gsung rab gnad/ /lta ba'i blo mig dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pa/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i blo gros gyis/ /grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i bka' dang bstan bcos kun/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa rab 'dzin pa/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes bde yangs grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan slob dpon rim bzhi'i gsol 'debs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni grwa tshang spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs so/ /don kun ma lus grub pa'i thub pa'i dbang / /'chi med dpal ster yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs/ /gnas lnga rig pa ngag dbang grags pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'grub byin rlobs/ /paṇa grub gtsug rgyan rdo rje gdan pa dang / /'jig rten mig gcig ba ri rin cen grags/ /gang des rjes bzung grub chen sle nag par/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'grub byin rlobs/ /sku tshe mthar phyin bshes gnyen sgra pa'i zhabs/ /bka' phyag gnyis 'dres zla 'od gzhen nu rje/ /dbon rigs sgom pa tshul khrims snying po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'grub byin rlobs/ /thugs sras bsgom chung shes rab byang chub dang / /dri med tshul khrims rnam dag 'dul 'dzin (111ba tshes bas/ /rtog pa'i bdag nyid 'bri gung gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'grub byin rlobs/ /mtshungs med bla ma dam chos gling pa dang / /mkhas grub chen po chos kyi tshul khrims dpal/ /skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan mnyam med lha lung par/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'grub byin rlobs/ /bshes gnyen dam pas rjes bzung thog gnas pa/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug zhabs/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gyur byang chub bzang po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'grub byin rlobs/ /kun mkhyen chen po bkra shis rnam par rgyal/ /mkhas btsun spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ /skye rgu'i rnam 'dren dpal ldan rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'grub byin rlobs/ /mang thos mkhas pa'i rtser son 'phrin las zhabs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos —3/6

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdamatshar ba rdo rje 'chang / /thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'grub byin rlobs/ /gsang chen snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i bslab gsum rje/ /rigs kun khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan dpal/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang mgon po bsod nams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'grub byin rlobs/ kun mkhyen bla ma chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /rjes bzung ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sder/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'grub byin rlobs/ /dman log lam las zlog byed skyabs sems dang / /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis yongs bsags nas/ /rgyal yum 'phags ma'i gzugs sku'i phra rags la/ /gsal snang brtan pa 'thob par bdag byin rlobs/ /thugs gar 'khor lo yig 'bru'i spro bsdu dang / /rigs kyi (112na)bdag po'i byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /drug ldan 'od gur bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yi/ /mnyam gzhag ting 'dzin g.yo ba med par shog /mtho ris chu rgyun ji bzhin chad med pa/ /grag stong sngags kyi bzlas brjod lhur blangs pas/ lhag pa'i lha mchog 'dzad med byin rlabs kyi/ /phung po snying gi pad mtshor 'jug par shog /tshig tsam ma yin deng nas byang chub bar/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo lhag pa'i ltar bsten mthus/ /'chi bdag g.yul las rnam par rab rgyal te/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i tshe srog 'grub par shog /rdul bral ston gyi zla ltar dkar ba'i dges/ /'gro kun lnga pa'i 'jigs pa las sgrol ba/ /thar pa'i khang bzang rtser son bdag gzhan gyi/ /don kun lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal 'gyur shog /ces pa'i lugs kyi rje btsun sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe sbyin ma'i rjes gnang tshe khrid dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam gyis mtha' rten pa 'di ni/ tre bo hor chang chos rje ta'i si tu ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis rgyang ring po nas gser gyi maṇḍal dang bcas bskul ba la brten nas/ za hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las so/ /yid gnyis za ba'i the tshom gi rnyog pa dang bral zhing gzhan rkyen gyi mi phyed dad pa'i mtshor dwangs pa/ /rang ngosakyi —3/7—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemos pa'i sgo nas mchog gsum kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan 'dus pa'i bdag nyid dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam par bstan pa'i zla ba'i gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs pa/ /srid pa 'khor ba dang (112ba/zhe ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' gnyis su lhung ba'i tsha ba'i gdung ba ma lus pa sel ba'i thugs rje ga bur lta bu'i gzigs ma yis/ /bdag gi snying gi dbus kyi 'de phyi bar gsum dge ba'i bde skyid kyi kunda ba 'ad pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag thi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs/ mgon po'i rjes su 'gro ba'i blo gros kyi rtsal rnam par yangs shing / /lag na padma dkar po 'chang ba'i thugs rgyun kyis kun la rjes su brtse ba'i/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bzang por do zla'i tshul gyis 'gran par nu pa/ /rgya mtsho lta bu ra zab cing rtogs dka' ba'i gsang ba'i bdag po dang mthu stobs nus pa chos mtshungs pa/ ra ldan pa'i dkyil 'bar kun gyi gtso bo sa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang po'i gar gyi rol pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus deng nas gzung ste sangs rgyas ma thob bar gyi skye ba nas tshe rabs ba ra du phan pa dang bde ba'i ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa'i zas lta bu/ /shin tu dngar por gyur pa lus sems bde ba bskyed nus pa la longs su spyod pa dang mi 'bral zhing / /'gro ba thams cad thar pa'i gling du 'dren pa'i ded dpon stobs bcu mnga' ba thub pa'i dbang po yi/ /go 'phang tshogs kyas bsgrub pa la ma ltos par sman rgyal gu ṇa'i gsang lam zab mo la brten nas yun/ ring por mi thogs par/ mngon par/ 'gyur par/ 3|ga /ces gsol 'debs smon lam gyi tshigs bcad 'grol dang bcas pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes shel dkar rdzong sdod bya ra dngos grub kyis rten sgam gra mtshungs dang dod kyis bzos pa'i do dam byas tshe bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /na mo badzra wā ra gyi/ rdo rje'i 'chang dang rje btsun rnal (113na〉cur ma/ /nā ro pham thing klog skya mal lo'i 'khas/ /gong ma lnga dang zhang ston brag phug par/ /gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod 'grub byin rlobs/ /bla ma dam pa yar klungs khu dbon gnyis/ /'jam dbyangs chos rje yab sras kun spangs zhabs/ /mtshar chen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bslab gsum par/ /gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod 'grub byin rlobs/ /dbang phyug rab brtan rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba/ /chos dbyings rang —3/8

bla ma'i bsted tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdegrol mkhan chen zha lu rje/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod 'grub byin rlobs/ /dbang bzhi bskur pas rgyud smin si rgyu ra'i/ /dkyil 'khor la brten bdag byin rab brlabs nas/ /bskyed rdzogs slob bshad zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyis/ tshe 'dir zung 'jug sku bzhi mngon gyur shog /ces nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs shin tu 'khyer bde ba zhig bris shig ces zha lu'i gdan sa nyer gcig pa rigs kun khyab bdag mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /'od dpag med mgon bcom ldan tshe mtha' yas/ /dpal chen rta mchog tshe dbang rigs 'dzin rtsal/ /thang stong rgyal po rdo ring kun spangs rjer/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ /rje btsun grol mchog bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang / /dbang phyug rab brtan 'jam (113ba)mgon bsod nams mtshan/ /chos dbyings rang grol rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ /e lha nyi zla zung 'jug mi shigs pa/ /'gyur med srog gi ka ba rdo rje'i khams/ /lhun grub 'chi ba med pa'i rig pa 'dzin/ /'thob pa'i skal ba bzang por bdag 'gyur shog /ces tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster gyi brgyud 'debs 'di'ang rigs kun khyab bdag mkhan chen zha lu ba chen po'i thugs dam du za hor gyi brnyes dang bas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /gnas thub bstan dge 'phel dben gnas su/ /mtshar chen rdo rje 'chang dbang la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas dbur stod lo dgon bzhugs gnas su/ /mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas dpal ldan rtse yi bsti gnas su/ /spyan snga chos kyi rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas chos 'khor yang rtse'i bzhugs gnas su/ /khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas bkra shis chos sde'i bzhugs gnas su/ /'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan —3/()

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shel gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas zha 'u/ gser bkang gi bzhugs gnas su/ /kun mkhyen bcu ted nams mchog grub la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes gshed dmar brgyud 'debs thugs sras lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i 'gros thugs sras sems dpa' chen po nas rdo ring rin po che'i bar mtshar chen gyis gnang ba'i 'jug rnams zha lu 'dus pa'i tshogs 'don du dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog (114na)grub kyi gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi brnyes sug bris su byas so/ /'od mtshan stong du 'bar ba'i mgon po yi/ /thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul rol gar srid gsum na/ /che btsan rigs sngags grub pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo padma 'byung / /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /si rtse'i mtsho gling gdengs can 'jog po yi/ khang bzang rtse mor 'dab stong bzhad pa'i mthus/ /rdzus skyes ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje rang byung sprul pa'i sku/ /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dag pa'i las sad ind+ra bhu ti yi/ /rgyal khab chen por spyan drangs mnga' gsol tshe/ /'bangs rnams rdzogs ldan bzhin du bde la bkod/ /ekhri yā ṇa'i sa spyod thor cog can/ /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal ring rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /srid 'byor sgyu ma'i rol rtsed thabs mkhas kyis/ /nyer spangs bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa mthar phyin sbyor sgrol gyis/ /ma tshogs mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug zhi ba 'tsho/ /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /—320

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdagasol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gar gyi dal/ /mkha' 'gros byin rlabs phag mo mngon sum gzigs/ /nam mkha'i gza' (114ba)sogs sde brgyad bran du bkol/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /rigs 'dzin mchog brnyes pra bha ha sti yis/ /rjes bzung yo ga'i lha tshogs dngos su mjal/ /ngur smig gos klubs sdom brtson dam pa mchog /thub dbang gnyis pa shākya seng ge'i zhabs/ /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /mkhas grub rigs 'dzin mang bsten mdo rgyud dang / /tha snyad rig pa'i gnas sogs shes bya'i mtha'/ /rnyed min de srid spros pa dmar thag bcad/ /thams cad mkhyen pa blo ldan mchog sred dpal/ /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /mngon sum byin brlabs mi shigs rdo rje'i srog /lhun grub 'chi med 'ja' lus sku brnyes pa/ /tshe la dbang ba'i rigs 'dzin padma 'byung / /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /rdzu 'phrul bkod pas za hor rgyal po sogs/ lha ga la yi 'gro rnams thar lam drangs/ /yid 'dzin dbang mo la brten dga' ba bzhi'i/ /ye shes skyed mdzad padma saṃ bha wa/ /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /zhugs kyi phung po dal 'gror —32/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'akhyil ba'i dbus/ /padma'i sbubs nas yab yum zung 'jug sku/ /mngon sum bstan pas 'byung po'i dbang po sogs/ /skyon 'gro 'dul sras mchog padma rgyal/ /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /bdud 'dul ye shes ḍā gis rjes su bzung / /lung rig mtshon chas (115na〉sna ngan grub mtha' bcom/ /mthu stobs rtsal gyis mu stegs thal bar brlag /'phags pa seng ge sgra sgrogs gsang ba'i bdag /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /yang le shod du badzra he ru ga'i/ dbang dang rim gnyis las byung phyag rgya che/ /bsgrubs tshe bgegs dpung dpal chen phur pas bsgral/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal/ /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /gangs can lha srin gdug pa'i srog snying blangs/ /chos 'khor bsam yas ljongs zhing bod yul kun/ /dkar por bsgyur nas mnga' bdag bzhed pa bkang / /sangs rgyas gnyis pa sprul sku padma 'byung / /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /mchims phur zhi khro bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor du/ /rje 'bangs grogs gsum dgu dang nyer lnga sogs/ /smin grol la bkod grub rtags mngon du 'byung / /bka' drin 'khor med padmā ka ra'i zhabs/ /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /stag tshang phug tu dmu bdud dam sri btul/ /bsil ldan ri brag gnas kun gter gyis bkang / /las 'phro can gyis —322

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bda'adon par smon lam btab/ /snyigs dus 'gro 'dren rdo rje gro lod rtsal/ mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /dben gnas ke'u tshang phal chen byin gyis brlabs/ /sku dang phyag zhabs rjes rnams brag mtshor bzhag /dong sprugs cho gas 'gro kun las sgrib sbyangs/ /ma 'dris lus can yongs kyi gnyen (115ba)gcig pu/ /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /sku dngos rnga yab dpal rir bzhugs bzhin du/ /bod kyi yul nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba btab tshe dngos su byin rlobs pa/ /lang ga'i dbang phyug rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal/ /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung thugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /khyod zhal dngos mjal las can rje 'bangs tshogs/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i dpal mgon gter ston du/ /sprul nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel mdzad rnams/ /lha gcig ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /mgon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtag bzhugs kyang / kha ba'i ljongs nas gdung shugs drag po yis/ /gsol ba 'debs na thogs med thugs rje'i mthus/ /byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub char ltar phob/ /gcam bu min par snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /cher snyigs dus kyi lus can ma lus dang / khyad par bod 'bangs mtha' dag thugs rje ches/ /rjes su zungs shig rigs 'dzin padma 'byung / /rims 'khrug dbul phongs sad ser btsa' than sogs/ /sngon las 'phral rkyen bod skyong lha srin 'khrugs/ /stod smad mtha' 'dre'i sa rlang las byung ba'i/ /ngan pa'i 'bras kun zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dge bcur legs spyod ring po'i bar du 'tsho/ /dpal 'byor longs spyod mtha' bzhi'i las sgo 'du/ /'byung lnga'i nus nyams ma lus gsos pa dang / /snod bcud yon tan 'phel bar byin gyis —323

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yesherlobs/ /'byung po rnams kyang 'gro la byams brtse zhing / /sa spyod rgyal po'i mnga' thang chab srid rgyas/ /mchod gnas sde gnyis chos spyod rnam bcu 'phel/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /khyad par 'dus mdo sgyu 'phrul sems (116na)phyogs sogs/ /chad med bka' nas rim par byon pa dang / /bla rdzogs thugs gsum sgrub sde brgyad la sogs/ /zab gter bstan pa 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bsil ldan skye rgu'i sdug bsngal tshe ring kun/ /zhi byed dus babs zab gter ga bur thigs/ 'don pa'i las 'phro nyer sad skal ldan gyis/ /rten 'brel 'phyug med 'grig par byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon khyod thugs rje'i nyi ma bdag snying la/ shar bas srid zhi'i gdung mun kun zhi nas/ /'khor 'das phan bde'i snang ba 'od po che/ /'bral med rtse dga' khong nas dgod par shog /skye bar khyod gsung zab gter mkha' 'gro yi/ kha rlangs ma nyams ro brgya'i 'bras bu la/ /longs su spyad nas las bzhi sgrub chen brgyad/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen lam bzang mthar phyin shog /mdor na bod 'bangs nam yang mi 'dor bar/ /rjes su 'dzin zhes mnga' bdag yab sras la/ /zhal bzhes rdo rje'i ri mo srid mtha'i bar/ /nam yang 'gyur ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ /gdod nas dag pa'i rang rig thod 'phreng rtsal/ /rang ngo 'phrod nas skyong ba'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i bkra shis dpal 'bar bas/ /kun khyab bsam don lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ces sangs rgyas kun 'dus dpal skyon chen po la rnam thar dang rjes su mthun par gsol ba gdab cing smon lam du bya ba'i rim pa dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes pa 'di ni gnyos kyi gdung las zab mo gter gyi bka' babs rigs 'dzin chen po ngag dbang (116ba)padmas don gnyer chen po'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gye bande gang shar rang grol gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /'khor 'das phyag rgya ma lus zil gnon sogs/ /drag po'i rnam rol 'gro ngor res ston kyang / /gdod nas rang rig 'jam dpal kun tu bzang / /rgyal kun yab gyur mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /—324

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bda'od mtshan stong 'bar mtsho skyes rdo rje'i gar/ /legs bsgyur srid gsum che ba'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /lha srin srog phrogs bod yul dkar por bsgyur/ /gangs ljongs phan bde'i nyi mar gsol ba 'debs/ /lung bstan dus babs lha sras skyu ra yi/ /bsams bzhin srid bzung zab gter sgo phye nas/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor los sgyur rgyal dpal/ /rin cen phun tshogs zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /slar yang rang gi mdzad 'phrin yid bzhin nor/ /'khrul ba'i 'dam las 'dren pa'i shing rta cher/ /legs byon mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug mchog /rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags par gsol ba 'debs/ /skyon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i zab gter la/ /sngon bsags las 'phro sad pa'i ngag gi dbang / /blo gros spobs pa bzang pos rgya chen chos/ /dbyar mtsho lta bur spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /skyabs mgon rnams la phyag 'tshal mchod sprin spro/ /sdig pa'i tshogs bshags dge kun la rjes rang / /chos 'khor bskor bskul bskal brgyar rtag bzhugs gsol/ /bsod nams byas kun byang chub mchog rgyur bsngo/ /bdag sogs mtho dma' (117na)bar pa'i srid lam du/ /dkar nag shugs drag las kyis rgyu ba na/ /'bral med bshes gnyen tshogs kyis sdug bsngal las/ /rnam grol thar pa'i sa la 'god byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang 'bri gung phyag mdzod dkon cog rgyal mtshan gyis kha ton tu 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo /bzod brtson shes rab shing rtas nyer drangs nas/ /thos pa'i mkhar 'grod bshes gnyen mtshan mo'i mgon/ /rgya chen gdul bya'i kunda dbyar mtsho ltar/ /'phel mdzad yongs 'dzin dam par gsol ba 'debs/ zhes dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling slob dpon pa'i gsol 'debs 'di yang bstan pa rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/gzhung mang thos dang bsams pas spobs pa'i mgrin/ /cher bteg smra ba ngag gi dbang phyug gis/ khrims ldan rgya mtsho'i dbus na mngon mtho ba/ /mkhan chen dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'adebs/ /zhes spos khang tshogs pa'i mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs 'di ni spos khang spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/gangs can lha gcig phyag na pad dkar 'chang / /sbyin pa'i phar phyin yongs rdzogs 'jig rten dbang / /bden pa'i tshig gis bdud bzlog lha'i rgyal po/ /lus can kun gyi gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /bod yul mang bkur rgyal po gnya' khri btsan/ /rgyal (117ba)bstan thog mar dbu brnyes tho tho ri/ /rgya gar shar phyogs sa skyong dad pa brtan/ /nor 'dzin dbang po gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyon yul bgrod dkon cog gsum gyi 'bangs/ /dam chos srol btod srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas mdzad lha'i me tog /chos kyi rgyal por gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsar bcad skad du gtan 'bebs khri ral pa/ /dbus 'gyur sa spyod rigs ldan dge ba dpal/ /grub brnyes rnal 'byor kha che dgon pa ba/ /skye rgu'i 'dren pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes po 'brom ston rje/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang bla chen sa skya pa/ /gnas lugs don gzigs g.yu brag 'gro ba'i mgon/ /thub bstan nyin mor byed la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab gter bstan pa'i nyi 'od mnga' bdag nyid/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu yis chu bzlog dge ba 'bum/ /lnga rig padma badzra bal po'i zhabs/ /mkhas grub 'khor los sgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kun thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ /dbyangs can mgrin chags dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /sa gsum rnam 'dren bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ mtshungs med bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /snying stobs mchog mnga' yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /sngon byon rnams dang las smon 'brel tsam la/ /snyan po'i sgro btags za hor bhu su ku/ /nges legs sa mkhan dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /grangs med lus kyis phyag 'tshal de snyed mchod/ /sdig tshogs 'gyod sdom (118na)bshags shing dge la rang / /chos 'khor bskor bskul bskal brgyar bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /rnam dkar las rnams byang chub mchog rgyur bsngo/ /thub bstan spyi dang kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ dri med ring lugs phyogs —326

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdabacur rab rgyas shing / /de 'dzin tshogs rnams bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan/ /lus can ma lus bde zhing skyid par shog /bstan la ri mor byed pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag /tshe dpal 'byor stobs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /ring min sa lam yon tan kun rdzogs nas/ /bla med byang chub snying po 'thob par shog /ces rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la sri zhur brtson pa'i sa skyong dga' ldan pa rdo rje rnam rgyal gyis sku rten grwa tshar bzhengs pa'i skabs de dang mthun pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /ngag la smra ba'i dbang phyug grub pa'i blos/ /zab rgyas chos tshul yan lag brgyad ldan rgyun/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i rgya mtshor legs babs pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/skye bar bshes gnyen dam pa'i gru gzings la/ /brten nas srid pa'i chu gter las bsgral te/ /sku gsum nor bu'i gling du nyer bgrod nas/ /'gro la phan bde'i 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs shog /ces pa 'di yang u pa san chas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb (118ba)pa 'jam dpal lo/ /'phags bod mkhas pa'i gsung ngag las brgyud pa/ /gzhung brgya 'chad rtsod rtsom la rab dbang bas/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i don kun grub mdzad rje/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes bde 'byor grwa tshang gi bla ma ngag dbang don grub kyi gsol 'debs 'di ni grwa tshang spyi sos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /ngag dbang 'jam dpal blo yis rjes 'gro zhing / /bzang po'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mthar khyab rje/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo sa /rtag tu gsol ba 'debs so bdag byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di slob dpon 'phrin rgyam pa'i kha ton du za hor gyi bzhes bkod do/ /mgon khyod sku la rgyal sras slob mar bcas/ /yongs tshang mchog gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo mā /mi phyed snying nas gus pas gsol 'debs na/ /'di phyi'i bsams don 'grub par —327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshebyin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang dpon mo tshe ring gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /'di phyi'i dngos grub legs tshogs 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon dam par nges rnyed nas/ /sgo gsum 'bad pas rtag tu gsol ba 'debs/ /'di dang gtan gyi mdun ma lhun grub lha/ga /ces pa 'di yang a mi da ras bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'o/ /thog ma'i mgon po chos sku kun tu bzang / /longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang / /sprul sku rigs gsum mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ /bar gcod g.yul las rgyal bar bdag (119na)byin rlobs/ /smug nag dbang gi ḍā gī mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /lha yi rgyal po tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa/ /brgya byin lha yi dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /bar gcod g.yul las rgyal bar bdag byin rlobs/ /klu rgyal 'jog po gdengs can yongs kyi gtso/ /tant+ra bco brgyad bka' babs rgyal ba dza/ /mkhas pa shākya pra bha ra gsol ba 'debs/ /bar gcod g.yul las rgyal bar bdag byin rlobs/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa phyon padma 'byung / /rgyal yum mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo mkhar chen bza'/ /sna nam rnal 'byor chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /bar gcod g.yul las rgyal bar bdag byin rlobs/ /sprul pa'i gter ston dngos grub rgyal mtshan dang / /rig sngags 'chang ba rdo rje mgon po'i zhabs/ /mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags par gsol ba 'debs/ /bar gcod g.yul las rgyal bar bdag byin rlobs/ /mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas dpal bzang rje/ /thugs sras mes ston nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /sngags 'chang shākya bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /bar gcod g.yul las rgyal bar bdag byin rlobs/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog legs ldan rdo rje'i zhabs/ /khri srong rnam sprul bkra shis stobs kyi rgyal/ /rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /bar gcod g.yul las rgyal bar bdag byin rlobs/ /yol mo gter ston bstan 'dzin nor lung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /bar gcod g.yul las rgyal bar bdag byin rlobs/ /yang na/ mes ston sras mchog gnubs chen —328

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdangag gi dbang / /skyi ston sngags 'chang chen po tshe ring pa/ /(119ba)rang grol klu sgrub rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /bar gcod g.yul las rgyal bar bdag byin rlobs/ /se ston chen po nam mkha' rigs 'dzin dang / /bkra bzang chos rje thugs mchog 'od 'bar mtshan/ /khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /bar gcod g.yul las rgyal bar bdag byin rlobs/ yang na/ /rigs 'dzin chos rje'i dngos slob dkon cog legs/ /skyi ston sngags 'chang chen po tshe ring pa/ /man gos ma 'dabs/ yang na/ sprul pa'i gter ston dngos grub rgyal mtshan dang / /rigs 'dzin bla ma sangs rgyas byams pa bzang / /se ston nyi ma bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /bar gcod g.yul las rgyal bar bdag byin rlobs/ /se yi sngags 'chang mgon po bzang po dang / /se ban rin cen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo/ /spyan tshab mgon po zla bar gsol ba 'debs/ /bar gcod g.yul las rgyal bar bdag byin rlobs/ /nub dgon byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal/ /khri srong rnam sprul bkra shis stobs kyi rgyal/ /man sngar bzhin no/ /dal ba'i rten thob bshes gnyen mgon gyis zin/ /dpal chen phur pa spu gri'i dkyil 'khor du/ /smin byed dbang gi chu bo legs nos nas/ /bdag rgyud sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs par shog /gzhes zhig med pa bsrung ba'i gur khang nang / /srid pa phur bur grub pa'i rgya mdud dbus/ /rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs gsal ba'i/ /phra rags bskyed rim rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /grol byed thun mong rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang / /thun mong ma yin snang bzhi lhun grub lam/ /bstar bas tshe 'dir (120na〉ges nyid zad sa sa /legs 'khyol 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog /gnam lcags 'bar ba drag po'i hom khung du/ /gnod byed dgra dang bdud dpung bgegs bkug nas/ /rdzong 'phrang srog gsum lam du yongs bsgral te/ /'tshengs po gsum gyi rang gzhan don byed shog /rdzas kyi phur bus dgra bgegs thal bar rlog /don gyi phur bus ma rig rtsa ba gcod/ /rang sems don gyi da rma he ru ka /mngon sum rang ngo 'phrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhal byang gter phur bu lugs gsum las 'bring po spu gri'i dbang gi brgyud 'debs smon —329

rgyal dbang lnga nga/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shelam dang bcas pa 'di ni dge slong blo bzang don 'grub/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ dga' gdong sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtsho/ chos rje rdzong ri ba blo bzang padma rnams phur pa'i bsnyen mtshams byed skabs bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /gang gi sku la gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha/ /yongs rdzogs bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa che/ /dngos grub kun 'byung dbang gi rgyal po mā /nges rnyed dad pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ shwakya mu ni'i zhal skyin blta ba sogs/ /sgo gsum rnam dkar dge ba bsgrub ba'i ched/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i spyod yul rab yangs par/ /dkon cog thugs rje chen pos 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di'ang bsod nams sgrol mas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dbyangs so/ /mchog tu rab yangs blo gros gter bum nas/ /legs bshad chu klung skal bzang gdul bya'i mtshor/ /phab ste thos nor (120ba)dpal ldan rin cen la/ /dbang 'byor bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes slob dpon blo bzang dpal 'byor gyi gsol 'debs 'di ni chos 'khor gling spyi sos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes bris/blo bzang mi ldan pa'i gzugs can/ zho 'thungs lag nyal thub bstan mkhar/ /tshig 'phreng gzas tsam mdzangs rlom gyen 'phyur tshogs/ /gnas lngar 'grod pa'i ngal ba mngon btang tshe/ /rab dkar grags snyan sa srungs steng na 'gying / /e ma 'jam dpal mkhyen rab pha mthastus le'u dang po nas bstan pa'i mdzes pa'i yon tan shar phyogs rgo ṭa par grags pa tshad/ /mig zla'i zhags pa snyim pas legs 'dzin pa'i/ /mdog lnga'i bgrod pa can de'i bsam pa'i khur/ /yol gor byed pos dbyig 'dzin lto ba sprul/ /thub gzugs can rab rtog /bstan sa la legs bshad gom gsum gyis/ /mkhas mang stobs ldan mi smra'i sa 'og zhugs/ /pad dkar mig de 'phyang mo sel ba'i slad/ /'dab bzang dbang po'i bzhen pa ched du bsten/ /phul gzugs can phul byung / byung shes rab gser gyi 'khor lo yis/ /rtogs dka'i gsung rab rta ljang dri ma bdar/ /skal ldan he ru ka yi 'dod tshim tshe/ /bi shwa gzhan zhig sa steng 'di na snang / /de —330

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdalta'i rgyal mchog bstan pa'i zhing sa la/ /rnam dkar sa bon bzang po legs btab pas/ /bsod nams smin pa'i char chen byed pa yis/ /gsum ldan gang ba'i g.yur za rab ldem pa/ /za hor rigs kyi 'chi med dga' tshal du/ /ngag dbang yongs 'du'i blo mchog dri bsung las/ /bzang po'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho chen po'i mtha'/ /kun khyab tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje dpal/ khres bya'i 'dzin mar (121na)gsang chen dpung tshogs dang / /gzhung lugs shing rta tha snyad gser 'khor gyis/ /lnga rig yangs pa'i gling bzhir dbang sgyur ba/ /gdong drug snyems pa'i lang tshor gsol ba 'debs/ /lcid kyis non pa'i chu 'dzin stug po'i gos/ /lha lam mdzes mas gyon tshe mdongs mtha'i gar/ /ldog med de bzhin gnas skabs mthar thug gi /'dod don lus pa med par 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni ding sang mkhas rlom gyi khur 'chang ba rnams kyang / mkhas pa mgu ba bskyed pa'i tha snyad kyi gtsug lag la mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs kyi mun khung skyabs su bstan pa mang bas snyan ngag gi spros pa spangs kyang yul byang phyogs kyi sa nas blo gros kyi mig can bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i gser yig pa che chen dpon pos snyan ngag dam pa zhig gyis zhes bskul ba las/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen por bstod pa blo ka bzhi dang / ngos cag la yon tan de dag gi cha shas tsam yang med par sgro btags te/ yul lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byung ba'i snyan ngag mkhan skad gnyis smra ba tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes 'phral du bris/ji snyed rlabs chen bsod nams phung po'i tshogs/ /gcig tu mngon zlums rnam par dkar ba'i las/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i grags snyan mthon po can/ /rje btsun dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon bsags mthu dang bshes gnyen mchog gi mgon/ /mtha' yas bka' drin dag las ye shes lha/ /zla ba'i cod paṇa rnal 'byor dbang po mchog /gzhan phan lhun gyis grub la gsol ba 'debs/ /brtson 'grus byed po'i mthu las dge legs kyi/ /yon tan dpal gyis mdzangs par grags pa yis/ /(121ba)bzang po'i dri bsung 'phro ba'i rkang 'thung 'phreng / /mtshungs bral sprul pa'i —33/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang ble bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshesku la gsol ba 'debs/ /phun tshogs grags pa'i snang brnyan lha lam ngos/ /gzha'u tshon gsar pa'i ngang tshul legs shis pa'i/ /grangs med rnam dkar rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa can/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge tshogs chu gter gyis/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyi kun gsal gos/ /'bral med brtse bas 'dzin pa'i gru char gyis/ /mtha' yas 'dod don snye ma rgyas par shog /gser mngal gtsug na zla ba la mos pa/ /mthu ldan rnams kyi stobs dang bden tshig gis/ /dam pa gang de ji srid bskal brgya'i bar/ /mi 'gyur brtan phyir bsrung zhing skyong gyur cig /ces sprul pa'i sku grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa 'di yang rab 'byams pa bkra shis rgya mtshos bskul ngor bris/rgyal kun gsang ba gsum gyi rgya mtsho las/ /rab skyes sprul sku padma'i sdong bu'i rtser/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rdo rje'i theg mchog gi /ge sar mngon par rgyas la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gis rjes bzung ngag gi rang bzhin kun/ /yongs grub dbang phyug yon tan blo gros rdzings/ /kun bzang dgongs pa'i rgya mtsho'i mthar bgrod pas/ /don gnyis nor bu stsol la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe rabs kun tu rdo rje slob dpon mchog /nye bar bsten pas gsang chen zab mo'i chos/ /dbang khrid lam gyi go rim ji bzhin du/ /brtson pa'i nyams su bstar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gdod (122na)nas 'brul ma myong ba'i rig pa'i mkha'/ /ma rig 'thug po'i sprin gyis nyer bsgribs pa/ /rkang 'khyams rgyal po'i dpe bzhin rang gi sems/ /ye grol kun tu bzang por ngo 'phrod shog /mdor na rgyal dbang 'chi med grub pa dang / /bi ma mi tra'i lugs bzang snang bzhi'i lam/ /legs rtogs bde chen sku gsum grong khyer du/ /zhugs nas rang gzhan don rnams lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di yang byang pa rigs 'dzin gyi bka' 'bangs kun bzang dbang po'i ngor za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar/rmad byung rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i don rnams ma lus pa/ /—332

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdalhun grub skal bzang gdul bya nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod zhing gzhan 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir/ /rab dkar mdzad pa'i bzhed don legs 'grub cing / /bdag sogs tshe rabs kun tu rjes bzung nas/ /dal 'byor don ldan 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes byes pa slob dpon 'phrin las bsam grub la gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes bris/rgyal kun gsung ngag snyan 'gyur bye ba'i glu/ /thub bstan lha dbang mdun sar blangs ba'i gdangs/ /blo ldan skal bzang rnar 'jibs rgya chen gzhung / /(122ba〉〉 la mtsho byung lha mo mgrin par rol/ /'jigs pa med pa'i rnam dpyod btsan po'i go /dkar cha'i zla ltar rab 'phel thub pa'i bstan/ /lang long dal bur g.yo ba'i chu 'dzin tsho'i/ /spun slar sde bzhi 'byung khungs byed pos brjod/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bla ma'i gsung rab rnams/ /smra la dga' zhing rtul phod 'gro ba'i mgon/ /ma 'dris kun gyi bshes dang gnyen gcig pu/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma smad dad pa'i 'od zer gyis zhu ba'i/ /byin rlabs gangs kyi ri las babs pa'i chab/ /srid bzhi'i tsha gdung sel ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /skal bzang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor 'grub gyur cig /phun tshogs dpal 'byor gshin po'i zhing sa la/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i sa bon legs btab pa/ /dri med smon lam drod gsher gyis smon pas/ /sku gsum 'bras bu'i snye ma rgyas gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang bying bsam gtan rtse'i bla mas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /rgyal kun 'gro 'dren bzhed pa'i dam bca'i khur/ /dus mthar ngur smig gar gyis legs mnabs te/ /thub bstan yongs kyi shing rta chen po pa/ /'jam mgon blo bzang grags par gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi gsung ngag mdo rgyud ma lus pa/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la dbang ba'i blo gros kyis/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i re skong 'phrin las rgyun/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can (123na〉byab la gsol ba 'debs/ /'di dang bar do phyi ma'i yang srid kun/ /mngon gyur sdug bsngal zug jus mi gtse zhing / /mtho ris bde ba'i lam brgyud thar pa'i grong / /—333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshemyur 'jug skal ba bzang por bdag byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang / gong gi gser yig pa de khe dge slong dang / blo bzang phun tshogs gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs so/ /dri med blo gros skal bzang yol ga'i nang / /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i gsung rgyun bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /rab 'khyil snod ldan gdul byar stsol mdzad pa/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas de gsung slob mar bcas pa yi/ /byin rlabs lha dang drang srong bden pa'i tshig /chos skyong srung ma'i nus mthus yongs 'dzin rje/ /zhabs brtan sde 'di srid mthar rgyas gyur cig /ces thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor ba'i slob dpon blo bzang 'jam dbyangs kyi gsol 'debs dang brtan bzhugs 'di ni grwa tshang spyi sos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /ngag la 'jam mgon byin rlobs nyer zhugs pas/ /chos kun smra bar dbang ba'i blo gros can/ /skal bzang rgya chen gdul byar legs bshad mtsho'i/ /rlabs 'phreng yol ba med la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod sku tshe mtha' yas pa'i (123ba)mgon po ltar/ /rab bzhugs thub bstan 'phel zhing 'gro rnams bde/ /bdag gi 'di dang gtan 'dun ma lus pa/ /shegs med lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang chos mdzad rgyal po don grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /gang gi sku la rab 'byams rgyal ba kun/ /ma lus tshang ba'i rdo rje'i slob dpon che/ /ngag dbang lha yis rjes bzung blo gros can/ /skal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di yang a pan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /dge ba'i bshes khyod snying gi 'dab stong dbus/ /rtag par 'bral med gsol ba 'debs byed na/ /deng nas byang chub bar du rjes bzung ste/ /kun mkhyen ye shes myur du 'thob byin rlobs/ /zhes dag mdzad bsam gtan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /nam mkha' lta bur yangs pa'i blo gros kyi/ /pha mtha' 'jig rten mes —334

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdapor rtogs dka' bas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtser/ /bsgreng ba'i bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /blo bzang snyan pa'i grags 'bar btsong kha ba'i/ /bstan pa 'chi med lam gyi tshad bzhin du/ /rgya cher spel zhing 'dzen la mtsho byung ma'i/ /rjes 'gro dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal snying po yi/ /bstan pa (124na)chen po hor gyi rgyal khams su/ /'dzin pa'i 'phrin las shing rta 'dren mkhas pa/ /mtshungs med sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge bas dam pa khyod/ /rdo rje lta bur mi g.yo rtag brtan cing / /tshe rabs kun tu khyed kyis rjes bzung ste/ /dal ba'i rten bzang don ldan byed par shog /ces skyid shod sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyi skyes rabs kyi gsol 'debs 'di ni pā khan brnyes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /blo gros yangs pa'i skal bzang gdul bya'i tshogs/ /gtsug na bsod nams ye shes 'bras bu yis/ /legs dud rlung gi rgyal mtshan ltar bkra ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sprul pa'i sku blo bzang ye shes kyi gsol 'debs 'di no mon e ching gi pa'i skye bas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /sgo gsum bag yod la goms tshul khrims kyi/ /zhing sar gtan bde'i myu gu legs dar nas/ /gdul bya'i rgyud la rnam dag bslab pa gsum/ /rgyas mdzad bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /rten 'brel 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid mkhar/ /rgyu 'bras nyi zla zung 'jug snang ba yis/ /'chi bdag mun pa'i smag rum mthar byas te/ /mgon khyod rdo rje'i khri la brtan gyur cig /ces ser smad slob dpon tshul khrims dar rgyas la gsol 'debs brten bzhugs 'di lta bu zhig dgos (124ba/zhes sngags rams pa 'jam dbyangs bkra shis kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /snying nas skyabs su gsol tshe byang chub bar/ /bslu med dkon cog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ /chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun btsong kha par/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub char du phob/ /'jam mgon ngag gi dbang phyug dam pa de'i/ /—335

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shelugs 'dzin blo gros rab gsal rnam dpyod kyis/ /skal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho'i 'dren pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub char du phob/ /dus kyi dgra bo 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i lha/ /phyag drug ye shes mgon po las gshin gyis/ /bar chad nyes pa'i g.yul las rab rgyal zhing / /'dod pa'i re ba 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang thag zhi bo lod kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus padma thod 'phreng gis/ /tshe rabs du mar rjes bzung bag chags mthus/ /theg mchog rgya mtsho'i bka' babs bzhad pa rtsal/ /gang shar rang sar grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i mtshon/ /gdengs pas yid srubs g.yul las rnam rgyal bas/ /gzhom med drag rtsal rdo rjer lhun grub pa/ /che mchog 'dus pa rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje khri srong lde'u btsan zung / /ngo mtshar sku yi bkod pas byin brlabs te/ /gangs can phan bde'i gzhir gyur rdo rje (125na tshe re dzin/ /rtsa gsum thugs rjes bskal brgyar brtan gyur cig /se zur gnubs gsum sngags pa'i rgyal por grags pa'i nang tshan/ zur 'ug bya lung pa'i rigs 'dzin chen po shākya'i mtshan can gyis 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes nan tan du bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las so/ /mchog gsum ngo bor nges rnyed gdung shugs kyis/ /spyi gtsug pad mtshor 'bad med gsol 'debs na/ /deng nas tshe rabs kun tu nyer bde zhing / /ring por mi thogs sangs rgyas 'thob par shog /ces ma rma mtsho mos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /man 'gos gsung ngag chad med bshad srol rgyun/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan blo bzang grags pa yi/ bzhed gzhung nor bu'i gan mdzod sgo phye nas/ /gdul bya'i re ba stong la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes smad rgyud slob dpon ngag dbang nor bu'i gsol 'debs 'di ni dge bskos byang 'dren gnyis kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar//lta na nyer sdug mthon mthing zur phud lnga/ /sin dhu wa ra'i mdangs kyi cod pan du/ /legs bsgyur —336

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdekun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa dang / /dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir nad gdon rgud pa'i mun pa sangs/ /skye ba brgyud mar mtho ris rten bzang thob/ /ring min 'gro rnams srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol ba'i ded dpon chen por bdag gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang do'i re se khos bskul ba'i don du za (125ba)hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lcang gseb pa 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /'khor bar grangs med skye ba blangs blangs kyang / /phal cher mi khom gnas brgyad kho nar 'khyams/ /da lam dal 'byor rten bzang rnyed pa 'di/ /rnam dag tshul khrims bsrungs pa'i 'bras bu ste/ /de yang mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes las byung / /de phyir 'khor thabs med pa'i bka' drin dran/ /zol med snying gi dkyil nas gsol ba 'debs/ /mi lus don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnyed dang dal 'byor thob kyang mthun pa'i rkyen/ /nyung zhing mi dge'i grogs kyis dbang song mang / /deng dus thub bstan rin cen sgor zhugs 'di/ /sngon tshe smon lam 'tshams sbyar 'bras bur nges/ /de'i tshul dge ba'i bshes kyi bstan la rag /de phyir 'khor thabs med pa'i bka' drin dran/ /zol med snying gi dkyil nas gsol ba 'debs/ /mi lus don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /thos grar zhugs kyang tshig sbyor blor chud cing / /bsams na go ba rnyed pa shin tu nyung / /thos bsam gang bgyis go yul chags pa 'di/ /tshe sngon sbyangs pa'i bag chags sad pa'i mthu/ /de yang ston byed dge ba'i bshes kyi drin/ /de phyir 'khor thabs med pa'i bka' drin dran/ /zol med snying gi dkyil nas gsol ba 'debs/ /mi lus don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /mang por thob kyang go yul tsam lus nas/ /kha bshad chos dred khyer ba shin tu mang / /gang shes sgom don nyams len phyogs dril pa/ /sngon tshe yang dag 'jog la goms pa'i 'bras/ /de yang tshul der sbyor mkhas bla ma'i drin/ /de phyir 'khor thabs med pa'i bka' drin dran/ /zol med snying gi dkyil nas gsol ba 'debs/ /(126na〉pe lus don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ kha zhu gting 'khyags nyi tshe'i nges 'byung dang / /—337

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6semi mtshungs gting nas 'khor bar chen log blos/ /tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa'i dam bca' 'di/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam la goms pa'i mthu/ /de yang ston byed yongs 'dzin bla ma'i drin/ /de phyir 'khor thabs med pa'i bka' drin dran/ /zol med snying gi dkyil nas gsol ba 'debs/ /mi lus don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /'chi bar brod kha rnyed pa'i nyams len gyis/ /'jig rten phyi ma'i 'dun ma lhun grub nas/ /pha khyim bu 'jug lta bu'i spro ba 'di/ /thos dang brtson pas nyams len byas pa'i mthu/ /de yang bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyi drin/ /de phyir 'khor thabs med pa'i bka' drin dran/ /zol med snying gi dkyil nas gsol ba 'debs/ /mi lus don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlobs kyis/ /deng nas kun mkhyen rgya mtshor 'jug min par/ /de nyid bcu ldan dam pas rjes 'dzin pa/ /gzhen nu nor bzang lta bur bdag gyur cig /ces rang la bka' drin gang che'i bla ma la sbyar chog pa'i bka' drin rjes dran gyi gsol 'debs 'di ni bi ri dge slong dbang phyug grags pas don gnyer chen pos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bandes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i grib tu nyer bsil bar/ /ris med 'gro kun bde bar ngal gso ba'i/ /ma 'dris yid can gnyen gyur shākya'i tog /don kun grub pa'i dbang por gsol 'debs/ /'phags bod mkhas grub bde 'byung ral pa'i rtser/ /zhabs sen zla tshes gsar pas yongs spud pa/ /mar me mdzad dpal gar (126ba)dbang sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /phul byung lhag bsam can la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gang gzigs shes bya'i yul/ /kun la lkog tu ma gyur thams cad mkhyen/ /blo bzang snyan pa'i grags 'bar btsong kha pa/ /gangs can bstan pa'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bla ma yi/ /ring lugs 'chad rtsod rtsom pas 'dzin pa la/ /blo gros spobs pa dge ba'i skal bzang rlabs/ /yol med rgya mtsho'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtog ge'i tshig don mtha' dag brgal brtag gis/ /dpyod la 'jigs med lung dang rig pa'i gos/ /rang —338—

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa khobakabastan dam bca'i cha shas ma lus pa/ /bzhom med lhun grub dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam gsum sde snod nges gsang rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /thub bstan yongs 'du gsar pa'i lang tsho kun/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i rlan gyis rab rgyas pas/ /sde gzhi'i sgo 'phar 'byed la gsol ba 'debs/ /skye rgu'i phan bde ma lus kun gyi gzhi/ /spyi dang khyad par zhwa ser 'chang ba'i bstan/ /legs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /chos 'khor bskor phyir bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /ma smad dad pa'i zhing sa gshin po la/ /bsod nams sa bon btab pa yongs smin pa'i/ /bde skyid gser gyi snye ma g.yur za bar/ /byed por gtogs so cog rnams longs spyod shog /rnam 'dren spyan sngar dkar phyogs legs skyong bar/ /zhal gyis nyer 'ches mthu ldan srung ma yis/ /deng 'dir smon pa'i re ba legs 'grub cing / /bkra shis dpal gyis dus (127na)kun khyab par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di'ang lha rigs nor 'dzin dbang mo lcam bsod nams chos bzang gis bskul ba'i ngor sde snod gsum pa za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /rgyal kun mdzad pa'i zhags pas mgon khyod kyi/ /'phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' 'jal nus min yang / /rtsod ldan 'gro ngor mtsho skyes sprul pa'i gar/ /legs bsgyur thod 'phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las rol ba'i rtsal/ /rang rigs rtags dang kha dog brgya phrag mtshon/ /'char ba'i dwangs shel ji bzhin ma 'dres pa/ /'phrin las bsgrub ched bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde chen waṃ gdangs stong nyid shes rab er/ /yongs shar rtse dga' khong nas nyer dgod pa'i/ /khro chags sgeg pa'i nyams ldan padma 'byung / /khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /bag yod ma la ya las tshul khrims ngad/ /'thul bas srid pa'i tsha gdung drungs 'byin pa/ /tshangs spyod rtser son padma sambha wa/ /thub pa'i nyan thos che la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod thugs rnyog pa'i dri bral mtsho nang du/ /shes byar srid pa'i zla gzugs rab 'char ba/ /blo ldan mchog sred nges par kun mkhyen zhes/ /snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar la gsol ba 'debs/ /rjes su chags pa'i —339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshe 'e gsung 'bum/ 6shedamar 'od zhags pa yis/ khams gsum brtan pa 'phrog pa'i chom rkun ma/ /dbang gi dngos grub tshogs la mnga' 'byor ba/ /padma rgyal por grags la gsol ba 'debs/ /dug lnga'i mtshan mor rmongs (127ba)pa'i mal stan las/ /slong ba'i thugs rje'i skya rengs rigs drug gnas/ /'char byed nyi ma'i 'od zer rnal 'byor mchog /brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa mtshan dpe'i sku/ /rgyal ba'i zhal skyin 'gro la mngon sum du/ /bstan nas yid srubs mya ngan khang bu dra/ /'jug mdzad shākya seng ger gsol ba 'debs/ /gnam lcags tsha tsha 'phro ba'i dpal gyi rtser/ /mu stegs sde bcas mi rtag lam bkod nas/ /'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud kyi brtul zhugs sgra/ /sgrog mdzad dpa' bo chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /chol ba'i khro tshogs nyer spros gzi brjid kyis/ /dregs pa kun gyi lag cha stabs gcig tu/ /bor nas gtsug tor khyod zhabs la reg pa'i/ /rdo rje gro bo lod la gsol ba 'debs/ /stong nyid snying rje'i rang rtsal lus phra mar/ /yongs shar manda ra dang mtsho rgyal yum/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sgyu 'phrul rol rtsed mkhan/ /mkha' spyod zhing gi dbang mor gsol ba 'debs/ /dor stabs zhabs kyis bdud sde 'dam bzhin du/ /brdzis kyang ma tshim khrag dren grub mdzad pa/ /dbang chen rta mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /zung 'jug he ru ka la gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro pho nya zhing ka ra/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo chos skyong gter srung tshogs/ /gtso las gzhan min rgyu ma'i rol rtsed kyis/ /dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra la gsol ba 'debs/ /skyabs mgon gzhan nas mi 'tshol rang gi sems/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo nges pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /'di phyi'i 'dun ma sgrub pa'i rig sngags 'chang / /gang shar rang sar grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /(128na〉sna di snang zhing sar btab pa'i legs byas 'bru/ /bgrang yas skye bar smin pa'i snye ma la/ /'dzad med spyad nas ring por mi thogs par/ /rang rig don gyi bad 'byung mngon 'gyur shog /ces slob dpon chen po mtshan brgyad 'khor bcas dang 'jug tu nged rang la gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes glang phu ba rdo rje 'gyur med kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa —340

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdani gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /dal ba'i rten la gzhung 'ga' brtson pa yis/ /nyer sbyangs 'chad par rtag tu 'grus min yang //spong ba'i brtul zhugs rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa la/ /mos pa'i zlos gar bsgyur der gsol ba 'debs/ /dbu tshad chos mngon 'dul sogs dam pa'i chos/ /'chad pa'i rnam dpyod dpal mdas phas rgol las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i rtags mtshan rab 'chang ba/ /yongs 'dzin bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes dkyil khang slob dpon pa gnyis kyi gsol 'debs 'di yang khal kha sku skye blo bzang 'phrin las kyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba'i za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/ /klog pa thos bsam spong ba bsam gtan dang / /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo rnam gsum gyis/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i re ba yongs skong ba/ /bka' drin mnyam med blo bzang 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /mgon khyod bye ba phrag brgya'i rdul rnyed kyi/ /dag pa'i nyid khams gang du legs bzhugs kyang / /mi phyed snying nas gus pas gsol 'debs na/ /ma smad thugs rje chen pos bdag byin rlobs/ /gang gi thugs rje'i 'phrin las mkha' (128ba)khyab kyi/ /ma 'dris 'gro la 'jug bzhed lhun grub cing / /bdag sogs rnam pa thams cad mkhyen min bar/ /'bral ba med par brtse bas rjes 'dzin shog /ces thang sag slob dpon pa blo bzang 'jam dbyangs kyi bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam 'di ni thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor gyi grwa tshang spyi tshogs dang drug brgya grub chen blo bzang dkon cog gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /thub dbang byams mgon thogs med dbyig gi gnyen/ /grol sde rnam gnyis gu ṇa mi tra dang / /seng ge bzang po gang pa spel ku swā li che chung / /gser gling maṅga chos kyi grags pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mar me mdzad dpal 'brom ston po to pa/ sha ra ru 'chad kha pa dang se spyil bu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan lha ston pa 'od zer bla ma/ /lha sdings pa byang chub 'bum lha sding dpon po kun rgyam tshogs pa'i dbu mdzad yon tan dpal/ /mkhan chen bde ba dpal rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dka' bzhi pa grags pa ga 'an —341 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshenu byang sems bsod nams grags pa thogs med bzang po dpal/ /rgya ma ba yon tan 'od dang 'phags pa blo 'phel spyan snga tshul khrims dar/ /lo pa spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang rgyal sras bsod nams legs mchog dang / /gzhug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags brag dgon spyan snga ba rdo rje yong pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub zhabs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings rang grol rje/ /yang na rgyal sras thogs med pa mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen grags pa/ bshes gnyen pa/ /(129na 'jam dbyangs/ rin cen rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhan chen/ rgyal ba phyag na mkhan chen/ kun dga' blo gros gzhug la ba paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ /yang na/ rgyal sras thogs med pa mang mkhar pa tshul khrims/ dpal sems dpa'/ gzhen nu rgyal mchog pa/ /mus chen dkon cog rgyan mtshan gung ru sher ba bzang po gtso la paṇa wo/ ngag dbang grags pa/ /lo pa spyan snga/ ngag dbang chos grags rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan chos 'byor lo pa spyan snga/ kun dga' don grub dang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma drin can gnas gsar ba mgon po bar nams ma sto ldan/ /yang na/ mus chen dkon cog rgyal mtshan kun mkhyen/sangs rgyas 'phel/ /'jam dbyangs/ kun dga' chos bzang rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas pa/ lha dbang blo gros rje byams pa phun tshogs dang / /rje dpal 'byor shes rab grub khang pa/ dpal ldan don grub zhabs/ /gnas gsar rje btsun mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ yang na sems dpa' gzhen nu rgyal mchog pa/ /ri pa/dpal ldan grags pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhan chen/ grags pa rgya mtsho mkhan chen/ rin cen grags pa dang / /mkhan chen/ sangs rgyas bkra shis mkhan/ dbang phyug dpal bzang po/ /yangs yo mal po/ ngag dbang chos grags drin can bka' 'gyur ba/ /mgon po/ bsod nams mchog ldan rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon 'gro skyes bu chung 'bring lam bsgoms pas/ /srid pa'i bde la sred pa yongs spangs te/ gtan 'dun thar pa don du gnyer ba'i blo/ /bcos min bsam pa thag pas 'byongs par shog zhos kun sems yin skye 'gag gnas gsum (129ba)bral/ /cir yang ma grub gang snang sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /bdag bde g.yin gtong gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rnams/ /tshur len byang —342

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdachub sems gnyis 'byongs par shog /kun rdzob don dam sems bskyed rnam gnyis kyis/ /bsam dang sbyor bas rkyen ngan ma lus pa/ /byang chub bsgrub pa'i lam du legs bsgyur nas/ /bdag nyid gces 'dzin drungs nas 'byin par shog /'phen goms sa bon sun 'byin smon lam ste/ /stobs lnga tshe gcig nyams len la bsgril zhing / /chags med smon lam 'tshams sbyar bdag 'dzin blo/ /sun phyung 'phen goms stobs kyis 'pho bar shog /gang byas chos rnams bdag 'dzin gnyen por 'gro/ /rang zhe rang la ma khrel dpang po'i mchog /rkyen ngan lam longs gang shar blo sbyong gi /grogs su 'bad med 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /spyi don gsum bslabs mngon chung sems rgyud 'dul/ /rang rgyal gzhan pham g.yo rgyu'i bsam sbyor spong / /dag snang nyer sbyong chos kyi nga rgyal dang / /rlom sems bskyed pa'i bdud las spong bar shog /nyes 'phel bka' bkol go log snyan grags yus/ /gang che'i nyon mongs gnyen po gtso bor bsten/ /bzod brtan phyogs med rtag tu blo sbyong zhing / /rang rgyud chos dang zhu dag pher bar shog /don tshan bdun gyi lcags kyu non po yis/ /bdag sems glang po nye bar dul byas te/ /thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i gom stabs kyis/ /rnam mkhyen thar pa'i grong du bgrod par shog /ces rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal gyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i steng nas nyams khrid legs (130na)par nos pa'i brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni 'di nyid dang blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo legs bshad kun dus gsum par du brko ba'i tshe za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /lhar bcas skye rgu'i 'dren pa zas gtsang sras/ /rgyal ba'i sras mchog mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ /khri srong lde btsan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yis sras pos srad na legs 'jin yon/ /gsar bcad skad kyis gtan 'bebs khri ral pa/ /yid srubs gshed gyur lha lung dpal rdo rje/ /mnga' bdag 'od srungs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon cog bla mar 'dzin pa'i dpal 'khor btsan/ /bstan la nyer gus skyid lde nyi ma mgon/ /mnga' —343

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebadag chos kyi rgyal po bkra shis lde/ /lha yi bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor 'dzin skyong ba mnga' bdag lha yi lde/ /mang bkur rigs kyi btsun pa 'od lde'i zhabs/ /gangs can gnyen gyur lha gcig rtse lde'i mtshan/ /mnga' ris dgra bcom rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhu lhan shes rab grags/ /ra sa chu lhad dar ma rgyal mtshan rje/ /snar thang bstan pa'i nyi ma gro mo che/ /sangs rgyas sgom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyags kyi rig 'khrungs snying po rgyal mtshan dpal/ /mtshungs med spru lung kun dga' smon lam zhabs/ /spang khang bla ma grags pa dpal bzang po/ /zhang ston bsod grags rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna chas lung mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ /'jam (130ba po pa la dbyangs dngos rin cen rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /'dul 'dzin mchog gyur rgyal ba phyag na'i mtshan/ /kun dga' blo gros rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdom brtson chen po tshul khrims dpal 'byor dang / /'brul zhig kun bzang mthu stobs dpal 'bar rje/ /nges par thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ /dbang phyug rab brtan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan dpal/ /rab 'byams chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho dang / /mkhas grub blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rje'i mtshan/ /drin can bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan slar yang pa'i rtsa lag bo dhi sa twa yi/ /rigs dbon bo dhi satwa chung ba'i zhabs/ /za hor chos kyi rgyal po dge ba dpal/ di paṃ ka ra rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan pa'i srog shing lha btsun byang chub 'od/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa ti si chen po'i mtshan/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po zla rgyal rje/ /kong po lo tsā rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs dgra tshogs bcom pa rgyal mtshan rje/ /gya ba dbang por mdzes pa'i grags snyan 'bar/ /gya ba dpal mdzes sdom brtson brtul zhugs can/ /yon tan dbang phyug rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas btsun chen po shangs pa 'dul ba 'dzin/ /mkhan chen byang sems zhang ston 'di man brgyud pa gong ma dang gcig pas de'i khongs su 'thus bsod grags sogs/ /bde bar gshegs pa bdun gyi mdo chog gi /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sman bla'i mdo chog gi —344

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rem pa/ khobadaphyag 'tshal gyi skabs 'jug rgyu'i brgyud rim 'di ni shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor gyi slob dpon pa (131na)don grub rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag /rigs gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bor nges rnyed nas/ /mi phyed dad pas snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang mon pa a chog gis kha rtan du byed rgyu'i gsol 'debs shig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'o/ /mkhyen brtse nus par ldan pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bden pa gnyis dang ldan pa dam pa'i chos/ /rig dang grol ba'i dpal ldan dge 'dun la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs shing skyabs su mchi/ /dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum thugs rje ches/ /'di dang yang srid phyi ma thams cad du/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal tshogs kyis mi brdzi bar/ /sgo gsum rtag tu bde ba chen po la/ /spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por byin gyis rlobs/ /mtho ris rten mang brgyud par dam pa'i chos/ /nyams su blangs pas thar pa'i lam zhugs te/ /'gro kun 'dren par nus pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ring min mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang 'or du su gu ru dbang gis tshe 'di phyi gnyis la phan pa'i gsol 'debs shig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /mtshan dpe'i gzugs sku mthong dang tshangs dbyangs gsung / /lhan cig thos pa'i mod la srid zhi'i gdung / /rab gsal khyod thugs rnam mkhyen la sbyor ba/ /kun mkhyen nyi (131ba〉pa'i gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ khwa ri'i bu dang rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin/ /bram ze'i btsun pa rā hu la gupta/ /'phags mchog klu sgrub slob dpon legs ldan 'byed/ /dpal sbas ye shes snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /bo dhi sa twa sba rigs ratna'i mtshan/ shwakya mu ni g.yor po dge ba 'byung / /dgongs pa rab gsal spa gong ye shes g.yung / /grub pa ye shes rgyan la gsol ba 'debs/ /lnga/ mes tshul she rdo —345
