rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sherje rgyal mtshan dang / /sne po grags rgyan 'bre chen shes rab 'bar/ /brtson 'grus 'bar dang gzhon nu seng ge'i zhabs/ /gro ston bdud rtsi grags la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchims chen nam mkha' grags dang grags she ba/ /mchims ston blo bzang grags pa kun rgyal rje/ /grub pa shes rab paṇa chen dge 'dun grub/ /gnas rnying kun dga'i mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / /dge legs dpal bzang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ /dam chos yar 'phel blo bzang chos rgyan zhabs/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /ngan song gnas gsum sdug bsngal drag pos mnar/ /mi dang 'dod lha 'gyur ba'i duḥkhas gzir/ /gzugs dang gzugs med 'du byed 'ching bas bcings/ /'khor ba'i rang 'tshang mngon sum mthong bar shog /chos des bcos min yid 'byung nges pa lnga/ /yongs bral da chog sgo nas gsol bzhi'i las/ /'khrul med cho gas tshangs spyod dpal thob ste/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i mchog tu 'gyur bar shog /mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i bsod snyoms zas kyis 'tsho/ /(132na 〉 shing drung lcog bu tsam gyi gnas mal dang / /rnyed sla phyag dar khrod pa'i ngur smrig gos/ /gzhan gyis spyad zin dman la brten par shog /pham pa bzhi dang lhag ma bcu gsum grangs/ /spang ltung sum cu ltung byed bcu phrag dgu/ /sor bshags bzhi dang nyes byas brgya bcu gnyis/ /bag yod brtan pos tshul bzhin bsrung bar sgo thog /gzhan gyis khro dang mtshon sogs nye bar rdeg /gshe dang mtshang 'dru la sogs gnod kun la/ /dran shes brtan pos gnyen po legs bsten nas/ /rtag tu bzod pa'i go cha bgo bar shog /mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes la mchog tu dad/ /tshangs par mtshungs par spyod la gcig tu gus/ /sde snod lung la rab sbyangs bslab pa gsum/ /mngon par rtogs pas bdag rgyud phyug par sna rdzog /bag yod mthun pa'i rlung gis tshul khrims gzings/ /mngon mtho'i rin cen gling bgrod thar pa'i nor/ /lhag bsam rgyal mtshan rtse mor yongs bkod nas/ /'gro rnams phan bde'i 'dod dgus tshim byed shog /ces so thar sdom rgyun gyi brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po'i gter —346

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdagasar gyi rtsa ba'i chos bdag lnga'i nang tshan du zhang sna nam gyi sprul par lung gis zin pa rigs kyi gcung gnas lnga rig pa smra ba rgyal sras bstan me'i nyi mas bskul ba la brten nas paṇa chen dam chos yar 'phel gyis paṇa chen blo gros legs bzang la bsnyen par rdzogs/ des chos lung tshogs su bsnyen rdzogs mdzad kyang rjes su thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho sog yul du thegs khar bskyar sgrub mdzad par brten so so'i blo dang bstun pa'i brgyud pa gnyis ka 'dren pa 'dug na'ang sdom gsum rim (131ba)gyis nos na sngon ma stongs shing bsnyen rdzogs rkyang pa bsgrubs na phyi ma mi skye bas so thar gyi sdom pa gzugs can la sngags dang byang sems ltar brgyud gnyis 'dres mi 'thad pa'i phyir phyi ma btsan pa'i dbang du bgyis nas za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i gar sgyur don grub dpal/ /de dbon rab 'byams smon lam dpal ldan rje/ /mtshungs med kong ston chos kyi seng ge dang / /byang chub tshe brtan rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sdom brtson dam pa bsod nams bzang po dang / /bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i lha ri rtse/ /bshes gnyen dam pa chos kyi rnam par rgyal/ /dpal 'byor rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug nam mkha' 'byams pa'i 'khas/ /gdan gcig mkhan chen rin cen rgya mtsho dang / /gzhung brgya smra ba bsod nams bsam grub rje/ /blo bzang bstan 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mthu stobs mnga' bdag blo gros rin cen dang / /lugs zung rnam par spangs pa'i dge legs mtshan/ /rab 'byams smra ba rin cen rab rgyas dang / /blo bzang bstan 'phel rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /legs byas gter mdzod bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / /rgyal ba'i sras po blo bzang bstan 'dzin dpal/ /chos gling gdan rabs byon dang 'byon 'gyur gyi/ /yongs 'dzin bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes lam rim gsol 'debs kyi mjug tu 'dogs rgyu'i ri bo chos gling gi bla rabs kyi gsol 'debs 'di ni spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i —347

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheyi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o/ /(133na)khyab bdag bde chen snang mtha' yas pa'i 'od/ /thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul rnam rol pad dkar 'chang / /ma 'dris lus can kun gyi gnyen gcig pu/ /gang des 'gro la phan bde'i dpal stsol cig /lnga brgya'i dpung gnyen lha gcig mar me mdzad/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'brom ston rje/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa/ rje btsun bla ma'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsung ngag legs bshad dbang gi 'dod 'jo mkhan/ /med byung blo gros rgyas pa'i dpag bsam ljon/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'bras bus legs dud pa'i/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya chen rnam dpyod yangs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /mtsho byung thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor gang ba'i zla/ /rmongs mun snying la 'jigs pa ster byed pa'i/ /sngon med ri bong 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal gsung thos 'dzin lam du legs go ba'i/ /cha shas bdud rtsis thub pa'i lung rtogs bstan/ /rab rgyas bshad dang sgrub pa'i 'khor lo che/ /gser ldan lto bar bskor la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i lang long chu 'dzin las/ /mthu stobs gnam lcags rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /nag phyogs mi bsrun bdud sde'i dpung tshogs tsho/ /phye mar 'thag pa'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam zhing ches dul sdom brtson dam pa'i dpal/ /dbyangs can lha mos rjes su rab bzung nas/ /gtsug lag dga' ston bye ba'i zil dngar la/ /'dzad med longs su spyod der gsol ba 'debs/ /kun la rjes brtse'i sa bon (133ba〉spegs smin pas/ /ma 'dris mdza' ba'i bshes su gyur pa'i 'bras/ /'gro rnams phan bder spyod pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pas nam mkha' las/ /med byung thugs rje'i gru char babs pa yis/ /don gnyis 'dod pa'i myu gu legs smin te/ /phan bde snye ma'i dga' ston g.yur za shog /rdo rje'i ming dang ldan pa mi yi rje/ /'bangs dang bcas pa'i nad gdon bar chad bgegs/ /zhi zhing tshe dang bsod nams gong du 'phel/ /bsams pa'i don kun thams cad grub par —348—

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ khobadashog /skye ba kun tu mgon khyod nyam ring du/ /skyes nas dam pa'i chos la longs spyod de/ /rang gzhan kun gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob pa'i bkra shis rgya mtsho stsol/ /ces gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes e chir thu tha'i jis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes ra sa 'phrul snang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /ngag gi gter gyur dbang phyug dga' ma sogs/ /gsum 'gying mi zad blo gros gter bum las/ /bzang po'i shes rab char dus rgya mtsho ltar/ /rab 'phyur bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams zhing du mgon khyod ji srid bar/ /rnam par rab brtan bdag gi 'dod pa'i don/ /gegs med 'grub phyir byed po tshangs pas kyang / /rtag tu bsrung zhing skyong ba nyid gyur cig /ces pa yang star sdong rab 'byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang gi ngor bris/ngo bo ka dag chos sku snang mtha' yas/ /rang bzhin lhun grub (134na〉pongs sku dbang chen lha/ /thugs rje sprul sku'i rnam rol padma 'byung / /gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ /zab gter sgo 'byed rgya gong sangs rgyas dbang / /rin cen bdun brgyud nang chen skyer sgang pa/ /skar chung rgyal po 'dul mdzad gnyan ston par/ /gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes sangs rgyas ston pa'i 'khas/ /mkhas grub dbang phyug gtsag ma shangs ston pa/ /zab don rtogs pa mthar phyin rgyal mtshan 'bum/ /gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ chos drug gdams pa'i mnga' bdag 'jag chen pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma mkhas btsun 'od zer mtshan/ /byang chub sems 'byongs kun dga' chos rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ /nyams rtogs mthar phyin mon rdzong ras pa dang / /sku zhang mkhyen rab rin cen mchog grub rje/ /nges gsang bstan pa'i nyi ma rdo ring par/ /gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang tshar pa chos kyi rje/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug zhabs/ /'khor lo'i mgon po dbang phyug rab brtan la/ /gsol —349

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheb 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ /rigs kun khyab bdag rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba/ /rgyal kun ngo bo chos dbyings rang grol rje/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ /slar yang rgyal mtshan 'bum gyis rjes bzung tshul khrims mgon/ /ri khrod dbang phyug sangs rgyas seng ge'i zhabs/ /mtshungs med sprul sku sangs rgyas rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ /pha rgod mkhas grub thar pa dpal bzang po/ /drin can bla ma sangs rgyas rnam par rgyal/ /(134ba)tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho dpal bzang por/ /gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ /slar yang rgyal mtshan 'bum gyi thugs sras byams pa dpal/ /blo gros dpal bzang 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal/ /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan kun mkhyen sangs rgyas dpal/ /gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ /chos kyi spyan ldan rin cen rnam par rgyal/ /gzhung lugs brgya pa dngos grub dpal 'bar dang / /ru thog bla chen nam mkha' gzi brjid la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos thugs rje chos rgyal dang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug don yod rgyal mtshan dpal/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang kun dga' rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mkhyen rtse man gong gis 'thus/ khyung po tshul mgon nas/ mtsho'i sde/ /mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i yon tan mchog /mkhyen brtse nus ldan bsod nams rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ /gnyos ston lha btsun lha dbang rgya mtsho dang / /rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal 'byor lhun grub zhabs/ /chos dbyings rang grol drin can bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ /dbang bzhin byin rlabs tshul gyi smin byed chus/ /sgo gsum sdig sgrib bag chags kun bkrus nas/ rta mchog rol pa'i bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i lam/ /tshul bzhin nyams su bstar ba'i snod du shog /rdo rje'i bsrung 'khor bskal pa'i me gur nang / /dbang chen nga rgyal gsal snang brtan po las/ /nyer 'phrog rdo rje'i tsha tsha me —350

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdadapal gyis/ /yid srubs sder bcas phye mar 'thag par 3(ga /bgrang yas rgyal ba zhi khro sras bcas la/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung nyer bstibs pas/ /lus ngag yid la gzhi (135na)gsum byin rlabs dpung / /nyer zhugs dag pa'i snang bar 'byam klas 3|ga /dbang drag las kyi gzhan sde tshar gcod sdud/ /nad gdon rtsa ba sgrib gnyis drung nas zhi/ /bde chen ye shes rgyud la bskyed pa'i zhar/ /gnas skabs tshe dpal rnams kyang rgyas par shog /rtsa thig rlung gi rnal 'byor rdzogs rim lam/ /'od gsal snang bzhi rim bgrod rdzogs pa che/ /nyams su blangs te dbang chen kun tu bzang / /tshe 'dir mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'phags yul paṇa chen mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / /gangs can grub dbang chos kyi seng ge yi/ /smin grol 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i gdams pa la/ /brten nas mchog thun dngos grub char 'babs shog /ces rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni sngags ban yon tan dpal bzang gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson rig pa 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /gang thugs byams pa'i chu rgyun ma 'dris 'gro/ /kun khyab rnam dpyod shel la legs bshad tshon/ /rab bkra skal bzang gdul byar shis mdzad pa'i/ /mtshungs med dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes shar pa chos rje byams pa bkra shis kyi gsol 'debs 'di ni nyid kyi dbon po dge slong gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o/ /kun khyab kun bzang 'od mtshan stong 'bar mgon/ /'dzam gling che ba'i rig sngags 'chang ba'i mthus/ /'jigs med brtul zhugs spyod pa'i thod 'phreng (135ba)rtsal/ /gsol ba 'debs so nad gdon dgra bgegs bzlog /'phags yul rigs 'dzin brgyad sogs grub pa'i dbang / /gangs can mig gcig rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga/ /so zur gnubs rigs khyab bdag he ru dar/ gsol ba 'debs so nad gdon dgra bgegs bzlog /ja mchod kyi dus mchod pa 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ /mnga' bdag nyang ral chos kyi dbang phyug sogs/ /'khrul med zab gter sgo 'byed —35/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sherig pa 'dzin/ /bka' babs las can snying gi bu rnams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so nad gdon dgra bgegs bzlog /khri srong yang srid ye shes rol pa rtsal/ /rgyal dbang padma'i gdung 'tshob mnga' ris pa/ /legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje dpal bzang por/ /gsol ba 'debs so nad gdon dgra bgegs bzlog /thugs sras 'bri gung gnam lcags me 'bar rje/ /lang 'gro'i rnam sprul kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang / /chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sder/ /gsol ba 'debs so nad gdon dgra bgegs bzlog /dam nyams 'dres khyer dug chus bslad min par/ /smin grol bdud rtsis thugs kyi za ma tog /legs gtams stsol mdzad rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so nad gdon dgra bgegs bzlog /zhi khro kun 'dus bka' brgyad 'khor lo'i lha/ /legs ldan tshogs bdag 'bar ma ma ning dang / /dregs pa'i sde dpon dam can gter srung la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'dul byin rlobs/ /rang rig ka nas dag pa'i dbyings kyi ngang / /lhun grub rtsa gsum 'ja' ltar yongs shar ba'i/ /gnas lugs rang zhal mjal bas gsol mchod pa'i dus mchod byed na 'don pa bsgyur/ 'debs na/ /gdod nas bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs snying la sim/ /thag khrar sprul bzhin 'khrul ba'i sems kyi ngor/ /(136na skor ba'i bdag sogs rgyu sbyor yon mchod gyi/ /mi mthun nyes brgya'i sgyu ma'i rol rtsed kun/ /spros bral ngang du dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /swa la'i sman ljongs bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ /nad khrug phongs rgud dam sri 'byung po'i dpung / /khro rgyal gdangs pa'i zhal gyi hom khung du/ /nyer drangs ye shes me yis bsreg tu gsol/ /gnas skabs lha yi bde skyid dpal bzhin spyod/ /ring min rang rig rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal/ /mjal bar rtsa gsum tshogs kyi bdag byin rlobs/ /lam bzang 'di 'dra'i dga' ston e ma ho/ /zhes rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la gsol 'debs dang ja mchod gnyis kur bsgyur chog pa 'di ni khro char g.yul bzlog gtong ba'i sngags 'chang rnams kyi zhal 'don du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkha'o/ /'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i smra mkhas rnam dpyod kyi/ /bkra shis dung dkar mgrin par —352

bla ma rtse bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdegayas 'khyil ba'i/ /legs bshad snyan pa'i sgra yis gdul bya rnams/ /tshim mdzad dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes ri bo bde chen mkhan po 'jam dbyangs bkra shis kyi gsol 'debs 'di ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa mnga' ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bden pa gnyis dang ldan pa dam pa'i chos/ /rig dang grol ba'i dpal ster dge 'dun te/ /dkon cog rin cen gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag (136ba)dbang 'jam dpal ngur smrig gar bsgyur ba/ /blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /gangs can phan bde'i rgya mtshor chad med du/ /'bebs mdzad bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba sbom por skyed bsrings pa'i/ /bsod nams a mra'i nags klung sdug po'i tshal/ /legs byas ro brgya 'da' ba'i 'bras bu la/ /bdag sogs lus can kun gyis spyod par shog /ces pa 'di ni dpon sa bsod nams rgyal mos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar pa'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkha'o/ /'chi med snang ba mtha' yas sgrib bral spyan/ /'gro la nyer gzigs mtsho skyes bde chen sku/ /stong gzugs rang snang mtsho rgyal yum dang sbyor/ /pad 'byung rdo rje 'chang la mchod pa 'bul/ /'phrin las bsgrub par mkha' la 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /ma 'dres shar ba'i sku mdog phyag mtshan can/ /bde gshegs rigs lnga'i bdag nyid thod 'phreng rtsal/ /mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub gsol 'debs kyi dus 'don pa bsgyur/ ma lus stsol/ /gcig las du mar snang ba'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /ya mtshan mchog la mnga' brnyes padma 'byung / /thams cad mkhyen pa blo ldan mchog sred la/ /mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /'phrin las 'gro 'dul nyi ma 'od zer zhabs/ /mu stegs phyer 'thag seng ge'i sgra chen sgrogs/ /yon tan kun brnyes padma saṃ bha bar/ /mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub ma lus stsol/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa padma rgyal/ shwakya seng ge bdud sde zil gyis gnon/ /dregs pa tshar gcod rdo —353

rgyal dbang snga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sherje gro (137na tshe sgod la/ /mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /khro rgyal dbang chen rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i lha/ /dpal mgon ma ning bstan srung rgya mtsho'i gtso/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /kun kyang rang sems rol par nges rnyed nas/ /mchod bya mchod byed bral ba'i gshis lugs dang / /mig 'phrul ji bzhin nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo/ /legs par 'byed do bsam don 'grub byin rlobs/ /zhes ja mchod dang gsol ba 'debs gnyis gar bsgyur chog pa 'di ni lha ldan ru bzhi'i tshes bcu pa rnams kyi ngag 'don du zur gyi sngags 'chang gzhis ka shar pa a gur gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkha'o/ /bden gnyis don ldan dkon cog rin cen chos/ /tshul bzhin ston la rgyal kun spyi yi gzugs/ /bshes gnyen dam par rnam rol dngos brgyud kyi/ /yongs 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs la gus gsol 'debs/ /yangs pa'i gser ldan khyon la thub pa'i bstan/ /legs par de 'dzin tshogs rnams zhabs pad brtan/ /ma rgan 'gro rnams phan dang bde ba la/ /longs su spyod par mchog gsum mthus byin rlobs/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi gsung gsang bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /rab dkar shog bu'i za ma tog 'khyil bas/ /srid zhi'i legs tshogs 'chi med srog 'grub pa'i/ /mes po'i ngang tshul 'dzin pa'i dge legs stsol/ /'jam zhing ches dul dge sbyong chos bzhir ldan/ /dbyangs can mgrin par chags pa'i smra mkhas can/ /'gro la lhag bsam dkar ba'i grags pa'i sgra/ /kun khyab dpal ldan bla mar gsol (137ba)ba 'debs/ /'jam mgon btsong kha pa yi gsung rab rnams/ /dbyangs bdun rgyud du 'gyugs la zla med pas/ /dpyod ldan dga' ba skyed pa'i grags pa yis/ /legs byas yongs 'dzin dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i bsod nams mchod sdong du/ /mgon khyod bskal brgyar zhabs pad legs brtan cing / /deng nas byang chub snying po ma thob par/ /bshes gnyen dam pas 'bral med rjes 'dzin shog /ces chos rje pha bong kha pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i —354

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ khobadagasol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni drug brgya ba blo bzang dkon cog gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o/ /blo gros te se'i gtsug tor las babs pa'i/ /ma smad legs bshad yan lag brgyad ldan bdun/ /'dus pa rgya mtsho'i sgra 'dzin mdzes rgyan du/ /'debs mdzad bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /mang thos ngur smig 'chang ba ngang pa'i khyus/ /mgrin pa'i lam nas bden tshig glur len na/ /dge 'dun mi phyed mthu yis mgon po khyod/ /rab brtan chos kyi 'khor lo skor gyur cig /ces sgo mang slob dpon rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs 'di ni grwa tshang spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang rab brtan no/ /dkon cog gsum gyi 'phrin las thugs rgyud la/ /zhugs pas chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa'i/ /'jigs med seng ge'i khri la rab 'gying pa/ /dpal ldan skal bzang dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /byams mgon (138na)'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi lugs 'dzin pa/ shing rta che gnyis mdo dang sngags kyi gzhung / /'chad la smra ba'i rnam dpyod zla bral bas/ /rgyal brtan srid rtser 'degs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon bsags dag pa'i smon lam las 'phro'i mthus/ /blo bzang grags snyan 'bar ba'i bstan pa'i rgyun/ /mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo gros yangs pas mdo sngags gzhung la sbyangs/ /bzang po'i mdzad pas lhag bsam gcig tu dkar/ /dpal 'byor phun tshogs gzi byin rab 'bar ba/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i 'khas la gsol ba 'debs/ /thos pas mkhas shing tshul khrims dag pas btsun/ /byams pa'i thugs bskyed rab tu bkra bas bzang / /rnam gsum 'khor los rtag tu shis mdzad pa/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes rig sngags 'chang ba'i gtsug rgyan stod rgyud grwa tshang gi slob dpon rim pa lnga'i gsol 'debs 'di ni spyi tshogs kyi gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni thon blo bzang dbang phyug go /—355

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheblo chen mes po'i yul las nyer brgal ba'i/ /bzang po'i zhing sar legs btab sa bon tshogs/ /smin pa ye shes myu gu gzengs mtho'i rtser/ /sprul pa'i 'bras bu dud la gsol ba 'debs/ /ring nas nyer goms ma la ya klung nas/ /dam pa'i bag chags sad pa'i tsandan dri/ /skal ldan snying la sim pa'i dga' ston can/ /mtshungs med bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /dregs ldan gnag snum mgo (138ba〉skyes lan bu'i ngos/ /zhabs sen ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /mtha' klas gnyis skyes tshogs kyi snyim pa'i 'dab/ /zum mkhas dam pa'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgra kun bcom pa'i rgyal rnga brdung ba'i lha/ /sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i bden byin gyis/ /gdong lngas bteg pa'i rin cen 'phangs mtho'i khrir/ /bskal par mi g.yo g.yung drung ltar brtan shog /gang gi mdzad pa'i 'dab ldan bdag snying dbus/ /zhugs pa'i mod la gdung ba'i zla nang du/ /'gyur med dang ba'i ri bong nyer chud pas/ /khyod gsung ji bzhin bsgrub par bdag byin rlobs/ /'phrin las si tā'i lang tsho dar ba'i bzhin/ /mthong ba'i 'bod sgrogs yid srubs 'brul pa'i gdon/ /ma btab skal bar ldan pa'i dga' bskyed lhas/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i ri dwags zin gyur cig /chos nyid rang bzhin gdod nas stong tsam gyis/ /chos can rgyu 'bras bslu med nges rnyed phyir/ /khrims ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis yongs smin pa'i/ /re ba ji bzhin lhun gyis grub gyur cig /ces rje btsun mtshungs med sprul pa'i sku rin po che blo bzang ye shes kyi gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan dang bkra shis lhun po spyi sger gyi grwa tshang slob dpon rnams phyogs mthun du blo ka lnga tsam zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /'jam dbyangs rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ /bzhed gzhung skal bzang gdul byar legs 'doms (139na)par/ /rnam dpyod lhun gyis grub pa dge ba'i bshes/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes byes slob dpon 'jam dbyangs lhun grub kyi gsol 'debs 'di ni rab 'byams pa bsam gtan bzang pos bskul ba'i 356

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdengor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /'di phyi'i gtan mdun yongs 'du'i 'khri shing las/ /bde skyid 'bras bu gu ṇa'i zhal lung la/ /nges rnyed dad thob dngos brgyud bla ma'i drin/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /nyes brgya'i nad kun sel mdzad sman gyi bla/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas spyi gzugs padma 'byung / /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dpal ldan 'phreng / /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /sman rgyal mi yi rnam rol g.yu thog pa/ /gdams pa'i bka' babs sum ston ye shes gzungs/ /zab don mdzod 'chang gzhen nu ye shes la/ gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /gtsang ston chen po sangs rgyas rin cen dpal/ /mkhas btsun bla ma rin cen rdo rje'i zhabs/ /brang ti mang thos don grub rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /rigs chos 'dzin pa brang ti dkon cog skyabs/ /gnas lugs mngon gyur dpal ldan 'tsho byed dang / /zul phu sman mo tsha ba rin cen mtshan/ gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /rtogs pa'i bdag nyid bsod nams dbang po'i zhabs/ /mtshungs med dag pa rnal 'byor chen po dang / grub pa mchog brnyes ri khrod zhig po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ gso rig spel mkhas dkon cog chos kyi rje/ /zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje bstan pa'i srog /phrag dbon mtshungs med dkon cog dpal (139ba)bzang po/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug kong chen nam mkha' dpal/ /padma'i gdung 'tshob legs ldan rdo rje'i sde/ /sum ston rnam sprul bkra shis stobs kyi rgyal/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /byang bdag rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs/ /'khor lo'i mgon po chos dbyings rang sar grol/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhis rang rgyud smin/ /phyi nang gsang dril bla ma'i sgrub pa yis/ /bskyed rim phra rags gsal snang nga rgyal brtan/ /rigs 'dus sman rgyal rang ngo 'phrod par shog /sbyang gzhi rang —357

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shelus rtsa khams las rlung kun/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i gsang gsum rol gar du/ /nyams su bstar bas las bzhi lhun grub cing / /mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir thob par shog /sgru tī ro rkyang 'khor lo bzhi ldan la/ /'brul 'khor gnad kyi rtsa yig lam kun sbyangs/ /gzung 'dzin rnam rtog zag med bde dbyings dag /rang lus snang stong lha skur 'char bar shog /rdor bzlas la sogs rlung gis gtum mo spar/ /ngag gi sgra kun sngags kyi gdangs su shar/ /rmi lam rtsal 'byongs sprul sgyur sna tshogs ston/ /'chi ba 'od gsal btsan thabs zin par shog /gang snang 'dzin med sgyu ma'i rol par shar/ /med 'dir ma grol bar dor nyams 'og chud/ /yang na 'pho bas dag zhing myul ba 'am/ /grong du 'jug pas lam gyi 'phro 'thud shog /dbang rnon rmi lam man gyi nyams len la/ /bltos min las brgyar thig le dbab ldog gis/ /bcu drug dga' bzhi'i bde chen rab drangs nas/ /tshe gcig rang sems chos skur (140na)grol par shog /dben sar gang gi bskyed rdzogs lhur len tshe/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i gegs kun sel nus shing / /grangs med 'gro ba'i nad rnams sman dpyad kyis/ /drung 'byin phan bde'i dga' ston 'byed par shog /mthong thos reg pa'i rtags la ma bltos par/ /lha sman drang srong rig 'dzin rab bsgrubs pas/ /lkog gyur chos rnams pra dang mngon shes kyis/ /me long byad bzhin sgrib med mthong bar shog /zhang blon gtsor gyur dam can sde dgu yis/ /dgra bgegs ming gi lhag mar yongs btang nas/ /dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin tshogs/ /legs skyed yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel par shog /dkon cog thugs rje nam yang yol ba med/ /lha dang drang srong bden pa'i tshig la dbang / /bka' srung thogs rdugs med pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /bsams pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par shog /ces rigs 'dus sman rgyal gu ṇa'i zab chos snyan brgyud bka' rgya can g.yu thog snying thig gi brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni/ sum rtsen yul la 'gran pa nyang stod kyi cha'i dpon tshang dkyil spe ba blo bzang bzod pas chos 'di bka' rdzogs su nyan pa'i tshe bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /—358

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdarnam dag dad pa'i me long gtsang ma'i ngos/ /mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan yongs su bkra ba'i sku/ /mthong bas srid zhi'i gdung ba kun sel bar/ /gsol ba 'debs so rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog /mi (140ba)phyed dung ba'i rna bar thos pa'i mod/ /tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i gdangs su shar ba'i gsung / /phan dang bde ba'i dga' ston mchog sbyin mkhan/ /gsol ba 'debs so rdo rje'i gsung 'grub shog /snying nas mos ngor ji lta ji snyed chos/ /mngon sum mkhyen pas 'gro ba'i dbang bo dang / /'tsham par 'jug pa'i dri bral ye shes thugs/ /gsol ba 'debs so rdo rje'i thugs 'grub 3thog /ces sku gsung thugs la bstod pa zhig dgos zhes tshe ring gnam gyi rgyud las dad stobs kyi dbang phyug sirta shrīs rgyang ring po nas gsol ba btab pa la brten za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas pa lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /paṇa chen ga smi ra pa'i tshangs spyod dpal/ /rgyun bzang dri bral som nyi mdzes sdug lus/ /ngur smig gos rgyan dbang po'i gzhu ris kyis/ /nyer 'byud 'dren byed bdud rtsir gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'ang chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan brgyud kha skong du bris/dkon cog gser rdul spungs bstan bdag gir du/ /'dzin pa'i brgya dzaḥ yi ltor/ /legs byas ga tho yongs 'khyil rang mtshan kun/ /rab gsal rgya mtshor 'bab la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'ang ra ba stod brgyud 'debs kha skong du blo bzang dpal ldan gyi 'dod ngor bkod/ /sras bcas sangs rgyas slob ma'i tshogs rnams kun/ /gcig bsdus bshes gnyen dam par nges rnyed nas/ /mi phyed gsol ba 'debs na bdag gi rgyud/ /byin rlabs phan bde'i dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshe brtan (141na)rgyal mtshan gyi kha ton du bris/ /gsung ngag dbang chus blo yi za ma tog /yongs 'khyil dpal ldan skal pa bzang po can/ /rgya chen shes bya'i pha mtha' nyer 'jal bar mtsho byung mgrin 'khyud khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jigs med lha sngags ye shes go cha las/ /'jam mnyen mda' yis tshugs min thub bstan gyi/ /lang tsho dkar cha'i zla ltar rab 'phel sde/ /'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams byas 'bras spyi bo'i rmen pa las/ /—359

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shelegs skyes chos kyi rgyal po nga las nu'i/ /tshogs gnyis gser gyi 'khor los sku bzhi'i gling / /dbang sgyur 'gro kun 'dren par bdag 'gyur shog /ces pa 'di yang legs ldan rigs kyi thig le zhang po khro dpon pa kun dga' tshe brtan stobs rgyas kyi zhal 'don du bdag bstod smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos tshul phebs pa ltar za hor gyi ban rgan gyis bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /phung khams skye mched nam mkha'i grong khyer dbus/ /rang snying zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang cher/ /ma 'gags rig gdangs rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /dbyer med mtsho skyes rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /rnga yab gling phran srin pos yongs bkur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po che/ /dmi gu ru khro chags rol pa'i gar/ /legs mdzad brtul zhugs grub par gsol ba 'debs/ /rang rgyud nyon mongs dug lnga 'khrug pa'i gzugs/ /phyi rol bdud bzhir shar ba'i gnyen po sa /ldang nag rigs 'dzin (141ba〉sna phrin las drag po'i lha/ /yid srubs g.yul las rgyal der gsol ba 'debs/ /ban sngags lam log dam sri ru nga sogs/ /mi bsrun gdon bgegs 'byung po brtsegs pa'i brag /mthu stobs gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog gi mdas/ /phyer 'thag yang gsang drag por gsol ba 'debs/ /snang stong 'gog med chu nang zla ltar gsal/ /brtul zhugs brtan pos gang la'ang nyam mi nga / /lha sngags ye shes rol pa'i bdag nyid can/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa lam du longs par shog /'dzab bsnyen grags thengs rtags dang drod tshad rnyed/ /man ngag phra rags kun la nang byan chud/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las sbyor ba kun/ /thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par shog /snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor 'khor lor gsal/ /gang snang ma lus rang byung rang las shar/ /sems nyid blo 'das ka dag rig pa'i dbyings/ /lhun grub 'od lngar 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam bkra 'ja' gur 'khrigs pa padma 'od/ /rin cen gzhal yas mdzes pa mkha' 'gro'i gling / /skam rlon thod pa brtsegs pa srin po'i mkhar/ /gcig las du mar 'char ba dag pa'i zhing / /dran pas ngan song —360

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdagasum gyi sdug bsngal skyob/ /thos pas mngon mtho'i bde skyid dpal la sbyor/ /mthong bas srid pa'i mtsho las rnam grol ba/ /'di bas lhag pa'i mkha' spyod dmigs su med/ /de phyir tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags ma thag /'chi ba 'od gsal don gyi thod 'phreng rtsal/ /rang ngo 'phrod nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gnas/ /rigs 'dzin 'dus pa'i gral der skye bar shog /rtsa gsum byin rlabs (142na)lus phra'i 'gram pa'i chang / /mngar por 'thul ba bdag rgyud ba ku la'i/ /'dab ma yongs phye 'di phyi'i mdun ma yi/ /ze'u 'bru ba 'ad pa'i phun tshogs dga' ston shog /ces bla ma ga me gu ru dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs zangs mdog dpal rir skye ba'i smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes dngul gyi maṇḍal dang bcas/ gnang byung ba ngag dbang mkhyen brtses bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /kumā rā bā lha'i ra kā rnga te bhi su lha pra kā sha su tar nta sen/ /a tsa lub dzā sa na5sin tsā chusarba addhi ṣaṇa sirnyinahi/ /legs sbyar skad du bsgyur te sdeb sbyor nye dbang rdo rje bsgrigs pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni don grub rgya mtsho'i kha ton du dgos zer ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sug bris su bgyis so/ /ngag dbang zur phud lnga pa blo bzang (142ba)grags/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhir 'dzin pa/ /sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo sa /nges rnyed dang ba'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di ni tre bo rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkha'i kha ton du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'o/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams zhing / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba bzhad pa'i mtshan/ /rje btsun bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag dge 'dun nor bu bzang / /rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen 'phrin las rje/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtsug rgyan chos kyi grags/ /mtshungs med bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug blo gros rin cen zhabs/ /mdo rgyud mnga' bdag phun tshogs bzang po'i mtshan/ /sngags 'chang dbang po skyon bstan pa 'dzin/ /bshes gnyen dam pa gsum la gsol ba —361 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'adebs/ /sprul sku ngag dbang blo gros bzang po'i dpal/ /dge 'dun sde ni dar zhing rgyas mdzad dang / /blo gsal skal bzang dpal 'byor chos kyi rje/ /'dren mchog yongs 'dzin gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /legs byas rdul brtsegs man shel dwangs pa'i dngos/ /lus ngag yid gsum dge la rab dbang gzugs/ tan ra bas gdul bya'i re ba yongs skong ba/ /phun tshogs rgya mtsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum thugs rje'i mthus/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i mtshan pa'i gdan khri la/ /mgon khyod g.yo ba med par rtag bzhugs nas/ /bdag sogs 'dod pa'i don kun lhun grub shog /ces (143na)gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs rang rtsom zhig dgos zhes bla mar thar gling grwa dmangs rnams kyis bskul ba'i tshe 'dir slob dpon pas rgyu mtshan mol ba'i sgo nas bla brgyud gsol 'debs shig dgos tshul byung bar phan bde legs bshad gling pa nas mched pa'i le lag yin gshis de dang 'brel ba'i bla rabs brgyud 'debs da lta'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /blo ldan skye rgu'i bsod nams mthus bskrun pa/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas bzhi pa'i mdo rgyud bstan/ /rgyas mdzad grags pa phyogs bral rnar 'god la/ /'jam mgon btsong kha pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /'phags mchog 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can lha mo yis/ /rjes bzung rnam dpyod dpyod ldan yid 'phrog pa'i/ /gnas lnga rig gzhung gzhung brgya smra mkhas pa/ /ma 'dris skyabs mgon mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ /gser sbyangs zhwa yi cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan/ /skor gsum ru bzhi sgang drug rgya dang hor/ /che dgu'i 'dzin mar yongs su khyab mdzad pa/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /zhing khams 'di dang rdul snyed zhing gzhan du/ /'gro ba'i don phyir sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar/ /bsgyur rnams mya ngan 'da' bzhed gang mchis pa/ /bskal brgyar ma 'gyur bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /rang rgyud dag pa'i dbyig 'dzin ngos 'jam por/ /rnam smin dkar po'i rin cen spungs pa'i zong / /bsod nams shing rtas (143ba)drangs te thar pa'i grong / /ring por mi —362

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdathogs 'jug pa'i skal ldan shog /gsol 'debs smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes 'phyong rgyas spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtshos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /gtsug na padma nyi zla dar chen stan/ /brtsegs steng drin can rtsa ba'i yongs 'dzin dang / /dbyer med bla ma rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /gar dgu'i rol pa'i nyams kyis rtag tu bzhugs/ /bder gshegs sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams/ /che mchog a nu lus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /'dus pa'i rigs 'dzin bla med rdo rje rtsal/ /bgrang yas 'khor lo'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhi khro nas bzung mi bsrun 'byung po'i bar/ /ma lus phyag rgya'i cho 'phrul ji snyed pa/ /zil gnon dus dgra'i dbang phyug drag po rtsal/ /'jam dpal dgyes pa'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /bzang ngan bar ma'i 'khrul tshogs gang shar ba/ skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba ka dag dbyings/ /rang sar grol ba'i rig rtsal lhun grub gdangs/ /thod 'phreng rigs lngar shar la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje rang snang gzung mar bcas/ /byin rlabs zil dngar snying gi za ma tog /lan cig min par 'khyil nas dbugs dbyung ba/ /rdo rje thogs med rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgrin pa'i pad mtshor ngag dbang dbyangs can lha/ /legs bzhugs blo yi 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la/ /bzang po'i spobs pa dge ba'i mchog sbyin pa/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal kun yongs 'dus rnga yab gling pa la/ /gsol (144na)btab mthu las rdo rje'i slob dpon che/ /mgon po khyod bzhin 'pho ba chen po'i skur/ /bskal ba zhing gi rdul snyed brtan par shog /bzhi ldan 'khor lor rim shar yig 'bru gsum/ /hriḥm zhal sbyor 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ /sgo gsum sgrib dag dbang gis rgyud smin cing / /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu thob par bdag byin rlobs/ /phra rags gsal snang brtan pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ /bskyed pa'i rim bsgom bsnyen sgrub lam du longs/ /rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa thig rlung gsum la/ /bsnan pa'i rdzogs rim grol lam 'byongs par shog /rang sems don gyi rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams/ /gzhan nas mi —363

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'atshol rig pa'i ngo bo sa /thag chod rkang 'khyam rgyal po'i rnam thar bzhin/ /rdzogs chen lam gyis tshe gcig grol bar shog /dbang po dman pas rten 'dir ma grol na/ yang srid 'phrang ring kun tu rjes bzung nas/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i lam mchog la/ /bde bar 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan mdzad par shog /bla ma rigs 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /sgrub sde brgyad 'dus yi dam lha'i ngo bo/ /pho rgyud mo rgyud bstan srung rgya mtsho yis/ /phyogs dus kun tu dge ba'i bkra shis shog /ces rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rigs 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal dbyer med du gsol ba gdab cing rjes 'dzin smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes sngags btsun ngag dbang bzang pos bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /lus ngag yid kyis thub dbang (144ba)sde snod gsum/ /'dzin pa'i blo gtan skal bzang 'dzad med nor/ /rgya chen shes bya smra la mtsho byung mas/ /mgrin 'khyud 'jam dbyangs dgyes la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di yang rtses thang las chen pa blo bzang chos grags gyi ngor sbyar/ /ngag dbang 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa yis/ /ring lugs zab cing rgya che dbyar mtsho ltar/ /'phel mdzad 'jigs med smra ba'i go cha can/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di ni rgyud smad byang 'dren blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyi kha ton du sbyar/ /blo ldan yongs kyi dpal du skal bzang 'di'i/ /bdun pa rab gsal shākya shrī yi/ /gdan sar phun tshogs legs byas mthus grub pa/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i zha khas la garbe(la ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'ang gra rigs rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /bstan pa'i sgron me phyogs bcur spar mdzad pa/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlob tu gsol/ /zhes pa 'di yang bdar dka' bcus bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /oṃ su sti siddhi/ bde stong e waṃ zung 'jug chos sku'i gdangs/ /'og min zhing gtsor nges pa lnga —364

bla ma'i bstod chegs kyi rim pa/ (bdaldan pa/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' ngur smig gar/ /yongs bsgyur bu ston chos rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam kun mchog ldan bde chen rigs brgya'i bdag /stong nyid sna tshogs lha mor rtag rtse ba'i/ /(145na)dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i sde dpung mi yi gzugs/ ston mdzad rin cen grub la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa swa la'i ljongs/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen 'jig rten mig tags bya thams cad mkhyen pa rin cen grub/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i 'khas la gsol ba 'debs/ /legs sbyar rin cen smra la rnam par rgyal/ /bsod nams dpal gyis tshad ma lhun grub pa/ tags rab spyan gyis bzo rig 'bum sde gzigs/ /dngos slob yang rtse gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /ring 'tsho'i don yod gso rig 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /ye nas mdo sde shes pas don kun grub/ /rang rgyud dam chos dpal gyis 'dul mkhas bzang / /dngos slob yang rtse gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /mngon pa rin cen ma rig las sangs rgyas/ /dbang po rnon pos gar thig dbyangs la byang / /rgyud gsum gzhen nu nas sbyangs bsod nams 'bar/ /dngos slob yang rtse gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshul ldan khrims kyi snying po 'dus par mkhas/ /phyi nang g.yin gsum chos kyi dpal kun 'dzin/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam man ngag mchog tu grub/ dngos slob yang rtse gsum gsol ba 'debs/ /nyer gnas bshes gnyen 'jam dbyangs tshe dbang zung / /skyabs mchog bsod nams grub pa don grub dpal/ /bde rgyal mchod g.yog gtso bo gnas brtan bzhi/ /dam pa'i zham 'bring drug la gsol ba 'debs/ /gong gsal bzhi nas dge slong mi gcig pu/ /dpe gnyer gzims g.yog gtor gshom bsod nams grub/ /dam pa'i chos kyi dung 'bud rin cen skyabs/ /rim gror brtson mdzad (145ba tshe gnyis la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhan yang bu ston lugs 'dzin rim byon pa/ /snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar pa'i rgyal mtshan 'chang / /sku zhang bkra shis g.yas 'khyil rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /mtshungs med dam pa gnyis pa gsol ba 'debs/ /rin cen chos mkhas phun tshogs bsod nams 'phel/ /yid bzhin nor bu ltar bzang rin po che/ /rnam dpyod phul phyin zla ba dpal rin —365

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshesde/ /mtshungs med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /so rigs sngags 'chang mthu chen shākya dpal/ /'khrul rtog kun zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan bsgreng / /bka' bzhi'i rin cen thub bstan rgyal mtshan mdzes/ /mtshungs med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /mang thos rin cen dpal gyis mngon mthar grub/ /lha sngags ye shes rgya mtsho shar chen pa/ /mkhyen rab snyan grags rin can mchog tu grub/ /mtshungs med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig 'dzin skyo ston sngags 'chang rgyal po'i zhabs/ /thams cad mkhyen nges lo chen chos skyong bzang / /rin cen grub bstan rgyal po'i srid 'dzin mkhas/ /mtshungs med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku zhang rigs las rin cen mchog tu grub/ /rnam bkra bskyed rim shis pa'i dpal la 'byor/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus tshar pa rdo rje 'chang / /mtshungs med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /bstan pa'i me ro slong ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang / /ches dkon mchog gi lam bzang ston la mkhas/ /rang gzhan don kun lhun grub rgyal mtshan 'chang / /mtshungs med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dul ba'i bstan pas 'gro rnams skal bzang sbyor/ /byang gling bkra shis ston (146na)pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung / /rigs kun khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan rje/ /mtshungs med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khrul sangs yo gar blo rgyas tshe yi dpal/ shwakya'i bstan pa 'jigs med seng ge bzhin/ /rin cen chos kyi rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng g.yo/ /mtshungs med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan rdo rje sems/ khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog tu grub/ /phyogs 'dir lhag bsam tshes dkar dam chos kyi/ /bka' drin stsol mdzad gnyis la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun mkhyen bu ston ma dros mtsho chen las/ /slob brgyud bgrang yas chu bo mtha' klas pa/ /ma dag rnyog ma yongs bral byon zin dang / /slad mar 'byon 'gyur rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog gsum kun gyi ngo bo dngos brgyud kyi/ /dpal ldan bla ma gdan gsum tshang pa'i mgon/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i lha yi tshogs bcas la/ /gaṅgā'i klung rdul lus sprul gus phyag 'tshal/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo —366

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdaphye mchod pa dbul/ /phra rags sdig lhung nyes so cog kun bshags/ /dge tshogs gang gis bsgrubs kyang snying nas rang / /ston pa yongs la dam chos gsung bar bskul/ /zhi mthar mi gnas g.yung drung rtag brtan gsol/ /bsod nams byas rnams mkha' mnyam sems can gyi/ /byang chen 'thob pa'i rgyu ru legs bsngos pa/ /bsams pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub par 3|ga /srid gsum bcud kyi nya phyis yangs pa'i khog /thub bstan mu tig phyur bur nyer spungs pa/ /phan dang bde ba'i gdugs dkar grib med (146ba)du/ /'jig rten khams kun yongs su ngal gsor shog /rin cen grub pa'i ring lugs sa srungs dbang / /smin grol man ngag gser sbyangs rgyan spras nas/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i gom stabs lhod po mā /swā la'i sman ljongs gzhi la rgyu bar shog /sde 'di gud lus thugs rje brgya byin gtsug /reg pas bu ston bzhed srol lha gzugs su/ /bsgyur mdzad tshar chen yab sras bstan pa'i nyi/ /'od brgyas gling bzhi'i snang ba rgyas par shog /phyag rgya pa sogs sna tshogs chos kyi rag /ma 'dres rgya gar mkhas grub ring lugs gser/ /'di phyi bde skyed rin du brin pa'i zong / /gtan bde'i gling bgrod ded dpon chen gyur shog /rnam thos bu sogs rdo rje'i chos skyong ba/ /'phrin las spu sdug bkra ba'i mdongs mtha' la/ /zhon nas yid srubs mche ba drung phyungs te/ /rang bstan mtho ris 'dun sar gar byed shog /gnas skabs su yang rdzogs ldan skye rgu'i tshe/ /bsod nams dbang thang bgo bsha'i byar yod pas/ /rtsod pa'i gdung ba mngon sum lta ci zhig /rmi lam du yang myong bar mi 'gyur shog /lo chen bu la snying nas gsol 'debs rnams/ /yang srid kun tu dga' ldan zhing mchog der/ /mi pham mgon pos dbugs dbyungs rjes bzung ste/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pas dus 'dar shog /mchog gsum grub pa lha dang rig 'dzin tshogs/ /snyan pa'i glu len rol mo 'brol bzhin du/ /bkra shis me tog ma sgra ra yi char/ /'dzin ma'i khyon kun ma lus khyab par shog /ces dpal ldan zha lu pa'i bstan pa la bka' drin che ba'i dam pa rnams la gsol 'debs kyi tshigs su bcad pa padma rā ga'i 'phreng ba 'di'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mkhan rin po che tshe (147na)—367

rgyal dbang ྅ pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedabang lhun grub rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rgyal ba kun dngos bu ston chos kyi rje'i/ /gsung rab rin cen spel la rnam dpyod mchog /dpal ldan lhun gyis grub pa nga ge ba'i bshes/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab don 'byor ba blo dang brtson pa'i rin/ /'bad pa chen pos nyer khugs rgyal ba'i bstan/ /rgyal mdzad bzang po'i skal ba ldan pa'i rje/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'ang khyab bdag bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin za hor gyi brnyes bkod do/ /rnam 'dren blo bzang grags snyan 'bar ba'i bstan/ /'dzin la bsams bzhin sprul pa'i zlos gar can/ /mtshungs med rgyal ba'i sras po chos kyi rje/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /yang srid du mar mkhas dang grub pa yi/ /ma smad skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul bgrang yas las/ /thos pas rnam par grol ba'i sems dpa' che/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje'i sku la gzhom zhig mi mnga' yang / /bdag sogs gdul bya'i bsod nams zhang mchog tu/ /sku tshe 'od mtshan 'bar bar byin brlabs nas/ /thub bstan de srid mi g.yo zhabs brtan shog /ces rgyal ba'i sras po blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs dang bcas (147ba)pa 'di ni bsam blo rab 'byams pa grags pa shes rab kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /stan gcig 'dus rtser rin cen dbang rgyal char/ /legs bsngags dri bzhon gyis drangs chos kyi ljon/ /phun tshogs lo 'dab yongs dud rnam bkra'i 'bras/ /shis mdzad mkhas grub chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes jo stan mkhan brgyud kyi kha skongs 'di ni bskul ba po rnams kyi ngor za hor gyi bzhes bris/ /ngag gi dbang phyug yang dag dge ba'i bshes/ /legs pa'i lam ston blo gsal skal bzang mgon/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mkhas bla ma zung / /byang chub bar du 'bral med gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes mkhas btsun rgya mtshos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes bris/—368

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdangag dbang 'jam dpal blo bzang grags pa yi/ /ring lugs rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas nor 'dzin gzhir/ /spel mdzad rje btsun bla mar gsol 'debs na/ /skye bar rjes bzung byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ kha ton nyung ngu 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gnam gyi bu bzod pa yel deng gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/rgyal kun yab cig 'jam mgon btsong kha pa/ /rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan shing rta che/ /mkhas grub chen po dpal 'byor lhun grub zhabs/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag la smra ba'i spobs pa dge (148na)ba'i dbang / /ches dkon dad rten mchog gsum thugs rje'i mthus/ /legs rnyed bstan pa'i nyi ma sprul pa'i sku/ mtshungs med rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /yang gsang khros pa'i byin rlabs med po ches/ /mkhas snyan byes pa gra tshang yongs 'phel zhing / /bdag sogs skye bar gsung rab la sbyangs nas/ /ring min rnam pa thams cad mkhyen thob shog / gsol 'debs smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /gangs ljongs mdo rgyud bstan pa'i shing rta che/ /blo chen mkhas btsun bzang po'i grags pa can/ /mgon de'i rjes zhugs 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes/ /dbyer med rnam 'dren dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas btsun ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan rje/ /zab don rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod lha dbang pa/ /chos kyi dbang phyug ngag dbang dkon cog nyi/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba btsong kha pa dang nged kyi 'jug tu ba so sprul pa'i sku'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes gsang sngags mkhar pa rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams kyi ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /dal ba'i (148ba)rten la dam pa'i chos kyi don/ /bsgrubs pas phan bde 'bras bur yongs dbang bas/ /srid pa'i —369

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshergya mtshor bying ba'i 'gro rnams la/ /rjes brtse dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di'ang blo bzang dbang rgyal gyi ngor za hor gyi bzhes bris/rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor spro bsdu'i byed pa po/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid/ /che mchog zhi khro ma lus 'dus pa'i rtsal/ /dpal ldan bla ma gdan gsum tshang ba'i mgon/ /rang rig ye shes rig pa'i drag po rtsal/ /nyid las gzhan min dbyer med ro gcig pa/ /lha sngags ye shes yongs kyi 'byung gnas su/ /nges rnyed mi 'gyur sems kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /snying dbus gzhon nu dus skyer rtsa ba gsum/ /ngo bo ka dag chos che mchog lha/ zil gnon lha/ 'phrin las lha/ zhes gang dgos su bsgyur chog /sku bde ba che/ /rang bzhin lhun grub longs sku dngas ma'i rtsal/ /kun khyab thugs rje'i sprul skus bdag byin rlobs/ /phung khams skye mched 'ja' lus snang stong lha/ brjod pa rnam dag grag stong sngags kyi gdangs/ /gang shar gsal stong lhan skyes gnyug ma'i ga sa/ /mtha' klas dag pa'i 'khor lor 'char bar shog /chos nyid ye nas 'gyur ba med pa'i mthus/ /chos can kun rdzob tsam du mchog thun gyi/ /dngos grub 'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos par/ /'grub par mchog gsum thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma yi dam rang sems dang dbyer med du gsol ba 'debs tshul 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes sngags rams pa (149na)bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dge slong yon tan dpal bzang / dge slong dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ sngags rams pa blo bzang skyes mchog /blo bzang dpal 'byor/ blo bzang thabs mkhas/ gnyos kyi sngags 'chang gung ru ba dbang rgyal lhun grub rnams kyis bsnyen mtshams kyi dus bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /gsung ngag dbang chus blo gros bum pa bzang / /legs gtams rgya chen smin grol dbyar mtsho ltar/ /'phel la 'jigs med rnam dpyod go cha can/ /thub bstan lang tsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /byams pa mgon po mchog gi sprul pa'i skur/ /bstan min de srid shākya seng ge yi/ rdo rje —37//

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdatheg pa'i ring lugs rgyas mdzad pa/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /rang sems bla ma dgyes mdzad rdo rje dang / /dbyer med brjod bral lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /ye shes zung du 'jug pa'i bde ba che/ /lam bzang grub mtha' snyog par bdag byin rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di'ang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i smin grol gdams pa'i bang mdzod mdo pa chos rje dge ba'i dbang po'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rnam dag dad pa'i me long du/ /mchog gsum 'dus pa'i gzugs brnyan kun/ /yongs shar rje btsun bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di zla ba grags pa'i kha ton tu (149ba)bris/bka' pod bzhi sogs chos kyi 'chad nyan la/ /gcig tu brtson pa'i snyan grags ches 'bar bas/ /sras bcas rgyal bas legs so sbyin mdzad pa/ /mtshan nyid kun ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /blo gros skal bzang 'du ba'i rnam dpyod nyis/ /mtha' klas gdul bya'i padma bzhad pa las/ /thos dang bsam pa'i sbrang rtsi rab dngar ba/ /spel mdzad rdo rje lta bur brtan par shog /ces pa 'di'ang blo gros dpal 'byor gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/rdzu ya bha bo dzña ne tra su tsā darsha to dwa ya1khunta tāswā pa trokaḥ praḥni rma rtse te shā klu ba rje pas kirti bā grag dzasanā thedza ya/ /shes byar srid kun mkhyen spyan me long du/ /shar ba'i blo gros mkha' mtha'i brgal shong snod/ /sprul la tshangs pa brel nus mkhas btsun bzang / /grags pa srid pa'i rtser sgrog mgon de rgyal/ /mang mang sras bcas slob ma'i tshogs (150na〉rnams kyis/ /yang yang bskal bar bsams kyang khyod yon tshad/ /gsal gsal rtogs nus min na bdag 'dra yis/ /ngal ngal dka' thub bsnyen pa g.yar khral bzhin/ /ma lus sangs rgyas yongs kyi yab gcig pu/ /mi sogs rgyud lnga'i 'gro 'dren btsong kha pa'i/ /mu med rnam par thar las cha shas tsam/ /me tog mda' can 'joms pa'i ched du spel/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegasum thugs rjes yongs bskul las/ /rab rgyas phun tshogs dga' ston dar bar shog /ces mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis dpal ldan 'bras spungs su spyil bu lha dbang gling du 'dri rgyu dgos tshul byung ba ltar nged rang gi ming yig thebs pa'i kun 'khor /smi ra pa'i lugs su za hor gyi bande (151ba〉bzhad pa'i rdo rjes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bgyis pa sa rsha sirnyi bha skyi/ /smra ba ngag gi brjod pa rnam dag las/ /chos phung rgya mtshor dbang ba'i blo gros rtsal/ /don bzang tshig gi nyams 'gyur phyogs bral gyi/ /dpyod ldan rna bar 'jebs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya chen gting zab lnga rig gtsug lag kun/ /mtsho byung lha mo'i drin las nged rnyed las/ /rmongs pa'i g.yul las 'jigs pa med pa'i go /dkar cha'i nya ltar gang la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdud bzhi yongs thub zas gtsang sras kyi bstan/ /lung rtogs lang tsho dar ba'i rnam dpyod sdes/ /'jam dbyangs gzhen nu dga' ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /ris med 'gro ba'i 'dren par gsol ba 'debs/ kha tsam min par snying nas mgon khyod la/ /gsol 'debs dad pa'i 'od zer stong spros pas/ /thugs rje pad dkar ze'u 'bru ba 'ad pa las/ /byin rlabs dngar ba'i sbrang rtsi rtag stsol shog /yang srid kun tu mtho ris rten bzang rnyed/ /ring min mi 'jigs bzhi ldan mngon gyur nas/ /mtha' dang tshad du med pa'i ma rgan 'gro /'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por bdag 'gyur shog /ces pa 'di'ang gnam jing gir rgyal po'i rigs las dkon mchog gsum la bla mar 'dzin pa u chu mu chu che chen ching wang gis ched du dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /dpal ldan shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la/ /legs zhugs ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sdes/ /mchog (152na〉na sum 'dus pa'i ngo bor rab mos nas/ /mi phyed dang ba'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /snang srid thams cad ri mor nyer 'dri bar/ /sgyu ma'i khengs pa 'phrog pa tshangs pa'i spun/ /—374

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bkagatsug lag gnyis pa'i byed po sman thang pa/ /don kun grub la dang bas gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs dang sgyu rtsal yongs kyi rgyun 'dzin pa/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nur 'gran pa'i blo gros dang / /dpal ldan bkra shis gzigs mo tshar dngar ba'i/ /mchog sbyin mkhan la dang bas gsol ba 'debs/ /pir thogs dbang po blo bzang mtshan can dang / /phun tshogs yon tan ldan pa rgya mtsho'i sde/ /dkon mchog lhun gyis grub pa'i sdom brtson sogs/ /mkhas mchog rnams la dang bas gsol ba 'debs/ /sman thang rigs 'dzin ma dros mtsho chen las/ /ru bzhi'i rgyal khams yongs khyab ri mo ba rang bzos ma bslad gong ma'i srol bzang po/ /spel mdzad rnams la dang bas gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol btab kun bzang mchod sprin phul ba'i dges/ /su la'i ljongs 'dir sman thang lugs 'dzin pa'i/ /rig byed mkhan po dbyar mtsho'i rjes 'gro ba/ /bla nas blar 'phel phyogs rnams khyab par shog /bdag gis sras bcas rgyal ba slob ma'i tshogs/ /snang brnyan ri mor bgyis ba'i bsod nams kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri med rgyal po ltar/ /gyur te lus can mtha' dag 'dren par shog /ces sman lugs ri mo ba rnams la nye bar mkho ba gsol ba 'debs dang ja mchod gang 'dod du sgyur chog pa (152bshig dbu 'bring rag kha 'jam dbyangs dbang pos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bande 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /dpal dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus pa/ /rje ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho la/ /yid gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /thugs brtse bas byang chub bar du bzung / /zhes pa 'di thang ring chos rje blo bzang dge 'dun gyi ngor za hor gyi bzhes bkod/'od mtshan stong 'bar thub pa'i spyan snga sa /mkha' mnyam 'gro 'dren thugs bskyed pad dkar 'chang / /gru 'dzin la dgyes tshad med snying rje'i gter/ /rgyal sras dam pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /thag khrar sgrul snang the tshom drwa ba kun/ /rnam dpyod mtshon gyis rab bcad rtse gcig tu/ /sgrub pa'i ting 'dzin dam bca' ches brtan pa/ /bram ze'i rigs 'khrungs gsal bar gsol ba —375

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'adebs/ /dri med rig pa'i mkha' la dag pa'i nyi/ /sgrib byed gnyid rmugs le lo'i na bun tshogs/ /brtson pa'i rlung gis pha mthar yongs bskrad pa/ /rgyal bu chags pa med la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang lnga'i rgyu lam mi dge'i chom rkun tshogs/ /srung byed dran shes bag yod bya ra yis/ /dus drug rang gi rgyud la legs brtag pa/ /rgyal bu kun tu dga' la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyes par byas pa'i rang gi las rnams kun/ /sba gsang med bsgrags g.yin la dag snang gi /'khrul pas nongs la skyon du mi 'dzin pa/ /lha skyes (153na)rgyal bur gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang gi yon tan la bsnyems dregs pa'i skyon/ /nyer sbas gzhan gyi yon tan rdul tsam kyang / /lhun po ltar sgrub rgyal sras spyod pa can/ /dkon cog gsum gyi 'bangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang don lhur len ched du rnyed bkur dang / /gzhan las rgyal 'dod khe dang snyan grags sogs/ chos brgyad skyon gyis nam yang gos min pa/ /rgyal bu dad pa brtan la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang 'dod snying las chung ngur gyur pa yis/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs kun la chog shes shing / /byas la drin bzo dam pa'i spyod tshul can/ /dad pa rab tu brtan la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyi tshe'i gnyen la gdung ba tsam min par/ /sems can kun la byams dang snying rje yis/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub sems ldan pa/ /rgyal bu blo gros 'phel la gsol ba 'debs/ /lus ngag yid kyi las lam mi dge bcu'i/ /rgyu 'bras phra mor nges rnyed sdig ltung tshogs/ /nyer spangs rtag tu dad pa rab brtan pa/ /kun dga'i yid dbang 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhan khro rang mtho'i nga rgyal khengs pa rnams/ /rang nyid dman par lta bas nyer bcoms shing / /log 'tsho spangs nas chos la longs spyod pa/ /dge bsnyen sdom brtson btsun par gsol ba 'debs/ /e raṇḍa ltar snying po med pa yi/ /don med 'du 'dzi mtha' dag rgyang bsrings te/ /ma smad 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyis phyug pa/ /nor bu'i 'byung gnas bzang por gsol ba (153ba)'debs/ /rnam par g.yeng ba'i gzob las rab grol nas/ /mi dge las kyis dben pa'i dgon pa ru /bag yod tshul gyis rang rgyud 'dul mdzad pa/ /rmongs pa'i mun sel zla 376

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdabar gsol ba 'debs/ /sna tshogs mi dge mtha' dag bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /don med 'khyal ba'i tshig rnams spong pa'i ngag /dran dang shes bzhin brtan pos nyer bsdams pa/ /dgos 'dod rin cen snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma bkur zhing chos mig las dang por/ /ston par lta zhing dug lnga'i sems can rnams/ /pha ma bu tsha'i 'du shes bskyed mdzad pa/ /lhag bsam padma ltar dkar gsol ba 'debs/ /nag po'i las la rtag sbyor sdig pa'i grogs/ /ha la'i dug ltar nyer spangs dge ba'i bshes/ 'bral med gtsug gi rgyan na bsten mdzad pa/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer 'byed la gsol ba 'debs/ /sdang dang mi dge'i sems spangs bder 'gro zhing / /'khor bar 'khrid la 'dod chags rba klong las/ /mi sdug snying po'i rdzings kyis bgrod mdzad pa/ /sems can kun la khyab par gsol ba 'debs/ /bde ba'i chos la rtag tu nyer 'bad cing / /thog mar brtsams pa'i dam bca' gang yin de/ /rdo la bris pa'i ri mo ltar brtan pa/ /rgyal bu seng ge'i sgra la gsol ba 'debs/ khengs sems nga rgyal 'joms pa'i gnyen po sa /sdig la dga' ba med pa'i mthu brtas pas/ /bla ma'i gdams pa tshul bzhin dran mdzad pa/ /rgyal po bde ba'i mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /chags sdang yul rnams sgyu ma sprul bsgyur dang / /(154na〉sku snyan tshig kun brag ca lta bu'i sgra/ /gnod bya gnod byed las su nyer gzigs pa/ /lha yi rgyal por gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ khyim nas nyer phyungs bas mtha' dgon pa mā /ri dwags ro bzhin rang nyid nyer sbas nas/ /kun tu chags pa med par gnas mdzad pa/ /dge la 'dun blo 'phel la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtag tu yi dam brtan pos rkyen dbang du/ /mi gtong khro ba med par gzhan ngo bsrung / /sna tshogs thabs kyi don kun sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /sro long kun tu rgyu la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang gzhan chos la skur pa mi gdab cing / /nyin mtshan dus kun chos spyod rnam bcus 'da'/ /dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo mdzad pa'i/ /mi 'jigs skyabs sbyin rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /bgrang yas rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'brom ston rje/ /dge 'dun mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ bsod nams yon tan zhing gi rgya mtsho che/ /mtshungs med 'gro ba'i 'dren —377

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shepar gsol ba 'debs/ /sgoms pa'i snang ngor smig rgyu 'phrul po che/ /sgro btags gcam bu'i ming gis g.yin 'drid kyang / /'dod rgyal brda bral lnga rig rdul gyi cha/ /nyer mthong tshangs sras bshad par gsol ba 'debs/ /skyabs yul dam pa rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa phul/ /sgo gsum gyis bsags sdig lhung ma lus bshags/ /skye 'phags kun gyi dge la bdag yi rang / /rgyal sras nyan rang (154ba)chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /rtag tu mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba 'debs/ /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar bgyis pa'i/ /rnam dkar las rnams sangs rgyas thob gyur bsngo/ /sa lam spang rtogs mngon gyur byang sems dang / /so skye srid par zo chun ltar 'khor ba/ /chu dang 'o ma ji bzhin ro gcig par/ /gsol 'bras 'di phyi'i mdun ma 'grub par shog /lha chos bdun ldan ngo bo bka' gdams pa'i/ /bstan pa rin cen srid mthar rab rgyas shing / /'jig rten gsum gyi skye rgu ma lus pa/ /bde skyid dpal la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces glegs bam rin po che'i bu chos le'u nyer gnyis kyi 'brungs rabs dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes a mdo men ju chos rdzong dkar dgon pa ba rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs 'od zer gyis bskul bar brten khye'u gsal ba 'o skol gyi ston pa mya ngan las 'das rjes su byung zhing / dkon cog 'bangs srong btsan sgam po'i skye ba snga ma yan lag dang / lha'i rgyal po bstan pa 'di'i sngon rol du byung ba sogs go rim la gtan tshigs kyis bsgrub rgyu mi 'dug kyang le'u'i 'gros dang bstun snyan ngag gi sbyor ba gtso bor ma byas par zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba'i dgongs don bzhin 'bol rtsom gyi tshul du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bsam mthong ngag rig phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /gzhung brgya smra ba ngag dbang dpal bzang po/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho'i sgo ru legs par zhugs/ /ngag brjod sna tshogs la dbang blo gros bzang / /(155na)don yod rgyal mtshan bzhi la gsol ba 'debs/ /yangs pa'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho lta bur zab/ /dge 'dun gtsug na snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar/ /legs par 'chad mkhas don kun lhun grub pa/ yongs 'dzin bla ma gsum la gsol ba —378

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bka'adebs/ /zhes blo gsal gling bla brgyud kyi kha skongs 'di ni rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs 'od zer gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes bris/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan dkyus zhags pas shes bya'i mtha'/ /bcings tshe blo chen mes po'i khengs pa yang / /thung ngur byed nus mkhas btsun bzang po yi/ /grags pas sa steng khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ /smra ba'i spobs pa gzengs mtho 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dga' ba'i mdza' bshes gnyen gyur mgrin mtsho'i dbus/ /tshangs sras lha mo bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i mtshon/ /rmongs chen drwa ba gcod la gsol ba 'debs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /rgya chen 'dod khams 'dzin mar dbyar mtsho bzhin/ /spel la gzhom med snying stobs go cha can/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i 'khas la gsol ba 'debs/ /slar yang phyogs 'di'i 'dren par ngag gi dbang / /bgrang yas skal par bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /phung po 'bad rtsol bral bar lhun grub pa/ /mtshungs med sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdo stod lus can mang po'i dpung gnyen du/ /mgon khyod rdo rje'i khri la rtag brtan par/ /smon lam rtse gcig btab pa'i re ba kun/ /(155ba)'grub par dkon cog gsum gyi byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa 'di ni bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis kyi sku skye grags pa chos 'dzin gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /gru 'dzin la dgyes phyag na pad dkar 'chang / /dkon cog gsum gyi 'bangs gyur sa spyod dbang / /gangs can skye rgu'i gnyen gcig srong btsan rjer/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /tshangs pa lha yi me tog khri srong zhabs/ /bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes po rgyal ba 'brom/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag sa skya par/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyi gzigs/ /zab gter bye ba'i sgo 'byed nyang ral rje/ /chos kun thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ /dge 'dun rgya mtsho dbyangs can grub pa'i ster/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyi gzigs/ /sa gsum mgon po bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /yon tan rgya mtsho bde chen chos kyi —379

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shergyal/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen dpal bzang por/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /yid ches dang bas gsol ba rtse gcig tu/ /btab 'bras 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ma lus pa/ /'grub pa'i thugs rje snying la rab 'jug par/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes pa 'di'ang thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho yan chad sprul pa'i rol gar du gor ma chag mod/ (156na)rang blo rang la lkog tu ma gyur pas rang ngos nas bzhugs gral du dog 'tshangs kyis rlom sems med na'ang mdo stod chos rje/ sog dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling gi bla ma blo bzang bdud 'joms gyi ngo ma bzlog par za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ /mchog gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsol 'debs na/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes bzung nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /zhes pa'ang dgon thang pa dgos pa rdo rje'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes bkod/su sti pra dzā saḥ yang srid mang por rab dkar rnam smin chus/ /lusang ga yid gyi dri ma nyer bkrus pas/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan blo bzang grags pa'i bstan/ /rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /ris bral 'gro 'dren khur la mi 'jigs pas/ /gcig tu mgon med dman par brtse ba'i go /cha nas rdzogs pa dkar cha'i zla ba ltar/ /phan bde'i kunda bzhad la gsol ba 'debs/ /'og min zhing du nyon mongs shes sgrib dgra/ /nyer thub mchog sprul zlos gar ma ga dhar/ /legs bstan rnam gsum chos 'khor rgyud mang glu /skal ldan rna bar mngar la gsol ba 'debs/ /thos dang bsam pa'i bcud kyis bskyed bsrings pas/ /rab sgom lang tsho'i dar drag don gnyis sde/ /rnam bzhi'i sgo 'phar skye rgu'i gsos sman du/ /'byed mdzad rje btsun bla mar gsol ba (156bskor de bas//yangs pa'i blo la 'jam dbyangs nyer dga' ba'i/ /rnam dag brjod mkhas gtam gyis gdul bya'i tshogs/ mngon mtho nges legs sar bkri bshes gnyen mchog /mtshungs med yongs 'dzin dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /mgrin mtshor tshangs sras ngang mo rab bzhad pa'i/ /glu dbyangs rdo rjes rmongs —380

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdabrag phyer 'thag tshe/ /gdong drug rnam dpyod la bsnyems rig pa'i 'phrul/ /lang tsho'i cho ga rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i bdag nyid gar gyi dbang / /tshe byin yid bzhin 'khor lo rgyal yum mar/ /tshe lo brgyad khrir spyod dang rjes mthun par/ /tshe yi dngos grub stsal nas brtan byin rlobs/ /bkra yul rje'i thu/shis g.yang du chags pa bsod nams la/ /dbang phyug ba dur dpa' bo'i rgyud bltams rigs kyi sras tha'i ji/ /tshe 'dir skyid pa'i nyi ma gnam gyi gung / shar ba'i bde drod tshor ba rtag myong shog /dus gsum bsags dge'i grib ma skye srid 'phrang / /mtho dman bar mar 'phur rjes 'brangs pa'i 'bras/ /dal 'byor rten la don ldan snying po sa /blangs nas myang 'das grong du bgrod par shog /legs ldan myur mdzad ma hā kā la che/ /lha chen nyi ma'i bu dang re ma ti/ /dpal mgon bdun cu la sogs dkar po'i phyogs/ /skyong byed rnams kyis mthun rkyen sgrub par shog /gang gis lam bstan rgyud la gos pa'i skyabs/ /legs grub bden pa rten 'brel bslu med pas/ /smon pa'i re ba mtha' dag skong ba yis/ /dga' ston dpal (157na〉pa longs spyod bkra shis shog /ces gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni yul ji'i thu bā dur tha'i rje'i rgyun gyi ngag 'don du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /legs byas phun tshogs kyis bskrun dam chos dang / /rab mjal dal ba'i rten la thos bsam gyi/ /don ldan snying por bsgrub pa'i yongs 'dzin rje/ /rig pa'i dbang phyug dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'ang ra ba stod brgyud pa'i kha skongs su drung chen phun tshogs chos ldan gyi gsol 'debs 'di ni nye gnas kyi ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /blo ldan yongs kyi btud bya bskal bzang 'di'i/ /bzhi pa lhar bcas skye rgu'i mgon po yi/ /bstan la nyer zhugs thos bsam rgyan mdzes pa /mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes dkyil khang bla ma blo bzang mgon po'i gsol 'debs dgos tshul ltar za hor bzhes bris/—381 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shen maḥ sarba lgi/ don kun grub pa dpal ldan shākya'i rgyal/ khres rab mchog gyur 'phags pa shā ri'i bu/ /gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan 'dzin pa la/ /gsol 'debs khrims kyis rang rgyud dul bar shog /bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs pa sa ra ha/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal mgon klu sgrub zhabs/ /rtsa she'i dgongs 'grel gu ṇa mi tra la/ /gsol 'debs khrims kyis rang rgyud dul bar shog /gnas lnga mkhyen pa rin cen bshes gnyen dpal/ /srid (157ba)gsum zla bral gnas brtan chos skyong zhabs/ /slob dpon chen po gu ṇa pa ti la/ /gsol 'debs khrims kyis rang rgyud dul bar shogarig gnas kun gzigs chos kyi phreng ba dang / /mkhas pa'i dbang po 'byung gnas sbas pa'i rje/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag chen po shākya'i rgyal/ gsol 'debs khrims kyis rang rgyud dul bar shog 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos sa skya lo tsā ba/ khang ston chen po 'od zer rgyal mtshan dpal/ /mnyam med bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol 'debs khrims kyis rang rgyud dul bar shog /mthu stobs lang tsho dar drag gzungs kyi dpal/ /tshul khrims ngad ldan dge legs bzang po dang / /mkhas grub chen po kun dga' blo gros la/ /gsol 'debs khrims kyis rang rgyud dul bar shog /thub bstan gsal mdzad byams pa chos rin cen/ /de dbon khrims gtsang brtson 'grus rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /mtshungs med chos rgyal mkhan chen dpal 'byor la/ /gsol 'debs khrims kyis rang rgyud dul bar lha thog /zla bral nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gnyag phu ba/ /dge lung bla chen nam mkha' dbang phyug dpal/ /gnas brtan chen po sangs rgyas 'od zer la/ /gsol 'debs khrims kyis rang rgyud dul bar shog /dbyangs can ba 'ad pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i sde/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen byams phrug pa/rgya chen mang thos grags pa rnam rgyal la/ /gsol 'debs khrims kyis rang rgyud dul bar shog /'dul 'dzin byams pa bsod nams bkra shis dpal/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyi ma zha lu pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sder zhes bsgyur/ mkhan chen chos kyi rjer/ /gsol 'debs khrims kyis rang rgyud dul bar shog /'jigs skyobs legs smon tsam min 'khor ba kun/ /me 'obs —382

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (ba)ltar mthong nges 'byung bser bu yis/ /nyer drangs tshul khrims tsandan dri 'thul zhar/ /srid pa'i tsha gdung (158na〉pa lus sel bar shog /yon tan phun tshogs mkhan slob dge 'dun dbus/ /'khrul med las kyi cho ga la brten nas/ /tshe rabs kun tu shākya'i bstan pa la/ /rab zhugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal thob shog /mngon par mtho ba'i rin cen them skas la/ /'dzegs nas rang blo rang 'tsham myang 'das kyi/ /rnam gsum khang par zhugs nas gtan 'dun rnams/ /lhun grub dga' ston mchog la spyod par shog /bag yod nor 'dzin gzhir btsugs rtsa ba dang / /yal 'dab spang gnyen 'khrul med g.yur za ba/ /so thar bstan pa'i 'bras bu ro brgya'i bcud/ /thar 'dod 'chi med spyad byar dar drag shog /rtags tsam 'dzin la re ba mi 'cha' bar/ khrims ldan dran gso'i ngur smrig gos mdangs kyis/ /'chi med lam gyi kha dog sgyur nus pa/ /srid mtha'i bar du 'phel ba'i bkra shis lha/ga /zhes so thar sdom brgyud kyi gsol 'debs 'di ni don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bka'i gnang ba thob pa la brten nas shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor sa pho rta'i lo nags pa'i dkar cha'i rgyal ba gsum pa la rang byung 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa bstan 'dzin dbang po'o/ /gang shar rang sar grol ba rig pa'i gdangs/ /che mchog 'dus pa dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso/ /dus dgra'i dbang po zil (158ba)gnon ba'ad pa rtsal/ /lhun grub rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /snying dbus 'dab brgya'i ke sa ra yi rtser/ /mgon khyod 'chi med sku gsum rigs 'dus lha/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor rtag bzhugs nas/ /kun bzang rang ngo 'phrod min rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa'ang sngags ban ngag dbang rgya mtsho'i kha rtan tu dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bandes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med pa dang / /dbyer med gcig tu snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /skye bar 'bral med rjes su nyer bzung ste/ /'di dang gtan —383—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegyi mdun ma lhun grub shog /ces pa'ang dge slong blo bzang kun dga'i 'dod pa ltar za hor gyi bandes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni sngags rams pa'o/ /blo ldan mkhas btsun bzang po'i dpal 'od 'bar/ /byams pas 'gro la bkra shis dge legs stsol/ /dge 'dun 'dus tshogs gtsug na grags pa'i sgra/ /ches gsal rnam gsum bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba'i yon tan kun la mkhyen dpyod dang / /brtson pas rab 'dun mkhas grub grags pa yis/ /yongs khyab bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rjeli khri la g.yo med brtan par shog /ces pa 'di'ang gsang ba 'dus pa'i dge 'dun dkon cog stod rgyud mkhas 'dus gra tshang gi dbu mdzad blo bzang dge legs/ dge bskos blo bzang rin cen sogs spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bandes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags (159na)rams pa'o/ /nor 'dzin ma 'di mtshan bzang 'khor lo'i zhabs/ /bkod pa'i mod la phun tshogs 'dod don kun/ /lhun grub gser gyi mdog can lha yi lha/ /mnyam med zas gtsang sras por gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod bstan gangs ldan dpal mo'i bzhin ras su/ /legs bshad gnad gsang lta ba'i spyan gyi dkyus/ /rnam dpyod smin ma'i nags klung ring po yis/ /khyab mdzad a ti sha la gsol ba 'debs/ /yi dam 'phags pas lung bstan ji bzhin du/ /lha chos bdun gyi ring lugs bka' gdams zhes/ /dar mdzad lag na pad dkar dge bsnyen tshul/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'khas la gsol ba 'debs/ /thos bsam phung po'i ljid kyi ljags ring po/ /rngul ba'i legs bshad chu bo rnam pa bzhi/ /thub bstan rgya mtshor 'bab mdzad btsong kha pa/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /skor gsum ru bzhi sbar gsum chen po hor/ /'dul dka'i 'gro 'dren snying stobs rlabs po cher/ /sbyong ba'i rgyal sras bsod nams bya ba'i zhing / /rgya mtsho'i gos mthar spel la gsol ba 'debs/ ngag gi rgyud las 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i glu/ /'dren la nyer dbang blo gros gar mkhan bro/ /thub bstan do rar bsgyur tshe skal bzang kun/ /'od kyi brtan pa 'phrog la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab —384—

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ khobadedang rgya che gtsug lag ma lus ma/ /mtsho byung tshangs pa'i lha mo'i bka' drin las/ /rnyed pa rgol ngan tshogs la 'jigs med pa'i/ /spobs pa dge (159ba)ba'i go char gsol ba 'debs/ /bdud bzhi kun thub shākya seng ge'i bstan/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i lang tsho dar drag pas/ /ris med skye rgur phan bde'i sgo 'phar brgya/ /'byed mdzad mchog gi sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi bsrun stobs rnams 'phrog byed gdong pa lngas/ /gyen btegs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i khri chen por/ /gzhom med g.yung drung lta bur rab brtan par/ /dkon cog thugs rje'i dpung bskyed dge legs stsol/ /bdag sogs ston zla ltar dkar dag pa'i sems/ khri/gas drag yongs btab smon lam a mra'i 'bras/ /smin pa'i ro bda'i zas la nyi 'og gi /lus can mtha' dag longs su spyod par shog /tshe mtha' yas dang yid bzhin 'khor lo ma/ /rnam par rgyal sogs 'chi med grub rnams kyis/ /byin rlobs zil mngar chad pa med pa'i rgyun/ /snying gi za ma tog tu 'khyil bar shog /sgang gsum stod snang yul gru rab yangs par/ /dge ldan lugs 'dzin gser mdog zhwa yi 'od/ /legs gsal bshad sgrub ljon pa'i grib bsil du/ /'gro kun bde ba'i ngal gsor spyod par shog /dga' bde'i dpal ldan gnam bskos pho brang che'i/ khrims gnyis bka' btags btsan po'i gser gyi shing / /rgya hor bod dang bod chen gnya' ba sa /rab lcis skyid pa'i nyi ma dgung 'char shog /phyogs 'dir dge 'dun sde rgyas yid can rnams/ /dus kyi chad pa legs bral 'bru bcud tshong / /rin cen gter kha la sogs 'dod dgu kun/ /rdzogs ldan gnyis pa'i dga' ston la spyod shog /ston dang de'i gsung (160na〉skrub po gtan gyi skyabs/ /'chi med drang srong bden pa'i tshig la dbang / /khyad par myur mdzad mgon po ma he'i zhal/ /'dod khams dbang mos bsam don lhun grub mdzod/ /ces gsol 'debs smon lam gyi rim pa blo ka kha yar yod pa zhig khams phyogs kyi chos sde tshor 'dzugs rtsis yin pas dgos tshul 'ba' lhun grub rab brtan gyi rdzong sdod 'bri lung legs ldan phun tshogs kyis byung ba dang / slar de dang mthun par mi nyag dgon gsar dga' ldan chos gling bla ma nyag re blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba la —385

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebarten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad kun rig khyab bdag che/ /phyag na rdo rje rgyal po rab gsal zla/ /sgra gcan 'dzin dang slob dpon kun snying la/ /gsol ba 'debs so ngan song sbyong byin rlobs/ pra dzñā wa li bra dzñā bo dhi dang / /mu lha ko ṣa dharma pā la'i zhabs/ /dī paṃ kā ra do pa sgom chen la/ /gsol ba 'debs so ngan song sbyong byin rlobs/ /skyi nor dzñā na nyi ma shes rab dang / /snur chen nyi 'od rdo rje seng ge gshen/ /glan ston chos 'byung shākya 'bum pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so ngan song sbyong byin rlobs/ /'dzim pa rin she yang rtse rin cen seng / /kun mkhyen bu ston thugs sras lo tsā ba/ /nam mkha' mchog grub rin cen dpal grub la/ /gsol ba 'debs so ngan song sbyong byin rlobs/ /mkhyen rab chos rje gnas brtan chos legs pa/ /bstan bzang byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpal rin cen rgyal mtshan la/ /(160ba)gsol ba 'debs so ngan song sbyong byin rlobs/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa'i srog shing che/ /khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub dang / /smin grol lam ston rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so ngan song sbyong byin rlobs/ /ngan song rnam par sbyong ba'i rgyud chen por/ /bsgrub cing mchod pa'i ga bur zegs ma yis/ /brnag dka' sdug bsngal tsha gdung kun bcil te/ /gnas skabs mtho ris rten bzang rnyed par shog /srid pa'i chu gter che las sgrol ba'i gru/ /rdor sems thugs rje'i rlung gis nyer bskyod nas/ /ma smad nges legs rin cen gling yangs por/ /nyer bgrod skal pa bzang por bdag 'gyur shog /'dis mtshon bsod nams byas pa'i phung po kun/ /nam mkha'i mtha' yis 'jal dka' ma gyur 'gro /lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku'i go 'phang che/ /ring min mngon du 'gyur ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbang gi brgyud pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub kyi bar du nye bar byon pa'i brgyud tshul bzhin ngag dbang legs mchog gi skye rtags su lo lo bzhin kun rig stong rtsa gtong dgos tshul ltar btsugs pa'i tshe bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge —386

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ khobadaslong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /brjod pa nyer gtsang ngag la rab dbang blo'i/ /bzang po'i bag chags mthu brtas rgya chen gzhung / /mtsho ltar gting zab smra bar spobs pa can/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam dag blo yis bzang po'i smon lam gyi/ /sa bon btab pa'i yal 'dab dar drag rtser/ /(161na)thos bsam 'bras bu rab rgyas dga' ston che/ /spel mdzad yongs 'dzin bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes nged rang dang sde drug mkhan po blo bzang dar rgyas kyi gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs dgos tshul nyi thang gnyal pa'i gra rgyun rnams kyis bskul ba ltar brtan bzhugs byed na zhabs brtan shog la bsgyur chog rtsis kyi za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /bde ldan mgon gyi sras mchog pad dkar 'chang / /spel pa'i gar mkhan rgyal bu 'jig rten dbang / /thub dbang spyan sngar khye'u snang ba'i 'khas/ /sgrub pa lhur len gsal bar gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyid rmugs le lo rab spangs chags pa med/ /dran shes bag yod rgyal bu kun tu dga'/ /rang gi nyes pa mi gsang lha skyes khas/ /rtse ldan dkon cog 'bangs la gsol ba 'debs//rnyed bkur khe dregs spangs pa'i dad pa brtan/ /byas la drin bzo dad pa rab tu brtan/ /byang chub sems kyis rgyud dal blo gros 'jal/ /dad ldan dga' 'dzin zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dman cha blangs pa'i dge bsnyen btsun pa'i zhabs/ /'phags pa'i yon tan mnga' ba nor bu bzang /'du 'dzi ma lus spangs pa'i zla ba dang / /bag yod rin cen snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /kun la dad ba'i sems 'chang padma'i mtshan/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i 'od zer zhabs/ /chags sogs mi dge yongs spangs byams pa che/ /brtson ldan seng ge'i sgra la gsol ba 'debs/ /(161ba)bla ma'i gdams ngag dran pa'i bde ba mchog /sgyu ma sprul par shes pa lha'i rgyal po/ /bas mtha' dgon par gnas pa'i dge 'dun 'phel/ /yid brtan sro long kun sgyur gsol ba 'debs/ /—387—
