rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'aphags nor bdun ldan rgyal po skyabs sbyin dang / /bod yul mi rje'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan/ /thub bstan dbu brnyes tho ri snyan shal zhabs/ /mnga' bdag srong btsan sgam por gsol ba 'debs/ /ting 'dzin g.yo med khri srong lde'u btsan/ /dge 'dun gtsug mchod khri lde srong btsan dang / /chos rgyal byang chub sems dpal dge ba dpal/ kha che dgon pa ba la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' gdams mes po rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dpal/ /'khor lo'i mgon po snying po'i mtshan can zhabs/ /rtogs pa'i bdag nyid 'gro mgon g.yu brag pa/ /gter chen mnga' bdag nyang la gsol ba 'debs/ /gso rig rgya mtsho'i mthar son dge ba 'bum/ /gnas lnga mkhyen pa padma badzra dang / /chos kun mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug dge 'dun grub/ /dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen brtse nus mnga' bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /bde chen chos kyi rgyal po dpal bzang po/ /dam pa rnams dang las smon yongs 'brel ba/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /pad rtsa ltar dkar dang bas bskrun pa'i dges/ /mgon khyod ma dag 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen du/ /tshe mtha' yas pa ji bzhin nam mkha'i mtha'/ /rnyed min de srid g.yung drung (162na〉gu brnyes shog /deng nas bla med byang chub ma thob bar/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyod dang mi 'bral zhing / /gnas skabs tshe dpal stobs 'byor dbang thang kun/ /dkar cha'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog /spyi dang khyad par mnyam med btsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid zung 'brel bstan pa dbang gi rgyal/ /'dzam gling yongs kyi rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nas/ /bde skyid 'dod dgu'i char gyis tshim par shog /'jig rten gsum gyi dga' tshal ra ba mā /dkon cog bden pa'i tshig gi bkra shis glu/ /a mra'i 'khri shing rab rgyas 'bras bu la/ /longs su nyer spyod skal bzang thob par shog /de yang glegs bam rin po che'i le'u nyer gnyis po nas gsungs pa rnams zhus lan nor bu'i 'phreng ba'i rtsa tshig la brten/ rngog gis dri ba zhus pa'i lan du mdzad pa las snga phyi'i go rim la nges pa med cing / gnya' khri btsan po man chad kyang thugs rgyud gcig pa sogs las yang srid snga phyi'i dus 'grig mi 'grig sna tshogs gtan tshigs kyiba'i—388

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdabasgrub dka' ba the tshom mi 'tshal zhing :sto ka rer bla ma bzhi re tshang ba'i gsol 'debs rin cen 'phreng mdzes smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni dpal grong sngags rams la gsol dpon ngag dbang dge legs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa'ang bskul ba po nyid do/ /rab 'byams gzhung brgya smra ba ngag gi dbang / /rnam dkar 'phrin las lhun gyis yongs grub dpal/ /thar pa'i lam gyi sa mkhan dge ba'i bshes/ /mtshungs (162ba)med rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod bdag sogs gdul bya'i bsod nams zhing / /rdo rje'i khri la mi g.yo rtag brtan cing / /zab dang rgya che'i chos 'khor legs bskor nas/ /smin grol lam gyi 'jug pa mthar phyin shog /ces slob dpon ngag dbang 'phrin las lhun grub kyi grwa rigs rnams kyis 'di lta bu zhig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/mi phyed dad pa'i me long dngas gsal ngos/ /rje btsun bla ma'i snang brnyan yongs shar bar/ /rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs na byang chub bar/ /'bral med rjes su 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ /ces pa'ang er kha paṇḍi ta'i mchis 'brang su dhi'i kha don du bris/gur kum mdog can dhiḥ yig ljags steng nas/ /zhu ba'i rang gi brjod pa ral gri'i rtses/ /rmongs pa'i dra ba gcod la dbang phyug blo/ /gser mngal can gyi rjes 'gror gsol ba 'debs/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas bzhi pa shākya'i rgyal/ /zab dang rgya che'i sde snod rin cen gsum/ /'dzin pa'i rnam dpyod dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel pas/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /smin byed dbang las byung ba'i rang byung gi /ye shes don gyi phyag rgya chen po'i lam/ /mngon gyur de srid 'bral med rjes bzung nas/ /mi 'jigs bzhi ldan go 'phang la spyod shog /ces pa 'di'ang mkhan chen ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi zhal 'don du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /(163na)rgyal kun ngo bo blo bzang grags snyan bstan/ /'dzin par bsod nams sa bon dar drag —389

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shelas/ /ye shes mchog gi yongs 'du sa brtol rtser/ /sprul sku'i 'bras bzang smin la gsol ba 'debs/ /sa chen rab 'byor rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas sa skya lo tsā sogs/ /'phags bod mkhas grub yang srid mu thi la/ /thugs bskyed srad bur brgyus la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshan dpe'i sku yis mthong ba don dang ldan/ tshangs pa'i gsung gi thos rnams rnam par grol/ /kun gzigs thugs kyis dran reg rjes 'dzin pa/ /'gro 'dren ded dpon chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /yon tan mi zad gangs can ri bo nas/ /'phrin las 'khor mtha' chad med gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /phan bde'i rgya mtsho tshangs pa'i yul sa'i bar/ /'phyur mdzad bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /'chad la brjod pa snyan 'jibs dbyig gi gnyen/ /rtsod ngag rgol ngan tshar gcod chos kyi grags/ /rtsom pa'i spobs pa sa spyod dge dbang gi /grib mar bltos min mched zlar gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen rab ral gris dpung mdzes 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ris med 'gro la rjes brtse pad dkar 'chang / /yid srubs sde bcas gnyen por mthu chen thob/ /rigs gsum sgyu dra'i gar la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kun ma lus mkhyen pas mkhas rtser son/ /bag yod tsandan ngad 'thul btsun pa'i mchog /bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i lhag bsam (163ba)bzang po'i gar/ /skal ldan 'gro ngor bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /lus can bsod nams nor 'dzin yangs pa'i stor/ /lung rtogs shing rtas mngon mtho nges legs nor/ /'dren la sras bcas rgyal bas mgrin gcig tu/ /rab bsngags me tog 'thor la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsang gsum rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzad pa'i gzugs/ khong snod srid 'dir ma rnyed nam mkha'i mtha'/ /brgal dogs mes pos dgu tshigs ska rags kyis/ /'ching ba'i sgyu thabs bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rje ga tpā ra yi zegs ma'i rdul/ /'bum phrag 'dzag pa zla ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i kunda rab ba 'ad pa'i/ /mtshungs med rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /gdong lngas legs bteg rdo rjes nyer mtshan khrir/ /'og min zhing gtso'i longs spyod rdzogs sku bzhin/ /'khor ba mtha' can de srid zhabs pad —390

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ khobakazung / /rab brtan 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /chos dkar legs byas drang srong chu lha'i bus/ /bdag sogs sgo gsum nyal 'gro'i dri ma kun/ /nyer bkrus khyod gsung yan lag brgyad ldan chur/ /rtag tu spyod pa'i skal bzang rnyed par shog /khyon yangs sa chen dum bu bcu gnyis la/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i 'dus pa thog ma sa /skyes te dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud rgyal gyi/ /smin grol bdud rtsi ngoms med 'thung bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rgyal srid la mnga' sgyur ba blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal (164na〉zang po'i sprul pa'i sku blo bzang ye shes la gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs su za hor gyi bzhes dang ba'i yid gyi sgo nas bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /snang mtha'i mgon la brten nas zab rgyas kyi/ /chos phung rgya mtshor thos bsam rtser son te/ /thub bstan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel mdzad pa/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di'ang thos bsam gling grwa tshogs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o /snang ba mtha' yas sras kyi thu bo mchog /phyag na pad dkar 'dzin pas rjes bzung nas/ /tshe rabs mang por bag chags yongs sad pa/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs//shākya (164ba)seng ge'i mdo rgyud gsung rab dang / /tha snyad gtsug lag rig pa'i gnas mang por//dpyad gsum rnam par dag pas legs thos pa/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs//mtha' klas shes byar srid pa'i chos tshul gyi/ /gnas lugs kun la zhib mor nyer bsam pas /zhabrul bral ji bzhin yid ngor rab shar ba/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /g.yo med zhi gnas chu nang lhag mthong gzugs/ /rab gsal bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/ /rnal 'byor mchog la legs bsgoms nyams myong can/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /thub gzhung spyi dang khyad par 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /ngur smrig zlos gar blo bzang grags pa yi/ /—391—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedagongs don 'grel la 'chad brtsod rtsom mkhas pa/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /ma dul rang rgyud glang po'i sna zhags la/ /tshul ldan khrims kyi lcags kyu rnon po yis//nyer btab bag yod btsun pa'i ngang tshul can/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /ris su ma chad skye rgu mtha' dag la/ /phan 'dod lhag bsam bzang po ston dus kyi/ /ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor ltar dkar ba/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sder/ /mi phyed snying nas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /'di phyi gtan gyi mdun ma mtha' klas pa/ /re ba ji bzhin 'grub par bdag byin rlobs/ /dkon cog thugs rje'i nam mkha' cher yangs las/ /byin rlabs char gyis zhing sa yongs brlan pa'i/ /'byung gnas gdan gsum tshang ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di'ang bstan pa rin po che la mi phyed pa'i dad stobs kyi dbang phyug dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu rgyal pos blo ka thams cad la nged rang gi ming sgra tshang ba'i gsol ba 'debs/ mang nyung 'tsham pa gra tshang gsar rnying tshor yang btsugs chog pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ma mdzad pa ltar shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa dza ( / /(165na)'a karma ra pa'i paṇa chen seng ge'i khrir/ /blo gros rab yangs mkhas btsun bzang po yi/ /lung rtogs bstan pa 'phel mdzad dge ba'i bshes/ /mkhan chen rnams kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/zhes chu mig mkhan chen blo bzang bstan 'phel gyi gsol 'debs 'di ni blo bzang bstan dar gyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar/o rgyan mkhan pos rjes bzung lha'i me tog /sku sprul mthu stobs nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdud sde'i mun 'joms 'khor 'das phyag rgya kun/ /zil gnon drag po rtsal la gsol ba 'debs//gsung sprul theg dgu'i chos kyi bang mdzod la/ /dbang phyug smin grol gdams pa'i gter sgo brgya/ /—392

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdarab phye skal bzang gdul byar 'byed mdzad pa/ /gang shar rang sar grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs sprul padma rgyal po'i ye shesakyi/ /rol ba'i sgyu 'phrul paṇa chen thugs rje'i gzugs/ /yid kyi me long ngos su rtag shar ba/ /bla med rdo rje rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /yon tan sprul pa mkha' 'gro 'phrin las kun/ /yongs su grub pas bgrang yas zhi dang khro'i/ /mchog mthun legs tshogs ma lus lhun grub pa/ /che mchog 'dus pa rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /'phrin las sprul pa'i mi bzad ches snyigs 'gror/ /nyer 'jug pad 'byung yab yum zhal lung las/ /rdo rje thogs med rtsal du dbugs byung ba/ g.yung drung srog gi ka ba rab (165ba〉brtan shog /sgra sgyur bee ro'i yang srid rin cen 'phreng //spel las khyad par lnga bdo'i dpung gnyen du/ /nyer byon rnga yab gling pa'i bka' gter bstan/ /srog mthud 'gyur med rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs bcud zab gter gyi/ /bdag por lung zin ji bzhin 'dzam gling gi /sgron mer sngon bzhengs dbang khrid man ngag lung / /gangs can padma'i rgyan du dar bar shog /slad mar dus rtags rten 'byung mi bslu bas/ /rang nor skal bar rje 'bangs smon lam mthu/ /btsan pos 'phyugs med gdan drangs phan bde'i nyi/ /ljongs 'dir rtag 'char ched du zhabs brtan shog /spyi dang khyad par mtsho skyes bi mā la/ /rma gnyags so zur gnubs gsum gong 'og gnyis/ /bcu gcig gling pas mtshon pa bka' gter bstan/ /lnga brgya phrag bcur rdzogs min rgyas par shog /dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang che'i/ /srid skyong mi dbang mnga' thang sku tshe brtan/ /lugs zung khrims kyi ra ba chol ka gsum/ /bde skyid rdzogs ldan dpal bzhin spyod par shog /'di don gnyer bdag rdo rje'i slob dpon gyis/ /skye bar rjes bzung thos bsam sgom pa'i mthus/ /ring min 'khreg chod thod rgal lan gyi sna/ /zin nas 'pho ba chen po'i sku thob shog /ces sprul sku rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pa'i zham ring pa ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis brjod don 'di lta bu yod pa'i kha ton byed rgyu zhig dgos zhes don gnyer chen pos skul ba (166na skor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'i/ /—393

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shengag dbang 'dod 'jo dbang phyug brgyad ldan pa/ /blo bzang grags bstan rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas gzhir/ /spel mdzad 'jam dbyangs gzhen nu dga' ba'i bshes/ /lus can kun gyi gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /brjod pa yongs dag ngag la dbang ba'i mtshon/ /rnon pos phas rgol g.yul las rnam rgyal ba/ /gdul bya'i re ba skong la dpag bsam ljon/ mtshungs med rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs skye rgu'i mgon du dam pa'i zhabs/ /g.yung drung lta bur mi 'gyur rab brtan cing / /sbe ser chos grwa 'khor lo rnam gsum gyi/ /sgo nas srid mthar dar rgyas gong 'phel shog /ces spe ser bla spyi thun mong nas bskul ma byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rgyal kun gsang ba sngags kyi mdzod chen po'i/ /mnga' bdag bka' rnams ma lus sdud mdzad pa/ /phyag na rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon gdengs nas/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya gar shar phyogs ka pi la yi grong / /chos ldan rgyal po'i srid 'dzin 'gro ba bzang / /bal yul sa spyod dharma pa la zhes/ /thub bstan gsal bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /kong po shu la'i nye 'dabs ju lang klu'i/ /rigs 'khrungs longs spyod lha yi 'byor par 'gran/ /yar klung thang ring (166ba)bon po rā dza shrī'i/ /sras gyur dge bcu spyod la gsol ba 'debs/ nyi ma'i brgyud 'brungs ljangs tsha lha dbon kyi/ /yang srid rgya gar nub phyogs rigs ldan rgyal/ /gyur tshe mu stegs phal cher nang pa yi/ /bstan par thabs kyis btsud la gsol ba 'debs/ kha che khri stan rnam dag dge slong gi /khrims ldan spyan ras gzigs kyis rjes su bzung / /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas su lha yi bur/ /sngon gyi las 'phros gzung la gsol ba 'debs/ /ri grong rnal 'byor chos kyi seng ge sa /gyur tshe drag sngags mthu yi snyan pa thob/ /nags khrod ba tsor skyes tshe ma ṇi'i sgra/ /bgrangs pas dge stobs 'phel la gsol ba 'debs/ /tsha ba rong du gla ba dkar po'i lus/ /blangs te gnyan gyi nang las 'gro mang gsol/ /mnga' ris khyim bdag byang chub bzang po zhes/ /gsang bdag grub pa —394

bla mje bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdabarnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ rgyal chen ris bzhi'i lha ru gyur pa'i tshe/ khro bo'i skad las gsang sngags sgra chen thos/ /ding ma'i mkhan po snga 'gyur zab chos la/ /nyams len snying por mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ khud bu dpon chen seng ge che mchog dang / /sngags srung e ka dzā zhis rjes su bzung / /rnga yab srin po'i bu ru 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ /pad 'byung thugs rje zhugs la gsol ba 'debs//gsang sngags rnying ma bka' gdams zung 'jug tu/ /mkhas grub nam mkha' rgyal mtshan phyag rdor dngos/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rigs brgya'i mgon/ /dge 'dun bkra shis zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i bstan pa rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /'phel (167na〉pa log par 'dren pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /mthu stobs nus pas 'joms mdzad rdo rje 'dzin/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ rnam dkar dge tshogs la 'dun gdul bya rnams/ /'dren par dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid la/ /dbang phyug mtshungs pa med pa sprul pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /theg pa che chung dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtsor/ /chos 'khor bskor la rgyal sras gsang ba'i bdag /rnam 'phrul tshe mtha' yas pa'i dbang phyug bzhin/ /'gyur med rdo rje'i khri la zhabs brtan shog /ces rje drung rin po che dge 'dun bstan pa rgya mtsho'i sprul sku dge 'dun chos rgyal dbang phyug gi 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa 'di ni rab 'byams pa blo bzang dbang pos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /brjod pa rnam dag ngag la dbang phyug par/ /dhīḥ yig zhun blo gur kum bzang po'i mdog /rnam dpyod ral gris log rtog drwa ba kun/ /gcod mdzad yongs 'dzin mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /mang thos dpung pas bteg pa'i ༄ la steng / /rgya chen drang nges gtsug lag pusta ka/ /ma 'dres 'byed la mgrin par mtsho byung mas/ /legs bshad yi wang 'khrol la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jig tshogs log ltas ma gos yod med kyi/ /mtha' bral klu sgrub dgongs don 'khrul med go /cha shas gang bas —395

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshezla ltar rab gsal ba/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes (167ba〉pa gsol ba 'debs/ /sgrib gnyis dgra tshogs kun thub zas gtsang sras/ /bstan pa'i snying po kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /lung rtogs lang tsho dar ba'i bzhin ras kyis/ /spyod ldan 'gugs pa'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i mthu dang bden tshig gis/ /mgon khyod rdo rjes mtshan pa'i khri chen por/ /ma pham mgon po dbus 'gyur byon min bar/ /g.yo med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /thu btsun 'od gsal lha yi gdung son pa/ /mi dbang sras dang rigs brgyud mnga' thang kun/ dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel lho phyogs nor 'dzin gyi/ /thig le mdzes pa'i rgyan du 'gyur bar shog /e dbyibs chos lung dkar po'i rgyal khams kyi/ /khrims ldan ngur smig 'chang ba'i sde rnams su/ /klog pa thos bsam spong ba bsam gtan dang / /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo dar bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang 'od gsal 'chi ba med pa'i gdung las lha btsun ngag dbang blo bzang lhun grub kyi gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /ngag gi dbang phyug chos 'phel dge ba'i bshes/ /smra ba zla med chos rgyal bkra shis 'khas/ /dbyangs can mgrin chags blo bzang mkhas shing btsun/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam dpyod zla bral mthu stobs dpal 'byor mgon/ /yum don sgron me blo bzang bstan 'dzin dpal/ /byams pa'i gzhung la blo (168na)gros kun gsal ba/ /mang thos bshes gnyen gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /dga' ldan gsung rab rgya mtsho'i bang mdzod 'dzin/ /blo gros rab yangs skal bzang don kun grub/ /blo bzang bstan pa rin cen 'dzin mkhas pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes dwags po grwa tshang gi bla brgyud kha skongs su lha btsun ngag dbang blo bzang lhun grub kyi gsung gi bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /don kun grub pa dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /'brom ston 'jam mgon btsong kha pa la —396

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdasogs/ /dam pa mang por las kya 'brel thogs pa/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs//legs bshad rgyud mangs mgrin pa'i 'o mtsho sa /chad med 'brol ba'i tshangs sras ngang mo dkar/ /mchu sgros 'dzum gyis bsus nas yongs ba 'ad pa/ /rdo rje'i spobs pa thob la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs gyis/ /tshe 'dir nad gdon bar chad kun zhi zhing / /phyi mar lha mi'i rten bzang nyer brgyud nas/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur 'thob shog /ces pa'ang chos bkra shis kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang dbang po'o/ /tshe rabs du mar 'jam dbyangs byin rlabs kyi/ /bdud rtsi snying la sim pa'i dga' ston gyis//ris med 'gro ba'i bshes dang gnyen gyur (168ba)pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'ang tshul khrims bkra shis kyi ngor za hor gyi bzhes bris/na mo badzra ḍā ki nai/ rigs kun khyab bdag bcom ldan rdo rje sems/ /rgyal ba'i yum mchog rje btsun rnal 'byor ma/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sgo 'byed a bha yar/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /nges gsang bstan pa'i nyi ma dpe med bsrung / /dkyil 'khor bye ba'i mdzod 'dzin rnam bshad lha/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag shākya shrī la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/de dbon mkhas grub bhu mi hri'i zhabs/ /rgyal ba'i sras po dri med dpal bzang po/ /mang mkhar lo chen byang chub seng ge la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ skyi ston chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ /kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan dol po la/ /sa bzang paṇa chen blo gros rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /kṛ ya'i gsal byed da chu ṇa ā tsarya/ /rgyud sde'i bka' babs sa manta bhra dra/ /yi dam rjes bzung ye shes glog 'od la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ shrī hā nu manta mkhas pa'i mchog /chos spyan yangs pa 'jam dpal bzang po'i zhabs/ /paṇa grub chen po dpal ldan bzang po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mgon po glog bzang dang / 'gro ba'i 'dren pa yid kyi —397

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshe'atsho ba bzang / /'chad rtsod rtsom la ngag gi dpal bzang rjer/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /smin grol lam ston rnam rgyal bzang po dang / /rnal 'byor spyod pa myos byed bzang po'i zhabs/ /skye rgu'i (169na)gnyen gcig phun tshogs bzang po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro 'dren bzang po rje/ /mkhas shing grub brnyes chu yi 'tsho ba bzung / /'jigs pa med pa 'phrog byed bzang po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /skal ldan 'dul bya'i dpal gyur bzang po'i zhabs/ /skye rgu kun dga'i 'tsho ba bzang po rje/ /bal po'i paṇa grub ma hā bo dhi la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol//chu bo gnyis 'dus sa bzang gzhen nu blo/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang ngor chen e waṃ pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin cen la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /mkhas pa'i rtser son sangs rgyas rin cen dpal/ /rgyal kun ngo bo lha mchog seng ge'i zhabs/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu dkon cog lhun grub rjer/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /thar pa rtse pa mkhas grub nam mkha' dpal/ /'jam mgon kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub zhabs/ ti shes bya kun gzigs ngag dbang chos grags la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /'khor lo'i mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan zhabs/ /ngag dbang blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /gsang ba sngags kyi rab 'byams nam bzang la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/mang thos dpyod ldan blo bzang skyes gos spungs su thos pa rnamasang ga dbang dpal bzang zhes bsgyur/ mchog zhabs/ /sprul sku ngag dbang bstan bla ma gzhan la thob na gang thob kyi 'don pa bsgyur/ 'dzin 'phrin las rje/ /bka' drin mtshungs med bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /bya spyod dkyil 'khor chen por smin byed chus/ /sgo gsum dri ma ma lus kun bkrus nas/ /mtshan bcas mtshan med rnal 'byor zab mo'i lam/ /ring min mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor (169ba)rgyud rgyal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /nyon mongs lnga dag ye shes lnga yi dbang / /rten dang —398

bla ma 'i bstod tshegs kyi rim pa/ (bkabarten pa spro bsdu'i byed po sa /mnga' sgyur rdo rje sems dngos 'grub par shog /sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi sa bon tshogs/ /yongs su btab pas snyigs dus tshe gcig la/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i 'chang gi lam bzang po/ /mngon gyur lus can mtha' dag 'dren par shog /khyad par rdo rje btsun mo'i lung bstan bzhin/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas 'gro ba'i me long gis/ /legs stsal 'phrad pa skor gsum kri ya yi/ /rnam dag bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /phun tshogs bsod nams nyer rgyas sa bon las/ /dar ba'i dge legs ma la ya yi nags/ /phan dang bde ba'i dri bsung mngar po yis 'gro rnams rdzogs ldan dga' ston myong bar shog /ces slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ras bkral ba'i phreng ba dang slob dpon da chu ṇa ā tsarya'i kṛ ya gnyis chu bo gnyis 'dres kyi dkyil 'khor brgyad cu gya bdun gyi sgo nas smin par byed pa'i dbang gi brgyud 'debs srid sgrub nyag phran 'di'i skyid shod sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyis stod rgyud slob dpon pas gtsos brgya skor la dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /phun tshogs blo gros rin cen 'byung gnas cher/ /thos bsam dbu phreng do shal rab g.yo ba'i/ /skal bzang chu yi smin legs thub bstan kyi/ /'dzin mar zlos gar bsgyur la gsol ba (170na)'debs/ /blo chen tshangs pa'i mkhur 'tshos las rdol ba/ /bzang po'i rnam dpyod ā tha'i gzugs shar bas/ /lung rtogs bstan srid srog song rtsi sman ljon/ /nor 'dzin rgyan du spud la gsol ba 'debs/ /shes byar gzigs pa'i blo mig rab yangs pas/ /dal 'byor rten bzang don ldan yongs bsgrub ched/ shwakya'i bstan pa 'dzin phyir g.yung drung ltar/ /g.yo med rab brtan bden tshig 'grub par shog /ces pa'ang er te ni kho thu thu blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs slo ka gsum la tshang ba zhig dgos zhes dge slong blo bzang brtson 'grus kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /—39(3—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sertsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /mi dge'i las lam kun 'joms gnyen po'i dpung / /bsten nas sgo gsum dge bar gzhol nus pa'i/ /byin rlabs snying la 'jug par gsol ba 'debs/ /g.yon ru sku skye ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyi ngor bris/'khor lo lnga mdud grol ba dhū ti'i dbus/ /dbyings rig chos sku'i rang mdangs 'ja' lus sku/ /sprul sku'i sgyu 'phrul rgyal kun spyi yi gzugs/ /snying dbus ze'u 'brur pad 'byung bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /rnga yab gling pa'i zhabs sor rdul dmar gyis/ /phung khams skye mched dri dag me long ngos/ /bgrang yas zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor yongs shar ba/ /rdo rje thogs med rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /gan (170ba)jag thang tar padma kā ra yis/ /nyer gtad zab gter dus babs 'dren pa la/ /bka' babs las 'phro rab sad gter bdag gling / /sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon nas sgo phye'i chas kyis 'jug pa dang / /slob mar rang nor len pa'i rten 'brel sogs/ /snga 'gyur bstan srog legs 'dzin bzhed don kun/ /'grub par rtsa gsum thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs/ /rang bstan spel bar las can snying gi bu/ /rigs dang slob mar bcas pas nor 'dzin mngal/ /ljid kyis 'phrin las dngul chu gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /ji bzhin char pa med pa'i bkra shis shog/ces pa 'di'ang khri lcam dngos grub dpal 'dzom gyi gsung gis skul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bandes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /gtso thang dpal ldan chos kyi 'byor ba'i mdzod/ /sku bzhi lhun grub rdo rje sems/ /mtshams sprin bla gos nyer klubs pa/ /drin can bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /phun tshogs blo gros ba gam rtser/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar gyi/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng mdzad pa/ /rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /dkon mchog gsum dang btsong kha pa'i/ /mdo rgyud dam chos 'phel ba la /'jam dbyangs gzhen nu ngur mig gis/ /zlos gar bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /byams chos lnga sogs sde snod gsum/ /'dus pa'i bka' gnad 'grol ba la/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i —400

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ khobadedapal/ /mtshungs med bla mar (171na)gsol ba 'debs/ /sgra tshad gzhud brgya smra ba'i tshe/ /brtan yangs blo gros phyag sor gyis/ /legs bshad rgyal mtshan bsgreng mkhas pa/ /skad gnyis smra bar gsol ba 'debs/ /byams pa chen po gsang sngags kyi/ /phra rags phyag bzhes kun gyi mdzod/ /sgo 'byed dga' ston 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rdo rje 'dzin par gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i man ngag ni/ /'byor pa'i mdzod la mnga' gyur te/ /dar zhing rgyas mdzad rig sngags 'chang / /mtshungs med chos rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dpal gzhon nus mgrin 'khyud pas/ /gtsug lag rgya mtsho smra ba la/ /'jigs med rdo rje'i snyems pa can/ /mang thos dbang por gsol ba 'debs//ngag dbang yongs 'dzin du ma yis/ /rjes bzung chos spyod rnam bcur brtson/ /me tog mda' can las rgyal ba/ /khrims ldan chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /rtsis rig rgya mtsho'i mthar son zhing / /thu mi gnyis pa mkhar grong pa'i/ /chos mdzad tshul ldan mang du thos/ /dharma kā rar gsol ba 'debs/ /thos dang bsam par legs brtson zhing / /zab mo'i rnal 'byor la 'grus pa/ /dal 'byor rten bzang nor bu'i dpya/ /don dang ldan par gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug tshul khrims ldan/ /mthu rtsal snyan grags phyogs bcur khyab/ ta shes rab gdams pa'i bang mdzod kun/ /nang byan chud la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhi khro rab 'byams ma lus pa'i/ /(171ba)thugs dam dbyangs bskul ngag gi dbang / /phun tshogs dga' ston spel ba yi/ /skal ldan mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsung ngag zab don la dbang bas/ /lha sngags ye shes grub pa'i blo/ /rab yangs ma 'dris gnyen gyur pa/ /dar zhing rgyas la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos g.yas thang dbyings slong du rang grol yang / /lhun grub 'od lnga longs sku'i gdangs/ /ma 'gags sprul pas dkyil 'khor kun/ /spro bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' gter chos kyi gnas lugs kun/ /mthar phyin grags pa'i rdza rnga ldir/ /tshe bdag zhal gzigs mthu stobs can/ /dbu ru smyon par gsol ba 'debs/ /padma'i gdung tshab mnga' ris pa'i/ /mchog sprul ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan snga 'gyur gyi/ /bstan srog —401 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshe'adzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsar rnying tha snyad gzhung brgya la/ /blo gros mchog yangs rig pa'i rtsal/ /rdo rjes log smra'i brag 'joms pa/ /rigs 'dzin chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /bee ro rdo rje gling pa sogs/ /skye mang brgyud mthar zab gter sgo/ /'byed mdzad snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /gter bdag gling par gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang chen lha yis rjes bzung nas/ /rig pa'i ye shes mtshan du gsol/ /mthu stobs mthar phyin snying ri ba/ /bde ba bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal dbang padma'i 'phrin las rgyun/ /spel ba'i smon lam mthu btsan pas/ /bka' gter du mar sngon med (172na)kyi/ /gnad mdud 'grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /dkon cog phun tshogs yongs 'dzin gyi//drin las snga 'gyur ring lugs la/ /thos bsam sgom pa lhun grub pas/ /sngags 'chang chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs 'dzin chen po'i thugs kyi sras/ /tshe 'phel bzang po'i yang srid can/ /kun bzang dgongs don mngon gyur pa/ /rang grol dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /gru gu yang dbang rigs kyi dbon/ /drag sngags don grub ye shes lnga/ /rnam par bkra bas shis brjod glu/ /mgrin par len la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdzod lnga 'dus pa'i zab mo'i gter/ /gtsor gyur snga 'gyur chos tshul la/ /ngag gi dbang phyug phun tshogs dpal/ /rig sngags 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /padma'i ring lugs theg pa dgu /blo dbang brtson pas legs grub mthus/ /man ngag zab don dmar khrid du//ston par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnam lcags thog mda' mdzub khrid du/ /nus pa po yi sngags rigs can/ /'jam dpal zil gnon rnal 'byor la/ /gcig tu gzhol der gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs gsum 'dus pa'i gshin rje gshed/ /dug sdong mchog tu rab grub pa/ /bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i brtul zhugs can/ /sngags 'chang rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /g.yon thang smin grol lam ston mgon po'i skur/ /gdan gsum kun tshang bsod nams mchog /skal bar ldan la rdo rje 'chang / /mngon sum byon par gsol (172ba)ba 'debs/ /rin cen lta bu'i 'dul bya la/ /bsod nams zhing du mchog grub pa/ /he ru gaḥ dpal tshul khrims kyi/ /dri bsung 'thul la gsol ba —4(12

bla ma'i bstong tshogs kye rim pa/ (bda'adebs/ /dal 'byor rin cen legs rnyed 'bras/ /sangs rgyas bstan la yongs rdzogs pas/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal 'bar ba/ /gnas brtan chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /dbyangs can rab dgyes blo gros can/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /'chi med dngos grub ma lus pa/ /stsol bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun bzang dgongs don mngon gyur thugs/ /rig rtsal rtogs pa mchog gi 'od/ /chos sku'i klong du chos 'bar ba/ /se ban chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /phyi nang gnyen po zhakhrul 'khor sogs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag don rnams kun/ /grub nas log 'dren las rgyal ba/ /dpal mtshan ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhi khro'i lha sngags ye shes kyi/ /nus mthu gu ru'i bka' drin las/ /rnyed tshe ting 'dzin ches brtan pa/ /mthu stobs bdag por gsol ba 'debs/ /rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng 'dzin sras/ /'jig rten mig gcig smon 'gro pa/ /'jam dbyangs gzhen nu dbang gi rgyal/ /'jigs med rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /gso rig gtsug lag rgya mtsho la//blo gros skal bzang gzhan phan gyi/ /lhag bsam zla gzhen ltar dkar ba/ /dbang gi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /dkar nag rtsis gzhung smra mkhas ngag /dbang phyug grub pas 'jam dpal (173na〉na byangs/ /dgyes pa'i blo gros ston zla ltar/ /ches cher gsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhen nu nyid nas blo gros dang / /brtson pas mdo rgyud tha snyad sogs/ /gzhung mang mkhas rtser son pa yi/ /skal ba bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /dus 'khor rgyud 'grel dgongs bcud gnad/ /thugs chud gsar rnying man ngag lugs/ /phug pa'i srol 'dzin don kun grub/ /dbang gi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /dus 'khor dbyangs 'char spor thang gzhung / /zab rgyas gdams pa'i gnad kun la/ /smra ba ngag gi dbang phyug can/ /gsang sngags 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ rig sngags grub mthus 'gro mang por/ /'chi med mchog ster gdung ras pa/ /mi 'jigs skyabs spyin dbang phyug che/ /bde skyid stsol la gsol ba 'debs/ /yongs 'dzin du mas rjes bzung bas/ /ngag dbang blo gros bzang po yi/ /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng ltar/ /dus las yol ba med par shog /—403

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shesmin grol rgyud bshad rig gtad rjes gnang lugs/ /phyag bzhes man ngag sems bskyed so so thar/ /sde snod gsum sogs bcu phrag tha slad gnas/ /tshigs bcad gcig gi mtha' brten legs nos pa/ /gdan gsum tshang dang yongs 'dzin slob dpon gyi/ /rigs su gtogs so cog rnams sangs rgyas kyi/ /rnam par 'phrul po che ru nges rnyed nas/ /dbang rnon chos rjes 'brangs te nyer bzhengs 'thus/ /tshe rabs (173ba)kun tu bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ /rjes gzung thos bsam sgom pa'i gom stabs kyis/ /sa lam rin cen them skas la 'dzegs te/ /zung 'jug sku bzhi'i khang par myur 'jug 3snag /ces bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi gzhud lugs la bka' drin nos so cog gi sku brnyan lcags pho spre'u'i lor ri mo ba skya ris/ tshon mdangs/ bcad/ gser ris/ 'jug skyong sogs dbu mdzad pho brang phun tshogs dang / rags kha 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ byings snye mo ga rma/ rong pa bsod nams rgyal po/ lcang srung khang rin cen rdo rje/ gzhis rtse rdo rje rab brtan/ pa nam mgon po/lags rta mgrin/ blo bzang / rta mgrin rgyal po/ mkhar rtse dge bsnyen rgyal po/ 'brang shor brkos pa/ /rngog so dge bsnyen/ dgos bsam/ byang steng skya 'ba' rnams dang / do dam 'bog gong blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis te bzhengs pa'i kha byang rgyal rtse ba ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis bris pa'i zhal byang smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni lcags bya nag pa zla ba'i gral tshes la za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa di ga ṇa phya shrī dzwa la bha wantu/chos sku'i ston pa dpal ldan kun tu bzang / /longs sku rdo rje gzhen nu dpal chen lha/ /sprul sku bcom ldan ga me he ru gar/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /'phrin las rigs kyi gdung gsob rdo rje 'dzin/ /slob dpon chen po u pa ra (174na)dza'i zhabs/ /grub pa mchog brnyes pra bha hasti la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal 3snag /mthu stobs dbang phyug dha ni saṃ ltu ta/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs padma 'byung / /sna nam chen po rdo rje bdud —404

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bda'ajoms la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /'khon gyi sngags 'chang rdo rje rin po che/ /de sras mthu chen shes rab yon tan zhabs/ /rigs chos 'dzin pa yon tan 'byung gnas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /rdo rje 'dzin pa tshul khrims rgyal po'i mtshan/ /khrag 'thung grub brnyes rdo rje gtsug 'od dang / /drag sngags 'thar phyin 'khon rigs dge skyabs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /'phrin las phur bu'i rigs 'dzin dge ba mthong / /gdung 'tshob dngos grub mchog brnyes bal po che/ /gsang sngags 'chang ba shākya blo gros la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /snga 'gyur rdor 'dzin shes rab tshul khrims rje/ /gsar rnying zung 'jug dkon cog rgyal po'i zhabs/ /'khor lo'i mgon po brtse chen sa skya par/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /mkha' spyod zang thal gshegs pa'i bsod nams rtse/ /rigs kun bdag po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes gan pa ston dar la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /bdud sde'i dpung 'joms gan pa so ston dang / /gan pa theg mchog rnal 'byor chos kyi rgyal/ /mkhas dbang gan pa rin cen rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis dpal/ /mkhan chen 'jigs med seng ge dpal ba la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /'khor lo'i dbang phyug brag thog (174ba)bsod nams bzang / /'jigs med dpa' bo kun dga' rnam par rgyal/ /gdams pa'i bang mdzod rin cen rnam rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal lha/ga /rje btsun bla ma shākya kun dga' dpal/ /dam chos gling pa ye shes dbang po'i mtshan/ /mkhas grub nyi gling tshul khrims bkra shis la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /rgyal kun ngo bo rje btsun gnas gsar ba/ /zur chen chos dbyings rang grol rigs kun bdag /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /bstod las byang chub —40da

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shesgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /legs smin sgo gsum dri ma ma lus pa/ /rab bkrus sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs par shog /gdod ma'i gshis lugs de bzhin nyid kyi ngang / /rjes chags kun tu snang ba'i ma 'gags gdangs/ /sprul sku rgyu yi ting 'dzin rol gar las/ /rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor lhun grub shog /snang stong dpal chen phur bu'i lha skur shar/ /grag stong ki la ya yi gdangs su sgrog /rig song gdod ma'i kun bzang he ru gaḥ /bde stong zung 'jug zlos gar bsgyur bar shog /sgrib gnyis des bskyed 'jigs brgyad mtha' dag zhi/ /srid zhi'i 'byor drug ma lus 'phel zhing rgyas/ /mos bzhis khams gsum dbang du bsdu nus pa/ /'jam po'i las kyis lus can don byed shog /lha min gdon gyis btab la gdul dka'i tshogs/ /thar med 'brub khung nang bcug phur rtse nas/ /rnam shes rgyal ba'i sras bskrun 'khor ba las/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i mngon (175na〉〉da las 'grub shog /don chung tshe 'di'i chos brgyad 'ching ba'i rgya/ /bkrol nas sgo gsum dben pa'i bsti gnas su/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba 'dren pa'i sems bskyed kyis/ /drangs nas grol byed zab don la gzhol shog /rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa khams thig le la/ /bsnun pa'i 'khor lo'i mdud pa yongs grol nas/ /a wa dhū ting 'bar 'dzag bde ba che/ /gtum mo'i rnal 'byor lam du longs par shog /rang lus thabs ldan ting 'dzin la goms nas/ /phyag rgya mar brten dbab ldog zhagi la 'khor gyis/ /bcu drug phyed phyed rdzogs pa'i dga' ba bzhi/ /bde stong ye shes mngon du 'gyur bar shog /sna tshogs spros pa'i 'char sgo ji snyed pa/ /gdod nas dag pa'i rang rig kun bzang du/ /nges pas sangs rgyas g.yin nas mi 'tshol bar/ khreg chod rtogs grol cig car 'byung bar shog /snying gar gzhen nu bum dbus chos sku'i gdangs/ /mngon sum gong 'phel rig pa tshad phebs kyis/ /phung po 'ja' lus longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /chos nyid zad pa'i mtha' ru 'khyol bar shog /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs sprin phung 'khrigs/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung dngos grub char chen phab/ /mkha' 'gro'i 'phrin las snye ma g.yur za ba/ /rtsa gsum bkra shis dpal gyis kun khyab shog /ces dpal chen rdo rje phur bu'i 4(/(nyi

bla ma'i bsted tshogs kyi rim pa/ (ba)smin grol 'phrin las 'khon ston rim par byon pa la bka' babs pa sa phur lha khra'i stod las (175ba)byang chub sgrub pa'i dbang gi brgyud 'debs dngos grub rol mtsho 'di ni legs ldan gshin rje pu tra'i rigs kyi thig le gong ma rgyal po'i lung gis dpal ldan sa skya pa'i dpon chen ag glen gyi gdung las mi dbang kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub kyi gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs nas 'phrin las phur bu'i rigs 'dzin za hor gyi sngags smyon che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis pho brang dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /phun tshogs blo gros yangs pas skal bzang gi /gdul byar grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i dgongs don tshogs/ /mngon par bkra bas thog mtha' bar shis pa'i/ /dge legs stsol ba'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ stonang rta che gnyis dbyig gnyen yon shāka gi /gzhung lugs klog pa'i rim pa grwa tshang byes/ /sde 'di dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rab 'phel nas/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum rgyas par lha/ga /ces byes slob dpon blo bzang bkra shis kyi gsol 'debs 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes rigs lung dge bskos mnga' ris rab 'byams pa blo bzang phun tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bandes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mtha' rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /ka dag 'dus ma byas pa kun bzang klong / /srid zhi'i rtog tshogs gang shar rang grol ba/ /ngo bo spros bral chos sku'i bla ma la/ /mi phyed dad pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs/ /ja mchod kyi dus su mchod pa 'bul zhes bsgyur/ 'jam dpal zhi khro'i 'khor lor snang srid (176na)gyi/ /phyag rgya ma lus zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal/ /rang bzhin lhun grub longs sku'i bla ma la/ mi phyed dad ba'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs/ /gdul dka' gnyen por las bzhi'i sgyu 'phrul mtshor/ /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen ri dwags gzugs/ /kun khyab thugs rje sprul sku'i bla ma la/ /mi phyed dad pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs/ /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsol btab pas/ /dus dgra'i dbang po tshe bdag nag po yi/ /sgron drug nyams len lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu/ /bstan pas 'di phyi'i don —407—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losheganyis 'grub par shog /mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal mgon stag zhen dang / /bla tshe srog bdud bha wa sa hā na go /zab gter bsrung mdzad mthu chen sde bzhi yis/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun grub par mdzod/ /ces gsol 'debs ja mchod sogs gang 'dod du bsgyur chog pa zhig dgos zhes zing po sngags 'chang tshe bdag dpa' bos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /kun bzang bde stong dbyings nas gzugs kyi skur/ /mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan 'khor ba ji srid bar/ /g.yo med nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /theg mchog chos kyi bka' rnams ma lus pa/ /legs par bsdus nas gsang ba kun gyi mdzod/ /yongs bzung rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los (176brkor/ dpal ldan rdo rje chos la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal rigs swā la chen po nyi ma'i brgyud/ /'khrungs kyang snyengs bral bu ram shing pa yi/ /sri zhur sgo gsum 'bad pa don ldan can/ /zham ring kun dga' bo la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal khang steng du tant+ra sde chen po/ /bco brgyad char babs ku ku rā dza yis/ /zab mo'i don bkral dngos grub rab brnyes pa/ /skal ldan rgyal po ji la gsol ba 'debs/ /gangs ljongs bshad sgrub bstan pa spel ba'i ched/ /a 'dus kā li'i 'phreng mdzes yi ge'i gzugs/ /brda sprod dang bcas sngon med shing rta che/ thu mi saṃ bho ṭa la gsol ba 'debs/ /stobs ldan nag po'i ting 'dzin 'dzab gyi rtsal/ /yongs rdzogs dmod pas log 'dren ma lus pa/ /tshar gcod drag sngags grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin/ /slob dpon shanti ga lhar gsol ba 'debs/ /lo tsā ra btags kyang don gyi paṇḍi ta'i/ /mkhas pa'i snyan grags sa steng kun khyab pa/ /bod yul chos kyi nyi ma 'od po che/ /sgra bsgyur be ro tsa nar gsol ba 'debs/ /sngags 'chang rgyal po so zur gnubs gsum las/ /'ug bya lung pa mdo sgyu sems phyogs kyi/ /bshad sgrub ba dan srid rtser bsgreng mdzad pa/ shwakya 'byung gnas chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /gra thang la sogs gnas gzhi brgya rtsa brgyad/ legs bzhengs gso rig bdud rtsi snying —4()8

bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi rim pa/ (bdapo sogs/ /zab gter kha byang spyan 'dren dbang phyug 'bar/ /gra pa mngon (177na)par shes la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam pa'i rdo rjes rjes su bzung ba'i mthus/ /ji lta ji snyed chos kyi gnas lugs kun/ /mkhyen pa'i me long gtsang ma'i ngos shar ba/ /rong zom chos kyi bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /rtsa gsum dgyes pa bskyed dang snang srid kyi/ /lha srin g.yar dam nyer skong mdos chog gi /sgo 'phar brgya phrag cig car 'byed mdzad pa/ /sprul sku ra shag chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /bla rdzogs thugs gsum gyis mtshon tshe gcig la/ /byang chub bsgrub dang 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi/ spel ba'i zab gter grangs med 'don mdzad pa/ /rgyal sras rdo rje gling par gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lung mchod rten dkar po la sogs pas/ /rgyal dbang padma'i thugs bcud spyan drangs te/ /skal bzang gdul bya mang po smin grol la/ /'god mdzad kun skyong gling par gsol ba 'debs/ /gung thang chos kyi rgyal po'i bla mchod du/ /yongs bkur bod yul mtha' dag phan bde la/ /sbyor ba'i 'phrin las snyan grags rnga bo che/ /sgrog mdzad mchog ldan mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo'i pho brang du/ /padma thod phreng rtsal gyis rjes bzung nas/ /zab don bdag po'i bka' babs gnyer gtad pa/ /srin po chos kyi go char gsol ba 'debs/ tan lug la sogs gter sgo mang du phye/ /gangs can bstan 'gro'i bde skyid nyi ma shar/ /mtha' yas gdul bya'i dga' ston phyogs bcur (177ba〉spel/ /chos rgyal gter bdag gling par gsol ba 'debs/ /sems can bsam pa'i khyad par ji snyed dang / /mthun pa'i sgyu 'phrul bkod pa bgrang yas dang / /bskal bzang rnam 'dren stong gi tha ma sa /bde gshegs rnam par ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi phyed dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /mgon khyod padma kā ra dang mtshungs par/ /legs bzhugs zab gter chos kyi 'phrin las rgyun/ /bzhed pa ji bzhin lhun gyis 'grub par shog /yang srid kun tu rdo rje 'dzin nyid kyis/ /dge ba'i bshes mdzad dbang khrid gdams pa lung / /zab don chos kyi ro brgya'i bdud rtsi la/ /ngoms pa med par longs su spyod par shog /khyad par padma 'od kyi gzhal yas su/ /—4/)(3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheslob dpon pad 'byung slob ma gter bdag gling / /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor chen po zhal 'byed pa'i/'dus pa dang po'i 'khor du 'gyur bar shog /gnas skabs su yang bla ma yi dam dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma yis/ /thugs rje'i sprin phung 'khrigs las byin rlabs char/ /nyer 'bab bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil bar 3|ga /ces padma'i gdung tshab chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i 'brungs rabs dang gter gsar gyi sku brnyan rags rim rang nyid kyi dad rten du bzhengs pa'i tshe skyes rabs gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa mchog dman kun gyis go bde bar 'bol rtsom gyi tshul du lcags bya hor zla brgyad pa'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i (178na tha ge pa ni rig byed 'dzin pa mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /shākya seng ge'i gsung ngag mdo rgyud kyi/ /rnam bzhi'i chu klung chad med 'bab pa la/ /dbang phyug blo yi ma dres mkhas btsun bzang / /gting mtha' mi mngon rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i bka' gnad 'grol ba la/ /'jigs med dpyad gsum yongs dag go cha can/ /thub dbang bstan la 'khor lo rnam gsum gyi/ /lang tsho rgyas pa'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshangs sras dri za'i bu mo lus dkar can/ /mgrin mtshor bzhad pa'i gtsug lag rdo rje'i don/ /snyan tshig rgyud mang glur 'bab thos 'dzin du/ /legs bshad zil mngar ster la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyon mongs rtsub reg dang bral 'jam pa'i lha/ /dbyangs can mgrin 'khrud rtse dga' khong dgod pas/ /rtag tu 'jam pa'i bshes dang gnyen gyur pa/ /sdom brtson sde snod gsum par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdud bzhi'i dngos kun thal byung phug ste 'joms/ /tshur la gzhom par nus min rdo rje'i khrir/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas tshe mtha' yas pa'i skur/ /dbang bskur byin brlabs bden tshig brjod gsol 'debs/ /smon pa'i re ba don dang ldan pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs byed por gtogs so cog kun gyi/ chos dang srid kyi 'dod don ma lus pa/ /bsam pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub par shog /mya ngan 'das lam ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rgyud la mngon byed skyabs gnas dam pa'i (178ba/chos/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub —4///

bla mje bstong tshogs kye rim pa/ khobadapa'i grogs mchog dge 'dun gyis/ /phyogs dus kun tu dge legs spel bar shog /ces gsol 'debs ring 'tsho'i smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni shar dwags yul nas sde pa rgyu pas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /byang chub lam rim chen mo'i spyod pa spyi bslab yan la zhib bshad/ zhi lhag gnyis la don bsdu/ lam rim chung ba'i spyod pa spyi bslab yan la lung rkyang / zhi lhag gnyis la zhib bshad rdzogs par thob pa'i rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po yan lam rim gsol 'debs ltar dang / de nas brgyud 'debs mu 'thud dgos/ rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dar ma rin cen zhabs/ mkhas pa'i dbang phyug bla chen nyan shāka pa/ /gzhung brgya smra ba don yod dpal ldan te/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /lung rigs gter mdzod rje btsun chos rgyal mtshan/ /gsung ngag mdzod 'dzin dge 'dun rgyal mtshan rje/ /shes bya kun gzigs blo gros rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /legs bshad bang mdzod gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos dkon cog chos 'phel zhabs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /mtshungs med 'dren pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma zhes pa'i tshab tu so so'i bla ma su yin gyi mtshan bsgyur chog /gling stod chos rje'i nyi thang drung 'tsho bar (179na)gsan yig med 'dug kyang khong gis pha bong khar zhus yod 'dug pa ltar na dge 'dun rgyal mtshan yan gcig pas rje stag lung brag pa'i tshab la/ rdo rje 'chang dngos dpal 'byor lhun grub ste/ zhes pa bcug /gso rig mthar son blo bzang rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /brag sgo rab 'byams pas su la zhus ma shes kyang ngo mtshar brgyud pa'i lugs byas/ /rab 'byams smra ba phun tshogs rgyal mtshan dang / /tshig rkang phyi ma gnyis gong 'dra byas pas mthus par mngon/ zhes pa 'di'ang li thang chos rje rab 'byams smra ba blo bzang chos grags kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /spros pa yongs dag stong chen phyag rgya e/ /bcu drug dga' ba rnam kun mchog ldan waṃ/ /zung —4// —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'ajug rin cen 'dul bya'i bsod nams zhing / /mchog grub bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /thub bstan lnga brgya phrag drug dus kyi tshe/ /thos bsam sgom la dbang bas kun mkhyen bu'i/ /ring lugs spel ba'i 'phrin las lhun grub pa/ /rab yangs blo gros brtan la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dkar byang gling bkra 3sa rgyal mtshan sogs/ /bshes gnyen rim byon bag chags sad pa'i mthus//mdo rgyud bstan pa gsal byed rnam dpyod zla/ /cha shas yongs su gang la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun thugs kyi bum bzang du/ /legs gtams gdan (179ba)gsum tshang ba'i sde dpon che/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro dang sdud mdzad pa/ /rigs kun khyab bdag chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /brtse chen snying po'i zhal lung tshad ma bzhi'i/ /snyan brgyud rdo rje 'chang dbang tshar pa rje/ /yab sras brgyud pa'i 'phrin las gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /chad med 'dren pa'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs/ /gtsang stod zhwa lu gser khang chos gra cher/ /rnal 'byor rgyud bstan spel la dga' ldan nas/ /bu ston chos rjes nyer bsngags tshar pa rje'i/ /rnam thar lhag por 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ tshul khrims dag pas rtsa ba rab tu brtan/ /mdo rgyud stong po yal ga dar drag pa/ /smin grol 'bras bu'i khur gyis nyer dud pa'i/ /bshes gnyen yongs 'du'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam gsum mkhas pa'i bya bas gangs can ljongs/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde rab spel nas/ /dga' ldan chos kyi 'dun sar byams mgon gyi/ /sras kyi thu bor gshegs la gsol ba 'debs/ khams 'dus gsum gyi 'phreng ring spyod pas bsgral/ /dbang bzhis dkyil 'khor rnam bzha'i 'gros bzhi thim/ /sku bzhi mngon gyur dgyes mdzad he ru rka'i/ /sgyu 'phrul rol gar sgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du mgon po khyod/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i gtso bor legs bzhugs kyang / /bdag sogs gdul bya ye shes spyan ras kyis/ /gzigs nas 'bral med rjes su 'dzin par (180na)shog /'dus pa dang por khyod gsung bdud rtsi'i sman/ /thar pa'i srog gi zungs su legs gyur te/ /bu ston zhabs dang tshar chen yab sras kyi/ /bstan pa srid mthar rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dus —4/2

gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' ngur sgrig gi gar gyis rnam par rol ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin cen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni gang gi zhabs 'bring du yun ring por bcar ba bsod nams legs mchog gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes dam pa de nyid mkha' spyod rdorje btsun mo'i zhing du gshegs pa lcags mo bya'i lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes nyer gsum la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losher༅༅/ /'khrungs rabs kyi zhing bkod 'dri tshul gyi rtogs brjod kha byang dang bcas pa gsal ba'i me long bzhugs tre(/ /༄7/ /su sti pra dza saḥ sku gsum ngo bo dag pa'i dbyings su dbyer med don dam mi zad 'khor lo'i rgyan gyi mdzod/ /dmigs med snying rje'i rlan gyis nyer bsgos mtshan dpe'i kha dog ma 'dres rab bkra'i ri mo can/ kha sbyor bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dbang po'i gzhu yi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar mkhan ma/ /zhing khams rgya mtshor ngo mtshar cho 'phrul 'byams su klas pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug phyag gi yul/ /srid dang zhi ba'i gtsug tor mthon po'i rtser/ /snang ba dam pa'i gzi byin cher 'bar ba'i/ /sngon med nyi ma gsar pa srong btsan rje'i/ /'od stong srid pa'i rtse las brgal (2na)te spro/ /lnga brgya'i nyes tshogs nags klung phyer 'thag pa'i/ /skyes rabs ral gri'i rtsibs stong 'khor ba'i rgyun/ /ma dmad thugs rje chen pos nyer bskul phyir/ /'khor ba'i pha mtha' ji bzhin 'dzad med ring / /gzhan phan don du 'gyur na ngan song gnas/ /'chi med tshal dang mtshungs par longs spyod pa'i/ /'jigs bral snying stobs 'phags chen dam pa'i tshul/ dman lam zhi bder goms rnams skal ba phra/ /rang bde 'dod pa'i mtshan mor nyer gzhol yang / /gzhan don phyogs brgyar ngom pa'i 'dab ma'i kha/ /dka' spyad nyin byed shar tshe rab zum pa'i/ /'khrungs (2ba)rabs kunda'i tshogs kyi do zla min/ /smra ba'i bang mdzod lce yi glog phreng stong / /rnam par 'thul yang tshul 'di brjod pa'i mtha'/ /bral phyir rdzogs par gleng ba'i dka' thub dag /bsten na tshangs pa rgan po gnyid la yur/ /'on kyang rang blo'i 4/4

'khrungs rabs kyi zhing bkod rtogs brjod gsal ba'i me long (bda.a smra'i tshi gu yis/ /rtogs brjod zla ba'i ma ma'i cha shas las/ /ji tsam len par spongs nus de srid du/ /'jug pa'i tshul la rgol ba'i klan ka su/ /ye shes snang ba dag pa'i 'i kha / /lag mthil ltar mnyam rin chen gzhin/ /nor bu'i rdul brtsegs ri bo'i tshogs/ /gnyis 'thung dal gyis rgyu ba bzhin/ /sna tshogs rin chen las bskrun pa'i/ /sngon med ljon pa'i dbang po can/ /nyon mongs gdung ba las skyob phyir/ /'dab ma'i tshogs kyis klubs sam snyam/ / dal 'bab chu klung sdig pa'i dri/ /'khrus pa'i cho ga bstar ba la/ /chu skyes tshogs rnams dga' ba'i 'dzum/ /rtse dga' khong nas rgod pa 'dra/ /lha mi'i 'byor pa ji snyed pas/ /dpe zlar 'os min ngo mtshar gyi/ /bkod pa rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas ni/ /bde ba can zhes grags pa dkar/ /sa gzhi dang ri dang shing thams cad kyang rin po che las grub cing / mtsho rdzing 'bab chu me tog bya skad snyan (3na/sgrog pa/ 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan/ rol mo sogs ngo mtshar ba dang ldan pa'i bde ba can gyi zhing de'i dbusasu go bzang dang byang chub shing gi ljon pa yod do/ /zhing de'i dbang phyug 'od dpag med/ /'khor mun mig sman ltar gnag pa/ /mthar byed sku gsung thugs kyi gzi/ /gtan bde'i rang snang 'od du 'bar/ /ngag yid 'du byed dang bral bem po'i khams/ /nyi 'od 'bum gyis 'byud pa'i pad rag gi /lhun po 'jig rten mes pos nyer bskrun kyang / /mgon khyod dpe zlar 'os pa'i go skabs ci/ /de yi drung du rgyal sras pad dkar 'chang / /sngon nas tshogs gnyis dkyil 'khor nya gang yang / /ris bral 'gro la brtse bas smon 'jug gi /sems bskyed zla tshes cha shas gong du 'phel/ /'khor ba e raṇḍa yi snying po la/ /gtan bde'i ngal gsor re ba'i 'brul ba'i 'gro /ma lus khyod kyis 'dren par dam bca' na/ /'phags chen g.yin rnams zhi bder mnal lo ci/ /mgon po 'od dpag med byang chub kyi shing gi drung na bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ spyan ras gzigs kyis phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar/ bus mo sa la btsugs nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i tshul lo/ /snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs nyams dang 'gyur ba'i dpyid/ /dbyar gyi rnga gsang ltar sgrog sa spyod kyi/ /rigs (3ba)sras 'jig rten las 'das dbang phyug brgyad/ /kun tshang yon tan gter gyur mi yi bdag /bcu drug bgrang ba'i na tshod ches phra yang / /ma dmad mdzad bzang rgan po'i blo 'chang bas/—415

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shernam 'dren 'od mdzad ye shes tog gi drung / /gtan gyi skyabs gsol zhur bgrod shul lam du/ /nyi zla nam mkha'i sgron mar nyer 'bod pa'i/ /'chi med lus phra'i khengs 'phrog mdzes ma zung / /'khor bar 'byul pa'i gtan mdun 'cha' 'dod nas/ /gtong min mdza' gcugs rtse dga'i brda thabs bstan/ /de tshe yid 'ong chu skyes 'dab rgyas dang / /ri skyes dong rtse'i dngos po nyer phul te/ /bla med byang chub sems bskyed char rgyun gyis/ /gtan bde'i myu gu bskrun pa'i cho ga bstar/ /yul sgro can na rgyal po sgra dbyangasarnga sgra'i sras su 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khrungs pa 'i tshe lo bas drug lon pa na/ sangs rgyas 'od mdzad ye shes tog gi drung du byon pa'i lam khar nyi zla'i sgron ma dang nam mkha'i sgron ma gnyis kyis btsun mo bya bar gsol cing / sangs rgyas la utpal dang dong rtse phul te sems bskyed do/ /gzi byin stong 'bar rin chen cod pan mchog /yab rjes rigs sras bu la nyer bkod nas/ /sa dbang rgyal po'i go sar mnga' gsol te/ /khrims gnyis gdugs dkar yu ba bu la gtad/ /rang gi lus srog 'gro la gtong ba'i sems/ /sbyin pa'i rtse dga' lhur len nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /sngon goms ri gzar rtse las nyer 'bab pa/ /ser sna'i rags kyis gyen du bzlog nus min/ /sbyin pa'i gtam (4na)snyan lus phra'i 'grin pa'i chang / /zegs ma grangs med phyogs brgyar 'thor ba yis/ /mchog dman skye po'i sgra 'dzin ba ku la/ /'dzum tshe kun rtog ze'u 'bru ci yang rgod/ /phrag dog rlung gis bskyod pa'i nags kyi mes/ /nor mchog tsandan ljon pa bsregs pa'i shul/ /sgra gcan rje 'bangs sems khong chud pa bzhin/ /brnams pa'i sol ba'i mgal dum ches cher spungs/ /de tshe g.yo med khrims kyi rlung / khri1gas drag gis bdas rgyal ba'i sras/ /zla gzhan mtha' 'khor chu lha yi/ /phang par song yang 'jigs pa med/ /bslu med bden pa'i skya rengs kyi/ /phan bde'i bya ma rta shar bas/ /ring min slar yang lha yi sras/ /nyin byed rang yul mkha' la 'ongs/ /e ma de tshe lus can kun/ /mi dbang yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /rang gi bsod nams bgo skal gyis/ /thob ces dga' ba'i gar gyis brel/ /dus der rje 'bangs yid la bde ba'i ro/ /myong dang lhan cig mtha' 'khob dregs ldan yid/ /dkar min sngon bsags las la cher mnong ba/ /lhan cig phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du byas/ /—416

'brungs rabs kyi zhing bkod rtogs brjod gsal ba'i me long (bkasras 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal sar bskos te sbyin pa rgya chen po btang bas/ phrag dog dang ldan pa'i rgyal po shing khri can gyis/ nor bu dgos 'dod 'byung ba slong bar btang ba bzhin byin pas sras yum rnams bdud ri nag po bya rog sgra gcan zhes bya bar sprugs/ de'i tshe lam du yang bzhen pa/ rgyan gos rnams kyang slong mo ba la byin/ bshul lam (4ba)nig tu lhas gzhal yas khang sprul nas mchod pas/ btsun mo gnyis der bzhugs par 'dod kyang yab kyi bka' mi bcag ba'i slad du byon/ der bye ma sheng drung nas 'ongs pa'i bram ze la sras ming sring yang byin/ de la brten nas yab yum rnams dang / yul de'i lha klu gzhi bdag rnams kyis ngus shing / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis spyan chab brtan pa gcig tu 'khyil ba mtshor gyur ba'i dbus su pad sdong gi me tog rnams la sangs rgyas re re bzhugs pa dang / 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i ltas ya mtshan du byung / brgya byin gyis nyams tshod sad par btsun mo byin yang slar phul/ mi ring bar rang yul du spyan drangs te sras 'od zer tog rgyal sar bsgo ba sogs dga' ston byas so/'phags yul lho phyogs 'dzin ma'i rgyan gcig pur/ /byed pos nyer bskrun dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bangs/ /'gro ba'i gnyen du sa dbang rgyal po'i tshul/ 'dzin mkhas gang gi sgyu 'phrul de med byung / /srid 'byor snying med dbu ba'i do shal dag /ngan g.yo mthor rlung drag pos nyer bcom pa'i/ /yul gzhan dal med rgyu ba'i rlabs phreng de/ /mtha' yas dge tshogs 'byung la yol ba med/ /legs byas 'bras ldan dus kyi rab dngas mkhar/ /mdzes sdug lang tsho'i bsil zer stong 'phro ba/ /bde spyod yid kyi kunda dbang med du/ /phyogs pa'i bzhin ras 'dab ma 'dzum zhing 'dar/ /de tshe ri dwags mig can mar/ /mchog gsum dam pas byin brlab pa'i/ /mi las 'das pa'i khye'u ni/ /khas blangs ji bzhin dus su btsas/ /las kyi thags su nyer btags pa'i/ /(ldan〉bgrang yas skye ba'i za 'og gos/ /bde sdug sna tshogs ri mo yi/ /rang mtshang ston pa'i slob dpon bzhin/ /cher 'bad g.yo sgyu'i gru rdzings dag /bden pa'i pi wang rgyud sgra yis/ /sa dbang mdun sa'i chu gter dbus/ /zhig tshe bran mo lha yul song / /bhe ta'i yul gyi rgyal po'i bu mo kun tu bzang mo bran mos bslad de gser gzhong chu la bskur bas rkyen byas/ yul lho phyogs su 'ongs pa na rgyal po bde spyod kyi btsun mor blangs/ bu stod gser rkang pa g.yu/ smad dung las byas pa zhig skye zhes btsun mos smras pa ltar btsas kyang bran mos rje mo la smyo chu blud/ sras sbas/ khyi gu'i ro zhig bstan te/ 'di byung zhes dril bsgrags pas thams —417

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshecad the tshom du byung / ring por ma lon par sras kyis pho brang chen po zhig sprul rgyal po 'khor bcas gdan drangs/ sngar gyi byung tshul rnams zhib par glengs/ bran mo gnyis rnam shes po ta lar 'phangs so/ /tha mal khyim thab 'a shegar ba yi/ /thar med rgya ru yongs rig ste/ /ltas ngan g.yang len nye ba'i lam/ /mkha' 'gro'i pho nya bsten la chas/ /mi zhum snying stobs brtson 'grus kyis/ /dka' ba'i las mang nyer bsgrubs pas/ /mi bsrun srin g.yag snying 'dar nas/ /mthong ba tsam gyis sa la 'gyel/ /de tsho skye ba mang po'i dge ba'i bshes/ /dri med mtsho skyes rigs 'dzin dpa' bo ches/ /gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro gnas bcas nyer bstan zhing / /'byung 'gyur gsung gi gsang ba du ma stsal/ /kun gsal dbyings su snyeg 'dra'i brag (5ba)gi ri/ /rdo rje lta bur rab mdzes lte ba'i dbus/ /gsang ba bde chen mkha' 'gro'i gzhal med khang / /ye shes lha tshogs 'du ba'i gnas der byon/ /thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i re ba kun/ /rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo kun grol bde ba'i dpyid/ /stong chen dag pa'i rang bzhin snyan pa'i glu/ /rdo rje'i tshig tu dpal gyi mgrin par len/ /au tri ya na'i yul nas skad cig la/ /yab yum bde ldan khab tu nyer bgrod nas/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i dge mtshan gyis/ /phyogs de'i 'gro rnams legs pa'i lam la sbyar/ /de nas dkon mchog 'bangs kyis gsang ba ye shes len par au rgyan gyi yul du byon pas/ lam du mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis lung bstan pa ltar/ srin pa'i snying len par chu dang nags la sogs lam bgrod dka' mang po spyad de byon/ der mkha' 'gro zhig dang 'phrad de lung bstan pa ltar / brag khung zhig gi sgo brdungs pas rnal 'byor ma rgan mo zhig dang phrad/ des zer ba bzhin ri nag po'i gtsug lag khang du mkha' 'gro'i tsho gis 'khor gyi sar byon pas/ de'i rdo rje'i slob dpon ma des lung bstan nas srin yul du mi snying bcu drug len par byon/ der rnal 'byor ma zhig gis khyed rang rgyal po mtsho skyong gi pho brang gi lho nas rtsis pa'i phyogs der sdod cig /mi snying ngas khyer yong zer ba ltar byas pas/ rgan mo gcig dang bu mo bco lnga byung nas tshogs kyi dga' ston byas/ rgan mo des bla ma dri ma med pa'i drung du btang ba bzhin byon/ de nas bla mas gsung ba bzhin byon pas gsang ba ye shes dang mjal zhing / ma 'ongs lung bstan sogs rgyas par (6na〉sung ba'i mthar rang yul du phebs so/ /zla shel 'bad pa med par gzugs brnyan gyis/ /cig car bgrang yas rdzing bur 'char ba ltar/ /rgyal rnams sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar dag /ston 'di byis —418

'brungs rabs kyi zhing bkod rtogs brjod gsal ba'i me long (bkablos gzhal ba'i yul las 'gong / khrims gnyis drang por srong ba'i srub shing gis/ /legs lam snang ba'i chu gter las btan pa'i/ /phan bde'i sa bsrung sna zhags ring brkyang yang / /ches btsan bsnyem med sgom pa'i blo chen ldan/ /gangs kyi ri bos bskor ba'i rab dkar ljongs/ /bdud rigs nag po'i ra ri'i dri ma can/ /drung 'byin thugs rje'i zhugs kyis bzhu ba'i chab/ /grags snyan lhung lhung sgrar bcas ci yang 'bab/ /mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba bzhin/ spang dang rtogs pa'i yon tan kun/ /yi dam lha dang dbyer med kyang / /gzhan ngor sgrub pa'i ngang tshul bstan/ /de tshe thugs rje'i 'dren byed mes/ /mi mthun 'dod lha'i lus bsregs dang / /lhan cig gya gyu'i ma rungs sems mya ngan khang bur brgyal ba bzhin/ /'chi med pho brang sa gzhi la/ /'phos 'dra'i lha ldan gtsug lag zung / /rlung gi rgyal mtshan ltar bkra ba/ /bsod nams pir gyis ri mor byas/ chos rgyal srong bzha sgam pos nyang bran pha bong khar/ mkhar dgu thog brtsegs te/ der sprul pa mnga' bas/ rigs gsum mgon po zhal gzigs shing byin gyis rlobs/ lha sa dang ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang rten brten par bcas pa legs par bzhengs so/ /gangs (6ba/5na rin chen rtsig pa'i ngos/ /thub bstan ri mor bris pa'i gzugs/ /gab pa slar yang gsal ba'i phyir/ /dbon sras su sprul lha'i me tog /dbus 'gyur ma la ya klung nas/ /smon lam bser bus bskul ba yis/ /mkhan slob tsandan dri gsung dag /phan dang bde ba'i sos su 'jebs/ /lugs zung mi 'gyur gtsug lag khang / lhun gyis grub pa'i dge mtshan gyis/ /sgyu mas sprul pa'i grong khyer dang / /'chi med tshal gyi khengs pa 'phrogs/ /dam tshig rten gyi rdzing bu la/ /ye shes gru char nyer phab pa'i/ /mtha' klas dpag dka'i rdo snyul dang / /lha mi'i dga' ston 'gran pa 'dra/ /chos rgyal khri srong lde'u pa' gyis mkhan slob gnyis spyan drangs sa gzhi btul nas bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang brtsigs/ /rab gnas kyi tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung zhing /rab gnas kyi dga' sngon rgya cher btang ngo / /bstan la ma dmad phud dud bsgrubs pa'i grangs/ /mgo skyes lhag mar bshad de lan bu sa /gyur pas ral pa'i cod pan 'dzin 'di yis/ /gsar bcad skad kyis thub bstan byi dor byas/ /dpa' rtags dpung gis rgya nag dmag tshogs kun/ /snying dbugs dang —4/1

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebacas nam mkha'i pha rol la/ /bskrad pa'i shugs kyis mgrin bcu srog bral bar/ /ra ci'i bu yis bsad ces gtam du gleng / /sngags dang rdzas kyis bslad min 'dren byed la/ /rgya phibs gdugs ltar 'khor ba'i sprul bsgyur gyis/ /sngon med gtsug lag gzigs mor dus gsum gyi/ /rnam (7na)'dren kun kyang ngang gis byon nam snyam/ /mnga' bdag khri ral gyis lo paṇa rnams spyan drangs nas skad gsar bcad kyisagatan la phab/ dbon zhab ma mthun pa'i tshe rgya dmag bcom 'u shang rdo'i gtsug lag khang steng gi rgya phibs gdugs ltar 'khor ba'i ngo mtshar can bzhengs so/ /rgyal gsung dbyangs su blangs pa'i sgra snyan por/ /byang gi phyogs su dam pa'i chos 'phel bar/ /'gyur khug lung du bstan pa'i mu tig gi /phreng ba'i do shal ring po rgyan du 'chang / /thabs mkhas 'phrul ldan g.yon mig ni ru gas/ bskul bas lha gcig bi shwa ga rma yis/ /bod ston grub mtha'i nyi ma bcu gnyis 'char/ /bdar bas thub bstan dri med dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /lung mang brgal ba'i gangs can byang gi char/ /lung bstan gyis zin ra sgreng gtsug lag khang / /lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa cher 'phel ba'i/ /lung rig smra ba'i 'dus pa'i sde chen bskrun/ /bka' chen mdo dang rgyud sde'i gzhung lugs kun/ /bka' babs dam pa gsum las nyer 'ongs pa'i/ /bka' rgyud chad med jo bo'i ring lugs pa/ /bka' gdams bstan pas nor 'dzin khyon kun khyab/ /'byom ston gyi mnga' ris su byon nas jo bo spyan 'dren pa'i do dam mdzad/ yer pa/ snye thang / bsam yas mchims phu rnams su jo bo kun ring du bsten nas zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /sku tshe'i mjug tu lung bstan bzhin dpal gyi rwa sgreng bzhengs pa yin no/ /rang gis sngon bskrun 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang / /gso (6ba)phyir 'dod dgu'i dpal ster rnam thos bu/ /zangs 'khar lo tsā ra gtad nas 'di yi don/ / bsgrub par bskul mdzad kha che dgon pa ba/ /de tshe lha ldan gnod sbyin phyogs/ /gser gyi phug par skad gnyis pas/ /mig skya bsgrubs tshe mkho dgu yi/ /'byor pa ri bo'i rjes 'gro rnyed/ /rang gi 'dren pa mchog de yi/ /bka' stsal ma khru ka yi gos/ /stod du gyon nas lha ldan gyi/ /bkur sti'i gar gyis rnam par brel/ kha tshe dgon pas zangs mkhar lo tsā la/ rnam sras gnang ste/ lha 'di bsgrubs la nga'i gtsug lag khang la zhig ga6gyis zhes bka' stsal/ nyang bran pha bong kha'i gser phug tu grub pa thob —420

gcings rabs kyi zhing bkod rtogs brjod gsal ba'i me long (bkanas lha sa'i zhig gsol mdzad do/ /sa bcu'i byang sems rnams kyis bsgrun min pa'i/ /sa mchog rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon gyur nas/ /sa la gnas pa'i 'og min zhing khams su/ /sa skya par grags bla chen snying po'i zhabs/ /sgrib gnyis las 'khon 'khon par skyes kyi rgyud/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos dngos grub ma lus thob/ /shes bya kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse nus mthur ldan/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang dbang phyug brgyad ldan pa/ /dge bcu'i yon tan kun tshang ba'i/ /yul gyur dpal ldan sa skya zhes/ /gsang ba sngags kyi chosatshul la/ /o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dang mtshungs/ /'gro ba'i yid kyi rtsig ngos la/ /gzugs sku'i snang brnyan byed pa dag/ting 'dzin pir gyis cig car du/ /bris tshe mes po'i snyems pa 'phrog /bla ma sa chen (8na) gyis sa skyar bzhugs te gsang sngags kyi chos ji snyed cig gsungs shing bye brag tu 'tsham khar bzhugs nas lo gsum gyi khrid bskyangs pa/ sa skyar bzhugs nas lam 'bras gsungs pa/ gung thang du bla ma mal gyi nye gnas mdzad cing bde mchog dril bu pa'i chos gsan pa/ 'bri mtshams su 'gron la lcam lha khang du nam mkha' dri med kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas rab gnas mdzad pa/bzang rtog 'brog gseng tu lam 'bras gsungs pa/ shab sgo lngar chos 'khor bskor ba'i bkod pa rnams dus gcig tu bstan pa yin no/ /yab yum zag med bde ba'i dga' ba bzhi/ /rdzogs pa'i lang tsho'i snying po dar ba'i dpal/ /zhang ston gsang sngags 'chang ba'i rigs rgyud du/ /srid zhi'i sgyu 'phrul ngom pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /skyid shod nor 'dzin lus phra'i bzhin ras ngos/ /tshal gung gtsug lag zung gi 'dren byed kyis/ /sde bzhi'i gzugs kun mthong ba'i dpe zla mā /'chi med gtso des mgo stong sprul min nam/ /padma saṃ bha srong btsan sgam po sogs/ /bgrang yas rgyal ba rnams la mngon sum du/ /zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi len byed na/ /mi shes ( lkog gyur gnas de gang du mchis/ /zhang 'gro ba'i mgon pos tshal gung gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ lha sa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / bsam yas su o rgyan rin po che zhal gzigs par gsang sngags kyi dbang sogs chos mang du gas no/ /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin gsung gi rdo rje'i tshig /'gyur med rtags su khri srong sprul pa'i sku/ /nyang rigs(8ba tshe pas son rig sngags 'chang ba yi/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i snyan pa srid na 'bar/ /las 'brel smon lam lde mig gis/ /sra brtan zab mo gter gyi sgo /phye ba'i theg mchog —421 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dpar blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebang mdzod las/ /dngos grub nor bu'i tshogs rnams rnyed/ /margad gos su nyer klubs pa'i/ /yid du 'ong ba'i ne'u sing ngogs/ /g.yo med ting 'dzin 'od gsal du/ /thun gcig mnal ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /mtsho rgyal sprul pa'i zhing skyes mas/ /'di yi bdag po khyod yin zhes/ /yang zab thugs kyi man ngag gi /dom sgro nag po dngos su gtad/ /mnga' bdag nyang gis brag srin mo'i sbar rjes/ mkho mthing lha khang / lha sa'i gtsang khang byang ma sogs nas gter mang du bzhes thengs gcig ni kha zhig tu mnal bas/ bud med rta zhen pa zhig gi spang nas dom sgro zhig bor/ thod 'phreng gis lcags rgyab byung ba dang brgyal/ brgyal sangs nas dom sgro la gzigs pas slob dpon padma'i zab chos kho nar 'dug go /dpal ldan tshangs dbang dbang po la sogs pa'i/ /gtsug tu rab bsngags bsngags 'os don ldan pa/ /lha sras skye mtha' mtha' 'khob 'gro ba'i gnyen/ /rje dpon rigs las las ldan dge ba 'bum/ /pur rgyal bod kyi bsod nams gzhi/ /'phrul snang yid bzhin nor bu mchog /klu dbang gtsug gi cod pan du/ /'dren pa'i nyal 'gro bzlog la brtson/ /dkar min las rlung gis bskyod rlabs kyi phreng / /chu yi lha mo dbu ba'i do shal can/ /gtsug lag mgron du bsu ba'i nyer sdogs la/ /mthon mthing bzhin ras (9na〉pa kha' la ngoms bzhin 'ongs/ /de tshe 'jig rten dbang phyug srong btsan la/ /ra mdar sbran pa'i gdung shugs drag po'i dbyangs/ / bden pa'i tshig gis smreng du gsol ba na/ /mchog gsum thugs rje 'gro la ngom pa/bzhin/ /nye 'dabs sa 'dzin ngos su gnas pa'i rdo/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis sems ldan ji bzhin du/ /gtsang chab gnod pa bzlog pa'i chu lon la/ /dad tshe kun gyis srong btsan sprul par gleng / lha rje dge ba 'bum gyis lha sa'i zhig sos dang chu bzlog mang du mdzad/ khyad par khyi lo zhig chu'i gnod pa shin du che ba byung khar/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po la ra mda' mdzad pas chu bri/ nyang dog ma la grong rab/gar pa tshun gyi ri rdo nas dzu 'phrul gyis ded de rags la bskyal lo/ /dge legs rab dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / /mi zad chos kyi dbyangs su 'dun pa'i sgra/ /skal bzang rna bar sgrog la zla bral ba'i/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i gtsug na mngon par mtho/ /gang de'i phyag tu rang gi dri med kyi/ /bstan pa'i gser gyi rtsibs stong legs gtad nas/ khyod kyis srid mthar bskor zhes nyer gdams te/ /'jam dpal —422

'khrungs rabs kyi zhing bkod rtogs brjod gsal ba'i me long (bdasnying po dga' ldan gnas su gshegs/ /'ja' tshon ltar bkra'i 'dus pa'i sde/ /legs pa'i mtshan mar rab shis pa'i/ /thos bsam g.yo med lhun po che/ /thub bstan gling bzhi'i dbus na mdzes/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyis dgung lo nyer lnga la rgyal ba tsong kha ba chen po dang mjal bstan (9ba〉pa yongs su gtad /bkra shis lhun po'i chos ldebatab bo/ /yang yang bsams kyang gang gi mkhyen pa'i mtha'/ /ngal ngal bgrod kyang rtogs par mi nus pa'i/ /mkhas mkhas yang rtse bzhad pa'i rdo rje khyod/ /'grig 'grig shes bya 'chad la 'gran pa med/ /kun dga'i mdza' ba nam yang gtong min pa'i/ /rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i dge ba'i rnga/ /dgra zla'i g.yul las rgyal te nyer thob nas/ /brdungs tshe 'dod lha lus med rdzu la brten/ /mchog gi dngos grub shing rta yis/ /'og min gnas kyang ma dag pa'i/ /zhing du drangs tshe shes bya kun/ /sems kyis btags pa'i rol bar khugs/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /rgyal bas lung du bstan pa'i gnas/ /sa la gnas pa'i mkha' spyod de/ /he ru ka rnams 'du ba'i gling / /o rgyan sham bha la dang 'og min sogs/ /grangs med gnas kyis bsgrun par mi nus pas/ /gang gi dpe zla 'tshol la pad dkar mig mkha' lding zhon nas phyogs kun dal med nyul/ /thams can mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos 'bras spungs kyi mkhan thog tu phebs 'phral/ lha sa smon lam slar rang phyogs la byung / chosa'akhor rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang chen po bskrun no/ /sde bzhi'i dpal gyi glang chen khar 'bab ba'i/ /legs lam chad pa med pa'i ga ba'i rgyun/ /lnga brgya'i nyes tsho gos dri ma zhabrud pa yi/ /bstar pa'i cho ga mgon 'di'i mdzad par rdzogs/ /gdug can dgra bgegs bsad pa'i khrag gi dris/ /myos pa'i chos bsrung rgya mtsho 'du ba'i sa/ /dga' tshal (10na de bang brag rol pa'i pho brang che/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod gnyisapar byas/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pas mi gnas myang 'das sar/ /bgrod dang lhan cig mtha' 'khob hor yul gyi/ /gser gyi rgyal po'i thod du zhabs sen gyi/ /u dum wa ra'i chun po'i phreng ba bcings/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i gnam bskos lha/ /'jam dbyangs wan li rgyal po'i lung las kyis/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren par dbang bskur bas/ /mchod sbyin brgya pa snying khar lag pad zum/ /—423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshethams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos/ glegs bam gyi lung bstan bzhin dga' tshal gyi gtsug lag khang btab/ /al tan rgyal pos mtha' 'khob kyi yul du spyan drangs te/ dam pa 'i chos kyi sgron me sngon rgya nag wan li rgyal po'i lung gis lha yi lha zhes mngon par mtho/ mthon po'i rigs ldan tshe ring gnam gyi rgyud/ /zing gi rgyan gyi gdung las nyer 'ongs pa/ /srid gsum dbang phyug kun gyi cod pan mchog /thugs rje'i rtsal gsum yongs rdzogs gdong lnga'i dbang / /dregs pa'i gdeng ka cher g.yo zhing / /'jigs pa'i phud sgra sgrog pa rnams/ /gzi brjid mkha' lding dbang po yis/ /thal bar ma byas su zhig mchis/ /rtsol ba med par srid zhi yi/ /yon tan chu klung ma lus pa/ /legs par 'du ba'i rgya mtsho ni/ /don gnyis nor bu'i 'byung gnas mchog /thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ mas stobs chan pos nag phyogs bdud rigs thams cad tshar bar do/ /'phag bas chen dam pa'i skye bsna(10ba)rabs mu tig gi /phreng ba lhag bsam srad bu la brgyus pa/ /'gro kun dga' ba bskyed pa'i do shal du/ /ring por 'chang ba'i pha mtha' rtogs nus min/ /thub bstan lha yi lam yangs par/ /mkhas grub mkha' snying bgrod pa'i shul/ /gyi nar spyod pa'i phye ma leb/ /bgrod rlom ngal ba bsgrub par zad/ /'on kyang sngon bsags legs byas kyis/ /rnyed pa'i dal 'byor yid bzhin nor/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i byi dor gyis/ /don gnyis 'dod dgu'i dpal la spyad/ /de phyir rang gi rtogs brjod kyi/ /spyod tshul rdzun gyi rnyog ma dang / /bral ba'i gtam gyi gang ga'i rgyun/ /mgrin pa'i lam gsum pa las 'ongs/ /dpal rgyal kun thugs rje bdag nyid mchog /lha phyag na padmas byin brlabs pa'i/ /gnas gangs can 'dzin ma'i mthil gyi ljongs/ /sa mtho ris yon tan bdun tshang ba/ /yul g.yang chags yar klung nub kyi cha/ /sngon chos rgyal mes dpon rnam gsum du/ /blon rig can 'byung ba'i sa dpyad kyi/ /ri glang chen dal gyis rgyu 'dra'i ngogs/ /steng 'chi med kyi yul grur co 'dri ba'i/ /grong rgyu skar sa la bkram 'dra'i dbus/ /rdzong 'phying bar stag rtse'i pho brang cher/ /las rnam dkar kyis bskrun pa'i lus rten bcas/ /lar slu med rten cing 'brel 'byung mthus/ /mgon padma'i rgyal tshab byang pa rjes/ /dpal 'chi med lha dang drag dmar (11na)gyi/ /rgyud thog mar smin pa'i bka' drin no/ /—424

'khrungs rabasakyi zhing bkod rtogs brjod gsal ba'i me long (ba)gnas 'phags yul gyi 'jam dpal bshes gnyen 'khas/ /bod spu rgyal gnub ban sangs rgyas kyang / /lar mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed po la/ /rje rigs 'dzin 'di pa'i lhag min snyam/ /der gzhan dbang gis bskyod pa'i bser bu yis/ rang 'ching byed kyi pha yul sprin tshogs dang / /yongs so sor phral bas dam chos kyi/ /mdangs nyi 'od gsal ba'i g.yang du lon/ /dus ring zhig yul mang bgrod pa'i mtshams/ lar skye bo'i gtam gyi ca co'i sgra/ /phyogs so sor khyab tshe thag khra la/ /sbrul 'dzin pa'i kun rtog ri mo shar/ /ches na tshod phra ba lo lnga'i dus/ /dpal 'dzin ma'i thig le skyid shod kyi/ /gnas dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sder/ /mgon rgyal bstan sgo ru thog mar zhugs/ der mkhan chen dam pa'i 'khas drung du/ /dpal di paṃ ka ra'i lam yig dang / /lha zhi drag 'ga' yi rjes gnang sogs/ /chos rnam grangs du ma'i bka' drin nos/ /lo brgyad du slebs nas dge tshul gyi/ /tshigs snga ma'i cho ga nyer bstan te/ /rang klog pa thos bsam bya ba la/ /blo brtson pas gang nus nyams su blangs/ /dus ring min bgrang bya bcu gcig nas/ khong 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu ngur smrig gi /zol nyer 'dzin dkon mchog chos 'phel drung / /ches phra zhib bsdus tshad kyi rig pa rtsis/ /rgya rnam par che ba thogs med kyi/ gzhung pha rol phyin pa'i sbas (11ba〉don dang / /ches yang zab stong nyid klu sgrub kyi/ /srol zla grags bzhed pa ji bzhin sbyangs/ /blang dor bya'i gnad ston 'dul ba'i sde/ /chos gzhi lnga gtsor brjod mngon pa mdzod/ /sngon rgya bod kyi mkhas grub gzhung 'ga' la/ /las skal bzang gi bag chags cung zad bzhag /gzhung kun la mkhas par ma gyur kyang / /deng rigs pa smra ba'i khrod nang du/ /mdog dkar po'i bya rog min 'di yang / /rje bla ma de yi drin du khums/ /yul nyer bzhi'i ya gyal lha mo mkhar/ /rje srong btsan sgam po'i sgrub gnas su/ /yongs rigs brgya'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /'khon dpal 'byor lhun grub drung du snyegs/ /mgon 'jam dpal snying po'i gdams pa'i bcud/ /dpal 'dus pa'i snyan rgyud zhal gdams dang / /sngags gsar snying gi dkyil 'khor mtha' klas par/ /rgyud smin byed dbang gi cho ga nos/ /lung man ngag phyag bzhes ji snyed pa'i/ /gnad —425

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedaka' ba'i 'phrang la zhun thar bcad/ /ye dag pa'i rig pa kun tu bzang / /ngo rjen sprod theg pa'i yang rtse bstan/ kha phyir bltas sems kyi tha rgod dag /rgyun chad med nges 'byung gis brlan nas/ /chos snying nas bsgrub blo'i myu gu 'di/ /drin 'khor thabs med pa'i thugs rjer nges/ lo nyer gnyis dus su tshigs snga ma'i/ /mkhan slob dpon dge 'dun bcu tshogs dbus/ /gnas 'phrul snang shākya mu ni'i drung / khrims tshangs spyod kyi gtso bo bsnyen par rdzogs/ /der mkhan chen 'gro ba'i bla ma'i drung / /dpal rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa yi/ /gsung dri med 'ga' sogs lung gi (12na)rigs/ /'gro gang che sna tshogs kha yar thob/ /phyi tha snyad mkhyen pa'i slob dpon 'gar/ /rtsis dkar nag snyan ngag sdeb sbyor dang / /ming mngon brjod ka tsan brda sprod gzhung / /don phyogs tsam rig pa'i bslab sbyangs gyi/ /zur rigs 'dzin padma rdo rje dang / /don yang zab thugs sgrub rnam gsum dang / /lha ma gshin gza' gdong dregs pa sogs/ /las rnam bzhi'i man ngag mtha' klas thob/ /blo mi bsrun bstan 'gro'i phan bde rnams/ /thabs du mas 'joms pa'i dgra sde'i tshogs/ /don bde chen rang snang mi bskyod pa'i/ /zhing dag pa'i mgron du bos snye bgyid/ /brda' 'dod rgyal tsam gyis btags min pa'i/ /don gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta/ /bod gangs can yul gyi dge ba'i dbang / /skad rnam gnyis smra ba'i smon 'gro bar/ /lha gzhen nu gdong drug bzhed srol gyi/ /gzhung dri ma med pa'i cha bsags mdo/ /dpal btsun pa zla ba'i tsand+ra ba/ /gnad zhib mor ri mos gtan la phab/ /yul dbus 'gyur du zla bral shanti pa'i/ /skyon kun bral sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung / /ming zad pa med pa'i 'chi med mdzod/ /tshul dgongs don ma lus lhug par bkrol/ /nyams 'gyur ba stong gi 'dzum zhal can/ /ngag smra ba'i 'byung gnas me long gi /don snga na med pa'i legs bshad kyi/ /mi kho bo'i rna bar bdud rtsi byin/ /dpal dus 'khor dbyangs 'char rtsis kyi gzhung / /thon sa sbyo ṭa yi sum rtags sogs/ /bod cher rlom phal gyis shes min pa'i/ /yid kun dga' bskyed pa'i ltad mo mthong / /yul rgya bal bod 'dir bsod nams kyi/ /zhing dam par bskrun pa'i (12ba〉skyi gzugs dang / /gtor rgya nag gi rol —426

'khrungs rabs kyi zhing bkod rtogs brjod gsal ba'i me long (bdacha gan gos sogs/ /yongs dngos po'i brtags thabs ji snyed cig /tshig dam dum bcad pa'i rtsom pa dang / /skad rdo chag sgrigs kyi rigs sbyar la/ /rang mkhas par sgrub pa'i re ba dag /byed ma dgos mkhas dbang khyod kyi drin/ /rje bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel la/ /dpal byang chub lam rim 'dus pa yi/ gnad 'khrul med rgyal dbang myong kha pa'i/ /lugs ji bzhin zhib mor nyan pa'i tshe/ /chos mtha' dag mngon sum lag mthil nang / /da ston par 'dug snyam byed nus pa'i/ /'chad mkhas la zla bral rnam dpyod mchog /de bsams kyin mkhas pa'i
