yang rtser khums/ /rigs kun khyab padma badzra las/ /dpal theg pa'i yang rtse bzang thal sogs/ /dbang rig gtad nyams 'khrid rgyab brten lung / /zab rgya che'i bdud rtsi rmad du byung / /mgon rdo rje 'chang dbang bsod nams drung / /chos yang zab gsung ngag slob bshad mchog /dbang rdo rje phreng sogs spyi bka' dang / /g.yin zur bka' mang po'i smin grol mdzad/ /lar gsang chen gyi bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ /pha rdo rje 'chang dbang rnam pa gnyis/ /yongs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i zlos gar gyi/ /bod gangs can 'di 'og min zhing du byas/ khas nyer blangs bslab la nan tan dang / /yid lhag bsam kyis rab drangs bshad sgrub sogs/ /gang ci nus su byed par rlom 'di yang / /rten dal 'byor don ldan du byas saṃ snyam/ /blo nang du bkug nas nyer bsams na/ /don go yul du lus pa'i kha bshad kyis/ /gzhan 'gro phan du rlom pa'i rnam g.yeng 'di/ /kun thabs mkhas kyis phung ba'i bslu brid mkhan/ /gnas ngan song gi sdug bsngal me longs dong / /srid 'khor ba'i btson dong mtha' med nags/ /srog mi rtag glog (13na)gi rol gar mkhan/ /'di mthong bzhin sgrub las g.yel bas nongs/ / sngon chos brgyad gdon gyi dbang song ba'i/ /tshe don med du 'das pa'i lhag ma la/ /lha dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje yis/ /dus gtan mdun 'grub pa'i bka' drin zhu/ /gong gi zhing bkod rnams kyi 'phros las mgrin bzang gzig pags gyon pa'i ngang tshul ltar/ bdag gispyod tshul cung zad bri bar 'dod na/ bshad ma thag pa'i tshigs bcad rnams ha cang mangs par 'gyur bas po ta la'i sa 'dul la yongasaskabs/ /'phags pa lo ke shwa ra phebs pa'i byin rlabs kyis ngo mtshar ba byung tshul dang / lha sa'i gser thog gi rab gnas la yongs—427

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shetshul tsam bris na rgyas bsdus 'tsham par mngon no/ /e ma srid pa'i me sku1nga ngos/ /skyes rabs gzugs brnyan grangs med pa/ tan ra ba'i ngo mtshar ltad mo la/ /blo ldan phal cher yengs sam snyam/ /snyan ngag srad bu la brgyus pa'i/ /don gyi rin chen phreng ba 'di/ /dpyod ldan mdzes byed mgul rgyan du/ /blo gros bi shwa ga rmas spel/ /dge bas 'gro kun ma lubs pa/ /phyag na padmas rjes bzung ste/ /gru 'dzin dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /bde chen dpal la spyod par shog /ces 'khrungs rabs zhal thang gra rtsar la/ /bla ma so so'i mdzad pa 'gangs che ba 'ga' zhig gi zhing bkod sa bon gyi tho dang / de kha'i bsdus don gyi tshig bcad thang gar bris chog pa'i rtsis dang bcas pa 'di ni/ sbus srang pa dkon gnyer smyon pas bskul ba'i ngor/ za hor gyi bzhes pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /'di dang thugs rgyud gcig pa 'ga' zhig phyogs gcig tu brgyud pa'i nges pa ni med do/ /—428

ra༅༅/ /snyan mgur gsang gsum yid bzhin char 'bebs bzhugs tre(/ /༄༅/ /'gro ngor sangs rgyas dang byang sems/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho yi rdul snyed/ /kun 'dusagacig chog gi skyabs mgon/ /o rgyan mkhan po des rjes zungs/ /snod bcud 'khor 'das kyi ngang tshul/ /long med myur du rang 'jig pa/ /rigs drug 'khor ba yi sdug bsngal/ /bsams tshe snying rlung zhig ldang ngo / /dkar nag las 'bras ni phra bas/ /dge sdig blang dor gyi sgrub rten/ /dal 'byor lan gcig rang rnyed 'di/ /don med stong log tu ma gtong / /bslu med gto mdun gyi skyabs mgon/ /rtsa gsum dkon cog tu nges so/ /sangs rgyas rang bcas 'di ma tshor/ /blun rmongs don phyir du sems bskyed/ /thog med nas bsags kyi sdig lhung / /yig brgya'i chu rgyun gyis bkru'o/ /snang srid 'khor 'das kyi maṇḍal/ /gnas lugs ngo 'phrod kyis 'bul lo/ /rang sems bla ma ru shes pas/ /byin rlabs gzhan 'tshol zhig ma khom/ /dge tshogs kun bzang gi rang zhal/ /rang ngo 'phrod phyir du bsngo'o//'khor 'das ru shan zhig phye nas/ /srid 'di phyi phyag gcig btsal la/ /rigs drug 'khor ba yi sa bon/ /'bru gsum me lce yis bsregs song / /sgo gsum tha mal gyi chen ldog /sku gsum sa (2na)bon de gdab bo/ /lus ngag yid gsum de khong glod/ /'dzin pa dang grol ba de blo bde/ /gzung 'dzin rang bzhin gyis stong pa/ /gnyis med snang ba yi sems 'dir/ btsal kyang mi rnyed pas stong pa//snang stong zung du rang 'jug pa/ /dbyer med brjod bral gyi gnas lugs/ /dri med dag pa yi sangs rgyas/ /wal le sing nge ru rjen par/ /rtog tshogs 'phro 'du rnams rgyang srings/ /rtse gcig gzung phur de ma 'debs/ /yang blang re dogs kyis ma bslad/ /gsal la 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /dngas la phyi —429

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbar ble bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shenang kho med pa/ /sangs kyang 'chal ba ru ma shor/ /nges bzung bral ba yi zang thal/ /khyab brdal rang babs kyi rjen pa/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems nyid/ /sgrib gnyis phra mo yi mun pas/ /ma gos nyi ma yi snying po/ 'gyur med chos sku yi rang bzhin/ /rang ngo shes pa ru gshog cig /tsitta sha sgron gyi dbus su/ nang dbyings gzhen nu yi bum sku'i/ /rang gdangs rtsa sgron gyi lam brgyud/ /rgyang bzhag chu sgron gyi sgor thon/ /phyi dbyings rnam dag gi sgron mer/ /thig le phyag mtshan dang sku shar/ shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma/ /snang bzhi pha mtha' ru phyin tshe/ /'ja' lus 'pho ba ni chen (2ba)po'i/ /sku 'grub kun bzang gi rang zhal/ /mthong yang sna tshogs kyi sprul pa'i/ /'phrin las 'bad med de ngo mtshar/ /le los tshe 'di ru ma grol/ /don med sna tshogs kyi 'du 'dzi/ /ded dpon gser gling du phyin ltar/ /skye gnas bar do la mtha' spyad/ /'chi ba bar do yi 'od gsal/ /rgyal po'i bka' 'phrin bzhin ma brjed/ /chos nyid bar do la rang byan/ /chud pas ma pang du bu bcug /srid pa bar do zhig shar yang //yur bkod chags la wa 'dzugs/ /mkhas rlom chos pa yi mal du/ /tha mal phung po zhig 'jog tshe/ /bar do rnam drug gi bla ma/ /sngags 'chang rgan po tsho'i gdengs tshad/ /mchog dman kun bgrod kyi lam 'dir/ /'jigs na gdams pa 'di nyams long / /chos nyid mngon sum gyi don tsam/ /mthong yang g.yeng 'byer gyis ma bsgoms/ /bar do dred chad kho nyams 'og /chud pa'i gdengs tshad de med rnams/ /srid pa bar do yi snang tshul/ /rmi lam lta bu ru shar tshe/ /sngon sgom bzang po yi bag chags/ /chos nyid 'gyur med kyi bden pa/ /rigs 'dzin bla ma yi byin rlabs/ /thabs shes zung 'brel gyi mthu las/ /gdod nas snying dbus su rang chas/ /zhi ba bzhi bcu yi rtsa gnyis/ /zhing bgrod ston pa rnams zhal mjal/ /chos nyan nyon mongs lnga rang dag /klad pa dung khang gi khro bo/ /lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor/ /sngon bzhin zhugs pa yi 'dod ma'i/ /zhing la skad cig gis grol te/ /sku dang ye shes la 'bral med/ /dus gsum 'gyur med du bzhugs kyang / /nam mkha'i pha mtha' yis 'jal dka'/ /gang la gang 'dul gyi sems can/ /don phyir 'khor ba ni ji srid/ /stong min bzhugs pa de —430

snyan mgur gsang gsum med bzhin char 'bebs (bde.a ho/ grub mtha' rnam bzhi de 'dzin pa'i/ /rgya gar (3na)'phags yul gyi paṇa chen/ /gangs can mkhas grub kyi bzhed pa'i/ /zab zab chos tshul de mang yang / /bgrang yas rgyud sde yi nying khu/ /pad 'byung bi mā la'i zab chos/ khregs chod thod brgal gyi gdams pa/ /rtogs grol dus gcig 'di blo bde/ /tshe 'di'i gdos bcas kyi phung po/ /'ja' lus 'od sku ru grol 'dod/ /skal ldan las 'phro tsho sad rnams/ /snying dbus dpal be'u ru chongs shig /ces pa'ang dbang chen gyi sprul par lung gis zin pa thugs sras sprul sku bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes nan gyis bskul ma mdzad par brten rang la nyams rtogs kyi yon tan dang mgur ma'i rigs brtsom par byang ba zhig med kyang g.yar khral tsam du za hor gyi bande gang shar rang grol gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /sarba maṅga lo// //

ra༅༅/ /lam yig rang gzugs gsal ston dri bral me long bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /na maḥ gar su sti/ med byung ngo mtshar legs bshad dal 'gro'i klong / /nam yang da pa med pa'i tshig gi gter/ /skyug mkhas tshangs pa'i bu mo dzaḥ/ /snying dbus bzhugs la ngag gi mchog sbyin stsol//'khor 'das gnyis med don dam bde ba cher/ /bzang ga blang dang dor bya'i yul bral yang / / kun rdzob rdzun pa'i phugs dong ma rdib bar/ /'khrul pa'i ltad mo sna tshogs ci yang mthong / /gtsug lag rgya mtshor thos pa'i blo ldan yang / /tshul bzhin bsgrub las g.yel ba'i snyoms las bdag /deng dus bstan 'dzin kun gyi ngang tshul ltar/ /rang don phugs bcug gzhan phan phyir ngom dus/ /yid 'ong 'jam mnyen 'dab mas snying phug pa'i/ /mas gyi grong du nye ba'i ngur pa zung / /'dir snang bde ba'i srid pa gsar bzhengs la/ /bsros nas lan gnyis 'phur ba'i phyi ma'i dus/ /grangs med skye bo'i yid la zug rngu'i 'khrun/ /'byin pa'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs na yang / /cig shos chu lha'i phang par gum pa na/ /rdo rje sna ldan ston chen rang mtshang bstan/ /brgya phrag thabs kyis phan bde'i myu gu dang / /bskrun pa'i ngang tshul ldan (2na)zhes dbyar gyi rnga/ /mthon po'i mkha' nas snyan pa'i sgra sgrog par/ /mi 'dod zhing sa de ni gdon gyis brlams/ /rang gzhan 'khrul nus kla klo dbang byed mkhan/ /dge ba'i ngang tshul las 'gongs sprul nag lce/ /phan byed tsandan sdong por rab 'khril bas/ shes ldan 'gro rnams nye ba'i skal pa phra/ /dkar nag las kyis nyer byin pa'i/ /lnga brgya tha ma'i me long du/ /skye dgu'i bde sdug kun 'char na/ /byed po gcig tu 'dzin nus su/ /gos ser can mtshungs 'gro mang gi /spyod tshul sgyu ma'i sprul bsgyur dag /yi ger 'god pa bdag 'dra las/ /tshangs pa yis kyang ji ltar nus/ /—432

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshe'on kyang a wa dhu tī la/ /mos blor spyod pa'i skyom bu ba/ /phyogs med rgyal khams myul ba'i gtam/ /yi ge'i phreng bar cung zad spel/ /bsod nams stobs kyis yangs pa'i sa chen por/ /rtsod pa'i dus kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i lha/ shar phyogs rgyal pos mngags pa'i pho nya ba/ /kun 'jig lo la gangs can yul grur 'byor/ /de'i tshe gong ma'i gser gyi zhal lung du/ shwakya'i bstan la zhugs pa'i sdom brtson khyod/ /rgya hor (2ba)yul gyi bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tsho'i ched/ /ring min shog ces bsgo ba'i tshig thos tshe/ /kye ma rang nyid phyi ma ngan song du/ /mi skye'i gdengs tshad tsam yang mi ldan par/ /gzhan phan 'dren par grags zhes rlom pa ni/ /rang gzhan slu ba'i byed po yin nam snyam/ /sngon chad thun mtshams mdog can sram mang pos/ /phyogs lhung brag rir gnas pa'i gnyis skyes tshogs/ /nya sha mkho dgu'i 'byor pas tshim byas pa'i/ /don de yid la brnags pa'i ba tso 'gas/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i snyan pa'i gtam/ /ma brtags rna ba'i yul du mngar ba'i ro/ /pi wang lta bur 'brol yang lus phra mas/ /chags bral drang srong g.yo bar ga la nus/ /'on kyang na tshod bcu dgur babs pa'i tshe/ /srong btsan sgrub pa'i bsti gnas pha bong khar/ /dus gsum kun gzigs rdo rje 'chang dbang des/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus/ /nam zhig khyod nyid tong khun rgyal po yi/ /pho brang chen por 'gro zhes gsung ba dag /skabs der ku rer go yang de dus kyi/ /'byung 'gyur lung du bstan par gor ma chag /rang lo nyer bdun dus la babs pa'i tshe/ /rigs 'dzin padma'i gdung 'tshob yol mo bas/ /da lta'i sog po 'di min shar phyogs nas/ /'bod cing myur du ldog ces gsung ba'ang dran/ /e ma lkog gyur chos kun me long gi /gzugs brnyan ji bzhin gzigs pa de mthong tshe/ /pho tshod rdzun gtam bsgrigs pa'i mngon shes mkhan/ /ri mor bris pa'i mar me'i spun zla bzhin/ /de ltar nyin zhag du ma'i ras gzhi la/ /kun rtog pir gyis ri mo bris pa'i mtha'/ /mi 'dod (3na)bzhin du 'ong zhes dam 'cha' ba/ /blun rmongs byis pa kun gyi ngang tshul yin/ /de nas bgrang bya gsum 'das lcags yos lor nges par 'degs la mngon phyogs sta gon du/ /grags pa don ldan chos rgyal mes dbon gyi/ /sprul pa'i —433

lam yig rang gzugs gsal ston dri bral me long / (banagatsug lag khang rnams mjal sems nas/ /phun tsho gos 'bras bu smin pa'i dga' ston can/ /khrums zla'i nyer dgur dpal ldan 'bras spungs nas/ /chas te gangs can dbus 'gyur rdo rje gdan/ /shākya'i pho brang bya 'dabs gam du 'byor/ /dus mtshungs gong mas mngags pa'i skya ser lnga/ /dar zab gser dngul nor bu'i phreng ba sogs/ /mkho dgu'i 'byor par bcas te rgyal po'i lung / /'jigs med seṅge'i nga ro bzhin du sgrog /de'i tshe chos sde rnam gsum mkhan slob dang / /byang phyogs sa skyong la sogs mgrin gcig tu/ shar phyogs tsi na'i yul grur khyod 'gro na/ /lo gsum tshun las mi 'byangs yong ba dang / /gangs can phan bde'i nyer 'tsho mchod yon gnyis/ /rgyal khab che las mi g.yo bzhugs dgos pa'i/ /rgyu mtshan nan tar gsung yang phyi ma'i don/ /re zhig 'khyags pa'i sbubs su chu bzhin gab/ /dbyug zla'i tshes lngar dbu ba'i do shal can/ /mtho mthing skra yi lan tshar rab g.yo zhing / /'dzum pa'i rlabs phreng 'khrigs pa'i chu klung na/ /gzings las pha rol thogs med bgrod pa'i tshe/ /bskal dus bzang por btsas pa'i sngon gyi mi/ /sa skyong yid bzhin mchod yon lhan cig par/ /'byor te ras dkar lding khang bkod legs pa/ /dmar ser (3ba)rgya ja'i btung ba skyems su drangs/ /de nas bshul du zhugs te phyin pa na/ /snang ba mtha' yas nyid gi bsti gnas zung / /rab g.yeng dbang gis mjal ba ma khom yang / /phyi nas dang ba'i yid kyis smon lam byas/ /rim gyis 'chi med yul la co 'dri ba'i/ /grong mang bgrod mthar gnam la snyeg pa'i mkhar/ /sdig rgyun gcong rong mi ldan 'jam pa'i thang / /gsang sngags bde ba chen po'i rdzong du slebs/ /der ni byang phyogs mi yi rje bo bas/ /mi 'dzad bza' gas 'dod dgu char bsnyil tshe/ /dmod pa'i 'bun bu 'byin pa'i bram ze rnams/ /drang srong bsam gto gsum pa bzhin du gyur/ /tshe rta lo ma gyon ma'i rjes gnang dang / /snying po don gsum 'khrid kyi dmigs rim sogs/ /ba ched pa'i chos dang kun mkhyen rgyal ba yi/ /'phel gdung yid bzhin nor bu'i rten mjal phul/ /rnam rgyal khang bzang lta bu'i tshoms chen der/ /grangs med mchog dman skye dgu'i tshogs gral du/ /bdag dang spe dmar nas kyis 'phros gleng ba/ /mi res pus —434

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemor babs pa'i chag theb bzhin/ /tshes brgyad snga bar lam du zhugs pa'i dus/ /thos 'dzin dum bur gcod 'dra'i grang ngar ni/ /'byung 'gyur byang phyogs yul gyi snang tshul rnams/ /'jig rten mes pos dngos su bstan nam snyam/ /de nas rgyang grags gsum tsam 'das pa'i sar/ /bkra shis ljongs su grags pa'i sde dgon gyis/ /nyi shar gung gi gdugs tshod legs bstar zhing / /zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor chos 'brel byas/ /de'i nyin 'jam dbyangs bla ma btsong kha pas/ /zung (4na tshe sog mngon du mdzad pa'i 'og min nas/ /dpal ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling chen po/ /mngon sum mthong bas skal pa bzang por gyur/ /rlung sems sku de dag pa'i zhing gshegs kyang / /lus can bsod nams gzhin gyur rags pa'i gdung / /bzhugs gnas rin cen gnyis pa'i mchod sdong che/ /kai la sha yi mdzes pa 'phrog pa'i drung / /nges pa don gyi rgyu mtshan yongs rig pa'i/ /mi phyed dang ba'i dad pas nyer drangs nas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde rgyas pa yi/ /dri med dag pa'i smon lam mtshams sbyor bskrun/ /kun dga' ra bar shong dka'i 'dus pa tshogs/ /legs bshad gdub sil 'brol pa ngang pa'i khyur/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i dgongs don rtogs dka' ba/ /rmongs rtul bdag 'dras 'chang ba'i khur chen blangs/ /spyi sger du mas bsnyen bkur bzhugs gral du/ /paṇa chen smon 'gro lo tsā glang phu nas/ /bshad pas 'byams klas skabs 'gar slob dpon rnams/ /rtsod ngag rig pa'i thog mda' nyug nyug mdzad/ /skor lam mtshon cha ltar gzigs brag ri'i ngos/ /dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa mtshon 'dra ba'i/ /grangs med tshar du dngar ba'i rang byon dang / /skabs 'gar gnas brtan rgan pos sgro btags mthong / /sa spyod zhabs su 'brang ba'i phyogs bral mi/ /sna tshogs grub mtha' rgyud bslad log rtog mkhan/ /mang zhig chu klung khrag tu mthong srid kyang / /rnam dpyod ldan rnams gnas der mi gus su/ /gdugs gcig 'grod tshe ming dang don mthun pa'i/ /dge skyon rjen par ston pa'i yul gru der/ /tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs ma'i (4ba)khog tu/ /zhugs dang mjal zhing gleng mo zhib tu byas/ /bod 'bangs bde ba'i thabs tshul 'dri ba las/ /rang gi gdul bya snyan grags don gnyer ba'i/ /gleng —435

lam yig rang gzugs gsal ston dri bral me long (bdabarjod bgyi bar ma dran blun rmongs bdag /bsams tshe tsu ta'i yul gyi rkang gnyis bzhin/ /gnas skabs 'gro kun mgu ba'i mchod sbyin gyis/ /'jam par 'jig rten grags pa'i rjesangs kyang / /nyams kyis dpyad na mi bsrun dregs pa'i lha/ /chu skyar ting 'dzin bsgom par kho bo dogs/ /mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam tshig gnyan po de/ /yang bskyar tshul du bka' rtags phyag rgya che/ /spyi bor bkod nasarigs 'dzin brgyud pa yi/ /phyag len 'khrul pa med pa'i dam bzhag byas/ /yul grong 'ga' zhig 'das tshe gung mkhar zhes/ /'tshe ba chos su smra ba'i sgom pa'i grwa/ /bsags pa'i 'bras smin bshul du kho shol ches/ /gsar bskrun gzhis kur 'dod yon char du bsnyil/ /sngon dus phyag chen rgan po'i srol 'dzin mkhar/ /ring min chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs nas/ /rgyal dbang padma'i gdung 'tshob 'bri gung pa/ /ngos dang 'phrad bzhed ched gnyer phebs dang mjal/ /bka' gter chos las brtsams pa'i 'phros gleng dag /mol tshe chu 'go gangs kyi dpe ji bzhin/ /mnga' ris rigs 'dzin yab sras rjes 'brangs pa'i/ /rnam dpyod de kos g.yin yid cis mi 'phrog /snod bcud kun la ya nga'i 'jigs skrag gi /skad ngan ca co sgrog pa'i chu phran rnams/ /skyid shong lung par rings pasang la med du/ /bab pa'i yul gru mang 'das mkhar skya'i mdor/ /sdodagon gnyis kyis gung gi bro bstab cing / /btags ming don dang mthun (ldan)pa'i skam yer du/ /chos ste rin chen gling pa'i 'dus sdornams/ /'ongs pa'i 'dod pa'i re ba ji bzhin bskang / /ring min grong gis dben pa'i 'brog dgon pa/ /sa mthar 'khyar ba'i mi yi dran sos pa/ /sman ljongs lung par skyes rnams byang stongs su/ /slesasnyam gdung ba bskyed pa'i la brgal tshe/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pas/ /byin brlabs rdzing phyi'i gtsug lag khang chen por/ /thugs rje'i sprin phung g.yo ba'i byams mgon dang / /chu lha'i phyogs nas byon pa'i dngul gdung mjal/ /so thar khrims dang ldan pa'i 'dus pa sde/ /gnag phyugs thob par 'dzin pa'i 'brog pa'i gling / /skya ser mang pos bsnyen bkur ma rdzogs par/ /nyin zhag gnyis la gdan gung bcu tsam bstab/ de nas bsam gtan gling gi dgon pa'i mdo/ /chu chen —436

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedrag tu 'bab pa'i zam pa'i snar/ /dus mtha'i rlung la 'gran bzod bser bu'i khrod/ /'khrul zhig bla mar bcas pasashang len mdzad/ /de nub ri bo'i spo la phan bde'i dgon/ /zhig gsos klungs su byas pa'i khang pa'i 'dabs/ /mi rjes sems ngo sprad pa'i sgom chen rnams/ /srab ther gos la brten pa'i ras 'bud btang / /tshes grangs bcu dgu'i nang par bteg pa na/ /dus gsum rgyal bsalung bstan chos 'khor rgyal/ /sbas yul dkar mo ljongs su slebs pa na/ /o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling yang gzhan du ci/ /gnyug mar gnas dang glo bur lhags pa yi/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i khrims ldan ngang pa'i khyu/ /legs bshad mgrin pa'i rdza rnga sgrog mthong tshe/ /byed pos thub bstan (5ba)gsar du bskrun pa bzhin/ /bkod pas khyad 'phags gtsug lag khang chen der/ /mthong bas don ldan mi pham mgon po'i sku/ /mthong tshe ma 'ongasasangasargyasabyamasamagon de/ /bsod namasazhing du da lta byon nam snyam/ /dbang drag 'phrin lasarol pa'i dur khrod che/ /dam can sprin bzhin 'du ba'i mgon khang rnams/ /spyan gzigs mchod bstod ba li rgyan ldan dang / /dam bzhag las bzhi'i 'phrin las rgyas par bcol/ /spyi sger sosor bzhed pa'i dbang lung dang / /rab byung bsnyen rdzogs cho ga bstar ba sogs/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las spel ba lhur len las/ /chos brgyad bya bsanyin mtshan 'dasapa med/ /srid gsum bdag mo'i bla mtsho mjal ba'i tshe/ /sngon chad mig gi yul du ma myong ba'i/ /yul mkhar chu gling myang ngam thang la sogs/ /ma phyin tsi nar 'grod pa'i lam kun mthong / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro kun 'du dga' ba'i tshal/ /chos srung rgya mtsho 'du ba'i bsti gnas der/ /sgo gsum g.yeng bas mi 'da' bcad rgya'i skabs/ /sna tshogasanyamasakyi rol ba ci yang 'char/ /smin drug zla ba'i yar ches brgyad kyi nyin/ /dkar mo'i ljongs nasabateg pa'i zhag gi sa/ /tshang tshing nags tshal stug po 'khrigs pa'i khrod/ /drang srong dka' thub bsten pa lta bur gnas/ /sang nyin rgyal ba gnyis par ngo mtshar gyi/ /gzigasasnang rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnasabasam gling gi /byin brlabasagazi byin 'bar ba'i phug pa dang / /sbyor drug mun 'khrid bstar ba'i khang bu mjal/ /kye ma sngon dusadam pa'i bsti gnasamachog /bar du —437—

lam yig rang gzugs gsal ston dri bral me long (bdablo gsal (6na)mang po'i spyod yul can/ /deng dus bshang gcis gang ba'i mi gtsang khrod/ /'dus byas mtshan nyid 'gro la ston pa bzhin/ /de nas 'ongs tshe ring min lung pa'i mdor/ /srin yul laṅka'i kheng 'phrog btsan po'i rdzong / shar phyogs 'ol kha stag rtse'i nye 'dabs kyi/ khrus kyi rdzing bu'i ngos su bde bar son/ /'thor rlung rgyud las drangs pa'i grong pa'i mdar/ /brnag dka'i zug rngu 'byin pa rnon po'i mtshon/ /dro 'jam reg bya dum bur bcad pa na/ /sngon bsags dkar min 'bras bu rdol ba bzhin/ /nyin gcig rdzong du dus ston la phyin tshe/ /lho phyogs zhig tu 'cha' ba'i khang rul rnams/ /gor khebs mkhregs pa'i khang gsar bskrun mthong bas/ /byed po dbus gshong skye bo yin par go /bsod nams zhing mchog ngo mtshar rgyal ba'i bka'/ /yi ge'i phreng bar spel ba'i pu sta ka /gsar bskrun brgya phrag brgyal bar shis brjod kyi/ /me rtag sil ma'i tshogs kun gcal du bkram/ /grangs med 'dus pa'i skya ser tshogs rnams la/ /yig drug bzlas lung bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs/ /so so'i 'dod dang mthun pa'i chos sbyin gyi/ /sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye ba'i cho ga bstar/ /ris med nad kyi gnyen po tsha chu'i rdzing / kha drag dbang chen rnams kyis bsrungs ba na/ /kun la rang dbang spyod pa'i gnas bral bas/ /chu la bre 'jal don de dngos su mthong / /phan tshun lung pa kha dog gcong rong gi /mi bzad g.yang sa ldan pa'i 'phrang ring po/ /bgrod dka'i la lam brgal tshe pa ltu 'gram/ /lha rigs bdud rtsi'i dbang pos (6ba)bsnyen bkur bstabs/ /rnam rtog thog rdzir gtong nus lab sgron ma'i/ /sgrub gnas gcod yul gdams pa'i gter gyi mdzod/ /zangs ri khang dmar zhes grags bar 'das tshe/ /yid 'ong rdzong dang grong khyer bkod pa mthong / /de na za hor rigs ldan dbang mo des/ /gsar bskrun lha yi khang par co 'dri bar/ /phun tshogs bsnyen bskur bstabs dang lhan cig par/ /dgun kyang sos kyi dro 'jam mes pos bskrun/ /de nas gnam sngon 'khyil 'dra'i pa klu'i klung / /brgal tshe lha rigs mi dbang blon bcas rnams/ /bsod nams lang tsho rgyas pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /mdun bsus chad gar rdzong du nye bar slebs/ /de na khul dog sge khung khab mig tsam/ /nyin mo mun —438

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shepa'i smag rum stug po can/ /cung zad mtshan mo'i cha la gsal 'dra der/ /zhag bzhir 'byung po'i bya yi brtul zhugs blangs/ /'on kyang mkhyen dpyod 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu la/ /'gran bzod lho rgyud sa yi tshangs pa des/ /bkod pas mdzes pa'i longs spyod char chen pos/ /kun gyi mgrin pa'i 'khor lo dog por byas/ /gung gi dus ston bstabs pa'i sder kha rnams/ /srod la mar me spar nas 'dren byed pa'i/ /bzhugs gral nyi ma'i 'khor lo grol ba dang / /sang gi skya rengs 'char ba mnyam du byas//rtog ge'i khengs pas dregs pa'i las chen pa/ /gtsug lag rgya mtsho mthong bas snying gas te/ /smra ba'i srog dang bral ba'i mu cor ro/ /legs bshad mtshon gyis phub kyang don gyis stongs/ /lha rigs rje blon nye dbang tshogs bcas la/ /'phags yul rnal 'byor dbang mo'i (7na)bzhed gzhung gi /tshe dbang skyer snang lugs kyi rta mgrin gnyis/ /sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i cho gas phul/ /sdodagon bdun du grags sogs e rong gi /skya ser mang po tshogs pa'i zang zing gi /'du 'god 'gal me'i 'khor lo lta bu des/ /srid pa 'khor ba'i ngang tshul ston pa bzhin/ /slar yang klung chen lo hi ta brgal te/ /sngon dus dam pa'i bsti gnas gsas khang rtse/ /bar du btsan po'i mkhar gyi ltag ri'i rdzong / / deng dus yang dgon zhes grags kun dang 'byor/ /gnas der dngos stobs rigs pa'i khab mig la//shes bya'i srad bu mtha' dag brgyud nus pa'i/ /lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i 'dus pa'i sdes/ /bsnyen bkur bla ma'i rnal 'byor chos 'brel phul/ /sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang / /grwa rkyang gnas mal bde ba'i shag skor dang / /zang zing 'byor pa'i 'du 'god gnyer khang sogs/ /kun la shis pa brjod pa'i me tog gtor/ /mar lam tshong 'dus brag kha'i tshoms chen du/ /byang phyogs sa dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje yis/ /longs spyod char sprin lta bur g.yo ba las/ /'ongs pa'i mchod sbyin char rgyun ci yang phab/ /pha mtha' mi mngon yar rgyab gtsang chu'i klung / /dka' tshegs chung ngus bgrod thabs lcags kyi zam/ /thang stong rgyal po'i byin rlabs gzugs can du/ grub pa'i 'og der nyang po'i gru las bgrod/ /sngon dus mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i chos grwa tshe/ /deng dus phun tshogs 'dod —439

lam yig rang gzugs gsal ston dri bral me long (bdadagu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /ces dang bla g.yer sa dge'i sde zung gis/ /phu dud ri mor bya ba dang (7ba)blangs nas/ /mar me mdzad pa'i gtsug rgyan gser gling pa'i/ /thugs dam zas gtsang sras po'i sku'i snang brnyan/ /mthong thos dran dang reg pas rnam grol ba/ /mjal 'di legs byas rgya mtsho'i zong gis bsgrubs/ /'khon rigs 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis/ /byin brlabs chos srung 'du ba'i bsam gtan gling / /mjal tshe sngon gnas sad 'dra'i dga' ba dang / /lhan cig smon lam 'phrin bcol nan tan byas/ /de dang 'brel bar 'dir snang phun tshogs kun/ /rmi lam ltar mthong sna shag grub chen pas/ /padma'i sku tshab las 'phro gling pa yi/ /gter byon yid bzhin ratna 'gro 'dul byin/ /de'i nub gangs can yongs kyi lha gcig pu/ /bla dbon zung du 'jug pa'i gong ma che'i/ /pho brang 'dzam gling rgyan gcig sne sdong rtser/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i mdun bsus 'byor/ /de'i nub lnga mchod chen mo'i dus ston dang / / 'grig pa'i mar me tshar du dngar ba'i phreng / /phyogs mtshams steng 'og ma lus yongs khyab pa/ /sa la rgyu skar grong khyer 'phos pa bzhin/ /sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i tshoms chen du/ /'dzad med 'dod dgu dus ston tshogs pa'i dbus/ /sman lung rigs sngags 'chang ba snga 'gyur las/ /brtsams pa'i legs bshad rgyud mang ci yang 'brol/ /rlangs ston 'gro ba'i mgon po yab sras la/ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang dang / /phyag drug gtor dbang bar chad kun sel gnyis/ /bzhes pa'i don dang sbyar nas rgyas par phul/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /mtshan brgyad gzugs su shar ba'i stang stabs (8na 〉 77sa/ /gzigs mo mtshar du dngar ba de mthong tshe/ /o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling yang gzhan du ci/ /dus der he ru ka yi stang stabs kyis/ /nag phyogs bdud sde phye mar 'thag pa'i 'chams/ /lha gzigs dam pa'i sku yi lus 'gyur gyis/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi khengs pa thung ngur byas/ /rgyal po'i pho brang chen po'i nye 'dabs kun/ /grangasamed sde dpon tshogs pa'i khang bzang gis/ /legs bskor phal cher gyang rnal 'dre can ltar/ gyur pa'i mi rtag 'gro la ston pa bzhin/ /paṇa grub dbang po nags kyi rin chen gyis/ /byin brlabs rgyud 440

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemagon gur gyi sku brnyan dang / /gong ma kun dga' legs pa'i phyag bzo yi/ /stobasa'aphrog zhing skyong dbang po'i snang brnyan mjal/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur mang po'i/ /mthu stobs gzi byin bskyed pa'i dur khrod che/ /dam can 'du ba'i gnas mchog de nyid las/ /gzhan pa'i bsil ba'i tshal de dmigs su med/ /bod 'bangs gnyen gcig lha gzigs ras pa yi/ /thugs dam 'khor mang mgon po'i zhal thang sogs/ /steng shod bar gyi mgon khang ma lus dang / /phur pa'i dzas phro'i dus su gong smyon gyis/ /sgrub pa'i ngo mtshar bstan pa'i zhabs rjes mjal/ /thub bstan rtsa ba nges par 'byung ba'i khrims/ /rgyas mdzad paṇa chen shākya shrī yi/ /lugs 'dzin jo bo stan gcig tshogs pa yis/ /bsnyen bkur bla ma'i rnal 'byor chos 'brel byas/ /gnas lnga mkhyen de'i thugs dam lhag pa'i lha /'jigs pa brgyad skyob dngos grub kun stsol ba'i/ /rgyal ba kun yum (8ba)rje btsun sgrol ma yi/ /sku brnyan mjal zhing smon lam mtshams sbyor byas/ /de nas rgyang grags gsum tsam 'das pa'i sang /phyag na padma'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul gar/ /bod 'bangs rgyal por shar ba srong btsan gyis/ /legs bskrun khra 'brug nye ba'i 'dabs su 'byor/ /gtsug lag khang bzang sku gsung thugs rten la/ /dngos bshams yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin dang / /lhan cig bstan 'gro phan bde rgyas pa yi/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i smon lam nan tan btab/ /khyams der sngon tshe bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor du/ /rgyal dbang padmas lha sras rje 'bangs rnams/ /smin byed sa stegs mthong bas don ldan pa/ mjal zhing gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab/ /chu sbur mig la snang ba tha mal grong / /phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas sprul pa'i gnas/ /nges pa'i don du dag pa'i zhing khams kyang / /gzhan du 'tshol bar byed pa byis pa'i blo/ /gangs can bstan pa'i nyer 'tsho dam pa 'dir/ /bsnyen bkur mchod pa dus kyis bskal ba yis/ /ches cher dman pa mthong bas rkyen byas te/ /mchod tshogs gaṅgā'i rgyun 'dra chad med btsugs/ /sngon byon rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /gtsug lag khang bzang gso dang mchod byed pa/ /gegs byed rang gi dgon sbugs chung ngu la/ /bsngags brjod byed pa phal cher bdud las —44/ —

lam yig rang gzugs gsal ston dri bral me long / (bdabazhin/ /gnas de'i chos srung dge bsnyen tshangs pa che/ /'ongs nas lung bstan sgra dbyangs sgrog byed pa/ /mthun pa'i rdzas phul 'phrin las nyer bcol zhing / /dam bzhag bcar tshe sku yi rnam 'gyur bstan/ /phyogs (9na)de'i ris med grub mtha' 'dus pa'i sde/ /kun la zang zing 'byor ba'i mchod sbyin sgo/ /mngon par bye ba'i 'dod dgu'i mtshams sbyor gyis/ /rnam thos bu yi mdun sa bzhin du byas/ /chos kun rig pa'i rtsal du rnam grol bas/ /mgrin pa'i rtsa kha bye ba'i kong chen pas/ /bod yul bde ba'i thabs kyi gleng mo dang / /khyab 'jug chen po'i gsang ba'i bla rdo byin/ /nyer brgyad nang par mtsho skyes rdo rje yis/ /byin brlabs tshe chu'i rgyun 'bab 'bum pa'i drung / /'byor tshe skam po'i rdo las gsher ba'i chu/ /chal chil g.yo ba'i ngo mtshar ltad mo mthong / /de'i nub lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan a ti sha'i/ /zhabs zung u dum wā ra nyer bkod pa'i/ /sol nag thang chen gtsug lag khang mjal zhing //pha mes brgyud pa'i chos srung mnyes par byas/ /rig can blon po 'byung ba'i sa dpyad kyi/ /ri ngogs pho brang 'ching bar stag rtse zhes/ /rnam rgyal khang bzang sa la 'phos 'dra der/ /gzigs mor mtshar ba'i bsu ba dang bcas 'byor/ /phyogs kun dgon dang yul gru'i khor yug can/ /rtsa bar rgyu skar lta bu'i grong khyer brdal/ /steng na mkha' la snyeg 'dra btsan po'i rdzong / /'di ko tshangs pas bskrun las gzhan sus nus/ /blo bzang grags snyan 'bar ba'i bstan pa la/ /rab gus sa hor tshe brtan rdo rje yis/ /nyer bskrun ri bo bde chen gtsug lag khang / /kun dga' ra bar bcas pa zhib tu myul/ /yang steng rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i lha yi sku/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyi rol pa mngon sum du/ /ston pa'i byed po pir thogs mkhyen brtse ba'i/ /bsngags brjod gleng mo phal (9ba ji ra drang po'i tshig /gnas der phun tshogs dus ston g.yu 'brug gi /sgra skad dbyangs su 'tsher ba'i bza' btung bcud/ /'chi med bza' shing ra ba nyul ba'i 'bras/ /star ga'i 'bras bu thob la bsnyems pa bzhin/ /gral der lung rigs smra ba'i mkhan chen pa/ /nyin bar mnal gyi 'od gsal ting 'dzin dang / /gang du ngos bzung bral ba'i 'phros gtam ni/ /'thug po'i gnyid la g.yar ba'i sla chos bzhin/ /de tshe grangs med khrom gyi sa chen —442

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shepor/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i shing rtas nyer drangs pa'i/ /'chi med dbang gi nor bu 'dren snyam yang / /mi bsrun gzhan 'phrul gnas kyi byed pos bkag /bgrang yas skye bo 'dus pa'i tshogs dbus su/ /sdodagon mtha' dag mgrin pa gcig pa'i dbyangs/ /snam phrug gtso bor gyur ba'i yul lugs dang / /bstun pa'i brgya phrag 'bul ba mtshar du dngar/ /chag mal 'byor ba'i dpal dang ldan pa'i rdzing / /'dren byed khab kyi mig bur drangs pa'i chu/ /dad pa'i 'phrul dang ldan pa'i nor bu'i zong / /pa klu'i klung tsam drangs la dka' ba med/ /bya nag gdung gis btsun pa'i sprul sku sogs/ /mchog dman bar ma'i skye bo sum brgya lhag /dge tshul bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dngos po la/ /bkod de rgyal ba'i bstan la ri mor byas/ /stod smad bar gyi ris bral 'dus pa'i sder/ /so so'i 'dod sbyar chos kyi 'brel ba dang / /'phral yun dge ba'i mthun rkyen bsgrub pa sogs/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'ang cung zad byas//za hor chos kyi rgyal po khu dbon dang / bee ro'i thugs sprul gter ston ra smi'i zhabs/ /(10nasgo chod yon zung du 'brel las nyer bskrun pa'i/ /theg mchog grub pa'i 'dus sde dpal ri bas/ /bod 'bangs don du rigs 'dzin padma 'byung / /yar ngo'i tshes bcur phebs zhes zhal 'ches pa'i mchod pa'i 'phrin las gyer ba'i stang stabs kyis/ /nag phyogs 'tshub ma'i rlung dang lhan cig bskrad/ /rang byon lnga ldan thugs ga'i rgya mtsho dang / /mi rje'i gzugs sku'i chu bo gcig 'dres kyang / /thun mong snang ngor rags pa'i za ma tog /sri zhur bskrun pa'i srong btsan dbang po'i steng / /bstan dang skye dgu'i phan bde spel ba dang / /sgos su za hor rigs la shis pa yi/ /phun tshogs rten 'grel bsgrigs tshe lha lam nas/ /me tog char dang 'ja' tshon gur khyim phub/ /rang 'dod lce gnyis rkyong ba'i 'byog po'i 'gros/ /mi ldan bod 'bangs bde ba'i lhag bsam dang / /lo paṇa rgyal blon rnams la dad pa'i mthus/ /ltas bzang byung gi bdag 'dra'i nus pas ci/ /de na mnga' bdag gsung sprul chos dbang gis/ /bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang shangs mtshal las/ /legs grub dpal mgon ma ning nag po yi/ /sku brnyan mjal zhing 'phrin las gnyer bcol byas/ /rta skad mngon sum dbyangs su 'tsher —443

lam yig rang gzugs gsal ston dri bral me long (bkabyed pa'i/ /dbang chen sku brnyan bzhugs pa'i khyams ra der/ /yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas tshogasabasags shing / /dri med rgya chen smon lam nan tan byas/ /bsams pa'i don kun grub pa rdo rje'i gsung / /thos pas srid zhi'i gdung sel pi waṃ sgra/ /sa mthar rgud pa'i 'khor lo bskor ba la/ /bde ba'i nyams ldan rna bar tsher ma bzhin/ /grwa pa mngon shes gdan sa (10ba)spyan g.yas dang / /bzang po'i la mo brgyud bar mngon phyogs tshe/ /rkun po'i bram zes ra skyes bor ba bzhin/ /sman ljongs skyid pa'i yar klungs phyogs su bteg /dus der ring phyogs zha ser 'dzin kun la/ /yang dag rdo rjes bya ba byas zin pa'i/ /mi rgan blon po mgar 'dra'i chos rgyal de/ kha ba'i ljongs su bzhugs pa'i zhal len mdzad/ /gtam de thos tshe shes ldan ma lus pa'i/ /yid kyi ngal gso'i gdung sel bla med kyang //byas pa drin du mi bzo mkhris nad can/ /gangs ri ser por snang la ci bya yod/ /de nub btsan thang g.yu yi lha khang 'dabs/ /dam pa'i ngang tshul ldan pa rlangs ston rje/ /yab sras zung dang mjal zhing 'phral yun du/ /rnam par dge ba'i gsung gleng ci yang byung / /'bras gshongs gnas sgo 'byed pa'i bka' babs can/ /zab don bstan pa rgyas mdzad lha btsun pas/ /ma 'ongs lung du bstan pa gsang ba'i tshig /thos che lkog gyur chos kun mngon sum bzhin/ /lam zhor btsan thang g.yu yi lha khang dang //bya sa ri zur gtsug lag khang mjal nas/ /gtsang chung gling khar grags pa'i grong chung 'dabs/ /byed pos thal ba'i rlung 'tshub gur du phub/ /mang thos mkhas pa'i gral du ma chud kyang / /btsun pos rim par bzung ba stag lung pa'i/ /zhabs drung tshul min spyod pa'i gar mkhan can/ /mdo khams phyogs nas phebs dang ngos kyis mjal/ /nang bar blo mda'i gzings las phyir brgal te/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i bsod nams mchod stong che/ /lugs gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i gtsug lag khang / /mthong thos dran reg don ldan sa der slebs/ /(11na8 'phral dbu rtse rigs gsum steng shod kun/ /zhib mor mjal yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de/ /snga phyi'i dus las ring 'dra'i long che zhing / /rgyal phur 'phrod kyang ma bsgrigs lhun rgyas grub/ /sang nyin dbu rtse rigs gsum gling phran rnams/ /zhib mjal mchod 444

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losebastod smon lam nan tan dang / /thub bstan rtsa lag mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i/ /dbu thod g.yu yi sgrol ma'i nang mjal zhus/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag dpon tse dmar ba/ /spyan gzigs ba lim rgyan gyis mnyes byas shing / /rdo rje'i phyag rgya bdud rtsi'i btung bar bcas/ /sngon gyi dam tshig gnyen po nan tan bskyar/ /srog bdag mi bsrun khros pa'i nyi zer gyis/ /cher rlom kun da dregs pa'i kha zum yang / /rig sngags 'chang ba'i rgyud kyi 'dab brgya pa/ /ngo mtshar ze'u 'bru bshad pa chos nyid yin/ /de'i nyin jo bo'i gling gsum ma gtogs pa'i/ /gling phran phyi nang rten kun mjal ba na/ /lo paṇa rgyal blon rnams la dad pa dang / /dga' dang spro ba phan tshun 'gran bzhin 'phel/ /yid 'ong bkod pas mdzes pa jo mo'i gling / /rnam gsum sang nyin snga dro'i char mjal nas/ /gung gi dus ston btsan po'i pho brang du/ /sa skyong mtsho skyes rdo rjes rgyas par bstabs/ /gung thang la khar rigs 'dzin padma yis/ /bzhag pa'i zhabs rjes 'gro ba'i mchod sdong che/ /lo chen bee ro'i phyag bzo'i rta mgrin sogs/ /byin rlabs sprin phung g.yo ba'i rten rnams mjal/ /nyi shu'i snga dro hal po ri yi rtser/ /byang gling zab gter bka' nan rab brjid kyis/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dam btags nas/ /bod yul bstan dang 'gro ba'i (11ba)phan bde bskrun/ /de tshe thog mar lha srin zhabrugs pa yis/ /mi bzad gnam lcags 'debs 'dra'i sprin nag dang / /thor rlung drag tu 'tshub pa mjug chog skabs/ /'ja' ltar yal te dro 'jam bde bas khyab/ /phun tshogs rten 'brel 'grig tshul 'dir brtags na/ /phung byed 'dren par rlom rnams 'dul ba'i gnyen/ /zab gter sgo 'byed gter ston grangs med zhig /'byon pa'i bzang po'i dus zhig 'ong ngam snyam/ /sa la dag pa'i zhing mchog gsung gi gnas/ /mchims phu nags kyi dur khrod gsang ba'i phug /mthong bas don ldan mkha' 'gro'i gnas mchog der/ /zhag gsum gnas kyi 'brel bas skal bzang byas/ /rdza mo hūṃ 'drar grags sogs grub pa'i rtags/ /bstan pa'i gnas kun mjal tshe 'bad med du/ /chos kun rmi lam yul gyi bya byed ltar/ /'di zhes brjod du med pa'i nyams 'ga' shar/ /phyir lam slar yang dbu rtse rigs gsum gyi/ /byin rlabs —445

lam yig rang gzugs gsal ston dri bral me long (bda'adzad pa med pa'i rten mjal zhing / /byang phyogs bdag po bar chad sel ba'i lha/ /phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i rjes gnang byas/ /sgrags mdar lho rgyud dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde/ /du ma'i ser sbrengs mu tig phreng ba ltar/ /bsgrigs pa'i rnam sbyar mdangs kyis nam mkha' yang / /thun mtshams gzhen nu'i mdzes pa 'phrog pa bzhin/ /rigs 'dzin bla ma'i gdan sa rdo rje brag /padma'i e waṃ lcog sgar 'du khang du/ /gung gi bro bstab nang rten gter rdzas kun/ /mjal zhing byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i dmigs pa blangs/ /de nas phreng 'go'i gzhis gar 'byor pa na/ /sa chen byams pas skyong pa'i mchod (12na)yon zung / /lho rgyud 'dzin ma'i dpya khral kun bsdus te/ /skyid shong yul gyur bteg dang lhan cig 'dzom/ /mkha' la snyeg 'dra'i mthon po'i la brgyal nas/ /zhag rer nyin mtshan lan bzhi 'byung ba'i sa/ /rtog ge'i lce gnyis rkyong ba ma la ya'i/ /lho phyogs gsang phu'i nags kyi khrod brgyud de/ /sne'u gzhis ga'i ljon shing ra ba'i khrod/ /gangs khrod phyag chen bstan 'dzin 'brug pa rje/ /dge tshul dngos por bsgrubs shing rje btsun ma/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang rgyas par phul/ /chos brgyad bya bas dben pa'i lha rtse ba/ /mkhyen dpyod tshangs par 'gran bzod sprul pa'i sku/ /tshig rer lan grangasamed du brtsegs pa'i gsung / /bag phebs gleng mo'i rim pa ci yang byung / /gangs can bod kyi mdzesargyan chos kyi sde/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs 'dus pa'i gling chen por/ /slob dpon rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen sogs/ khrims ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pas mdun bsus te/ /rnam dpyod ldan na 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gnas/ /sgrub la gzhol na bsam gtan khang bu brtsegs/ /snyoms las ci bder spyod pa'i spro khang can/ /'chi med yul ngas dga' ldan pho brang der/ /mtha' 'khor yul nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /mos ldan gsar du 'ongs pa'i skya ser rnams/ /'dod pa'i chos kyis re ba skong ba dang / /phar gtong tshul len 'jig rten mthun 'jug byas/ /rgyal zla'i stod du sgo gsum mi g.yeng ba'i/ /ting 'dzin bzlas brjod brtson pa lhur blangs shing / /lo gsar dus chen gnam bzas khrigs rim kun/ /sngar gyi srol rgyun ji bzhin chad (11ba)med byas/ /rdo rje'i gdan mchog ra sa —446

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshe'aphrul snang du/ /mnyan yod mchod pa'i dus ston stod kyi char/ /'phral phugs kun tu dge ba'i smon lam dang / /bstan srung dung skyong dbang mor 'phrin las bcol/ /sa chen chos kyi rgyal po nam mkha'i mtshan/ /'phyong rgyas paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po sogs/ /du mas spungs pa'i gser dngul gos dar gyis/ /dregs ldan rus sbal mang po'i snying rtsa 'dar/ /de nas bla chen rnam pa'i sku tshab kyis/ /ming dang don mthun ca po'i rdzong sta sogs/ gar phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram du 'grod pa'i grabs/ /rkang drug bung ba'i lag pa khrus kyis bral/ shar phyogs kong yul lo ma'i nags tshal nas/ /gnas brtan yan lag 'byung gi skye ba zhig /mes po tshangs pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa de/ /bcu gsum lha lam 'khor los smin par byas/ /'khon rigs 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo rtse gdong pa/ /rlangs ston lha gzigs gong ma chen po sogs/ /dus der bod kyi che dgu phal che ba/ /ngos cag gong du 'gro ba'i rdzong bar byon/ /nag zla'i dmar phyogs bzang po dang po'i tshe/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi bsti gnas nas/ /bteg ste stod lung zhes bya'i yul gru che/ /rim bgrod dri za'i rgyal po'i mdun sar 'byor/ /yul der dgon sde grong gi bkod pa sogs/ /dkar nag 'dres ma las kyi thag khra can/ /cher rlom lto 'gro'i mi bzad gdug pa'i lte/ /sa 'og srad bu dar gyi thags la 'grim/ /lam du ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dbang gi /rgyal tshab gar chen shes rab 'byung gnas dang / /phan tshun gsung ngag chos kyi gleng mo yi/ /pad dkar dri dang bung (12na)ba'i dpe ji bzhin/ /chen po'i rnam dpyod 'dzin pa ga me pa'i/ /rgyal tshab sprul sku grags pa mchog dbyangs dang / /ngos kyi mjal zhing 'jig rten mi chos las/ /brtsams pa'i smra mkhas gsung gis g.yin sems 'khrid/ /dus der gtsang stod bkra shis lhun po nas/ /paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po 'gro ba'i mgon/ /gnas rnying zhabs drung slob dpon rnam bzhi sogs/ /yab sras ma lus phebs dang zhib par mjal/ /de'i tshe gsum las gong ma'i mdun sa sa /phebs pa'i mthun 'gyur byas pa de bzhin du/ /da sgos mgyogs skor mdzad nas bod yul du/ khog ces nan tan chen pos lan 'ga' stsal/ /bsam pa'i don kun grub pa bde ba che/ /gnam bskos rgyal —447

lam yig rang gzugs gsal ston dri bral me long (ba)po'i pho brang gsar pa der/ /nyin zhag bcu phrag gnyis kyi bar dag tu/ /thag ring yul du chas pa'i mgron po kun/ /the tshom sngas la mgo bo bzhag ste nyal/ /rim gyis shul du zhugs te zla gcig bar/ /phyag mdzod nor 'dzin skyong ba 'khor bcas dang / /lhan cig pho rog rdo rje'i bgrod tshul gyis/ /gdang lar gragasapa'i ri bo phal cher brgal/ /nyin zhag mang 'dasachu stod zla ba'i nang / /sa gzhir chal chil g.yo ba'i rlabs phreng can/ /'dre chur grags pa'i chu bo che lasabagrod/ /de nasarim brgyud shong mong 'dzom ra'i mdun/ /da las pā dur cung zad bro 'tshal bar/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i rjes gnang gis/ /sems kyi ngal gso'i rten gyi cho ga bstar/ /hong tshang garma bsod nams mched gnyis kyis/ /gtor tshogs med pa'i snyan pa'i rnga gshang la/ /re ba'i bya rog tshogs (12ba)rnamasakhrom pa steng / /nyin zhag gnyis bar 'phur lding gar gyis rol/ /rim 'grod mtsho mor bar ma mdo yi hor/ /dad mos rnga ma nag po'i mdog can gyis/ /mkho dgu'i 'byor ba cher spungasa'achi med dbang / /sum stong brgal ba'i khrom la rgyas par byas/ /de tshe lha rgyal dar gyi be'u dang / /lhan cig brgya phrag mdzo mo nyer bstar zhing / /sgar chen sgrigs kyi ri mo nam mkha'i ngos/ /'dri bar nor 'dzin skyong de rnam par brel/ /thang phrog bsam grub bde chen nasabazung ste/ /gdang la'i la mor gragasatshun zla gcig bar//phyag mdzod nor 'dzin skyong ba 'bor bcas dang / /lhan cig pho rog rdo rje'i 'gros kyis bgrod/ /bod 'bangs bde skyid spel thabs pi waṃ sgra/ /mi dbang snyan gyi dbang por nyer 'khrol ba/ /nang semasa'agro la dkar ba'i mos 'dun las/ /phal cher grog skam nya rgya tsam du zad/ /de nas nyin zhag mang bgrod lha rtse'i gzhung / /be ri stod rta'i sder slebs bsnyen rdzogs dang / /rab byung thugs rje chen po'i bzlas lung sogs/ /'gro phan ming du bsnyad nasalam du zhugs/ /dbyar dusamakha' la 'phyo ba'i 'bri chu la/ kho rkyal rdzings kyi bye brag rgyang ring por/ /bor nas mi khal mtha' dag rab brgal te/ /dka' tshegs chung ngusapha rol bde bar bgrod/ /de 'dra chen po 'ga' ltar grub rtagasasu/ /'beb na gzhan mgo bskor mod gsung rab dang / /bstun tshe stes dbang tsam la rlom sems su/ /rmongasapa'i —448—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losherang mtshang yin snyam btang snyoms bor/ /mdo stod sa skyong mkha' 'gros lha sde dang / /mi sde'i zhabs 'bring bar bcas mdun bsus te/ /brgya stong (14na)grangs kyi 'bul ba nyer bstar bas/ /bla chen 'phrin las mngon sum bzhin du byas/ /stag lung thang ba'i bka' brgyud srog shing des/ /chab shog chos srid zung 'brel 'phrin lan bcas/ /phyag mdzod ngag gi dbang phyug nyer bsngags tshe/ /'dzam gling snod bcud mngon sum mthong ba bzhin/ /mtsho sngon g.yas ru'i dpon khag du ma yis/ /rta dang rnga mo brgya phrag gis bsu ba/ /thag ring lam du chas pa'i mgron po rnams/ /bde bar gnas su phyin pa'i byed po bzhin/ /na mar mdor slebs tre bo hor tshang dang / /dge rtse sogs kyis rta drel mdzo gser ja'i/ /brgya 'bul nyer bstar sgos su gtong ba'i sgo/ /phye tshe dkar nag bzhin ras spel mar ston/ /rjes gnang lung sogs 'dod chos sna tshogs pa/ /'grul dang bstun pa'i sgo gsum nyer 'bad tshe/ /gsang bde 'jigs gsum rjes gnang shes bya la/ /sngon med mi srid srid pa'i gtam gsar thos/ /sarba mas lo// //—449

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mche'i gsung 'bum/ 6sher༅༅/ /phan bde'i rtsa lag jo shāka rnams kyi brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga mi 'gyur g.yung drung zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru waṃ/ rang sems dag pa'i bod yul gser gyi sgor/ /yo pas smin phros bzang bde skyid dus kun tu/ /mi zad rgyan 'khor stsol mdzad shākya'i rgyal/ /'gro ba'i mgon por sra mkhregs ka ba 'dzugs/ /de'ang gangs can sogs skye dgu thams cad kyi las nyon bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong zhing thar pa dang rnam mkhyen mchog la 'god thabs su jo shāka rnam gnyis rang byon lnga ldan sogs phan bde'i rtsa lag dam pa rnams ji srid bskal ba'i bar brtan par bzhugs pa'i slad du/ gnas yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su thub pa'i dbang po shar phyogs su sgra gcan 'dzin/ lam phran bstan/ bha ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len/ lam bstan pa/ lho phyogs su klu'i sde/ sped byed/ mi phyed/ yan lag 'byung / nub phyogs su ma pham pa/ nags na gnas/ dus ldan/ rdo rje mo'i bu/ byang phyogs su bzang po/ gser bes bha ra bha dza gser can/ ba ku la rnams dgram/ bla ma dkon mchog gi gtor ma/ /gnas brtan gyi gtor ma/ dpal lha dang mgon po bdun cu'i gtor ma/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma/ cha gsum (2na)gtor ma/ gtor ma brgya rtsa mchod yon la sogs pa rnams bsham/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang / thugs rje chen po'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa zhig brtan/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dngas shing thogs pa med pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā&lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin gyis brlab/ mchod pa gong bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung 45()

phan bde'i rtsa lag jo shaka rnams kyi brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga mi 'gyur g.yung drung / khobadaba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ a lha āḥ& oṃ pā hūm̐ 〉 〉 / oṃ badzra puṅge āḥ&/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥ// oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥ&/ oṃ badzra ga rje ā&/ oṃ badzra ni li dre u:/ oṃ badzra shasta ā hūm̐/ zhes brlab/ dbus kyi lte ba la/ yang (2ba)dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po/ sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ phyag g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon pa mnyam gzhag /zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ na bza' chos gos snam sbyar dmar po gsol ba/ zhal 'dzum mdangs dang ldan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ sku lta bas chog mi shes pa/ dbu'i gtsug tor ltar mi mngon pa/ 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/'od de gang la reg pa thams cad byang chub chen por 'gyur ba/ sku de gang gis mthong ba dang / reg pa dang / yid la byas pa dang / mtshan thos pa thams cad/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur pa/yon tan bsam gyi khyab pa'i phung por gyur pa de bzhugs pa'o/ /shar phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhi la/ gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan 'dzin phyag na rin po che'i phrog zhu bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po lam phran bstan phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag pa dang /gnas brtan chen po bha ra dhwa dza bsod snyems len/ phyag g.yas glegs bam 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa mnyam bzhag gi steng du lhung bzed bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po lam bstan/ phyag g.yas glegs bam/g.yon chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhi la/ gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde/ g.yas bum pa/ g.yon 'khar gsil bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po sped byed/ phyag na glegs bam bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pa/ phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po (3na)yan lag 'byung / phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na spos phor bsnams pa/ mchan khung g.yon na rnga yab bsnams pa'o/ /nub phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhi la/gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa/ phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag pa/ gnas brtan chen po nags na —45/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheganas/ phyag g.yas zhi ba'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ g.yon rnga yab bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po dus ldan phyag na gser gyi rna kor bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bu/ phyag gnyis sdigs mdzub dang rnga yab bsnams pa'o/ /byang gi pad 'dab bzhi la/ gnas brtan chen bo bzang po/ phyag g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ gnas brtan chen po gser bes phyag na rin po che'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po bha ra dha dza gser can/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag /gnas brtan chen po ba ku la/ phyag na ni'u le bsnams pa'o/ /sgo bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi dang /'phags pa'i dge bsnyen chen po dharma ta la'i phyag na rnga yab dang bum pa bsnams pa/ ral pa'i thor cog bcangs pa la/ sde snod kyi glegs bam mang po 'khur ba/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs pa/ dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub tu yod pa pus mor brjes pa/ pus mo g.yas pa las stag gi tshogs sprul pa/ dge bsnyen gyi tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs par bsam mo/ /thub pa'i bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /mya ngan mi 'da' mngon sum kun yul du/ /lha mi'i bsod nams dpal zhing 'tsho (3ba)gzhes pa/ /rgyal tshab dgra bcom bcu drug zhabs la 'dud/ /te se'i gangs na dgra bcom yan lag 'byung / /drang srong ri ngos shel nags ma pham pa/ /lo ma bdun rir btsun pa nags na gnas/ /zangs gling dbus na rgyal sras dus ldan bzhugs/ /si gha la na rdo rje mo yi bu/ /chu bo ya mun gling na bzang po bzhugs/ kha che'i yul na thub pa gser belā /nub gling ba ra dhwa dza gser can bzhugs/ /sgra mi snyan na dpal chen ba ku la/ /bri yang ku na gnasabartan sgra gcan 'dzin/ /bya rgod phung por dge slong lam phran bstan/ shar gling bha ra dha dza bsod snyoms len/ /sum cu rtsa gsum 'phags pa lam bstan bzhugs/ /ngos yangs ri la sdom brtson klu yi sde/ /ri rgyal bhi hu la na sbed byed bzhugs/ /gangs ri'i rgyal po la ni mi phyed pa/ /'phags chen gnas brtan rgyal po bcu drug po/ /re re bzhin yang dgra bcom du mas bskor/ /nyan thos tshul 'dzin rgyal sras 'phrin las skyongs/ /chos gsungs 'gro don mdzad pas legs skyob mdzad/ /ces lha tshogs —452

phan bde'i rtsa lag jo shaka rnams kyi brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga mi 'gyur g.yung drung / (bdarnams gsal btab/ sngon tshe bcom ldan shākya thub/ shwakya seng ge rgyal ba'i sras/ /'jig rten 'di na yongs bzhugs shing / /mya ngan 'das tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ /bde gshegs chos kyi rgyal po'i sras/ /'phags pa yang dag shes rab kyis/ /nyon mongs bud shing bsreg par mdzad/ khams gsum sgrol ba'i dgra bcoms nas/ /bya ba byas shing byed pa byas/ khur bor bdag don rjes su brnyes/ /srid pa'i sbyor ba yongs su zad/ /yang dag shes rab rnam par grol/ /nyen mongs (4na)bag chags rnam par bcom/ /zab mo'i don la mkhas pa po/ /dmigs med chos kyi nges par 'byung / /spyod lam mdzes pas rnam par brgyan/ /bde gshegs bka' la rab gnas pa'o/ /dgra bcom bcu drug bzhugs pa ni/ /koṇḍi ya dang sha ri'i bu/ /mod la bu dang 'od srung dang / /kun dga' bo dang sgra gas 'dzin/ /nye bar 'khor dang ma 'gags pa/ /rab 'byor dang ni rta thul dang / /bha ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len/ /gyad bu nor dang legs 'ongs dang / /nag po dang ni 'char ka dang / /gang po dang ni ka tya'i bu/ /dgra bcom bye ba mang po dag /sang gi dus 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das slad du//dam pa chos kyi gnyer gtad pa/ /'jig rten khams 'di bsrung mdzad pa/ /'khor bzhi yongs su skyong mdzad pa'i/ /sems can don la phan brtson pa/ /gnas brtan chen po bcu drug rnams/ /dgra bcom brgya stong mchod tshogs dang / /'dzam bu dang ni gling bzhi dang / /yul rnams so sor bzhugs pa rnams/ shar gyi lus 'phags gling chen nas/ /gnas brtan chen po mtshan grags pa/ /bha ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len/ /dgra bcom stong gi 'khor rnams dang / /sang gi dus 'dir gshegs su gsol//sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas nas/ /nyan thos chen po lam bstan yang / /dgra bcom dgu brgya'i 'khor tsho gos dang / /sang gi dus der gshegs su gsol/ /ri yi rgyal po ngos yangs nas/ /nyan thos chen po klu'i g.yang / /dgra bcom stong dang nyis brgya yi/ /'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /(4ba)ri yi rgyal po bhi hu nas/ /nyan thos chen po sped byed kyang / /dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgya yi//'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /gangs kyi ri bo chen po nas/ /nyan thos chen po mi phyed pa//—463

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedagra bcom stong gi 'khor tshogs dang / /sang gi dus 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /gangs ri chen po te se nas/ /nyan thos chen po yan lag 'gyung / /dgra bcom stong dang sum brgya yi/ /'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /drang srong ri ngogs shel nags nas/ /nyan thos chen po ma pham pa/ /dgra bcom mang po'i 'khor tshogs dang / /sang gi dus 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /lo ma bdun pa'i ri phug nas/ /nyan thos chen po nags na gnas/ /dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgya yi/ /'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /zangs kyi gling zhes bya ba nas/ /nyan thos chen po dus ldan yang / /dgra bcom stong dang chig brgya yi/ /'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /sirnya la yi gling phran nas/ /dgra bcom rdo rje mo yi bu/ /nyan thos stong gi 'khor tshogs dang / /sang gi dus 'dir gshegs su gsol/ kha che'i yul gyi sa mtshams nas/ /nyan thos chen po gser be lnga /dgra bcom lnga brgya'i 'khor tshogs dang / /sang gi dus 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /nub kyi ba lang spyod pa nas/ /bha ra dhwa dza gser can yang / /dgra bcom bdun brgya'i 'khor tshogs dang / /sang gi dus 'dir gshegs su gsol/ sgra mi snyan gyi gling nas kyang / /gnas brtan chen po ba ku la/ /dgra bcom dgu brgya'i 'khor tshogs kyang / /sang gi dus 'dar gshegs su gsol/ /pri (ldan)yang ku yi gling phran nas/ /nyan thos chen po sgra gcan 'dzin/ /dgra bcom stong dang chig brgya yang / /'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri las kyang / /nyan thos wo po lam phran bstan/ /dgra bcom stong dang drug brgya yis/ / 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /de dag la sogs gzhan dag kyang / zhang chen swā la'i drung dag nas/ /lu zhi'i gnas dang rgyal po'i khab/ /ni ra3 na bdud 'dul ba/ ba ra ṇa si yangs pa can/ /mnyan yod lha yi grong khyer dang / /mchod rten brgyad kyi gnas rnams dang / /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas rnams dang / /bzhugs dang grags pa thams cad dang / /gzhan yang 'dzam gling lto phyogs kyi/ /mtsho yi 'gram dang ma la ya'i/ /nags dang ri khrod sa rnams su/ /chu bo na ra ma ti'i 'gram/ /ri bo lhan dhu yongs 'du yi/ /gzhan yang me tog 'bras ldan pa'i/ zhang dang spang du ni'u —454

phan bde'i rtsa lag jo shaka rnams kya brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga mi 'gyur g.yung drung /(bdagasing dang //bya dang ri dwags gnas pa dang //nyams dga' ba yi sar bzhugs dag/rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram logs na//klu chen las la 'khril mdzad cing //yang dag 'jigs pa'i ting 'dzin gnas//sprul mgo gdengs pas gdugs ltar skyobs//don rnams mdzad cing bzhugs pa dang //gzhan yang rgyal bas zhabs bcags par//bzhugs par gyur ba'i dgra bcom rnams//ting 'dzin rdzu 'phrul rkang par ldan//sku tshe ring ba'i tshul ston cing //gnas brtan chen por mtshan grags pa//nyan thos chen po sbyin byed dang //skyes pa dang ni rtogs byed dang //5ba/ku srung bu dang grags ldan dang //dgra bcom bye ba mang po yi//'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol//stong chen khams dang gling phran gzhan rnams dang //'dzam bu'i ri khrod nags tshal chu bo'i rgyun//lta dang lteng ka dri zhim ngad ldan pa//de na 'phags pa'i tsho gos rnams legs bzhugs te//gnas brtan chen po dgra bcom yon tan ldan//tshe yi 'du byed lhag ma'i sku la gnas//sems can don phyir brtse bas der dgongs te//bsod nams bsags pa'i mchod pa gang bshams par//brtse phyir byams ldan thugs rjes gshegs su gsol//zhes pas lan gsum/gnas brtan chen po dgra bcom yon tan ldan//tshe yi 'du byed lhag ma'i sku la gnas//sems can don phyir brtse bas der dgongs te//bsod nams bsagasapas mchod pa gang bshams par//brtse phyir byams ldan thugs rjes gshegs su gsol//zhes pasalan gsum la brten nas//phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang /shes rab me 'bar nyon mongs mtsho skems shing //rnam grol bsod nams zhing du bka' bstod par//phyogs bas nyan thos dge 'dun bzhugs so 'tshal//yon sbyor mar pa'i gnas su spyan 'dren gyis//'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol//'gro ba'i mgon po shākya seng ge yis//sangs rgyas bstan pa gang gi phyag tu bzhag/gsung rab rin chen sgom gyi kha 'byed pa//chos skyong dgra bcom chen po bzhugasaso yol//dam chos spel ba'i slad du spyan 'dren gyis//'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol//thub pa'i bka' bsgo bstan pa'i rgyal 4 5 5 'dzin//6na〉na lag 'byung dang ma pham

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho' gsung 'bum/ ()nags na gnas//dusaldan rdo rje mo bu bzang po dang //gser be'u bha ra dha dza gser can dang //'phags pa ba ku la dang sgra gcan 'dzin//lam 'phran bha ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len//lam bstan klu sde sted byed mi phyed pa//'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol//spangs dang ye shes phun tshogs sangs rgyas kyang //gdul bya'i dbang gis nyan thos skur 'dzin pa/khyad par can gyi phrin lasachosaskyong ba'i//gnasabartan bcu drug 'dir gshegasagadan la bzhugs//bde gshegasabaka' lung stsol mdzad bstan pa bsrung //rang don dor nas 'khor ba'i nags tshal du//gzhan don lhur mdzad gnas brtan bcu drug po//dam bcas thugasarje'i dbang gisaganasa'adir gshegs// dge bsnyen skyabs gsol bden pa'i tshig nyan pa//dkon mchog gsum gyis zhabs 'bring mchis so 'tshal//bsod nams rin go gling du spyan 'dren gyis//'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol//zhes pas spyan drangs la bzhugs su gsol//yan lag bdun pa tshar gcig bya/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegasapa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangasargyasashākya thub pa'i zhabasaladusathamasacad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabasasu mchi'o//byin gyisabarlab tu gsol/sangasargyasabacom ldan 'dasakyi bstan pa dam pa'i chosaskyongs zhig cesalha mi rnamasakyisabasod namasakyi dpalazhing du/de bzhin gshegasapa shākya thub pasabaka' bsgosate/mya ngan lasami 'da' bar 6bangajig rten na macan sum du bzhugasashing //bka' lung gi rjesasu bsgrub par 'phagasapa'i tshogasangesapar zhal gyisabazhesapa/bri yang ku'i gling nas 'phagasapa'i gnasabartan chen po sgra gcan 'dzin/'khor dgra bcom pa stong dang chag brgyasabaskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabasal dusathamasacad du phyag 'tshal lo//mno do/skyabasasu mchi'o//byin gyisabam tu gsol/de rnamasathams༅ lasbyar ro//bya rgod phung po'i ri la/'phagasapa'i gnasagato go po lam phran bstan/'khor dgra bcom pa stong drug brgyasabaskor te bzhugasapa'i zhabasal dusathamasacad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do/skyabasasu mchi'o//byin gyisabarlabatu gsol/shar gyi lusa'aphagasagling na/'phagasapa'i gnasabartan chen po bha ra dhwa dza 4

phan bde'i rtsa lag jo shaka rnams kya brtan nga kya cha ga ma 'gyur g.yung drung /(bdabasod snyoms len/'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlab tu gsol/lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum gnas/'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po lam bstan/'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa' zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyisabarlab tu gsol/ri'i rgyal po ngos yangs la/'phags pa'i gnas brtan wo po klu'i sde/'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa' zhabasal dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//ri'i rgyal po bhi hu la/'phags pa'i gnas brtan rsā po sped byed/'khor dgra bcom pa stong dang bzhi brgyasabaskor te bzhugs pa' khas la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mar do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlab tu gsol/gangs ri'i rgyal po la/'phags pa'i 7na nas brtan wo po mi phyed pa/'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/mar do//skyabs su mtsho//byin gyis bas tu gsol/gangs ri li po te sel/'phags pa'i gnas brtan byu po yan lag 'byung /'khor dgra bcom pa stong sum brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa khas la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mar do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis bas tu gsol/drang srong ri ngogs shel nags na/'phags pa'i gnas brtan wo po ma pham pa/'khor dgra bcom pa brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ri nags kyi ngogs lo ma bdun pa zhes bya ba'i ri phug na/'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas/'khor dgra bcom pa stong bzhi brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mar do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis bas tu gsol/zangs gling na 'a 'phags pa' gnas brtan rṣa po dus ldan/'khor dgra bcom pa stong dang chog brgyasabaskor te bzhugs pa zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mar do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis bas tu gsol/siṅgā la'i gling na 'phagaXpa rdo rje mo bu 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzas rgya mtsho' gsung 'bum/ smyonate bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyisabs tu gsol/chu bo ya mu na'i gling na 'phags pa gnas brtan wo po bzang po la 'khor dgra bcom pa nyis brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa' zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlab tu gsol/kha che'i yul na/'phags pa'i gnas brtan rṣa po gser belā'akhor dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 7ba tshe a 'a lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byen gyis bas tu gsol/nub kyi ba lang spyod na/'phags pa'i gnasabartan rṣa po bha ra dhwa dza gser can la/'khor dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa zhabasal dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mgo do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis bas tu gsol/byang gi sgra mi snyan na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan wo po ba ku la/'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa' khas la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mar do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyisabarlab tu gsol/'phags pa'i dge bsnyen chen po dharma ta la la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do//skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo//zhes phyag 'tshal/rab stims rgya mtsho dpag med na//zhesasogs mchod pa rgyas par dbul/phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa nyan thos dang /gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la sogs pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thamasacad dgongs su gsol/bdag cag la sogs pa'i 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag cing /bsam sbyor dad cing gus pa sgo nas khyed rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba bto pa dang /mchod pa phul ba la sogs pa dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/sangs rgyas kya bstan pa rin po che phyogs med dud ra zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/sems can thams cad la phan bde dpag tu med pa 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/lha dang mi thams cad kyi 'dren pa'i gtsug rgyan dam par gyur pa/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub 8na ) pa shākya'i rgyal po' gdung kṣe tu gyur pa 4'a/ nyid 'gro ba thams cad kyi dpal dang mgon dang

phan bde'i rtsa lag jo shaka rnams kye brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga mi 'gyur g.yung drung / khobadaskyabs gnas dam par ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'byung ba'i gnod pas mi tshugs bar gnas 'di nyid du brtan par bzhugs par mdzad du gsol lo/ /bzhugs nas kyang 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa 'bul ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa'i dmigs yul du gyur zhing 'dren pa dam pa mdzad du gsol/ gzhan yang de dag sku dang / gsung dang / thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo/ /rten mchog khyad bar can rnams kyang 'gro ba thams cad kyi dpal dang / mgon dang skyabasaganas dam par ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'byung ba'i gnod pas mi tshugs par gnas 'di nyid du brtan par bzhugs par mdzad du gsol/ bzhugs nas kyang 'gro ba sgos can thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa 'bul ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa'i dmigs yul du gyur cing 'dren pa dam pa mdzad du gsol/ /de dag thams cad kyi mthu dang / stobs dang / nus pa dang / bsod nams kyi dpal la brten nas 'byung ba me dang chu'i gnod pa dang 'tshe ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /ces pa la sogs pa 'dun pa drag po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsol ba gdab pa dang / smon lam du gsol ba/ mdo las byung ba dang ci ltar rigs pa rnams bya'o/ / de ltar gsol ba 'debs pa dang smon lam gang btab kyi dus na gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas dad pa dang gus pa byed pa gal che gsungs/ yang mchod pa (8ba kho gsos nas gong bzhin bldab dpal gsol gyi rjes su/ sngon mosangs rgyas spyan snga mā /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis po/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /a kā ro ma kho sogs lan gsum gyis gtore ma bsngos/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis po//mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /zhes so gos bya/ phun sum tsho gos pa mnga' ba sogs ba po shis kyi tshigs bcad rnams brjod/ ces gter chen chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas gling pas mchims phu'i lam kha brag sna seng ge'i gdong nas bzhes pa'i rgyal po bka' 'bum nang bzhin 'byer bder za hor gyi bande sngags dkar ma ṇi bas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa phyogasadus gnas skabs thams cad du bde zhing skyid pa'i dga' ston la gnas par gyur cig /sarba maṅga lo/ /—459

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbas blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ra༅༅//smon lam chen mo'i dam bca'i skabs kyi ma ṇi bskul rgyu'i tshigs bcad brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa bzhugs so//༄༅//phun tsho gis legs byas bye ba'i 'od stong gis//bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i snang ba rab gsalaba'i//bde legs rgya mtsho'i sgo 'phar phyogs kun du//rnam par 'byed pa'i dpal des khyab gyur cig/rmad byung thub bstan dar ba kha ba'i ljongs//dge bcu'i yon to kun tshang skyid shod mthil//sde bzhis mngon mtho bod yul rdo rje gdan//'bum phrag grong khyer ldan pa yul gyi ljongs//skar tshogs sa la 'phos 'dra'i grong khyer mchog/gnam la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad gdugs ltar phub//sa gzhi pad 'dab brgyad pa'i tshul gyis brten//phyogs mtshams bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis mdzes shing //grangs med dge mtshan tshogs kyis skor ba'i dbus//spyan ras gzigs dbang gangs can ljongs kyi rjer//bsams bzhin srid bzung srong btsan sgam po yi//thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar las legs grub pa'i//lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang bzang 'dir//sngon tshe 'phags pa'i yul du shākya'i rtag/zas gtsang sras kyis mu stegs rab brtul ba'i//ngo 2na ) mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i dge mtshan rnams//gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal du skrun mdzad pa'i//blo gros mchog gi skal ba bzang po sa/sgyur mdzad 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa'i//cho 'phrul mar pa'i mdzad wo dge ba'i dus//lus can rnams kyi bsod nams zhing mchog tu//sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad par ma mchos par//zhal gyis bzhes pa'i shākya mu ni sogs//rgyal dang de sras snang brnyan grangs med cing //rgya chen mang pos lung gi yon to dang //mngon rtogs bslab pa ༷༷ma gyis rgyud phyug pa'i//phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun

smon lam chen mo'i dam bca'i skabs kyi ma ṇi bskul rgyu'i tshigs bcad brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa (bda'adus pa'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /dri med smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar ba'i/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dus chen 'di nyid la/ /lus ngag yid kyis bsags pa'i dge ba'i tshogs/ /cung zad bgyis kyang grangs med bsod nams kyi/ /dngos po zad pa med phyir 'bad par rigs/dam bca'i rim pa la/ bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ gur brtag sam gsum/ dus 'khor sogs kyi rgyud 'dzin/ byams chos sde lnga/(2brko bu ma rigs tshogs drug /'grel pa sgron gsal/ dus 'khor 'grel chen/ bka' gdams gzhung drug /lam rim che chung / rim lnga gsal sgron/ rang gang mos kyi yi dam lha'i bsnyen sgrub/ lha sa bsam yas la sogs pa'i gnas khyad par can la phyag dang skor ba 'bum ther/ dkar me/ zhal zas/ spyan gzigs mchod rdzas 'bul ba/ bka' 'gyur gyis thog drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzheng ba/ mtshan brjod/ dmigs brtse ma/ sa lam/ lhung bshags/ smon lam lnga/ sgrol ma sher snying sogs 'bum ther/ yig drug dung phyur/ lam srang / zam pa 'chos pa/ rdo lha spyan 'byed/ srog gcod spong ba/ bsnyen gnas smyung gnas bsrung ba/ ngan slong la sbyin pa gtong ba sogs rang gang 'dod kyi dam bca'/ /zhes smon lam chen mo'i dam bca'i skabs ma ṇi'i 'go brgyangs la bskul rgyu dkon mchog blo gros kyis bskul ba'i ngor za sto gyi brnyes sbyar ba'o/ /ma sgo lo/ /'jam mgon lang tsho dar ba'i mkhyen pa'i gzhir/ /thub bstan dpag bsam sdong po rab rgyas pa'i/ /blo bzang grags snyan ring lugs grib bsil la/ /'gro kun longs su spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /phul byung bsod nams mchog tu rab brtan cing / /thub bstan legs skyong sa dbang chos kyi rgyal/ /gnam bskos sa yi tshangs pa'i sku tshe dang / /mtshan byus mnga' thang phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /legs byas bye ba'i yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /sde bzhi'i 'dod dgu char du bsnyil ba'i 'bras/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon kun yongs khyab pa'i/ /(3na)phan bde'i dpal gyis dus kun khyab gyur cig /ces smon lam chen mo'i rda bca'i skabs ma ṇi bskul rgyu'i tshigs bcad brtan bzhugs 'di yang dkon mchog blo —46/ —

rgya smu dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshegros kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'o/ /na moḥ shākya mu ba yi/ 'dzam bu'i gser sbyangs las grub sa 'dzin dbang / /mtshan dpe'i dra bas 'khrud pa'i gzugs kyi sku/ /mthong bas don ldan nges legs la sbyor ba'i/ /rgyal ba zas gtsang sras por gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi mgur gnas gzhes med nā da'i sgra/ /dam pa'i chos kyi dbyings su sgrog pa'i glu/ /thos pas srid zhi'i gdung sel thos 'dzin rgyan/ /yan lag drug cu'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun gsal zhags pas 'ching bar nus min pa'i/ /rgya chen pha mtha' bral ba shes bya'i khyon/ /mngon sum gzigs pa'i ye shes mchog gi thugs/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /'og min gnas su sku gsum mngon gyur kyang / /'dzam bu gling du mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi/ /tshul bstan 'gro ba 'dren pa'i thabs mkhas can/ /kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs gyis/ /tshe rabs kun du sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /zhugs nas de don tshul bzhin nyams blangs pas/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig /ces bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa la bstod pa'i rim pa 'di ni su hing u ching wang gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes tal khar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /bkra shis/ /—462

ja mchod kyi rim pa bcud mchog nam mkha' mdzod kyi dga' ston/ khobanar༅༅/ /ja mchod kyi rim pa bcud mchog nam mkha' mdzod kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄tsho/ /pad rtsa lta bur dkar ba'i yol go'i nang/ kha dog dmar ser legs 'khyil rgya ja yi/ /phun tshogs ro brgya bda' ba btung ba'i mchog /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod du byin brlabs te/ /gdengs can klu dbang 'dzin pa lag mang dang/ /btsun mo sras dang bka' nyan blon por bcas pho nya mngag gzhug 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho la/ /mchod par 'bul lo dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /'jig rten khams su char 'bab lo tog dang / /rtsi bcud rab rgyas dpal 'byor longs spyod 'phel/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin dgon gnas sde bcas skyongs/ /'dod pa'i re ba yid bzhin skong bar mdzod/ /ja mchod 'di'ang gdengs can dbang pos bskul 0ltar za hor gyi brjes bkod pa'o/ /don kun grub pa dgra bcom shākya'i tog /rigs gsum rnam sprul chos rgyal mes dbon tshogs/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun btsong kha pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo dus kyi dgrar bzhengs nas/ /gnam sa ltar bgrad zhal gdangs gshin rje gshed/ /bar chad kun sel dpal chen he ru gaḥ yi dam dkyil 'khor 'khor lor mchod (2na)pa 'bul/ /rdo rje dbyings phyug dbyangs can ngag gi lha/ /srid gsum mnga' sgyur 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /dung skyong rgyal mo bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs/ /bka' sdod 'khor tshogs bcas la mchod pa 'bul/ /byin rlabs char 'bebs myur mdzad ye shes mgon/ /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrub mdzad ngal bsos po/ /skye 'gro'i srog 'phrog las gshin 'chi bdag nag /bstan srung dam can rgya mtshor mchod pa 'bul/ /bde gshegs yongs kyi mthu stobs bzhu blugs pa/ /rdo rje srin po gur zhal pu tra —463—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedang / /beg tse rgyal po sku lnga tse'u dmar/ /dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs la mchod pa 'bul/ /bod kyi lha chen rje yi mgur lha dang / /'bangs kyi srog lha thugs dkar gza' chos lha/ /sa bdag rgyal blon 'go ba'i lha lnga sogs/ /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /nad gdon dbul phongs bar gcod kun zhi zhing / /ma rungs dgra sde dpung bcas tshar bcad de/ /dpa' bo'i lag rtags phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /ru mtshon srid pa'i rtse mor bsgreng par mdzod/ /ces sa skyong blo bzang mthu (2ba)stobs kyis dbus gtsang tsho chen rnams la 'os pa'i ja mchod cig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /pad rag mdangs 'phrog ga bur ngad pa 'thul/ /phun tshogs ro bda' rkang 'thung phur ma'i bcud/ /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod du rab spel ba/ /skyabs gnas dkon cog gsum la mchod pa 'bul/ /bstan pa'i bdag po thub dbang zas gtsang sras/ /nye bar 'khor dang rgyal sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ /zhi ba 'tsho sogs 'phags bod gnas brtan te/ /phan bde'i rtsa lag rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ kha che'i paṇa chen shākya shi'i 'bras/ /lnga rig kun zig gas sa skya lo tsā ba/ /chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /gangs can mun sel tshogs la mchod pa 'bul/ /rgyud sdo rnam bzhi'i yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /thub bstan skyed mdzad legs ldan nag po che/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gtsang ris mgon po sogs/ sa dge sgo sor tshogs skabs tshig 'di gnyis gang rung dor nas/ lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldanas ti sha /zhes khe3 paṇa 'a gyi gong du khrun /bsod nams zhing gyur yongs la mchod pa 'bul/ /lus can spyi dang ja 'di bsgrub pa'i ched/ /dka' spyad mi dang dud 'gror bcas pa kun/ /nub phyogs bde ldan zhing du padma la/ /skyes nas theg chen chos la longs spyod shog /ces ja mchod 'di ni ka smi ra pa'i ma hā paṇḍita'i srol 'dzin tshag mig tshogs pa spyi sos gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkra shis rab brtan pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /ro brgya bda' ba ljon shing phur ma'i bcud/ /phye mar lan tshwas ro bsgyur gas ba'i mchog /—464

ja mchod kyi rim pa bcud mchog nam mkha' mdzod kyi dga' ston/ (bdadus gsum rgyal sras slob mar bcas kun dang / /yang sgos nyi ma'i gnyen la mchod pa 'bul/ /grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba bi rū pa/ /'jig rten mig gcig lo chen 'brog mi'i zhabs/ /'jam dbyangs bdun sogs dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas la mchod pa 'bul/ /gnas lnga rigs pa'i gtsug rgyan a ti sha /'brom ston rje sogs rgya chen spyod brgyud dang / /zab mo lta brgyud nyams len byin rlabs kyi/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la mchod la 'bul/ khyad par rgyal ba gnyis pa btsong (3nasgo ba pa/ /rgyal tshab rje dang shes rab seng ge'i zhabs/ /dge 'dun mkhas grub bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing / /dga' ldan bstan 'dzin tshogs la mchod pa 'bul/ /lha rigs rlangs kyi gdung las gsang ba'i bdag /mi yi srid bzung drung chen tā'i si tu/ /byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis mtshon phag gru pa'i/ /gdan rabs bka' rgyud rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /rdo rje gur gyi mgon po phyag bzhi drug /'dod khams dbang phyug lha chen stobs 'phrog nag /rnam mang thos sras la sogs thub pa'i bstan/ /srung mdzad dam can rgya mtshor mchod pa 'bul/ /bsod nams byas pa' 'bras bu nam mkha'i mtha'/ /de srid bar du nam yang mi 'dzad pa/ /gro bzhin skyes kyi rnam par thar pa bzhin/ /'dzin phyir dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo/ /zhes chos grwa chen po dpal gyi rtses dang gi las chen pa gsum dang gnyer pa gnyis sogs kyis bskul ba ltar chos sde 'di nyid sde srid phag mo gru pas phyag dar nas btab cing deng sang (3ba)sa dge nyis tshogs kyi ra ma lug gi rigs 'di 'dra la ja mchod kyang rma bya'i sgro gdongs lta bu zhig dgos par mngon nas go bde 'bol rtsom gyi tshul du za tor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rab dwangs man shel zhun ma'i yol go'i nang / /pad rā ga mdangs 'phrog shong dkar rtse mo'i bcud/ /myangs pas rig pa gsal zhing lce bde ba/ /phun tshogs ro brgya'i rtser son btung ba 'di/ /rnam 'dren mched bdun mdo sde blo ka /brgyad brgya'i grangs ldan ri mo g.yas 'khyil ba'i/ /mgur nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan gdul bya'i rnar/ /sgrogs mdzad nyi ma'i gnyen la mchod pa 'bul/ /—465

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshe'i gsung 'bum/ 6sekhyod gsung zab dang rgya che'i 'dzin ma las/ /nyams len snying po'i cho ga sa le sbram/ /blo gsal rgyan du spud mdzad zhi 'tsho sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /ji ltar zhal gyis 'ches pa'i smon lam rnams/ /nyer grub thugs rje'i glog zhags snyigs dus mun/ /gzhil la ches myur beeḍūr 'od kyi rgyal/ /bcom ldan sman gyi bla mar mchod pa 'bul/ /dam bca' mi 'gyur rdo yi ri mo la/ /mkhyen brtse nus mtshungs macan mkhyen chos bsgrags dang / /mya ngan med dpal gser bzang rin cen zla/ /mtshan legs mched drug bcas la mchod pa 'bul/ /thub gsung chu gter las thon bden tshig gis/ /srid zhi'i gdung sel glegs bam zil mngar gyis/ /lus can mngon par mtho dang thar pa'i srog /zungs gyur dam pa'i chos la mchod pa 'bul/ /sems pa bcu drug phyogs skyong nyi zla zung / /gnod sbyin sde (4na)dpon rgyal chen rnam bzhi sogs/ /smon lamamachog 'di zhu gsol 'dzin cing spel/ /srung mdzad dge 'dun rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /'jig rten gsum gyi gser ldan lus phra'i ltor/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas thugs rje'i mkha' klong las/ /byin rlabs char kyis ring por bskyed bsrings pa/ /phan bde'i snye ma g.yur du za bar shog /khri srong lde btsan ched btab smon lam bzhin/ /thub pa'i bstan rgyas de 'dzin skyes bu dang / /sa spyod tshogasarnams sgrib dag sku tshe 'phel/ /dbu rmog legs btsan chos srid dar bar shog /rkang 'thung phur ma tsi na'i yul gru nas/ /'dren par ngal ba'i khur lci mi khal tshoges/ /sngar bsags sdig sgrib byang nas rgyal ba bdun/ /legs bzhugs dag pa'i zhing du skye bar shog /rig can blon po'i 'byung ba'i ri bo'i dbyibs/ /gnyis 'thung 'gying 'dra'i sa bkra shis pa'i ngos/ /'di phyi'i bde skyid rab 'phel sa chen pos/ /'jig rten 'degs nus de srid rgyas par shog /rgya ja'i phud mchod spyad pa'i 'bras bu las/ chosasdegawa ྾ zhal 'don du mang ja mdzad na/ /sala'i sman ljongasabasod namasagashin pa'i sar/ /mdo chog smon lam che btab so nam la/ /nyer brtson tshangasapar spyod pa'i chosasde 'di/ /'dzam gling mun sel sgron mer rtag 'bar shog /cesa'abyin lajug byed/ /byams mgon mchog gi sprul sku 'tshang rgya tshe/ /'dus pa dang por skyes nas dam chos kyi/ /bdud rtsis legs ngoms smin cing grol —466

ja mchod kyi rim pa bcud mchog nam mkha' mdzod kyi dga' ston/ (bdabar shog /mkha' la gza' skar 'phrod dang dus sbyor dge/ /nor 'dzin khyon la khri gdugs nyi 'od dro//bar snang phyogs mtshams dge mtshan ltas kyis khyab/ /bkra shis zla rgyas ltar 'phel med du byung / /zhes (4ba)bde gshegs bdun gyi smon lam cho ga dang 'brel ba'i ja mchod cig chos sde ri bo bde chen du 'dzugs rtsis kyis gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i/ /rin chen yol gor rkang 'thung phur ma'i bcud/ /'char ga'i thun mtshams mdangs 'dzin btung ba'i rtse/ tha kya seng ge des gsungs dam pa'i chos/ /theg gsum dge 'dun bcas la mchod pa 'bul/ /grub thob brgyad cu rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / /chos rgyal mes dbon mkhan slob lo paṇa tshogs/ /khyad par jo 'brom khu rngog shākya shrī/ /gangs can bstan pa'i sgron mer mchod pa 'bul/ /'khon rigs 'jam dpal rdo rje sa skya pa/ /rab 'byams shes bya kun gzigs bu ston rje/ /rgyal ba kun dngos blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /bka' drin mtshungs med rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /rgyal bstan gyen du 'degs la ma pham mgon/ /snying stobs rab brtan kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /spro mdzad 'phags chen dam pa sa spyod tshul/ /'dzin la yi rang dad pas mchod pa 'bul/ /bgrang yas rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /legs ldan lcam dral dpal mgon bdun cu sogs/ /rnam bzhi'i 'khor tshogs skyong la mthu rtsal can/ /phyi nang bstan srung rgya mtshor mchod pa 'bul/ /ro bde'i btung bar nyer zhen 'dod sred dang / /log 'tshos ma gos dkon mchog mchod pa'i rdzas/ /'khor gsum rnam dag nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo/ /rab 'byed skal bzang byang chen bar thob shog /rnam 'dren sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams/ /tsandas byug dang (ldan)mtshon cha gzas pa la/ /mnyam yang dgyes par bzhes nas legs byas kyi/ /phung po ma zad ster la spro dga' brtas/ /zhes myang stod dpal 'khor bde ba chen po'i tshogs chen kyi zhal 'don du 'os pa'i ja mchod cig dgos zhes mkhan chen ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal —467

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegrong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /ngo bo 'dus ma byas pa rig pa'i rtsal/ /ka dag kun bzang gnas lugs rang grol ba/ /gar dbang chos skur 'khrul dga'i lha bzhin du/ /gzhan min rang ngo shes pas mchod pa 'bul/ /rang gzhan dbyings la ye shes lnga ldan gdangs/ /ma 'dres shel tshon lta bur gsal ba'i 'ja'/ /zhi khro sgyu 'phrul longs skur nam mkha' mdzod/ /'byams klas sgo 'phar phye ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /thugs rje si rgyu'i dwangs mtshor 'dab brgya'i rtser/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes rdo rje sems/ /pad 'byung yab yum
