sprul skur phyi dang nang / /gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /dug lnga ye dag phung lnga gnas gyur la/ /lnga ldan 'khor lor thod phreng rigs lnga'i 'phrul/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag thams cad las grub par/ /gnyis med gnyis snang sprul bsgyur mchod pa 'bul/ /thabs mchog waṃ yig pad 'byung kun gsal mdangs/ /zhes pa e dbyings 'tsho rgyal yid 'dzin mar/ /mkha' la mkha' sbyor lta bu'i sgyu 'phrul can/ /dga' bzhi'i bde stong rgyas la mchod pa 'bul/ /sgo gsum bag yod ri shis nyes lhung chu'i/ /dug rnams tshul khrims yan lag brgyad ldan du/ /yongs (5ba)bsgyur sdom brtson padma saṃ bha wa/ /las 'bras phra zhib 'byed par mchod pa 'bul/ /da lta ji snyed chos kun dwangs ma'i mtshor/ /zla gzugs lta bur dri med spyan ras kya/ /mngon sum gzigs pa blo ldan mchog sred zhabs/ /thams cad mkhyen par nges la mchod pa 'bul/ /nang du dug gsum rgya bral rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gzhan nas ma 'tshol 'khor 'das thams cad la/ /snang ba 'byams klas padma rgyal po ches/ khams gsum dbang du sdud la mchod pa 'bul/ /sems can rnams kyi ma rig stug po'i mun/ /cig car sangs byed snang ba'i gter chen po/ /brgya phrag nyi ma'i 'od zer cher 'bar ba/ /grangs med 'gro ba 'dul la mchod pa 'bul/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba'i zhal/ /mthong thos dran dang reg pas rnam grol ba/ /'jigs med shākya seng ge'i nga ro yi/ /bdud tshogs 'joms par mdzad la mchod pa 'bul/ /gtum chen dpa' bo rdo rje rtse brgya'i mtshon/ /gdengs pas log 'dren lha min —468

ja mchod kyi rim pa bcud mchog nam mkha' mdzod kyi dga' ston/ (bkame yi mngal/ /lhung byed seng ge sgra sgrog mig stong can/ /lta ngan mu stegs 'dul la mchod la 'bul//'chol ba'i khro rgyal mthong ba'i mod nyid la/ /'khor 'das lha 'dre lag cha stabs gcig tu/ /'chor nus yid srubs klad 'gems gro bo lod/ /dregs pa tshar gcod mdzad la mchod pa 'bul/ /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bor legs mchod pas/ /gnas skabs srid zhi'i yon tan gong 'phel zhing / /skye bar thod 'phreng rtsal gyis rjes bzung nas/ /ring min chos nyid zad sar 'byol bar shog /ces chos longs sprul gsum/ thod phreng rigs lnga/ mtshan brgyad dang (6na)sbyar ba'i ja mchod cig rtsoms zhes lha bcas skye dgu'i 'dren mchog dpal sa skya pa gdan sa 'og nas bdag chen rin po che bsod nams bstan 'dzin dbang po byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bka' stsal ba dang du blangs te g.yo ru lho rgyud du skyes pa'i za hor gyi sngags smyon che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis lcags sprel sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /'khor 'das rgyal pos dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams/ /mtsho skyes sprul sku padma 'byung gnas dang / /dbyer med 'jam dpal rdo rje btsong kha pa/ /blo bzang grags pa'i dpal la mchod pa 'bul//dge 'dun kun 'dus bsod nams bye ba'i zhing / /yon tan 'byung gnas ngag dbang blo yi gter//skal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgon dang dbang chen lha/ /mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs la mchod pa 'bul/ /khyad par snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon che/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga gsang ba'i yum/ /blon po las mkhan bka' sdod tshogs rnams la/ /mchod pa 'bul lo 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod/ /ces gnas chung pe dar lcog tu ja mchod 'di 'dra zhig byung na legs 'dra zhes dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan dang /mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab gnyis kyis mtshams sbyar bas rkyen byas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /—469

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho' gsung 'bum/ ()stse//phun tshogs 'dod dgu ma sogs ja mchod kyi skor bzhugs so//sto//sgo wo mi kyi rgyal po'i gsung /oṃ ā ཿ /phun rdzas 'dod dgu'i na mtsho kun gyi sko 4la//ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya ma'i byin bsas nas//yid 'ong mtho sprin rgya mtsho wo po 'dis//skyabs gnas mchod 'os rgya mtsho ma lus mar//bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang //rgya bod brgyud pa'i bla ma thugs rje can//yi dam dkyil lor rgyal ba rgya mtsho tshogs//mar pa 'bul lo dngos grub rnam gnyis sto//skye dgu'i gnyen gcig thub dbang shākya'i kho/'phags brgyad ga sto gyi skabs 'ad sor gnas dang /tshes༅ la/'phags yul grub pa'i gas rgyan rigs 'dzan brgyad//gangs༅ shka pa'i bdag po padma yang dang /rgyun ja/'phags yul grub pa' gtsug rgyan mar me mdzad//gangs can bstan pa' bdag po btsong kha pa/zhes 'don pa spo//yul grub pa'i gtsug rgyan bi rū pa//gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa//ma rdzo pa 'bul lo dngos grub rnam gnyis slo//rang byung rdo rje lus kyi pho brang dbyings//snying dbus padma btsos pa'i drin can rje//rtsa khams dpa' bo ḍa zhi'i tshogs bcas la//mar pa tsol lo dngos grub rnam gnyis slo//mchod bya mar byed dag pa gdod ma'i skyos//gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa mchod pa'i mchog/zung khrug bde wo rang sems bla ma la//mar pa 'bul lo dngos grub rnam gnyis slo//rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung zhing skyong ba dang //rnal lhor sgrub tsho gos kyi grogs mdzad pa'i//gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho la//mar pa tsol lo dngos grub rnam gnyis slo//snod snyo rgyal ba'i dkyil lor pho bar shar//'dod yon byang tso sgrub pa'i grogs su gyur/'di 'dra'i lam bzang rnyed pa bla ma'i drin//dgye17 ༷ra rol 2na ) zhig rdo rje'i spun grogs rnams//

phun tshogs 'dod rgu ma sogs ja mchod kyi skor/ (bdango mtshar bkod pa'i rin cen snod yangs su/ /ro brgya'i bcud du 'khyil ba'i rgya ja'i mtsho /ye shes bdud rtsir rab spel 'dzad med gter/ /med byung kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin 'di/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang dbang padma 'byung / /jo 'brom chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa/ /dge 'dun lhun grub bsod nams yon tan gter/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sde la mchod pa 'bul/ /legs ldan rdo rje bkra shis stobs kyi rgyal/ /dge 'dun bkra shis tshar chen mkhyen brtse'i dbang / /gsar rnying chos kyi dbang lung man ngag dang / /rgyud bshad gdams pa stsol ba'i bla ma'i tshogs/ /khyad par snying dbus padma'i ze'u 'bru na/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag /dpal 'byor chos kyi bang mdzod kun dga'i dpyid/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bor mchod pa 'bul/ /sgrub chen bka' brgyad zil gnon tshe bdag lha/ /mi bskyod rdo rje bde dgyes ma he'i zhal/ /rnam par rgyal ma la sogs dngos grub kun/ /char 'bebs yi dam lha la mchod pa 'bul/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug dmag zor lha/ /myur mdzad mgon po rnam sras las gshin gsum/ /gur zhal pu tra beg tse stag zhen sogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtshor mchod pa 'bul/ /ma ning sngags srung thang lha khyab 'jug che/ /pe har tsi dmar rdor legs bdud mgon nag /dregs pa'i sde dpon mthu chen sde bzhi sogs// chos skyong gter srung tshogs la mchod pa 'bul/ /gnas skabs zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun grub/ /mthar thug rig pa'i ngo bo kun bzang mthong / /phyogs dus (2ba)kun tu bsam don ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ja mchod kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung 'di ni rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi zhal 'don du/ mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs dang dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes bkra shis 'khyil par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni smon 'gro paṇa chen gyis mdzad do/ /rgyal ba kun dngos mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /phyag na padma bsod nams mtshan can sogs/ /dngos brgyud rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams —471

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedang / /srid gsum phyag rgya zil gnon lha'i 'khor lo/ /'dod khams dbang phyug zhing skyong stobs 'phrog nag /bstan srung dam can rgya mtshor bcas rnams la/ /phun tshogs ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin rgya jas mchod/ /rnam par smon pa'i mchog thun 'dod pa'i don/ /thogs med lhun grub khyad par mngon spyod kyi/ /las sbyor mthu yis dgra bgegs dpung 'joms shing / /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa'ang lcags sbrul lor me'i spu gri'i sgrub pa tshugs skabs brag sna chos rje skyon bstan 'dzin gyis gtsos pa'i mtshams pa ba rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bande zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /ljon shing phur ma'i nying khus gtams pa'i snod/ /bdag nyid gar dbang phyag gis nyer bteg pa/ /gser sbyangs bum par bsgyur nang srid zhi'i bcud/ /yongs 'dus ro brgya bda' ba'i (3na)bdud rtsi 'dis/ /rang lus phung khams skye mched yan lag rnams/ /gdan gsum kun tshang mkha' 'gro rnam pa lnga/ /zag med bde bas tshe mtha' yas pa'i skur/ rab gsal srog gi zungs gyur mchod pa 'bul/ /dkar dmar thabs shes zhu bas dga' bzhi rgyal/ /'khor lo'i mdud grol rlung sems dhū tir 'dus/ /'chi med 'od snang 'ja' lus dwangs ma'i skur/ /legs shar gzhom gzhig bral ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /gsal mtshor zla bzhin snang ngor rtog tshogs 'khrul/ /ka dag dbyings su 'khor 'das dbyer med gshis/ /gnas lugs chos skur rang ngo 'phrod pa'i zhal/ /rab mthong don dam mchog gi mchod pa 'bul/ /spros bral mkha' la lhun grub zhi khro'i gdangs/ khugs 'byung 'char ba 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/ /mngon 'gyur tshe dbang rigs 'dzin padma dang / /skal mnyam ngo mtshar mchod pa 'di rmad byung / /zhes mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul ba ltar gsang sngags gsar rnying gi tshe chog dus 'brel chags pa'i ched du lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor la za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /'khor 'das rgyal por dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams/ /mtsho skyes sprul sku padma 'byung gnas —472

phun tshogs 'dod rgu ma sogs ja mchod kyi skor/ (bdadang / /dbyer med 'jam dpal rdo rje bcong kha pa/ /blo bzang grags pa'i dpal la mchod pa 'bul//dge 'dun kun 'dus bsod nams bye ba'i zhing / /yon tan 'byung gnas ngag dbang blo yi gter/ /skal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgon dang dbang chen lha/ /mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs la mchod pa 'bul/ /khyad par snang srid dregs pa'i (3ba)sde dpon che/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga gsang ba'i yum/ /blon po las mkhan bka' sdod tshogs rnams la/ mchod pa 'bul lo 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod/ /ces gnas chung pe gar lcog tu ja mchod 'di lta bu zhig byung na legs 'dra zhes dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan dang mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab gnyis kyis mtshams sbyor bas rkyen byas za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /'dod dgu'i char 'bebs bla ma yi dam lha/ /'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan re ma tī/ /'dod yon rnam lnga'i rgya ja 'di bzhes la/ /'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bstan pa'i dpal gyur ma dang / /dpon slob dgon gnas ma gnyis kyis 'phrin las 'chol// //sarba maṅga lo/ /—473

〈gangs can khyad nor 〉 dpe tshogs chen mo'i bsdu sgrig dang las zhugs mi sna'i mtshan tho/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'dzin pa gtso bo/ blo bzang lhun grub/ dbang grags/ tshe ring /bsdu sgrig 'gan 'dzin pa gzhen pa/ blo bzang stobs bcu/ phur bu chos 'phel/las zhugs mi sna/ blo bzang chos 'byor/ rgyal mtshan byams pa/ grags pa kun ldan/ tshe brtan rdo rje/blo bzang 'phags mchog /snyan grags/ blo bzang 'jigs med/ tshe ring ma/byams pa brtson 'grus/ rdo rje mtsho/ lhag pa sgrol ma/ tshe ring chos sgron/lha skyid/ bsod nams dbyangs can/ spen pa/deb 'di'i zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ tshe brtan rdo rje/ snyan grags/glog 'phrul yig 'jug pa/ lhag pa sgrol ma/ bsod nams dbyangs can/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring ma/
